tei:titleStmt.tei:title: bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ /chos sde smad cha wam̐ rtags can bzhugs so/ /oṃ swa sti/sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/
bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ /chos sde smad cha wam̐ rtags can bzhugs so/ /oṃ swa sti/sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/

tei:div.tei:p: bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ /chos sde smad cha wam̐ rtags can bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /bka' gsang zab gter bdun cu'i cha shas las/ /bsam yas mchims phu'i gter byon thugs sgrub rmad/ /bde gshegs bka' 'dus chos sde'i them byang 'god/ de yang o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi sgrub thabs sna tshogs pa las/ 'di ni bka' phur thugs gsum gyi ya gyal thugs sgrub yin pa ma zad rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi mtsho zhes rtsa gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa'i zab chos bla na med pa zhig yin te/ ka tho rin chen phreng ba las/ mnga' bdag rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis: za hor rig 'dzin pad+ma spyan drangs nas: brag dmar dpal gyi bsam yas pho brang bzhengs: bder 'dus bka' 'dus chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: las can skal ldan rje 'bangs smin par mdzad: bod la mdo sngags bstan pa'i nyi ma shar: bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis sems can smin par mdzad: lung rigs gnyis kyis theg chen chos sgra sgrogs: 'chad rtsod rtsom pas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs: rtsod bzlog nga ros mu stegs mtha' ru spyugs: rim gnyis spobs pas bstan pa'i srog shing btsugs: rgya chen rgyun mi 'chad pa'i gter kha sbas: snyan brgyud rgya mtsho gangs can ljongs su 'khyil: bstan pa'i sa gnad mi 'jig me btsa' bsdams: mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gtsug lag chos 'khor bzhengs: 'di phyi bod 'bangs skyob pa'i zhal gdams bkod: man ngag rin chen phreng ba'i tshom bu bkram: gsang sngags bstan pa mtha' ru rgyas par mdzad: rje la zhus pa'i bka' gnang gegs med grub: de nas lha sras mu khri btsan po dang : rje 'bangs rgya mtsho bka' yi 'bangs bcas nas: bsam yas dam pa'i rgya mkhar rtse dgu'i mdun: pho brang dbu rtse rim gsum dag la ni: ma 'ongs lung bstan zhus pa snga ma dang :

mchims phur bder 'dus skor gsum bar pa'i skabs: phyi ma khra 'brug bka' 'dus zhal phyes tshe: zhus lan zhal gdams le'u bdun ma dang : snga phyi thams cad bkra shis mtha' rten du: rje 'bangs rgyal blon dgongs pa rdzogs pa yi: smon lam bsam pa lhun 'grub rgyab chos bzhag: zhal gdams gsol 'debs phyogs gcig bsgrigs nas su: bskyed rdzogs gnyis bcas lag len gdams pa gnang : man ngag bcu gsum ngo sprod rnam lnga bzhag: ces gsungs pa bzhin thog mar mnga' bdag btsan po sogs rje 'bangs snying gi bu dgu la bder 'dus gsum gyi smin grol phog pa dang*/ bar du bsam yas dbu rtse rim gsum du ma 'ongs lung bstan zhus len rgyas par bstsal ba/ tha ma khra 'brug tu lha sras mu khri btsan po sogs las can 'dus pa'i 'khor rnams la/ bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho zhal phyes shing zhus len zhal gdams le'u bdun ma bka' stsal zhing snga phyi de thams cad kyi rgyab chos su bsam pa lhun 'grub ma man ngag bcu gsum bcas gung thang la thog tu skyel len tshul du bstsal bar lung bstan pa'i tshul yang de nyid las/ gangs can bod yul bsam yas rdo rje gdan: lha sa khra 'brug rdo rje'i rwa g.yas g.yon: 'di nyid 'dzam gling sa yi lte ba'i tshul: kho bos brda bzhi bka' yi gnang ba'i yul: da lta spel bar mi bya yi ger gdab: nam zhig srin yul 'dul zhing bgrod pa'i lam: mang yul kha la bya ba gung thang la: bal bod mtshams su bslebs skabs nyid la gtad: gdams pa'i shog dril rje yi thugs dam mdzod: snyan brgyud dbyangs can brda yi ri mor gzug: da lta'i rje 'bangs rnams la smon lam thob: dge bsnyen shan+ta pu ris gter srung gyis: mchims phu brag btsan tha tshig gnyer la bskos: ma 'ongs las can rnams la smon lam thob: zhes gsungs pa bzhin phyi mor gung thang la ru bod kyi rje 'bangs la zhal chems su gdams pa ste/ de ltar thog mtha' bar gsum chos 'khor rim pa gsum dang zhus len man ngag zhal chems dang bcas pa phyogs gcig tu dril ba'i chos sde chen po 'di nyid gu ru'i shin tu gces par mdzad de jo mo mtsho rgyal la ma 'ongs pa'i don du zab mo'i gter du bsdams par gnyer kha gtad cing gter gyi gnas kyang gangs can rdo rje gdan dpal bsam yas gtsug lag khang dang 'brel ba'i mchims phu brag dmar ke'u tshang zhes sngar bder 'dus gsum gyi chos 'khor dang po zhal phyes pa'i gnas de nyid du sbas par mdzad pas/

zugs pa rtsa ba lta bu'i dbus gter gyi khongs su gtogs pa bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen sogs lam gyi nyams len ma tshang ba med cing zab khyad rmad du byung ba'i chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang 'god pa la/ thugs sgrub stod cha e rtags can la'ang rtsa ba gter gzhung gi skor/ yan lag kha skong skor/ chog khrigs sna tshogs kyi skor bcas gsum las/ dang po rtsa ba gter gzhung gi skor la/ ka) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: lha sras dang rje 'bangs grogs rnams la zhal gdams gnang ba sgrub khog ka tho rin chen phreng ba/

1-27 kha)rig 'dzin srog sgrub yid bzhin nor bu las: bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsang ba'i sgrub thabs/ 28-48 ga) rig 'dzin srog sgrub yid bzhin nor bu las: gu ru pad+ma rgyal po snang srid zil gnon gyi las byang bde gshegs kun 'dus/ 49-118 nga) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: byin 'bebs tshangs pa'i gaṇ+ḍi'i phreng ba/ 119-137 ca) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: 'dzab dgongs ye shes don gsal/ 138-143 cha) rig 'dzin srog sgrub yid bzhin nor bu las: gtor bsngos bsdus pa phrin las myur mgyogs/ 144-161 ja) rig 'dzin srog sgrub yid bzhin nor bu las: bskang gsol 'dod rgu mchog sbyin/ 162-202 nya) thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ gshin po rjes 'dzin mkha' spyod zab lam/ 203-223 ta) rgyal ba kun 'dus khyab bdag rol pa las: dam can rgya mtsho'i gsol mchod phrin las myur mgyogs/ 234-299 ༈ gnyis pa yan lag kha skong la/ tha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhun mar smon lam/ 300-305 ༈ gsum pa chog khrigs sna tshogs kyi skor la/ da) thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun 'grub/ 306-310 na) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ bsam lhun las byang chog khrigs ye shes sprin phung*/ 313-438 pa) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi brgyud 'debs dbang bzhi'i bcud 'bebs/ 439-440 pha) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ las byang ngag 'don chog khrigs su bsdebs pa khyer bde don zab/ 441-529 ba) rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi gsol 'debs bsdus pa/ 530-531 ma) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ rtsa ba gcig dril gyi las rim khrigs chags su bkod pa dngos grub char 'bebs/ 532-554 tsa) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi bdag 'jug gi rim pa dbang bzhi'i ye shes dpal skyed/

555-583 tsha) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ las bzhi lhun grub dang bcas pa'i sbyin sreg rigs lnga'i rgyan/ 584-635 dza) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las gshin po rjes 'dzin mkha' spyod zab lam gyi zur 'debs thar lam 'dren pa'i shing rta/ 636-670 wa) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ spros bcas sgrub chen gyi stong thun rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i dgyes dbyangs/ 671-751 zha) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ spyi dril gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun grub kyi sgrub pa'i khog dbub mchog thun 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs/ 752-883 bcas chos sde nyer gcig bzhugs so/ bde gshegs kun 'dus thugs sgrub rgya mtsho'i phul/ /rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes/ /gcig chog kun 'dus zab chos rgya mtsho 'di/ /tshogs gnyis yongs 'dus chos sbyin rgya mtshor spel/ /de slad dpal mgon bla ma yi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang*/ gang la me tog phog pa yi/ /lhag pa'i lha dang gang de'i chos/ /rgyun dkon gsung rab bsdu skrun dang*/ chad nye'i smin grol rgyun spel slad/ /'di yang bka' gter sri zhu ru/ /e waṃ dpe skrun khang nas bsgrubs/ /des kyang snying po'i ring lugs 'di/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /snyigs ma'i rgud pa yongs su zhi/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog / zhes pa'ang sgo chen sprul ming gsang sngags bstan 'dzin pas gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'grub par gyur cig/ // ka)༄༅/ /bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: lha sras dang rje 'bangs grogs rnams la zhal gdams gnang ba sgrub khog ka tho rin chen phreng ba'o: bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: mnga' bdag rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis: za hor rig 'dzin pad+ma spyan drangs nas: brag dmar dpal gyi bsam yas pho brang bzhengs:

bder 'dus bka' 'dus chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: las can skal ldan rje 'bangs smin par mdzad: bod la mdo sngags bstan pa'i nyi ma shar: bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis sems can smin par mdzad: lung rigs gnyis kyis theg chen chos sgra sgrogs: 'chad rtsod rtsom pas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs: rtsod bzlog nga ros mu stegs mtha' ru spyugs: rim gnyis spobs pas bstan pa'i srog shing btsugs: rgya chen rgyun mi 'chad pa'i gter kha sbas: snyan brgyud rgya mtsho gangs can ljongs su 'khyil: bstan pa'i sa gnad mi 'jig me btsa' bsdams: mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gtsug lag chos 'khor bzhengs: 'di phyi bod 'bangs skyob pa'i zhal gdams bkod: man ngag rin chen phreng ba'i tshom bu bkram: gsang sngags bstan pa mtha' ru rgyas par mdzad: rje yis zhus pa'i bka' gnang gegs med grub: de nas lha sras mu khri btsan po dang : rje 'bangs rgya mtsho bka' yi 'bangs bcas nas: bsam yas dam pa'i rgya mkhar rtse dgu'i mdun: pho brang dbu rtse rigs gsum dag la ni: ma 'ongs lung bstan zhus pa snga ma dang : mchims phur bder 'dus skor gsum bar pa'i skabs: phyi ma khra 'brug bka' 'dus zhal phyes tshe: zhus lan zhal gdams le'u bdun ma dang : snga phyi thams cad bkra shis mtha' rten du: rje 'bangs rgyal blon dgongs pa rdzogs pa yi: smon lam bsam pa lhun 'grub rgyab chos bzhag: zhal gdams gsol 'debs phyogs gcig bsgrigs nas su: bskyed rdzogs gnyis bcas lag len gdams pa gnang : man ngag bcu gsum ngo sprod rnam lnga bzhag: de'ang ma 'ongs bod 'bangs la dmigs nas: zhal gdams skor rnams bzhed don so so ltar: rin chen gter kha rnams la bkram ste sbas: kha byang yang byang rje 'bangs nyer lngar gtad: ma 'ongs lung byang gong thang la thog tu: lha sras mu khri btsan pos dbu mdzad pa: jo mo mtsho rgyal thugs sras bu lnga la: mi brjed dran pa'i smon lam dang bcas gnang :

byon skyel yan chad le'u dang po'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de yang khra 'brug tu bla ma'i thugs sgrub rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye skabs: rje 'bangs grogs lngas gser g.yu rin chen sna lnga'i maṇ+ḍal phul zhing rje'i gdung rgyud kyi tha ma dang dus ma 'ongs pa'i skabs bcas ji ltar 'byung : de'i dus su phyi nang chos kyi nyams len ji ltar bgyid: spyir gsang sngags chos thams cad 'o ma'i rgya mtsho ltar snang ba la: bcud bsdus kyi snying po mar lta bu'i gdams ngag ji ltar lags: bskyed rdzogs sngags gsum gyi 'bras bu dngos grub kyi drod tshad smin pa la: thugs rje'i sgrub thag gang nye: dam pa'i man ngag gi snying po tshig nyung la don 'brel ba gdams ngag gcig la man ngag kun rdzogs pa gsung du gsol: zhes zhus pas: rje btsun gyis: e ma nyon dang lha sras bod kyi rje: gdams pa'i snod bzang grogs lngas legs par soms: lha sras sku ring bstan pa nam mkha' 'dra: chos srid chab 'bangs nyi zla'i phreng ba bsgrengs: gnam bskos lha yi gdung rabs 'ga' zhig nas: rje la zhal ngo bdud kyi sprul pa 'byung : rgyal po dud 'gro'i ming can gdug sems can: dpung pa g.yas su mi dge'i sha mtshan 'byung : de tshe mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gtsug lag bshig: chos khrims bshig nas bdud kyi khrims kha 'cha': rnam smin bskyed pa'i rgyal blon mang zhig 'byung : de yi rkyen bslangs bod kyi mdun gros 'gyur: re zhig bar du dus bzhi'i rnam par gnas: de tshe nyid kyi gdung rabs skyong ba yi: da lta'i rje 'bangs grogs lnga yang yang 'byung : lha sras nyid kyang skye ba du ma 'byung : da lta bskal pa yar ldan bzang po'i 'phro: smon lam bgyis pas ci btab 'grub par 'gyur: phyi nang chos kyi dbye gsal go rim ni: phyi ru thos pas chos kyi sgro 'dogs chod: sgro 'dogs bcad pas sems kyi the tshom chod:

nang du nyams len gnas lugs ngo bo skyongs: rang ngo shes pas rig pa'i btsan sa zin: gsang sngags man ngag brgyad khri bzhi stong yang : nyams su blangs pas gcig shes kun grol yin: bcud bsdus snying po'i nges don ma rtogs na: tshad ma'i chos rnams gnas skabs bde ba tsam: byang sems bral rnams dge ba'i rtsa ba rul: gsang sngags 'bras bu rtogs pa bcud bsdus mar: snying po kun gyi yang snying nyams len yin: khas len du ma mi 'da' zhal gdams gnad: bskyed rim snang stong bdag 'dzin med pa yin: rdzogs rim sems kyis bsu skyel bcos ma zhugs: grags stong sngags ni bzang ngan sgro mi btags: bskyed rim thun mong dngos grub mchog la gzhol: mchog gi bstan pa thob pa drod tshad yin: thugs kyi sgrub pa bla mar mos gus yin: ci mdzad legs par mthong na 'grub pa yin: tshig gcig don kun rdzogs pa gsang sngags yin: ro gcig bcud kun 'dus pa ting 'dzin zas: mdangs gcig phyogs kun gsal ba ye shes che: rgyan gcig kun la mdzes pa yid bzhin nor: gdan gcig kun la thob pa chos sku'i sa: grogs gcig kun la mthun pa gnyug ma'i gshis: bu gcig kun las brtse ba dbang po'i dwangs: nor gcig kun las phyug pa sems nyid gter: rdzong gcig kun las btsan pa rdo rje'i gur: mtshon gcig kun las rno ba shes rab mtshon: dmag gcig kun las hrag pa dug lnga'i dpung : bzlog thabs gcig gis kun thub rdzogs pa che: 'gag gcig kun las dom pa rgyu 'bras yin: zin nas gtong mi shes pa 'khor ba'i btson: mthar ni phyir mi ldog pa bde 'gro'i chos: 'phrad nas gang la 'bag pa 'tshogs pa yin: reg phung 'khor ba'i rgyu bsags bag zon gyis: lha sras dam 'dzin rje yi thugs la bcag: rje 'bangs grogs lngas ma brjed yid la chongs: gcong chen mdze pho dug nad ngad ldan bzhin: rdzogs ldan rtsod ldan yang mtha' snyigs ma'i snyigs:

deng nas bzung ste yang snyigs 'byung ba'i bar: dung dung gdung bas dus drug gsol ba thob: dus mtha'i skabs su ma gdung bu skad ltar: gdung dbyangs skyo shas dang bcas gsol ba thob: tho rangs skabs su bag med ma nyal bar: bde chen zhing sgrub gsal gdab gsol ba thob: nam langs ma yengs da lta'i dus la soms: chos skyong rgyal pos chos kyi bstan pa skyongs: nyi shar ma yengs snang ba rgyas kyis thob: kho bo srin yul bzhud sogs mi rtag sgoms: nyin phyed spyod lam rnam bzhi tshogs 'khor phul: dngos su lung ston tshes bcur dag snang mjal: phyed yol lnga brgya mar 'grib dus la soms: dug lnga lam 'khyer dug gsum chag med sbyongs: nyi thal 'byung bzhi 'dus pa bral la bskyed: nga nyid sman lhar mos pas tshe 'phrang sgrol: nyi nub sgyu lus gnad gcod drag por gzhig: nga nyid spyi bor snang mthar rlung sems bsres: srod la bar do rnam pa drug la mos: bdag la gsol btab rigs drug 'khrul rgyun 'chad: srod 'phros las dbang sdug bsngal mun sred skabs: bdag la gsol btab gnas ngan sgo khegs 'gyur: nam phyed skye gnas bzhi la 'jigs srid sgoms: bdag la gsol btab sngon gyi 'phro mtha' sad: man ngag bcu gsum nyams len snying por bzhag: lha sras rje 'bangs ma 'ongs de ltar spyod: zhal gdams le'u don tshan gnyis pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: yang de'i tshe lha sras rje 'bangs rnams kyis gser shwa ba can gyi maṇ+ḍal nor bu rin po che'i rigs khyad par nor bu nī laṃ dha mañja rtag sha dhe wa hu ya gzhan yang zhang po rgya'i pha 'bab gnam sde brgyad gnam skyogs 'bras chang dwangs mas bkang nas phul zhing phyis ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus de 'dra ba la rje btsun gu ru rin po che'i thugs rjes phyi thag mi chad pa'i sgrub pa las rim khyad par ma 'ongs sems can rnams kyi 'phel 'grib sogs lung bstan gyi rnam dbye bcas bdag cag la gnang bar zhu zhus pas:

rje btsun gyi phyag g.yas lha sras kyi mgor bzhag: g.yon mtsho rgyal gyi drangs pa'i skyems shig bzhes te zhal gdams su gsungs pa'o: e ma nyon dang lha sras bod kyi rje: ma 'ongs lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: las stobs bzang po bdud kyi dbang du 'gro: de 'dra'i skabs su nga la gsol ba thob: rje yis dbu mdzad las can rje 'bangs rnams: (hrī) ma 'ongs dag snang sgyu mar snang ba'i tshe: lha sku stong ra gzugs sku sgyu ma'i ngang : dran rig snang mtha'i ngo bo sgrub pa la: rang nyid rnam snang chos bdun ldan pa'i sku: nga nyid zung 'jug bde chen rgyal por sgoms: spros bcas spros med bskyed rdzogs zung ldan las: zhing khams lha khrid dkyil 'khor thog ma'o: (ka) ma 'ongs rin chen gter la spyod pa'i tshe: thog mar yar tshes dge ba'i dus nyid du: mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor legs par bshams: skal ldan rig ma bcu drug rgyan gyis spras: rang nyid he ru ka yi cha lugs 'chang : rang nyid bde chen dpa' bo yab yum sgoms: rten 'brel sna tshogs bgyis pas phun tshogs gyur: zhal gdams gter gyi lde mig dang po'o: sa ma ya: (kha) ma 'ongs sems can 'dod chags las gyur pa'i: 'byung ba dgrar langs sa bcud nyams pa'i tshe: dgos 'dod lhun grub nor lha'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs: bkra shis 'khor ba'i rdzas rnams bsags nas su: rang nyid gnod sbyin dbang phyug chas su bgyid: nga nyid pad+ma rgyal po sgeg pa'i gzugs: mkha' 'gro dbang sdud 'bum bcas bskyed par bya: dngos grub nor 'gugs zhal gdams gnyis pa'o: sa ma ya: (ga) ma 'ongs sems can zhe sdang las gyur pa'i: mtha' 'khob dmag dpung dbus su 'khrigs pa'i tshe: gtsug lag chos 'khor 'jig pas nyen gyur na: smug nag khro bo dbal gsham dkyil 'khor bzhengs: rang nyid dmod pa sngags pa'i chas su bzhugs: nga nyid sde brgyad dpung bcas gsal bar bskyed: dmag dpon rā hu la la gnyer byang gtad:

bdud sde dpung 'joms mngon spyod gsum pa'o: sa ma ya: (nga) ma 'ongs sems can gti mug po las gyur tshe: na tsha 'byung bzhi 'khrugs dang 'chi ltas phog: tshe rabs rnam smin lus la 'khor ba'i tshe: ye shes gsal rdzogs sman lha'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs: rang nyid a tsa ra yi cha lugs 'chang : nga nyid sman lha rab khros seng sgrogs sgoms: sman sgrub rlung sgrub tshe sgrub gnad du bsnun: 'chi med 'ja' lus gsal rdzogs bzhi pa'o: sa ma ya: (ca) ma 'ongs sems can nga rgyal las gyur pas: chags sdang dus mtha'i me bzhin 'bar zh-ing 'khrugs: phyi nang mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe: bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal byed dkyil 'khor bzhengs: rang nyid drang srong gnam lcags rtsibs zhus brgyan: nga nyid gtum po gnod sbyin bzhi bcas sgoms: bsrung bzlog phyi nang 'khor lo drwa mig gdab: mi shigs rdo rje'i gur khang lnga pa'o: sa ma ya: (cha) ma 'ongs sems can phrag dog las gyur pas: mtha' bzhi dbus 'khrugs bod 'bangs sil bur 'thor: skyabs med sems can bar do ci bzhin du: sbas yul nags khrod dben ri 'grim pa'i tshe: dpa' bo 'jigs pa brgyad skyob dkyil 'khor bzhengs: gar ging dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i chas su zhugs: rten 'brel ji srid rdzas kun tshags su bcug: nga nyid rig 'dzin kun 'dus ngo bor sgoms: dgu 'grigs lnga 'grigs sum 'grigs rgyan gyis spras: dben ri sbas gnas mthun rkyen drug pa'o: sa ma ya: (ja) ma 'ongs sems can chos la the tshom zh-ing : gsang sngags zab lam gnyan po smad pa yis: sbas yul srung mas 'khu zhing bka' chad 'bebs: lam log lam gol rkyen stobs che ba'i tshe: nyi ma 'od zer dkyil 'khor legs par bzhengs: tshogs bskang rgyal brngan lha 'dre dam bsgrag bya: gser skyems brngan cha la sogs legs par bsgrengs: bro gar glu dbyangs dam bskang kho nar 'bad: rang nyid rnal 'byor spyod pa'i lugs su spyod:

nga nyid nyi ma 'od zer cha lugs sgoms: nam mthongs phye zhing lha 'dres phrin las sgrub: sbas yul sgo 'byed rten 'brel bdun pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: (nya) gang zhig snyigs ma lnga bdo'i gnas skabs su: skye 'gro kun kyang sil bor 'thor nas su: ri rlung shwa rdel phyogs su 'bros pa dang : khyad par phyogs med bgrod dang dben rir snyogs: lam 'phrang 'jigs pa'i skyi g.ya' 'grim pa'i tshe: bsad khyer jag chom lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul sogs: ya nga rab rgyu bag tshar gyur pa la: nga nyid phyag rgya bzhi yi gtum chas sgoms: rang nyid dmod pa ngan sngags chas su zhugs: sa ma ya: (ta) mi rtag sgyu ma'i grogs po g.yar khang lus: 'byung bzhi na tsha 'khrugs nas 'chi ltas phog: nad gcod drag po mi bzod sdug bsngal bskyed: 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi 'byung lnga'i kha dog brten: 'byung bzhi so sor bral la nye ba'i tshe: nga nyid bde chen rgyal po'i ngo bor sgoms: rang nyid longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas su bgyis: sa ma ya: (tha) nam zhig tshe yi 'phen pa zad pa'i tshe: rtsa gsum 'khor lo drug rnams rim par sdud: snang mched thob gsum shar nas lus sems bral: rnam shes myu gu me tog yal ba'i tshe: nga nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor zab lam sgoms: dran rig 'od lus a yig chos skur 'phro: rang nyid rnam snang chos bdun khregs se bzhag: sa ma ya: (da) bzang ngan las dbang rkyen gyi rtar bskyon nas: bar do gnyis snang 'jigs skrag shar ba'i tshe: thams cad sgyu mar shes pa'i dpa' gdeng skyed: sngon byung srid pa'i bag chags sha gzugs la: ma chags ma zhen sgyu mar shes par gyis: nga nyid dus gsum mkhyen pa'i ngo bor sgoms: rang nyid bskyed rdzogs zung ldan gsal stong ngang : sa ma ya: (a)ma 'ongs skye gnas 'du byed rnam bzhi yis: 'phro 'du srid pa'i chu rlung rab g.yos nas: byer zhig stong la khru chad had por lus: sgyu ma'i grong la smig rgyu spyod pa bzhin:

rtag mi thub ste dri za'i grong khyer ltar: ngos bzung cing med grog ma'i tshang shig 'dra: bya gcan yid mtshar 'tshogs pa'i spu ris bzhin: yid brtan mi snang gar mkhan lag dang mtshungs: rgyal 'gong 'tshogs pa'i sgo them ji bzhin du: yid brtan mi rung srid pa'i phung shul 'dra: de dus gdams ngag snying po 'di kho na: lha sras rje bo'i thugs la de skad 'chang : zhes gsungs so: yang lha sras kyis dbu mdzad rje 'bangs grogs rnams dang : dkyil 'khor kun gyi 'byung gnas ma cig mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal gyis saṃ skṛ ta'i skad kyis rig pa rdo rje'i glu ru gdangs nas maṇ+ḍal phul te zhus pa: kye hoḥ lam dha hi k+ṣa: ko la ka ra mu pa sam: gu ru in+ḍa mu la k+ṣaṃ: kal pa wa dī po ro tsa: swa pa swa ra pa ti: de'i lan du rje btsun gyi dpal chen phyag rgya zil gnon gyi ting 'dzin dang bcas: lta ba mi shigs pa rdo rje'i gur khang dum bu gcig tu lhun gyis gnas pa'i ngang nas 'di skad ces gsungs pa'o: e ma nyon dang lha sras bod kyi rje: dbang gi dpal mo mtsho rgyal brda ru zungs: rje 'bangs ye shes grogs rnams rig pas zungs: da lta dus dang bskal pa yar ldan te: mkhan slob chos gsum nyi zla zung 'brel te: rje 'bangs nyer lnga tho rangs skar chen bkrag: 'jigs skyob chos khrims rgyal khrims bka' nan lci: mi'am dpon po lha yi rje bo byed: de yi bla ma mkhan po lha bla ma: de yi slob dpon 'ja' lus rig 'dzin bdag: de yi maṇ+ḍal gsang mdzod theg dgu'i yum: de yi ram 'degs rigs lnga lnga tshom lnga: de la shes rab 'brel pa sum cu lnga: 'gos rgan lha bzang klu dpal li khri sogs: phyi pa nang par 'jug pa'i chos blon bcas: sgrol ma'i rig ldan lha yi btsun mo'i tshogs: lang tshos kyud pa'i rgyal btsun blon 'bangs 'khor: dpung tshogs bzhi ldan cod pan phyogs su phyar: gangs can bod yul bsam yas rdo rje gdan:

lha sa khra 'brug rdo rje'i rwa g.yas g.yon: 'di nyid 'dzam gling sa yi lte ba'i tshul: kho bos brda bzhi bka' yi gnang ba'i yul: da lta spel bar mi bya yi ger gdab: nam zhig srin yul 'dul zhing bgrod pa'i lam: mang yul kha la bya ba gung thang la: bal bod mtshams su bslebs skabs nyid la gtad: gdams pa'i shog dril rje yi thugs dam mdzod: snyan brgyud dbyangs can brda yi ri mor gzug: da lta'i rje 'bangs rnams la smon lam thob: dge bsnyen shan+ta pu ris gter srung gyis: mchims phu brag btsan tha tshig gnyer la bskos: ma 'ongs las can rnams la smon lam thob: 'di nyid 'byin pa'i dus dang sa rtags ni: sum cu'i kha ral nyi shu dus dang mtshungs: khyad par 'di nas gdung rabs mi ring bar: rnam smin skyid rgyal phyogs dang phyogs nas 'byung : lo skor dus dang lo zla so so ru: gdams pa 'di nyid nye bar mkho ba 'byung : de dus lha sras skye ba rim brgyud dang : da lta'i rje 'bangs grogs lngas nges par 'byin: sa steng thon pa tsam gyis sgom sgrub dang : spel sbyong 'dzin 'chang klog la nan tan gyis: thugs rjes skyob nges the tshom bor la sgrubs: pad 'byung nga ni sems can don las med: 'di phyi don yod nga phyir 'jug rlom na: nyin mtshan dus drug nga la gsol ba thob: dad ldan mdun du nga nyid sprul pa re: mo gus can la sgo nyal lta bu yod: khyad par tshes bcu'i dus su mngon sum mjal: gsol btab rab gnas thebs rnams dag zhing bgrod: rnga yab gling du bdag mjal the tshom med: lhag par sems can sdug bsngal nyam thag tshe: blo yi gzu dpang nga nyid gzu bor zhog: 'di yi go rim yi ge 'phrin pa bcas: skal ldan kun gyi rna bar sim par gyis: ci phyir pad 'byung nga la mi mos pa'i: da lta'i bdud blon ngan btsan dbang chen dang : dus gsum rgyal bas chos 'khor gang bskor du: dam nyams phal cher sdig to can du skyes:

khyad par lha bdud bden gnyis rtsod pa'i tshe: lha rgyal bdud pham yi mug ga chad kyis: smon lam log pa thams cad dus gcig 'tshogs: chos rgyal gdung la bdud kyi sprul pa 'byung : de yis bstan pa'i sa gnad me btsa' bshig: de yi mthun grogs 'gong po spun dgus bsgrub: 'gong po lhar brten srid pa'i lha rab 'khros: de yis bod khams bsod nams phywa g.yang rgud: lnga bcu pa yan dar rgud res mos 'byung : bzhi bcu'i mgo tshugs chos srid brtse ldan 'khrugs: dug dang nad mug mtshon cha'i bskal pa dar: nyi shu pa la mi dge sna tshogs 'byung : ma mo 'khrugs pas dmar nad chu ltar khol: brtan ma 'khrugs pas sa bcud zhag rnams nyams: rgyal po 'khrugs pas dge bshes dmag khrims g.yo: srin mo 'khrugs pas ban btsun sdom pa 'phrog: gri pho 'khrugs pas srin rdzong gri khrag 'khyil: pho lha 'khrugs pas sde dpon gri ru 'chi: yul lha 'khrugs pas nang 'khrug dme rgyal byed: skyes lha 'khrugs pas srung ma'i mgon skyabs bral: dam sris srid brku rgyal srid dmangs kyis 'phrog: gsang sngags chos gshe sangs rgyas bstan pa nyams: dam med dregs pa las bskul sde dgon 'khrugs: bka' 'gal khrims ral dam nyams seng ltar 'gying : bdud kyi mkhan pos bstan pa'i dmar lam byed: dam sri sde dpon 'khrugs pas go ra 'dzin: bdud blon nag pos phyogs bzhir g.yab mo brgyag: yul gru thams cad slang tshan yos bzhin 'khrugs: de tshe nag phyogs bdud kyi chos la mos: ma 'ongs nga yi rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams: gtsug lag chos 'khor gza' klu rgyal pos gnyer: mkha' yi rten 'brel gza' rgod chen por dbang : dbyings kyi rten 'brel dkor bdag shel ging gtso: sa la dbang bsgyur klu rgyal thod pa dkar: 'di gsum rdo rje theg pa'i gnyer kha'o: khyad par mtha' bzhi 'khrugs nas dbus su lhags: nyi shu kha ral mu stegs dmag tshogs g.yo:

bhang gha la yi rgyal po dmag thag gcod: de nas mkha' ru phyogs nas rim bzhin du: mu stegs nag po sog kha'i gdong bzhin rgyug: bal yul nyi ma khud kyi klu bdud de: ma 'ongs lha sa'i lcags po ri la chags: de nas mal gro gzi chen pho brang 'debs: lcags po ri gdong klu gyong gdong du grags: de tshe dpal chen chu bo ri yi khrod: gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos sgra sgrogs: drang srong mnga' brnyes rnal 'byor pa zhig 'byung : gnod sbyin bu mo za byed rgod ma kha: byang phyogs sde dpon zhig gi phyogs la 'byung : de tshe po tā la ru na bun 'khrigs: snang srid khyab pa'i nag mo glog ma sprin: nam langs nyi shar de dang bsdebs nas 'byung : de gsum 'tshogs pa'i snga ltas dang po la: 'go ba'i nad la nag po sum bsgril 'byung : rlung dang mu ge mtshon gyi bskal pa dar: sdig sprul sdig rgyal dge slong dmag sna 'dren: bsags pa'i nor zas dmag las 'khrug par rdzogs: de tshe sde dpon phal cher gri ru 'chi: dge rgyal bris pa'i ri mo shul rjes tsam: chos rgyal gdung rgyud nyin mo'i skar ltar yal: lha sras nyid kyang 'khor ba'i zhen pa ldog: ma 'ongs ri dwags rmas ma ji bzhin du: bag zon nang nas rig pa lcags su bcug: sa mkhar ri rdzong mi yi blo rten tsam: 'chi ba'i tha ma rlung bshod thim la 'byung : de bas sbas yul phyogs med dben ri 'grim: kun la gces pa rang srog yin pa'i phyir: bros zhogs byol ba mi yi mtshan nyid yin: de nas bdud sprul dmag gis ma reg tsam: chos rgyal gtan du dran pas de ltar bzung : ma yengs kho bo nga la gsol ba thob: snga phyi legs nyes 'di yang rten 'brel gnad: ma nyams gyur na mi tshe lo grangs su: tshe yi lhag lus bar du bde bas bsrings: 'bring po rnams kyang lo skor gcig gnyis gsum: tha ma rnams kyang dus dran nam bgyis skyongs: khyad par mos gus gsol btab kho na gzab:

lha srin dam bsgrags sa gnad bcos ka gtso: kha byang yang byang lung bstan ltar du spyad: dang po tshod yod blo yis mi su zh-ing : tha ma 'gyod pa'i khur gyis mi skyel gyis: nges par gdams so rje 'bangs ye shes grogs: dam chos don tshan yang snying 'dus pa yi: bka' yi them byang 'gag tu dril ba 'di: 'dzin pa'i sa rtags dbus yul bdud kyis 'dzin: sa steng g.yo ba'i mtha' dmag dbus su 'khrigs: bsam yas rta mgrin mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs: jo shāka mdun du khrag gi rlangs pa 'khrigs: gtsug lag sgrub gnas bshig nas sil bur 'thor: byang sems skyes bu mang po gri ru 'chi: bdud sprul sde dpon mang po snying khrag 'pho: chos spyod sde pa mang po dmangs su 'bebs: dmag 'khrug nad yams mi lo bco brgyad 'byung : bdud kyis ma bslus chos byed nyin skar tsam: me chu rlung gsum 'khrugs pa'i na bun bzhin: phyi dang nang med dbyar sos rlan ltar 'brub: de dus nga nyid sku yi sprul pa'i cha: lo tsā sangs rgyas ye shes khyod la gdams: gsung sprul bai ro tsa na khyod la gdams: thugs sprul lha sras rje bo khyod la gdams: yon tan rdo rje bdud 'joms khyod la gdams: phrin las dbang gi mtsho rgyal khyod la gdams: shog dril sgrub khog lnga ru bgyid nas su: sku tshab gter lnga dbang ba'i bu la bzhag: ma 'ongs skal ldan grogs lnga snga phyi ru: rten 'brel dus las ma 'das 'phrad par shog: khyad par rtsod ldan snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus: sangs rgyas ye shes skye ba rtags rgya can: las can skyes bu de yis 'byin par 'gyur: 'byin pa'i grogs ni lug sprel byi ba dang : yos bu'am ni lug gi lo 'dzin 'gyur: rten 'brel rgya ldan bsgrigs nas smon lam bzung : mchims phu brag btsan bya dang sprel gyis mchod: drang srong 'brug dang ma mo tsit+tas mchod: rgyal po za 'og dar tshon g.yag dkar dang : 'bras chang skyems bzang khu bas bye brag mchod:

dge bsnyen sbrul dkris can dang sman sna phud: gzhi bdag rnams la gser mchod skyems bcas pa: rigs lnga dar dpyangs gar gos ldan pas mchod: 'byin nas 'bebs te spel ba'i skal ldan bdun: chos sku kun bzang mgo nas rten 'brel du: rdo rje shrī maṅga ku sā li: maṇ+ṭa dz+nyā na dhe wa tsar+ya bhe: ā yur pad+ma wāk+ka ṇa bh+wa dhi bi: rtsa ba'i chos bdag sbyin bdag zung du 'jug: ma 'ongs gter gnas srung ma spel sgrub yul: nges par 'byung bas smon lam dang bcas sprod: de dang dus mtshungs sde dpon gdong sme can: dmag dpon nag po khrag gi kha rlangs can: chos gzugs btsun pa'am ni sngags chas can: dam sri mngon sum 'byung bas bag zon gyis: gter ston nam ni chos bdag la gnod pa'i: zhib brtag dam nyams de 'drar sbas par bya: bka' yi rgya 'di drag po sde lnga dang : gnyer gtad klu rgyal gtsug na nor bur bcol: bstan pa'i bya ra chos 'di'i mel tshe gyis: khyad par rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa skyongs: skal ldan las can zhig dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:

gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: them rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa khyi lor bsam yas mchims phu'i dge'u gong nas gdan drangs shing lcags phag lor mdo khams sgang gi lte ba nang chen rgyal po'i ur 'gos rdo rje rwa ba'i gzim chung du shog ser nas zhal bshus pa'o// // kha)rig 'dzin srog sgrub yid bzhin nor bu las: bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsang ba'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so: rig 'dzin rgyal ba 'dus pa'i lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas ky-is: rang nyid sgrub par rang gis brtsams pa 'di: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus kyi tha ma la: sems can dmu rgod sdug bsngal zad mtha' med: las kyi rlung 'khrugs nyon mongs me ltar 'bar: rkyen gyis g.yengs nas dus min bdud kyis sdang : tshe la nges med dpyid kha'i nyi ma 'dra: glo bur bar chad 'chi bas nyen pa'i tshe: gcig dril sgrub pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gtso: man ngag nor bu rin chen 'od rab 'byin: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de yang nyams len bla ma'i rnal 'byor yid bzhin nor bu'i them yig med pa'i sde tshan las: bla ma sku gsum dang sku lnga lhun grub pad+ma rgyal po mnyam bzhag ye shes rol pa'i sgrub thabs bstan pa la don gsum ste: sku tshab la brten pa'i nor sgrub thabs: snying po sngags la brten pa'i rten 'brel sgrub thabs: nyams len la brten pa'i rnal 'byor sgrub thabs te don tshan gsum mo: gsum po de'i gzhung rnams sku tshab la rag las pa yin: de ci'i phyir zhe na: mtsho rgyal zhus lan las: e ma nyon dang jo mo mtsho rgyal ma: deng sang dus dang bskal pa yar ldan kyang : ma 'ongs yang mtha' sum cu'i mjug sdud tshe: so kha ru bzhi'i dpung tshan chu ltar khol:

bod kyi bde skyid dgong kha'i nyi ma bzhin: gnas skabs bde yang yad yud ldog pa'i tshe: kyai ma bsam zhing nga nyid dran par 'byung : de tshe bdag dang dbyer med sku tshab 'di: mig ltar gces la gsol ba rgyun du thob: snying ltar chongs la dkon mchog rtag tu mchod: ces pa ltar: ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis rten gyi dkar chag dang sgrub thabs rnams yi ger bzung nas mchims phu ru sbas pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de yang rten mchog pad+ma rgyal po'i dkar chag bstan pa ni: rje btsun chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas bsam yas mchims phu'i ke'u tshang du bzhugs pa'i dus su jo mo mtsho rgyal la ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga bdo'i lung bstan rnams gsungs shing rnga yab gling du bzhud par dgongs pa'i brda mdzad pa'i phyir: jo mo mtsho rgyal gyis zhus te: rje btsun rin po che nyid rnga yab gling du bzhugs pa'i tshe: sku dngos su bzhugs pa 'dra ba'i 'gro ba kun gyis gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis dngos grub 'byin nus pa zhig zhu zhus pa'i tshe: gu ru'i zhal nas: de ltar bgyis pa la rten 'brel dang rdzas sna tshogs tshang dgos so gsungs: ci ltar lags zhus pas: phyogs bcu'i gnas su rin po che'i rigs du ma dang : dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rdzas sna du ma yod pa rnams len nus na de bzhin bya ba'i thabs yod gsungs: gu ru'i gsung bzhin mtsho rgyal gyis rlung ye shes zla 'gro'i shugs kyis dar cig nas phyogs bcur byon: steng phyogs tshangs pa 'phrul gyi gnas tshangs pa'i chu bdud rtsi lnga ldan: lha'i bu mo bde skyid ma'i nor bu zur phud tshar gcig: ma hā de wa'i stobs bskyed dza na mo: klu yi rgyal po rtag smyos nor rgyas 'jog po gsum gyi 'chi med klu 'jim gyi sa zhag dkar po: klu yi rgyal po yid bzang dang gtsug na rin po che'i pho brang gser phreng gyi bye ma a krong bskyed pa'i gzhi: he ru ka'i gnas brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor rang byung gi sa sna:

yul nyer bzhi gnas so gnyis kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi rten rdzas: rigs gsum mgon po dang rig 'dzin brgyad kyis bsgrubs pa'i chos sman bram ze'i sku sha sgrub rdzas dga' rab rdo rje dang shrī singha gnyis kyi phyag bzhes ma tsan+da ko sha'i bye ma: nor bu sūr+ya klu yul nas bhi ṭa sogs rje btsun gyi phyag tu yod pa dang : mtsho rgyal gyis gdan drangs pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgril nas: klu 'jim bye ma'i a krong shas che zhing tsur+ya bha tra'i pags pas rtsi rlan: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sman mchog byin rlabs rnams kyi chus byugs te: pad+ma rgyal pos gtsor byas pa'i sku tshab dang rten sna che ba bcas brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga bzhengs pa las: sku tshab rnams nyin gcig la grub pa mdzad: sku tshab che ba rnams sor bzhi 'bring po sor gsum tha ma tshon gang bcas mang du bzhengs pa khyad par du 'phags pa nyer lngas dus gcig tu gsung grags so: de yang ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga brgya'i dus kyi tshe: sems can gyi bde skyid zad: sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa dbyings su sdud: yi dam gyi lha rnams phal cher ri rab la zhal gzigs: sde brgyad nag phyogs rnams dgra la phyogs: de'i tshe ma mo dang brtan ma 'khrugs: yul la nad yams sngar nas med pa sman dpyad kyis bcos lta ma mchis pa du ma dang : lo nyes dang mu ge'i bskal pa dar: sde brgyad 'khrug pas dmag 'khrug dang bdud kyi sprul pas sa steng khyab: sems can phal cher gri ru 'chi zhing yul stong la khad du 'byung : de'i tshe mdo sngags kyi bstan pa mkha'i na bun ltar gnas: khyad par gsang sngags kyi bstan pa la bdud kyis sdang ba 'byung : de'i skabs su sems can pre ta'i 'jigs pas shin tu nyam thag pa 'byung : de'i skabs su rten pad+ma rgyal po 'di la gsol ba gang btab pa rnams bsod nams dam pa mchog tu 'phel: phyi ma yang bdag gi 'khor gyi thog mar 'byung zhing dam pa'i lung bstan thob par 'gyur ro:

zhes gsungs lung bstan rgyas bsdus mang du mdzad: khyad par rje 'bangs grogs lnga la kha byang lung gi rgya rtags rnams dang smin grol gyi gdams pa mang du gnang : de yi nang nas rang rang gi 'gro don snga phyi la bstun nas gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes la: gu ru pad+ma rgyal po snang srid zil gnon ltar sgrub pa dang : bde gshegs kun 'dus ltar sgrub pa dang : rig 'dzin srog sgrub ltar sgrub pa: pad+ma mnyam bzhag bsod nams ye shes rol pa them med ltar sgrub pa: dpag tu med pa'i rnal 'byor sgrub skor gnang ba la: bde gshegs kun 'dus yid bzhin nor bu'i cha rkyen sku tshab pad+ma rgyal po ltar sgrub pa'i cha lag them med bcas gnang ba la: de yang sku tshab la khyad chos gsum dang ldan te: dbu zha pad+ma bdud 'dul: zhal ras pad+ma zil gnon: sku lus pad+ma rgyal po mnyam bzhag can: gzungs sgrub pa'i go rim nor bu sūr+ya sogs bcas zhabs sdom ko sha pad+ma las rab rtsal rgya'i gdams pa dang ldan pa'i bod yul ma zhes pa'i sku tshab rang 'dra mar grags pa de bsam yas mchims phu'i ke'u tshang du rgya rim dang bcas pa'i dkar chag: sa ma ya: de yang sku tshab la brten pa'i rtsa ba dril sgrub ni: rin po che'i dal du sku rten sku tshab: gsung la shog dril: thugs la shel gyi mchod rten bcas bkram: de'i mdun du mchod pa sna mdun: sman phud mchod gtor rin chen 'bar ba nor bu sum tshugs bzhis bskor: de la mdzes pa'i rgyan spras: g.yas g.yon du byang sems dkar dmar: de'i mdun du tshogs mchod dang pañca gzhan yang mchod rdzas du ma: rin po che'i maṇ+ḍal steng du dar mtshon gyi gur: mdun 'tshams 'khod pa zhig tu dung zhal nang du: sman bhi dza su ra rdzas ke ke ru rtsa kun+tu bzang po shing 'dzam bu prik+ṣa me tog ut+pal lo ma bcas zhib tu 'thag pa chu yan lag brgyad ldan bcas bsdus pa gtams: kha chod gser gyi me long :

rigs lnga'i sa bon dar sna'i cod pan tshang bas bkab par bya: thog mar sgrub pa nye bar bya na tshes gcig nas bcu'i bar: ring bar bcu nas bco lnga'i bar: de la tshes gcig tho rangs la khrus bya: dar dmar po'i gos gyon: lho nub o rgyan gyi phyogs su kha bltas la khrus bya: phyag brgya 'tshal: de nas gdan du 'khod: rang nyid lho nub tu kha gyu: mchod rdzas rnams: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: gyis nyes skyon sbyangs: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gis spel: rang nyid gdung ba'i shugs dang bcas nas: hūm̐: rnam dag sa gzhi lag mthil ltar mnyam pa: rin chen sna tshogs las grub baiḍūr+ya: sa gzhi dwangs ba'i dbus su pad+mo'i mtshor: rang byung ye shes lnga yi sdong po'i rtser: rin chen zur brgyad nyi zla pad+ma'i steng : snang mtha'i dwangs ma hrīḥyig dmar ser las: lugs su 'byung ba 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku: skyon bral yon tan mtshan dpes rab brgyan pa: rje btsun chen po gu ru pad+ma 'byung : dbang gi mdangs las sa snying rab bzhad pa: khro 'dzum sgeg pa'i nyams ldan 'gying bag can: zil gnon 'khyil ba'i spyan rtsa phyogs bcur gzigs: rin chen rgyan ldan pad zhwa rtse gnon gsol: za 'og ber dang phod kha mdzes par bklubs: phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag steng du ka pā la: dgos 'dod yid bzhin nor bu 'bar bas bkang : gsus khyim rgyas shing zhabs gnyis skyil krung bzhugs: gzi brjid 'od 'bar nyi zla 'bum du 'khrigs: dbyings phyug gsang ba'i ḍāk+ki rnam bzhis bskor: rin chen rgyan ldan nor bu'i phyag rgya can: lha rdzas na bza'i cod pan du ma mdzes: bde chen phyed pa'i skyil krung rol stabs can: gtso 'khor 'ja' lus 'od klong gsal bar bsgom: de ltar bskyed pa'i gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyis: rigs 'dus bla ma yab yum spyan drangs gyur: om̐ gu ru bo dhi sa twa ya pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki nī sa mā ya dza dzaḥ spyan drang ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la:

o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: de ltar rnga yab gling bzhugs pa: gdong mar srin po'i kha gnon mdzad: rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: gdung ba drag pos spyan 'dren no: gsol ba 'debs phyir gshegs su gsol: mos pa'i bu la zhal ston 'tshal: gsung gis gdams pa'i gnad sgrog nas: rin chen khri rkang mdzes pa'i gdan: 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs su gsol: om̐: skye ba med pa gu ru'i sku: 'gro ba'i nad gdon zhi mdzad pa: rdo rje thod phreng la phyag 'tshal: āḥ 'gags pa med pa rgyal ba'i gsung : snang srid dbang du sdud mdzad pa: pad+ma thod phreng la phyag 'tshal: hūm̐: 'khrul pa med pa chos kyi thugs: sems kyi gnas lugs ston mdzad pa: bud+dha thod phreng la phyag 'tshal: trām̐: yon tan ma lus kun 'byung zhing : skye dgu'i dbul phongs sel mdzad pa: rat+na thod phreng la phyag 'tshal: hrīḥ phrin las bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad pa: mthu stobs chen pos las mdzad pa: karma thod phreng la phyag 'tshal: mā: bcu drug bde chen lang tsho ldan: zag med dga' chen bskyed pa'i yum: dbyings phyug rigs bzhi la phyag 'tshal: phyag rgya dge bas rab bskul nas: rje la yi rang gus mos pa'i: lus ngag yid gsum mchod pa 'bul: gzugs mdzes mchod pa me tog ma: rgyal ba'i dbu la 'bul lags na: rtag tu rin chen rgyan ldan shog: dri zhim mchod pa bdug spos ma: rgyal ba'i shangs la 'bul lags na: rtag tu spos dang ldan par shog: snang gsal mchod pa mar me ma: rgyal ba'i spyan la 'bul lags na:

rtag tu ma rig sel bar shog: dag gtsang mchod pa dri chab ma: rgyal ba'i sku la 'bul lags na: rtag tu dpe byad 'bar bar shog: ro mchog mchod pa zhal zas ma: rgyal ba'i ljags la 'bul lags na: rtag tu longs spyod 'phel bar shog: dbyangs gsal mchod pa rol mo ma: rgyal ba'i snyan la 'bul lags na: rtag tu chos sgra sgrogs par shog: dug gsum nad sel sman mchod ma: rgyal ba'i thugs la 'bul lags na: rtag tu tshad gdung sel bar shog: rmad byung dgyes pa gtor mchod ma: rgyal ba mnyes par 'bul lags na: rtag tu tshogs gnyis smin par shog: shes rab spyod byed byams mchod ma: rgyal bas rol par 'bul lags na: rtag tu stong nyid don ldan shog: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta bha ling+ta rak+ta su ṣaṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes mdun bskyed rten gyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la mchod pa phul bas mnyes shing dgyes nas bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la tshogs gnyis kyi 'bras bu smin par bsam: de nas gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis bstod pa ni: hrīḥm: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi spyi mes po: thog ma'i mgon po snang mtha'i rigs kyi sras: mtsho skyes rdo rje 'ja' lus skye 'chi bral: snang srid dbang sdud pad+ma rgyal po'i sku: sa snying dbang gis 'khyud pa'i gzi 'od 'bar: khro 'dzum dgyes pa'i spyan rtsa phyogs bcur 'khyil: bag dro lhun chags dpa' bo sgeg bzhad can: bdud dpung zil gnon pad+ma'i zhu chen gsol: 'dod rgu mchog sbyin rat+na'i rgyan chas spras: snang srid dbang sdud za 'og ber chen bklubs: snying rjes 'gugs te mnyam bzhag sor mo'i mthil: bde chen snod du 'dod 'byung yid bzhin spungs: lhun po rab brjid zhabs gnyis skyil mo krung : mi zad 'khor lo'i rgyun bzhin gsus khyim 'khyil: srid gsum dbang bsgyur nyi zla'i pho nya 'phros:

yangs pa'i gzhu ltar 'gengs pa'i dpal 'byor sdud: phrin las rnam bzhi bskul ba'i sgeg mos bskor: dza na mo yi spros pa'i las byed tshogs: ma hā dhe wa'i dpyid mnga' lhan cig ltar: srid pa gsum mam 'jig rten stong khams 'di: 'gran zla bral lo dga' ba tshal gyi rje: khams gsum dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: sku lnga mtshan brgyad bla ma rin po che: zhi ba'i las mdzad rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs: rgyas pa'i las mdzad rat+na thod phreng rtsal: tshe bsod mnga' thang rgyas par byin gyis rlobs: dbang gi las mdzad pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: khams gsum dbang du 'du bar byin gyis rlobs: drag po'i las mdzad karma thod phreng rtsal: bdud dang dam sri sgrol bar byin gyis rlobs: lhun gyis grub pa'i bud+dha thod phreng rtsal: 'dod rgu phun sum tshogs par byin gyis rlobs: bde chen mtsho rgyal shar phyogs mnga' dbang bsgyur: chu khams srid rnams dbang sdud byin gyis rlobs: sgeg bzhad rab g.yo lho phyogs mnga' dbang bsgyur: sa khams srid rnams dbang sdud byin gyis rlobs: dbang gi mdangs ldan nub phyogs mnga' dbang bsgyur: me khams srid rnams dbang sdud byin gyis rlobs: khyab 'jug rab rgyu byang gi gling dbang bsgyur: rlung khams srid rnams dbang sdud byin gyis rlobs: dbyig gi khur 'dzin gu lang g.yo ba'i tshogs: 'bad med bdag la nye bar stsal du gsol: byin gyis rlobs shig o rgyan rin po che: pad+ma rgyal po thugs rje mnga' ba'i lha: 'khor los dbang bsgyur rje btsun gu ru la: gsol ba 'debs so brtse bas bdag la skyongs: rten 'brel sna tshogs spyod pa'i mkha' la rol: nā das rab g.yo grol bzhi rgyas 'debs ma: ka len ldang ltar 'phul ba rab bskul bzhin: 'phrog byed nus pa 'bebs ltar 'dod rgu'i tshogs: sa 'dzin 'du phon khengs ltar bdag la stsol:
gsol ba 'debs so dbyings kyi dbang bsgyur che: dpa' mo rigs bzhis byin rlabs nus pas skyongs: ma ltar byams pas rtag tu dung bar mdzod:

pad+ma rgyal po'i srog sgrub sngags ni: om̐ ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki sid+dhi hūm̐: yab yum nor sgrub sngags ni: om̐ hri ma gu ru rat+na sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes brgya rtsa bzlas te mdun bskyed rten la rje btsun yab yum dngos su bzhugs par bsams la maṇ+ḍal 'bul: phyag 'tshal tshogs kyis mchod: sgrib sbyong gi bshags pa bya: de nas sku gsung thugs rten gyi rten khrus bya rab tu gnas shing rtag par gsol ba 'debs pa ni: e ma ho: mngon par dga' ba'i zhing mchog bde ba can: rnam dag pad+ma bkod pa'i mkha' dbyings nas: snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur la gsol ba 'debs: dbang bzhi stsol zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: rnga yab dpal ri lhun grub pad+ma 'od: zangs mdog tsit+ta'-i dbyibs kyi pho brang nas: o rgyan yab yum rnams la gsol ba 'debs: dbang bzhi stsol zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: dug lnga rnam dag sku lnga lhun gyis grub: ye shes rtsal lnga spros pa'i rang dbyings nas: thod phreng yab yum rnams la gsol ba 'debs: dbang bzhi stsol zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: yid bzhin 'khor lo 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i gnas: snang srid dbang du 'du ba'i gnas mchog nas: rten mchog pad+ma rgyal por gsol ba 'debs: dbang bzhi stsol zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar: bsod nams longs spyod 'bad med 'grub pa dang : mi mthun bdud bzhi'i tshogs las rab rgyal nas: tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam par mdzad du gsol: gu ru pad+ma sarba sid+dhi dzaḥ rgyun du gsol 'debs gang mang thon nas dmigs pa'i dbang bzhi blang : sgrub pa grol nas 'di'i khar rten rnams kyis dbang bzhi blang : skabs su tshogs bsags maṇ+ḍal kyang 'bul: tshogs las gzhung nas blang : rten khrus spyi mthun ltar bya zhing sgrub pa grol tshe sman dri chab bdag gi lus la byugs: rjes shes kyi bya ba rang rig pad+ma rgyal po rtag tu yid la bya:

thun mtshams med par nyams su blang : spyod lam rnam bzhir rjes thob kyi go rim ma chag par 'bad pas 'bras bu rten 'brel phyogs med du 'char zhing rgyal dbang pad+ma kā ras rjes su bzung bar bya'o: tha ma rjes chog bsdu ba'i tshe dbang bzhi rang thim rten la gnas par bya: bkra shis bsngo ba smon lam spros pa 'dod na las byang nas blang : dam tshig tu tshes bcur mchod pa mi chag par bya: lo re bzhin tshogs skong dang dam tshig nyams chag skong ba brgya tshar re btang : khyad par snyigs ma lnga brgya la thug pa'i tshe: dam tshig nyams pa'i skye 'gro pho mo 'ga' zhig sdug 'dre'i lus su gyur nas sgrub pa la brtson pa rnams la sdang zhing chos pa rnams snying bslu nas: bla ma dang yi dam lha la rgyang thag ring bar byed pa ste: de dag sngar byas rnams sor chud cing phyis mi 'byung ba'i ched dam bca' rnams yin te: go rim de bzhin gtso che bas ji bzhin nyams su blang bar bya'o: sa ma ya: zab pa'i mthar thug yid bzhin nor bu nyid: sku gsum sgrub pa gcig dril khyad par 'phags: pad+ma rgyal po yid bzhin nor mchog las: them byang gud du sbas pa khyad par can: ma 'ongs thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: las dag dbang gi lha mos rgya 'di srungs: snod min lag tu ma shor sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgyas: zab rgya: gsang rgya: them rgya: kho bo sngags 'chang rtsa gsum gling pas sa khyi lor bsam yas mchims phu'i ke'u tshang nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags gling du shog ser nas phab pa'o// // ga)rig 'dzin srog sgrub yid bzhin nor bu las: gu ru pad+ma rgyal po snang srid zil gnon gyi las byang bde gshegs kun 'dus bzhugs so: rgyal dbang kun 'dus gar gyi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal: e ma kho bo rgya gar mkhas pa paṇa chen la: ye shes mtsho rgyal sangs rgyas ye shes sogs: las can skal ldan rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor: nga nyid bzhugs dang dbyer med byin rlabs can:

yid bzhin nor bu bla ma'i sgrub pa bstan: brtsams pa'i shog ser gsang ba'i logs su bzung : 'brel tshad don ldan smon lam rgya yis btab: brag dmar bsam yas ke'u tshang 'dir sbas: sngags bdag bstan srung gtso bo ral gcig mar: rgya 'di gnyer gtad bya ra mel tshe gyis: ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus kyi tha ma la: da lta'i lo tsā sangs rgyas ye shes kyi: rnam 'phrul rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgyal: rig 'dzin thugs sras de la legs par sprod: dam nyams bdud rigs lag tu ma shor rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de yang bla ma sgrub pa'i rim pa ni: bkra shis byin chags rgyal bas me tog 'thor: smon lam mchog ldan dben ri yid 'ong 'dir: mkho ba'i yo byad sgrub pa'i cha rkyen bsags: sa slong stegs bu bcags te dbus mtho ba: gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang rtse'i dbyibs dag la: thig gdab tshon spel bkod mdzes legs par bya: de nas gzhung spyi'i mchod pa bsgrigs chag 'di: bum pa rnam rgyal sman sgrub bdud rtsis gtams: kha rgyan mgul chings la sogs tshang bar bya: bhan+dha mtshan ldan sman raka phud kyis bkang : rtsa gsum gtor ma rgyan bzang legs par bshams: gzhan yang spyan gzigs tshogs gtor tshang bar bskor: de nas dkyil 'khor bca' gzhir 'jug pa ni: sngon 'gro gtsang mar sbyar ba'i gser skyems btang : gzhi bdag rnams la sgrub pa'i rogs dan bcol: de nas dkyil 'khor thig gdab pa ni: hūm̐: bkra shis lha mo dge ba'i grogs: mnyen lcug 'khril ldan tshe 'dzin ma: kun gzhi lhun grub dkyil 'khor la: rig pa rdo rje'i thig thob cig: oṃ bh+rūm̐ dz+nyā na saṃ tri ta dha ra swā hā: zhes rim bzhin dgos chad sbyar: sa ma ya: dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni: na mo: bde gshegs kun 'dus gu ru pad+ma 'byung : thugs rje'i bdag nyid o rgyan chos kyi rje: rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gsum kun 'dus la: bdag yid rtse gcig gdung bas skyabs su mchi:

gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni: hoḥ gdod nas rang rig rnam dag sku lnga'i mchog: ji bzhin rtogs pa'i byin rlabs nus rtsal gyi: 'od zer nar ma 'gro la rab spros nas: yang dag sangs rgyas lam 'god sems bskyed do: gsum pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid pad+ma 'byung gnas gsal ba yi: spyi bor khyab bdag mgon po rdo rje sems: dung mdog rdor dril bsnol thabs skyil krung bzhugs: yum snyems gri thod bde stong sku la 'khril: hūm̐: de yi spyi bor mgon po 'od mi 'gyur: dmar gsal mnyam bzhag rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: 'ja' lus 'od phung dbyings rig ngo bor gsal: hūm̐: de la skyabs yul rigs 'dus lha tshogs bskor: phyogs dus bde gshegs kun 'dus ngo bo nyid: rtsa ba'i bla ma'i skur gsal maṇ+ḍal 'bul: 'od zhu bdag thim sgrib gnyis g.ya' bral bsgom: bzhi pa maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: gling bzhi ri rab khyon ltar bkod pa dang : dngos 'byor yid sprul maṇ+ḍal dag pa'i tshogs: skyabs yul kun 'dus mchog gsum lha tshogs la: 'gro ba'i don phyir dmigs te phu+ul ba yis: ma gyur 'gro kun byang chub lam dgod shog: oṃ i daṃ gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍal keṃ nir+ya ta yā mi: lnga pa yig brgya bzlas shing bshags pa ni: hoḥ bdag ni bag med rmongs pa yi: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig gis: don dang 'gal ba ci mchis pa: rigs 'dus dkyil 'khor tshogs la bshags: gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid: thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid la: 'gro ba'i don phyir bdag skyabs mchi: drug pa gsol ba 'debs pa ni: hūm̐: thog ma'i mgon po kun bzang 'od ma'i 'gyur: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: khyab bdag dag pa rdor sems bde gshegs 'dus: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:

rgyal mchog thugs rje gcig 'dus pad+ma 'byung : gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dbyings phyug nam mkha'i gos can mtsho rgyal ma: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bka' bab gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: las 'phro don rtogs gnam lcags rdo rje rtsal: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: zab gter sgo 'byed rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling : gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: lung zin skyes mchog chos bdag las can la: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: yi dam rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i zhal: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: snying thig skyong ba'i ral gcig sngags srung mar: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub bar byin gyis rlobs: skyabs yul kun kyang 'od zhu rim pa bzhin: spyi bor thim nas bdag lus snang stong nyid: dbang bzhi rdzogs nas zang thal chen po'i sku: gu ru pad+ma 'od 'bar mchog 'grub shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: badz+ra sa mā ya dza sid+dhi pha la a be sha ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: dang po bgegs gtor gtong ba ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid dbang drag 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas: gzi byin 'od stong zer ma phyogs bcur 'phros: de yi shugs las bgegs rnams snying rjes bkug: gtor ma len phyir gnas 'dir myur du mchis: oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dza dzaḥ bgegs tshogs 'byung po a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ

de nas kha phyir bstan la: hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs dang 'byung po log 'dren tshogs: deng nas phan dge'i byang chub lam dgod phyir: yid mthun 'dod yon mchod sbyin 'di bzhes la: gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du 'gro bar gyis: ci ste mi 'gro gdug pa'i sems 'chang na: bdag nyid dbang chen drag sngags phyung brdeg gis: khyod kyi lus ngag yid gsum rdul du brlag: de bas rang rang gnas su phyir dengs shig: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas thun brdeg cing : hūm̐ hrīḥ bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang : yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong mthu rtsal gyis: dngos grub bar chad byed ba'i bgegs: log par 'dren pa bdud kyi tshogs: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'tshe byed na: bdag nyid dpal chen thugs khros nas: khro bo spros pas nam mkha' gang : khro mo spros pas sa gzhi gang : sras mchog khro chung bar snang gang : me yi bya khyung phyogs bcur 'khrigs: drwa mig lcags sdig glog ltar 'khyugs: 'khor yug mtshon char thog ltar 'bebs: bgegs tshogs thal ba'i rdul du brlag: de bas bka' las ma 'da' zhig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra hūm̐: rak+sha hūm̐: yak+sha hūm̐: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya: gnod byed bgegs tshogs thams cad tshin+dha tshin+dha ban+dha ban+dha ha na ha na pa tsa pa tsa ma tha ma tha da ha da ha hu lu hu lu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: gnyis pa mtshams gcod srung 'khor bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: nga nyid gdod nas rab khros he ru kaḥ ka dag thugs las brdol ba'i shes rab mtshon: rno dbal lhun grub rang rtsal 'gengs pa'i tshogs: bar med khyab ste skar ltar rab 'khrugs pa: bsrungs mtshams med pa dum bu gcig pa ni: e dbyings mkha' ltar gnas pa'i gur khang gyur: oṃ badz+ra dharma dz+nyā na tsakra e khaṃ raṃ dz+wa la rak+ṣa ye swā hā:

gsum pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes brjod pas mchod pa'i gzhi khyab par bsang chu 'thor: hūm̐: rig pa'i gru 'dzin khyon ltar yangs pa'i dbus: phyi mchod lha mo me tog bdug spos ma: mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo dang : gzugs mdzes lang ling gar mo yid 'ong rigs: lta na sdug cing tshul bzang mchod thogs tshogs: grangs med sprul pa rgyal ba mnyes rdzas gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: bzhi pa bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: bhan+dha mtshan ldan lcang lo 'khyil ba'i nang : sha lnga rdzas lnga pañca a mṛ ta: dri lnga 'bru bcud chang dang dza gad phud: sman mchod dug lnga sel ba'i ye shes mdangs: dkar mngar kha dang ro skyur zhun gyi rigs: sna tshogs tshang 'di rgyal ba mnyes rdzas gyur: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ lnga pa rak+ta byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: bum ril bhan+dha dum gcig zlum pa'i dbus: bzang mo'i mkha' yi mu kha sgra gcan gyi: 'khor lor khyab 'jug myur 'gros rab bskul nas: 'dar ma'i rlung las 'gyu ba'i byams chen po: chags med dmar chen gzi 'od 'khyil ba'i tshogs: mtsho ltar 'khrugs pa rgyal ba mnyes rdzas gyur: oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ drug pa gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: thabs shes rin chen las grub nyi zla'i snod: rgya cher srid pa'i khyon ltar yangs pa'i dbus: snod gzugs bsdus pa'i bcud mchog ba liṃ ta: lhun mtho dbyings la bsnyegs pa'i rgyan mdzes btsugs: mdangs ldan bcud g.yo rgyas pa'i zer stong 'khyugs: kun tshang mchod pas rgyal ba mnyes mdzad gyur: oṃ ma hā bha ling+ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ drug pa byin dbab pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min bkod pa rab rdzogs lhun grub zhing : lnga ldan zang thal 'gyu ba'i pho brang nas:

rigs 'dus rgyal ba rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams: 'du 'bral med par thugs rje'i shugs mtshon nas: gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin chen myur du phob: mchog thun 'bad med lhug par deng stsol shog: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sa ma ya a be sha ya a āḥ bdun pa brda sgo dbye ba ni: hūm̐: rang rig gdod nas kun 'dus rtsa ba gsum: sku lnga lhun grub 'du 'bral med mod kyang : bar du shes bya phra mo'i kun rtog tshogs: da ni rmongs gzhom rang rig brda sgo phyes: oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ de nas brda bstod ni: hūm̐: ma rig ka dag klong thim g.ya' bral phyir: tshe rabs gnyug ma'i rang rig lha zhal mjal: 'dus ma byas kyi gshis lugs so mar bstod: nam yang bag yod mi 'da' chos 'khor bskor: oṃ badz+ra dharma shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na tsakra hūm̐: de nas dgu pa dkyil 'khor dam bca' 'dzin pa ni: hūm̐: yang dag don rtogs rlabs po che: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: ngo mtshar che nyid snyan pa'i dal: srog gi phyir yang mi btang bzung : oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta sa ma ye hūm̐: dang po de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin ni: hūm̐: ka dag lhun grub bde ba che: mu mtha' bral ba kun la khyab: blo 'das rtog med de bzhin ngang : thog ma'i mgon pos de ltar smras: oṃ dharma dhā tu gar+bha shū n+ya ta hūm̐:

gnyis pa kun tu snang ba'i ting 'dzin ni: hūm̐: rang byung dmigs su ma mchis kyang : zang thal chen po'i brtul zhugs kyi: rol rtsal 'gags med kun tu snang : rdo rje sems dpas de ltar smras: oṃ badz+ra dz+nyā na dharma sa twa swa bhā wa hūm̐: gsum pa rgyu yi ting 'dzin ni: hūm̐: chos rnams bden med de bzhin la: rang byung snying po rgyu yi mchog: kun gyi srog tu hūm̐ gnas pas: pad+ma badz+ras de ltar smras: oṃ gu ru dz+nyā na sarba tsit+ta badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐: bzhi pa 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni: hūm̐: ye shes lnga yi rang mdangs las: rtogs pa'i rlung lnga rol rtsal shar: de las phra mo'i sa bon dag: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: brtsegs thabs 'byung ba lnga ru grub: oṃ e ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la: ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la: a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la: ru tra ti ra baṃ: hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭḥ a dharma ya hoḥ lnga pa pho brang bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: e nam mkha' mthing nag kun tu bzang mo'i mkha': yam̐ g.yo byed rlung ri dam tshig sgrol ma'i mkha': ram̐ sreg byed me ri na bza' dkar mo'i mkha': kham̐ dam tshig bdud rtsi mā ma kī yi mkha': sum̐ dbang chen sa gzhi sangs rgyas spyan ma'i mkha': keṃ rdo rje ri rab mi shigs brag chen steng : bh+rūm̐ ye shes mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs pho brang bsgom: oṃ bh+rūm̐ dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍal tsakra hūm̐: hūm̐: de dbus mi 'gyur sna tshogs rdo rje yi: lte bar ye shes lnga ldan gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi lhun grub ngang nyid las: rtsig pa 'dod snam pha gu drwa ba mdzes: shar bu mda' yab pu shu brgyad dang ldan: bcu drug gdung ma ka ba brgyad kyis btegs: zhu chen zhu chung nyi zla 'ja' ris 'khyugs: 'phan dar bla bre yol ba sna tshogs bres: phyogs bzhir rta babs chos 'khor nyi zlas mdzes: dbus su rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa'i: zla gam bya 'dab 'od 'bar nor bu'i tog: thog steng gser gyi rgyal mtshan bcu drug dang :

rin chen 'phan dar mdzes pa'i cod pan 'phyangs: phyi rol dur khrod chen po brgyad rnams dang : me brgyad shing brgyad chu brgyad rlung brgyad dang : sprin brgyad nam mkha' brgyad dang mchod rten brgyad: de nas sprul pa yang sprul rnam pa can: sgyu ma'i rtsal du so sor shar ba ni: phyi rol dur khrod chen po brgyad rnams ni: bsil tshal sku la rdzogs dang laṅka brtsegs: pad 'khyil lhun grub gter dang gsang chen rol: he chen brdal ba la sogs dur khrod brgyad: dur khrod brgyad la dbang phyug nyer brgyad dang : baṃ ro brgyad la zhing skyong laṅka brgyad: keng rus brgyad la kau rī ma mo brgyad: gcan spyang brgyad la siṃ ha phra men brgyad: dur bya brgyad la lha bdud gnas nyul brgyad: dug sbrul brgyad la gcan spyang gdong chen brgyad: me 'bar brgyad la gnas pa'i gza' brgyad ni: ki kang mig dmar nyi zla lhag pa dang : phur bu spen pa pa sangs dag dang brgyad: rngam pa shing brgyad dag la gnas pa yi: hūm̐ kar mañju shrī nā gardzu: pra bha hastī bi ma mi tra dang : dha na saṃ skṛ rom+bu gu h+ya dang : shān+tiṃ gar+bha la sogs rig 'dzin brgyad: bdud rtsi'i chu mig brgyad la gnas pa yi: mtha' yas 'jog po dung skyong stobs rgyu dang : pad+ma hu lu ka dang rigs ldan no: bā su ta la sogs te klu chen brgyad: ye shes rlung brgyad dag la gnas pa ni: dbyings phyug spyan ma mā kī gos dkar sgron: tsaṇ+ḍa lī dang skyong byed rnal 'byor ma: sprin chen g.yo ba brgyad la gnas pa yi: dbang po tshangs pa dbang phyug khyab 'jug dang : bh+ring gi ri ti dga' byed tshogs kyi bdag: kīrti la sogs lha brgyad gnas pa'o: nam mkha' brgyad la gnas pa'i zhing khams lha: kun bzang rnam snang mi bskyod rdo rje dang : mi 'khrugs rdor sems rin 'byung 'od dpag med: don yod grub pa la sogs sangs rgyas bzhugs: mchod rten brgyad la rang srung sangs rgyas ni:

rnam gzigs gtsug tor can dang log par skyobs: 'khor ba 'jigs dang gser thub 'od srung dang : shākya thub pa byams pa mos snang brgyad: de la sogs te dur khrod bkod pa brgyad: phyi rol rdo rwa me ri srung ba'i gur: 'ja' 'od lug rgyud gtibs pa'i pho brang gsal: gnyis pa brten pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha bskyed pa la gtso dang 'khor bskyed pa gnyis so/ dang po ni/ hūm̐: de dbus pad+ma nyi zla mdzes pa'i steng : gser gyi rdo rje hūm̐ yig dmar pos mtshan: 'od zhu dran rdzogs gu ru pad+ma ni: dkar dmar mdangs ldan bde chen rgyal po'i tshul: pad zhwa za ber chos gos phod kha gsol: rin chen snyan rgyan dar dmar sku rags mdzes: rdo rje thod pa tshe bum kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams: rgya lham gsol zhing zhabs gnyis rol stabs tshul: bag dro lhun chags gzi brjid ldan par bskyed: hūm̐: lhun grub stong gsal bde chen sku yi sbubs: ye shes 'khor lo lnga yi 'od klong du: badz+ra thod phreng dkar 'dzum mdzes 'od 'phro: pad+ma thod phreng dmar la chags pa'i mdangs: bud+dha thod phreng smug nag zhi ma khro: rat+na thod phreng ser bzhad mdzes cing sgeg: karma thod phreng ljang nag rab tu gtum: thams cad phyag g.yas thod pa'i cang te'u: g.yon pa mnyam bzhag bdud rtsi bhan+dha bsnams: dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ka ber phyam bklubs: bdud 'dul pad zhwa rtse rnon nyi zlas brgyan: zhabs rnams rol stabs swag chen rgya lham gsol: rang 'od 'byung lnga'i yum 'khril bde chen bskul: rtsa khams zhing kun dwangs pa'i lha sku gsal: hūm̐: g.yas g.yon pad zlar bde chen bskyed pa'i yum: lha lcam dmar mos mda' dar tshe bum bsnams: mtsho rgyal dkar mos bhan+dha bdud rtsi mchod: zhi 'dzum dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan: chags pa'i nyams kyis gtso la gus pas 'dud: hūm̐: de yi spyi bor nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan: rigs 'dus ngo bo bla ma rdo rje 'chang :

sku mdog mthing nag rdor dril bsnol thabs can: phyed skyil pang du dbyings phyug dmar mo 'khril: rdo rje tshe bum yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: longs spyod rdzogs sku zung 'jug ldan par bsgom: hūm̐: de yi spyi bor 'ja' 'od thig le'i klong : thog ma'i sangs rgyas snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur: dmar gsal mnyam bzhag skyil krung lham mer gsal: hūm̐: gtso bo'i phyogs bzhi'i 'khor lo'i rim pa bzhir: mdun phyogs pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: dbang chen dmar smug zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: g.yas pas dbyug tho g.yon pas thod khrag bsnams: dur khrod chas ldan brkyang bskum gar stabs can: rdo rje phag mo gri thod mgul nas 'khyud: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'khril sbyor gsal bar bskyed: hūm̐: g.yas su pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: 'jam dpal dmar ser khro 'dzum sgeg bzhad tshul: phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon pas po ti 'dzin: dur khrod chas ldan brkyang bskum gar thabs can: yum chen sher phyin dmar gsal gri thod 'dzin: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'khril sbyor gsal bar bskyed: hūm̐: rgyab tu pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: 'jig rten dbang phyug zhal gsum phyag drug pa: dkar dmar mthing ba'i khro 'dzum mdzes zhal can: g.yas gnyis shel phreng nor bu 'bar ba 'dzin: g.yon gnyis tshe bum bdud rtsi lhung bzed bsnams: rtsa phyag thal sbyar 'chi med tshe bum thogs: longs sku'i chas ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor 'khril: mda' dar dung dmar yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: zhabs gnyis yab 'khril gtso bo bzhengs stabs gsal: hūm̐: g.yon du pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: phyags rdor mthing nag rdo rje sdigs mdzub can: dur khrod chas ldan brkyang bskum 'gying bag bzhugs: sgrol ljang pad phreng dung dmar mgul nas 'khyud: zhabs gnyis sked 'khril zung 'jug ldan par bsgom: hūm̐: de yi phyi rol 'khor yug rim pa bzhin: sna tshogs rin chen mdzes pa'i gdan khri'i steng :

'od zer thig le 'bar ba'i shar phyogs su: pad+ma 'byung gnas mthing nag zhi ma khro: rdo rje dril 'dzin lha lcam dmar mo 'khril: gcer bu rus rgyan phyed skyil gar stabs bzhugs: lho ru blo ldan mchog sred dkar gsal mdzes: ḍā ru pad phor bsnams nas dar thod bcing : dar dmar phod gsol rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: nub tu nyi ma 'od zer li khri'i mdog: khro 'dzum kha ṭ+wāṃ nyi zer zhags pa bsnams: gcer bu stag sham rus rgyan rol stabs gsal: byang du seṅge sgra sgrogs mthing ka gtum: skra gseb seng skad sgrog cing seng lpags gyon: rdo rje sdigs mdzub stag sham zhabs dor bzhugs: hūm̐: shar lho pad+ma sam+bha dkar smug mdzes: rab byung cha lugs chos gos gsum dang ldan: thod pa skyabs sbyin mdzad nas skyil krung bzhugs: lho nub pad+ma rgyal po dmar gsal sgeg: ḍā ru pad phreng me long lcags kyu bsnams: ber gsol dal 'bol steng na rol stabs bzhugs: nub byang shākya seṅge gser bzang mdog: sa gnon mnyam bzhag dge slong cha lugs can: chos gos dmar po gsol nas zung 'jug bzhugs: byang shar rdo rje gro lod smug nag rngam: rdo rje phur pa bsnams shing rab byung chas: mgo phreng rgyan ldan stag steng gar stabs bzhugs: de yi phyi rol pad 'dab bcu drug la: rdo rje dpa' bo yab yum ging yab yum: rat+na dpa' bo yab yum ging yab yum: pad+ma dpa' bo yab yum ging yab yum: karma dpa' bo yab yum ging yab yum: thams cad gar stabs rus rgyan g.yer kha'i sgra: zhi ma khro la thor tshugs rus rgyan can: phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon pas bhan dmar bsnams: yum rnams thams cad kha ṭ+wāṃ gru mor brten: kun kyang rang mdog gzi brjid ldan par bsgom: de yi phyi rol 'khor yug bar mtshams su: gsang ba'i lha mo bcu drug gar stabs sgyur: rang mdog phyag mtshan mdzes pa'i rgyan dang ldan: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes pa'i tshul du gsal:

hūm̐: dbang phyug laṅka zhing skyong gnas nyul sogs: nyi ma dang ni zer bzhin snang ba yi: sprul pa yang sprul kun kyang 'ja' ltar lhags: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyis: 'og min zhing dang rnga yab dpal ri nas: pad 'byung rgyal ba rig 'dzin lha tshogs rnams: gsang ba'i pho brang gnas 'dir spyan drangs gyur: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: dri bzang gi spos btang zhing rol mo gling bu'i dbyangs snyan dang bcas: spyan drangs shing byin dbab pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐: gnyis pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: ma chags skyon bral pad+ma ge sar dbus: 'dab stong khyon yangs rin chen seng khri'i steng : pad+ma 'byung gnas rtsa gsum ngo bo mchog: bde gshegs 'dus pa'i lha tshogs bzhugs su gsol: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sa ma ya satwaṃ: gsum pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: ka dag lhun grub bla ma chos kyi sku: zang thal bde chen bla ma longs spyod rdzogs: sna tshogs ma 'gags bla ma sprul pa'i sku: rtsa gsum bder 'dus lha la phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ bzhi pa phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa ni: hūm̐: bde chen ngo bo bla ma thabs kyi yab: stong gsal ma 'gags rig pa shes rab yum: zung 'jug dga' bzhi rol pa'i 'khrul 'khor sgyur:

phyag rgya bla med mchod pa bzhes su gsol: oṃ badz+ra dz+nyā na mu ṭa rā ga ya ho sarba pū dza hoḥ lnga pa bstod dbyangs glu'i mchod pa ni: hūm̐: gzugs mdzes gar mo lang ling glu dbyangs can: bde ba mi bzod g.yo ba'i sgra skad sgrog: dri za'i dbyangs snyan lta bur sgrun med tshogs: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ lā s+ye mā l+ye gīrti nīrti swa ra sarba pū dza hoḥ drug pa 'dod yon phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: mdzes pa'i me tog dri zhim bdug pa'i spos: snang gsal mar me bsil ba'i dri chab dang : ro mchog zhal zas snyan pa'i rol mo'i rigs: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: bdun pa nyon mongs ma spangs nang mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dug lnga rnam dag sku lnga ye shes rdzas: gdod nas snang srid chos sku'i rol rtsal dang : sha lnga rdzas mchog pañca a mṛ ta: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta dz+nyā na pū dza la kha kha khā hi: brgyad pa bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa ni: hūm̐: rnam par rgyal sogs dug lnga sel ba'i sman: kha mngar skyur dang bcud ldan tsha ba'i ro: lde gu khaṇ+ḍa zhun khol 'khyil ba'i tshogs: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ bhai ṣa dz+yai aṇ+ṭau a mṛ ta sarba pañca pū dza la kha kha khā hi: oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kun bzang yab yum rdo rje 'chang chen dang*/ /snang ba mtha' yas dgongs brgyud bla ma la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal ba rigs lnga sogs/ /rig 'dzin brda brgyud bla ma thams cad la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ dga' rab shrī sing rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung*/ /bka' bab lung chen tshig brgyud bla ma la/

/dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal sangs rgyas ye shes dang*/ /rtsa gsum gling pa gter brgyud bla ma la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ thugs mchog rdo rje dkon mchog seṅge dang*/ /ye shes rgyal mtshan mi 'jigs rdo rje sogs/ /dbang lung man ngag don brgyud bla ma la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ thod phreng sde lnga lha lcam mtsho rgyal dang*/ /rnam rol mtshan brgyad rig 'dzin 'dus pa la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ yi dam rta phag rigs gsum mgon po dang*/ /dngos grub stsal ba yi dam 'dus pa la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ging dang dpa' bo laṅka gnas nyul sogs/ /grub gnyis char 'beb dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ mgon po sde lnga dregs sde sa ya dang*/ /bka' gter srung ma dam can rgya mtsho la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ sku gsum mi shigs rdo rje'i klong*/ /ma bcos mchog gi dngos grub kyis/ /bdag rgyud sku gsum snying por grol/ /bde gshegs go 'phang myur thob shog /

au ḍī sha dha karmas sbyar ba'o// // dgu pa bha ling brgyan pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: thod pa mtshan ldan lcang lo 'khyil ba'i dbus: dpal gyi gtor ma brjid ldan ri ltar spungs: bcud g.yo gling bzhi rol mtsho bkod legs brgyan: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ ma hā bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: bcu pa rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dung dmar bde chen yangs pa'i bhan+dha ru: chags med bcud g.yo mdangs ldan rlabs su 'khyil: rgyud drug bsgral ba'i rmad byung rak+ta ni: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: bcu gcig pa dga' bzhi'i gsang mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: shes rab mu kha chos 'byung sgra gcan rtser: dga' chen khyab bdag nor bu'i sor bsnun pas: byang sems dkar dmar bde rgyun g.yo ba'i tshogs: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra a haṃ pra mo ti raṃ sarba pū dza khā hi: bcu gnyis pa nyon mongs bsgral ba'i mchod pa ni: hūm̐: shes bya'i lta ba gyad kyi phur pa yis: nga bdag srid pa'i ru tra bsgral gtubs nas: sha khrag klad rus phung por spungs pa 'di: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su+u ta la kha kha khā hi: bcu gsum pa kho na nyid mchog gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: gdod nas rnam dag ye shes sku lnga'i mchog: 'du 'bral med pa'i dbyings rig so ma ni: bsngo mkhan 'bul yul mi dmigs mchog mchod nyid: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ dz+nyā na dhā tu swa bhā pū dza hoḥ bcu bzhi pa rang bzhin lhun grub dkyil 'khor la bstod pa ni: hūm̐: thog ma'i mgon po ye shes lam me ba: ka dag dbyings rig bde chen 'du 'bral med: thugs rje chags pa'i mnyam bzhag skyil krung can: mgon po 'od mi 'gyur la phyag 'tshal bstod:

hūm̐: nam mkha'i mdangs ldan rigs brgya'i cod pan can: khyab bdag ye shes 'khor los 'gro ba 'dren: thabs shes dbyer med rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: zung 'jug dga' ba'i dbang phyug sku la 'khril: sgyu ma'i ngang tshul phyed skyil rol stabs can: rdor 'chang longs spyod rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: ma bcos spros bral ka dag ngo bo nyid: zang thal 'gags med thugs rjes so sor ston: 'gro ba'i don phyir thugs rje sgyu ma'i gar: o rgyan gu ru pad 'byung sku la bstod: hūm̐: sku mdog dkar mdzes zhi 'dzum chags pa ni: ye shes sku lnga 'du 'bral med pa'i brda: dbu la gser gyi snyan zhu gsol ba ni: bde chen rgyal po 'gro ba'i don mdzad brda: de la rin chen rdo rje btsugs pa ni: kun gzhi gnas lugs 'gyur ba med pa'i brda: rtse mor rgod po'i dang ru btsugs pa ni: sa lam theg chen dus gcig 'jug pa'i brda: dar tshon sna lnga'i cod pan 'phur ba ni: ye shes lnga ldan rol rtsal ston pa'i brda: nyi zla nor bu'i rgyan mdangs spras pa ni: srid zhi'i ma rig mun pa sel ba'i brda: sna tshogs rdo rje'i rgya gram ldan pa ni: dgongs brda rgya mtsho'i slob dpon yin pa'i brda: khyung gshog rin chen drwa bas spras pa ni: brgyud 'dzin bu la 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i brda: rat+na snyan rgyan gdu bu 'khrol ba ni: 'khor los sgyur rgyal kun gyi dad dpon brda: mthing nag chu ris phod ka bklubs pa ni: zab gsang lta ba mi shigs ston pa'i brda: gong lag mu tig chun pos spras pa ni: rtsa rlung bde stong 'du 'bral med pa'i brda: dar dmar rgya ma'i sku rags bcings pa ni: ma sring mkha' 'gro rtag tu 'du ba'i brda: chos gos gser gyi ha ris gsol ba ni: sde snod lung rigs gsang mdzod 'dzin pa'i brda: smug nag g.yung drung ber chen gsol ba ni: snang srid dbang sdud gtso bo yin pa'i brda: zhe sdang stag gis gong lag brgyan pa ni:

skal ngan bdud rigs rgol ba 'joms pa'i brda: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams pa ni: ma rungs zil gnon gdug pa 'dul ba'i brda: g.yon pas bhan+dha tshe bum bsnams pa ni: 'chi med rig 'dzin 'ja' lus 'grub pa'i brda: kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum mchan du 'chang ba ni: dug gsum la sogs 'khrul rtog gcod pa'i brda: gsus pa che zhing gsus khyim 'khyil ba ni: sgrub la mchog thun char ltar 'bebs pa'i brda: zhabs gnyis rol stabs rgya lham gsol ba ni: 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem pa'i brda: sku la 'od dpung gzi brjid 'khyil ba ni: phyogs dus rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo'i brda: spyan rtsa 'khyil zhing mkha' dbyings gzigs pa ni: nam yang thugs rje 'du 'bral med pa'i brda: brda rtags rgyan rdzogs bla ma rje la bstod: 'gro ba'i mgon mchog ma hā gu rur bstod: snang mtha'i dbang phyug mtsho skyes rje la bstod: rgyal sras lhun grub pad 'byung sku la bstod: bstan pa'i skyabs mchog rgya gar pa la bstod: mdo sngags gtsug rgyan nyi 'od gsal la bstod: bka' drin 'khor med pha la bstod pa'i mthus: bu la thugs rje'i byin rlabs char ltar phob: mtshungs med nyi ltar deng 'dir bdag gyur cig: hūm̐: sku yi bdag nyid badz+ra thod phreng rtsal: zhi ba'i las mdzad dkar gsal 'dzum mdangs can: za ber gsol nas cang te'u bhan+dha bsnams: chu khams rnam dag rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'khril: me long ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gsung gi bdag nyid pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: dbang gi las mdzad dmar gsal 'dzum mdangs can: za ber gsol nas cang te'u bhan+dha bsnams: me khams rnam dag pad+ma mkha' 'gro 'khril: sor rtog ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: thugs rje'i bdag nyid bud+dha thod phreng rtsal: sna tshogs las mdzad smug nag zhi ma khro: za ber gsol nas cang te'u bhan+dha bsnams: nam mkha' rnam dag sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro 'khril:

chos dbyings ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: yon tan bdag nyid rat+na thod phreng rtsal: rgyas pa'i las mdzad ser gsal 'dzum mdangs can: za ber gsol nas cang te'u bhan+dha bsnams: sa khams rnam dag rin chen mkha' 'gro 'khril: mnyam nyid ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: phrin las bdag nyid karma thod phreng rtsal: drag po'i las mdzad ljang nag zhi ma khro: za ber gsol nas cang te'u bhan+dha bsnams: rlung khams rnam dag karma mkha' 'gro 'khril: bya grub ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: zag med dga' bzhi skyed pa'i dbang mo che: dbyings phyug man+da ra ba mtsho rgyal lcam: mda' dar tshe bum srid zhi'i tshe bcud sdud: dwangs ma'i bdud rtsi bde chen mchod sprin g.yo: zung 'jug ye shes 'khor los phyag rgya sgyur: thugs 'dzin yum mchog gnyis la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal me 'od 'khrugs pa'i mdangs: bdud dpung 'joms byed dbyug to bhan+dha bsnams: 'bar ba'i gar dgu dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: snang srid dbang sdud phag mo sku la 'khril: nyon mongs tshar gcod gri thod mgul nas 'khyud: brkyang bskum 'khril sbyor rtsa khams 'khor los bsgyur: rta skad phag skad hūm̐ bh+yo 'brug ltar ldir: dbang chen yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dmar ser sgeg pa gtum chen g.yul las rgyal: bdud dpung tshar gcod ral gri po ti 'dzin: gshe zhing dur khrod chas ldan gar dgu ldan: sangs rgyas kun gyi yum chen sku la 'khril: ma rig gzhom phyir gri thod mgul nas 'khyud: brkyang bskum 'khril sbyor bde chen thabs kyis bskul: mu stegs rgol ba 'joms byed mthu rtsal can: 'jam dpal yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: byams pa'i 'od zer 'gro la dgyes mdzad pa: 'khor ba stongs phyir shel phreng nor bu 'dzin: byang chub lam ston pad dkar bdud rtsi 'dzin: skye 'chi spang phyir phyag rgya tshe bum thogs:

gsang ba'i lha mo rnal 'byor sku la 'khril: rig 'dzin mchog stsol mda' dar dung dmar 'khyud: zhabs gnyis 'khril sbyor bde stong 'du 'bral med: snying rje'i dbang phyug mtha' yas mgon gyur mchog: spyan gzigs yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: bdud dpung 'joms mdzad mthing nag gtum po'i sku: snang srid bsngang phyir rdo rje sdigs mdzub bsgrengs: rngam stabs dur khrod chas ldan gar bsgyur can: dam tshig yum chen sgrol ma sku la 'khril: 'khor ba stongs phyir pad phreng dung dmar 'khyud: zhabs gnyis 'khril sbyor 'khor lo rgyas kyis 'debs: sa bcu'i dbang phyug gtum chen g.yul las rgyal: lag na rdo rje yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: rnga yab gling bzhugs 'gro mgon gu ru rje: gdong dmar srin po thabs kyis kha gnon mdzad: pad+ma 'byung gnas yab yum sku la bstod: bsil ba tshal du yon tan dngos grub brnyes: theg chen chos sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs mdzad pa: pad+ma saṃ bha'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: rā ga ra tir mkhyen gnyis dngos grub brnyes: shes bya kun la thogs med spobs pa rgyas: blo ldan mchog sred sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dga' ba tshal du dbang sdud dngos grub brnyes: ma sring rgya mtsho thabs kyis rol rtsal mdzad: pad+ma rgyal po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: so sa gling du 'gro 'dul dngos grub brnyes: srid zhi'i rmongs tshogs ma rig rab gzhom pa: nyi ma 'od zer sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: za hor yul du bdud 'dul dngos grub brnyes: log 'dren bdud rigs dam sri 'dul mdzad pa: shākya seṅge'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: ma ghar mu stegs 'dul ba'i dngos grub brnyes: dmod pa drag sngags gnam lcags thog mda' 'phen: seṅge sgra sgrogs sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: stag tshang dregs pa tshar gcod dngos grub brnyes: ma rungs tshar gcod khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ rdo rje gro lod sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:
