hūm̐: dug lnga 'joms mdzad dpa' bo chen po bzhi: rang 'dra mkha' 'gro sde yum dang bcas: bde stong dbang sgyur gtso bo yab yum brgyad: he ru ka pa brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: las bzhi mnga' mdzad gtum pa'i ging chen bzhi: rang 'dra shugs 'gro sde bzhi yum dang bcas: rdzu 'phrul shugs 'chang ging chen yab yum brgyad: 'jigs byed 'bar ba brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho mnyes pa'i gar ma gzugs: phyag na dbang po'i yul 'dzin mchod sprin thogs: khams g.yo 'khor lo bde stong phyag rgya can: bcu drug rig ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: zhing skyong laṅka dbang phyug ma mo dang : gnas nyul la sogs dkyil 'khor skyong ba'i tshogs: bka' yi bya ra las kyi mtha' sdud pa: gter srung la sogs yongs rdzogs bcas la bstod: de nas 'dzab kyis thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba bde gshegs 'dus pa'i tshogs: ye shes dbyings nas thugs dam rgyud bskul la: 'gro ba'i don phyir phrin las gter chen gyi: dgongs pa klong yangs byin rlabs shugs 'byung bas: sgrub la smin grol gdams pa zab mo mchog: 'bad med myur ba nyid la stsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru dharma tsit+ta gar+bha ā yur+dz+nyā na s-id+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa mā ya dza sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ hri ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dza sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes pa'i sngags phreng rnams bung bas rtsi myong ba'i sgra ltar gtsang si li li bzlas: bsnyen pa'i tshad kyang 'bum ther las mi nyung par bzlas so: de nas tshogs bya ba ni: thog mar chu gtsang gis bran zhing : oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: chos rnams mi dmigs spros dang bral: rang byung gdod nas mkha' ltar khyab: 'khor 'das ro gcig lta ba'i klong : gnyis med ye shes chen por bskyed:

gnyis 'dzin bag chags ka nas dag: oṃ dharma shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa sbyang ba ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid pad+ma 'od 'bar thugs ka nas: dug gsum sbyang phyir yig 'bru ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: 'od 'phros tshogs la phog pas nyes skyon gtor: bag chags rnam rtog mi dmigs sgyu mar sbyangs: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: lan gsum brjod: gsum pa spel ba ni: hūm̐: byin gyis rlob pa'i yig 'bru oṃ āḥhūm̐: 'dod yon tshogs la phog pas dpag med sbyangs: rtsa gsum bde gshegs mnyes pa'i mchod sprin tshogs: rmad byung nam mkha'i mtha' las khyab par spel: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ga ṇa tsakra sarba ma hā me gha s+pha ra ṇa oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes pa'i snying pos lan gsum gyis spel: bzhi pa tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: lhun grub rab 'byams stug po bkod zhing nas: bla ma bder 'dus chos sku rgya mtsho rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: bde chen mkha' dbyings khyab brdal pho brang nas: bla ma bder 'dus longs sku rgya mtsho rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: zang thal lhan skyes gnyug ma'i pho brang nas: bla ma bder 'dus sprul sku rgya mtsho rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas: o rgyan dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: bde chen nam mkha' 'phrul gyi gdengs ka nas: chos srung bstan pa'i bya ra 'khor bcas rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rab 'jigs sa gsum g.yo ba'i dur khrod nas: bstan srung las mkhan myur mgyogs 'khor bcas rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: chos sku rgya mtsho ka dag sangs se sang : longs sku rgya mtsho rang mdangs ta la la: sprul sku rgya mtsho 'ja' tshon spungs se spung : rtsa brgyud bla ma byin rlabs thibs se thib: yi dam lha tshogs hūm̐ sgra 'u ru ru:

ma sring mkha' 'gro'-i brda skad di ri ri: dpa' bo rgya mtshos gar byed shigs se shig: dpa' mo rgya mtshos glu len kyu ru ru: ging chen pho mos gar stabs khrigs se khrig: chos skyong rgya mtsho las byed sha ra ra: nor lha dbang sdud longs spyod chi li li: gter srung gnyer gtad bya ra lhangs se lhang : tshogs gsog rgya mtsho'i bcud g.yo me re re: gnas khang byin 'bebs gar mo kyi li li: 'dir tshogs pho mo dga' bro ya la la: gnas 'dir gshegs la dbang bskur byin chen phob: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ lnga pa tshogs mchod pa ni: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : dam can chos srung nor gyi bdag: gter bdag gnyan po skyong la sogs: rig 'dzin bder 'dus dkyil 'khor la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bla med bdud rtsi'-i mchod pa 'bul: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: sna tshogs spyan gzigs mchod pa 'bul: mthun rdzas brtse bas bzhai+es su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi: tshogs phud dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du phul: drug pa bskang ba mchod pa ni: hūm̐: phyi mchod mdzes pa'i lha mo sna tshogs dang : nang mchod sha lnga bdud rtsi a mṛ ta: gsang mchod bde stong chags med ye shes rdzas: sman gtor rak+ta sbyor sgrol dbang po lnga: spyan gzigs dkor cha yid 'ong mnyes pa'i brten: rol mo sgra snyan gdangs dbyangs dgyes pa'i glu: kun nas ma tshang med pa'i mchod sprin 'di: bla ma rig 'dzin bde gshegs 'dus pa'i tshogs: rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : nyams chag bskangs shing bar chad sel gyur na: mchog thun 'bad med lhun grub stsal du gsol:

zhes thugs dam bskangs: bdun pa bshags pa ni: hūm̐: rtsa gsum kun 'dus lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag cag dkyil 'khor zab mo'i sgor zhugs nas: bag med dbang gyur dam 'gal ci mchis pa: mthol bshags bzod gsol mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: oṃ gu ru sa twa sa ma ya: ma nu pā la ya: gu ru sa twa twe no pa: sogs yig rgya brjod: brgyad pa bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i lha: dkyil 'khor skyong sogs srung ma 'khor bcas kyi: bden pa chen po'i mthu stobs nus pa yis: bla ma'i sku dgra sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra: rnal 'byor sgos dgra sems can yongs la 'tshe: ma nyes log par lta ba'i dgra bgegs kyi: bla tshe rnam shes srog dbugs dbang thang bcas: steng 'og phyogs bcu'i bar mtshams gar gnas kyang : snying nas zungs shig ma mo za byed ma: ske nas zungs shig ma mo gsod byed ma: yan lag sdoms shig ma mo sha za ma: myos par gyis shig ma mo srog bdag ma: lha dang phyes shig ma mo zangs gri ma: bdud dang sprod cig ma mo spu gri ma: dbyer med gtubs shig ma mo srid bdag ma: dus la bab bo pho nya mthu ma chung : dmigs pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs shor ra re: rang dbang med par myur du khug la shog: oṃ ma tri ma tri re ma ti rak+mo a tri ya dgra bgegs a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ de nas phur bu thogs la: hūm̐: dpal chen sras mchog badz+ra kī la ya: rgya mdud steng nas 'brug stong di ri ri: 'chang bzung ngos nas glog dmar khyugs se khyug: chu srin kha nas ser ba hri li li: zur gsum rngam la thog rgod sha ra ra: 'dril zhing 'debs pa'i shan pa phur bu khyod: dgra bgegs gdug pa'i snying la mā ra ya: brlag cing bcom nas ming yang med par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig+nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ru tra shag thuṃ nṛ tri ya ma ha ri kha dgra bgegs kyi srog la gzer thuṃ bi shwa tsakra ha la ha la hūm̐ phaṭḥ

dgu pa zhal du bstab pa ni: hūm̐: bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha: ye shes spyan ldan 'khor dang bcas pa yi: gnam sa ri rab khyon ltar zhal phyes la: dgra bgegs don snying sha khrag bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta la kha kha khā hi: bcu pa tshogs la rol ba ni: rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: bla med dkyil 'khor rdzas chen gyi: dngos grub rmad byung ro brgya'i zas: deng 'dir skal ldan rnams la stsol: de nas slob dpon gyis: hoḥ 'di ni legs 'ong ya mtshan ldan: 'khor 'das ro gcig blang dor bral: gtsang rme gzung 'dzin gdod nas dag: dge bas de bzhin a la la hoḥ e ma hoḥ bcu gcig pa lhag ma btang ba ni: hūm̐: dang po phud kyi mchod pa ni: bla ma rig 'dzin dgyes pa'i rtags: bar du bskang zhing bshags pa ni: yi dam mkha' 'gro mthun pa'i rdzas: tha ma 'gugs shing bsgral ba ni: chos skyong dam can rbad pa'i rtags: dbyer med tshogs la rol ba ni: nor lha gter bdag dngos grub brda: kun nas lhag ma sdud pa ni: laṅka gnas nyul dgyes par mtshon: dkyil 'khor mtha' la bzhag pa ni: bka' bzhin bstan pa srung bar stsol: lhag ma kha chus bran pa ni: 'da' ka dam tshig gcig par ston: hūm̐: bde gshegs rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs bstan srung ni: mtshan mo sgra sgrogs ma mo bye ba 'bum: srod la rab rgyu sna tshogs cho 'phrul ston: smag rum gseb nas mi sdug bshugs ring 'then: la las rgyan mdzes spras nas mkha' la lding : la las 'dab chags bzhon nas bar snang kheng : la las sder chags bzhon nas sa gzhi nyul: la las gcer mo dur khrod baṃ ro khur: la las g.yang gzhi gyon cing bhan+dha thogs: la las nang rol 'dren zhing rgyu ma za: la las srod 'phros drod nyul lam lam 'gyu: don la thams cad rnal 'byor ma sring ste:

bye brag so sor snang ngor sgyu ma'i gar: mi bzad gar sgyur bstan pa'i bya ra tshogs: bka' yi las byed phra men 'khor bcas kyis: 'dod yon tshogs kyi lhag ma 'di bzhes la: rgyud srung sgrub pa'i sdong grogs ma g.yel zhing : ma rungs gdug pa'i tshogs rnams tshar bcad nas: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ma ma tri hriṃ hriṃ mu kha le sa ma ya maṇ+ḍal pā la i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: dang po thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: rnam dag ye shes dbyings kyi pho brang nas: rig 'dzin kun gyi 'dus gzugs pad+ma 'byung : rtsa gsum lha tshogs bde gshegs dkyil 'khor rnams: thugs rje'i klong nas sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs shig: deng 'dir 'gro la brtse chen gzigs par bskul: deng sang yang mtha' snyigs ma lnga brgya'i dus: sems can dmu rgod khro gtum 'gong po'i tshogs: rnam smin bag chags brtsegs pa'i ngan goms kyis: ci byed rgyu 'bras khyad gsod brtson lags pas: 'chi 'pho ltung bar thugs rje'i rtsal phyungs la: srid pa'i rgya mtsho skem pa'i dus la bab: sdug bsngal btson ra bshig pa'i dus la bab: rnam smin 'khrul sgo gcod pa'i dus la bab: deng nas sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skems par mdzod: hūm̐: bskul lo bzhengs shig rgyal ba thugs rje can: rtsa gsum bder 'dus lha tshogs mthu ma chung : sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khyad du dmod de phrin las bcol ba ni: deng sang snyigs ma yang mtha' 'dul dka'i dus: ma rungs sdig to bdud kyi sde tshogs kyis: gsang sngags bstan pa gnyan la dgra dar bas: mthu chen khyod kyi mngon spyod dus la bab: bar gcod brtsams pa'i log 'dren 'di dag kun: rdo rje bka' yis chad pas rab brdegs nas: bcom zhing brlags te ming yang med par mdzod: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sarba sa ma ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: gnyis pa chad mdo btang ba ni:

hūm̐: sngon tshe 'og min bkod pa rab rdzogs nas: zhing khams pho brang 'thug po bkod pa ru: thog ma'i mgon po snang ba mtha' yas dang : rigs kyi yum chen rdo rje rnal 'byor gnyis: ka dag dang po'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs pa ru: sprul sku sgyu ma'i rang gzugs bstan nas kyang : skye 'gag gnas gsum dngos blo bral ba bzhin: gang shar bde stong gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sna tshogs bdag med rtogs pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og gsang sgrom me ri 'bar ba yi: ma la ya zhes tsit+ta'i pho brang nas: rdo rje 'chang dbang dga' rab rdo rje dang : dbyings kyi yum chen snyems ma kun gsal gnyis: rtsal snang brda bzhi'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: ma sring ḍāk+ki dbang phyug rgya mtsho yis: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang : bstan srung phrin las bcol bar khas blangs bzhin: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dngos grub mchog stsol bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og bod yul dbus kyi bsam yas nas: brag dmar mchims phu dpal gyi ke'u tshang du: rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang : dbyings kyi yum chen mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal gnyis: bder 'dus srog sgrub dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: lo tsā'i dwangs ma sangs rgyas ye shes la: lung bstan bka' gtad kha byang phog pa'i tshe: rgyal po la sogs dregs chen bco brgyad kyis: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang : bka' yi bstan pa bsrung phyir khas blangs bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad du gsol: hūm̐: de 'og lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma ru: brag dmar mchims phu dpal gyi gnas mchog tu: rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho yis: bder 'dus zil gnon thugs sgrub gdan drangs tshe: sngags bdag ma mo e ka dzā ṭi yis: dngos su gzugs bstan gter sgrom phul ba'i tshe:

zab chos rgyas pa'i grogs mor khas blangs bzhin: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dus drug ma g.yel bya ra mdzad du gsol: oṃ sarba ḍāk+ki nī dharma pā la ma tri e ka dzā ṭi sa ma ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: gsum pa brtan skyong bya ba ni: hūm̐: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i bka' nyan ma: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis ni: bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma: dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje ya ma skyong : gangs dkar sha med rdo rje kun tu bzang : 'brog chen 'khor 'dus rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso: gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje g.yu bun ma: kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum: gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje klu mo dang : rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal: kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong : btsan la rol pa'i rdo rje sman gcig ma: mo btsun ug chos rdo rje g.yar mo bsil: g.yu yi dril bu rdo rje si le ma: ma sring bod skyong chen mo bcu gnyis ni: so so'i bran g.yog yang 'khor g.yog dang bcas: lhab lhub mdzes pa'i na bza' sku la gsol: sna tshogs rgyan cha mang po khro lo lo: g.yer kha rol mo sil snyan si li li: glu len bro rdung gar rtsed khyugs se khyug: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa'i bya ra mel tshe mdzod: oṃ pra mo li tsa tur yak+sha li tsa tur ma tri li tsa tur ya sarba i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: bzhi pa rta bro bya ba ni: hūm̐: bde gshegs rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du: grub thob rgya mtshos bro brdungs pas: ye shes lnga ru lhun gyis grub: mu kha chos 'byung khri rkang du: rdo rje mchu yi bro brdungs pas: rigs drug 'khor ba'i rgyud lam gcod: las mtha' rnam bzhi'i dal dbus su: so so'i phrin las bro brdungs pas: rang rang gzhung bzhin lhun gyis grub:

bro yang ye shes chen po'i bro: glu yang ye shes chen po'i glu: gar yang phyag rgya drug gi gar: gdangs kyang ma 'gags rig pa'i sgra: de ltar brda dang rten 'brel gyis: sna tshogs las kun lhun grub shog: oṃ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: sgab 'dre 'byung po thams cad satwaṃ bha ya nan: tshe 'gugs bya ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hri ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ ba su sid+dhi na na kha dhi ā yu puṇ+ye sarba bsdus bsdus pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: mkha' mnyam tshe bdag 'od dpag med: chos dbyings nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na shrī bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: lhun grub rigs lnga rdo rje sems: sku lnga dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na shrī bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: rigs 'dus pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: thugs rje ye shes dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na shrī bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: dbyings phyug bde chen mtsho rgyal ma: dbang sgyur stobs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na shrī bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: mtshan brgyad rig 'dzin rje 'bangs tshogs: rmad byung sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la:

bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na shrī bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: dngos grub kun stsol yi dam lha: thugs rje rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na shrī bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: bka' sdod mkha' 'gro chos srung rnams: dam tshig gnyan po'i dkyil 'khor du: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na shrī bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: bskul lo rig 'dzin snying nas bskul: skyed cig thugs dam dbyings nas skyed: bdag cag rig 'dzin sgrub pa por: tshe dang ye shes char chen phob: phyi snod 'byung ba'i tshe bkrag mdangs: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: sgrub rdzas ye shes bdud rtsir bskyil: bkrag dang gzi mdangs ya la la: rig rtsal ye shes stobs skyed la: 'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub par stsol: mda' dar g.yob sgrub rdzas bdag nyid dngos su mos par bskyed/ rtse gcig gsol btab dngos grub stsol bar dmigs/ hūm̐: bstan pa 'di la ngo mtshar rmad byung ba'i: 'jig rten dbang bsgyur pad+ma rgyal po ni: rigs ni za hor rgyal po'i sras su 'khrungs: o rgyan yul du sgro 'dogs ma lus bcad: bsil ba tshal du dngos grub sna tshogs brnyes: wā rā ṇa sīr chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: rgya gar yul du bstan pa rgyas par mdzad: 'jig rten khams kyi gdug pa thams cad btul: bod yul dbus su rgyal po'i thugs dam bskangs: kha ba can du bstan pa rgyas par mdzad: lho nub mtshams su 'gro ba'i don du dgongs: sku tshab lung bstan gsung tshab gter du sbas: lho nub mtshams su 'gro ba'i don la dgongs: skal ldan rnams la zab gsang brda chos ston:

zangs mdog dpal rir rig 'dzin gtso 'khor bzhugs: rnga yab gling du srin po'i kha gnon mdzad: 'jig rten 'khor ba ma stongs de srid bar: mya ngan mi 'da' thugs rje spyan gcig po: sku gsum dbyer med che mchog he ru kaḥ mnyam med bla ma mchog khyod dus 'dir dran: gsol ba 'debs so o rgyan rin po che: thugs rjes khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas sprugs: khyad par bdag sogs bod kyi rje 'bangs rnams: rtse gcig pha khyod yon tan dran pa yis: mos gus gdung bas 'bod pa cang gsan nam: brtse chen thugs rje skyed cig mthu ma chung : bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: sku lnga rigs 'dus gu ru zil gnon la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus zhu: skye shi bral ba'i bde chen rgyal po la: lta ba'i gzhi rtsa chod pa'i dngos grub zhu: ka dag mngon rdzogs dpa' bo gyad kyi skur: g.yo med dgongs pa rang gsal dngos grub zhu: tshogs drug zhen bral dus gsum mkhyen pa la: spyod pa blang dor bral ba'i dngos grub zhu: 'byung lnga rang grol rdo rje rnal 'byor mar: blo bral chos zad 'bras bu'i dngos grub zhu: 'chi med mgon po 'phags mchog sman gyi lhar: tshe ring nad med bde skyid dngos grub zhu: 'dod rgu'i srid rje pad+ma rgyal po la: dgos 'byung lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub zhu: gsang sngags rig sngags khyab bdag gur gyi lhar: log 'dren bdud bzhi tshar gcod dngos grub zhu: drag sngags rtsal 'byin stobs ldan kī la yar: shugs sgrol phrin las mthar phyin dngos grub zhu: bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa brgyad skyob zil gnon lhar: skye 'gro bde la 'god pa'i dngos grub zhu: snang srid dbang bsgyur stag zhon yi dam lhar: chos ltar phyogs med thob pa'i dngos grub zhu: lha 'dre mi gsum 'dul mdzad nyi ma 'od: bzang ngan 'brel tshad don ldan dngos grub zhu: tshad med bzhi ldan dregs pa zil gnon lhar:

dmod pa'i las kun gdung mchog dngos grub zhu: bla ma rig 'dzin zhi khro rab 'byams lhar: mngon spyod rdzu 'phrul thogs med dngos grub zhu: gnas yul skyong zhing dpa' bo ḍāk+ki la: rten 'brel phyogs med 'char ba'i dngos grub zhu: bka' nyan las byed chos skyong srung ma la: las bzhi thogs med 'grub pa'i dngos grub zhu: ye shes las grub dkyil 'khor thams cad la: snang srid chos skur 'char ba'i dngos grub zhu: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: mos pas gsol ba snying nas btab pa'i mod: bde gshegs sgyu 'phrul dgongs pa gcig tu dril: sku yi gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum du 'char: gsung gi gdangs sgra 'brug stong ldir ba'i che: thugs kyi dgongs pa nam mkha'i glog bas myur: yon tan gdul bya'i rol pa ma 'dres gsal: phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam ris med brdal: 'gyur med rdo rje sku yi dngos grub stsol: nad gdon sdig sgrib rkyen ngan bral ba'i tshe: mi 'gyur g.yung drung lta bur lhun grub nas: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: 'gag med rdo rje gsung gi dngos grub stsol: ngag gi sgrib dag brgyad khri bzhi stong sgo: gdul bya so so'i skad du chos ston pas: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca āḥ 'khrul med rdo rje thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: yid kyi sgrib dag chos nyid bde ba che: dus gsum bstan pa'i bdag por lhun grub nas: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: yon tan rdo rje gzi brjid dngos grub stsol: shes bya'i sgrib dag sangs rgyas thugs rje rdzogs: 'khor 'das lhun 'byams zad med gter mnga' ba: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:

gu ru gu na a bhi ṣiñca trām̐: phrin las rdo rje mthu stobs dngos grub stsol: rtog sgrib dag nas thabs shes dngos grub stsol: dgongs pas rgyas thebs gdul bya mthar phyin nas: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru karma a bhi ṣiñca hoḥ

bsnyen sgrub las sbyor sngags bzlas dbang rnams blang : lnga pa dngos grub blang ba ni: hūm̐: bde mchog ngo bo lhun grub ka dag las: legs rtsal sprul pa'i rnam rol cher ston pa: bder 'dus rig 'dzin rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha: sangs rgyas sku dngos pad 'byung mkha' 'gros bskor: rtsa brgyud bla ma thugs rje'i gter chen po: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag la: tshe chos zas nor gos dang snyan grags stobs: kun la dbang bsgyur 'khor 'bangs mnga' thang rgyas: srid spel longs spyod 'dod pa'i yon tan rnams: skad cig nyid la deng 'dir thob gyur cig: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ha ri ni sa ā yur+dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: dbang dang dngos grub kyi rdzas la rol: de nas mchod pa ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ sogs? shab+da pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: bstod pa ni: ma bcos spros bral ka dag ngo bo nyid: zang thal 'gags med thugs rjes so sor ston: 'gro ba'i don phyir thugs rje sgyu ma'i gar: o rgyan gu ru pad 'byung sku la bstod: bstod par 'os p bshags pa ni/ ma 'byor p sogs yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po bzlas 'di nas rten sogs/ drug pa bkra shis brjod pa ni: chos sku'i bkra shis snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur: gnas lugs rgyal sa zin pa'i bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis drug pa rdo rje 'chang : thugs rje phyogs bcur khyab pa'i bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung : 'gro kun smin grol 'god pa'i bkra shis shog: snyan brgyud bkra shis mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma: zab rgya mkha' ltar brtan pa'i bkra shis shog: smon lam bkra shis bud+dha dz+nyā na ba: lung bstan dus las mi 'da' bkra shis shog: bla ma'i bkra shis rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling : 'gro don phyogs mthar khyab pa'i bkra shis shog:

gter gnas bkra shis mchims phu ke'u tshang du: byin chags yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog: zab rgya'i bkra shis zil gnon rig 'dzin 'dus: mkha' ltar mtha' yas kun khyab bkra shis shog: gter srung bkra shis sngags bdag ral gcig ma: phrin las glog ltar myur ba'i bkra shis shog: nyin yang bkra shis mtshan yang bkra shis nas: nyin mtshan rtag tu bkra shis bde legs shog: bdun pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hoḥ mi dmigs ka dag ngo bo dbyings rig gi: kun gsal rol pa'i cho 'phrul zhi khro'i lha: lhan skyes ye shes gnyug ma'i sbubs su bsdu: bde gsal mi rtog gnas lugs ngo bor āḥ a a āḥ brgyad pa bsngo ba 'gyed pa ni: hūm̐: gdod nas chos dbyings lhun grub ngo bo yang : de don ma rtogs rmongs 'gyu'i sems can rigs: a 'thas zhen pa'i gol lam bsal mdzad phyir: kun rig don gnyis rtogs phyir dge tshogs bsngo: dgu pa smon lam sbyar ba ni: hoḥ bla med bder 'dus rgyal ba'i dal bzung nas: mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin rtse gcig gis: ma 'ongs 'di nas rnga yab dpal ri ru: pad 'byung rgyal ba'i sras su 'khrungs par shog: ces pa'i dge tshogs? gus 'dun brgyan pa'i? de yi 'phrul gyis? dge bar 'dun? ting 'dzin 'khyams mor? rgya yan bar ma dor? bag yod brtan par? 'dzin blo cher bskyed? 'di ga nas skabs cung zhig dgos pa mi gda' bas bzhag: sa ma ya: e ma 'od dbyings brtse ba dpag dka'i 'dod snam la: spras pa'i mu tig nyi ma'i rgyan mdzes la: brda tshogs drwa ba'i sor rtse'i zlos gar gyis: 'od ris gzugs dbang 'bum gyis mngon dgyes nas: mkha' bdag pad+mo'i skyed yangs 'dab bzhad pa: 'dzum pa'i ge sar mi bskyod 'bum pa'i blos: rgyu gnyis rgya mtsho'i smin legs ka ras bkod: 'grub des theg chen lam zhugs dga' ston ru: pad 'phrul dpal yon brgyan 'os sras de la: zab pa srid pa'i las srung sprod do rgya:

sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: mi nub rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa khyi lor bod yul bsam yas mchims phu'i ke'u tshang nas gdan drangs shing chu pho stag lor sbas yul gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // nga)bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: byin 'bebs tshangs pa'i gaṇ+ḍi'i phreng ba bzhugs so: bla ma'i thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu las: byin 'bebs dkyil 'khor bca' gzhi gzhung lag len: snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i go rim gyis: dbang bzhi chu bo'i bka' chen 'bebs pa'i tshe: thugs rje'i dbyings nas 'dul zhing bu yi ched: skal ldan smin grol lam la bkod pa'i phyir: thog mar rigs ldan bcu drug gar chas spras: longs sku'i chas kyis phyug par bgyis nas su: ḍā ma ru dang dril bu rkang gling bcas: rol mo'i bye brag ji snyed tshogs nas su: zhing khams kun khyab dri bsung phyur mar btang : 'phan dar rgyan 'phyangs mkha' la bskyod pa'i rigs: phyogs bcur mchod pa'i rnam pa bsgrengs nas su: dkyil 'khor mtha' nas gar 'cham dbyangs ring len: mos gus gdung ba'i shugs las 'di skad do: hūm̐ hrīḥ ka dag bde chen zhing khams nas: rigs kyi bdag po thog ma'i mgon: rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas tshogs dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen phob: mos pa'i bu la dbang mchog bskur: o rgyan mkha' spyod zhing khams nas: longs sku'i dbang phyug 'jig rten mgon: dag zhing rig 'dzin tshogs dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen phob: mos pa'i bu la dbang mchog bskur: rang byung lhun grub zhing khams nas: shāka thub rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung : sprul sku byang sems rjes 'brangs bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen phob: mos pa'i bu la dbang mchog bskur: he ru ka pa'i gnas bcu nas: dbyings phyug las kyi dbang mo dang :

grub thob rig 'dzin brgyud par bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen phob: mos pa'i bu la dbang mchog bskur: gnas yul sgrub gnas gter mdzod nas: bka' 'dus bder 'dus dgongs 'dus kyi: dkyil 'khor lha dang srung ma bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen phob: mos pa'i bu la dbang mchog bskur: bsam yas gangs can ma la yar: bder 'dus rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus kyi: man ngag bka' bab brgyud 'dzin bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen phob: mos pa'i bu la dbang mchog bskur: sku yi sgo nas byin rlobs 'tshal: gsung gi gdams pa gnad sgrogs 'tshal: thugs kyi gdams pa sgo dbye 'tshal: 'gro ba'i don du brtan bzhugs 'tshal: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid dang : bdag dang mos pa'i bu slob la: thugs rje'i skyong bar mdzad du gsol: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī badz+ra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sarba sa ma ye swā hā: zhes rig 'dzin brgyud pa bcas byon nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par bsams: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: snang ba mtha' yas byin phob cig: dag pa mkha' spyod pho brang nas: spyan ras gzigs dbang byin phob cig: ri rgyal me ri 'bar ba ru: dga' rab rdo rjes byin phob cig: lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog nas: phyag na rdo rjes byin phob cig: ma la ya yi gnas mchog nas: shrī singhas byin phob cig: bde byed brtsegs pa'i gnas mchog nas: las kyi dbang mos byin phob cig: dha na ko sha'i klong nas 'khrungs: mtsho skyes rdo rjes byin phob cig: mā ra ti ka'i gnas mchog nas: man+da ra bas byin phob cig: thor lcog dgu ldan pho brang nas: in+d+ra bo dhis byin phob cig: hūm̐: bsil ba tshal gyi gnas mchog nas: hūm̐ chen ka ras byin phob cig: sku la rdzogs pa'i gnas mchog nas: 'jam dpal bshes gnyen byin phob cig: laṅka brtsegs pa'i gnas mchog nas:

nā gardzu nas byin phob cig: pad+ma brtsegs pa'i gnas mchog nas: pra bha hastīs byin phob cig: lhun grub gter gyi gnas mchog nas: bi ma mi tras byin phob cig: gsang chen rol pa'i gnas mchog nas: dha na saṃ skṛs byin phob cig: he chen brdal ba'i gnas mchog nas: rom+bu gu h+yas byin phob cig: 'jig rten brtsegs pa'i gnas mchog nas: shān+tiṃ gar+bhas byin phob cig: nags tshal drwa ba can gyi gnas: nyi zla dngos grub byin phob cig: dbang bzhi ngo bo gcig tu sdud: pad+ma thod phreng byin phob cig: thabs shes zung 'jug 'gro ba 'dul: mthing 'od 'bar bas byin phob cig: rdzu 'phrul sku yi bkod pa bstan: pad+ma badz+ras byin phob cig: hūm̐: bde chen 'khor lo'i pho brang nas: rdo rje thod phreng byin phob cig: longs spyod 'khor lo'i pho brang nas: pad+ma thod phreng byin phob cig: chos kyi 'khor lo'i pho brang nas: bud+dha thod phreng byin phob cig: sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i pho brang nas: rat+na thod phreng byin phob cig: bde skyong 'khor lo'i pho brang nas: karma thod phreng byin phob cig: me long ye shes ngo bo nyid: rdo rje mkha' 'gros byin phob cig: sor rtog ye shes ngo bo nyid: pad+ma mkha' 'gros byin phob cig: chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gros byin phob cig: mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid: rin chen mkha' 'gros byin phob cig: bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid: las kyi mkha' 'gros byin phob cig: hūm̐: ye grol rtogs pa 'khor 'das khyab: rnam smin rig 'dzin byin phob cig: zhi ba'i dgongs pa byams pa'i 'od: sar gnas rig 'dzin byin phob cig: rgyas pa'i dgongs pa snying rje'-i shugs: tshe dbang rig 'dzin byin phob cig: dbang gi dgongs pas dga' ba 'phel: phyag rgya'i rig 'dzin byin phob cig: drag po'i dgongs pas btang snyoms can: lhun grub rig 'dzin byin phob cig:

hūm̐: rgya mtsho'i klong nas sku 'khrungs pa: pad+ma 'byung gnas byin phob cig: 'ja' lus rang bzhin skye 'chi spangs: tsaṇ+ḍa lī yis byin phob cig: yi dam rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: dbang chen rta mchog byin phob cig: smin grol bum bzang yang bcud ldan: rdo rje phag mos byin phob cig: hūm̐: bsil ba tshal gyi gnas mchog nas: pad+ma sam bhas byin phob cig: rā ga rak+ta'i gnas mchog nas: blo ldan mchog sred byin phob cig: dga' ba tshal gyi gnas mchog nas: pad+ma rgyal pos byin phob cig: so sa gling gi gnas mchog nas: nyi ma 'od zer byin phob cig: za hor gsang ba'i gnas mchog nas: shākya seṅges byin phob cig: rdo rje gdan gyi gnas mchog nas: seṅge sgra sgrogs byin phob cig: stag tshang seṅge bsam 'grub nas: rdo rje gro lod byin phob cig: hūm̐: mchims phu dge'u gong ke'u tshang nas: snang srid zil gnon byin phob cig: ke'u ri gsang ba yang rdzong nas: ye shes mtsho rgyal byin phob cig: bsam yas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: khri srong lde'u btsan byin phob cig: rdzu 'phrul brag la phur pa gdab: sangs rgyas ye shes byin phob cig: rlung sems rtsal rdzogs nyi zer zhon: nam mkha'i snying pos byin phob cig: stong nyid rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog: rgyal ba mchog dbyangs byin phob cig: ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud: dpal gyi ye shes byin phob cig: lha srin sde brgyad dam la btags: rlangs chen dpal seng byin phob cig: mkhas grub chos kyi sgro 'dogs bcad: bai ro tsa nas byin phob cig: ting 'dzin rtogs pa mngon du gyur: g.yu sgra snying pos byin phob cig: nus pas brag la bdud rtsi 'byin: gnyags chen dz+nyā nas byin phob cig: drag sngags dmod pas gdug pa 'dul: rdo rje bdud 'joms byin phob cig: rgyal sras mkha' spyod gnas su 'phur: ye shes dbyings kyis byin phob cig:

kha la mtshon thogs gcan gzan 'dzin: sog po lha dpal byin phob cig: mkha' lding lta bur dbyings la bskyod: sna nam ye shes byin phob cig: gdeng chog phur pas mngon spyod grub: dpal gyi dbang phyug byin phob cig: tshe rabs mi brjed dran pa rnyed: ldan ma rtse mang byin phob cig: mngon spyod dgongs pas gzhan rgyud mthong : ska ba dpal brtsegs byin phob cig: snod kyi rgya mtsho mkha' la bzlog: shud bu dpal seng byin phob cig: 'dun pas ro langs gser bsgyur nus: rgyal ba'i blo gros byin phob cig: 'od kyi lcags kyus mkha' lding 'dzin: khye'u chung lo tsās byin phob cig: dmod pa'i pho nyas byang g.yag 'gugs: dran pa nam mkhas byin phob cig: rgya mtshor thogs med nya ltar 'gyu: 'o bran dbang phyug byin phob cig: sra mkhregs pha bong zan ltar rol: rma thog rin chen byin phob cig: rtogs pas ri brag thogs med bgrod: dpal gyi rdo rjes byin phob cig: mkha' la rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: rgyal ba byang chub byin phob cig: gnam lcags thog rgod mda' ltar 'phen: lang 'gro dkon mchog byin phob cig: pad 'byung sprul pas 'gro ba 'dul: rig 'dzin bla mas byin phob cig: hūm̐: bde gshegs kun gyi thugs sgrub ste: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus byin phob cig: thabs kyis 'gro don mdzad pa yi: dpa' bo ging brgyad byin phob cig: shes rab grol lam ston mdzad pa'i: ma sring brgyad kyis byin phob cig: bla med dkyil 'khor mchod 'bul ma: lha mo bcu drug byin phob cig: sgo bzhi skyong mdzad bdud bzhi bsrungs: laṅka ging brgyad byin phob cig: gnas nyul rnal 'byor tshogs khang 'grim: dbang phyug phra men byin phob cig: hūm̐: rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang nas: lha yi dbang pos byin phob cig: gling bzhir dbang sgyur dad dpon pa: tshogs bdag tshangs pas byin phob cig: mnga' dbang 'dod spyod rgyud kyis phyug:

gnod sbyin chen pos byin phob cig: dgos 'dod mchod sbyin dbul phongs sel: klu yi dbang pos byin phob cig: zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor shar sgo skyong : yul 'khor srung bas byin phob cig: rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor lho sgo skyong : 'phags skyes po yis byin phob cig: dbang gi dkyil 'khor nub sgo skyong : spyan mi bzang gis byin phob cig: drag po'i dkyil 'khor byang sgo skyong : rnam thos sras kyis byin phob cig: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor phyi nang bar chad srung : khro bcu yab yum byin phob cig: skal med log lta sgrol mdzad pa: gnod sbyin mched gsum byin phob cig: sgrub la mi dbang dam sri sgrol: gter srung yongs rdzogs byin phob cig: hūm̐: bde gshegs kun 'dus dkyil 'khor du: bla ma rnams kyis byin phob cig: sgrub chen bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor du: yi dam rnams kyis byin phob cig: ma rgyud 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: mkha' 'gro rnams kyis byin phob cig: 'chi med bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du: tshe bdag rnams kyis byin phob cig: dngos grub kun 'byung dkyil 'khor du: nor bdag rnam sras byin phob cig: bar chad kun sel dkyil 'khor nas: rdo rje gzhon nus byin phob cig: las mtha' mngon spyod dkyil 'khor du: chos skyong gter srung byin phob cig: hūm̐: zhi ba dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas: thugs rje'i sprin phung thibs se thib: drag po khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor du: dgyes pa'i 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: gnyis med sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: gzi byin glog dmar khyugs se khyug: dkyil 'khor kun 'dus lha tshogs rnams: byin rlabs char rgyun na ra ra: zhi ba'i lha tshogs spungs se spung : khro bo'i drag sngags 'u ru ru: dpa' bos gar byed shigs se shig: dpa' mos glu len kyu ru ru: rig 'dzin sprin ltar kyi li li: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri:

ging chen bro rdung khrabs se khrab: ging mos gar thabs khyugs se khyug: chos skyong las byed sha ra ra: gnas nyul bshugs sgra tsi ri ri: byin 'bebs dbyangs snyan ta la la: skal ldan bzhad gad ya la la: byin 'bebs gar thabs khrigs se khrig: rin chen dar dpyangs pu ru ru: rus rgyan g.yer kha si li li: ḍā ru cang te'u khro lo lo: rnga sgra dung sgra bhi ri ri: gnas mchog dam pa nyams re spro: gnas mchog nyams re dga' ba'i dkyil: rigs 'dus dkyil 'khor byin re che: lha dang srung ma bag re dro: skal ldan pho mo dam tshig gtsang : dri bzang dud pa bsung re zhim: sman gtor rak+ta bcud re che: tshogs kyi 'khor lo lhun re mtho: māṃ sa sha chen dbyings su bsnyegs: tshogs chang bdud rtsi mtsho ltar 'khyil: shing 'bras zas rnams bsam las 'das: spyan gzigs mchod sprin dpag med tshogs: dam tshig lnga yis rgyas btab nas: ye shes lnga ru byin gyis brlabs: sa bon yig 'brus dbang mchog bskur: bdag dang mos pa'i bu slob la: byin phob rgyal ba thugs rje can: sku yi dbang mchog lus la bskur: skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub stsol: gsung gi dbang bzhi ngag la bskur: tshangs dbyangs drug cu'i dngos grub stsol: thugs kyi dbang bzhi yid la bskur: 'khrul 'dzin zhig pa'i dngos grub stsol: sgo gsum tha mal mi g.yel bar: pad 'byung nyid ltar bdag gyur cig: oṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ sa ma ya a be sha ya a ā: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dza sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ phaṭḥ

ces pas rig pa ngar bskyed la rol mo drag tu brdungs la: dmigs pa ni: o rgyan mkha' spyod 'og min bkod zhing sogs dang rang rang gnas nas rgyal ba rig 'dzin brgyud bcas kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar byon nas dkyil 'khor dang mchod pa'i bye brag khyad par 'dus pa'i las can gyi 'khor dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bu slob rnams la thim pas thugs rje byin rlabs kyi shugs g.yos te gzi brjid mi bzod par bsgom: ye shes pa byin 'bebs pa'i rtags su sa g.yo ri 'bir rlung char khu rlangs gtibs: 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba bkra shis pa'i rtags rnams 'byung : lus bde drod g.yo nus pa bskyed rnam rtog rgyun chad: 'dar 'phar la sogs ngo mtshar ba'i nyams 'byung : lus ba spu g.yo la gdan gyi kha nas yar 'phar nus pa sogs nyams 'phar: yang na sngar las med pa'i rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs: rmi ltas bzang po 'byung : byin 'bebs pa ni: sgrub khang la dkyil 'khor dbang bskur ba: gnas ri bzang por las grub skabs: sku gsung thugs rten la rab gnas bskyar ba sogs la med thabs med pa yin: de ltar byin 'bebs kyi rigs rnams rje btsun chen pos dkyil 'khor rnam gsum zhal phyes nas rnga yab dpal ri la byon khar lha klu mi dang mi ma yin dang khyad par rgyal chen sde bzhi bcas kyis: maṇ+ḍal phul te zhus pa'i tshe: rig 'dzin chen pos mdo sngags rgya bod kyi rgyud: dbang bzhi bka' chen 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor bcas las phyogs sgril byin 'bebs 'di nyid: ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis dbu mdzad nas rje 'bangs nyer lnga lha klu bka' bab bcas la gdams pa'i shog dril gnod sbyin mched gsum la bka' gdams pa'o: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: mi nub rgya: ྀatsha rgya: kho bo rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa khyi lor bsam yas mchims phu nas gdan drangs shing lcags phag lor khams tshin+dha ha nā ga ko ṭi ma la ya yi gnas su zhal rgyas pa'o//

// ca)༄༅/ /rig 'dzin srog sgrub yid bzhin nor bu las: spro bsdu dmigs pa'i 'dzab dgongs ye shes don gsal bzhugs so: rgyal dbang kun 'dus gar gyi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo: sa ma ya: e ma kho bo bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: don gsal snying thig man ngag rin chen las: bskyed rdzogs gzhi lam don rtogs zung 'jug gis: spro bsdu tsam gyis spyi chings ngo sprod bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: ma 'ongs thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: de yang sngags bzlas brtson pa'i rnal 'byor la: phyi nang gsang gsum gyi ngo sprod de: thog mar chos sku'i ngo sprod gsal gdab ni: hūm̐: rang rig snang ba mtha' yas sku: smra brjod bral ba'i sems la ltos: 'khor gsum gdod nas rnam dag ngang : 'khor 'das dbye ba'i sa mtshams 'das: dran rdzogs bla ma chos kyi sku: ka dag 'od gsal gnyug ma'i gshis: chos sku snang mtha' gzhan na med: mi rtog ye shes ngo mtshar che: oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ zhes pa'i sngags phreng gang mang bzlas: de nas spro bsdu bya ba ni: hūm̐: sngags phreng 'od zer lnga ldan tshul: spros pas rgyal ba mchod cing dgyes: bsdus pas byin rlabs 'ub kyis thim: sbyor bas ma sring dbang du sdud: bsgral bas bdag 'dzin dbyings su gtor: lta ba rang rig bla ma lha: sgom pa snang srid chos skur rol: spyod pa re dogs blang dor zad: kun kyang 'bras bu'i ngo bor ldan: oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ de nas longs sku'i ngo sprod ni: hūm̐: rang rig bla ma rdo rje 'chang : zang thal 'gags med sems la ltos: smra brjod bral yang sna tshogs 'char: rang bzhin klong las thugs rje'i rtsal: kun gyi byed po bdag med nyid: gang shar bla ma longs spyod rdzogs: sgra grags 'gags med stong pa'i dbyings: longs sku ston pa gzhan du med: spros bral rang grol ngo mtshar che: oṃ badz+ra sa twa dz+nyā na dha ra hūm̐:

zhi ba'i sngags phreng gang mang bzlas: hūm̐: sngags phreng 'od zer lnga ldan tshul: spros pas rgyal ba mchod cing dgyes: bsdus pas byin rlabs 'ub kyis thim: sbyor bas ma sring dbang du sdud: bsgral bas bdag 'dzin dbyings su gtor: lta ba rang rig bla ma lha: sgom pa snang srid longs sku rol: spyod pa re dogs blang dor zad: kun kyang 'bras bu'i ngo bor ldan: oṃ badz+ra sa twa dz+nyā na dha ra hūm̐: de nas sprul sku'i ngo sprod ni: hūm̐: rang rig pad+ma 'byung gnas sku: sna tshogs shar grol sems la ltos: cir snang sgyu ma'i ngang tshul nyid: snod bcud dkyil 'khor lha yi zhing : rang lus dag kyang gzhal yas khang : rtsa khams bla ma sprul pa'i sku: gzugs rnams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i ngang : sprul sku pad 'byung gzhan na med: sprul sku drwa ba ngo mtshar che: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: sngags phreng gang mang bzlas: hūm̐: sngags phreng 'od zer lnga ldan tshul: spros pas rgyal ba mchod cing dgyes: bsdus pas byin rlabs 'ub kyis thim: sbyor bas ma sring dbang du sdud: bsgral bas bdag 'dzin dbyings su gtor: lta ba rang rig bla ma lha: sgom pa snang srid sprul sku rol: spyod pa re dogs blang dor zad: kun kyang 'bras bu'i ngo bor ldan: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: sngags phreng bar med du 'khor: rnal 'byor rang rig nyams dga' 'od gsal gyi ngang du dbyings rig bsre: rjes su dngos grub blang ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma rig 'dzin bde gshegs 'dus: dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs rnams kyi: bsnyen sgrub bzlas brjod mtha' ru phyin: rang nyid lha la lha nyid rang : rang byung lhan skyes ngo bo 'phros: bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i bye brag rnams: sgyu ma tsam du sprul bsgyur nyid: don mthong ci bzhin lam du lhong : deng sang skya rengs dang po shar: rdo rje srin po nam langs nye: dngos grub 'gugs pa'i dus la bab:

rgyal ba'i thugs dam gnas nas bskul: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bzhi stsol: rtsa gsum lha dngos bdag gyur cig: oṃ kā ya sid+dhi: wāk+ka sid+dhi: tsit+ta sid+dhi: gu na sid+dhi: gu h+ya sid+dhi: sarba sid+dhi ā bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes dbang dang dngos grub blang : don gnyis yang dag thob par bsam: sa ma ya: e maḥ man ngag don gsal me long bzhag: gnad zab bcud 'dus snying thig 'di: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa khyi lor bod yul bsam yas mchims phu ke'u tshang nas gdan drangs shing chu pho stag gi lor sbas yul gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // thun gtor 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rtsa gsum kun 'dus bde gshegs dkyil 'khor du: phyi nang gsang ba'i bla med mchod gtor 'bul: deng 'dir byin rlabs thugs dam rgyud bskul nas: sgrub la dbang bzhi mchog thun stsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha gter bdag la sogs pa rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: zhes thun gtor 'bul: gdams pa zab mo bde chen gsang lam bgrod par mos pa'i yid mi phyed pa'i lhag bsam 'dun pas sor rtse spyi bor thal mo sbyar la dkon mchog mchod sprin la 'bad 'bung bgyis so: na mo hūm̐: phyogs dus bde gshegs ma lus 'dus pa'i tshogs: snang srid zhing khams lhar gsal bzhugs pa la: bdag sogs 'gro ba ma gyur sems can gyis: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul gus pas gsol ba 'debs: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo hūm̐: phyogs bcu dus bzhir bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang : byang sems rig 'dzin 'phags tshogs 'dus sde la: bdag cag gus pas skyabs mchis phyag 'tshal lo: na mo hūm̐: chos sku skye ba med pa'i ngang nyid las: sangs rgyas thams cad thugs las skyes pa'i yab:

snang mtha' 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo: chos kyi sku yis byams pa'i spyan gyis gzigs: snying rje thugs kyis 'gro drug gnas nas 'dren: 'phags mchog nam mkha'i rgyal por phyag 'tshal lo: snang stong sku la ye shes rgyun chad med: chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong 'byung ba'i yum: dbyings phyug pha rol phyin mar phyag 'tshal lo: shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su: rdo rje sems dpa' longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas: zhi ba'i rig 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: byang chub sems ma sa khams rnam par dag: me long ye shes sangs rgyas byang sems yum: sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: lho phyogs dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing khams su: rin chen 'byung ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas: rgyas pa'i rig 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: byang chub sems ma chu khams rnam par dag: mnyam nyid ye shes sangs rgyas byang sems yum: mā ma kī yi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su: rnam par snang mdzad longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas: dbang gi rig 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: byang chub sems ma me khams rnam par dag: sor rtog ye shes sangs rgyas byang sems yum: gos dkar mo y-i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: byang phyogs las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing khams su: don yod grub pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas: drag po'i rig 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: byang chub sems ma rlung khams rnam par dag: bya grub ye shes sangs rgyas byang sems yum: dam tshig sgrol ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: 'phags pa'i zhing khams 'og min 'thug po bkod: sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'dzin 'dus sde la: lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: om̐ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: om̐ rat+na sa twa hūm̐: om̐ pad+ma sa twa hūm̐: om̐ karma sa twa hūm̐: oṃ gu ru sa twa hūm̐: om̐ dhe wa sa twa hūm̐: om̐ ḍāk+ki sa twa hūm̐: de nas rig 'dzin phyag rabs ni:

na mo hūm̐: kun gzhi ma bcos sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i gnas: 'ja' lus dpal 'bar rkang gnyis sangs rgyas gtso: pad 'byung tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo: mkha' spyod rnga yab dag pa rig 'dzin gnas: rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi zhing khams su: o rgyan rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: bde stong ye shes zab rgya theg chen mdzod: bde gshegs rig 'dzin rnams kyi yum chen mo: man+da ra ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: shar phyogs lta na sdug pa'i zhing khams su: rdo rje thod phreng sprul sku'i cha lugs 'chang : bde ba rig 'dzin sku la phyag 'tshal lo: byams pa'i 'od zer 'gro la 'gyed pa yi: bde gshegs rig 'dzin rgyal yum rdo rje'i rigs: ye shes mtsho rgyal sku la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: lho phyogs 'thug po bkod pa'i zhing khams su: rat+na thod phreng sprul sku'i cha lugs 'chang : phyag rgya rig 'dzin sku la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: snying rje lcags kyus rigs drug gnas nas 'dren: bde gshegs rig 'dzin rgyal yum rin chen rigs: ka la sid+dhi'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: nub phyogs mkha' dbyings brtsegs pa'i zhing khams su: pad+ma thod phreng sprul sku'i cha lugs 'chang : tshe dbang rig 'dzin sku la phyag 'tshal lo: dga' ba'i shugs 'chang skye gnas sgo bzhi khegs: bde gshegs rig 'dzin yum chen pad+ma'i rigs: shākya dhe ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: byang phyogs lcang lo 'khyil ba'i zhing khams su: karma thod phreng sprul sku'i cha lugs 'chang : lhun grub rig 'dzin sku la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: stong nyid dgongs pas sku bzhi'i sa bon rnyed: bde gshegs rig 'dzin rgyal yum las kyi rigs: bkra shis khye'u 'dren sku la phyag 'tshal lo: sa spyod dag pa mkha' spyod rnam dag zhing : ji snyed bzhugs pa'i rig 'dzin brgyud bcas la: mi phyed yid kyi gdung bas phyag 'tshal lo: om̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma dha ra dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sa ma ya a ti pu hoḥ

pra tīts+tsha hoḥ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ de nas sgrib sbyang phyag bshags ni: na mo phyogs bcu'i zhing du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang : byang sems 'phags tshogs bdag la dgongs su gsol: bdag sogs skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs su: rnam smin 'khor ba'i rgyu bsags ci mchis pa: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i mdun du mthol lo bshags: de bzhin mtshams med lnga yi las la ni: ma byin len dang rku 'phrog bcom pa dang : gzhan la 'phrog tu bcug dang bka' stsal pa: dkon mchog mchod pa phri dang bcom pa dang : lha khang dkar me bcom dang snyan dar bregs: de bzhin gsung rab klog pa'i glud zos dang : mchod rten gang zhig sāts+tsha'i dkor la 'bag: zhal zas bcom dang me tog yon chab bcad: dri spos ngar bsad 'bog pa'i thal ba spur: 'og rlung ra sun dri dang tha dud btang : bris sku thang rten no g.yol chu shar bgoms: gtsug lag 'bag pa'i gshang lci 'dor ba dang : rgyal ba'i khri gdan rnams la 'gom pa dang : de bzhin phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun bcom pa dang : pha dang ma yi don du slong ba dang : rang gi lto gos don du slong ba dang : ma sbyin pa la yang yang slong ba dang : ma mthong ba la 'phrog dang rku ba dang : gzhan la 'phrog pa'i las kyis bskul ba dang : ma 'os pa yi phyag sna len pa dang : mi zhu ba yi 'bul tshogs sdud pa dang : bdun zhag bzhi bcu'i dkor la 'bag pa dang : chos gos bla gos skye bos reg pa dang : bud med rnams kyis sbags pa'i zas la sogs: dkon mchog gsum la gnod pa'i las bsags pa: mtshams med dang po bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: de nas mi gtsang mtshams med bsags pa'i rgyu: dkon mchog rnam pa gsum gyi glud zos dang : dge 'dun nor brnag can gyi dkor zas dang : mtshan nyid grub mtha' pa yi kha 'phro zas: rigs drug kha chings bgyis pa'i yas rdzas dang : sdig spyod rgyal pos phrogs pa'i bcom zas dang : sde brgyad kha chings ser ba srung ba'i yon:

dmangs po'i lan chags sri'u gso ba'i gla: tshong 'dus la sogs shan pa'i lag zas dang : lho tshong byang la 'dren sogs mtha' zas dang : smon lam log pas 'brel ba'i mna' zas dang : nyams pa'i zas dang nyams pa'i gos la 'bag: dam nyams grogs dang 'grogs pa la sogs pa: mi gtsang pa la 'bag pa'i las bsags pa: mtshams med gnyis pa bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: khyad par mi mthun sbyor ba rtsub pa'i las: phyogs bcur 'khrug pa'i dmag chen g.yul ngo bskul: 'byung ba 'khrug pa'i rdzas ngan bsregs pa dang : zur za bgyis pa dgon sde dkrugs pa dang : byang sems dge 'dun mthun gnyis phye ba dang : ma mthong tshun gyis rgyus chen bshad pa dang : pha ma spun zla gnyen 'khor dkrugs pa dang : yul gru mtha' 'khob 'khrug pa'i gzhi bzhag dang : don med rnams la lam gol bslab pa dang : dus ma yin par gtam ngan bshad pa dang : nyes med sems can ku dir sgrogs pa dang : nyam chung rnams la sngangs skrag bgyis pa sogs: phra ma bcug dang rdzun smra dbyen bgyid pa: mtshams med gsum pa bsags pa mthol lo bshags: de bzhin lus ngag yid kyi sgo nas ni: pha ni dang po sgyu lus sbyin pa'i gnyen: tshig rtsub 'thab dang sbyor ba ngan pa dang : de bzhin ma ni sgyu lus bskyed pa ste: khengs sems che bas drin lan bcag pa'i rigs: lus dang sems kyi pha ma bsad pa dang : de bzhin las kyi pha mar gyur pa yi: drin can sgo nor bzang po bsad pa dang : zhon rta bkal khal bu lon dmyal ba ster: rmo rko tshong 'dus dmyal ba dngos bsags dang : sems can ma bu phral nas bsad pa dang : dus gcig grangs med srog bcad nya 'phrang byas: phag dang gcan gzan sdig pa'i ring bsrel zos: sngon gyi lan chags srog lan bsad pa dang : zhe sdang mi dang gdug pa'i khyi dang ni: nga rgyal rta dang 'dod chags bya dang ni: gti mug phag dang shin tu khro ba sbrul: nyes med btson du bcug dang ri dwags bsad:

drin chen lus kyis bskyangs pa'i gnag lug bsad: tshe gcig sangs rgyas ster ba'i bla ma la: lus kyis ltung ba bsags pas dam tshig bsad: ngag gis skur ba btab pas dam chos bsad: yid kyis log lta bgyid pas sangs rgyas bsad: bsnyen bkur mos pa ma bgyis dge 'dun bsad: dbang bskur dam tshig ma srung sdom pa bsad: ltung ba bzhi dang bcas pa'i bslab pa bsad: khyad par kha bcug bsad dang yid sems bsad: srog yod srog med thabs kyis bsad pa dang : dug dang mtshon dang me chur bsad pa dang : lus kyi srin bu la sogs bsad pa dang : rkang 'gro lag 'don ched du bsad pa dang : shin tu mtshams med dge bcur bsngos nas bsad: srog bcad las kyis bsad pa'i rnam smin dang : mtshams med bzhi pa bsags pa mthol lo bshags: dkon mchog gsum la smad pa byed pa dang : dam pa'i chos ni spangs par bya ba dang : sems can rnams la 'tshe bar byed pa dang : gsang sngags chos la log lta'i ru tra dang : mtshan ldan bla ma snying nas smad pa dang : rig 'dzin gdung gi dbu 'phang smad pa dang : dkon mchog rnam gsum dbu 'phang smad pa dang : dge ba'i bshes gnyen thabs kyis smad pa dang : g.yo can rnams kyis gang zag smad pa'i las: rang ni thabs kyis bstod pa byed pa dang : gzhan ni shugs kyis smad pa byed pa ste: ngos lkog bgyis nas sems kyi khrag byug dang : bzang rkyen ngan rkyen dge ba'i bar chad dang : gzhan snang bslu phyir sangs rgyas smad pa dang : rdo rje slob dpon sku dgra bgyis pa dang : byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dgongs pa dkrugs: bsam gtan sgom pa rnams kyi dben ri phrogs: bsnyen sgrub dge ba rnams la bar chad brtsams: ku re bzhad gad tshul du bla ma smad: dam nyams sdom nyams ma bshags mchod pa 'gom: khrus ma bgyis pas bla ma'i sku la reg: 'bag pa rnam bzhir 'bags shing bla ma mchod: bla ma'i sku yi grib ma bgoms pa dang : bla ma'i khri gdan sgab sham spyod pa dang :

dam tshig bum par dug chu blugs pa dang : dam tshig g.yel ba'i 'byen du 'bud pa sogs: bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos dang ni: bla ma dge 'dun bla ma rig 'dzin pa: gzugs sku bla ma bsod nams tshogs las 'khrungs: don dam bla ma chos sku sangs rgyas la: ngan sems sna tshogs bgyis pa'i khrag byugs pa: mtshams med lnga yi las bsags mthol lo bshags: de bzhin nye ba lnga dang ltung ba lnga: mi dge bcu po bgyid pa mthol lo bshags: so sor thar pa rnams kyi sdom pa dang : byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab pa dang : rdo rje sngags kyi dam tshig nyams pa dang : dbang bskur dkyil 'khor dam tshig nyams pa sogs: ngan song sgo bzhi bsags pa mthol lo bshags: bag med las kyis mnar med rgyu bsags dang : phyi nang dam tshig 'gal ba ci mchis pa: zhing khams lha la mthol bshags bzod par gsol: mi sgrib bde chen zhing khams bgrod par shog:

ces pas 'gyod tshangs phul bas las sgrib thams cad byang zhing rnam mkhyen thar pa chen po'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro: tha ma rjes shes bsngo smon ci rigs bya: 'di nyid bde chen zhing sgrub bya ba smon lam chos zhes pa spros bcas spros med ci bder bya: sa ma ya: zhes pa rtsa gsum gling pa'i bde chen zhing sgrub las khol du phyung ba'o// // o rgyan rtsa gsum pad+ma gter bdag gling pa'i rnam thar dang 'brel gnam lcags kyi chos skor gyi lo rgyus yid ches dwang ba bskyed pa'i gsos byed zhes bya ba bzhugs so// // na mo/ /gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye/ /gdod ma'i sangam̐s rgyasam̐ rig stong 'jam pa'i dpal/ /ye ྃshesam̐ lus can rtsam̐ gsum̐m dkyil 'khor bdag /glingam̐ dang dus 'dir gang 'dul der ston pam̐/ /chosam̐ ky-im̐ rgyam̐ mtshom̐ mkhyen brtse'i dbang por 'dud/ /don med byis pa'i rtsed mkhar tshul 'di yang*/ /lugs 'di nub par ma bzod lhag bsam gyis/ /yid ches lo rgyus khol btus cung 'bri na/ /rtsa gsum srung mas bka' gnang byin gyis rlobs/ /de yang rig 'dzin grub pa yongs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba/ o rgyan rtsa gsum pad+ma gter bdag gling pa'am/ gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje zhes mtshan nyi zla ltar lha mi 'jig rten na grags pa 'di nyid bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol na dus gsum rgyal ba'i yab gyur rje btsun 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpar sangs rgyas zin kyang*/ grangs med srid mtha'i bar du 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa yin zhing*/ de yang ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi skabs su gnas brtan bzang po ba/ 'phags pa'i yul du slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ gu ru'i spyan sngar gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes/ de yi sprul pa gter chen dum rgya zhang khrom dang*/ dri med kun dga' sogs mdor na/ skyes rabs bcu gsum kyi gsol 'debs snang gsal me long las gsal ba ltar rtogs par bya la/

de ltar gter ston rkyang pa'i skye ba bdun du 'byung bar gsungs pa'i tha ma rtsa gsum gter bdag gling pa 'di nyid lho zla nang chen gy-i stod gnas chen gze rgyal gyi nye 'dabs/ spa rong sa yi ste bar/ rigs ni dbang chen/ rus ni rlangs chen dpal gyi seng ge'i gdung las drag sngags so lnga zhal 'don gnang bzhin par ngo mtshar ba'i rtags mtshan du ma dang bcas sku 'khrungs/ rngog lo'i sprul pa dge lugs chos rje zhig las dge bsnyen kyi sdom pa bzhes pa'i mtshan bkra shis phun tshogs su gsol/ gsan sbyang ci rigs par mdzad cing byis pa'i skabs nas sngon sbyang las 'phro sad pa'i rtags mtshan du ma dang ldan zhing gter chen stag sham gyis nang chen sgar du khrom thog tu chos gsungs skabs ma yi pang khar rig pa ngo 'phrod par grags shing dgung grangs lngar son skabs nyams dang rmi lam dngos su la yang gu ru yab yum gyis dbang bskur ba dang chos gsung lung bstan mdzad pa sogs nyams snang du ma shar ba ma zad bka' srung rnams kyis lus dang grib ma bzhin srung ba dang phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub par khas blangs srog snying phul ba sogs ya mtshan mang*/ khyad par du 'bri gung dkon mchog phrin las bzang po bla mar bsten zhing bka' chos ci rigs dang*/ khyad par rlung dza ber snyan brgyud zhib tu gsan te/ lo gsum sbyangs pa mdzad pas nyams rtogs khong nas brdol/ sngar gyi skye ba mang po dran pa sogs mngon shes thogs med du gyur/ 'bri gung ti sgro ru bzhugs tshe ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis gdan drangs nas rnga yab gling du gu ru yab yum dngos su mjal nas smin grol gyi gdams ngag bstsal/ lung bstan dbugs dbyung mdzad/ rang snang la dbang 'byor bas phyi rol gyi snang ba thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu mngon sum du rtogs te nam mkha' la bya bzhin 'phur ba dang*/ rdo brag zan bzhin du rol ba dang zang thal du 'jug pa dang*/

phyag zhabs kyi rjes sogs da lta'ang mang du bzhugs shing rdzu 'phrul sku yi rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgo nas gdul bya mang po dad pa'i gnas la bkod cing smin grol mdzad/ shing pho rta yi lo la thog mar a mye mu khri nas gter gyi kha byang phyag tu son sngar bzhin lung don ltar dus la bab pa'i rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas rgyal khams phyogs med du nyul zhing a phyi chos kyi sgron ma dang 'dod khams dbang phyug sogs mi min ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis lung bstan dang gsang ba'i brda grogs mdzad/ rong chen lnga yi zab rgya rtags bdun sogs gter gnas gtso bo sum cu so dgu la sogs nas bka' gsang shog dril bdun bcu don lnga sogs rim gyis bzhes phab grub rigs kyang pod sum cu tsam yod la de dag gi so so'i gter gnas dang mtshan byang grub rtags sogs che long tsam gnas ri so dgu ma ru gsal ba bzhin yin te/ de yang 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro nas mkha' 'gro'i chos bzhi dang pad+ma khrag 'thung gi skor/ gnas mchog tsā ri tra nas tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon/ mon sha 'ug stag sgo nas yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi chos skor yar lha sham po nas gza' bdud dug mtsho khol ma'i chos skor/ dpal gyi bsam yas mchims phu'i ge'u gong nas bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs 'dus pa'i chos skor dang thugs sgrub bsam pa lhun 'grub ma'i chos skor gnyis dang*/ brag gsum gnam lcags mtsho nas phyag rdor dregs pa kun 'dus/ sga rgyal rin chen spungs pa nas drag po kī la ya yi chos skor dang*/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro snying phug nas tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud kyi skor dang*/ gze rgyal ma yo gangs ra nas bdud 'dul drag mo dang zhing skyong ru dar dmag bzlog gi skor gnyis dang*/ khyung po ri rtse drug nas rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i chos skor dang bon chos dbal sras gsang ba tha nag gi skor dang*/

rag ne brag dmar nas rdo rje gro lod kyi chos skor/ wa zhabs brag nas tshe sgrub rdo rje'i go khrab kyi chos skor dang*/ gnas mdo dge bsnyen pho brang nas bla ma'i nor sgrub pad+ma rgyal po'i chos skor/ spo bo mdong chu gtsug lag khang nas drag po gnam lcags 'khor lo'i skor dang*/ dar sna pha wang rta mgo nas rta mgrin nā ga klu 'dul gyi chos skor/ phag mo gsang ba lung gi phyag rdor bla mtsho nas phag mo rigs lnga dang ma ning gi skor/ sbas yul pad+ma shel phug nas thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi chos skor/ seṅge gnam rdzong nas pad+ma bkod kyi lam yig dang gsang rgya lung bstan 'ga' zhig /mye bo lha mo nas bzhes pa'i zab gter rnams rgya ma grol/ spo bo khrom gzigs rngam pa rong gi me 'bar mtsho nas 'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar gyi chos skor sogs te/ mdor bsdu na shog dril bdun bcu don lnga'i zab chos dang sku tshab dam rdzas phyag mtshan mchod rdzas bla rdo sogs rdzas gter gyi rigs khyad 'phags mang du bzhes/ khyad par du yar 'brog mtsho mo nas bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon gyi chos skor bzhugs pa'i gter sgrom mthong ba don ldan rgyu bram ze snying po'i dbu klad las grub pa rin po che ru bya'i mdog can sgo gsum dang ldan/ sgo dang po la rdzogs chen bla med snying po dang zhi khro na rag dong sprug phyi rgyud thig pa rim dgu dang bcas pa bzhugs/ sgo bar pa la bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs rgyud lung man ngag dang bcas pa/ sgo 'og ma la dregs pa srog thig nag po'i man ngag lag len dang bcas pa 'di gcig pu glegs bam sa bcu'i grangs ldan dang sku tshab pad+ma mthong grol dam rdzas khro 'dus ril bu/ a thaṃ ma bsgoms sangs rgyas/ gu ru'i phyag mtshan rdo rje rtse dgu/ las phur bdud dpung zil gnon/ mkhan slob chos rgyal gsum gyi na bza' gos ber mtsho rgyal gyi dbu skra sogs lhan du gdan 'dren gnang nas phab pa'i zab chos rigs bsdus kyi dbang du byas na pod chen sum bcu rgal ba dag da lta'i bar rgyun ma chad par spo bo khyung po 'brong pa rdo shul nang chen sogs su rgyun ma chad par dbang lung man ngag phyag len dang bcas pa bzhugs la gdan sa'i mthil spo bo khrom gzigs rngam pa rong du mdzad nas phrin las kyang dar rgyas su byung*/

thugs sras kyi thu bo rig 'dzin chen po skyid grong thugs mchog rdo rje de nyid zab gter yongs rdzogs kyi bdag por mnga' gsol/ gzhan yang rwa ston stobs ldan rdo rje dang*/ dkon seng paṇ+ṭi ta/ rje kun dga' blo gros/ ye shes rgyal mtshan sogs bstan pa spel nus pa'i zhal slob du ma byung*/ dgung grangs 45par dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim rjes kyang thugs mchog rdo rjes rgyal tshab kyi mdzad phrin bskyangs/ zab gter phal po cher phyogs bsgrigs dang bka' bsdu mdzad pa dang*/ smin grol rgyun spel sogs 'di nyid las bka' drin che ba ma byung bar snang*/ sku tshe'i smad rang nyid la'ang zab gter gyi bka' babs shing slob ma yang grangs med byung ba ma zad khyad par slob ma'i gtso bo rig 'dzin bzhi ru grags pa/ zur mkhar thig chen gling pa'am dri med gling pa dang*/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa/ kun bzang bde chen rgyal po/ mthu chen pra ti sngags 'chang ste/ snga ma gsum po zab gter gyi bka' babs/ lhag par du dri med gling pa ni gter chen yab sras zung gi thun min chos bdag lung zin bzhin gter kha gong 'og gi gnam lcags pa'i zab chos rnams kyi smin grol yongs rdzogs chos rje ye shes lhun grub dang rdo rje snying po sogs nas gdan brgyud byung ba'o/ de ltar o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi sprul sku gsum du byung ba'i dang po ni/ sku sprul o rgyan rig 'dzin dang*/ o rgyan 'gro 'dul gling pa/ pad+ma nges don bstan 'dzin/ nges don chos dbyings rang grol sogs sku 'phreng rim byon rnams gdan sa spo bo khrims gzigs su bzhugs nas gdul bya bskyangs/ gsung sprul 'chi med nor bu spo bo dga' ba lung du byung yang rjes su sprul brgyud ma gsal/ thugs sprul rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rje ni/ ngag dbang snyan grags rgya mtsho/ grub mchog gsang sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang*/

snyigs dus 'gro ba'i mgon po bzod pa rab brtan sogs sku 'phreng rim byon bzhin gdan sa dang po khyung po gnam lcags ri khrod dam gsang sngags chos gling du gdul bya bskyangs nas chos brgyud spel/ de yi yang srid drug pa 'phags pa rgya mtsho dang phrin las rgyal mtshan gnyis su byung da lta'ang 'tsho zhing bzhugs bzhin pa'o/ de bzhin chos brgyud 'di nyid kyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba'i dgon sde kha shas zhu ba la/ thog mar bdud 'dul gsang sngags chos gling ni/ o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas tsā ri gnyis pa gze yi ma yo gangs ra'i gnas sgo 'byed skabs gnas kyi sgo chen du dgon pa'i chags tshul mdzad rmang rdo bzhag nas slad 'dir khong gi brgyud 'dzin 'byung bar zhal bzhes lung bstan mdzad pa'i ming yang sgo chen ri khrod du grags so/ de'ang sngar gong du bshad pa'i zur mkhar thig chen gling pa de nyid kyi zhal snga nas/ /nam zhig tshe yi 'du byed ltung ba'i tshe/ /nga ni o rgyan pad+ma'i lung bstan du/ khams dang mon du gdul bya skyong dgos yod zhes gsungs pa bzhin re zhig sku'i bkod pa dbyings su bsdus te/ lung bstan bzhin sku bltams shing gdan sa chag btab/ mtshan yang rgyal ba rgya mtsho ru gsol ba 'di'i man chad kyi mtshan yang sgo chen rgyal ba sprul sku ru byung bar snang ngo*/ de nas rim par lung zin ar+ya dh+wa dza/ rdo shul dpon bla ma tshe dbang bstan 'dzin/ nam mkha' tshe dbang sogs nas da lta'i bar ro/ de bzhin 'brong pa rdo shul gyi phyogs 'dir dkon seng bla rabs dang*/ gwa grwa karma o rgyan nas khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po nyi ma 'od zer bar/ gwa grwa bla brgyud dang*/ 'phen bla rabs/ sngon ne bla rabs sogs nas rim gyis dar 'phel byung ste 'brong pa rdo shul stod smad kun la khyab par gyur ro/ de bzhin du'ang lci ljongs lha lung phyug mo zhes pa ru ri pa smad ma dgon bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling zhes chos phyag rdzogs dbyer med ces grags pa'i bstan bdag ni/

ri pa rgyal mtshan dang thub bstan rgyal po mchog sprul rnam pa gnyis da lta'i bar bla rabs bcu gsum dang brgyad bar deng sang yang dge 'dun brgya phrag lhag tsam bzhugs skad lags/ de ltar gter chen stag sham pa dang*/ rig 'dzin chos rje gling pa sogs kyi cher bsngags shing rwa ston stobs ldan rdo rje/ dri med gling pa/ rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje sogs kyi spyi bor bsnyen zhing zab chos kyi bdud rtsi bzhes la grub pa'i sa mthor gshegs/ rgyal dbang zhwa dmar nag la mtshur phur gter phud 'bul bar bskyar yang gzims 'gags pa'i rkyen byas nas gter ston nyid la bstun phyogs cher ma mdzad pas lung don thog tu ma khel bar brten 7rgyal dbang nyid kyang thugs 'gyod gnang tshul nyid kyi rnam thar las gsal/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos kyang gnas skor phebs skabs chos 'brel nyung ngu tsam gsan nas de nyid kong sprul rin po cher gnang bas thugs shin tu dgyes te bsngags brjod dang bcas gter mdzod du bzhag par mdzad pa sogs mdor na tshad ma'i gter chen du rtsod med yongs grags su gyur la/ bar skabs su dar rgyas yang che bar byung 'dug kyang rim rgud du gyur/ phangs pa zhig la gter mdzod du'ang nyung ngu las bzhugs ma thub la par bskrun sogs ma byung bar ri khug dang lung skyog gi dgon pa rnams su bzhugs par brten nye dus bod yul bstan 'gror gegs chags chen por byung ba'i skabs 'dir chos dang brgyud 'dzin lhan cig phal cher rtsa brlag tu zin zhing de sngon 'phags yul du rtse sprul pad+ma dbang rgyal dang*/ mkhan chen dpal ldan shes rab rnams nas yang yang btsal yang 'khor 'das zil gnon tsam las ma rnyed/ nye char kho bo 'dir 'byor 'phral snga 'gyur bstan pa'i gtsug rgyan skyabs rje bdud 'joms rin po che mchog nas kyang gnam lcags kyi bstan pa 'di nyid snum zad mar me ltar gyur 'dug pa'i gso thabs gal che zhes bka' 'phrin yang yang gnang ba ma zad rang dgon bdud 'dul gsang sngags gling gi dad ldan grwa 'thor rnams dang lhag par du mkhan chen dpal ldan shes rab sku mched zung nas thugs khur cher bzhes kyi thog mar dpe rgyun 'tshol rgyu'i bka' stsal dang dpe bskrun gyi yon sbyor kyang gnang bar brten bod du rdo shul sogs su dpe rgyun 'tshol bar ched du mngags te btsal rung cher yod pa ma mngon/

'dir pod dgu tsam thob pa phal cher 'thor bu'i tshul las cha tshang ni re shas las ma rnyed de dag yang phal cher grong gseb kyi yi ger song tsang chad lhag mang ba dang*/ dag cha med pa ma zad ldil+li dpe mdzod kyang sgo rgyab nye thug nas gsar bris dang dpe zhus kyi go skabs yang che bar ma byung bas/ le'u tshan re gnyis gsar brje dang 'bru zhus cung zad re byas nas ma phyi gang thob steng brel zing ngang dpe bskrun mi byed thabs med byung bas rgyu mtshan yang tshul 'di'i dpe cha sho lo ka re yang thob dka' ba'i gnas su gyur bas na lugs 'di'i srol 'dzin gangs can lung skyog pa rnams la smin sems kyis bskrun na/ mkhyen dpyod ldan pa rnams kyis dpyad zhib dang ma phyi 'dra gzhan nas rnyed na nor bcos zhu dag yod pa zhu ba dang*/ de lta bu'i nyung ngu'i lo rgyus 'di yang 'jam mgon gyis gsung gter rnams nas gsungs pa nyid gzhir byas gzhan yang gter chen rang gsung rnam thar gsol 'debs dang 'brel yod gzhan las kha bskangs te/ /de yang gsang chen nges pa'i bka' 'di la/ /lo rgyus tshig gis ma bkrol na/ /yid mi ches pa'i skyon du 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar mkhyen dpyod thos bsam can dag la de lta'i skyon du mi 'jug kyang*/ thos bsam dbul ba'i gang zag bdag 'dra ba dag la de ltar yong srid pas de dag kun la smin slad kho na'i lhag bsam gyi kun slong las rang nyid mkhas grags 'dod pa'i re ba dang tshig don gnyis med smyon pa'i ku co lta bu 'di 'dra zhes gzhan kyi 'phya khrel yong gi dogs pa gnyis ka spangs nas 'di ltar bgyid pa la/ nyes 'gal mchis na rtsa gsum lha la bshags shing dge rtsa cung zad mchis na chos tshul 'di nyid mi nub srid mtha'i bar du dar zhing rgyas nas 'gro kun gu ru yab yum gyi go 'phang bde blag tu thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pa'ang mkhan slob chos rgyal gsum gyis gangs can gdul byar bzung ba'i thugs bskyed go cha bzhes pa'i gnas mchog bal yul mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi 'gram snga 'gyur bstan pa'i 'byung gnas dpal zhe chen bstan gnyis dar rgyas gling gi rang gnas bsam gtan gyi khang bur sgo chen rgyal ba'i sprul ming 'dzin pa phyogs nyul gyi sprang po wā gin+d+ra nā gardzu na 'bod pas bod rgyal lo 2112'dzam gling spyi bsang gi dus tshes bzang por spel ba dge bar gyur cig/

rig 'dzin srog sgrub yid bzhin nor bu las/ bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi brgyud 'debs dbang bzhi'i bcud 'bebs bzhugs so/ ka dag dang po'i sangs rgyas 'od ma'i 'gyur*/ /ye shes lnga rdzogs rigs lnga rdo rje sems/ /thugs rje kun khyab rgyal sras rigs gsum mgon/ /gsol ba 'debs so dgongs brgyud byin rlabs stsol/ /sprul pa'i sku mchog dga' rab rdo rje dang*/ /las kyi dbang mo grub pa'i rig 'dzin brgyad/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje mtsho rgyal man+da rar/ /gsol ba 'debs so lta ba'i gdeng chen spor/ /phung lnga rnam dag rigs lnga thod phreng dang*/ /tshogs brgyad gnas dag gu ru mtshan mchog brgyad/ /rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang rje 'bangs nyer lnga la/ /gsol ba 'debs so sgom pa'i rtsal chen bskyed/ /bud+dha dz+nyā na gter 'byin rtsa gsum gling*/ /hūm̐ chen 'gro 'dul chos bdag lung zin sogs/ /dgongs brda snyan brgyud rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so spyod pa'i bogs chen dbyung*/ /dbang chen yab yum yi dam rgyud sde bzhi/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro dpa' bo ging chen dang*/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lhar/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /ma mgon lcam dral drag po sde lnga dang*/ /rdo rje chos srung nor lha gter bdag sogs/ /snang srid bla ma'i dkyil 'khor rol pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so don gnyis mthar phyin stsol/ /dkyil 'khor rnam bzhir dbang bzhis rang rgyud smin/ /sgrib pa bzhi dag rig 'dzin bzhi'i lam 'byongs/ /sku bzhi ye shes ka dag mngon gyur nas/ /snang bzhi mthar phyin 'od lus 'grub par shog / ces pa'ang gi li sgrub bla'i ngor gnam lcags pa gu h+yas spel/ bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi las byang ngag 'don chog khrigs su bsdebs pa khyer bde don zab ces bya ba bzhugs so/ phyogs dus rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dpyid/

/sin+dhu'i dwang mtshor ngo mtshar pad sdong rtser/ /rang byung sangs rgyas skur snang pad+mar skyes/ /mkha' 'gro'i sprin phung spros de spyi bo'i rgyan/ /gang gi sgrub thabs bye ba phrag brgya'i phul/ /bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus kyi/ /phrin las snying po'i 'don chog khrigs bsdeb pa/ khyer bde don zab 'god la gnang ba stsol/ de yang gzhung las/ nga nyid bzhugs dang dbyer med byin rlabs can: yid bzhin nor bu bla ma'i sgrub pa bstan: zhes gu ru nyid dang dbyer mi gnyis pa nyid kyis bsngags pa'i thugs sgrub rgya mtsho'i yang bcud o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter thugs sgrub bder 'dus phrin las 'bring po dkyil 'khor lnga pa'i dgongs don nyams su len pa la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ gzhung las/ de yang bla ma sgrub pa'i rim pa ni: bkra shis byin chags rgyal bas me tog 'thor: smon lam mchog ldan dben ri yid 'ong der: /mkho ba'i yo byad sgrub pa'i cha rkyen bsags: zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las/ bum pa rnam rgyal sman sgrub bdud rtsis gtams: kha rgyan mgul chings la sogs tshang bar bya: bhan+dha mtshan ldan sman raka phud kyis bkang : rtsa gsum gtor ma rgyan bzang legs par bshams: gzhan yang spyan gzigs tshogs gtor tshang bas bskor: zhes gsungs pa bzhin rig 'dzin gong mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i sgrub gnas khyad par can rnams su/ dus khyad par can yar mar gyi tshes bcu sogs kyi skabs/ thog mar rang gi spros pa dang mtshams pa'i dkyil 'khor bkod pa'am mdun stegs rim pa gsum gyi steng*/ dbus su dbang bzhi'i rten dkyil 'khor ram 'bru dkar gyi lha tshom bkod pa'i steng*/ bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings dmar po/ de yi steng thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba'i khar dar dmar brgyad ltebs me long sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor shel rdo sogs brtsegs mar byas pa bsham/

bdag bskyed rkyang pa bsnyen 'brel dang tshes bcu dus mchod tshogs 'khor lta bur ma 'dzoms kyang sgrub gtor gcig pus chog /gtor ma rang lugs dpal ri ma dang pad sdong ma zhes bca' gzhi zur gsal ltar gong gtor dang*/ bang rim bar mar rig 'dzin srog sgrub bskang gtor dang de dag gi g.yas g.yon du sman raka chad brtan bskul gsum/ chos skyong sde lnga gtso bor gyur pa'i rang lugs gsol kha dang*/ bang rim 'og mar chu gnyis sngon du 'gro bas nyer spyod 'dod yon lnga sogs mchod pa'i bye brag dang*/ gzhan yang dkar bgegs thun gyi gtor ma tshogs 'khor yo byad bcas 'du bya'o/ de bzhin slob dpon gyi mdun du las bum/ ḍā ma ru/ dar dmar nag /nas gzed yungs gzed/ rdor dril/ las phur/ nang mchod sogs dgos pa'i yo byad ma tshang ba med par tshags su tshud par bya'o/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ thog mar bkra shis brgyad pa/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ sku gsum gsol 'debs sogs nas theg chen dgu ldan/ 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs/ gnas ri so dgu bcas rgyas bsdus skabs dang bstun la/ chos spyod zur gsal ltar bya/ dang po sngon 'gro la rgyud sbyang ba dang cho ga'i sngon 'gro gnyis/ dang po la'ang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdor sems bsgom bzlas dang*/ tshogs bsags bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang lnga las/ thog mar skyabs yul skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar sad par mos la/ rang gzhan sems can rnams 'di nas byang chub bar skyabs su 'gro ba'i 'dun pa dang bcas/ na mo: bde gshegs kun 'dus gu ru pad+ma 'byung : thugs rje'i bdag nyid o rgyan chos kyi rje: rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gsum kun 'dus la: bdag yid rtse gcig gdung bas skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ gnyis pa sems can thams cad byang chub tu 'god 'dod kyi smon pa dang*/ de'i ched du lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bya'o snyam pa ni 'jug pa ste/

smon 'jug byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i dam bca' brtan po'i ngang*/ hoḥ gdod nas rang rig rnam dag sku lnga'i mchog: ji bzhin rtogs pa'i byin rlabs nus rtsal gyi: 'od zer nar ma 'gro la rab spros nas: yang dag sangs rgyas lam 'god sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ mthar skyabs yul rnams rang la thim pas de dag gi thugs rgyud kyi yon tan khyad par can bdag rgyud la 'phos nas byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ gsum pa sgrib pa sbyong ba rdor sems bsgom bzlas ni/ āḥ spyi bor pad dkar zla ba'i gdan: rigs 'dus bla ma rdo rje sems: dkar gsal rdor dril longs spyod rdzogs: thugs srog āḥl yig brgyas bskor: bdud rtsis sgo gsum sgrib dag gyur: oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya: ma nu pā la ya: badz+ra satwa te no pa tiṣ+ṭha: dṛ ḍho me bha wa: su to ṣ+yo me bha wa: su po ṣ+yo me bha wa: a nu rak+to me bha wa: sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha: sarba karma su tsa me: tsit+taṃ shrī yaṃ ku ru hūm̐: ha ha ha ha ho: bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta: badz+ra mā me muñca: badz+ri bha wa ma ha sa ma ya sa twa āḥ yig brgya bzlas shing stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bshags sdom la 'bad par bya'o/ hoḥ bdag ni bag med rmongs pa yis: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig gi: don dang 'gal ba ci mchis pa: rigs 'dus dkyil 'khor tshogs la bshags: gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid: thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid la: 'gro ba'i don phyir bdag skyabs mchi: sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ ces skyabs gsol gyi tshig brjod pa dang*/ rang rgyud kyi sdig ltung dag nas bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' bde stong chen po'i ngo bor 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam/ bzhi pa tshogs gnyis bsags pa snod bcud bdag lus longs spyod dang bcas pa maṇ+ḍal du dmigs te 'bul ba ni/

hūm̐: gling bzhi ri rab khyon ltar bkod pa dang : dngos 'byor yid sprul maṇ+ḍal dag pa'i tshogs: skyabs yul kun 'dus mchog gsum lha tshogs la: 'gro ba'i don phyir dmigs te phu+ul ba yis: ma gyur 'gro kun byang chub lam dgod shog: oṃ i daṃ gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍal keṃ nir+ya ta yā mi: zhes skyabs yul gyi lha la ltos med du 'bul zhing mi dmigs pa'i ngang du bzhag par bya'o/ lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor la dang po tshogs zhing bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid pad+ma 'byung gnas gsal ba yi: spyi bor khyab bdag mgon po rdo rje sems: dung mdog rdor dril bsnol thabs skyil krung bzhugs: yum snyems gri thod bde stong sku la 'khril: hūm̐: de yi spyi bor mgon po 'od mi 'gyur: dmar gsal mnyam bzhag rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: 'ja' lus 'od phung dbyings rig ngo bor gsal: gnyis pa gsol ba 'debs pa'i slad du thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshamasaḥ pad+ma ge sar sdong po laḥ ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyesaḥ pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su gragasaḥ 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskoraḥ khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyiḥ byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsolaḥ gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐ḥ de nas gsol ba 'debs shing dbang bzhi len pa ni/ mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag po dang bcas te/ hūm̐: thog ma'i mgon po kun bzang 'od ma'i 'gyur: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: khyab bdag dag pa rdor sems bde gshegs 'dus: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rgyal mchog thugs rje gcig 'dus pad+ma 'byung : gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dbyings phyug nam mkha'i gos can mtsho rgyal ma:

gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bka' bab gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas/ /rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zab gter sgo 'byed rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling*/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas/ /rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /lung zin chos bdag thugs mchog rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas/ /rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /las can rgyud 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas/ /rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ yi dam rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i zhabs: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lhar/ gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: snying thig skyong ba'i ral gcig sngags srung mar: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub bar byin gyis rlobs: skyabs yul kun kyang 'od zhu rim pa bzhin: spyi bor thim nas bdag lus snang stong nyid: dbang bzhi rdzogs nas zang thal chen po'i sku: gu ru pad+ma 'od 'bar mchog 'grub shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: badz+ra sa mā ya dza sid+dhi pha la a be sha ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes dbang bzhi blangs shing bla ma rang dang dbyer med du bsres la chos dbyings ka dag gi ngang du mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ gnyis pa cho ga'i sngon 'gro la 'gal rkyen bsal ba dang mthun rkyen sgrub pa gnyis/ dang po la'ang dkar phyogs gnas gzhi'i bdag po la gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcol ba dang*/ nag phyogs bka' bsgo zhing bskrad pa'o/

dang po dkar gtor bka' brgyad ltar bya srol bzhin/ gser skyems dkar gtor bcas chu gtsang gis bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ ā kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma nāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na na twata oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swā hā: oṃ yak+ṣa hūm̐: oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃḥ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma gser skyems mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las om̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du: oṃ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+ya: sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: om̐ badz+ra a mṛ t om̐ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ā wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐: om̐ dz+nyā na a wa lo ki te na maḥs man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi bha wa sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hri da ya dz+wa la ni hūm̐: om̐ na maḥ sa man+ta bud+dha nam gra he shwa ri pra bhañja te ma hā sa ma ya swā hā': om̐ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ om̐ las 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga: bh+rūm̐ las rin chen gzhal yas khang : trām̐ las sna tshogs rat+na'i snod: hrīḥlas gsung dbyangs drug cur ldan: āḥlas ci 'dod phun sum tshogs: so so'i dga' mgu tshim byed pa: 'dod pa'i yo byad chen por gyur: hūm̐: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang : grub pa thob pa'i rig 'dzin rnam brgyad kyi: bka' dang dam tshig gnyan la gnas pa yi: lha brgyad klu brgyad gza' brgyad rgyu skar brgyad: sde brgyad sde dpon sum cu rtsa gnyis dang : phyogs skyong bcu dang sa bdag dmu sman dang : phyi nang gsang ba'i dregs pa sde bcu gnyis: dpal gyi mgon po chen po bdun cu lnga: rgyal chen bzhi dang dus kyi skyong ma 'bum: mkha' la rgyu ba'i yid gzugs gzhi bdag dang : lo zla zhag dus chu tshod dbang ba'i lha: skyes lha yul lha gzhi bdag 'go ba'i lha:
