khyad par rin chen gter gyi srung ma dang : pha ri tshur kha g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab ri: steng 'og phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gnas pa'i tshogs: bka' dang dam la gnas pa'i gzhi bdag rnams: 'dir gshegs gser skyems phud dang gtor ma bzhes: bdag gi legs nyes bya ba ci la yang : ko long ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par: rin chen gter gyi sa 'di myur du stsol: slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' las ma 'da' bar: bdag gi bsam pa sgrubs la re ba skongs: las bzhi phrin las gang bcol myur du sgrubs: lo legs nad zhi sa phyogs bkra shis nas: dkar po dge bcu sgrub pa'i rogs dan sgrubs: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ bhū mi pa ti lo ka pā la sarba dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hiḥ zhes dkar gtor phyogs gtsang sar phul zhing : bkra shis pa'i phrin las bcol: gnyis pa nag phyogs bgegs la gtor ma bsngo zhing bka' bsgo ba la/ thog mar bgegs gtor byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ de nas rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis lan chags bgegs rigs kyi mgron dgug pa ni/

hūm̐: bdag nyid dbang drag 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas: gzi byin 'od stong zer ma phyogs bcur 'phros: de yi shugs las bgegs rnams snying rjes bkug: gtor ma len phyir gnas 'dir myur du mchis: oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dza dzaḥ bgegs tshogs 'byung po a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ de nas 'dod yon gtor ma bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs dang 'byung po log 'dren tshogs: deng nas phan dge'i byang chub lam dgod phyir: yid mthun 'dod yon mchod sbyin 'di bzhes la: gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du 'gro bar gyis: ci ste mi 'gro gdug pa'i sems 'chang na: bdag nyid dbang chen drag sngags phyung brdeg gis: khyod kyi lus ngag yid gsum rdul du brlag: de bas rang rang gnas su phyir dengs shig: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas bgegs tshogs phyir bskrad cing mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang : yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong mthu rtsal gyis: dngos grub bar chad byed ba'i bgegs: log par 'dren pa bdud kyi tshogs: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'tshe byed na: bdag nyid dpal chen thugs khros nas: khro bo spros pas nam mkha' gang : khro mo spros pas sa gzhi gang : sras mchog khro chung bar snang gang : me yi bya khyung phyogs bcur 'khrigs: drwa mig lcags sdig glog ltar 'khyugs: 'khor yug mtshon char thog ltar 'bebs: bgegs tshogs thal ba'i rdul du brlag: de bas bka' las ma 'da' zhig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra hūm̐: rak+sha hūm̐: yak+sha hūm̐: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya: gnod byed bgegs tshogs thams cad tshin+dha tshin+dha ban+dha ban+dha ha na ha na pa tsa pa tsa ma tha ma tha da ha da ha hu lu hu lu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: de nas srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa ni/

hūm̐: nga nyid gdod nas rab khros he ru kaḥ ka dag thugs las brdol ba'i shes rab mtshon: rno dbal lhun grub rang rtsal 'gengs pa'i tshogs: bar med khyab ste skar ltar rab 'khrugs pa: bsrungs mtshams med pa dum bu gcig pa ni: e dbyings mkha' ltar gnas pa'i gur khang gyur: oṃ badz+ra dharma dz+nyā na tsakra e khaṃ raṃ dz+wa la rak+ṣa ye swā hā: bdag nyid kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer khro chung me dpung mtshon thun gyi tshogs spros bgegs tshogs rnams phar bskrad/ 'od zer tshur 'dus pas gzhom med rdo rje'i srung 'khor du gyur bar mos la stong nyid mi shigs pa'i rgya yis gdab bo/ gnyis pa mthun rkyen spel ba la mchod pa'i yo byad dang dkyil 'khor byin dbab pa brda bsgo phyag dam bca' ba bcas lnga/ dang po mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa la/ thog mar thun mong phyi yi mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes brjod pas mchod pa'i gzhi khyab par bsang chu 'thor/ hūm̐: rig pa'i gru 'dzin khyon ltar yangs pa'i dbus: phyi mchod lha mo me tog bdug spos ma: mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo dang : gzugs mdzes lang ling gar mo yid 'ong rigs: lta na sdug cing tshul bzang mchod thogs tshogs: grangs med sprul pa rgyal ba mnyes rdzas gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa khyad par nang gi mchod pa la sman raka gtor gsum las dang po bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: bhan+dha mtshan ldan lcang lo 'khyil ba'i nang : sha lnga rdzas lnga pañca a mṛ ta: dri lnga 'bru bcud chang dang dza gad phud: sman mchod dug lnga sel ba'i ye shes mdangs: dkar mngar kha dang ro skyur zhun gyi rigs: sna tshogs tshang 'di rgyal ba mnyes rdzas gyur: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ gnyis pa rak+ta byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: bum ril bhan+dha dum gcig zlum pa'i dbus:

bzang mo'i mkha' yi mu kha sgra gcan gyi: 'khor lor khyab 'jug myur 'gros rab bskul nas: 'dar ma'i rlung las 'gyu ba'i byams chen po: chags med dmar chen gzi 'od 'khyil ba'i tshogs: mtsho ltar 'khrugs pa rgyal ba mnyes rdzas gyur: oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ gsum pa gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: thabs shes rin chen las grub nyi zla'i snod: rgya cher srid pa'i khyon ltar yangs pa'i dbus: snod gzugs bsdus pa'i bcud mchog ba liṃ ta: lhun mtho dbyings la bsnyegs pa'i rgyan mdzes btsugs: mdangs ldan bcud g.yo rgyas pa'i zer stong 'khyugs: kun tshang mchod pas rgyal ba mnyes mdzad gyur: oṃ ma hā bha ling+ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ gnyis pa byin dbab pa ni/ rang nyid lha yi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin phung gtibs pa ltar byon nas rten bsgrub kyi rdzas dang rnal 'byor pa'i sgo gsum la sib sib thim pas rnam dag ye shes kyi 'khor lor byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhwa gos gzab 'chor dang*/ spos bdug gdung ba'i dbyangs dang rol mo sna tshogs kyi sgra dang bcas spro na byin 'bebs rgyas pa yang 'dir bya/ hūm̐: 'og min bkod pa rab rdzogs lhun grub zhing : lnga ldan zang thal 'gyu ba'i pho brang nas: rigs 'dus rgyal ba rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams: 'du 'bral med par thugs rje'i shugs mtshon nas: gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin chen myur du phob: mchog thun 'bad med lhug par deng stsol shog: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sa ma ya a be sha ya a āḥ mthar me tog bkram brdung dang bcas byin chen dbab/ gsum pa rang rig don gyi brda sgo dbye ba ni/ hūm̐: rang rig gdod nas kun 'dus rtsa ba gsum:

sku lnga lhun grub 'du 'bral med mod kyang : bar du shes bya phra mo'i kun rtog tshogs: da ni rmongs gzhom rang rig brda sgo phyes: oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ bzhi pa rang rig lha dang mjal ba'i brda phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: ma rig ka dag klong thim g.ya' bral phyir: tshe rabs gnyug ma'i rang rig lha zhal mjal: 'dus ma byas kyi gshis lugs so mar bstod: nam yang bag yod mi 'da' chos 'khor bskor: oṃ badz+ra dharma shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na tsakra hūm̐: lnga pa rang bzhin ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor mi gtong bar bzung ba'i dam bca' ba ni/ hūm̐: yang dag don rtogs rlabs po che: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: ngo mtshar che nyid snyan pa'i dal: srog gi phyir yang mi btang bzung : oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta sa ma ye hūm̐: gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bskyed bzlas gnyis/ dang po la'ang gzhi ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi khog dbub pa/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa gnyis/ dang po de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐: ka dag lhun grub bde ba che: mu mtha' bral ba kun la khyab: blo 'das rtog med de bzhin ngang : thog ma'i mgon pos de ltar smras: oṃ dharma dhā tu gar+bha shū n+ya ta hūm̐: gnyis pa kun tu snang ba'i ting 'dzin ni/ hūm̐: rang byung dmigs su ma mchis kyang : zang thal chen po'i brtul zhugs kyi: rol rtsal 'gags med kun tu snang : rdo rje sems dpas de ltar smras: oṃ badz+ra dz+nyā na dharma sa twa swa bhā wa hūm̐: gsum pa rgyu yi ting 'dzin ni/ hūm̐: chos rnams bden med de bzhin la: rang byung snying po rgyu yi mchog: kun gyi srog tu hūm̐ gnas pas: pad+ma badz+ras de ltar smras: oṃ gu ru dz+nyā na sarba tsit+ta badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐: gnyis pa rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa la'ang*/ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten pa'i 'khor lo bskyed pa/ ye shes pa dbab cing spyan drangs pa/ gnyis med du bsre zhing phyag 'tshal mchod bstod 'bul ba bdun las/

dang po rten bskyed pa la gnyis kyi dang po 'byung ba rim brtsegs bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: ye shes lnga yi rang mdangs las: rtogs pa'i rlung lnga rol rtsal shar: de las phra mo'i sa bon dag: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: brtsegs thabs 'byung ba lnga ru grub: oṃ e ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la: ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la: a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la: ru tra ti ra baṃ: hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭḥ a dharma ya hoḥ gnyis pa rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa la thog mar yum lnga'i mkha' klong rnam par dag pa gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: e nam mkha' mthing nag kun tu bzang mo'i mkha': yam̐ g.yo byed rlung ri dam tshig sgrol ma'i mkha': ram̐ sreg byed me ri na bza' dkar mo'i mkha': kham̐ dam tshig bdud rtsi mā ma kī yi mkha': sum̐ dbang chen sa gzhi sangs rgyas spyan ma'i mkha': keṃ rdo rje ri rab mi shigs brag chen steng : bh+rūm̐ ye shes mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs pho brang bsgom: oṃ bh+rūm̐ dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍal tsakra hūm̐: hūm̐: de dbus mi 'gyur sna tshogs rdo rje yi: lte bar ye shes lnga ldan gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi lhun grub ngang nyid las: rtsig pa 'dod snam pha gu drwa ba mdzes: shar bu mda' yab pu shu brgyad dang ldan: bcu drug gdung ma ka ba brgyad kyis btegs: zhu chen zhu chung nyi zla 'ja' ris 'khyugs: 'phan dar bla bre yol ba sna tshogs bres: phyogs bzhir rta babs chos 'khor nyi zlas mdzes: dbus su rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa'i: zla gam bya 'dab 'od 'bar nor bu'i tog: thog steng gser gyi rgyal mtshan bcu drug dang : rin chen 'phan dar mdzes pa'i cod pan 'phyangs: phyi rol dur khrod chen po brgyad rnams dang : me brgyad shing brgyad chu brgyad rlung brgyad dang : sprin brgyad nam mkha' brgyad dang mchod rten brgyad: de nas sprul pa yang sprul rnam pa can: sgyu ma'i rtsal du so sor shar ba ni: phyi rol dur khrod chen po brgyad rnams ni:

bsil tshal sku la rdzogs dang laṅka brtsegs: pad 'khyil lhun grub gter dang gsang chen rol: he chen brdal ba la sogs dur khrod brgyad: dur khrod brgyad la dbang phyug nyer brgyad dang : baṃ ro brgyad la zhing skyong laṅka brgyad: keng rus brgyad la kau rī ma mo brgyad: gcan spyang brgyad la siṃ ha phra men brgyad: dur bya brgyad la lha bdud gnas nyul brgyad: dug sbrul brgyad la gcan spyang gdong chen brgyad: me 'bar brgyad la gnas pa'i gza' brgyad ni: ki kang mig dmar nyi zla lhag pa dang : phur bu spen pa pa sangs dag dang brgyad: rngam pa shing brgyad dag la gnas pa yi: hūm̐ kar mañju shrī nā gardzu: pra bha hastī bi ma mi tra dang : dha na saṃ skṛ rom+bu gu h+ya dang : shān+tiṃ gar+bha la sogs rig 'dzin brgyad: bdud rtsi'i chu mig brgyad la gnas pa yi: mtha' yas 'jog po dung skyong stobs rgyu dang : pad+ma hu lu ka dang rigs ldan no: bā su ta la sogs te klu chen brgyad: ye shes rlung brgyad dag la gnas pa ni: dbyings phyug spyan ma mā kī gos dkar sgron: tsaṇ+ḍa lī dang skyong byed rnal 'byor ma: sprin chen g.yo ba brgyad la gnas pa yi: dbang po tshangs pa dbang phyug khyab 'jug dang : bh+ring gi ri ti dga' byed tshogs kyi bdag: kīrti la sogs lha brgyad gnas pa'o: nam mkha' brgyad la gnas pa'i zhing khams lha: kun bzang rnam snang mi bskyod rdo rje dang : mi 'khrugs rdor sems rin 'byung 'od dpag med: don yod grub pa la sogs sangs rgyas bzhugs: mchod rten brgyad la rang srung sangs rgyas ni: rnam gzigs gtsug tor can dang log par skyobs: 'khor ba 'jigs dang gser thub 'od srung dang : shākya thub pa byams pa mos snang brgyad: de la sogs te dur khrod bkod pa brgyad: phyi rol rdo rwa me ri srung ba'i gur: 'ja' 'od lug rgyud gtibs pa'i pho brang gsal: gnyis pa brten pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha bskyed pa la gtso dang 'khor bskyed pa gnyis so/

dang po ni/ hūm̐: de dbus pad+ma nyi zla mdzes pa'i steng : gser gyi rdo rje hūm̐ yig dmar pos mtshan: 'od zhu dran rdzogs gu ru pad+ma ni: dkar dmar mdangs ldan bde chen rgyal po'i tshul: pad zhwa za ber chos gos phod kha gsol: rin chen snyan rgyan dar dmar sku rags mdzes: rdo rje thod pa tshe bum kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams: rgya lham gsol zhing zhabs gnyis rol stabs tshul: bag dro lhun chags gzi brjid ldan par bskyed: hūm̐: lhun grub stong gsal bde chen sku yi sbubs: ye shes 'khor lo lnga yi 'od klong du: badz+ra thod phreng dkar 'dzum mdzes 'od 'phro: pad+ma thod phreng dmar la chags pa'i mdangs: bud+dha thod phreng smug nag zhi ma khro: rat+na thod phreng ser bzhad mdzes cing sgeg: karma thod phreng ljang nag rab tu gtum: thams cad phyag g.yas thod pa'i cang te'u: g.yon pa mnyam bzhag bdud rtsi bhan+dha bsnams: dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ka ber phyam bklubs: bdud 'dul pad zhwa rtse rnon nyi zlas brgyan: zhabs rnams rol stabs swag chen rgya lham gsol: rang 'od 'byung lnga'i yum 'khril bde chen bskul: rtsa khams zhing kun dwangs pa'i lha sku gsal: gnyis pa 'khor tshogs bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: g.yas g.yon pad zlar bde chen bskyed pa'i yum: lha lcam dmar mos mda' dar tshe bum bsnams: mtsho rgyal dkar mos bhan+dha bdud rtsi mchod: zhi 'dzum dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan: chags pa'i nyams kyis gtso la gus pas 'dud: hūm̐: de yi spyi bor nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan: rigs 'dus ngo bo bla ma rdo rje 'chang : sku mdog mthing nag rdor dril bsnol thabs can: phyed skyil pang du dbyings phyug dmar mo 'khril: rdo rje tshe bum yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: longs spyod rdzogs sku zung 'jug ldan par bsgom: hūm̐: de yi spyi bor 'ja' 'od thig le'i klong : thog ma'i sangs rgyas snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur: dmar gsal mnyam bzhag skyil krung lham mer gsal:

hūm̐: gtso bo'i phyogs bzhi'i 'khor lo'i rim pa bzhir: mdun phyogs pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: dbang chen dmar smug zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: g.yas pas dbyug tho g.yon pas thod khrag bsnams: dur khrod chas ldan brkyang bskum gar stabs can: rdo rje phag mo gri thod mgul nas 'khyud: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'khril sbyor gsal bar bskyed: hūm̐: g.yas su pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: 'jam dpal dmar ser khro 'dzum sgeg bzhad tshul: phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon pas po ti 'dzin: dur khrod chas ldan brkyang bskum gar thabs can: yum chen sher phyin dmar gsal gri thod 'dzin: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'khril sbyor gsal bar bskyed: hūm̐: rgyab tu pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: 'jig rten dbang phyug zhal gsum phyag drug pa: dkar dmar mthing ba'i khro 'dzum mdzes zhal can: g.yas gnyis shel phreng nor bu 'bar ba 'dzin: g.yon gnyis tshe bum bdud rtsi lhung bzed bsnams: rtsa phyag thal sbyar 'chi med tshe bum thogs: longs sku'i chas ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor 'khril: mda' dar dung dmar yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: zhabs gnyis yab 'khril gtso bo bzhengs stabs gsal: hūm̐: g.yon du pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: phyags rdor mthing nag rdo rje sdigs mdzub can: dur khrod chas ldan brkyang bskum 'gying bag bzhugs: sgrol ljang pad phreng dung dmar mgul nas 'khyud: zhabs gnyis sked 'khril zung 'jug ldan par bsgom: hūm̐: de yi phyi rol 'khor yug rim pa bzhin: sna tshogs rin chen mdzes pa'i gdan khri'i steng : 'od zer thig le 'bar ba'i shar phyogs su: pad+ma 'byung gnas mthing nag zhi ma khro: rdo rje dril 'dzin lha lcam dmar mo 'khril: gcer bu rus rgyan phyed skyil gar stabs bzhugs: lho ru blo ldan mchog sred dkar gsal mdzes: ḍā ru pad phor bsnams nas dar thod bcing : dar dmar phod gsol rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs:

nub tu nyi ma 'od zer li khri'i mdog: khro 'dzum kha ṭ+wāṃ nyi zer zhags pa bsnams: gcer bu stag sham rus rgyan rol stabs gsal: byang du seṅge sgra sgrogs mthing ka gtum: skra gseb seng skad sgrog cing seng lpags gyon: rdo rje sdigs mdzub stag sham zhabs dor bzhugs: hūm̐: shar lho pad+ma sam+bha dkar smug mdzes: rab byung cha lugs chos gos gsum dang ldan: thod pa skyabs sbyin mdzad nas skyil krung bzhugs: lho nub pad+ma rgyal po dmar gsal sgeg: ḍā ru pad phreng me long lcags kyu bsnams: ber gsol dal 'bol steng na rol stabs bzhugs: nub byang shākya seṅge gser bzang mdog: sa gnon mnyam bzhag dge slong cha lugs can: chos gos dmar po gsol nas zung 'jug bzhugs: byang shar rdo rje gro lod smug nag rngam: rdo rje phur pa bsnams shing rab byung chas: mgo phreng rgyan ldan stag steng gar stabs bzhugs: de yi phyi rol pad 'dab bcu drug la: rdo rje dpa' bo yab yum ging yab yum: rat+na dpa' bo yab yum ging yab yum: pad+ma dpa' bo yab yum ging yab yum: karma dpa' bo yab yum ging yab yum: thams cad gar stabs rus rgyan g.yer kha'i sgra: zhi ma khro la thor tshugs rus rgyan can: phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon pas bhan dmar bsnams: yum rnams thams cad kha ṭ+wāṃ gru mor brten: kun kyang rang mdog gzi brjid ldan par bsgom: de yi phyi rol 'khor yug bar mtshams su: gsang ba'i lha mo bcu drug gar stabs sgyur: rang mdog phyag mtshan mdzes pa'i rgyan dang ldan: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes pa'i tshul du gsal: hūm̐: dbang phyug laṅka zhing skyong gnas nyul sogs: nyi ma dang ni zer bzhin snang ba yi: sprul pa yang sprul kun kyang 'ja' ltar lhags: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyis: 'og min zhing dang rnga yab dpal ri nas: pad 'byung rgyal ba rig 'dzin lha tshogs rnams: gsang ba'i pho brang gnas 'dir spyan drangs gyur:
oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ

gsum pa ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs shing byin dbab pa ni/ dri bzang gi spos btang zhing rol mo gling bu'i dbyangs snyan dang bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐: bzhi pa dam ye gnyis med du bsre zhing bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: ma chags skyon bral pad+ma ge sar dbus: 'dab stong khyon yangs rin chen seng khri'i steng : pad+ma 'byung gnas rtsa gsum ngo bo mchog: bde gshegs 'dus pa'i lha tshogs bzhugs su gsol: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sa ma ya satwaṃ: lnga pa gnyis med kyi dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal zhing mchod bstod 'bul ba la/ thog mar rang nyid las spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis phyag mchod sogs las rim la 'jug par mos shing*/ de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: ka dag lhun grub bla ma chos kyi sku: zang thal bde chen bla ma longs spyod rdzogs: sna tshogs ma 'gags bla ma sprul pa'i sku: rtsa gsum bder 'dus lha la phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ drug pa mchod pa 'bul ba la drug /dang po phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: bde chen ngo bo bla ma thabs kyi yab: stong gsal ma 'gags rig pa shes rab yum: zung 'jug dga' bzhi rol pa'i 'khrul 'khor sgyur: phyag rgya bla med mchod pa bzhes su gsol: oṃ badz+ra dz+nyā na mu ṭa rā ga ya ho sarba pū dza hoḥ gnyis pa bstod dbyangs glu'i mchod pa ni/

hūm̐: gzugs mdzes gar mo lang ling glu dbyangs can: bde ba mi bzod g.yo ba'i sgra skad sgrog: dri za'i dbyangs snyan lta bur sgrun med tshogs: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ lā s+ye mā l+ye gīrti nīrti swa ra sarba pū dza hoḥ gsum pa 'dod yon phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: mdzes pa'i me tog dri zhim bdug pa'i spos: snang gsal mar me bsil ba'i dri chab dang : ro mchog zhal zas snyan pa'i rol mo'i rigs: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: bzhi pa nyon mongs ma spangs nang mchod 'bul ba la sman raka gtor gsum las/ bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: dug lnga rnam dag sku lnga ye shes rdzas: gdod nas snang srid chos sku'i rol rtsal dang : sha lnga rdzas mchog pañca a mṛ ta: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta dz+nyā na pū dza la kha kha khā hi: bye brag nad sel sman rigs kyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: rnam par rgyal sogs dug lnga sel ba'i sman: kha mngar skyur dang bcud ldan tsha ba'i ro: lde gu khaṇ+ḍa zhun khol 'khyil ba'i tshogs: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ bhai ṣa dz+yai aṇ+ṭau a mṛ ta sarba pañca pū dza la kha kha khā hi: bdud rtsi lag mchod 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kun bzang yab yum rdo rje 'chang chen dang*/ /snang ba mtha' yas dgongs brgyud bla ma la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal ba rigs lnga sogs/ /rig 'dzin brda brgyud bla ma thams cad la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ dga' rab shrī sing rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung*/ /bka' bab lung chen tshig brgyud bla ma la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/

sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal sangs rgyas ye shes dang*/ /rtsa gsum gling pa gter brgyud bla ma la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ thugs mchog rdo rje dkon mchog seṅge dang*/ /ye shes rgyal mtshan mi 'jigs rdo rje sogs/ /dbang lung man ngag don brgyud bla ma la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ thod phreng sde lnga lha lcam mtsho rgyal dang*/ /rnam rol mtshan brgyad rig 'dzin 'dus pa la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ yi dam rta phag rigs gsum mgon po dang*/ /dngos grub stsal ba yi dam 'dus pa la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ging dang dpa' bo laṅka gnas nyul sogs/ /grub gnyis char 'bebs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ mgon po sde lnga dregs sde sa ya dang*/ /bka' gter srung ma dam can rgya mtsho la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ sku gsum mi shigs rdo rje'i klong*/ /ma bcos mchog gi dngos grub kyis/ /bdag rgyud sku gsum snying por grol/ /bde gshegs go 'phang myur thob shog au ḍī sha dha karmas sbyar ba'o// // bha ling gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: thod pa mtshan ldan lcang lo 'khyil ba'i dbus: dpal gyi gtor ma brjid ldan ri ltar spungs: bcud g.yo gling bzhi rol mtsho bkod legs brgyan: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ ma hā bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: dmar chen rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: dung dmar bde chen yangs pa'i bhan+dha ru: chags med bcud g.yo mdangs ldan rlabs su 'khyil: rgyud drug bsgral ba'i rmad byung rak+ta ni:

rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: lnga pa gsang mchod sbyor sgrol gnyis las/ bde stong sbyor ba dga' bzhi'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: shes rab mu kha chos 'byung sgra gcan rtser: dga' chen khyab bdag nor bu'i sor bsnun pas: byang sems dkar dmar bde rgyun g.yo ba'i tshogs: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra a haṃ pra mo ti raṃ sarba pū dza khā hi: zhe sdang nyon mongs bsgral ba'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: shes bya'i lta ba gyad kyi phur pa yis: nga bdag srid pa'i ru tra bsgral gtubs nas: sha khrag klad rus phung por spungs pa 'di: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su+u ta la kha kha khā hi: drug pa yang gsang de kho na nyid ting 'dzin don gyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: gdod nas rnam dag ye shes sku lnga'i mchog: 'du 'bral med pa'i dbyings rig so ma ni: bsngo mkhan 'bul yul mi dmigs mchog mchod nyid: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ dz+nyā na dhā tu swa bhā pū dza hoḥ bdun pa rang bzhin lhun grub dkyil 'khor la bstod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: thog ma'i mgon po ye shes lam me ba: ka dag dbyings rig bde chen 'du 'bral med: thugs rje chags pa'i mnyam bzhag skyil krung can: mgon po 'od mi 'gyur la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: nam mkha'i mdangs ldan rigs brgya'i cod pan can: khyab bdag ye shes 'khor los 'gro ba 'dren: thabs shes dbyer med rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: zung 'jug dga' ba'i dbang phyug sku la 'khril: sgyu ma'i ngang tshul phyed skyil rol stabs can: rdor 'chang longs spyod rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: ma bcos spros bral ka dag ngo bo nyid: zang thal 'gags med thugs rjes so sor ston: 'gro ba'i don phyir thugs rje sgyu ma'i gar:

o rgyan gu ru pad 'byung sku la bstod: hūm̐: sku mdog dkar mdzes zhi 'dzum chags pa ni: ye shes sku lnga 'du 'bral med pa'i brda: dbu la gser gyi snyan zhu gsol ba ni: bde chen rgyal po 'gro ba'i don mdzad brda: de la rin chen rdo rje btsugs pa ni: kun gzhi gnas lugs 'gyur ba med pa'i brda: rtse mor rgod po'i dang ru btsugs pa ni: sa lam theg chen dus gcig 'jug pa'i brda: dar tshon sna lnga'i cod pan 'phur ba ni: ye shes lnga ldan rol rtsal ston pa'i brda: nyi zla nor bu'i rgyan mdangs spras pa ni: srid zhi'i ma rig mun pa sel ba'i brda: sna tshogs rdo rje'i rgya gram ldan pa ni: dgongs brda rgya mtsho'i slob dpon yin pa'i brda: khyung gshog rin chen drwa bas spras pa ni: brgyud 'dzin bu la 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i brda: rat+na snyan rgyan gdu bu 'khrol ba ni: 'khor los sgyur rgyal kun gyi dad dpon brda: mthing nag chu ris phod ka bklubs pa ni: zab gsang lta ba mi shigs ston pa'i brda: gong lag mu tig chun pos spras pa ni: rtsa rlung bde stong 'du 'bral med pa'i brda: dar dmar rgya ma'i sku rags bcings pa ni: ma sring mkha' 'gro rtag tu 'du ba'i brda: chos gos gser gyi ha ris gsol ba ni: sde snod lung rigs gsang mdzod 'dzin pa'i brda: smug nag g.yung drung ber chen gsol ba ni: snang srid dbang sdud gtso bo yin pa'i brda: zhe sdang stag gis gong lag brgyan pa ni: skal ngan bdud rigs rgol ba 'joms pa'i brda: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams pa ni: ma rungs zil gnon gdug pa 'dul ba'i brda: g.yon pas bhan+dha tshe bum bsnams pa ni: 'chi med rig 'dzin 'ja' lus 'grub pa'i brda: kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum mchan du 'chang ba ni: dug gsum la sogs 'khrul rtog gcod pa'i brda: gsus pa che zhing gsus khyim 'khyil ba ni: sgrub la mchog thun char ltar 'bebs pa'i brda:

zhabs gnyis rol stabs rgya lham gsol ba ni: 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem pa'i brda: sku la 'od dpung gzi brjid 'khyil ba ni: phyogs dus rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo'i brda: spyan rtsa 'khyil zhing mkha' dbyings gzigs pa ni: nam yang thugs rje 'du 'bral med pa'i brda: brda rtags rgyan rdzogs bla ma rje la bstod: 'gro ba'i mgon mchog ma hā gu rur bstod: snang mtha'i dbang phyug mtsho skyes rje la bstod: rgyal sras lhun grub pad 'byung sku la bstod: bstan pa'i skyabs mchog rgya gar pa la bstod: mdo sngags gtsug rgyan nyi 'od gsal la bstod: bka' drin 'khor med pha la bstod pa'i mthus: bu la thugs rje'i byin rlabs char ltar phob: mtshungs med nyi ltar deng 'dir bdag gyur cig: hūm̐: sku yi bdag nyid badz+ra thod phreng rtsal: zhi ba'i las mdzad dkar gsal 'dzum mdangs can: za ber gsol nas cang te'u bhan+dha bsnams: chu khams rnam dag rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'khril: me long ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gsung gi bdag nyid pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: dbang gi las mdzad dmar gsal 'dzum mdangs can: za ber gsol nas cang te'u bhan+dha bsnams: me khams rnam dag pad+ma mkha' 'gro 'khril: sor rtog ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: thugs rje'i bdag nyid bud+dha thod phreng rtsal: sna tshogs las mdzad smug nag zhi ma khro: za ber gsol nas cang te'u bhan+dha bsnams: nam mkha' rnam dag sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro 'khril: chos dbyings ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: yon tan bdag nyid rat+na thod phreng rtsal: rgyas pa'i las mdzad ser gsal 'dzum mdangs can: za ber gsol nas cang te'u bhan+dha bsnams: sa khams rnam dag rin chen mkha' 'gro 'khril: mnyam nyid ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: phrin las bdag nyid karma thod phreng rtsal: drag po'i las mdzad ljang nag zhi ma khro: za ber gsol nas cang te'u bhan+dha bsnams:

rlung khams rnam dag karma mkha' 'gro 'khril: bya grub ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: zag med dga' bzhi skyed pa'i dbang mo che: dbyings phyug man+da ra ba mtsho rgyal lcam: mda' dar tshe bum srid zhi'i tshe bcud sdud: dwangs ma'i bdud rtsi bde chen mchod sprin g.yo: zung 'jug ye shes 'khor los phyag rgya sgyur: thugs 'dzin yum mchog gnyis la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal me 'od 'khrugs pa'i mdangs: bdud dpung 'joms byed dbyug to bhan+dha bsnams: 'bar ba'i gar dgu dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: snang srid dbang sdud phag mo sku la 'khril: nyon mongs tshar gcod gri thod mgul nas 'khyud: brkyang bskum 'khril sbyor rtsa khams 'khor los bsgyur: rta skad phag skad hūm̐ bh+yo 'brug ltar ldir: dbang chen yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dmar ser sgeg pa gtum chen g.yul las rgyal: bdud dpung tshar gcod ral gri po ti 'dzin: gshe zhing dur khrod chas ldan gar dgu ldan: sangs rgyas kun gyi yum chen sku la 'khril: ma rig gzhom phyir gri thod mgul nas 'khyud: brkyang bskum 'khril sbyor bde chen thabs kyis bskul: mu stegs rgol ba 'joms byed mthu rtsal can: 'jam dpal yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: byams pa'i 'od zer 'gro la dgyes mdzad pa: 'khor ba stongs phyir shel phreng nor bu 'dzin: byang chub lam ston pad dkar bdud rtsi 'dzin: skye 'chi spang phyir phyag rgya tshe bum thogs: gsang ba'i lha mo rnal 'byor sku la 'khril: rig 'dzin mchog stsol mda' dar dung dmar 'khyud: zhabs gnyis 'khril sbyor bde stong 'du 'bral med: snying rje'i dbang phyug mtha' yas mgon gyur mchog: spyan gzigs yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: bdud dpung 'joms mdzad mthing nag gtum po'i sku: snang srid bsngang phyir rdo rje sdigs mdzub bsgrengs: rngam stabs dur khrod chas ldan gar bsgyur can:

dam tshig yum chen sgrol ma sku la 'khril: 'khor ba stongs phyir pad phreng dung dmar 'khyud: zhabs gnyis 'khril sbyor 'khor lo rgyas kyis 'debs: sa bcu'i dbang phyug gtum chen g.yul las rgyal: lag na rdo rje yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: rnga yab gling bzhugs 'gro mgon gu ru rje: gdong dmar srin po thabs kyis kha gnon mdzad: pad+ma 'byung gnas yab yum sku la bstod: bsil ba tshal du yon tan dngos grub brnyes: theg chen chos sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs mdzad pa: pad+ma saṃ bha'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: rā ga ra tir mkhyen gnyis dngos grub brnyes: shes bya kun la thogs med spobs pa rgyas: blo ldan mchog sred sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dga' ba tshal du dbang sdud dngos grub brnyes: ma sring rgya mtsho thabs kyis rol rtsal mdzad: pad+ma rgyal po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: so sa gling du 'gro 'dul dngos grub brnyes: srid zhi'i rmongs tshogs ma rig rab gzhom pa: nyi ma 'od zer sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: za hor yul du bdud 'dul dngos grub brnyes: log 'dren bdud rigs dam sri 'dul mdzad pa: shākya seṅge'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: ma ghar mu stegs 'dul ba'i dngos grub brnyes: dmod pa drag sngags gnam lcags thog mda' 'phen: seṅge sgra sgrogs sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: stag tshang dregs pa tshar gcod dngos grub brnyes: ma rungs tshar gcod khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ rdo rje gro lod sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dug lnga 'joms mdzad dpa' bo chen po bzhi: rang 'dra mkha' 'gro sde yum dang bcas: bde stong dbang sgyur gtso bo yab yum brgyad: he ru ka pa brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: las bzhi mnga' mdzad gtum pa'i ging chen bzhi: rang 'dra shugs 'gro sde bzhi yum dang bcas: rdzu 'phrul shugs 'chang ging chen yab yum brgyad: 'jigs byed 'bar ba brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho mnyes pa'i gar ma gzugs:

phyag na dbang po'i yul 'dzin mchod sprin thogs: khams g.yo 'khor lo bde stong phyag rgya can: bcu drug rig ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: zhing skyong laṅka dbang phyug ma mo dang : gnas nyul la sogs dkyil 'khor skyong ba'i tshogs: bka' yi bya ra las kyi mtha' sdud pa: gter srung la sogs yongs rdzogs bcas la bstod:

ces brjod cing gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ brgyad pa bzlas pa sngags kyi rnal 'byor la 'jug pa ni/ dang po sgrub pa'i skabs yin na dzap khang dbye dgos pas/ thog mar bdag mdun 'jug pa gcig bskyed ni/ bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe hūm̐ phaṭ dzaḥ sa rten par/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa mā ya dza sid+dhi pha la hūm̐:phaṭ dzaḥ sa brten pa'i lha/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor las ye shes rtsal 'bar gyi rnam par logs su phyes te mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par bsam mo/ zhes se gol gtog la mdun rten dbye zhing gsal brtan dag gsum gyi ting 'dzin la bslab/ gnyis pa dzap kyis thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba bde gshegs 'dus pa'i tshogs: ye shes dbyings nas thugs dam rgyud bskul la: 'gro ba'i don phyir phrin las gter chen gyi: dgongs pa klong yangs byin rlabs shugs 'byung bas: sgrub la smin grol gdams pa zab mo mchog: 'bad med myur ba nyid la stsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru dharma tsit+ta gar+bha ā yur+dz+nyā na s-id+dhi hūm̐: gsum pa dzap dgongs gsal gdab pa la/ thog mar chos sku'i ngo sprod gsal gdab ni/ hūm̐: rang rig snang ba mtha' yas sku: smra brjod bral ba'i sems la ltos: 'khor gsum gdod nas rnam dag ngang : 'khor 'das dbye ba'i sa mtshams 'das: dran rdzogs bla ma chos kyi sku: ka dag 'od gsal gnyug ma'i gshis: chos sku snang mtha' gzhan na med: mi rtog ye shes ngo mtshar che: oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ zhes pa'i sngags phreng gang mang bzlas: de nas spro bsdu bya ba ni: hūm̐: sngags phreng 'od zer lnga ldan tshul: spros pas rgyal ba mchod cing dgyes: bsdus pas byin rlabs 'ub kyis thim: sbyor bas ma sring dbang du sdud: bsgral bas bdag 'dzin dbyings su gtor: lta ba rang rig bla ma lha: sgom pa snang srid chos skur rol: spyod pa re dogs blang dor zad:

kun kyang 'bras bu'i ngo bor ldan: oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ de nas longs sku'i ngo sprod ni: hūm̐: rang rig bla ma rdo rje 'chang : zang thal 'gags med sems la ltos: smra brjod bral yang sna tshogs 'char: rang bzhin klong las thugs rje'i rtsal: kun gyi byed po bdag med nyid: gang shar bla ma longs spyod rdzogs: sgra grags 'gags med stong pa'i dbyings: longs sku ston pa gzhan du med: spros bral rang grol ngo mtshar che: oṃ badz+ra sa twa dz+nyā na dha ra hūm̐: zhi ba'i sngags phreng gang mang bzlas: hūm̐: sngags phreng 'od zer lnga ldan tshul: spros pas rgyal ba mchod cing dgyes: bsdus pas byin rlabs 'ub kyis thim: sbyor bas ma sring dbang du sdud: bsgral bas bdag 'dzin dbyings su gtor: lta ba rang rig bla ma lha: sgom pa snang srid longs sku rol: spyod pa re dogs blang dor zad: kun kyang 'bras bu'i ngo bor ldan: oṃ badz+ra sa twa dz+nyā na dha ra hūm̐: de nas sprul sku'i ngo sprod ni: hūm̐: rang rig pad+ma 'byung gnas sku: sna tshogs shar grol sems la ltos: cir snang sgyu ma'i ngang tshul nyid: snod bcud dkyil 'khor lha yi zhing : rang lus dag kyang gzhal yas khang : rtsa khams bla ma sprul pa'i sku: gzugs rnams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i ngang : sprul sku pad 'byung gzhan na med: sprul sku drwa ba ngo mtshar che: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: sngags phreng gang mang bzlas: hūm̐: sngags phreng 'od zer lnga ldan tshul: spros pas rgyal ba mchod cing dgyes: bsdus pas byin rlabs 'ub kyis thim: sbyor bas ma sring dbang du sdud: bsgral bas bdag 'dzin dbyings su gtor: lta ba rang rig bla ma lha: sgom pa snang srid sprul sku rol: spyod pa re dogs blang dor zad: kun kyang 'bras bu'i ngo bor ldan: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: bzhi pa bzlas pa dngos la bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa las sbyor gsum mo/

dang po bsnyen pa ni/ bdag nyid gu ru snang srid zil gnon gyi/ /chos kyi 'khor lor 'od lnga'i thig klong du/ /bud+dha thod phreng smug nag zhi ma khro/ /cang te'u bhan+dha 'dzin pa'i thugs ka ru/ /pad nyi zla steng rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i/ /lte bar hūm̐ dmar mtha' bskor sngags kyi phreng*/ /g.yas bskor 'od kyis phyogs dus rgyal kun dang*/ /o rgyan chen po'i thugs rgyud rab tu bskul/ /kun kyang gu ru pad+ma'i sku gsung thugs/ /phyag rgya yig 'bru phyag mtshan rnam pa ru/ /spyan drangs mtsho la kha char babs pa bzhin/ /rgyun mi chad par thim pas byin brlab gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes bsnyen pa ci nus bzlas/ dmigs bsal bsnyen sgrub so sor dbye ba'i skabs sgrub tshul dang dus grangs rtags gsum la sbyar ba sogs skabs gzhan du shes par bya dgos so/ gnyis pa sgrub pa'i dmigs pa ni/ gtso bo'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' yi/ /thugs dbus ting 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ gi mthar/ /sngags phreng 'od bcas 'gal me klad skor ltar/ bar med 'phros pas mdun bskyed lha tshogs bskul/ /kun gyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng las/ /'od zer dpag med nam mkha' gang bar 'phros/ /phyogs bcu'i rab 'byams rgyal ba ma lus mchod/ /kun gyi byin rlabs gu ru pad+ma yi/ /gsang gsum 'khor lo'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ /bdag mdun sgrub rdzas la thim dngos grub bskyil/ /'gro drug sems can la phog sdig sgrib sbyangs/ /dam can srung mar phog pas dam tshig bskul/ /rnal 'byor mched lcam la phog nyams sgrib dag /mdor na phyi nang snod bcud snang grags sems/ /gdod nas ye dag lha sngags chos sku'i ngang*/ /ma bcos dkyil 'khor gsum du ngang gis rdzogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa mā ya dza sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ zhes sgrub sngags bsnyen pa'i bcu cha bzla/

gsum pa las sbyor ni/ thugs ka'i 'od kyis rigs bzhi thod phreng dang*/ khyad par rta phag yab yum thugs dam bskul/ /de yi 'od las ye shes 'jig rten gyi/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro kun gyi srog snying bskul/ /de las sprul dang yang sprul mkha' khyab spros/ /nad gdon sdig sgrib ba mor nyi bzhin gzhom/ /tshe dpal bsod nams yar ngo'i zla bzhin spel/ /'khor 'das mos bzhis snang ba dbang du bsdus/ /ma rungs dgra gdon thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag /tshur 'dus thams cad chos dbyings ka dag klong*/ /'khor 'das mnyam nyid rdo rje'i srog 'grub gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hri ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: de ltar sgrub pa'i bcu cha las sbyor bya bar gsungs so/ de yis 'khor 'das kyi stong srog la dbang thob pa'i phrin las rab 'byams la mnga' brnyes par 'gyur bar gdon mi za ba man ngag gi yig cha rnams las ches gsal lo/ de ltar dmigs pa dang ldan pa'i ngang bsnyen sgrub las gsum ci 'grub bzlas pa'i mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten 'brel snying po bcas kyi mthar/ mchod bstod dam bsdu na stong tshig 'bul ba ni/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod/ /bag med 'gal 'khrul nyams chags bshags/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ ma hā sarba pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ gsham du thun gtor 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: rtsa gsum kun 'dus bde gshegs dkyil 'khor du: phyi nang gsang ba'i bla med mchod gtor 'bul: deng 'dir byin rlabs thugs dam rgyud bskul nas: sgrub la dbang bzhi mchog thun stsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha gter bdag la sogs pa rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: zhes thun gtor 'bul/ de dag gis stod las byang bu khrigs su bsdebs pa re zhig grub bo/

skabs 'dir bsnyen rkyang lta bur yin tshe rjes chog la 'jug pas chog go /rim pa gnyis pa smad las tshogs mchod kyi bya ba la 'jug par mos na/ thog mar chos skyong sde lnga sogs rang lugs gsol kha rgyas bsdus gang rung sngon du song nas/ na raka bshags skong sogs rgyas bsdus ci rigs sngon du 'don srol snga 'gyur spyi chos ltar grub na legs pa'i yan lag yin la ma byas kyang mi 'gal lo/ dang po thabs shes kyi rdzas phun sum tshogs pa 'du byas la/ tshogs phud rim pa gsum du spros nas/ thog mar rig 'dzin srog sgrub tshig lhug btang*/ de nas las rdor gyis tshogs zhus sngon du 'gro bas/ tshogs mchod dngos la/ dang po byin gyis brlab pa ni/ thog mar chu gtsang gis bran zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab/ hūm̐: chos rnams mi dmigs spros dang bral: rang byung gdod nas mkha' ltar khyab: 'khor 'das ro gcig lta ba'i klong : gnyis med ye shes chen por bskyed: gnyis 'dzin bag chags ka nas dag: oṃ dharma shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bdag nyid pad+ma 'od 'bar thugs ka nas: dug gsum sbyang phyir yig 'bru ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: 'od 'phros tshogs la phog pas nyes skyon gtor: bag chags rnam rtog mi dmigs sgyu mar sbyangs: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ hūm̐: byin gyis rlob pa'i yig 'bru oṃ āḥhūm̐: 'dod yon tshogs la phog pas dpag med sbyangs: rtsa gsum bde gshegs mnyes pa'i mchod sprin tshogs: rmad byung nam mkha'i mtha' las khyab par spel: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ga ṇa tsakra sarba ma hā me gha s+pha ra ṇa oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes pa'i snying pos lan gsum gyis spel/ gnyis pa tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: lhun grub rab 'byams stug po bkod zhing nas: bla ma bder 'dus chos sku rgya mtsho rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: bde chen mkha' dbyings khyab brdal pho brang nas:

bla ma bder 'dus longs sku rgya mtsho rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: zang thal lhan skyes gnyug ma'i pho brang nas: bla ma bder 'dus sprul sku rgya mtsho rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas: o rgyan dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: bde chen nam mkha' 'phrul gyi gdengs ka nas: chos srung bstan pa'i bya ra 'khor bcas rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rab 'jigs sa gsum g.yo ba'i dur khrod nas: bstan srung las mkhan myur mgyogs 'khor bcas rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: chos sku rgya mtsho ka dag sangs se sang : longs sku rgya mtsho rang mdangs ta la la: sprul sku rgya mtsho 'ja' tshon spungs se spung : rtsa brgyud bla ma byin rlabs thibs se thib: yi dam lha tshogs hūm̐ sgra 'u ru ru: ma sring mkha' 'gro'-i brda skad di ri ri: dpa' bo rgya mtshos gar byed shigs se shig: dpa' mo rgya mtshos glu len kyu ru ru: ging chen pho mos gar stabs khrigs se khrig: chos skyong rgya mtsho las byed sha ra ra: nor lha dbang sdud longs spyod chi li li: gter srung gnyer gtad bya ra lhangs se lhang : tshogs gsog rgya mtsho'i bcud g.yo me re re: gnas khang byin 'bebs gar mo kyi li li: 'dir tshogs pho mo dga' bro ya la la: gnas 'dir gshegs la dbang bskur byin chen phob: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa tshogs mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : dam can chos srung nor gyi bdag: gter bdag gnyan po skyong la sogs: rig 'dzin bder 'dus dkyil 'khor la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bla med bdud rtsi'-i mchod pa 'bul: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul:

sna tshogs spyan gzigs mchod pa 'bul: mthun rdzas brtse bas bzhai+es su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi: tshogs phud dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du phul/ gtor bsngos mthar dbyung*/ bzhi pa bskang ba la 'jug pa ni/ thog mar bskang gsol 'dod rgu mchog sbyin bshags pa'i bar btang*/ de nas bskang ba bsdus pa ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod mdzes pa'i lha mo sna tshogs dang : nang mchod sha lnga bdud rtsi a mṛ ta: gsang mchod bde stong chags med ye shes rdzas: sman gtor rak+ta sbyor sgrol dbang po lnga: spyan gzigs dkor cha yid 'ong mnyes pa'i brten: rol mo sgra snyan gdangs dbyangs dgyes pa'i glu: kun nas ma tshang med pa'i mchod sprin 'di: bla ma rig 'dzin bde gshegs 'dus pa'i tshogs: rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : nyams chag bskangs shing bar chad sel gyur na: mchog thun 'bad med lhun grub stsal du gsol: zhes thugs dam bskangs/ lnga pa bshags pa ni/ skong bshags rgyas par spro skabs/ hoḥ 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi?sogs bshags pa'ang 'dir bya/ hūm̐: rtsa gsum kun 'dus lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag cag dkyil 'khor zab mo'i sgor zhugs nas: bag med dbang gyur dam 'gal ci mchis pa: mthol bshags bzod gsol mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: oṃ gu ru sa twa sa ma ya: ma nu pā la ya: gu ru sa twa twe no pa: sogs yig rgya brjod/ drug pa bsgral ba ni tshogs tha ma'i dmigs rten mdun du bkod cing rak+tas bran la dgug pa ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i lha: dkyil 'khor skyong sogs srung ma 'khor bcas kyi: bden pa chen po'i mthu stobs nus pa yis: bla ma'i sku dgra sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra: rnal 'byor sgos dgra sems can yongs la 'tshe: ma nyes log par lta ba'i dgra bgegs kyi: bla tshe rnam shes srog dbugs dbang thang bcas:

steng 'og phyogs bcu'i bar mtshams gar gnas kyang : snying nas zungs shig ma mo za byed ma: ske nas zungs shig ma mo gsod byed ma: yan lag sdoms shig ma mo sha za ma: myos par gyis shig ma mo srog bdag ma: lha dang phyes shig ma mo zangs gri ma: bdud dang sprod cig ma mo spu gri ma: dbyer med gtubs shig ma mo srid bdag ma: dus la bab bo pho nya mthu ma chung : dmigs pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs shor ra re: rang dbang med par myur du khug la shog: oṃ ma tri ma tri re ma ti rak+mo a tri ya dgra bgegs a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ bdun pa phur bu thogs la/ hūm̐: dpal chen sras mchog badz+ra kī la ya: rgya mdud steng nas 'brug stong di ri ri: 'chang bzung ngos nas glog dmar khyugs se khyug: chu srin kha nas ser ba hri li li: zur gsum rngam la thog rgod sha ra ra: 'dril zhing 'debs pa'i shan pa phur bu khyod: dgra bgegs gdug pa'i snying la mā ra ya: brlag cing bcom nas ming yang med par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig+nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ru tra shag thuṃ nṛ tri ya ma ha ri kha dgra bgegs kyi srog la gzer thuṃ bi shwa tsakra ha la ha la hūm̐ phaṭḥ tshe khrus lung gsum gyi dgongs pa ldan pas bsgral zhing gtub par bya'o/ brgyad pa zhal du bstab pa ni bdud rtsis bran la/

hūm̐: bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha: ye shes spyan ldan 'khor dang bcas pa yi: gnam sa ri rab khyon ltar zhal phyes la: dgra bgegs don snying sha khrag bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta la kha kha khā hi: zhes dkyil 'khor du 'bul/ dgu pa tshogs la rol ba ni rdo rje'i glu gar sogs kyang bya/ las rdor gyis tshogs rdzas thabs shes ma nor bar thogs la tshogs zhus ni/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: bla med dkyil 'khor rdzas chen gyi: dngos grub rmad byung ro brgya'i zas: deng 'dir skal ldan rnams la stsol: ces zhus pa'i lan du slob dpon gyis phyag rgya dang bcas blangs nas/ hoḥ 'di ni legs 'ong ya mtshan ldan: 'khor 'das ro gcig blang dor bral: gtsang rme gzung 'dzin gdod nas dag: dge bas de bzhin a la la hoḥ e ma hoḥ 'dus pa kun la bkye zhing rol bar bya'o/ bcu pa lhag ma gtong ba ni de tshe las rdor pas lhag ma gral mthar bkod nas phyag sngon du song bas lhag gtor byin gyis brlab pa la thugs gtad par zhu zhes gsol ba dang*/ 'dus pa byings nas/ oṃ a kā ro sa sngags dang*/ lhag ma dam rdzas 'dod yon gyi phung po zad mi shes par nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ e a ra li hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ dzaḥ zhes slob dpon nas mkha' lding gi rgya bcas zhal chab kyi bdud rtsis bran la lhag ma bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐: dang po phud kyi mchod pa ni: bla ma rig 'dzin dgyes pa'i rtags: bar du bskang zhing bshags pa ni: yi dam mkha' 'gro mthun pa'i rdzas: tha ma 'gugs shing bsgral ba ni: chos skyong dam can rbad pa'i rtags: dbyer med tshogs la rol ba ni: nor lha gter bdag dngos grub brda: kun nas lhag ma sdud pa ni: laṅka gnas nyul dgyes par mtshon: dkyil 'khor mtha' la bzhag pa ni: bka' bzhin bstan pa srung bar stsol: lhag ma kha chus bran pa ni:

'da' ka dam tshig gcig par ston: hūm̐: bde gshegs rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs bstan srung ni: mtshan mo sgra sgrogs ma mo bye ba 'bum: srod la rab rgyu sna tshogs cho 'phrul ston: smag rum gseb nas mi sdug bshugs ring 'then: la las rgyan mdzes spras nas mkha' la lding : la las 'dab chags bzhon nas bar snang kheng : la las sder chags bzhon nas sa gzhi nyul: la las gcer mo dur khrod baṃ ro khur: la las g.yang gzhi gyon cing bhan+dha thogs: la las nang rol 'dren zhing rgyu ma za: la las srod 'phros drod nyul lam lam 'gyu: don la thams cad rnal 'byor ma sring ste: bye brag so sor snang ngor sgyu ma'i gar: mi bzad gar sgyur bstan pa'i bya ra tshogs: bka' yi las byed phra men 'khor bcas kyis: 'dod yon tshogs kyi lhag ma 'di bzhes la: rgyud srung sgrub pa'i sdong grogs ma g.yel zhing : ma rungs gdug pa'i tshogs rnams tshar bcad nas: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ma ma tri hriṃ hriṃ mu kha le sa ma ya maṇ+ḍal pā la i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: smon lam ni/ rig 'dzin bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yis/ /bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog / ces dang gtor 'gugs ni/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum gyi bden pa'i stobs kyis sdang dgra gnod byed gdug pa can thams cad drag po dmar gyi gtor ma 'di la khug cig /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bcu gcig pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: rnam dag ye shes dbyings kyi pho brang nas: rig 'dzin kun gyi 'dus gzugs pad+ma 'byung : rtsa gsum lha tshogs bde gshegs dkyil 'khor rnams: thugs rje'i klong nas sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs shig: deng 'dir 'gro la brtse chen gzigs par bskul: deng sang yang mtha' snyigs ma lnga brgya'i dus: sems can dmu rgod khro gtum 'gong po'i tshogs:

rnam smin bag chags brtsegs pa'i ngan goms kyis: ci byed rgyu 'bras khyad gsod brtson lags pas: 'chi 'pho ltung bar thugs rje'i rtsal phyungs la: srid pa'i rgya mtsho skem pa'i dus la bab: sdug bsngal btson ra bshig pa'i dus la bab: rnam smin 'khrul sgo gcod pa'i dus la bab: deng nas sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skems par mdzod: hūm̐: bskul lo bzhengs shig rgyal ba thugs rje can: rtsa gsum bder 'dus lha tshogs mthu ma chung : sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khyad du dmod de phrin las bcol ba ni: deng sang snyigs ma yang mtha' 'dul dka'i dus: ma rungs sdig to bdud kyi sde tshogs kyis: gsang sngags bstan pa gnyan la dgra dar bas: mthu chen khyod kyi mngon spyod dus la bab: bar gcod brtsams pa'i log 'dren 'di dag kun: rdo rje bka' yis chad pas rab brdegs nas: bcom zhing brlags te ming yang med par mdzod: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sarba sa ma ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: chos skyong gi gtor 'bul nyung bsdus mthar rig 'dzin brgyud pas gtor ma 'bul/ bcu gnyis pa chad mdo btang ba ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe 'og min bkod pa rab rdzogs nas: zhing khams pho brang 'thug po bkod pa ru: thog ma'i mgon po snang ba mtha' yas dang : rigs kyi yum chen rdo rje rnal 'byor gnyis: ka dag dang po'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs pa ru: sprul sku sgyu ma'i rang gzugs bstan nas kyang : skye 'gag gnas gsum dngos blo bral ba bzhin: gang shar bde stong gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sna tshogs bdag med rtogs pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og gsang sgrom me ri 'bar ba yi: ma la ya zhes tsit+ta'i pho brang nas: rdo rje 'chang dbang dga' rab rdo rje dang : dbyings kyi yum chen snyems ma kun gsal gnyis: rtsal snang brda bzhi'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: ma sring ḍāk+ki dbang phyug rgya mtsho yis:

so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang : bstan srung phrin las bcol bar khas blangs bzhin: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dngos grub mchog stsol bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og bod yul dbus kyi bsam yas nas: brag dmar mchims phu dpal gyi ke'u tshang du: rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang : dbyings kyi yum chen mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal gnyis: bder 'dus srog sgrub dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: lo tsā'i dwangs ma sangs rgyas ye shes la: lung bstan bka' gtad kha byang phog pa'i tshe: rgyal po la sogs dregs chen bco brgyad kyis: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang : bka' yi bstan pa bsrung phyir khas blangs bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad du gsol: hūm̐: de 'og lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma ru: brag dmar mchims phu dpal gyi gnas mchog tu: rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho yis: bder 'dus zil gnon thugs sgrub gdan drangs tshe: sngags bdag ma mo e ka dzā ṭi yis: dngos su gzugs bstan gter sgrom phul ba'i tshe: zab chos rgyas pa'i grogs mor khas blangs bzhin: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dus drug ma g.yel bya ra mdzad du gsol: oṃ sarba ḍāk+ki nī dharma pā la ma tri e ka dzā ṭi sa ma ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: bcu gsum pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i bka' nyan ma: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis ni: bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma: dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje ya ma skyong : gangs dkar sha med rdo rje kun tu bzang : 'brog chen 'khor 'dus rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso: gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje g.yu bun ma: kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum: gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje klu mo dang : rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal: kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong :

btsan la rol pa'i rdo rje sman gcig ma: mo btsun ug chos rdo rje g.yar mo bsil: g.yu yi dril bu rdo rje si le ma: ma sring bod skyong chen mo bcu gnyis ni: so so'i bran g.yog yang 'khor g.yog dang bcas: lhab lhub mdzes pa'i na bza' sku la gsol: sna tshogs rgyan cha mang po khro lo lo: g.yer kha rol mo sil snyan si li li: glu len bro rdung gar rtsed khyugs se khyug: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa'i bya ra mel tshe mdzod: oṃ pra mo li tsa tur yak+sha li tsa tur ma tri li tsa tur ya sarba i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: gtor gzhong kha sbub la 'gugs pa ni/ na mo dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum gyi bden pa'i stobs kyis gnod byed sdang dgra gdug pa can thams cad gtor gzhong ri rab 'bar ba'i 'og tu khug cig /dza hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sa rang rgya dang bcas bcu bzhi pa rta bro bya ba ni/ hūm̐: bde gshegs rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du: grub thob rgya mtshos bro brdungs pas: ye shes lnga ru lhun gyis grub: mu kha chos 'byung khri rkang du: rdo rje mchu yi bro brdungs pas: rigs drug 'khor ba'i rgyud lam gcod: las mtha' rnam bzhi'i dal dbus su: so so'i phrin las bro brdungs pas: rang rang gzhung bzhin lhun gyis grub: bro yang ye shes chen po'i bro: glu yang ye shes chen po'i glu: gar yang phyag rgya drug gi gar: gdangs kyang ma 'gags rig pa'i sgra: de ltar brda dang rten 'brel gyis: sna tshogs las kun lhun grub shog: oṃ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: sgab 'dre 'byung po thams cad satwaṃ bha ya nan: gtor gzhong kha yar bzed de slob dpon gyis 'bru gtor la/ oṃ 'grub par gyur cig dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: āḥdagyes par gyur cig mchod sprin rgya mtsho mchod: hūm̐ bde bar gyur cig mtha' yas sems can rnams: hrīḥ'agrub par gyur cig bkra shis bde legs stsol:

trām̐ brtan par gyur cig smon lam mthu btsan shog: skabs 'gar tshe 'gugs bya bar mos na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hri ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ ba su sid+dhi na na kha dhi ā yu puṇ+ye sarba bsdus bsdus pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: mkha' mnyam tshe bdag 'od dpag med: chos dbyings nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na shrī bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: lhun grub rigs lnga rdo rje sems: sku lnga dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na shrī bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: rigs 'dus pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: thugs rje ye shes dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na shrī bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: dbyings phyug bde chen mtsho rgyal ma: dbang sgyur stobs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na shrī bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: mtshan brgyad rig 'dzin rje 'bangs tshogs: rmad byung sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na shrī bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: dngos grub kun stsol yi dam lha: thugs rje rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la:

'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na shrī bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: bka' sdod mkha' 'gro chos srung rnams: dam tshig gnyan po'i dkyil 'khor du: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na shrī bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: bskul lo rig 'dzin snying nas bskul: skyed cig thugs dam dbyings nas skyed: bdag cag rig 'dzin sgrub pa por: tshe dang ye shes char chen phob: phyi snod 'byung ba'i tshe bkrag mdangs: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: sgrub rdzas ye shes bdud rtsir bskyil: bkrag dang gzi mdangs ya la la: rig rtsal ye shes stobs skyed la: 'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub par stsol: mda' dar g.yob sgrub rdzas lha nyid dngos su mos par bskyed/ bco lnga pa dngos grub blangs pa ni/ sgrub chen dang sgrub mchod skabs yin na nyin tha ma lta bu las rgyun du mi dgos/ hūm̐: bde mchog ngo bo lhun grub ka dag las: legs rtsal sprul pa'i rnam rol cher ston pa: bder 'dus rig 'dzin rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha: sangs rgyas sku dngos pad 'byung mkha' 'gros bskor: rtsa brgyud bla ma thugs rje'i gter chen po: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag la: tshe chos zas nor gos dang snyan grags stobs: kun la dbang bsgyur 'khor 'bangs mnga' thang rgyas: srid spel longs spyod 'dod pa'i yon tan rnams: skad cig nyid la deng 'dir thob gyur cig: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ha ri ni sa ā yur+dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: dbang bzhi blangs shing dngos grub kyi rdzas la rol/ gsum pa rjes chog la/ dang po mchod bstod ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ

sogs? shab+da pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral ka dag ngo bo nyid: zang thal 'gags med thugs rjes so sor ston: 'gro ba'i don phyir thugs rje sgyu ma'i gar: o rgyan gu ru pad 'byung sku la bstod: bstod par 'os p gnyis pa bshags pa ni/ ma 'byor p sogs yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po bzlas/ gsum pa brtan bzhugs ni/ 'di nas rten sogs spyi ltar bya/ bzhi pa rtag pa'i mtha' bsal ba'i slad du dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mi dmigs par bsdu ba ni/ hoḥ mi dmigs ka dag ngo bo dbyings rig gi: kun gsal rol pa'i cho 'phrul zhi khro'i lha: lhan skyes ye shes gnyug ma'i sbubs su bsdu: bde gsal mi rtog gnas lugs ngo bor āḥ a a āḥ zhes bsdus la slar chad pa'i mu spang ba'i phyir/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes brjod pas skad cig la lha yi skur ldang zhing rjes thob kyi bya ba la 'jug par bya'o/ lnga pa gzhan don du dge rtsa bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐: gdod nas chos dbyings lhun grub ngo bo yang : de don ma rtogs rmongs 'gyu'i sems can rigs: a 'thas zhen pa'i gol lam bsal mdzad phyir: kun rig don gnyis rtogs phyir dge tshogs bsngo:

drug pa smon lam gyi mtshams sbyar ba ni/ hoḥ bla med bder 'dus rgyal ba'i dal bzung nas: mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin rtse gcig gis: ma 'ongs 'di nas rnga yab dpal ri ru: pad 'byung rgyal ba'i sras su 'khrungs par shog: bdun pa bkra shis brjod pa ni/ ye dharmā? chos sku'i bkra shis snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur: gnas lugs rgyal sa zin pa'i bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis drug pa rdo rje 'chang : thugs rje phyogs bcur khyab pa'i bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung : 'gro kun smin grol 'god pa'i bkra shis shog: snyan brgyud bkra shis mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma: zab rgya mkha' ltar brtan pa'i bkra shis shog: smon lam bkra shis bud+dha dz+nyā na ba: lung bstan dus las mi 'da' bkra shis shog: bla ma'i bkra shis rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling : 'gro don phyogs mthar khyab pa'i bkra shis shog: gter gnas bkra shis mchims phu ke'u tshang du: byin chags yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog: zab rgya'i bkra shis zil gnon rig 'dzin 'dus: mkha' ltar mtha' yas kun khyab bkra shis shog: gter srung bkra shis sngags bdag ral gcig ma: phrin las glog ltar myur ba'i bkra shis shog: nyin yang bkra shis mtshan yang bkra shis nas: nyin mtshan rtag tu bkra shis bde legs shog: ces gzhan yang bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ zhes pa'ang lam zab 'di nyid kyi bskyed rdzogs nyams len la rtse gcig tu gzhol ba'i gsang sngags phur pa gling gi lo gsum sgrub sde skabs gnyis pa legs par grub pa'i gtang rag dang 'brel gcung gnam lcags mkhan po ngag dbang dge legs mchog dang e wam̐ sgrub sde zung nas thugs sgrub sgrub chen gsar 'dzugs mdzad pa'i skabs nye bar mkho ba'i cha rkyen dang*/ 'byung gyur yang lam 'di nyid kyi sgo nas rang don bsnyen sgrub dang gzhan don sgrub mchod sgrub chen sogs nyams len dngos gzhi'i mthun gyur rang lugs nyams pa slar gso rgyun skyong rgyur 'gyur ba tsam ma zad deng dus 'dzam gling shar nub kyi mi rigs 'dra min bod kyi skad dang yig rigs la goms 'dris chung ba'i gsar bu rnams 'jug pa bde ba sogs dgos pa du mar mthong ba dang*/

rang slob au ḍī sogs kyis ched bskul byung bar brten/ gter gzhung rtsa ba'i rgyud lung man ngag gi gnad gcus dkrugs gab pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa 'khrugs bsdebs lag len dka' bas cho ga nar 'gros bklag chog pa zhig byung na dge mtshan che bar snyam yang*/ bdag kyang tshul 'di'i mthong rgyun gyi myong ba phra zhing*/ snga rabs kyi zin bris khag la dpyad pas gcig tu nges par ma mthong la gzhan yang deng gi dus rang lugs gsang sngags kyi cho ga bskyed rdzogs snying po'i go don slong ba ni nam mkha'i pad+mo'i zla ru gyur zhing tshig gyer tsam la yang dpyad par mi bzod pa'i chal chol du gyur ba mang zhing phal cher lag len gyi shan du zhugs pa du ma 'dom pa'i rnam dpyod kyi blo rtsal bdag lta bur mi mnga' bas/ des na snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa so zur gnubs gsum gyi phyag bzhes su grags pa'i o rgyan smin grol gling gi phyag srol dang rang lugs rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje'i phyag bzhes chog khrigs rnams phal cher mthun pa snang bas de ga'i 'gros bstun gyi gab bsdebs 'khrugs bsal bcas chu babs kyi tshul du bklags pas grub par bgyis pa'i khul yin yang*/ don du ma 'brel ba dang chad lhag 'gal 'khrul rgyun 'bab kyi gnyer ma bzhin bgrangs kyis mi long ba yod nges pas chos spyan ldan pa rnams dang chos bdag dam can rgya mtsho'i spyan sngar mthol zhing bshags la/ 'di las byung ba'i rnam dkar gyi cha shas cung zad mchis na de'ang pad+ma'i phrin las gnubs lugs zab gter 'di nyid mi nyams dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang*/ 'gro kun smin grol gyi 'bras bu g.yur du za ba'i rgyur gyur cig /ces rab byung bcu bdun pa'i shing pho sprel gyi lor rgyam̐l zla ba'i dmar phyogs rgyam̐l ba dang po dus sbyor pau ṣa'i khyim du res gza' ngan las rgyam̐l dang*/

rgyu dkar gyi bu mo lha skyes dang lhan cig rtse 'jor rol ba'i dus dang*/ lhag tu gsang chen snga 'gyur bstan pa'i mig gcig kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyam̐l po rgyam̐l ba klong chen rab 'byams kyi phyi gsal gzugs sku'i bkod pa nang dbyings gdod ma'i gzhi thog tu bsdus pa'i dus khyad par can la/ rgyam̐l ba gang gi rjes dran mchod sprin du dmigs te ngan lam rgyam̐l ba mchog dbyangs kyi skye srid sgo chen rgyam̐l ba'i sprul ming du sgro btags pa gsang sngags bstan 'dzin gyis bgyis shing yi ge pa yang bskul ba po nyid kyis mdzad pas rgyam̐l ba'i bstan pa srid pa'i rtse mor bsnyegs pa'i rgyam̐l mtshan du gyur cig/ // cha) rig 'dzin srog sgrub yid bzhin nor mchog las: gtor bsngos bsdus pa phrin las myur mgyogs bzhugs so: rig 'dzin rgyal ba kun 'dus tshogs la gus pas 'dud: de yang rig 'dzin 'dus pa rtsa ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyi dkyil 'khor ma lus shing rab 'byams zhing gi rdul snyed rnams gcig tu bsdus nas: tshogs zhing gi mchod pa la 'jug par brtsam na: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis sgrig chog 'di ltar bgyi'o: sa ma ya: thog mar dngos 'byor gyi mchod pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs bkod pa ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs par bgyis nas 'bul: ma 'grigs tshe yid sprul rgyas btab blo dang bstun pa'i 'dun pa bya: oṃ raṃ aḥyaṃ hūm̐ khaṃ sarba swā hā: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ha ho hrī hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung me thod sgyed kyi steng du bh+rūm̐ smug po las byung ba'i thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bh+rūm̐ e dzeṃ kheṃ be ra shu la 'bru brgyad zhu ba las byung ba'i sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur: thod pa'i kha chod nyi zla rdo rje'i yu ba can: steng nyi ma la ā li:

'og zla ba la kā li: bar mu khyud la rten 'brel snying po: rdo rje'i yar gyi rwa lnga la oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mar gyi rwa lnga la mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: bhan+dha'i kha khyer phyogs bzhir dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pa'i yi ge de rnams kyi sgras bskul ba'i rigs lnga yab yum gyis sbyor ba mdzad: sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyi rgyun babs pas dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsi gcig tu 'dres ting nge 'dzin gyi bdud rtsir gyur: thabs kyi rlung g.yos shes rab kyi me sbar bdag 'dzin gyi dri ma sbyangs shing bdud rtsi khol: lbu ba'i rlangs pa las byung ba'i oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs: shab+da rū pa gan+dhe rā sa spar+she lā s+ye mā l+ye gīrti nīrti swa ra swa sti sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta pū dza me gha swā hā: zhes pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyon thams cad gang bar gyur: oṃ hūm̐ a hrīḥtrām̐ bh+rūm̐ mūm̐ lam̐' mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dzaḥha ho hrī phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ de nas mchod cing lha spyan 'dren pa ni/ hoḥ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong nor lha gter bdag gter srung gzhan yang phyi rgyud kyi dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu: sngags bdag dregs chen bco brgyad: bka' yi dregs pa sde brgyad 'jigs byed chen po dgu: yul lha gzhi bdag gnas bdag zo dor dang bcas pa rnams skad cig gis spyan drangs: thugs rje dang smon lam gyi bden pa'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ: tshogs 'khor sogs kyi skabs yin na 'dir tshogs zhus sngon du song bas tshogs bskang ba'i bar chog gzhung ltar 'jug srol mchis/ de nas bha ling+ta bran pa'o:

bdud rtsi yin na mchod: gsur rdzas yin na bsreg: bsgrub gtor yin na mchod kha gso: gtor snod stong gsum tsam gyi 'jig rten bcud kyi skye 'gro 'byung lnga'i dbang du bsdus pa thams cad yi dam lha'i gsol mchod dmigs la 'bul ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum: hūm̐: phyi snod srid gsum yangs pa'i gtor gzhong du: nang bcud 'jig rten bcud kun gtor mar bsgyur: khams gsum 'byung lnga sems can rtsis su gdab: sems kyis ma bzung skye gnas 'jig gsum sogs: zhing rdul brtsegs pa'i grangs med mchod sprin rnams: 'bul byed mchod pa'i lha mo yid 'phrog rigs: nam mkha'i rgyun ltar gang ba'i tshogs rnams kyis: bstod cing bsngags nas btud de 'bul lags na: thugs rje'i brtse bas nyer dgongs bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: kun bzang yab yum ston pa rdo rje sems: rin 'byung snang ba mtha' yas don yod grub: spyan ma mā kī gos dkar dam tshig sgrol: rdo rje 'chang sogs sangs rgyas byang sems la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: gnas lugs chos skur rtogs pa'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: gsang ba ye shes dga' rab rdo rje dang : shrī singha mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang : sa la gnas dang phyag rgya tshe la dbang : lhun grub rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin dang : dgongs brda brgyud kyi slob dpon thams cad la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: 'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: hūm̐ ka ra dang 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang : klu sgrub snying po pra bha hastī dang : dha na saṃ skṛ bi ma mi tra dang : rom+bu gu h+ya shān+tiṃ gar+bha sogs: rig 'dzin grub thob drang srong thams cad la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi:

hūm̐ḥ rtsa ba'i bla ma o rgyan rin po che: man+da ra ba ye shes mtsho rgyal dang : ka la sid+dhi shākya dhe ma dang : bkra shis khye'u 'dren la sogs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: snyan brgyud 'dus pa'i slob dpon thams cad la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: tshe rabs rjes su bzung ba'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐ḥ bya rgyud spyod rgyud rnal 'byor bla med rgyud: dam tshig dbang dang man ngag lung dang ni: shes rab rgyud dang nyams chag bskang ba yi: theg pa 'dzin pa'i slob dpon chen po dang : rje 'bangs nyer lnga lung 'dzin sum cu bdun: bka' bab brgyud 'dzin gter ston brgya rtsa brgyad: dbang lung man ngag brgyud dang brgyud 'gyur pa'i: drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: mi zad gter la spyod pa'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: rdo rje drag po dmar nag me phreng can: 'jam dpal sku dang pad+ma gsung gi lha: yang dag thugs dang che mchog yon tan sku: phrin las phur pa ma mo rbod gtong lha: 'jig rten mchod bstod dmod pa drag sngags pa: ye shes pa dang las su grub pa sogs: sgrub chen bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: mchog thun dngos grub stsol ba'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: dbyings kyi dbang phyug mthing 'od 'bar ma dang : rdo rje phag mo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: rdo rje mkha' 'gro rin chen mkha' 'gro dang : pad+ma mkha' 'gro las kyi mkha' 'gro dang : sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro khros ma nag mo dang : seṅge'i gdong can sna tshogs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas pa la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: rten 'brel phyogs med 'char ba'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha hi: hūm̐: legs ldan nag po phyag bzhi yab yum dang :

ma ning gdong bzhi phyag drug bram ze'i gzugs: srog bdag bya rog gdong can bka' 'khor bcas: ye shes mgon po'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i phrin las mdzod i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: dpal 'bar zhing skyong seng gdong yab yum dang : sprul pa las byed baṃ ro pho mo gnyis: bka' yi 'khor bcas dregs pa sde brgyad bcas: stobs ldan bdud mgon nag po 'khor bcas la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: ma rungs bstan dgra bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: thog 'bebs ljang sngon gza' mchog rā hu la: gza' brgyad gdong mo mched bzhi yab yum dang : skyes bu chen po dam can rdo rje legs: mgar nag sde bzhi mched 'khor sum brgya drug: srog bdag sngags srung e ka dzā ṭi ma: 'dod khams dbang phyug dpal ldan re ma ti: ma mo mched brgyad bse mo khrag ral can: dam can sde gsum 'khor dang bcas pa la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: dam sri log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: a phyi chos sgron ti sgro sman btsun lnga: rdo rje g.yu sgron ma gcig dpal lha mo: bod skyong bstan srung mi sring 'khor bcas la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: phrin las spel ba'i kha 'dzin sdong grogs mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: gnod sbyin chen po btsan rgod me 'od gdong : sprul pa sde bzhi rol pa khrag 'thung bzhi: shan pa rlung sgrub gnod sbyin khyung zhon dang : shan pa dmar nag rol pa bco brgyad dang : dgra srog dbang ba'i btsan rgod 'khor bcas la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: pha rol dgra bo sdig can sgrol bar mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: lha yi dge bsnyen tshangs pa dung thod can:

srog bdag chos skyong chen po dpe dkar dang : sprul pa sde brgyad yang 'khor bye ba 'bum: dge bsnyen chen po klu bdud ti pa tsa: smyo kha mkhar nag ti pa dam 'dzin sogs: drag rtsal ldan pa'i chos skyong 'khor bcas la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: dkor rkun rtsad nas gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: ma hā dhe wa dbang phyug tshogs kyi bdag: rnam mang thos sras nor bdag dzam bha la: ku we ra dang rta bdag gnod sbyin brgyad: phyugs lha ljang gu dpal ldan nor rgyun ma: lug lha gang bzang ra lha gtsang btsan dang : drel lha dud sol 'bru lha brtan ma sman: mdzo lha khyung rgyal khyi lha bya ra ba: nor bdag dkor cha'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: dgos 'dod char ltar 'bebs pa'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: dregs pa sde brgyad dregs chen bco brgyad dang : sde dpon sum cu dge bsnyen nyi shu gcig: 'jigs byed sde dgu dpal mgon bdun cu gnyis: srid pa'i lha dgu mgul lha bcu gsum dang : gter srung sprul pa yang sprul 'khor bcas la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: gsang sngags gnyan gyi bya ra 'grub par mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: lha klu gnod sbyin gzhi bdag zo dor dang : sa bdag chu bdag me bdag rlung bdag dang : nam mkha'i bdag dang rang bzhin 'gyu ba dang : shing spang rdza dang yul chen dur khrod brgyad: gangs gnyan chen po nyi shu rtsa gcig gi: srung ma gnas dang dus su 'gyu ba dang : gtsang ma res sogs 'jig rten skyong rnams la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor 'bul: lo nyes nad 'khrugs zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: gzhan yang 'khor ba myang 'das ma lus kyi: ye shes las dang grub pa'i srung ma dang : dkar phyogs lha dang nag phyogs bdud la sogs:

mgron du 'os kyang dmigs bsal ma mchis pas: rgya mtsho'i srub dang ri rab zom gyi shod: dpag bsam rtse sogs mkha' lding mi ma yin: tshe rabs bsags pa'i bag chags nyer len rigs: dbang po nyams pa glo bur 'gyu ba sogs: kun bzang thugs dang srin bu phra mo'i sems: thams cad chos kyi dbyings su bdal gyur pas: las dang ye shes grub pa'i tshogs rnams la: mnyes pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod gtor bzhes: tshe rabs lan chags byang ba'i phrin las mdzod: i daṃ bha ling+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: lcang lo can gyi bhan+dha'i snod nang du: rtsa gsum gtor ma phrin las bzhi ldan ni: rtse mo nor bu dgos 'dod char bzhin 'bebs: dpung gshog zla gam 'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub: logs gsum chos 'byung ma sring dbang du bsdus: rtsa ba zlum pos nad gdon bar chad zhi: mtha' rnams gru bzhis phrin las sna tshogs 'grub: pad 'dab bzhis brgyan gling bzhi'i 'gro ba 'dul: skyu nyis bzhis bskor sde brgyad dam la gnas: ril bu bzhis bskor phyi rgyud mgron rnams tshim: rtse phran pa tra nor bu'i 'khor lo yis: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams kun tu mchod sprin g.yo: dkar rtsi dmar rtsi gur dang thig phran gyis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam dgyes par bskang : de ltar mthun rdzas gnyan po bha ling gis: chos sku longs sku sprul sku'i thugs dam bskang : dgongs brgyud brda brgyud rig 'dzin thugs dam bskang : snyan brgyud shog ser slob dpon thugs dam bskang : bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : chos skyong dam can nor lha'i thugs dam bskang : gter bdag gter srung rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : rigs drug pha ma lan chags thugs dam bskang : chos sku skye ba med pa'i ngang du bskang : longs sku 'gag pa med pa'i ngang du bskang : sprul sku 'khrul pa med pa'i klong du bskang :

'khor gsum skye 'gag bral ba'i klong du bskang : bskang zhing dam tshig nyams chag thams cad bshags: 'dod rgu dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol ba dang : rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ sarba dharma ya du ta e haṃ shrī gh+raṃ badz+ra bi ma la ye swā hā:

zhes phrin las rgyun chags kyi gtor bsngos bsdus pa 'di nyid rang gzhung gi gtor ma yod na kha gso med na gang 'byor gyi gtor ma bsham: rab stong nyid kyi mchod pa zer ba yin kyang : rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs la dkon mchog la mchod pa dang : nyam thag la sbyin pa btang ba sems bskyed rnams: rnam dag gi dge rtsa yin pas shin tu yang spros pa bya rung : spros bcas spros med gang byas kyang rung 'don brjod rnams kyang med kyang rung : des na dngos rdzas che phra gang 'byor bshams par bya: tshig kha yi 'don don yid la bsgom pa yin pas sgra yang dag par bya: ji bzhin nyams su blangs pas tshogs gnyis smin cing mkha' 'gro chos skyong gis grogs yang dag par bgyid do: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: thig le rgya: kho bo rig pa 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor pa o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos bod yul bsam yas mchims phu'i ke'u tshang nas gdan drangs shing*/ bdud 'dul sngags gling du shog ser nas bshus so/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ dge'o/ ja)rig 'dzin srog sgrub yid bzhin nor bu las: bskang gsol 'dod rgu mchog sbyin rin chen phreng ba bzhugs so: rigs 'dus rgyal sras pad 'byung rje la 'dud: e ma hoḥ skye med rang bzhin chos dbyings rol pa'i rtsal: ma 'gags bde stong ye shes ngo bo nyid: zang thal spros bral rnam mkhyen thugs rje'i gar: stobs bcus skye dgu'i tshogs rnams sgrol mdzad rje: mtshungs med skyabs kyi mchog gyur rgya gar pa: mtsho skyes rdo rje'i zhabs la gus btud nas: bdag 'dra dbyangs can kho mo mtsho rgyal gyis: rje yi bka' bzhin rgyud kyi 'grigs chag rnams: gsang ba brda yi ri mor bgyis nas su: mchims phu'i dge'u gong ke'u tshang du sbas: nang gi gter srung sngags kyi ma mor bcol: phyi yi bka' srung chos skyong lnga la gtad:

ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus kyi tha ma ru: gnubs kyi lo tsā sangs rgyas ye shes dang : ḍāk+ki dhe wa dha ra bcas la sprod: bdud 'gong dam sri dmar pos ma rig rgya: de yang srog sgrub yid bzhin nor bu las: rgyud mchog zab mo rin chen phreng ba yi: dkyil 'khor rdzas dang cha rkyen mthun pa'i rdzas: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa legs par bsham: bag dro lhun chags rgyan ldan ngang nyid du: nyams chag bskang zhing cho ga brtsam par bya: thog mar sgrib bsal bsang sbyang ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: bar du byin rlob yi ge oṃ āḥhūm̐: dngos gzhi las kyi rim par 'jug pa'o: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: bskang rdzas mi gtsang ba'i 'bag btsog shes sgrib thams cad om̐ shud+dhe sho dha na ye swā hā: om̐ āḥhūm̐: phyi snod kyi 'jig rten rang byung lhun gyis grub pa'i gzhal yas khang : nang bcud kyi sems can snang zhing bdag med pa ye nas stong pa'i ngo bo rnams phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can gter bdag rnams mnyes pa'i bskang rdzas sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra a nu ta ra ya taṇ+ṭa me gha ma hā mu ṭa s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye swā hā: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ya shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā bha ling+ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ ma hā māṃ sa sogs? brjod: sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar byin rlabs bya: de nas bskang ba la 'jug pa ni: bskang mchod dang phyi nang mchod pa kha gso: rol mo spos dud btang la dgyes pa'i gdangs kyis 'di ltar bstan par bya'o: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings bde chen pho brang nas: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi spyi mes pa: kun bzang snang mtha' mgon po gshegs su gsol: snang srid klong yangs bha ga'i mkha' la rdzogs:

rgyal ba kun kyang 'byung ba'i yum gcig ma: dbyings phyug ye shes mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: rnga yab dpal ri 'od kyi pho brang nas: sde brgyad dam btags srin po'i kha gnon mdzad: pad+ma 'byung gnas yab yum gshegs su gsol: bde chen dbang drag rol pa'i pho brang nas: che mchog spyi gzugs yi dam he ru kaḥ dbang chen rta phag yab yum gshegs su gsol: rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga'i pho brang nas: shes rab chen pos srid zhi'i mun pa sel: 'jam dpal gzhon nu yab yum gshegs su gsol: shar phyogs ri bo tā la'i pho brang nas: snying rje'i 'od zer 'dzam gling yongs la shar: 'jig rten dbang phyug yab yum gshegs su gsol: byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas: thugs mchog rdo rjes log 'dren ma lus 'joms: phyag na rdo rje yab yum gshegs su gsol: chos dbyings ye shes mthing gsal pho brang nas: gti mug rnam dag ka dag 'od zer 'gyed: bud+dha thod phreng yab yum gshegs su gsol: me long ye shes dkar gsal pho brang nas: zhe sdang rnam dag byams pa'i 'od zer 'gyed: rdo rje thod phreng yab yum gshegs su gsol: mnyam nyid ye shes ser gsal pho brang nas: nga rgyal rnam dag snying rje'i 'od zer 'gyed: rat+na thod phreng yab yum gshegs su gsol: sor rtog ye shes dmar gsal pho brang nas: 'dod chags rnam dag dga' ba'i 'od zer 'gyed: pad+ma thod phreng yab yum gshegs su gsol: bya grub ye shes ljang gsal pho brang nas: phrag dog rnam dag btang snyoms 'od zer 'gyed: karma thod phreng yab yum gshegs su gsol: za hor o rgyan yul gyi pho brang nas: rgya mtshor sku 'khrungs mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sku: pad+ma badz+ra yab yum gshegs su gsol: dur khrod bsil ba tshal gyi gnas mchog tu: sde snod bcu gnyis thugs kyi klong du rdol: gu ru pad+ma saṃ bha gshegs su gsol: rā ga ra ta'i gsang ba'i gnas mchog nas:
