thos bsam sgom gsum mkhyen gnyis nyi zla rgyas: gu ru blo ldan mchog sred gshegs su gsol: dur khrod dga' ba tshal gyi gnas mchog nas: sbyor sgrol spyod pas snang srid dbang du bsdus: gu ru pad+ma rgyal po gshegs su gsol: dur khrod so sa gling gi gnas mchog tu: snang srid kun mkhyen snod bcud sa ler gsal: gu ru nyi ma 'od zer gshegs su gsol: za hor rgyal po'i yul dbus gnas mchog nas: bdud dang mu stegs dam sri dam la btags: gu ru shākya seṅge gshegs su gsol: rgya gar ma gha dha yi gnas mchog nas: mkha' 'gros lung bstan drag sngags phyung rdeg 'debs: gu ru seṅge sgra sgrogs gshegs su gsol: stag tshang seṅge bsam grub gnas mchog tu: dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad dam la btags: gu ru rdo rje gro lod gshegs su gsol: thabs mchog bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas: bskyed pa don rtogs phyi yi tshogs drug bcom: he ru ka pa rigs bzhi gshegs su gsol: shes rab gsang ba mchog gi pho brang nas: rdzogs pa mngon 'gyur ting 'dzin zag med rol: zab spyod mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi gshegs su gsol: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog gi zla 'dzin ma: bcu drug bde ba dga' bzhi spyod pa'i dbyings: gsang ba'i lha mo bcu drug gshegs su gsol: phrin las sna tshogs ma nges pho brang nas: bstan pa'i bya ra gter kha skyong ba'i mchog: dkyil 'khor skyong ba'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas dam bskang phrin las mdzad pa'i phyir: rig 'dzin bdag la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ de nas bskang mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rig 'dzin bde gshegs 'dus pa'i lha tshogs la: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: phyi yi mchod pa tshogs drug lha mo'i gar: nang gi mchod pa bde chen thig le'i bcud: gsang ba'i mchod pa zung 'jug dga' bzhis srub: sbyor ba'i mchod pa phyag rgya drug gi lam:

sgrol ba'i mchod pa dug lnga dbyings su dag: bskang ba'i mchod pa rang byung skye ba med: ye nas rang shar bla med mchod pa 'di: bde gshegs rgyal ba kun 'dus lha la 'bul: bzhes nas 'chi med tshe dbang rig 'dzin dang : mchog thun dngos grub deng 'dir stsal du gsol: oṃ ma hā gu ru dhai wa ḍāk+ki nī sarba sa ma ya bi shwa pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: de nas bskang ba gtong ba ni: hūm̐: dbyings rig mu mtha' bral ba'i pho brang nas: khyab bdag gdod mi mgon po 'od mi 'gyur: kun bzang thog mi mgon po'i thugs dam bskang : ka dag lhun grub kun gzhi mi dmigs ngang : ye grol gnyug mas 'khor 'das kun la khyab: snang mtha' rigs kyi bdag po'i thugs dam bskang : rdo rje'i sku ni g.yo med chos kyi dbyings: rdo rje'i gsung ni 'gags med ru lu'i sgra: rdo rje'i thugs ni 'gyur med ka nas dag: che mchog he ru ka dpal thugs dam bskang : kun gzhi mkha' ltar khyab pa'i dbang mo che: dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas: dbyings phyug kun tu bzang mo'i thugs dam bskang : rnga yab dpal ri 'od kyi pho brang nas: lha srin dam btags gdong dmar thabs kyis 'dul: gu ru pad+ma thod phreng thugs dam bskang : mā ra ti ka gsang ba'i pho brang nas: 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin 'ja' lus brnyes: lha lcam man+da ra ba'i thugs dam bskang : ke'u ri bde chen mchog gi pho brang nas: zag med dga' bzhi bskyed pa'i dbang mo che: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: dbang chen khro bo rol pa'i pho brang nas: gar dgu'i dbang phyug khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ dbang drag rta zhal can gyi thugs dam bskang : gsang ba ye shes dbyings kyi pho brang nas: chags med skyon bral gtum mo rā ga'i mdangs: yum chen rdo rje phag mo'i thugs dam bskang : gnas mchog ri bo rtse lnga'i pho brang nas:

mkhyen gnyis rgyud sde'i lung rigs dkyil 'khor rgyas: dpa' bo 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i thugs dam bskang : dbyings rig sgyu ma 'phrul gyi pho brang nas: dam chos kun gyi 'byung gnas dbang mo che: yum chen shes rab phar phyin thugs dam bskang : gnas mchog ri bo tā la'i pho brang nas: byams pa'i 'od zer snying rjes 'gro la gzigs: 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs dam bskang : lhun grub klong yangs gnyug ma'i pho brang nas: 'gags med rdo rje'i dbyangs snyan rta ring len: rnal 'byor dpa' mo brda 'byin thugs dam bskang : gnas mchog lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas: g.yo med ting 'dzin nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam: gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po'i thugs dam bskang : gnas mchog g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing khams nas: dug lnga rang grol ye shes dbyings su shar: rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: smug nag gti mug rnam dag pho brang nas: thugs rje'i bdag nyid skye med don rtogs phyir: bud+dha thod phreng rtsal gyi thugs dam bskang : dkar gsal zhe sdang rnam dag pho brang nas: sku yi bdag nyid zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad: rdo rje thod phreng rtsal gyi thugs dam bskang : ser gsal nga rgyal rnam dag pho brang nas: yon tan bdag nyid rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzad: rat+na thod phreng rtsal gyi thugs dam bskang : dmar gsal 'dod chags rnam dag pho brang nas: gsung gi bdag nyid dbang gi phrin las mdzad: pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi thugs dam bskang : ljang gsal phrag dog rnam dag pho brang nas: phrin las bdag nyid drag po'i mngon spyod pa: karma thod phreng rtsal gyi thugs dam bskang : nam mkha' rnam dag chos dbyings pho brang nas: sems kyi khams rnams bskyed pa'i las 'dzin ma: sangs rgyas rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : chu khams rnam dag me long pho brang nas: khrag gi khams rnams bskyed pa'i las 'dzin ma: rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang :

sa khams rnam dag mnyam nyid pho brang nas: sha yi khams rnams bskyed pa'i las 'dzin ma: rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : me khams rnam dag sor rtog pho brang nas: drod kyi khams rnams bskyed pa'i las 'dzin ma: pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : rlung khams rnam dag bya grub pho brang nas: dbugs kyi khams rnams bskyed pa'i las 'dzin ma: karma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : rgya mtsho'i klong nas rang byung sprul pa'i sku: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus rdo rje brnyes: gu ru pad+ma yab yum thugs dam bskang : za hor yul byon skye 'gro chos la btsud: yon tan thams cad klong yangs thugs la rdzogs: gu ru pad+ma saṃ bha'i thugs dam bskang : rgya gar gnas chen bzhi la sgrub pa mdzad: 'chad rtsod brtsams pas lung rigs phyogs bcur sgrog: gu ru blo ldan mchog sred thugs dam bskang : rgya gar dur khrod brgyad la brtul zhugs mdzad: sbyor sgrol spyod pas khams gsum dbang du bsdus: gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : so sa gling du 'khor 'das don rdzogs shar: ma rig rmongs pa'i sems can chos la btsud: gu ru nyi ma 'od zer thugs dam bskang : za hor yul du yo ga'i brtan pa thob: rdzogs chen klong gsal snying po mngon du gyur: gu ru shākya seṅge'i thugs dam bskang : ma ga dha ru mu stegs dam la btags: bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro'i rig sngags bka' chen bab: gu ru seṅge sgra sgrogs thugs dam bskang : stag tshang seṅge bsam 'grub ke'u tshang du: dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad dam la btags: gu ru rdo rje gro lod thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: tshad med rnam bzhis 'gro ba thabs kyis 'dul: phrin las bzhi ldan bde stong 'khrul 'khor sgyur: dpa' bo rigs bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : rdzu 'phrul myur mgyogs sna tshogs ci yang ston: las dang ye shes dbang gis 'gro ba 'dul:

ging dang shugs 'gro tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang : gzhan yang ye shes rol pa'i cho 'phrul 'gyed: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong zhing bya ra mdzad: phyi nang las byed 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: rig 'dzin sgrub la 'chi med 'ja' lus stsol: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba kun 'dus lha tshogs la: mnyes pa'i phyi mchod thugs dam bskang ba ni: mdzes pa'i me tog rgyal ba'i dbu la 'bul: lha mo puṣ+pe ma yis thugs dam bskang : dri zhim bdug spos rgyal ba'i shangs la 'bul: lha mo dhū pe ma yis thugs dam bskang : snang gsal mar me rgyal ba'i spyan la 'bul: lha mo ā lo ke yis thugs dam bskang : mchod yon dri chab rgyal ba'i sku la 'bul: lha mo gan+dhe ma yis thugs dam bskang : ro brgya'i zhal zas rgyal ba'i ljags la 'bul: lha mo nai wi d+ye yis thugs dam bskang : rol mo sna tshogs rgyal ba'i snyan la 'bul: lha mo shab+da ma yis thugs dam bskang : gzugs kyi me long snang stong lha la 'bul: lha mo rū pa ma yis thugs dam bskang : sgra yi pi waṃ grags stong lha la 'bul: lha mo gīrti ma yis thugs dam bskang : dri yi dung zhal bde stong lha la 'bul: lha mo gan+dhe ma yis thugs dam bskang : ro yi longs spyod myong stong lha la 'bul: lha mo rā sa ma yis thugs dam bskang : reg bya sna tshogs rgyal ba'i sku la 'bul: lha mo spar+she ma yis thugs dam bskang : phyi yi mchod pas thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐: nang gi mchod pas thugs dam bskang ba ni: bhan+dha lcang lo sil bur 'phyang ba'i nang : sha lnga dri mchog lnga dang 'bras bu lnga: sman lnga rdzas lnga la sogs sbyar ba 'di: rig 'dzin rgyal ba kun 'dus lha la 'bul: pañca a mṛ ta yis thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: rak+ta'i mchod pas thugs dam bskang ba ni: thod pa bum ril skra yi ba dan can:

'khyil zhing zla gam zlum po de yi nang : ma hā rak+ta pad+ma rak+ta dang : mu la rak+ta gu h+ya rak+ta dang : an+dza rak+ta du na rak+ta dang : 'bri mog rgya skag la sogs 'byung ba'i khrag: mdangs ldan g.yo ba dmar chen rgya mtsho 'di: rig 'dzin rgyal ba kun 'dus lha la 'bul: ma hā rak+ta bi shwas thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: gtor ma'i mchod pas thugs dam bskang ba ni: rin chen las byung snod mchog yangs pa'i nang : 'bru mchog sna tshogs sbyar ba'i phye ma la: sbrang dang bu ram ka ra bcud kyi rigs: gzhan yang mngar gsum lan tsha du ma'i ro: bcud dang sbrags pa'i longs spyod rmad byung rdzas: zag med tshogs kyi gtor ma rgya chen la: sha sna snying sna dmar gyi bye brag dang : rgun 'brum nyi khri co le yags pa kaḥ kham bu star ga ku shu bil wa ra: ri sgog rlung sgog sha mong sna tshogs rigs: se'u 'bru dang bcas sga dang la la phud: zla rgyas zho dang zla phrom mar dang thud: myos pa'i ngad ldan bdud rtsi su ra chang : gzhan yang kha dang mngar dang skyur ba'i ro: gtor mchod tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen 'di: rig 'dzin rgyal ba kun 'dus lha la 'bul: ga ṇa tsakra pū dzas thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: sna tshogs spyan gzigs mchod cing bskang ba ni: rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang 'od khyim 'khyud: phyi nang bkod pa yid mtshar rgyan gyis spras: gdugs dang ba dan bla re 'phan rtse gsum: phye ma'i phur ma rin chen drwa ba bres: dar dpyangs cod pan sna tshogs pu ru ru: khor yug gang ba lha mos mchod sprin thogs: lha yi dung dang lha yi rnga bo che: lha yi cha lang lha yi dung bu bhi: lha yi shang kha pi waṃ gling bu sogs: gzhan yang sna tshogs yid 'thad maṇ+ḍal ni: gser ri rol mtsho lus 'phags 'dzam bu gling : ba lang spyod dang sgra mi snyan rnams su: 'khod pa'i rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun dang : bkra shis rtags brgyad dang ni dpag bsam shing : 'dod 'jo'i ba dang ma rmos lo thog dang :

lha yi bdud rtsi lha yi yug gos sogs: gter gyi bum pa sna tshogs 'dod 'byung can: nyi zla gza' skar dbyings kyi spyan gzigs bcas: snod bcud 'di ru nye bar mkho ba yi: 'byung lnga'i dwangs ma skyed mos tshal chen dang : 'khod cing bkod dang nye bar 'tshogs pa'i tshogs: rig 'dzin rgyal ba kun 'dus lha la 'bul: puts+tsha bi shwa me ghas thugs dam bskang : rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐: ye nas ka dag sangs rgyas phyir: snang ba mtha' yas thugs dam bskang : ma 'gags longs sku'i rtsal ston phyir: rdo rje 'chang chen thugs dam bskang : snang srid klong la rdzogs pa'i phyir: rdo rje snyems ma'i thugs dam bskang : sprul sku'i 'gro don mdzad pa'i phyir: pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs dam bskang : tshe yi rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i phyir: man+da ra ba'i thugs dam bskang : mchog gi bde ba ster ba'i phyir: mkhar chen mtsho rgyal thugs dam bskang : yi dam rtsa ba brtan pa'i phyir: dbang chen rta mgrin thugs dam bskang : rtog med brda yi sgra sgrogs phyir: rdo rje phag mo'i thugs dam bskang : gzhon nu sku lus 'chang ba'i phyir: 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi thugs dam bskang : dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i phyir: yum chen sher phyin thugs dam bskang : snying rjes 'gro la skyob pa'i phyir: spyan ras gzigs ky-i thugs dam bskang : gsung gi snyan brgyud ston pa'i phyir: rnal 'byor brda 'byin thugs dam bskang : mthu stobs gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir: phyag na rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang : 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa skyob pa'i phyir: rje btsun sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: gti mug dbyings su 'dag pa'i phyir: bud+dha thod phreng thugs dam bskang : zhe sdang dbyings su 'dag pa'i phyir: rdo rje thod phreng thugs dam bskang : nga rgyal dbyings su dag pa'i phyir: rat+na thod phreng thugs dam bskang :

'dod chags dbyings su 'dag pa'i phyir: pad+ma thod phreng thugs dam bskang : phrag dog dbyings su 'dag pa'i phyir: karma thod phreng thugs dam bskang : nam mkha'i khams rnams gnas dag pa'i: dbyings phyug dkar mo'i thugs dam bskang : sa yi khams rnams gnas dag pa'i: ser mo rgyas pa'i thugs dam bskang : chu yi khams rnams gnas dag pa'i: sngon mo spyod ldan thugs dam bskang : me yi khams rnams gnas dag pa'i: dmar mo brda 'byin thugs dam bskang : rlung gi khams rnams gnas dag pa'i: sna tshogs dga' byed thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: skye 'chi gnyis spangs rdo rje'i sku: pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs dam bskang : lung rigs rgyud sde'i nyi ma shar: blo ldan mchog sred thugs dam bskang : rdzu 'phrul drwa bas snang srid mkhyen: nyi ma 'od zer thugs dam bskang : mu stegs bdud kyi bstan pa bsnubs: seṅge sgra sgrogs thugs dam bskang : bla med a ti'i brtan pa thob: pad+ma saṃ bha'i thugs dam bskang : sbyor sgrol spyod pas 'gro ba sdud: pad+ma rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : bden bzhi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: shākya seṅge'i thugs dam bskang : bdud btul lha srin dam la btags: rdo rje gro lod thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: dngos 'dzin stong pa'i dur khrod nas: badz+ra dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskang : rnam rtog zhig pa'i dur khrod nas: rat+na dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskang : 'gog lam 'thor ba'i dur khrod nas: pad+ma dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskang : 'khri ba chod pa'i dur khrod nas: karma dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskang : kun tu rgyu ba'i dur khrod nas: rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : rnam par rgyu ba'i dur khrod nas: rin chen mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : nges par rgyu ba'i dur khrod nas: pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : rab tu rgyu ba'i dur khrod nas: las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : tshogs drug mtha' bral dur khrod nas:

lha mo bcu drug thugs dam bskang : gnas yul drag rgyu'i dur khrod nas: dbyings phyug lha mo'i thugs dam bskang : 'phro 'dus sa mtshams dur khrod nas: zhing skyong pho mo'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: dam nyams zas su za ba'i phyir: srin po pho mo'i thugs dam bskang : mtshan mo dur khrod 'grim pa'i phyir: gnas nyul pho mo'i thugs dam bskang : sprul pa phyogs bcur khyab pa'i phyir: mu ran skyong ba'i thugs dam bskang : las byed bya ra byed pa'i phyir: sprul 'khor nyid sprul thugs dam bskang : rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bdag gi g.yar dam sor chud de: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i phyir: dbang po'i me tog sna tshogs 'di: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i rten phyir 'bul: sha chen gsur gyi dud pa 'di: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i rten phyir 'bul: tshil chen snang gsal mar me 'di: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i rten phyir 'bul: rak+ta dmar chen sbreng ba 'di: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i rten phyir 'bul: ga ṇa tshogs kyi longs spyod 'di: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i rten phyir 'bul: thod pa ltag sprod rnga sgra 'di: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i rten phyir 'bul: rkang chen dung gi gling bu 'di: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i rten phyir 'bul: g.yang gzhi mkha' la bres pa 'di: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i rten phyir 'bul: dur khrod rdzas chen bkram pa 'di: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i rten phyir 'bul: mda' dar me long brgyan pa 'di: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i rten phyir 'bul: rus pa'i rgyan chas du ma 'di: ma dang mkha' 'gro'i rten phyir 'bul: mchod pa bzhes nas thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: dzā lan+dha ra'i dur khrod nas: bde chen rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma: dkar mo 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : lam bha ka li dur khrod nas: dri med pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma: dmar mo 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : kan ṭa tsit+ta'i dur khrod nas: bud+dha rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma:

sngon mo 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : tri sha ku na'i dur khrod nas: dga' byed rin chen mkha' 'gro ma: ser mo 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : tshan+dho ha yi dur khrod nas: sna tshogs las kyi mkha' 'gro ma: ljang mo 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : pul+lī ma yi dur khrod nas: rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: dkar nag 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : ka liṅka yi dur khrod nas: pad+ma rigs kyi shugs 'gro 'bum: dmar nag 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : o ṭi ya yi dur khrod nas: bud+dha rigs kyi shugs 'gro 'bum: mthing nag 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : kā ma ru yi dur khrod nas: rin chen rigs kyi shugs 'gro ma: ljang nag 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : nā ga ra yi dur khrod nas: sna tshogs rigs kyi shugs 'gro ma: smug mo 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : ma ro raṣ+ṭa'i dur khrod nas: sha za khrag 'thung shugs 'gro ma: nag mo 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : ma rgyud thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: sgrub pa'i dam tshig nyams pa gso: bka' chad 'khu ldog zhi ba dang : mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: nyams chag thams cad bskang gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: hūm̐: bskang du med de skye med ngang du bskang : mchod du med de gnyis med dgyes pas mchod: sbyor du med de zung 'jug rol par sbyor: sgrol du med de ye shes chen pos sgrol: bshags su med de ye sgrol chen por bshags: 'khor gsum yongs dag 'bras bu stsal du gsol:

bdun pa bshags pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: rtsa gsum kun 'dus lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag cag dkyil 'khor zab mo'i sgor zhugs nas: bag med dbang gyur dam 'gal ci mchis pa: mthol bshags bzod gsol mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: oṃ gu ru sa twa sa ma ya: gu ru sa twa twe no pa: sogs?brjod nas bshags pa bya ba ni: hoḥ 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas: kun bzang snang mtha' gsang ba rnal 'byor ma: dga' rab rdo rje 'jam dpal bshes gnyen pa: shrī singha rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung : man+da ra ba ye shes mtsho rgyal ma: dbang chen rta mchog rdo rje phag mo yum: 'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs: bo dhi sa twa khri srong lde'u btsan: sangs rgyas ye shes dpal gyi seṅge sogs: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dgongs su gsol: khyad par phyogs bcu'i zhing du bzhugs pa yi: rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus dgongs su gsol: bdag ni byang chub snying po'i lam zhugs nas: so sor thar dang byang chub bslab pa dang : byams dang brtse ba shes rab snying rje sogs: sngon 'gro khas blangs 'bog pa'i dam tshig la: 'gal ba ci mchis thams cad mthol lo bshags: gsang sngags zab lam gnyan gyi dkyil 'khor gyi: lha sgom sngags bzlas phyag rgya'i rtags 'chang nas: bskyed pa ma gsal bzlas pa grangs nyung dang : phyag rgya chad cing rgya rtags bral ba dang : lung yod chog bsam bag med mchis pa rnams: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mdun du mthol lo bshags: gnas lugs ting nge 'dzin gyi sgor zhugs nas: lta ba phyogs 'dzin sgom pa blos gzhigs dang : spyod pa tho co g.yo sgyu'i byed las dang : mtshan ma'i mnyam bzhag rnam rtog rjes thob dang : bdag 'dzin spang gnyan phyogs su shor ba sogs: 'gog lam 'khri ba'i rgyur gyur ci mchis pa: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i lha la mthol lo bshags: gnas lugs snying po nges pa'i don rtogs nas: gzhi thog khregs chod gshis su ma pheb dang :

lam gyi ci snang sgyu mar ma spyad cing : 'bras bu yang dag brtan pa ma thob nas: ngo bo skye med stong par 'dzin pa dang : rang bzhin gsal ba dngos por 'dzin pa dang : thugs rje byed las ma ning nyer len mchis: bde ba'i cha la nyams su zhen nas gol: gsal stong zung 'jug lhug bzhag mi shes shing : mi rtog ting 'dzin a 'thas mthong ba sogs: yang dag snying po'i rgyud dang ci 'gal ba: rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha tshogs spyan sngar bshags: gzhan yang mi spang lnga yi dam tshig la: zhe sdang me long ye shes ma rtogs nas: pha ma rigs drug rnams la 'khon pa bshags: nga rgyal mnyam nyid ye shes ma rtogs nas: khong khro tshig rtsub smra ba mthol lo bshags: 'dod chags sor rtog ye shes ma rtogs nas: chos brgyad las la chags pa mthol lo bshags: phrag dog bya grub ye shes ma rtogs nas: ko long ru nga bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: gti mug chos dbyings ye shes ma rtogs nas: ma rig 'khor bar 'khyams pa mthol lo bshags: rang lus dkyil 'khor bkod pa ma mthong nas: mtshan ma'i gzhal yas bsgoms pa mthol lo bshags: rang rig rtsa ba'i lha ru ma rtogs nas: yi dam gzhan du bzung ba mthol lo bshags: rlung lnga rdo rje'i sngags su ma shes nas: rtsol bcas sgra zur bzung ba mthol lo bshags: gdod nas rang sems chos skur ma mthong nas: sangs rgyas gzhan nas btsal ba mthol lo bshags: longs spyod lha yi tshogs 'khor ma shes nas: ser snas 'dzin chags bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: rgyan gos lha yi cod pan ma shes nas: kha dog spangs blangs bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: gzhan yang gsang ba chen po'i dam tshig la: sgrub pa'i tshe na rten rdzas chad pa dang : bskang ba'i tshe na spyan gzigs dor ba dang : dam tshig bhan+dha gzhan la bstan pa dang : mchod pa'i tshogs gtor yo byad phud lhag 'dres: rtag tu dus kyi mchod pa lo zla 'das: dkyil 'khor dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: phyag rgya dam med g.yel mo bsten pa dang :

sbyor ba'i tshe na phyag rgya gnad ma chun: 'bebs ldog 'dren bkram gnad du mi khel zhing : bag med 'dod sred gzhan dbang chang gis myos: chags pa'i rgyas 'debs ye shes ma bsgoms sogs: zung 'jug lus kyi 'khor lo nyams pa bshags: bsgral ba zhe sdang las kyi mtshon btab pas: gzhan phan kun slong khyad du bsad pa dang : dge 'dun zur za'i ched du dam tshig bsad: gti mug dbang gis snying rje ma bsgoms shing : 'dod chags dbang gis sha khrag spyod la dga': phrag dog dbang gis tshe lung ma bgyis te: bsgral ba'i rnam shes zhing du ma spar nas: mu stegs spyod par song ba mthol lo bshags: hūm̐: gzhan yang las ngan rgyu bsags 'gal ba'i rigs: sku yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: yan lag dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: sdom pa spyi dang 'gal ba mthol lo bshags: bka' lung dbang dang mi ldan mthol lo bshags: dam tshig snod dang mi ldan mthol lo bshags: bskyed rim so sor ma gsal mthol lo bshags: rdzogs rim dgongs pa ma rtogs mthol lo bshags: bzlas brjod grangs rtags ma thon mthol lo bshags: mthol lo bshags so bla ma yi dam lha: gnong ngo 'gyod do mkha' 'gro dam can bcas: mi sgrib tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra sa tw ma nu pā l sa twa āḥ yi ge brgya pa dang : gu ru sa twa sogs rigs lnga'i yig brgya sbyar: khyad par bshags pa bya ba'i tshe 'gyod tshang gis smre sngags dang bcas bshags pa phul: de yang rtsa ba yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa rnams: rang gi bla ma rdo rje slob dpon: dkyil 'khor gyi rig ma sras yod na rab med na rdo rje mched lcam dam tshig can de yang ma 'grigs na: rje btsun pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sku'am: dkyil 'khor byin ldan khyad par can gyi mdun du bshags pa bya: bye brag dam tshig nyams pa la gnyis te:

'dul ba phyi yi bslab pa khas blangs dkyil 'khor dam tshig la 'gal na: rdza yi be'u chag pa bzhin du gso ba'i thabs med: gsang sngags sdom pa nyams na slar gso thabs yod: dper na gser dngul zangs lcags rin po che'i snod chag na: slar bzo mgar gyis rgyas btab pas rang sar log ste bcud gang gtams pa'i snod du 'gyur: bshags su med pa'i las ni: phyi bslab pa rgyud sde'i chos la mkhas pa: nang gnas lugs rdzogs pa chen po don yang mngon du gyur pa: gsang ba man ngag zab mo'i lam 'byong zhing rig pa klong las brdol ba: rgyud ma nyams shing gsang sngags zab mo'i gter gyi bka' bab pa: rgyal ba'i bka' la phog 'phags pa'i lung gis zin: rgyud lung spyi yi dgongs bzhes thams cad chu phran rnams rgya mtsho'i klong du 'dus pa bzhin du dril ba'i: sum ldan gyi bla ma dam pa de'i bka' dang 'gal na slar gso ba'i rgyu ma mchis: na rag rdo rje dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur ro: 'on kyang bshags pa 'gyod tshang drag po'i phan par rgyud sde nas bshad: des na chos thams cad ngo bo gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig dang ma 'gal ba gtso che: khyad par dus snyigs ma lnga brgya'i tha ma la thug pa'i tshe: chos brgyud lung nges don mi 'dod: man ngag mthu gtad 'dod: bla ma mi 'dod gdams ngag rku thabs 'dod: slob mas rdor slob mi 'dod phyag len 'dod: yi dam gyi sgrub pa mi 'dod: thugs rje dang nus pa 'dod: snying rus kyi sgrub tshugs mi 'dod grub rtags 'dod: rgyu 'bras kyi srung sdom mi 'dod thar lam 'dod: yon tan gyi sbyong ba mi 'dod bshad pa 'dod: chos kyi che ba mi 'dod byin rlabs dam rdzas 'dod: slob dpon smad nas rang gi che ba 'don: yi dam gyi srog 'khor bor nas: rdzas ni rwa co'i par ru lus la 'chang : dam tshig rdo rje gsum gyi rgya rtags med pa la: khro dang gri lcags sogs gang 'thad kyi phur pa sked la bcug:

ma bcos he ru ka'i brtul zhugs ma mthong bar skra ring bzhag: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i 'gyu lam ngo ma shes par brang la me long btags: mgo la sngags skra bzhag nas lus la btsun chas bzung : rkub la dor ma gyon la sdom pa bla ma la zhu: 'jig rten gyi gzhi nag bzung ba lta bu bya: dbang rtags spyi bor brgyan pa'i dam bca' rdo rje slob dpon la zhu: tha mal khyi phag 'dra ba'i nag mo'i gos lag sngas kha ru bcug: kha nas gtam bzang po bshad: gsang sngags kha 'byams bon ltar gyer: gdams pa'i gnad bdun slob dpon la mi bsten par lag len brtsam: dug sbrul kha chus smyos pa lta bur stong skad 'don: zog po la kun gyis dad pa byed: chos tshul bzhin byed pa rnams log par mthong zhing skyon du lta: mi khas sdang bar chad dang rkyen ngan na tsha mod longs spyod dbul: mi yi khyu la mi tshud: dam sri bdud kyi rigs rnams dbugs dbyung la gzengs bstod: thor cog bzhin gtsug tu khur: kun gyis mi dge ba bcu spyod pa rnams kyi phyir 'brang : gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la gshe zhing skur pa 'debs: pho yi dbang las mo kha btsan: bud med dang mu stegs rnams kyis khrims skad 'don: chos khrims kyi bstan pa yur ba'i mjug ltar dma': bdud mo gson 'dre ma rnams kyis lung pa khengs: mi thams cad de yi dbang du byed: nag po bdud kyi dmag tshogs rdza rgyud kyi sprin phung ltar g.yo: chos rnams smad pas thams cad bdud kyi dbang du 'gro: bden pa smad: rdzun ma bstod: bka' log dang khrims ral gyis lung pa khengs: rku 'phrog dang ar jag gis ri lung gang zhing lam mi thob: rje dang che btsun thams cad dug gis gsod: lha srin 'khrugs pas skyes pa thams cad gri khar 'chi: 'byung ba lnga yi sa bcud thams cad nyams pas lo thog dkar gzhon dkon: ri lung med par 'byung po'i mkhar brdung : girti nag po'i sprul pas phyogs nas dmag chen g.yo:

dus de 'dra'i skabs su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mtha' la thug: sems can las ngan spyad pa'i dbang gis bsod nams zad: mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen med pas ngan song drug tu yun ring por skyes nas duḥkha myong : ngan 'gro'i dong du lhung bas bde ba dang thar pa thob pa'i dus mi 'byung : de bas mig can ha re lta ba rnams kyis gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas: dam tshig bsrung ba gnad che: dus de 'dra'i skabs su gsang sngags nyams su len pa re re tsam las mi 'byung : gal srid byung na sngar las 'gyur khyad par che: 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'i rnal 'byor pa: rje btsun pad+ma 'byung gnas la 'di phyi re ltos mos pa rnams kyis: bla ma sku gsum gyi gsol 'debs dang sgrub pa: khyad par tshes bcu nya stong nyer lnga bcas dus bzhi'i mchod pa: tshogs bskang bshags pa rnams nan tan bya ba gtso che: de'i thugs bskyed bla na med pas: rgyu bsod nams chen pos tshogs rdzogs: 'bras bu 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs mthar thug ma hā gu ru'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro: de nas blo dkon mchog gsum la gtad mos na: snying gtam bdud dang 'gong po la mi bshad pa yon tan che: rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa 'di gzu bor bzhag pa dang : mthar thug gi bde 'gro rnyed pa the tshom med do: sa ma ya: e ma rje yi bka' stsal gsung gi bdud rtsi'i bcud: zhum pa med pa'i thugs kyi bum par gtams: ye shes chen po pad+ma'i rtsal las bkral: nyi zla mi snang rin chen 'od po che: nor bu rin chen 'bar ba dgos 'byung 'di: ma 'ongs don du mtsho rgyal bdag gis bkod: skal ldan las can smin pa'i rten du bzhag: yang mtha' thugs sras sangs rgyas ye shes kyi: sprul pa rim byon rtsa gsum gling la sprod: gter gnas bod yul dbus kyi gnas mchog ni: mchims phu dpal gyi dge'u gong-i atsha rgya:

gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa khyi lor bod yul rdo rje gdan gyi gnas mchog bsam yas mchims phu'i dge'u gong ke'u tshang nas gdan drangs shing me rta lor bdud 'dul gsang sngags gling gi gzim chung bde chen yang rtse ru shog ser nas bod yig tu zhal bshus so// // nya)bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: gshin po rjes 'dzin mkha' spyod zab lam bzhugs so: rigs lnga'i gtso bo mgon po 'od mi 'gyur: bde gshegs sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon du gyur: thugs rje'i spyan gyis gdul bya'i zhing du gzigs: rtsa gsum ma hā gu ru'i sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: de yang bde chen zhing sgrub kyi cha lag gshin don bag chags sreg par bya ba'i thabs te: de la khrus bum dang mchod pa'i bye brag tshogs kyi yo byad: mchod pa rnams bcas gzhan yang sbyang chas cha tshang : 'dod yon sna tshogs rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan: rigs drug gi sa bon: sngon 'gro'i bgegs gtor la changs bu mar me bcas snod gcig tu bzhag: byang bu'i gnas su rigs drug gi sa bon bkod: pad+ma'i gdan dang snyug ma tshigs drug byang gos gdan bcas legs par bkod nas: rang nyid ma hā gu ru dus gsum sangs rgyas su bskyed mdun du dmigs yul bkod: oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyang : stong pa'i ngang las: rang nyid skad cig gis rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru thod phreng rtsal du gsal ba'i mdun du: gdan pad+ma'i steng du tshe las 'das pa'i cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ mo'i phung po khams dang skye mched rnam shes thams cad gsal zhing yongs su rdzogs par gyur: oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐ dza dzaḥ dang po tshe 'das rnam shes 'gugs pa ni: na mo: sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang : chos kyi bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bdain pa dang : snying po sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin rnams kyi bden pa dang :

bcom ldan 'das mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dang byang sems rnams kyi bden pa dang : khyad par 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje'i bdag nyid rig 'dzin thod phreng sde lnga la sogs pa'i bden pa dang : bden pa chen po'i mthus 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol du 'phos shing tshe dus las 'das pa'i rnam par shes pa srid pa rigs drug gang du gnas kyang skad cig gis rten 'di la mchis par gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dza dzaḥ zhes lan gsum gyis rten la bkug: hoḥ 'jig rten 'di nas 'phos shing pha rol du song ba chaig mo khyod deng 'dir dkyil 'khor zab mo'i sgor zhugs te tshe rabs nas las dang nyon mongs pa'i duḥkha sbyang ba la mos gus dang gdung ba drag po'i shugs skyed cig: de nas zhing khams bkod pa ni: hoḥ tshe las 'das pa'i snang yul mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su zhing khams bkod pa 'di bzhin gsal thob: de yang dbus su seṅge'i khri dang pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la thog ma'i sangs rgyas mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba: mdun du spyan ras gzigs: shar du rdo rje sems dpa': lhor rin chen 'byung ldan: nub tu snang ba mtha' yas: byang du don yod grub pa ste: thams cad kyang yab yum zung 'jug gi sku 'od kyi rang bzhin du 'bar bar mos mdzod/

bdag nyid kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis rigs lnga drug pa'i bdag nyid spyan drangs te: tshe las 'das pa chaig mo' ི mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen du bzhugs par gyur: oṃ badz+ra pad+ma dha ra ā wa lo ki te badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma pañca ku la badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag: chu yi lhag ma yar lud pa las: 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra pad+ma dha ra ā wa lo ki te badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: zhes mchod pa 'bul: hūm̐: bde gshegs gtso bo mgon po 'od mi 'gyur: rang bzhin 'jig rten dbang phyug drug pa'i bdag: rgyal sras byang sems tshogs dang bcas pa la: bde chen dag zhing bgrod phyir phyag bgyi'o: zhes bstod la de nas gshed dang phral ba ni: na mo sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang : chos kyi bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang : rdo rje dang : rin chen dang : pad+ma dang : las kyi rigs su gyur pa dang : snying po dang : phyag rgya ting 'dzin rnams kyi? khyad par 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje'i bdag nyid rig 'dzin thod phreng sde lnga la sogs pa'i bden pa dang : bden pa chen po'i mthus 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu song ba chaig mo la gson gyi dus su tshe srog la bar du gcod pa: gshin gyi dus su sgrib pa sbyong ba la bar du gcod cing : gnyen 'brel gyi chas su zhugs nas ngan song du 'khrid pa'i gshed ma byed pa: gnas skabs su gson po nye 'brel rnams la 'tshe bar byed pa thams cad lan chags gtor ma len pa'i ched du 'dir mchis par gyur cig: om̐ badz+ra ṭāk+ki rā dza hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes lan gsum gyis 'gugs: hūm̐: nyon cig log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs: gson la bdud dang gshin la lcags: mtho ris bde 'gro'i bgegs byed rnams:

gtor chu changs bu mar me dang : 'dod yon glud gtor 'di khyer la: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: ci ste 'tshe zhing sdang ba dang : tshe 'das thar pa'i bgegs byed na: rab tu gzhom par gdon mi za: hūm̐: ye shes 'bar ba me yi tshwa tshwa g.yo: sdang mig nyi zla ltar bgrad glog ltar 'khyugs: 'debs pa'i phyag mtshan rdo rje'i mtshon char gdengs: de bas so so rang rang gnas su dengs: nyon mongs bdud dang 'byung po rab tu gzhom: om̐ badz+ra kro ta he kā la kro ti li hūm̐ gnod byed 'byung po thams cad mā ra ya phaṭḥ om̐ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye swā hā: de nas rten khrus gsol ba ni: hūm̐: ye shes sku lnga lhun grub bum pa ru: rnam dag dam tshig chu bo drug gis bkang : deng 'dir rgyal ba'i sku la khrus 'bul na: tshe 'das sgrib gnyis bag chags sbyangs nas ni: tshogs gnyis 'bras bu yongs su smin gyur cig: om̐ sarba ta thā ga ta ā bhi ṣai ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: ye shes sku la skye 'chi mi mnga' yang : tshe 'das dag zhing pad+mor skye ba'i phyir: rgyal ba'i sku la khrus chab 'di 'bul bas: tshe 'das lus kyi sgrib pa dag gyur cig: om̐ na ma sarba thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: ye shes gsung la 'gags med sgra ldan yang : tshe 'das gsung dbyangs drug cu 'thob pa'i phyir: rgyal ba'i gsung la khrus chab 'di phul bas: tshe 'das ngag gi sgrib pa dag gyur cig: om̐ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: ye shes thugs la ka dag sgrib bral yang : tshe 'das rang rig ye shes don rtogs phyir: rgyal ba'i thugs la khrus chab 'di phul bas: tshe 'das yid kyi sgrib pa dag gyur cig: om̐ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: ye shes yon tan phrin las gzhan med kyang : tshe 'das dug lnga dbyings su dag pa'i phyir:

yon tan phrin las khrus chab 'di phul bas: tshe 'das tha mal sgrib pa dag gyur cig: om̐ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: sku phyi ba ni: hūm̐: gtsang zhing dge ba rlung g.yab las byung bas: ma dag 'khrul ba dag par byi dor zhing : ku shas sa bon bgyid la sman spos byug: dri med pañca li kas sku phyi'o: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥsarba bi shud+dhe bi sho dha ya swā hā: de nas rigs lnga'i spyi khrus ni: hūm̐: 'di ni me long ye shes chu: tshe 'das khyod la khrus bgyid pas: zhe sdang sgrib pa dag gyur nas: dmyal ba'i sa bon stong gyur cig: om̐ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: tshe las 'das pa'i zhe sdang gi sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig: om̐ badz+ra ma hā duḥkha bi sho dha na ye swā hā: hūm̐: 'di ni sor rtog ye shes chu: tshe 'das khyod la khrus bgyis pas: 'dod chags sgrib pa dag gyur nas: yi dwags sa bon stong gyur cig: om̐ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ tshe las 'das pa'i 'dod chags kyi sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig: om̐ pad+ma pre ta rā ga pre bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: hūm̐: 'di ni chos dbyings ye shes chu: tshe 'das khyod la khrus bgyis pas: gti mug sgrib pa dag gyur nas: byol song sa bon stong gyur cig: om̐ bā+ai ro tsa na hūm̐: tshe las 'das pa'i gti mug gi sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig: om̐ bud+dha pā paṃ tir+ya ka su bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: hūm̐: 'di ni bla med ye shes chu: tshe 'das khyod la khrus bgyis pas: las kyi sgrib pa dag gyur nas: bag chags sa bon stong gyur cig: om̐ gu ru pad+ma dha ra hrī: tshe las 'das pa'i mir skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig: om̐ dharma rā ga he sha ni bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: hūm̐: 'di ni bya grub ye shes chu: tshe 'das khyod la khrus bgyis pas:

phrag dog sgrib pa dag gyur nas: lha min sa bon stong gyur cig: om̐ āḥyo gha hūm̐: tshe las 'das pa'i phrag dog gi sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig: om̐ karma a ri sha tri ta tri bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: hūm̐: 'di ni mnyam nyid ye shes chu: tshe 'das khyod la khrus bgyis pas: nga rgyal sgrib pa dag gyur nas: lha yi sa bon stong gyur cig: om̐ rat+na sam+bha wa trām̐ hūm̐: tshe las 'das pa'i nga rgyal gyi sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig: om̐ rat+na aṇ+ḍa kha a bi sho dha na ye swā hā: hūm̐: 'di ni pha rol phyin drug chu: tshe 'das khyod la khrus bgyis pas: rnam shes tshogs drug gnas dag nas: rigs drug skye ba'i sgo chod cig: oṃ dā na shrī la kan+ti nid+ya sa ma dhi pra dz+nyā ye swā hā: tshe las 'das pa rigs drug gi sdug bsngal las grol te pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi go 'phang thob par gyur cig: om̐ sarba pā paṃ bi shwa dha ye kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: de nas dbang bskur ba ni: chab blang khrus stsal lha bskyed la: hūm̐: ye shes lnga yi gzhal yas bum pa yis: de ring tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: lus ngag yid gsum las nyon kun byang nas: rnam dag zhing du skye bar mdzad du gsol: om̐ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma gu ru bud+dha sarba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: dkyil 'khor la mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: gzugs kyi lha mo'i me long 'dzin: dkyil 'khor lha yi spyan la 'bul: snang stong mchod pas dgyes gyur cig: tshe 'das bla med thob par shog: om̐ rū pa pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: hūm̐: sgra yi lha mos pi waṃ 'dzin: dkyil 'khor lha yi snyan la 'bul: grags stong mchod pas dgyes gyur nas: tshe 'das bla med thob par shog: om̐ shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: hūm̐: dri yi lha mos dung chos 'dzin: dkyil 'khor lha yi sku la 'bul: gsal stong mchod pas dgyes gyur nas:

tshe 'das bla med thob par shog: om̐ gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: hūm̐: ro yi lha mos zhal zas thogs: dkyil 'khor lha yi ljags la 'bul: bde stong mchod pas dgyes gyur nas: tshe 'das bla med thob par shog: om̐ rā sa pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: hūm̐: reg bya lha mos na bza' 'dzin: dkyil 'khor lha la 'jam mnyen 'bul: tshor stong mchod pas dgyes gyur nas: tshe 'das bla med thob par shog: om̐ spar+she pra tīts+tsha swā hā: zhes rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas dmigs yul tshe las 'das pa'i rgyu tshogs rdzogs lam sgrib pa sbyangs nas: 'bras bu rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur cig: de nas gsur bsngo ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las: rin po che zhi ba'i me thab dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du me gsur 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur cig: om̐ sarba bid pu ra pu ra a wārta a wārta ya hoḥ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ hi maṃ ga gā khaṃ swā hā: om̐ āḥhu ti swā hā: dri gsur 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni: mdangs da nang shi ba lus snga lus bor phyi lus ma thob par: rig pa gtad med du 'khyams pa'i sems can thams cad la bsngo'o: 'bul lo: mig gi yul du gzugs mdzes par gyur cig: rna ba'i yul du sgra snyan par gyur cig: sna yi yul du dri zhim par gyur cig: lce yi yul du ro mngar bar gyur cig: lus kyi yul du reg bya 'jam par gyur cig: yid kyi yul du rig shes phun sum tshogs par gyur cig: hoḥ thams cad nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin du: longs spyod zad pa med pa yi: rtsod pa med cing 'tshe med pa: rang dbang du ni spyod par shog: om̐ ha sa bha tra su tra bhū pa ye swā hā: de nas rten bca' zhing phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: nyon cig tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu:

zhing khams 'di nyid rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas zhing : phyag 'tshal skyabs mchis gus pas gsol ba thob: hoḥ 'jig rten pha rol song ba'i bu khyod nyon: mtshan byang 'di ni lus kyi bla rten yin: snyug ma tshigs drug srog gi bla rten yin: gdugs dang cod pan gos kyi bla rten yin: me long 'di ni sems kyi bla rten yin: mar me 'di ni mthong ba'i bla rten yin: rin chen 'di ni rgyan gyi bla rten yin: dar thag 'di ni lam gyi bla rten yin: pad+ma 'di ni sdod pa'i bla rten yin: mtshan byang 'di la rnam shes rten chos la: dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal sdig pa bshags: 'di'i skabs phyag 'tshal bshags pa las gzhung nas blang : de nas rnam shes spar ba ni: ngo sprod bya ba: hoḥ nyon cig tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu: 'jig rten tshe 'dir re ba'i nyi ma nub: gnas gang lus kyi sgrom bu 'byung bzhi 'thor: dga' ba'i grogs dang bral nas gcig pur 'khyams: dbang med bya sgro rlung khyer lta bu'i dus: pha ma spun zla mthong yang 'grogs dbang med: 'jig rten snang ba nub pa'i bar do 'dir: skyabs med mgon med dpung gnyen zad pa'i tshe: dkyil 'khor gtso bo bla mar 'dun pa bskyed: yi dam lha yi gsang mtshan dran par gyis: snang ba gang shar bsam blo bral bar zhog: dran rig rgyang so rgyal ba'i thugs kar gtod: mos gus dag snang bgyis pa'i dus gcig po: bla ma'i gdams ngag snying la ma 'chang na: rang gis rang nyid bslu bar mi 'gyur ram: rang sems dri med rnam shes āḥdakar de: snang mtha' ka dag rgyal ba'i thugs ka ru: blo bur phaṭ kyis gdab tshe yar 'phos shig: zhes smon lam gyi mtha': e ma hoḥ zhing khams mchog rab bde ba can gyi sogs? zhes pas mtshams sbyar te rnam shes spar: de nas byang bu bsreg pa ni: hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las khro bo zan za rdo rje zhal gru gsum du gdangs pa'i hom du tshe las 'das pa'i rnam par shes pa'i phung po las kyi sgrib pa shes bya'i sgrib pa:

nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pas kun nas bslangs pa'i bag chags kyi sgrib pa thams cad ye shes kyi me yis bsregs pas sku lnga'i sa bon thob par bsam: hūm̐: ye shes mched pa'i hom yangs su: de ring tshe 'das 'di nyid kyi: las dang nyon mongs bsreg pa'i phyir: stong nyid bden pa'i me sbar ro: hūm̐: phung po lnga yi bud shing la: rgyal ba rigs lnga'i me sbar ro: 'byung ba lnga yi bud shing la: yum chen lnga yi me sbar ro: rnam shes drug gi bud shing la: pha rol phyin drug me sbar ro: skye mched bcu gnyis bud shing la: rnam thar bcu gnyis me sbar ro: srog 'dzin bcu drug bud shing la: stong nyid bcu drug me sbar ro: dug lnga ma rig bud shing la: sku lnga ye shes me sbar ro: om̐ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ gu ru bo dhi sa twa ya ma hā sa twa ya: ma hā ka ru ṇi ka pa ri sho dha ya rā dza badz+ra ya bha ga wa ti sarba durga te pa ri sho dha na ye swā hā: oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru bi shwo dha na ye swā hā: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sarba bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: zhes byang bu bsregs pa'i thal ba chu bor dor ram sāts+tsha btab ste chur gshegs: rjes bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis rgyas gdab: sa ma ya: spyir byang bu 'di yang mi 'dra ba kha shas 'byung ste ci zhe na: bya rgyud la sbyangs bkrus bsregs gtor bcas te 'byung ba yang de kha rang lugs dang : 'di nyid bla med lugs ltar rten bskyed sgrib bkru dbang bskur ba sogs dang gtang rag mchod 'bul 'gyod tshangs sogs: 'byung ba rang lugs bslad med nges pa'i don no: sa ma ya: de la gang la la zhig gis dbang du bsgyur te: ngo bo sdig pa la rnam pa srin bu ra can sreg pa 'byung ste: sgrib pa'i sdig pa ni pā paṃ zhes pa srin bu'i sdig pa ni biṣatsha ṣa yang brjod pa ste don mi gcig pa'i phyir ro:

sgrib pa sbyong ba'i rgyud las: nyon mongs pa'i dug lnga ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin du sbyang ba'i chos su 'dod pa dang : dug lnga'i dug kyang sgrib gnyis ma rig pa'i dug yin pa'i don gyi 'byung ba gdos bcas su sbyang ba yang po'i go rim yin mod kyang : ye shes 'pho ba'i sems la ni: de la 'byung lnga bag mi snang : zhes bla med lugs la: phung po lnga dag sangs rgyas nyid: ces sbyang bas mthus pa'i phyir na sa chu me rlung gi dug phral mi dgos bla med lugs so: sa ma ya: e maḥ rigs drug skye gnas srid pa'i shing rta ltar: yang yang 'khor bar 'khrul rgyun gcod pa'i phyir: sreg sbyong sgrub sbyang bla med snying po 'di: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis brda bkod nas: mi nub rin chen sgrom gyi nang du bskyil: bka' yi rgya 'di las kyi srung mar bcol: gsang sngags bstan pa gnyan gyi mel tshe mdzod: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo sngags 'chang rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa khyi lor bsam yas mchims phu'i dge'u gong nas gdan drangs shing shog ser las zhal bshus so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// //

ta) ༁ྃ: rgyal ba kun 'dus khyab bdag rol pa las: dam can rgya mtsho'i gsol mchod phrin las myur mgyogs bzhugs so: che mchog 'dus pa thod phreng drag po'i lha la 'dud: sa ma ya rgya: de yang bka' srung 'dus pa phrin las myur mgyogs mngon spyod rtsol med du 'byin pa che zhes cher 'jigs pa'i las su bskul na tha tshig so so'i gnyer du mgyis pa la: thog mar drag po'i snod dam rang byung bhan+dha'am ci 'khod pa zhig tu: gdan ri rab bang rim gsum pa: de'i steng du 'khor lo brtsibs bcu pa dang bzhi pa: de'i steng du thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum: de'i steng du chos 'byung rngams 'thug gcig la thod tshal gyi kha bad yod pa: bang rim gsum dang ldan pa: de'i steng du rin chen zur brgyad pa: de'i steng du mgon po'i gtor ma tsit+ta'i dpal bshos thod tshal bzhis brgyan pa bya: rtsibs bzhi pa'i steng shar du zhing skyong mgon po'i gtor ma dbal zur gsum dang ldan pa dpung gshog gnyis brgyangs pa thog mde'u lta bur khrag kong gsum gyis bskor ba: zor ris rak+ta'i rgyun lam bya: lho ru gza' mchog gtor ma dpal gtor g.yas gcus gru gsum gyi steng du sbrul mgo gsum brgyan pa: logs gsum du bzhag: nub tu gnod sbyin gtor ma chos 'byung steng du bra gzugs dbal thon la tsit+ta gsum chos 'byung zur gsum du bzhag: gri ris kyang 'then: byang du rgyal po dpe ha ra'i gtor ma gdan gru bzhi'i steng du mkhar thab rtse mo spre'u mgos mtshan pa mkhar gyi logs gsum du phyi ba gyen du langs pa bya: rtsibs bcu par shar du lha bshos: shar mtshams dkar gtor: shar lho kong bu gru bzhi'i kha ru phyi ba: lho ru gtor ma nag po zur bzhi pa khram ris can: lho nub tu dpal gtor g.yas gcus: nub tu sog kha'i steng du snying bshos: nub mtshams su mkhar thab steng du ra mgo bzhag: nub byang rus sbal steng du 'brang rgyas:

byang du gtor ma zur gsum sbrul mgos brgyan par sbrul dkris can: byang shar du zur gsum g.yas gcus: mtshams rnams su khrag kong bcu: bang rim rnams su gtor zur drug cu rtsa bzhi: ling tshe drug cu rtsa gnyis mtha' ru khrag kong dang mtheb skyu: mtshams bzhir dbang po rnam lnga bcas rtse mor mdzes pa'i rgyan khra: gzhan yang liṅga'i rgyal mtshan dang dmar rgyan tshe nyungs kyi rkang bu bcas: rtse mor dar nag po'i rgyal mtshan: shar du seng lpags rgyal mtshan: lho ru stag lpags rgyal mtshan: nub tu dom lpags rgyal mtshan: byang du zhing lpags rgyal mtshan: mtshams su ru mtshon dkar ser dmar ljang : gru bzhir dar mtshon sna lnga: byung na snal ma'i gdugs bcas phub: gzhan yang mthun pa'i spyan gzigs du ma bsham: rang nyid yi dam gang rung gi bskyed rim song ba'i rjes su chos skyong bskyed nas spyan 'dren pa ni: sha chen sna tshogs kyi spos bsregs shing rol mo rnga chen 'brug ltar sgrogs shing : bdag nyid drag po'i ting 'dzin dang bcas nas: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: lan gsum: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum: om̐ swa bhā w stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid yi dam che mchog drag po he ru ka gsal ba'i mdun du khrag zhag rgya mtsho ltar 'khyil zhing phyur ba mi ro rta ro'i lbu ba lang ling du 'phyo ba: de'i dbus su srid pa'i ri rab gru bzhi pa: de'i steng du pad+ma dang nyi ma ro yi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag dang gri gug las skyes pa'i dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa sku che zhing yan lag rags pa: thung zhing sbom la gsus pa rgyas pa: phyag g.yas g.yon dang pos gri gug dang bhan+dha 'og mas ral gri dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ka bsnams pa zhabs phyed skyil du bzhugs shing dur khrod 'bar ba'i chas dang ldan pa: de'i pang du 'khyud pa'i yum tsaṇ+ḍi ma dmar mo gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa: yab la 'khyud pa yab yum bskal pa'i me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba'o:

gtso bo'i phyogs bzhir dpal ye shes kyi mgon po ma ning nag po gdong bzhi pa phyag drug pa bram ze'i gzugs can sogs yum sgo skyong dang bcas pa snang la rang bzhin med pa gsal bar bskyed do: om̐ shrī ma hā kā la kā li dz+nyā na dhe wa gha na gu h+ya k+ṣeṃ k+ṣe ṭa raṃ sid+dhi hūm̐ phaṭḥ hoḥ shar phyogs dur khrod me rlung 'tshubs pa'i dbus su dgra bgegs pho mo gdan du bting ba'i steng du yi ge he dang ru mtshon las skyes pa'i dpal bdud kyi mgon po ma hā kā la sku mdog mthing nag seṅge rab tu khros pa'i gdong pa can sku la dar nag gi phod kha dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gis spras pa g.yas ru mtshon nag po mkha' la 'phyar zhing g.yon thod pa'i nang du dmar nag dbal gyi gtor ma dgra la 'phen pa stag ral gzig shubs ral gris brgyan pa swag lham gsol zhing bdud rta nag po rlung gshog la chibs pa: de'i g.yon du bh+yo las bdud mo seng gdong ma sku mdog dmar mo dar dmar gyi phod kha gsol zhing : g.yas rtse gsum dang g.yon ral gri 'dzin pa btsan rta dmar zhur la chibs pa: yab yum me ri 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba'o: de'i 'khor du sprul pa'i las mkhan spre'u gdong can gnyis: shar du lha: lho ru btsan rgod: nub tu ma mo: byang du dge bsnyen: mtshams bzhir bdud gza' dgra lha dam can la sogs pa myur mgyogs can gzhan yang sprul pa yang sprul dang bcas pa 'jigs pa'i rgyan sna tshogs kyi spras par bskyed do: lho ru dug mtsho khol ma'i dbus su yi ge ra dang ral gri las skyes pa'i drang srong gza' bdud nag po sku mdog dud kha zhal dgu bya rog gi dbu dang bcu: phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis spu gri dang chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan 'og ma gnyis ra yi mda' gzhu 'gengs shing sbrul zhags 'dzin pa sku smad dug sbrul nag po rgya mtsho'i klong du 'khyil ba: sku lus thams cad spyan stong gis gtams pa de'i g.yon du yum klu mo khrag mig ma nyi ma dang zla ba 'dzin pa:

yab yum rlung nag bu yug 'tshubs pa'i klong du gsal ba'o: shar du zla ba: lho ru spen pa: nub tu nyi ma: byang du phur bu: mtshams bzhir lhag pa pa sangs mig dmar sgra gcan: gzhan yang gdong mo mched bzhi las kyi klu mo rigs brgyad nye 'khor sa bdag dang bcas pa bskyed do: nub tu byad ma mi ro rta ro bsnol mar brtsegs pa'i dbus su yi ge tsa dang beng chen las skyes pa'i gnod sbyin btsan rgod chen po sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa'i ya so yis ma mchu mnan pa: sku la dar dmar gyi za ber gsol zhing bswe khrab bswe rmog ru mtshon gyis brgyan te phyag g.yas tsan dan gyi beng chen dang g.yon ru mtshon dang zhags dmar 'dzin pa: sku la stag ral gzig shubs ral gris mdzes pa: rta rag pa rting dkar la zhon cing myur mgyogs shan pa chen po'i las su chas pa'o: shar du lha: lho ru klu: nub tu sman mo: byang du yak+ṣa: mtshams bzhir sprul pa za byed gsod byed sgrol byed las byed kyi bshan pa bzhi yang sprul dang bcas pa gsal ba'o: byang du snang zhing srid pa'i skye 'chi thams cad kyi 'byung ba 'khrugs pa dang ma 'khrug pa'i rlung dbang du phyam pa na bun 'tshub mar gtibs pa'i dbus su yi ge ru dang 'khar bsil ri rab kyi bkod pas brgyan pa las sprul pa'i chos skyong ba'i gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po chen po ging ha ra dpe dkar dkor bdag bstan pa'i bya ra ba chen po sku mdog dkar smug rgyas pa'i zhal can dbu la bswe chen gyi theb gsol zhing dar dkar po dang za 'og gi go zu gsol ba: phyag na 'khar bsil dang lcags kyi lhung phor byad ma sdang zhing gdug pa can rnams kyi snying khrag dang tsit+tas bkang ba chibs su seṅge dkar mo la zhon cing dkor cha'i gnyer kha 'tsho bar gsal ba'o: shar du dpe har shel ging : lho ru tshangs pa shel ging : nub tu li byin shel ging :

byang du dpe har shel ging : mtshams bzhir dpe nag shing bya dpe dmar gnam lha bzhi ste thams cad kyang mngon spyod dang ldan pa: gzhan yang sprul pa yang sprul nyid sprul dang bcas pa gsal snang sgyu ma'i gar bsgyur ba lta bur gsal zhing bskyed do: de'i phyi rol du rin chen gter gyi rgya rin po che bsrung ba la dbang ba'i sprul pa nyid sprul gzhan yang sha za khrag 'thung las byed bsam gyis mi khyab pa du mar gsal ba'i dpral bar om̐: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: lte bar swā: gsang bar hā: las byed du bh+yoḥ sprul pa ru phaṭḥ nyid sprul du dzaḥ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bstan pa'i bya ra ba gnyan po chos skyong ba'i srung ma drag rtsal dang ldan pa 'khor bcas spyan drangs: om̐ badz+ra shrī kā la k+ṣe ṭa pā la ki kang shu la tsa tri ging ka ra yak+ṣa rak+ṣa du pra ma ma hā raṃ ata tsi ta a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa mā ya dza dzaḥ zhes rnga dang rkang gling drag po 'bod pa'i dbyangs sna tshogs bgyis la: hūm̐: dur khrod ming ni nges su gang zhig bca': 'dzam gling 'di ru stobs bcus mnga' bsgyur ba'i: sa mtshams 'gog pa'i dmigs su ma mchis pa: tshangs pa'i yul nas sdong po'i gling 'jug pa: dpal chen nag po phyag bzhi gshegs su gsol: thabs shes mkha' la rol pa'i tshul 'chang ma: yum mchog tsaṇ+ḍi ma mo gshegs su gsol: phyogs bzhi mtshams dang las su sprul pa'i lha: ye shes mgon po lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: shar phyogs 'dzam gling 'jig rten tsā ri'i gnas: g.ya' gangs lhun snyogs nags tshal sprin ltar gtibs: ma mo mngon rgyu sha za lang long rgyug: de 'dra'i pho brang dbang sgyur nag po che: bdud mgon zhing skyong lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: dug mtsho nag po rba rlabs phyur ma 'khyil: stong gsum 'di ru 'gyu ba'i drag rtsal can: myur mgyogs shugs 'chang gnam lcags 'od po che:

thog ser rngam klong 'gyu ba'i las byed pa: drang srong gza' mchog lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: khrag mtsho 'khrugs pa'i gnas chen zangs ri'i gling : mchong dmar 'gyings pa'i pho brang khang bzang nas: gnod sbyin chen po mi bsrun mthu bo che: mngon spyod mdzad tshe bshan pa'i tshul bzung ba: btsan rgod 'bar ba'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: tshangs pa'i pho brang 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i gnas: dbang phyug lha yi gzhal med lta bu'i khyim: 'dzam gling dkor mdzod spungs pa'i pho brang nas: skye 'gro dbang sgyur las byed dkar smug zhal: sprul pa'i chos rgyal 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: gzhan yang dam can srung ma drag rtsal can: gter la dbang zhing sngags kyi bstan pa srung : bka' yi las byed mthu ldan ma lus pa: sprul pa yang sprul las byed la sogs pa: chos skyong yongs rdzogs 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: om̐ e h+ya hi shrī nā tha ma hā kā la singha mu kha ki kang shu la ya ging ka ra sarba dharma pā la ya dza dzaḥ sa ma ya dung dung thun thun phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya hriṃ hriṃ dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes chos skyong 'khor bcas sprin chen rlung gis bskyod pa ltar byon nas rten dang pho brang la bzhugs par bsam: hūm̐: dur khrod pho brang me rlung 'tshubs pa'i dbus: khrag mtsho nyi zla pad+ma ro yi gdan: bdud dgra bgegs srin tshar gcod gdan steng du: bstan pa'i bya ra myur mgyogs dam can rnams: chos 'khor gtsug lag gnyan po skyong ba'i phyir: phrin las thogs med bsgrub phyir brtan par bzhugs: om̐ sa ma ya dharma pā la ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: gtor ma sman raka gis bran: mchod pa kha gso zhing gsur btang : dri zhim kyang bsreg: rol mo dang dbyangs shin tu snyan par bya: hūm̐: dpal mgon dam can rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs la: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: gdug pa'i dam nyams byad ma bsgral ba yi:

mig dang rna ba sna dang lce snying sogs: bsam gyis mi khyab ri ltar spungs pa 'di: dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya badz+ra puṣ+pe swā hā: hūm̐: mi sha rta sha glang chen ba glang sha: khyi sha la sogs sha chen sna tshogs bsregs: gzhan yang rdzas rgod ngar ldan sbyar spos 'di: dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya badz+ra dhū pe swā hā: hūm̐: rkang mar zhag dang til mar sbyar ba la: ro ras shi skra dkris pa'i sdong bus gtams: sbar ba'i sgron me 'tshubs pa'i 'od 'gengs 'di: dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya badz+ra ā lo ke swā hā: hūm̐: dug khrag thang khrom gu gul sbyar ba yi: ngar ldan rba rlabs nag po gyen du phyur: rgyu khrag la sogs mkhris pa'i dri chab 'di: dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya badz+ra gan+dhe swā hā: hūm̐: 'bru nag ngar phye gri khrag sbags pa'i zan: dmar nag dpal ldan sha khrag liṅgas brgyan: zhag gi bcud g.yo 'khyil zhing phyur ba 'di: dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya badz+ra nai wi d+ye swā hā: hūm̐: thod pa ltag sprod las kyi phyag rgya lnga: rdza rnga rnga zlum drag po'i shing gi rnga: 'brug ltar ldir ba'i rnga chen rol mo 'di: dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la badz+ra shab+da swā hā: hūm̐: bhan+dha lcang lo yangs pa'i snod mchog tu: sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang yig 'bru lnga: 'od zhu sbyangs spel bsgyur ba'i rdzas mchog 'di:

dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya ma hā a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: gtor snod drag po yangs shing rgya che'i nang : dgra bgegs 'byung po rnams kyi sha dang khrag: klad rus rkang dang nang rol khu ba bcas: ri ltar spungs pa'i dgra sha khrag mchod 'di: dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta la kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: bum ril mtshan ldan snod mchog ka pā la: ma rungs byad ma rnams kyi snying khrag gtams: rlabs chen 'phyur ba'i rak+ta 'bar ba 'di: dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ sarba ma hā rak+ta la kha kha khā hi: de nas bskang gsol bya ba ni: mchod pa gso zhing bran khrag chang nam mkhar gtor zhing : hūm̐ hūm̐: phyi snod yangs pa 'dzam gling bhan+dha ru: nang bcud longs spyod bsod nams dngos zhing tshogs: nyer spyod mthun rdzas sgrub rdzas skong ba'i rdzas: dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchod pa'i bye brag dang : rab dmar khrag gi rgya mtsho kyi li li: rmad byung sbyor ba'i mchod rdzas sna tshogs 'di: dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul lags na: dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs rnams kyi snying gi khrag: 'bru nag chang dang dug rigs sbyor ba'i phud: ru tra bsgral ba'i dbang po rnam lnga 'di: dpal chen nag po phyag bzhi'i zhal du 'bul: dpal mgon sde bzhi yab yum zhal du 'bul: las byed sgo ma mched bzhi'i zhal du 'bul: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: bha ling dbang po rnam lngas mnga' gsol lo: dgra bgegs klad rus sha yis mnga' gsol lo: sna tshogs spyan gzigs du mas mnga' gsol lo:

mnga' gsol 'di bzhes sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs: ma rungs log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs rnams kyi mchin pa'i khrag: 'bru nag chang dang dug rigs sbyor ba'i phud: ru tra bsgral ba'i dbang po rnam lnga 'di: dpal ldan zhing skyong yab yum zhal du 'bul: las mkhan bam ro pho mo'i zhal du 'bul: bka' sdod dregs pa sde brgyad zhal du 'bul: las byed sprul pa yang sprul zhal du 'bul: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: bha ling dbang po rnam lngas mnga' gsol lo: dgra bgegs klad rus sha yis mnga' gsol lo: sna tshogs spyan gzigs du mas mnga' gsol lo: mnga' gsol 'di bzhes sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs: ma rungs log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs rnams kyi glo ba'i khrag: 'bru nag chang dang dug rigs sbyor ba'i phud: ru tra bsgral ba'i dbang po rnam lnga 'di: drang srong gza' bdud yab yum zhal du 'bul: myur mgyogs gza' chen rnam brgyad zhal du 'bul: yum dang sras mchog sprul pa'i zhal du 'bul: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: bha ling dbang po rnam lngas mnga' gsol lo: dgra bgegs klad rus sha yis mnga' gsol lo: sna tshogs spyan gzigs du mas mnga' gsol lo: mnga' gsol 'di bzhes sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs: ma rungs log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs rnams kyi mkhal ma'i khrag: 'bru nag chang dang dug rigs sbyor ba'i phud: ru tra bsgral ba'i dbang po rnam lnga 'di: gnod sbyin btsan rgod chen po'i zhal du 'bul: las mkhan myur mgyogs sde brgyad zhal du 'bul: sprul pa byi la mtshal bya'i zhal du 'bul: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: bha ling dbang po rnam lngas mnga' gsol lo:

dgra bgegs klad rus sha yis mnga' gsol lo: sna tshogs spyan gzigs du mas mnga' gsol lo: mnga' gsol 'di bzhes sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs: ma rungs log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs rnams kyi srog gi khrag: 'bru nag chang dang dug rigs sbyor ba'i phud: ru tra bsgral ba'i dbang po rnam lnga 'di: chos skyong dpe dkar chen po'i zhal du 'bul: yum mchog gnam sman rgyal mo'i zhal du 'bul: shel ging dregs pa sde brgyad zhal du 'bul: sprul pa yang sprul nyid sprul zhal du 'bul: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: bha ling dbang po rnam lngas mnga' gsol lo: dgra bgegs klad rus sha yis mnga' gsol lo: sna tshogs spyan gzigs du mas mnga' gsol lo: mnga' gsol 'di bzhes sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs: ma rungs log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs rnams kyi dbang po'i khrag: 'bru nag chang dang dug rigs sbyor ba'i phud: ru tra bsgral ba'i dbang po rnam lnga 'di: dam can myur mgyogs rnams kyi zhal du 'bul: gter bdag gter srung rnams kyi zhal du 'bul: yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyi zhal du 'bul: mchod 'os bstod 'os rnams kyi zhal du 'bul: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pas mnga' gsol lo: bha ling dbang po rnam lngas mnga' gsol lo: dgra bgegs klad rus sha yis mnga' gsol lo: sna tshogs spyan gzigs du mas mnga' gsol lo: mnga' gsol 'di bzhes sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs: ma rungs log 'dren bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ āḥhūm̐: ma hā sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi: om̐ āḥhūm̐: ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la ya kha kha khā hi: om̐ āḥhūm̐: ma hā bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: om̐ āḥhūm̐: ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta la kha kha khā hi:
om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba bi shwa pū dza me gha ya āḥhūm̐:

de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: che mchog lhag pa'i lhar gyur nag po che: 'jigs byed stobs ldan khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ dpa' bo g.yul las rgyal byed phyag bzhi pa: 'bar ba'i mtshon cha bsnams shing dpa' ba'i chas: dur khrod bdag mo tsaṇ+ḍi zung 'jug 'khril: che ba'i 'khor bcas gdug pa'i g.yul las rgyal: ma rungs 'joms mdzad ye shes mgon po'i tshogs: bka' sdod srung mar bcas la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: pho brang chen po tsā ri'i gnas kyi bdag: legs ldan sras po bdud mgon seṅge'i gdong : mngon spyod las mdzad rta nag rting dkar zhon: mtshon cha'i sgyogs chen ma rungs dgra la 'phen: bdud mo yum bcas dregs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor: za gsod las mdzad pho nya 'bum dang bcas: zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: lho nub mun rum 'khrigs pa dug mtsho'i klong : me rlung 'tshub ma 'khyil ba'i pho brang nas: stong khams 'di ru drag rtsal ldan pa'i lha: srog bdag nag po srin lus sbrul mjug can: gnam lcags thog mda' dam nyams dgra la 'bebs: khrag mig yum chen glog gi zhags pa can: gza' brgyad 'khor bcas gdong mo las la 'gyed: ki kang nag po dbyings kyi las byed pa: drang srong 'khor dang bcas la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: khrag mtsho 'khrugs pa'i gnas chen zangs ri'i mkhar: mchong dmar dgra la 'gyed pa'i pho brang nas: gnod sbyin chen po mi bsrun srin po'i gzugs: btsan rgod 'bar ba myur mgyogs 'dzam gling nyul: lus la go khrab mtshon cha dmag gter thogs: rta mchog rag pa chibs shing sprul pa 'gyed: dgra bo rtsad brlag bshan pa'i 'khor gyis bskor: bstan pa srung ba'i las byed mthu bo che: btsan rgod 'khor dang bcas la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: rin chen sna tshogs las grub 'phrul lding khang : za 'og sna tshogs bkram pa'i pho brang dbus: skye 'gro mnga' dbang sgyur mdzad dkar smug zhal:

dar dkar lhub gsol 'khar bsil lhung bzed thogs: sder chags zil gnon seṅge dkar mo zhon: mthu ldan las byed phrin las sde bzhi 'gyed: sku gsung thugs sprul sa gzhi'i rdul ltar 'gengs: chos rgyal 'khor dang bcas la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: gzhan yang bka' yi las byed gter gyi bdag: mthu rtsal rmad byung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: phrin las bzhi ldan bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod: gsang sngags gnyan gyi chos 'khor skyong byed pa'i: gter srung yongs rdzogs tshogs la bdag bstod do: de nas skong ba bya ba ni: hūm̐: smug nag gru gsum e yi dkyil 'khor nas: sa bcu'i dbang phyug legs ldan nag po che: ma hā kā la mthing nag rngam pa'i sku: srid gsum sngangs byed khrag 'thung phyag bzhi pa: ye shes mgon po chen po'i thugs dam bskang : gsang chen me ri 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: ma ning srog sgrub nag po'i thugs dam bskang : ha ha dgod pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: dpal chen gdong bzhi mgon po'i thugs dam bskang : shing rkang gcig pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: myur mdzad phyag drug mgon po'i thugs dam bskang : rlung nag 'tshubs pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: mgon po bram ze'i gzugs can thugs dam bskang : 'phro 'du srid pa rnam bzhi'i dur khrod nas: tsaṇ+ḍi ma mo rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : las mdzad mā ra ya yi dur khrod nas: srog bdag bya rog gdong can thugs dam bskang : sngags bdag las la 'gyed pa'i dur khrod nas: tsaṇ+ḍi ma mo sgo skyong thugs dam bskang : srid pa las kyi mtha' sdud dur khrod nas: mgon po'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: shar phyogs kha ba can gyi shar lho'i mtshams: dbyings la bsnyegs pa'i dur khrod tsā ri ṭa: thod pa brtsegs pa'i pho brang chen po nas: mthing nag rngam byed dpal ldan seṅge'i gdong : dpa' ba'i chas ldan bdud rta rlung gshog chibs:

bdud mo yum bcas 'dzam gling dbang sgyur ba: dpal mgon zhing skyong yab yum thugs dam bskang : dri gzhon rdul ltar g.yo ba'i gnas mchog nas: sprel gdong bam ro pho mo'i thugs dam bskang : dung ri 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba'i gnas mchog nas: lha btsan rdo rje 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskang : brag dmar khra tshang zangs g.yag gnas mchog nas: bshan pa btsan rgod chen po'i thugs dam bskang : mthing bzang srid pa yangs pa'i gnas mchog nas: sngags bdag e ka dzā ṭi'i thugs dam bskang : mtsho nag rba klong 'khrugs pa'i gnas mchog nas: dge bsnyen nā ga rak+sha'i thugs dam bskang : mun gling kha rag mgo dgu'i gnas mchog nas: bdud rje nag po bkrag med thugs dam bskang : me rlung rdul ltar 'khrigs pa'i gnas mchog nas: drang srong gza' mchog nag po'i thugs dam bskang : ma sang rtsal bcu 'gyed pa'i gnas mchog nas: che btsan dgra lha gnyan po'i thugs dam bskang : 'o yug lcags mkhar nag po'i gnas mchog nas: dam can rdo rje legs pa'i thugs dam bskang : myur mgyogs me ltar 'bar ba'i gnas mchog nas: zhing skyong bka' 'khor yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: lho nub rang bzhin dbyings kyi pho brang dbus: 'byung ba dkar dmar rlung gsum tsha grang 'khrugs: lta bas mi bzod snang srid chu ltar khol: de 'dra'i gnas bzhugs srog bdag ljang sngon zhal: srid rtse mnar med kun kyang lto bar 'gengs: mkha' ru rgyu ba'i khyab 'jug phyag bzhi pa: srin po dbu dgu klu mo dug sbrul 'khyil: dug mtsho'i klong bzhugs ki kang dmar 'od can: gza' mchog rā hu la yi thugs dam bskang : snang srid yongs kyi skye 'gro'i srog la rgyu: yum mchog khrag mig nag mo'i thugs dam bskang : chu yi mkha' la rgyu zhing bsil dug 'bebs: gza' rgod zla ba chen po'i thugs dam bskang : sa yi mkha' la rgyu zhing ri rab g.yo:

gza' rgod spen pa chen po'i thugs dam bskang : me yi las byed tshad dug rims yams 'phyo: gza' rgod nyi ma chen po'i thugs dam bskang : rlung dang bu yug 'brug sgra'i sna ru rgyu: gza' rgod phur bu chen po'i thugs dam bskang : sngo dmar khrag gi rlabs la las kun byed: gza' rgod lag pa chen po'i thugs dam bskang : sha dang khams kyi dbang po 'phel 'grib byed: gza' rgod pa sangs chen po'i thugs dam bskang : tsha ba'i 'od ldan skye 'gro yongs la sdang : gza' rgod mig dmar chen po'i thugs dam bskang : snang srid 'khor 'das dbu ma'i zom du bcug: gza' rgod sgra gcan chen po'i thugs dam bskang : skye gnas rnam bzhi khams dang srid par sbyor: gza' yum gdong mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : dug lnga dug gsum g.yo byed ma rig bdag: klu yi ma mo brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : steng 'og bar dang skye 'gro'i las su rgyu: dregs pa gza' rgod yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: rngam pa 'od ldan zangs gling ma ru rtse: sham pa la zhes mchong brag khrag mtsho'i gling : btsan mkhar dmar smug ldan pa'i pho brang nas: gnod sbyin rgyal po dregs byed bshan pa'i gzugs: me 'od gdong can myur mgyogs rag pa zhon: 'dzam gling 'di ru dbang byed dregs pa'i gzugs: btsan rgod bswe khrab can gyi thugs dam bskang : sku yi sprul pas sbrul zhags dgra la 'debs: klu btsan bshan pa mthing nag thugs dam bskang : gsung gi sprul pas ma rungs srog rtsa gcod: btsan rje bshan pa dmar nag thugs dam bskang : thugs kyi sprul pas skye 'gro rtsis la 'debs: srog bdag tshangs pa dkar po'i thugs dam bskang : yon tan sprul pas rin chen gter rgya skyong : sngags skyong ma mo dkar mo'i thugs dam bskang : phrin las sprul pas dkor rkun rtsad nas gcod: btsan rgod rol pa sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang :

yang sprul gtsug lag ka cha'i rten la 'bul: spra sprel mtshal bya byi la'i thugs dam bskang : bka' yi bya ra bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin ma: btsan rgod 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du ma nas byung ba: li yul mnga' bsgyur bha ta'i sgom grwa skyong : bdud dang gnod sbyin btsan klu bshos pa'i rigs: gtsug lag ka cha'i rten la chags byed cing : skye 'gro'i srog la dbang zhing rtsis la 'debs: gnod sbyin chen po dkar smug khro 'dzum can: gdong lnga'i khrir bzhugs 'jig rten snang ba sdud: gsang sngags grogs mdzad dngos grub char ltar 'bebs: chos skyong rgyal po dpe dkar thugs dam bskang : shar phyogs mnga' bsgyur lha yi longs spyod sdud: rgyal po dpe har chen po'i thugs dam bskang : lho phyogs mnga' bsgyur gshin rje'i longs spyod sdud: rgyal po tshangs pa chen po'i thugs dam bskang : nub phyogs mnga' bsgyur ma mo'i longs spyod sdud: rgyal po li byin chen po'i thugs dam bskang : byang phyogs mnga' bsgyur gnod sbyin longs spyod sdud: rgyal po dpe ha ra yi thugs dam bskang : shar lho mnga' bsgyur dmu yi longs spyod sdud: rgyal po dpe nag chen po'i thugs dam bskang : lho nub mnga' bsgyur btsan gyi longs spyod sdud: rgyal po shing bya chen po'i thugs dam bskang : nub byang mnga' bsgyur bdud kyi longs spyod sdud: rgyal po dpe dmar chen po'i thugs dam bskang : byang shar mnga' bsgyur klu yi longs spyod sdud: rgyal po gnam lha chen po'i thugs dam bskang : sprul pa phyogs bcur khyab cing longs spyod sdud: dkor bdag rgyal po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa la: gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas mchog ni:

dmar chen yon chab dbang po'i me tog dang : sha gsur bdug spos tshil chen zhun me sbar: dug khrag dri chab 'bru nag dpal gyi bshos: sna tshogs rol mo 'brug ltar sgrogs pa 'dis: dpal chen phyag bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : zhing skyong mgon po yab yum thugs dam bskang : gza' mchog rā hu la yi thugs dam bskang : gnod sbyin btsan rgod chen po'i thugs dam bskang : dkor bdag dpe har rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : dam can yongs rdzogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag bsal du gsol: hūm̐: bhan+dha lcang lo yangs pa'i snod mchog tu: sman mchod bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho kyi li li: bla med nang gi mchod pa mtsho ltar 'khyil: dung khang zhal bur rak+ta phyur ru ru: sha chen zhag gi lbu ba gya ma gyu: drag po'i snod du bha ling ri ltar spungs: dbang po rnam lnga'i rgyal mtshan ye re re: lcang lo'i snod du dgra sha rdza ltar bskyil: bsgral mchod nang rol sna tshogs nyi li li: rin chen snod mchog yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor du: ga ṇa tshogs kyi mchod pa dbyings dang mnyam: mtho bsnyegs longs spyod bcud mchog chi li li: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'dis: dpal chen phyag bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : zhing skyong mgon po yab yum thugs dam bskang : gza' mchog rā hu la yi thugs dam bskang : gnod sbyin btsan rgod chen po'i thugs dam bskang : dkor bdag rgyal po dpe dkar thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag bsal du gsol: hūm̐: dpal ldan ye shes mgon po mnyes pa'i rdzas: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i bhan+dha ru: dmar chen gtor ma dar nag gdugs kyis brgyan: gri rgod snying dang bla rdo srog 'khor bcas: rten dar rnga thug nag po mkha' la phyar: gri gug ral gri kha ṭ+wāṃ mtshon cha gzengs: rta nag cang shes bcu gsum 'tsher skad tser: g.yag nag ngar ldan bcu gsum dal gyis 'gro:

lug nag dpyi dkar bcu gsum 'ba' sgra tser: tsa ra rog po bcu gsum sbrid cing 'khrab: khyi nag snying dkar bcu gsum kha gdangs 'dur: bya nag gser mig bcu gsum gshog 'gyur lding : dom nag smyon pa bcu gsum ngar sgra 'byin: sbrul nag 'khyug 'gying bcu gsum phya ma phyo: rwa can sder chags 'dab chags du ma dang : gzhan yang dgyes shing bskang dang mthun pa'i rdzas: byang g.yag zhol ldan kham pa ru ring la: rgyab tu dgra bgegs pho mo'i bam ro bkal: phyogs bzhir dur khrod ging pa pho mo rgyug: lag tu thod dbyug bhan+dha khrag bkang thogs: mtshams bzhir bram ze mi nag gcer bu yis: thod rnga dang ni gri rkang gling bu thogs: gzhan yang spyan gzigs mchod rdzas du ma yis: yab gcig legs ldan nag po'i thugs dam bskang : yum mchog 'dod khams dbang phyug thugs dam bskang : ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : ma ning dpal 'bar nag po'i thugs dam bskang : gdong bzhi ma hā kā la'i thugs dam bskang : phyag drug ye shes mgon po'i thugs dam bskang : bram gzugs dur khrod bdag po'i thugs dam bskang : las byed bye ba 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag kun bsal nas: bar chad sel zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐: chos skyong nag po bdud mgon mnyes pa'i rdzas: ru mtshon nag po pha rol rgol 'joms dang : ru dar nag po rlung gi 'khor lo can: g.yab dar nag po srid pa'i g.yul zlog che: dar nag phod dang gnam lcags go khrab bkram: chu gri ral gri spu gri drwa ba bris: mda' mo sgro gsum mthing nag dar gyis brgyan: me long la sogs srog gi yi ges spras: thog mda' dgra la 'phen pa'i gtor zor la: bdud kyi mtshon cha sna tshogs rtsang ltar gzengs: g.yu ral gtibs pa'i seng chung 'bum 'bum dang : rtsal sgro gzigs pa'i bya khyung sa ya khri: mkha' yi sgra 'dzin g.yu 'brug sngon mo stong :

rta nag rta dmar nyi khri rlung gshog can: gzhan yang mi zan rngam dred dmar nag la: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs pho mo'i bam chen bkal: bdud kyi ling pa khyi khrid nyi li li: lce spyang lag ring ngu zug cangs se cang : zangs 'phar dmar po 'dur rgyug myu ru ru: khra glag bya rog dmar nag tshubs se tshub: bdud bya mchu dmar rngam 'jums kyi li li: srin bya 'ug pas ku 'debs lhangs se lhang : 'dre bya sreg pas skad ngan tse re re: sman bya pu shud bshugs sgra kyu ru ru: ging bdud sha za mtshon thogs rongs se rong : srin mo khrag mdog mi sdug mtshan ma bsgrad: zangs kyi spre'u pho mo la sogs pa: mthun pa'i spyan gzigs du ma bkram pa 'dis: bdud mgon zhing skyong chen po'i thugs dam bskang : yum mchog bdud mo seng gdong thugs dam bskang : sprul pa bam ro pho mo'i thugs dam bskang : lha btsan rdo rje 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskang : gnod sbyin btsan rgod chen po'i thugs dam bskang : ma mo sngags kyi srung ma'i thugs dam bskang : dge bsnyen nā ga rak+sha'i thugs dam bskang : bdud rje nag po bkrag med thugs dam bskang : gza' rgod ki kang nag po'i thugs dam bskang : myur mgyogs dgra lha chen po'i thugs dam bskang : dam can rdo rje legs pa'i thugs dam bskang : sprul pa yang sprul rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag kun bsal nas: bar chad sel zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐: chos skyong khra bo gza' rgod mnyes pa'i rdzas: bya rog prog gi zhu chen dbyings su phyar: rngam byed chu srin 'bar ba'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs: nyi zla'i phreng ba glog zhags mkha' la bskyod: rno ba'i dbal ldan du ma dgra la phyar: 'ching byed sbrul zhags nag po glog ltar 'khyugs: rten dar khra bo ma ning thig le can: g.yab dar ljang sngon me yi ba dan can: gzi mig dgu dang rwa yi mda' gzhu 'gengs: g.yu 'brug sngon po rlung gi gshog pa can:

lho bun sngon po ngam nag 'khrigs pa'i dbus: glo bur yud ldang dmar 'od tsha zhags 'khyugs: las kyi mtshon cha thog ser skar ltar 'khrugs: dug rigs thun gyis brgyan pa'i gtor chen spungs: 'gyu ba bcu gnyis gnyan gyi bu mo stong : srid pa bcu gnyis klu yi bu mo stong : lo skor bcu gnyis bdud kyi bu mo stong : me yi las byed pho nya 'bar zhing mched: chu yi las byed pho nya 'brub cing 'phyur: sa yi las byed pho nya nyil zhing 'khrugs: rlung gi las byed pho nya 'ur zhing 'thab: bdud kyi srin po'i las byed rdul ltar 'tshubs: phyur ba'i dug chu 'tshubs pa'i dug rlangs dang : gzhan yang mthun rdzas sgrub rdzas sna tshogs kyis: gza' mchog dug gdong mgo dgu'i thugs dam bskang : yum mchog khrag mig nag mo'i thugs dam bskang : chu gza' zla ba lhag pa'i thugs dam bskang : me gza' nyi ma mig dmar thugs dam bskang : rlung gza' sgra gcan phur bu'i thugs dam bskang : sa gza' spen pa pa sangs thugs dam bskang : stag srin zor ba gdong gi thugs dam bskang : 'brog srin chu srin gdong gi thugs dam bskang : kong srin ba glang gdong gi thugs dam bskang : bam srin dred mong gdong gi thugs dam bskang : rgyu skar 'gyu ba bcu gnyis thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag kun bsal nas: bar chad sel zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐: chos skyong dmar po btsan rgod mnyes pa'i rdzas: ru mtshon dmar po me lce ya la la: bswe yi rmog chen ru dar du mas brgyan: bswe khrab 'od ldan dam nyams klad pa 'gems: bswe phub ling chen rnga zhol dmar pos brgyan: tsan dan beng chen pho brang dmag gi gter: dung gi beng chen lha dmag nyi khri gtibs: gser gyi beng chen gnyan dmag sprin ltar g.yo: zangs kyi beng chen btsan dmag chu ltar khol: g.yu yi beng chen klu dmag mun ltar 'tshubs: dngul gyi beng chen pho nyas dgra srog sdud:

seng ldeng beng chen bshan pas mtshon cha thogs: lha zhags dkar po nyi ma'i zer ltar 'khyugs: btsan zhags dmar po bar snang rlung ltar 'gyu: bdud zhags nag po myur mgyogs glog ltar 'phen: klu zhags sngon mo rba rlabs chu ltar 'khrugs: gza' zhags khra bo snang srid skar ltar 'khrugs: gnyan zhags ser po nyi ma'i zer ltar gtibs: dmu zhags kham pa sa g.yo rgyu ltar ldog: dar dmar rtsi ber sprin chen bzhin du g.yo: stag ral gzig shubs tshogs ni mkha' la bkram: zangs dmar mda' gzhu gnam lcags dar mdung 'gengs: rnga thug tshogs ni sprin dmar bzhin du 'tshubs: zangs khram zangs sho zangs rdel zangs kyi gdan: g.yang gzhi dmar po 'khor yug kun la bris: dgra bo'i mgo bcad lcang lo thur du bsigs: rgyu ma'i drwa ba drwa ba phyed pa la: byad ma'i glo snying rkang pa lag pa 'phyangs: mkhal ma mchin pa mtsher pa pho rdos brgyan: gzhan yang mdzes pa'i rten rdzas du ma ni: rta mchog rag pa'i tshogs ni 'dur zhing rgyug: zhol g.yag kham pa ngar bas sa gzhi g.yo: lug dmar dar dmar tshogs ni gar rtsed 'khrab: zangs kyi spra sprel mang po'i mche ba gtsigs: dung gi byi la gwa pa rlung ltar 'tshubs: mtshal gyi bya dmar zangs kyi mche ba can: srin bya 'dab chags gtsug phud gyen du 'phyo: stag mo ri bkra 'bum sde ngar zhing 'phyo: zangs khyi zangs 'phar zangs wa nyi li li: btsan gyi pho nyas dgra bo 'ching zhing 'drud: btsan gyi khyi dmar dgra bo'i glo snying khur: btsan gyi bu mos khrag gi ral pa bsigs: btsan gyi bshan pas spu gri dgra la 'debs: btsan shwa ru bcur mi ro ring po bkal: btsan gyi kha sha dmar po phyogs bcur rgyug: btsan gyi las byed nyi khri rdul ltar 'tshubs: btsan brag btsan mkhar la sogs mthun rdzas kyis: gnod sbyin me 'od gdong gi thugs dam bskang : btsan rgod bswe khrab can gyi thugs dam bskang : sku sprul klu yi bshan pa'i thugs dam bskang :
