gsung sprul btsan gyi bshan pa'i thugs dam bskang : thugs sprul tshangs pa dung thod thugs dam bskang : yon tan sngags skyong dkar mo'i thugs dam bskang : phrin las rol pa spun bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : yang sprul mtshal bya byi la'i thugs dam bskang : bka' yi 'khor bcas yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag kun bsal nas: bar chad sel zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐: chos skyong dkar po dpe dkar mnyes pa'i rdzas: dar mdung dkar po 'phan 'phyang pu ru ru: za 'og ber chen sna tshogs dbyings la bskyod: lhab lhub mdzes pa'i phod ka shel khrab dang : shel rmog dang ru bya rgod thul bas brgyan: rba dkar tshigs bdun smyug dkar tshigs dgu la: rnga ma dkar po dngul byang mig dgus spras: dung sho dang ni khrung khrung rgyal mtshan gzugs: srog gi yi ge rin chen sna lngas brgyan: 'od zer zhags dkar wang long lcags kyu dang : dgra satwa mda' gzhu stag gi rlid bu'i nang : shel gyi gwa'u'i nang du bla rdo sbas: bswe theb chos gos lhung bzed 'khar bsil dang : kai la 'od ldan yid du mchis pa'i rdzas: rten mdos dkar po ring cha drwa bas brgyan: mda' dar shing khra gtsug lag gnyug ma'i sa: 'phen 'phyang bla bre gdugs tog ba dan bsgrengs: rol mo bye brag ma nges snyan pa'i rigs: 'bras dkar la sogs 'bru mchog rdza ltar spungs: pha rol rgol 'joms mtshon cha sna tshogs dang : gzhan yang dung seng glang chen ma he dkar: rta dkar g.yag dkar lug dkar byi la dkar: ba dkar ra dkar khyi dkar bya dkar dang : spra sprel mon pa pho mo a tsa ra: sngags gzugs btsun gzugs mo sman gzhon nu'i tshogs: stag shar dang ni dar seng 'bag seng dang : pu tra'i gzugs can mgo brnyan du ma'i tshogs: khyad par rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa'i: pho brang dkor mdzod yid du mchis pa ru: phyi nang spyan gzigs longs spyod du mas bskang :

ched du bkod pa'i gzugs 'gros la sogs kun: blos blangs yid sprul snang srid khyon 'gengs 'dis: chos skyong dpe dkar rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : yum mchog gnam sman rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskang : dkor bdag shel khrab can gyi thugs dam bskang : rgyal po dpe ha ra yi thugs dam bskang : rgyal po tshangs pa dung thod thugs dam bskang : rgyal po li byin chen po'i thugs dam bskang : rgyal po bhi ha ra yi thugs dam bskang : rgyal po dpe nag chen po'i thugs dam bskang : rgyal po shing bya chen po'i thugs dam bskang : rgyal po dpe dmar chen po'i thugs dam bskang : rgyal po gnam lha chen po'i thugs dam bskang : yang 'khor gtsug lag skyong ba'i thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag kun bsal nas: bar chad sel zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐: gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba kho na nyid: de bzhin blo yis blangs dang rang bzhin gyis: dngos 'byor yid sprul rgyu las byung ba yi: mchod rdzas sgrub rdzas skong rdzas rten pa'i rdzas: 'bod rdzas sgrub rdzas mnyes pa'i rdzas la sogs: spyan gzigs du ma gzugs 'gros sna tshogs dang : snang srid stong gsum 'jig rten thams cad du: ci srid de dang de srid 'byung ba dang : 'byung 'gyur spyad dang spyod pa'i tshogs rnams kyis: chos skyong pho rgyud thams cad thugs dam bskang : chos skyong mo rgyud thams cad thugs dam bskang : dam can tha tshig gnyer ba'i thugs dam bskang : gter bdag gter srung rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : mchod 'os bstod 'os rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bar chad sel zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo dam tshig ldan pa'i lha: deng 'dir sngags 'chang sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin gyis: bskyed rim ma gsal rdzogs rim ma rtogs dang : bzlas brjod grangs nyung mchod rdzas g.yel ba dang : phud lhag 'dres shing dus kyi mchod pa chag: dam bca' dor bas nus mthu nyams pa dang : mngon spyod rtsal chung dgra bgegs ma bsgral sogs: le lo btang snyoms g.yeng ba'i dbang gyur rnams: dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba: mthol bshags bzod gsol mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya sho dha ya sho dha ya bi sho dha ne bi sho dha ne sa pa ri bi sho dha na dharma pā la sarba shud+dhe ye swā hā: de nas gtor bskul bya ba ni: rab 'don cha ltar so so kha phral zhing gtor ma 'bul: bsdu na phyogs gcig tu lha grangs gtor gzugs kyi 'khor bha ling gis bskor bar bya: de yang gtor bsngos bya ba'i rim pa ni: gtor mchod stegs kyi kha ru bzhag: sha chen snod du bkram par khrag chang gis bran: sha gsur bya zhing rol mo drag brdung bya la 'di skad do: hoḥ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba'i gtor ma sman raka dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa dbang po rnam lngas brgyan pa 'di nyid 'bul zhing bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni: dpal ye shes kyi mgon po legs ldan nag po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: yum mchog 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma yi zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: khrag 'thung phyag bzhi chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: yum mchog tsaṇ+ḍi ma mo'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: ma ning dpal 'bar nag po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: gdong bzhi ma hā kā la'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: myur mgyogs phyag drug mgon po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: bram gzugs dur khrod bdag po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi:

yum mchog ma mo rigs bzhi'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: sgo skyong phra men rigs bzhi'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: gzhan yang sprul pa srog bdag bya rog gi gdong can 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: hoḥ ye shes mgon po'i lha tshogs kyis: dgyes pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang : bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba dang : rig 'dzin bdag la 'gras pa dang : ka cha dkor nor 'phrog pa dang : gdug pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma yi: pho rgyud rnams kyi sha la zo: mo rgyud rnams kyi khrag la 'thung : rigs rgyud thams cad mngal nas skoms: sgo nor thams cad phyags mas thob: dgra bo'i gnyen 'dun nang 'thab thongs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma dang : nyams pa'i dgra bo mnyam par bzhes: rbad do bzlog go las mdzod cig: thal mo lan gsum brdab cing gtor ma phul: hoḥ dpal ldan zhing skyong dbang po sha za nag po seṅge'i gdong pa can gyi zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: yum mchog bdud mo si na ra ma'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: las byed myur mgyogs bam chen pho mo'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: lha btsan rdo rje 'bar ba'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: btsan rgod 'bar ba khrag 'thung zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: ma mo sngags kyi srung ma'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: klu bdud nā ga rak+sha'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: bdud rje nag po bkrag med zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: gza' mchog dug gdong mgo dgu'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: che btsan dgra lha chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: dam can rdo rje legs pa'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: bdud kyi las byed du ma'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: hūm̐:

bdud mgon zhing skyong lha tshogs kyis: dgyes pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang : bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba dang : rig 'dzin bdag la 'gras pa dang : ka cha dkor nor 'phrog pa dang : gdug pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma yi: pho rgyud rnams kyi sha la zo: mo rgyud rnams kyi khrag la 'thung : rigs rgyud thams cad mngal nas skoms: sgo nor thams cad phyags mas thob: dgra bo'i gnyen 'dun nang 'thab thongs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma dang : nyams pa'i dgra bo mnyam par bzhes: rbad do bzlog go las mdzod cig: thal mo lan gsum brdab cing gtor ma phul: hoḥ drang srong gza' mchog gi rgyal po ki kang rā hu la chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: yum mchog khrag mig nag mo'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: chu gza' zla ba lag pa'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: me gza' nyi ma mig dmar zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: rlung gza' phur bu sgra gcan zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: sa gza' spen pa pa sangs zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: stag srin zor ba gdong gi zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: 'brog srin chu srin gdong gi zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: kong srin ba glang gdong gi zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: bam srin dred mong gdong gi zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: pho nya dur bya bzhi yi zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: drang srong gza' bdud yongs rdzogs zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: hoḥ drang srong gza' bdud 'khor bcas kyis: dgyes pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang : bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba dang : rig 'dzin bdag la 'gras pa dang : ka cha dkor nor 'phrog pa dang : gdug pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma yi: pho rgyud rnams kyi sha la zo: mo rgyud rnams kyi khrag la 'thung :

rigs rgyud thams cad mngal nas skoms: sgo nor thams cad phyags mas thob: dgra bo'i gnyen 'dun nang 'thab thongs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma dang : nyams pa'i dgra bo mnyam par bzhes: rbad do bzlog go las mdzod cig: thal mo lan gsum brdab cing gtor ma phul: hoḥ rgyal po chen po gnod sbyin 'bar ba btsan rgod bswe khrab can gyi zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: sku sprul klu yi bshan pa'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: gsung sprul btsan gyi bshan pa'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: thugs sprul tshangs pa dung thod zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: yon tan gter srung ma mo'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: phrin las rol pa sde bzhi'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: yang sprul bshan pa nyi khri'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: ban sngags mon pa nag po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: stag shar a tsa ra yi zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: spra sprel byi la mtshal bya'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: sprul pa'i btsan rgod yongs rdzogs zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: hoḥ btsan rgod 'bar ba 'khor bcas kyis: dgyes pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang : bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba dang : rig 'dzin bdag la 'gras pa dang : ka cha dkor nor 'phrog pa dang : gdug pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma yi: pho rgyud rnams kyi sha la zo: mo rgyud rnams kyi khrag la 'thung : rigs rgyud thams cad mngal nas skoms: sgo nor thams cad phyags mas thob: dgra bo'i gnyen 'dun nang 'thab thongs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma dang : nyams pa'i dgra bo mnyam par bzhes: rbad do bzlog go las mdzod cig: thal mo lan gsum brdab cing gtor ma phul: hoḥ sprul pa'i dge bsnyen gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po chos skyong dpe dkar dkor gyi bdag po chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi:

rgyal po dpe har chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: rgyal po tshangs pa chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: rgyal po li byin chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: rgyal po bhi har chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: rgyal po dpe nag chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: rgyal po shing bya chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: rgyal po dpe dmar chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: rgyal po gnam lha chen po'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: dgra bcom dang ni sngags pa'i zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: stag shar dang ni sman btsun zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: pu ṭa'i gzugs 'chang gdong can rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: gnod sbyin hor pa nor sdud zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: byi thang ke ru lug sdud zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: dkor bdag rgyal po rta sdud zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: myur mgyogs sprel mgo zas sdud zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: dkor bdag dpe dkar 'khor bcas zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: hoḥ dkor bdag chen po 'khor bcas kyis: dgyes pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang : bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba dang : rig 'dzin bdag la 'gras pa dang : ka cha dkor nor 'phrog pa dang : gdug pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma yi: pho rgyud rnams kyi sha la zo: mo rgyud rnams kyi khrag la 'thung : rigs rgyud thams cad mngal nas skoms: sgo nor thams cad phyags mas thob: dgra bo'i gnyen 'dun nang 'thab thongs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma dang : nyams pa'i dgra bo mnyam par bzhes: rbad do bzlog go las mdzod cig: gtor ma chos skyong 'grig chags su gong du gnas shing rgyas pa so sor phrin bcol bzhin 'bul mthar thal mo gsum brdab par bya/

dmigs pa gzhung gi 'don cha ltar gang lcogs bya: dus bzlog la sogs shin tu gal che ba la dar nag g.yab skong ba brgya tshar bsog: yang 'bring po 'dra yin na gzhung gi las bskul thams cad mthar rdzogs pa dang : gtor ma'i spyi 'dus gcig la tshang bar phul: bskul ring 'di phyogs kyi dmag chen byung ba'am: dgra jag chom pos ka cha 'phrog pa dang : don med kyis dgra rgol sdang sems byung na dgra bo la rtags ma thon bar nyin re rer bskul: do gal chung na tshes dgu dang bcu dgu nyer dgu rnams la bskul: bskul ba'i tshe mchod gtor shin tu rgyas par bya: bye brag phrin las so so'i sham bu sbyar dgos byung na: dgra bo 'di zhes bya ba zer nas dmigs bsal bya: hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ mi mngon chos dbyings dag pa'i pho brang nas: ye shes mgon po'i lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: chos skyong smug mthing thugs dam dus la bab: dur khrod rab 'bar tsā ri'i pho brang nas: zhing skyong dpal 'bar lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: chos skyong nag po'i thugs dam dus la bab: lho nub me dpung mun rub pho brang nas: drang srong gza' mchog lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: chos skyong khra bo'i thugs dam dus la bab: byang shar ma ru rtse yi pho brang nas: gnod sbyin btsan rgod lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: chos skyong dmar po'i thugs dam dus la bab: byang phyogs sham bha la yi pho brang nas: dpe dkar rgyal po'i lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: chos skyong dkar po'i thugs dam dus la bab: phrin las glog ltar myur ba'i pho brang nas: gter bdag gter srung yongs rdzogs skur bzhengs shig: dam can rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs dus la bab: khyed rnams mi mngon dbyings las bzhugs pa'i lha: gang la bya ba phrin las mngon par mkhyen: bdag ni zob med don gyi rnal 'byor pa: thar pa sgrub cing 'gro don phan sems kyang : bdud dgra 'byung po'i byad du ma ster bas:

kun mkhyen mgon pos gzu dpang rgyab rten mdzod: bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag dpung skyed: deng 'dir pha rol dgra bo byad ma 'dis: byas pa med kyang srog la rgol snyob byed: chags pa med kyang bu lon ded nas byung : nyi ltar gsal yang sprin ltar g.yogs nas byung : char ltar 'bebs kyang rlung ltar gtor nas byung : dung ltar dkar kyang mun ltar gnag nas byung : seng ltar 'gyings kyang rlung ltar 'tshub nas byung : mi ltar bros kyang gshed ltar bsnyags nas byung : lha ltar bstod kyang 'dre ltar smad nas byung : chos ltar bsgrubs kyang sdig ltar bsags nas byung : de ltar dam can rgya mtshos dgongs mdzod cig: rig 'dzin bdag gi byang chub sgrub pa la: 'tshe zhing sdang ba'i byad ma sdig can 'di: lo zla dus la ma 'da' myur du sgrol: khyad par dmag sna jag sna ston pa dang : rku sna ston cing khyad gsod byed pa yi: pha rol byad ma dam nyams sdig can rnams: gnam sa gling bzhi ri rab zom khang dang : chos bon srung ma rnams kyi gur khang skyabs: gzhan yang steng 'og 'khor yug gar gnas kyang : dgra bo mi nor mkhar khang sa gzhi rnams: srid pa las kyi rlung gis mkha' la phyor: myur mgyogs rtsal gyis bar snang dbyings su g.yugs: mngon spyod sgyogs kyis sa gzhi'i mthil du rdobs: phye mar bshig nas ming yang med par gyis: dbyar sos gangs ri rtse nas zhig pa bzhin: dgra bo pho rgyud thams cad rtsad nas chod: ston ser lhag pas me tog khyer ba bzhin: dgra bo mo rgyud thams cad mngal nas skoms: brag ri gnam lcags thog gis bshig pa bzhin: dgra bo'i rten mkhar thams cad rmang nas bsgyil: me rgod 'tshub mas rtswa shing bsregs pa bzhin: dgra bo'i sgo nor thams cad phyags mas thob: spang sgang lcags dbyug ngar mas brdungs pa bzhin: dgra bo'i yul zhing thams cad ser bas khongs: dbal gyi spu gris tā la bcad pa bzhin:

dgra bo'i mi rabs bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: thal me'i dong du chu nag blugs pa bzhin: dgra bo'i yul zhing thams cad phye mar dkrugs: bya rog 'ug pa 'thab pa'i snang ba bzhin: dgra bo'i pha sde nang tshan 'khrug par gyis: stag g.yag rtsal kha 'gyed pa'i 'phro mtha' bzhin: dgra bo'i dpung tshan gnyis med phung bar gyis: dus la bab bo mthu ldan srung ma rnams: mgon po'i dmag tshogs g.yab dar dgra la phyor: zhing skyong dmag tshogs ru mtshon dgra la phyor: gza' yi dmag tshogs thog mda' dgra la phob: btsan gyi dmag tshogs zhags pa dgra la thob: rgyal po'i dmag tshogs smyo 'bog dgra la thongs: pho nya 'bum gyi dmag tshogs dgra la bh+yoḥ dzaḥ dam can rgya mtsho'i shar gyi las byed pa: dri za'i rgyal po ru lu rta mgo can: dri za'i dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: shar gyi dgra bgegs thams cad cham la phob: me lha'i rgyal po drang srong ra mgo can: me lha'i dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: shar lho'i dgra bgegs thams cad cham la phob: gshin rje'i rgyal po'i khram bdag glang mgo can: gshin rje'i dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: lho yi dgra bgegs thams cad cham la phob: srin po'i rgyal po mgrin bcu mi rgod gdong : srin po'i dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: lho nub dgra bgegs thams cad cham la phob: klu yi rgyal po zhe sdang sbrul mgo can: klu yi dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: nub phyogs dgra bgegs thams cad cham la phob: rlung lha'i rgyal po g.yer shing shwa mgo can: rlung lha'i dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: nub byang dgra bgegs thams cad cham la phob: gnod sbyin rgyal po gti mug lug mgo can: gnod sbyin dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: byang phyogs dgra bgegs thams cad cham la phob: dbang ldan rgyal po glang po che yi mgo: dbang ldan dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: byang shar dgra bgegs thams cad cham la phob:

gzhon nu tshangs pa bya khyung gdong pa can: lha yi dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: steng phyogs dgra bo thams cad cham la phob: sa bdag rgyal po rus sbal gdong pa can: sa bdag dmag tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: 'og phyogs dgra bgegs thams cad cham la phob: shar gyi dmag dpon chen po yul 'khor srung : lus 'phags gling gi dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: lho yi dmag dpon rgyal po 'phags skyes po: 'dzam bu gling gi dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: nub phyogs dmag dpon rgyal po spyan mi bzang : ba lang spyod kyi dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: byang phyogs dmag dpon rgyal po rnam thos sras: sgra mi snyan gyi dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon dgra la phyor: mgon po'i dmag tshogs dar nag pu ru ru: zhing skyong dmag tshogs gtor zor wa la la: gza' yi dmag tshogs thog mda' sha ra ra: chos skyong dmag tshogs ru mtshon lhabs se lhab: shel ging dmag tshogs mtshon cha tshubs se tshub: lha yi dmag tshogs bswo sgra di ri ri: btsan gyi dmag tshogs sho kha tha ra ra: gshin rje'i dmag tshogs khram kha yugs se yug: rgyal 'gong dmag tshogs smyo 'bog chi li li: ma mo'i dmag tshogs nad rlangs phyu ru ru: dmu gnyan dmag tshogs rtsis kha ya la la: bdud kyi dmag tshogs zhags pa khyugs se khyug: klu bdud dmag tshogs mdze nad thibs se thib: dgra lha'i dmag tshogs rta rgyug springs se spring : gzhi bdag dmag tshogs go cha rongs se rong : pho nya'i dmag tshogs las byed nyi li li: bshan pa'i dmag tshogs gri brdar yugs se yug: srog gcod dmag tshogs shan pa rubs se rub: sha za'i dmag tshogs mche ba krigs se krig: khrag 'thung dmag tshogs rkan sgra thags se thag: sprul pa yang sprul nyi zer rdul ltar 'tshub: dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor bcas kyis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod:

dzaḥ gzhan yang bzlog cing dgra la bsgyur ba ni: yi dam lha yis bka' chad dgra la zlog: ma sring mkha' 'gros sun ma dgra la zlog: nor lha'i dngos grub chad pa dgra la zlog: dam can las kyi pho nya dgra la zlog: pho rgyud khro bo'i drag sngags dgra la zlog: mo rgyud ma mo'i thun sngags dgra la zlog: gshin rje dregs pa'i 'khor lo dgra la zlog: zhang zhung dzo zor 'phen pa dgra la zlog: 'byung pos thod zor 'phen pa dgra la zlog: drang srong gza' yi dug mda' dgra la zlog: bdud kyis khram kha 'debs pa dgra la zlog: btsan gyis gzer nad gtong ba dgra la zlog: klu yis gtad du bcug pa dgra la zlog: sa bdag zha grum gtong ba dgra la zlog: ma mos rims nad gtong ba dgra la zlog: gnyan gyi lhog yams dmar nad dgra la zlog: gnod sbyin za kha ston pa dgra la zlog: rgyal 'gong smyo 'bog 'khrugs pa dgra la zlog: dmu yis gnam rdo 'phen pa dgra la zlog: ban+des sngags zor 'phen pa dgra la zlog: bon pos gtor zor 'phen pa dgra la zlog: sngags pas kong zor 'phen pa dgra la zlog: skye bos mda' zor 'phen pa dgra la zlog: bud med dmod zor 'phen pa dgra la zlog: gnam nas dal kha 'bebs pa dgra la zlog: sa nas dug mda' langs pa dgra la zlog: phyogs nas dmag chen g.yos pa dgra la zlog: jag pas rta kha bsigs pa dgra la zlog: rkun mas sha chings khur ba dgra la zlog: skag dang spar kha bdun zur dgra la zlog: sme ba dbang thang nyams pa dgra la zlog: rlung rta'i rgya ma chag pa dgra la zlog: phung sri gri sri langs pa dgra la zlog: rgyal po'i bka' yis chad pa dgra la zlog: lo nyes sad ser thams cad dgra la zlog: god kha gyod byur thams cad dgra la zlog: mi kha bram mchu thams cad dgra la zlog: dur sgo gshed sgo bye ba dgra la zlog: na sri 'chi sri thams cad dgra la zlog: nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dgra la zlog: gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu dgra la zlog:

bgegs rig stong phrag brgyad cu dgra la zlog: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu dgra la zlog: glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig dgra la zlog: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad dgra la zlog: byis pa'i gdon chen bco brgyad dgra la zlog: mi mthun rkyen ngan bar chad bdud kyi tshogs: bzlog go drag po'i zor chen 'di yis zlog: bsgyur ro dam nyams dgra bo'i steng du sgyur: bh+yoḥ lha yi bu mo dung gi mche ba can: de ring dmar chen gtor ma'i zor sna drongs: klu yi bu mo dug gi kha phru can: de ring dmar chen gtor ma'i zor sna drongs: bdud kyi bu mo nad kyi rkyal pa can: de ring dmar chen gtor ma'i zor sna drongs: btsan gyi bu mo khrag gi ral pa can: de ring dmar chen gtor ma'i zor sna drongs: srin po'i bu mo zangs kyi gdong pa can: de ring dmar chen gtor ma'i zor sna drongs: myur mgyogs chen mo gdug pa'i bu mo lnga: de ring dam nyams dgra la za kha ston: dgra bgegs thams cad rtsad gcod phrin las mdzod: om̐ ka la ka la dung dung e thun bh+yo bh+yo dgra bgegs byad ma zlog zlog: ka li ra tri shan+ta pa ra nan bring bring bh+yo bh+yoḥ dgra bo byad ma zlog zlog: ma hā kā la singha mu kha si na ra ma bh+yo bh+yoḥ dgra bo byad ma zlog zlog: ki king hri shag ru raṃ nṛ tri myog bh+yo bh+yoḥ dgra bo byad ma zlog zlog: shu la e haṃ ma ru rtse tsa tri ya bh+yo bh+yoḥ dgra bo byad ma zlog zlog: ging ka ra yak+sha dhe wa rak+sha pra ma sha la tri tri dz+wa la ya bh+yo bh+yoḥ dgra bo byad ma zlog zlog: dhe wa ma tri nā ga ma tri du pra ma ma tri shu la ya ma tri rak+sha ma tri sarba rak+ṣa ka ṇa ṣa sa ma ya bh+yo bh+yoḥ dgra bo byad ma mā ra ya zlog zlog: a ya ma du ru tsa sha ghan+dha re a su re kin na re gha ru tra: ma ho rā ga du kha biṣ+ṇi ṣa bh+yo bh+yoḥ dgra bo byad ma thams cad zlog zlog: mā ra ya nan:
hūm̐ laṃ laṃ satwaṃ bha ya nan:

zhes gtor ma dgra phyogs su 'phang ngam phul ba gal che na zor thab tu 'phang : 'di bskul zor bzlog pa zhes ste: thog mar gtor ma lha yi ngo bo: bar du gtor ma dgra bgegs kyi ngo bo: tha ma gtor ma sha khrag gi ngo bo: slad mar gtor ma mtshon cha'i ngo bo: rjes nas gtor ma ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo dang bcas lugs lnga las: thog mar 'bag bsang skabs gtor ma de lha dang : bar du dgra bgegs bkug cing bstim: thim pa'i ngo bo de rang bzhin gyi mtshon chas gtubs nas sha khrag gi ngo bor bsam: de dag chos skyong rnams kyis bzhes pa'i lhag ma phran tsam lus pa de chos skyong rnams kyi kha phru yis byin brlabs pas mtshon cha sna tshogs sgyogs chen lta bas mi bzod pa'i rang bzhin du bsam: bskul zhing 'phang pa'i tshe dgra bgegs rnams la phog pas byad ma rtsad nas brlags te ming yang med par bsam: dgra bo'i tshe bsod dbang thang rang la bsdu: rjes shes mtshon cha dang dgra bo mi dmigs pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag: de yang dmag bskul zor gnyis so sor bya na: zur du gtor zlog bsdus pa'i bzlog chung zhig bzos: rbad na zor bzlog skabs gdan chos 'byung gi steng du dpal gtor gri ris can bzhag kyang rung : gtor 'bul thams cad gzhung bzhin byas: zor rnams rtsang dang tshe nyungs kun kyang 'dzugs dmod pa'i las rang gzhung ltar gces: khyad par chos skyong drag po sde lnga'i bskang gsol 'di shin tu bka' gnyan pas rtsal grags che ba gal thod thod tu mi btang : bskang gtor dang gtor zor mi la mi sbyin: bye brag tu dam nyams rnams kyi don du chos skyong mi btang : rigs kyi brgyud pa 'dzin pa dang : gtsug lag khang chos rje rnams kyi sgar gzhis ma gtogs gang yang btang bar mi bya: dpe dang gdams pa mi sbyin gal srid bskang gsol gzhung rnams gzhan don du bya rung las kyi bskul pa mi btang : khā hi'i mtshams nas bzhengs bskul spyi 'gros dang :

de nas las mtha'i bzlog byang tsam bya: de bas mang ba gzhan du mi bya: rig 'dzin rdo rje slob dpon bka' med par dpe dang gdams pa mi sby-in: ci zhe na slob ma snod dang ldan mi ldan pas bskul du mi thub: dpal ye shes kyi mgon po chen po 'di bzhengs dka': legs ldan zhing skyong 'bar ba 'di bka' gnyan: drang srong gza' bdud nag po 'di mthong bas dug che: btsan rgod gnod sbyin 'bar ba 'di stobs dang drag rtsal che: gnod sbyin rgyal po dpe dkar gdeng che la zhe nag: de bas na bskyed rdzogs kyi gdeng med pa rnams kyis spyod du mi thub pa'i rgyu de ltar snang ngo : dngos blo'i dad pa dam tshig 'dun pa gtsang ba rnams la bran bzhin du mchis par 'gyur ro: sa ma ya: e maḥ mngon spyod phul byung shes rab spu gri'i mtshon: dgra bgegs sdig can rnams la phyung zhing brdeg: las kyi rlung dang gnam lcags 'khyug pa'i thog: gang la btab kyang 'gog med rtsal po che: gang gis mi bzlog las kyi sgyogs po che: ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus kyi mtha' gyur tshe: bstan dgra sgos dgra bsgral ba'i mtshon char shog: dpal gyi mchims phur mi nub a thaṃ rgya: bka' yi chos 'di dam can sde lngas skyongs: dam med bdud kyi lag tu ma shor gtad: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: mi nub rgya: sngags 'chang rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa pho khyi lor bod yul bsam yas mchims phu'i ke'u tshang nas gdan drangs shing me pho rta yi lo la sbas yul bdud 'dul gsang sngags gling du zangs shog dmar po nas zhal bshus so// // tha)bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon las: zhun mar smon lam bzhugs so// // gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: dkyil 'khor bya ba rdzogs nas ni: smon lam dga' ston rim pa bstan: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog:

dkyil 'khor bya ba mthar phyin nas: dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang : dkyil 'khor mdun du mar me brgya: gtams shing mched lcam 'dus byas te: rdo rje slob dpon gzungs ma dang : dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi dam tshig nyams: phyi nang sgrib dang bshags pa dang : nam yang gcig tu 'tshogs pa'i phyir: bshags pa smon lam 'di ltar brjod: thams cad pus btsugs thal mo sbyar: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ las kong bu rin po che chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam par gyur cig: āḥlas mar khu 'dod yon lnga'i rang bzhin rgya mtsho'i klong dang mnyam par gyur cig: hūm̐ las sdong bu ye shes lnga yi me nyi zla chos kyi rang bzhin ltar gsal bar gyur: hrīḥde las mchod pa'i lha tshogs ā lo ke dpag tu med pa spros pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing rdo rje slob dpon gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor la 'bul bar gyur: oṃ dharma dz+nyā na ā lo ke āḥhūm̐: de nas mgrin gcig la 'di skad do: e ma hoḥ chos rnams rang bzhin skye med rnam dag kyang : ma rig dbang gis bdag 'dzin so sor phyes: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gzungs dag gi: thugs dang 'gal ba mthol bshags bzod par gsol: longs sku ye shes ma 'gags 'char ba la: ngar 'dzin dbang gis sna tshogs rtag chad 'dzin: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gzungs dag gi: gsung dang 'gal ba mthol bshags bzod par gsol: sna tshogs sprul sku rang byung rtsol bral ba: yid dpyod blo yis 'khor 'das ris su phyes: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gzungs dag gi: sku dang 'gal ba mthol bshags bzod par gsol: dkyil 'khor gcig tu dam tshig bka' mnos pas: rdo rje mched dang lcam dral grogs rnams la: log lta skyon gyur ma dag ci mchis pa: deng nas bzung ste mthol bshags bzod par gsol: phyi nang rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig dang : sdom pa nyams dang 'gal bar gyur pa dang : mchod rdzas ma tshang 'byor rdzas chung ba sogs:

bag med ci mchis mthol bshags bzod par gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: e ma hoḥ bla med gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor la: bdag lus longs spyod dge rtsa phyi nang bcu: rang byung gsal ba'i sgron me sbar te 'bul: kun gzhi rnam dag skye med kong bu ru: ka dag khregs chod gshis kyi mar khus bkang : lta ba zang thal 'od gsal sgron me 'di: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gzungs la 'bul: sna tshogs rang shar ma 'gags kong bu ru: ye shes lnga ldan dran rig mar khus bkang : sna tshogs 'dzin med rang byung sgron me 'di: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gzungs la 'bul: rtsa khams rnam dag 'khor lo'i kong bu ru: byang sems bde chen dgyes pa'i mar khus bkang : rlung sems tsit+ta gsal ba'i sgron me sbar: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gzungs la 'bul: hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon gnyan gyi dal bzung nas: rang byung ye shes sgron me sbar ba'i tshe: ma rig mun pa'i stong khams gsal ba dang : dmyal ba'i zangs khar nang du mi ltung zhing : nyon mongs las kyi dbang du mi gtong shog: smon lam rten 'brel zhun mar 'di sbar bas: bdag 'dzin gcong rong zab mor mi ltung zhing : rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mi myong shog: bsod nams tshogs chen zhun mar 'di sbar bas: dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi mchod pa mi nyams shing : zag med nam mkha' mdzod la spyod par shog: hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor rigs kyi bdag: shes rab gnyan gyi 'brel ba'i gzungs ma rnams: tshe rabs mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: sa gsum dkyil 'khor rten la 'tshogs par shog: rdo rje mched lcam 'brel ba'i dam tshig can: skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du: dkyil 'khor 'di bzung rnga yab dpal ri ru: pad 'byung rgyal ba'i sras su 'tshogs par shog: 'da' ka rdo rje'i dam tshig gnyan po yi: rgyud dang lung gi 'brel ba'i skal ldan rnams:

sa bcu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: tshe rabs rtag tu bdag gi yi dam lha: 'dzin cing chos kyi sgra chen sgrog par shog: smon lam bzang po rten 'brel bslu med kyi: bden tshig skad cig dus 'dir 'grub par shog: bsngo ba smon lam bya zhing slob dpon la phyag dang bskor ba bya: dga' ston gyi rten 'brel bzang po bsgrig: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs rjes 'jug bu yi don: rdzas kyi rten 'brel bya ba gces: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: kha thaṃ rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum pa chos kyi rgya mtshos pad+ma sbas pa'i tshal nas gdan drangs shing pad+ma chos gling du zhal bsgyur ro: sarba bha wan+tu// da)ying bag chuzos zin/ ༈ bla ma'i thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel las: gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun 'grub bzhugs so: e ma hoḥ nub phyogs bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams su: snang mtha'i sprul pa 'dzam bu gling du byon: o rgyan dha na ko sha'i mtsho las 'khrungs: in+d+ra bhū tis rgyal srid mnga' gsol mdzad: za hor rgyal po'i bstan pa chos la btsud: 'gro ba'i mgon po o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rgyal srid spangs nas dur khrod gnas brgyad byon: ta na ga ṇa'i sbyor sgrol spyod pa mdzad: rgya gar mu stegs dmag tshogs dam la btags: man+da ra sogs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon mdzad: rgya gar thams cad rin chen gter gyis bkang : rig 'dzin gtso bo o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: thugs rje'i dgongs pas bod la gzigs pa'i tshe: bal bod mtshams su lha srin dam la btags: mkhan slob chos gsum bod la nyi ma shar:

bsam yas la sogs mtha' 'dul yang 'dul grub: mdo sngags gnyis kyi chos kyi sgron me sbar: thugs rje'i bdag nyid o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bsam yas mchims phur bde 'dus sgrub chen mdzad: rje 'bangs rgya mtshor chos kyi bka' chen phab: sku tshab nyer lnga bod kyi don la bzhag: dgongs brda nam mkha' rgya mtsho'i shog ser la: ye shes lnga ldan tshom bu'i tshul du zug: kha byang yang byang lung byang rgya chen bsdams: dus gsum kun mkhyen o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: khra 'brug rtsa gsum bka' 'dus zhal phyes tshe: man+da ra ba mkha' spyod gnas nas byon: dkyil 'khor byin 'bebs bkra shis mtha' rten mdzad: 'gro don mthar phyin o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: thugs sras lnga dang rje 'bangs nyer lnga la: zhal gdams don tshan ma 'ongs lung bstan bzhag: 'dzam gling khams kun rin chen gter gyis bkang : lho nub gdong dmar srin po'i kha gnon mdzad: thugs rjes bod kyi sems can don la gzigs: grub thob rgyal po o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: skal ldan las can gsol ba btab pa'i tshe: nangs re dgong re bod kyi don la byon: yar mar tshes bcu'i dus su dngos su byon: rig 'dzin rnams kyi zhal mjal lung bstan gnang : gnas chen dus bzang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon mdzad: gtan gyi skyabs mchog o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gter la dbang sgyur smin grol dkyil 'khor gyi: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba'i tshe:

rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs: byin 'bebs dbang bskur bkra shis rab gnas mdzad: mchog thun dngos grub 'byung bar the tshom med: byin rlabs kun 'dus o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar: rigs dang dkyil 'khor lhag pa'i lhar gyur nas: bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum bdag gyur pa'i: phrin las 'gro 'dren dpal du 'byung gyur cig: om̐ gu ru badz+ra yo gi ni sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes gsol 'debs 'di o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas bsam yas mchims phu nas gdan drangs pa'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // na) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: spyi dril gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun 'grub ma'i las byang chog khrigs ye shes sprin phung bzhugs so/ rtsa gsum bde gshegs kun 'dus lha la 'dud/ de la rtsa gsum kun 'dus kyi rgyab chos gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun 'grub ma'i lha tshogs spyi dril gyi las byang chog khrigs su bsdebs pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa'o/ dang po ni/ gzhung las/ thog mar 'jug pa'i chos la rnam pa drug: dang po skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa dang : bgegs bskrad mtshams gcod mchod pa byin rlabs so: dang po byin dbab skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo: gdod nas rnam dag sangs rgyas chos kyi sku: brgyad khri bzhi stong dam chos longs spyod rdzogs: gang 'dul der ston dge 'dun sprul pa'i sku: dkon mchog sku gsum dbyer med o rgyan rje: gsol 'debs skyabs gsol brtse chen thugs rjes gzigs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rig 'dzin bde gshegs 'dus pa bla ma'i sku: che mchog yi dam 'dus pa bla ma'i gsung : mkha' 'gro bde chen 'dus pa bla ma'i thugs: nor lha 'dus pa bla ma'i yon tan gter:

chos skyong 'dus pa bla ma'i phrin las rtsal: rtsa gsum kun 'dus gu ru rin po che: gsol 'debs skyabs gsol brtse chen thugs rjes gzigs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: mthong grol sku yi gzi brjid 'od du 'bar: phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs thams cad sprin ltar gtibs: thos grol gsung gi sgra dbyangs theg chen mdzod: sna tshogs 'gro 'dul chos sgra 'brug stong ldir: tshor grol thugs kyi dgongs pa ris med gsal: rtsol med rang byung ye shes lhang gis ston: dran pa tsam gyis mthu dpung byin rlabs bskyed: tshad med thugs rje mnga' ba'i gu ru rje: gsol 'debs skyabs gsol brtse chen thugs rjes gzigs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bdag sogs khams gsum rigs drug sems can kun: 'di phyi'i re ltos skyid sdug khyed shes pas: brtse chen thugs rjes nam yang mi gtong zhing : smin grol dbang dang dngos grub dus 'dir stsol: rig grol sku las ye shes 'od dpung 'bar: las nyon rtog sgrib gzhob dud thu lu lu: myong grol thugs rje'i byin rlabs char rgyun gyis: dbang bzhi'i don rgyud nyams rtogs ya la la: btags grol zab don tshig brgyud man ngag rnams: chos dang rang rgyud 'dres par byin gyis rlobs: tshe 'dir rang rig chos sku mngon gyur nas: longs spyod sprul sku'i 'gro don mthar phyin shog: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:

gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ kyaiḥ bde gshegs ma hā gu ru dgongs su gsol: bdag gi pha khyed snying nas sgrub lags na: sku yi phyag rgya lus la rdzogs pa dang : gsung gi nus rtsal ngag la smin nas su: thugs kyi ye shes dgaungs pa mngon gyur nas: mtha' med 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i pha ma rnams: gang la gang 'dul phrin las rnam pa bzhi: byang chub mchog tu 'god par sems bskyed nas: gu ru yid bzhin nor bu'i thugs rje yis: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gsum pa yan lag bdun pa ni: hūm̐: ma hā gu ru bde chen chos kyi rje: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid: rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad la: lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: mchod pa'i bye brag dpag med ci bgyis pa: kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin chen po ltar: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rgya mtsho rnams: o rgyan gu ru 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bdag gzhan 'gro drug lus ngag yid gsum gyis: tshe rabs thogs med dus nas da lta'i bar: mi dge sdig pa'i las rnams ci mchis pa: rje btsun ma hā gu ru'i spyan sngar bshags: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba sras bcas kyi: dpag med dge ba'i tshogs gnyis gter chen 'di: yon tan dpag yas lhun 'byams yongs mnga' bar: bdag cag gus pas rjes su yi rang ngo : bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru'i byin rlabs thugs rje rgya mtsho yis: 'gro drug mang po so so'i sgra skad du: dri med gsung gi bdud rtsi bla med kyis: chos kyi 'khor lo rtag par bskor du gsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru 'chi med rdo rje'i sku: ma gyur 'gro ba thugs rjes skyong ba'i phyir:

ji srid 'jig rten 'khor ba ma stongs bar: thugs rje mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bla ma bde gshegs rgyal ba sras bcas la: phyag 'tshal mchod sogs dge tshogs ci mchis pa: 'gro kun rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob bya'i phyir: dmigs med mtha' bral chos dbyings chen por bsngo: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: lnga pa bgegs bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid dbang drag 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas: gzi byin 'od stong zer ma phyogs bcur 'phros: de yi shugs las bgegs rnams snying rjes bkug: gtor ma len phyir lhag med gnas 'dir mchis: lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha ya dzaḥdzaḥ bgegs tshogs 'byung po a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ de nas kha phyir bstan la/ hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs dang 'byung po log 'dren tshogs: deng phan de dag byang chub lam dgod phyir: yid mthun 'dod yon mchod sbyin 'di khyer la: gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du bde bar dengs: ci ste mi 'gro gdug pa'i sems 'chang na: bdag nyid dbang chen drag sngags phyung rdeg gis: khyod kyi lus ngag yid gsum rdul du brlag: de bas rang rang gnas su phyir dengs shig: oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bgegs gtor btang la thun brdeg cing : hūm̐ hrīḥ bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang : yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong mthu rtsal gyis: dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs: log par 'dren pa bdud kyi tshogs: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'tshe byed na: bdag nyid dpal chen thugs khros nas: khro bo spros pas nam mkha' gang : khro mo spros pas sa gzhi gang : sras mchog khro chung bar snang gang : me yi bya khyung phyogs bcur 'khrigs: drwa mig lcags sdig glog ltar 'khyug: 'khor yug mtshon char thog ltar 'bebs: bgegs tshogs thal ba rdul du brlag:

de bas bka' las ma 'da' zhig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ a hūm̐: badz+ra hūm̐: rak+sha hūm̐: yak+sha hūm̐: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya gnod byed bgegs tshogs thams cad tshin+dha tshin+dha bhan+dha bhan+dha ha na ha na pa tsa pa tsa ma tha ma tha da ha da ha hu lu hu lu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: lnga pa mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐: nga nyid gdod nas rab khros he ru kaḥ ka dag thugs las rdol ba'i shes rab mtshon: rno dbal lhun grub drag rtsal 'gengs pa'i tshogs: bar med khyab ste skar ltar rab 'khrugs pa: srung mtshams med par dum bu gcig pa ni: e yi mkha' ltar khyab pa'i gur khang gyur: oṃ badz+ra dharma dz+nyā na tsakra e kham̐ ram̐ dz+wa la rak+ṣa ye swā hā: drug pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes mchod gzhi khyab par bsang chu gtor zhing*/ phyi mchod la dmigs te/ hūm̐: rig pa'i gru 'dzin khyon ltar yangs pa'i dbus: phyi mchod lha mo me tog bdug spos ma: mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo dang : gzugs mdzes lang ling gar ma yid 'ong rigs: lta na sdug cing tshul bzang mchod thogs tshogs: grangs med sprul pas rgyal ba mnyes rdzas gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: lan gsum bdud rtsi la dmigs te/ hūm̐: bhan+dha mtshan ldan lcang lo 'khyil ba'i nang : sha lnga rdzas lnga pañca a mṛ ta: dri lnga 'bru bcud chang dang dza gad phud: sman mchod dug lnga sel ba'i ye shes mdangs: dkar mngar kha dang ro skyur zhun gyi rigs: sna tshogs tshang 'di rgyal ba mnyes rdzas gyur: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ lan gsum rak+ta la dmigs te/ hūm̐: bum ril bhan+dha dum gcig zlum po'i dbus: bzang mo'i mkha' yi mu kha sgra gcan gyi: 'khor lo khyab 'jug myur 'gros rab bskul nas: 'bar ba'i rlung las rgyu ba'i byams chen po:

chags med dmar chen gzi 'od 'khyil ba'i tshogs: mtsho ltar 'khrugs pa rgyal ba mnyes rdzas gyur: oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ lan gsum gtor ma la dmigs te/ hūm̐: thams cad rin chen las grub nyi zla'i snod: rgya che srid pa'i khyon ltar 'thug pa'i dbus: snod gzugs bsdus pa'i bcud mchog bha ling+ta: lhun mtho dbyings la bsnyegs pa'i rgyan mdzes btsugs: mdangs ldan bcud mchog rgyas pa'i zer stong 'khyugs: kun tshang 'tshogs 'di rgyal ba mnyes rdzas gyur: oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes lan gsum gyis spel/ gnyis pa/ dngos gzhi dngos la sgrub gzhi dam tshig dkyil 'khor bskyed: sgrub don ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren bstim: sgrub thabs mchod bstod dzapa ྄bzlas mdo don gsum: zhes pas thog mar dam tshig dkyil 'khor bskyed pa la lnga las/ dang po sku gsum ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni/ hūm̐: zab zhi spros bral gdod nas chos kyi dbyings: bya rtsol skye 'gag bral ba ka nas dag: dmigs med mkha' ltar khyab pa'i klong chen po: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru dharma dhā tu āḥ hūm̐: chos dbyings ngang las rtsol bral thugs rje'i 'od: mkhyen brtse'i rang bzhin phyogs ris med par brdal: phrin las shugs la rdzogs pa'i nus stobs can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru dz+nyā na sa twa hūm̐: hūm̐: thams cad snying po byang chub sems kyi gzhi: kun byed brda ston ye shes rdo rje hūm̐: 'gro don thugs rjes skyob mdzad sprul pa'i sku: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐:

gnyis pa klong lnga'i dgongs pa gsal gdab pa/ hūm̐: dbyings kyi rang bzhin chos dbyings stong pa'i mkha': thabs kyis bskyed pa snod bcud srid pa'i gzhi: klong lnga'i dgongs pa ye shes rdo rje'i rtsal: dbyings kyi thig ler rdzogs pa'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru dz+nyā na pañca e: gsum pa gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: 'og min lhun grub zhing gi bkod pa'i khyon: rin chen 'od lnga 'bar ba'i sa gzhi ni: phyogs dang phyogs bral nam mkha'i pha mthar brdal: thig le thig phran lug rgyud zer dpung 'khrigs: rdo rje'i 'od las rin chen gzhal med khang : dkar ser dmar ljang bzhi la brtsegs rim lnga: nang du sku gsum thod pa tshar gsum brtsegs: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs 'dod snam 'khor: pha gu drwa phyed mda' yab shar bu sogs: zhi rgyas dbang drag brda rtags rdzu 'phrul gyis: phyi nang rgyan rdzogs snang stong 'od skur 'thibs: chos dbyings dur khrod rdo rwa me gur 'bar: bde chen zhing bkod rdzogs pa'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍal hūm̐: bzhi pa dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: pho brang gzhal yas dbus kyi lte ba la: rin chen zur brgyad seṅge glang chen rta: rma bya shang shang gis btegs nor bu'i khrir: dar zab 'bol brtsegs pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : 'khor yug rin chen pad+ma'i phreng bas bskor: dbus su hūm̐ las ma hā gu ru rje: snang srid zil gnon dmar smug khro 'dzum sgeg: 'dab ldan dar gyi snyan zhu gsang gos dkar: dar dmar chos gos mthing nag phod chen gsol: smug nag ber phyam snyan rgyan mgul rgyan mdzes: rdo rje bhan+dha tshe bum kha ṭ+wāṃ brten: zhabs gnyis swag lham rgyal po rol pa'i stabs:

'gying bag brjid ldan nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi: tsha zer 'khrigs pas phyogs bcu'i zhing kun khyab: thugs kyi ngo bo bla ma rdo rje 'chang : mthing gsal rang 'od yum 'khril longs spyod rdzogs: rdo rje dril 'dzin 'od lnga'i klong du gsal: gsang sngags don brgyud rdzogs pa'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: dbu gtsug 'ja' 'od tshom bu 'bar ba'i klong : shrī singha dmar smug cang dril bsil: dbang mo zung 'jug rnal 'byor spyod pa'i chas: dga' rab rdo rje dkar gsal he ru kaḥ rdo rje thod 'dzin rnal 'byor ma dang sbyor: rdo rje sems dpa' rigs lnga yab yum dang : thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun bzang 'od mi 'gyur: dmar gsal mnyam bzhag skyil krung drang por bzhugs: dgongs brda brgyud pa'i rig 'dzin bla ma rnams: snang stong sku yi phyag rgya 'od stong 'bar: dbang bzhi chu bo gcig bsdus thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de yi phyi rim phyogs kyi pad 'dab bzhir: shar phyogs pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: nyon mongs rang grol rigs drug sdug bsngal skyob: rig 'dzin 'dus pa bde chen rgyal po'i sku: dmar smug khro 'dzum mtsho rgyal dkar mo sbyor: rdor dril bsnol stabs longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'khor: rnam smin rig 'dzin mdangs lnga gsang ye sbyor: sa gnas rig 'dzin nyi zla bde chen dkar: phyag rgya rig 'dzin ser gsal mthing 'od sngo: tshe dbang rig 'dzin rdo rje rnal 'byor dmar: lhun grub rig 'dzin las kyi dbang mo ljang : 'khril sbyor gri thod ḍā ru bhan+dha bsnams: gtso bo'i chas rdzogs ye shes rang 'od 'bar: sdug bsngal bde chen mchog sbyor thugs rje can:

gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: lho phyogs pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: tshogs drug rang grol bag chags dbyings su sbyor: thugs kyi bdag nyid bud+dha he ru kaḥ mthing gsal rdo rje bhan+dha longs spyod rdzogs: rol stabs lha lcam dmar mo 'khril sbyor rol: sku yi bdag nyid badz+ra thod phreng dkar: yon tan bdag nyid rat+na thod phreng ser: gsung gi bdag nyid pad+ma thod phreng dmar: phrin las bdag nyid karma thod phreng ljang : rigs kyi phyag mtshan bhan+dha yum dang rol: dus gsum kun mkhyen 'gro drug lam sna 'dren: 'khrul snang rang sar grol ba'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: nub phyogs pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: 'byung lnga rang grol dpa' bo gyad kyi sku: mtsho skyes rdo rje sprul sku'i cha lugs can: chos gos gsum ldan pad zhwa rtse rnon gsol: sa gnon rdo rje mnyam bzhag bhan+dha bsnams: bde stong kha ṭ+wāṃ ye shes rol pa'i 'khor: mā kī dkar mo sangs rgyas spyan ma ser: gos dkar dmar mo dam tshig sgrol ma ljang : 'khor lo rin chen pad+ma rgya gram g.yas: g.yon rnams dril 'dzin lha mo'i chas kun rdzogs: phyed skyil 'byung lnga'i rang bzhin gsal 'tsher 'bar: dbyings rig dbyer med sbyor ba'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: byang phyogs pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: 'pho ltung 'jigs skrag rang grol zab lam ston: rdo rje rnal 'byor dmar gsal cung zad khro: rus rgyan zangs gri bhan dmar brkyang bskum gar: rjes chags gzhan snang dbang sdud phag zhal ngur: bde chen kha ṭ+wāṃ dkur brten gar dgu'i nyams:

mkha' spyod sa spyod bde spyod zab spyod kyi: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi dkar ser dmar ljang mdog: gtso mo'i chas rdzogs zhi rgyas chags dang khro: las bzhi phrin las dbu ma'i chos sgo 'byed: bde chen dag zhing 'dren pa'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: phyogs mtshams nam mkhar sgrub sde brgyad kyi lha: dam pa rigs brgya'i lha tshogs tshom bur 'khrigs: rin chen zur brgyad pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad las bzhi'i gar: ma 'dres mtshan rdzogs phyogs mtshams 'gro ba 'dul: mtshams brgyad rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las: ḍāk+ki sde bzhi zhi rgyas dbang drag gi: bde spyod gar ldan ye shes rang 'od 'bar: rdo rje bdud 'dul ma dang zhi ba mtsho: rdo rje phra men mtsho gling mkha' 'gro rnams: las mdog phyag mtshan gri thod kha ṭ+wāṃ gaḥ rigs kyi ḍāk+ki 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor dgyes bskang thugs dam bskul: thabs dang shes rab phrin las du ma yis: 'gro don stobs chen mdzad pa'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de yi phyi rim 'ja' zer mu khyud kyi: sna tshogs pad 'khor 'od lnga'i drwa ba mdzes: shar du dug lnga'i nad sel sman gyi lha: log 'dren bdud dpung 'joms mdzad seṅge'i sgra: mthing nag rab khros dpa' bo dpa' ba'i chas: nyon mongs rtsad gcod phag mo dmar mo 'khril: rdo rje dril 'dzin gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan: pad nyi'i gdan steng ye shes me dpung 'bar: dbu gtsug drang srong sman lha baiḍūr mdog: mnyam bzhag mchog sbyin lhung bzed a ru ra: stong gsum 'byung ba'i bcud sdud mgyogs ma bzhi: tshe 'phrang bar chad sel ba'i thugs rje can:

gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: lho phyogs dbul phongs gdung sel 'dod rgu'i rje: pad+ma rgyal po dmar smug sgeg pa'i gzugs: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs gnyis rol pa'i stabs: g.yas gsum rdo rje rgyal mtshan lcags kyu dang : g.yon gsum thod pa ne'u le pad+ma bsnams: longs spyod rab rdzogs dbang mo zung 'jug 'khril: rin chen pad+ma nyi zla'i gzi brjid 'bar: gsang yum man+da ra dang mtsho rgyal ma: gling bzhi dbang sgyur mgyogs ma sde bzhi'i tshogs: dgos 'dod re ba skong ba'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: nub tu bdud bzhi g.yul las rgyal ba'i stobs: gzhom bral gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po'i sku: mthing nag rab khros dur khrod chas kun rdzogs: rdo rje'i go ldan gnam lcags bu yug 'tshubs: phyag g.yas rgya gram g.yon pas thog rgod 'bebs: drag rtsal stobs ldan spyi bor bya khyung lding : rdo rje'i gdan la dor stabs srid gsum gnon: rnam rgyal mi g.yo stobs chen dbyug sngon rgyal: rang rtags phyag mtshan rgyan rdzogs me dpung klong : rdo rje'i go cha rdzogs pa'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: byang du phung byed bdud dgra gzhaum pa'i rgyal: shān+tiṃ gar+bha bdud 'joms nag po'i sku: srid gsum srog bdag dur khrod dpal chas rdzogs: rdo rje'i rwa rtser gnam lcags 'khor lo bskor: lcags sdig kha nas phur bu char du 'bebs: sku smad dbal gsham mu stegs snying la gzir: lha dang gshin rje ma bdud rgyal po btsan: gnod sbyin klu gnyan gza' bdud dmu rje sogs:

'jig rten dregs pa'i sde dpon yongs kyis bskor: pha rol dmag dpung bzlog pa'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: shar lhor bdud bzhi 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i mgon: bde gshegs kun 'dus pad+ma thod phreng dmar: rgyal po'i cha lugs rdo rje mkha' la gdengs: g.yon pa mnyam bzhag bhan+dha bdud rtsis gtams: gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ brten mdzad 'gying bag can: zhabs gnyis rol stabs bzod dka'i gzi byin 'bar: snang srid zil gnon bde stong gsang ba'i yum: gar ging dpa' bo ḍāk+ki'i tshogs dang bcas: chos mdzad lam sna 'dren pa'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: lho nub zab gter sgo 'byed phyag rgya rdzogs: dbang drag khro rgyal badz+ra lo ha he: dmar nag am gtsigs rdo rje phur bu gdengs: thod skam dbu rgyan dbu skra khams nag gtibs: stag sham rus rgyan mgo phreng wang long 'khrol: stag mo grus ma'i steng na ya 'dor 'gyings: rigs bdag pad+ma thod phreng yab yum dang : phyogs bzhir mkha' 'gro sde bzhi bde spyod gar: bka' dang gter srung dbang sdud gus pas 'dud: zab gsang gter la spyod pa'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: nub byang snang srid dbang sdud he ru kaḥ brtul zhugs ngar ldan dmar ser khro 'dzum nyams: nyi ma 'od zer nyi zer bhan+dha bsnams: stag sham rus rgyan phyag zhabs gdub bu 'khrol: phyed skyil rol stabs 'od zer spyan ma 'khril: yab yum gnyis med ye shes gzi byin 'bar: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bde stong rol: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gar:

zab gter sbas gnas dga' bzhi'i gsang sgo 'byed: thogs med rten 'brel mnga' ba'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: byang shar ma rungs bdud tshogs mthar byed che: dregs pa zil gnon gtum drag he ru kaḥ smug nag am gtsigs bdud 'dul sngags pa'i chas: dug sbrul sku rags gnam lcags phur bu bsnams: phyag g.yas rtse gsum g.yon pas seng phur 'dril: pad nyi baṃ steng zil gnon stangs stabs gar: khrag 'thung mngon spyod lha srin sde brgyad 'dul: khro chen sde bzhi gtum rngam bzhad gshe 'bar: phyag mtshan bzhi ldan stobs bcu'i rtsal chen 'byin: log 'dren rgol ba tshar gcod thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: gru chad bar khyams khor yug gnas yul gyi: dpa' bo ḍāk+ki ging chen sgo skyong sde: bar snang lha klu gnod sbyin mi'i rig 'dzin: rgya bod mkhas grub bka' brgyud bla ma rnams: thugs rje'i sprin gtibs byin rlabs char rgyun 'bebs: 'dod snam mchod sprin lha mos gar stabs bsgyur: nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang gang ba yi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam dgyes par bskang : mchog thun dngos grub stsol ba'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong zhing bstan pa srung : dbang mo nyer brgyad mkha' 'gro sum cu gnyis: ma bdun sring bzhi ging chen bco brgyad dang : 'bar ma brgyad dang sa bdag sum cu gnyis: pho nya sum brgya drug cu laṅka'i tshogs: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang : phyi rgyud gtsang ris mgon po bdun cu lnga:

bka' dang bstan skyong phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub: 'khor 'das dbyer med dkyil 'khor gcig gi ngang : khams gsum yongs su sgrol ba'i thugs rje can: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐:

lnga pa gnas gsum rgyas gdab cing snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ hūm̐: de ltar bskyed pa'i dam tshig 'khor lo yi: spyi bor zla ba mgrin par pad+ma dmar: thugs kar nyi steng oṃ dkar āḥdamar po: hūm̐ mthing las 'phros 'od zer dpag med pas: rang bzhin chos dbyings rnga yab dpal ri nas: rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i lha tshogs rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren snying nas gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gnyis pa sgrub don ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drang ba la gnyis las dang po ni/ snyan pa'i dbyangs dang gdung ba'i shugs kyis/ hūm̐: bzhengs shig pad+ma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dgongs shig phyogs bcu'i dus gsum bde gshegs rnams: rje btsun chen po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: rig 'dzin yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: chos sku skye med dbyings las ma g.yos kyang : sprul bsgyur gzugs kyis 'gro don mdzad pa'i phyir: rtse gcig phur tshugs dad pas gsol ba 'debs: thugs rje'i dbyings nas bzhengs te skur bskyod 'tshal: byin rlabs mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams: g.yel ba med par dus 'dir stsal du gsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: thugs rje'i stobs kyis mdzad pa'i phrin las shugs: cir yang bsgyur ba'i mthu stobs rtsal 'bar zhing : 'gyur med sku ni lta bas chog mi shes: gar gyi stangs stabs brda 'gros lam se lam: 'gag med gsung gi sgra dbyangs nus pa ldan: hūm̐ dang phaṭ kyi 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: 'khrul med thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su khyab: brtse chen thugs kyi byin rlabs thibs se thib: rnam 'gyur yon tan du ma brjod las 'das: yid bzhin 'bad med dngos grub char ltar 'bebs: 'gro 'dul phrin las gar yang thogs pa med: zhi rgyas dbang drag cig car sha ra ra: gsol ba 'debs so o rgyan rin po che:

bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru 'dus pa'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams: rnam 'gyur cha lugs cir yang ston byed cing : nyi zla'i 'od 'phro gzi byin ya la la: dbu skra mdzes pa'i thor tshugs shigs se shig: sna tshogs dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: rin chen rus pa'i rgyan cha khra la la: dri zhim spos kyi ngad pa chi li li: sgra dbyangs rol mo mang po ti ri ri: dpa' bos hūm̐ sgra bro rdung 'u ru ru: dpa' mos glu len gar stabs khrigs se khrig: ging chen pho nyas bshugs pa kyu ru ru: zhi tshogs mdangs ldan gar sgyur shigs se shig: 'ja' dang 'od kyi gur khang thibs se thib: khro tshogs rngam brjid 'cham stabs lams se lam: drag sngags gnam lcags thog ser sha ra ra: dam can chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: myur mgyogs me rlung glog dmar tshubs se tshub: nor lha gter bdag sgeg bzhad ya la la: dgos 'byung longs spyod bu yug chi li li: sde brgyad bshan pa'i tshogs ni rubs se rub: mda' mdung mtshon cha'i rno dbal zengs se zeng : mtha' sdud pho nya'i tshogs ni nyi li li: dug rlangs nad kyi rlung dmar 'u ru ru: kun kyang 'bar ba'i cha lugs rngam pa'i sku: bdud 'dul dpal gyi rta bro chems se chem: nad gdon sdig sgrib rkyen tshogs sangs se sangs: thugs rje'i stobs bskyed nus pa'i rtsal phyungs la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char ltar phob: dkyil 'khor gzhal yas 'di la byin chen phob: rnal 'byor sgrub mchog bu la byin gyis rlobs: phyi nang gsang dbang ma lus bskur du gsol: gsol ba 'debs so o rgyan rin po che: pho brang chen po 'di la brtan par bzhugs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: mthu chen khyed kyi mthu rtsal nus pa phyungs: rtags dang mtshan ma ma lus bstan du gsol: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i thugs dam dus la bab: ma g.yel bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs:

rang bzhin gnas nas skur bzhengs 'dir gshegs la: dbang chen khyod kyis bdag la dbang mchog stsol: byin chen khyod kyis bdag la byin phob cig: bla ma'i sku las ye shes gzi brjid che: rnal 'byor lus la bde ba bskyed du gsol: yi dam gsung gi byin rlabs nus pa ldan: sgrub pa mthar phyin dngos grub stsal du gsol: mkha' 'gro'i thugs kyi dgongs pa klong du gyur: ci bsam yid bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol: bdag sogs byang chub snying po ma thob par: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad 'dul ba dang : mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: ha ri ni sa badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ zhes spyan drangs pas/ mngon rtogs ltar byon par bsams la/ gnyis pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: ting 'dzin cho 'phrul ye shes rol pa'i zhing : pho brang rang bzhin dam pa rgya re che: rin chen rgyu lnga'i khri mchog dpangs re mtho: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan mdzes 'od re gsal: phyi nang stong gsal gzhal yas nyams re dga': 'ja' tshon spel legs bkod pa dwangs re spro: sgom pa'i lha tshogs bkrag mdangs gzi byin 'bar: ma bsgoms sangs rgyas rang bzhin lhun gyis grub: gnyis med 'gro ba'i don du sku bzhugs 'tshal: gsol ba 'debs so o rgyan rin po che: bdag sogs 'gro kun byang chub ma rnyed bar: thugs rje rtse gcig breng breng bdag la dgongs: sgrib dag ye shes chos sku 'char ba dang : bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba tiṣ+ṭha lhan: gsum pa sgrub thabs phyag 'tshal mchod bstod dzap bzlas bcas don tshan dgu las/ dang po mos gus phyag mchod ni/ e ma hoḥ dus gsum skye 'gag med pa chos kyi sku: bde chen 'du 'bral med pa longs spyod rdzogs: 'gag med cir yang ston pa sprul pa'i sku:

sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: skye 'chi med pa rdo rje lta bu'i sku: 'gag med gsung dbyangs thos grol dam pa'i gsung : mkhyen brtse ye shes mnyam nyid rig pa'i thugs: sku gsung thugs ldan pad+mar phyag 'tshal lo: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: log 'dren bdud bzhi bcom pa sangs rgyas dngos: chos sgo kun la thogs med dam pa'i chos: mdo sngags zung 'jug skur ston dge 'dun sde: mchog gsum kun 'dus pad+mar phyag 'tshal lo: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: zhi ba'i las mdzad nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs: rgyas pa'i las mdzad tshe dpal ye shes bskyed: dbang gi las mdzad rang snang dge la sbyor: drag po'i las mdzad gzung 'dzin kun rtog bsgral: mchog thun lhun grub rang byung ye shes ston: phrin las rdzogs pa'i rje la phyag 'tshal lo: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gang la gang 'dul tshad med thugs rje'i rtsal: thabs shes dbyer med rnam bzhi'i 'khor los bsgyur: ye shes las grub bka' sdod pho nya'i tshul: chos nyid rnam dag lha la phyag 'tshal lo: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī a ti pu hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ gnyis pa thun mong spyi yi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams rgya mtsho na: dri bral yan lag brgyad ldan mchod yon tshogs: ma lus thogs med blo yis yongs bsdus te: ting 'dzin dgongs brgyud dag pas byin brlabs nas: bde gshegs rgyal ba thugs rje can la 'bul: ar+ghaṃ dhe wi badz+ra pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can nyon mongs pa'i: tshad gdungs bsil ldan zhi gnas bde thob shog: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams rgya mtsho na:

dkar ser dmar ljang mthing gsal me tog tshogs: ma lus thogs med blo yis yongs bsdus te: ting 'dzin dgongs brgyud dag pas byin brlabs nas: bde gshegs rgyal ba thugs rje can la 'bul: puṣ+pe dhe wi badz+ra pū dza hūm̐: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can nga rgyal gyi: gzugs ngan skyon bral mtshan dpe thob par shog: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams rgya mtsho na: dri bsung zhing khams kun khyab bdug pa'i sprin: ma lus thogs med blo yis yongs bsdus te: ting 'dzin dgongs brgyud dag pas byin brlabs nas: bde gshegs rgyal ba thugs rje can la 'bul: dhū pe dhe wi badz+ra pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'daibs: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can ma lus kyi: khong khro dag nas tshul khrims mchog thob shog: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams rgya mtsho na: phyi nang snod bcud ye shes gsal ba'i sgron: ma lus thogs med blo yis yongs bsdus te: ting 'dzin dgongs brgyud dag pas byin brlabs nas: bde gshegs rgyal ba thugs rje can la 'bul: ā lo kai dhe wi badz+ra pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'daibs: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can gti mug gi: mun sangs ye shes 'od gsal mchog thob shog: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams rgya mtsho nas: 'jam legs 'o ma'i rgya mtsho spos kyi chu: ma lus thogs med blo yis yongs bsdus te: ting 'dzin dgongs brgyud dag pas byin brlabs nas: bde gshegs rgyal ba thugs rje can 'bul: gan+dhe dhe wi badz+ra pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can gzung 'dzin gyi: dri spangs mi rtog ye shes don rtogs shog:

bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams rgya mtsho na: ro brgya'i bcud ldan lha yi zhal zas sogs: ma lus thogs med blo yis yongs bsdus te: ting 'dzin dgongs brgyud dag pas byin brlabs nas: bde gshegs rgyal ba thugs rje can la 'bul: nai wi d+ye dhe wi badz+ra pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can 'dod chags kyi: ser sna dag nas ting 'dzin ros tshim shog: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams rgya mtsho na: zhing khams bkod mdzes lha yi 'byor pas gtams: ma lus thogs med blo yis yongs bsdus te: ting 'dzin dgongs brgyud dag pas byin brlabs nas: bde gshegs rgyal ba thugs rje can la 'bul: maṇ+ḍal dhe wi badz+ra pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can lus ngan gyi: rgyu spangs zhing khams rnam dag thob par shog: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams rgya mtsho nas: sgra snyan glu dbyangs rol mo ji snyed pa: ma lus thogs med blo yis yongs bsdus te: ting 'dzin dgongs brgyud dag pas byin brlabs nas: bde gshegs rgyal ba thugs rje can la 'bul: shab+da dhe wi badz+ra pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'daibs: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can zhe sdang gi: dri dag snyan grags chos sgra sgrog par shog: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: gsum pa bla med phyi yi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: snod kyi 'byung ba las skyes sangs bzhin mdzes: bcud kyi lha klus brgyan pa mdzes pa'i sku: phyi nang mchod rdzas stangs stabs bskrun pa'i gzugs: che ba'i yon tan dgyes mdzad 'dod yon gyi: lha mos yongs gang rdo rje gzungs ma'i tshogs:

rigs 'dus o rgyan gu ru'i lha tshogs la: spyan gyi mchod pa 'bul lo gnyis med bzhes: rū pa dhe wi badz+ra pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs khams gsum sems can thams cad la: 'gyur med rdo rje sku yi dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: reg med rang bzhin lhun grub 'byung ba'i sgra: reg bcas glu dbyangs snyan tshig skye 'gro'i sgra: zung 'jug rnga yab dung ting 'bud dkrol brdungs: gaṇ+ḍi chos tshig don rdzogs 'dod yon gyi: lha mos yongs gang rdo rje sgra ma'i tshogs: rigs 'dus o rgyan gu ru'i lha tshogs la: snyan gyi mchod pa 'bul lo gnyis med bzhes: shab+da dhe wi badz+ra pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs khams gsum sems can thams cad la: gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: lhan cig skyes dang a gar du ru kaḥ dam rdzas tshim byed bdug pa spos kyi dri: dwangs byed rgyas pa rang bzhin sman gyi dri: snang srid yongs gang rdo rje dri ma'i tshogs: rigs 'dus o rgyan gu ru'i lha tshogs la: shangs kyi mchod pa 'bul lo gnyis med bzhes: gan+dhe dhe wi badz+ra pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs khams gsum sems can thams cad la: dngos grub kun 'byung yon tan dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: kha mngar skyur rtsub rang bzhin 'byung ba'i ro: btso bsregs rjen sogs thabs kyis sbyor ba'i ro: sha lnga dam rdzas lnga sogs lha'i bdud rtsi: rtsa brgyad stong ldan mthu stobs byin rlabs ro: snang srid yongs gang rdo rje ro ma'i tshogs: rigs 'dus o rgyan gu ru'i lha tshogs la: ljags kyi mchod pa 'bul lo gnyis med bzhes: rā sa dhe wi badz+ra pū dza hoḥ

gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs khams gsum sems can thams cad la: thogs med phrin las mthar phyin dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: phyi yi reg bya lha yi dar zab gos: nang gi lha klu mi mo mtshan ldan dang : thabs shes sbyor ba bde ba myong reg gi: bde chen ye shes gsang ba bla na med: smra bsam brjod bral shes rab rig ma'i tshogs: rigs 'dus o rgyan gu ru'i lha tshogs la: sku yi mchod pa 'bul lo gnyis med bzhes: spar+she dhe wi badz+ra pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs khams gsum sems can thams cad la: mkhyen brtse ye shes thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: 'bru tshig don dang man ngag zung du bsdebs: gsal dang go 'byed snying po sdud pa sogs: shes bya'i dbang po tshim byed rgyal ba'i bka': phyag rgya gsum ldan chos kyi rdo rje ma: mkha' klong rnam dag chos nyid rol pa'i tshogs: rigs 'dus o rgyan gu ru'i lha tshogs la: chos kyi mchod pa 'bul lo gnyis med bzhes: dharma dhe wi badz+ra pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs khams gsum sems can thams cad la: sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐:

bzhi pa nang mchod sman raka gtor gsum las/ dang po 'chi med bdud rtsi'i sman mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag pa'i rdzas: rtsa brgyad yan lag stong dang sbyar ba'i sman: rigs lnga ye shes lnga rdzogs bsgrub pa'i rdzas: 'gro drug sdug bsngal 'joms pa'i ye shes rtsi: dus gsum bde gshegs ma lus mchod pa'i sprin: rā sa ya na'i rdzas mchog khyad par can: rig 'dzin 'dus pa bla ma'i zhal du 'bul: sarba pañca tsit+ta su ra hūm̐: bskyed rdzogs dbyer med dgongs rgyud dag par sbyor: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: che mchog 'dus pa yi dam lha la 'bul: sarba pañca tsit+ta su ra hūm̐: dam tshig nyams skong sngags kyi dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bde chen 'dus pa mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: sarba pañca tsit+ta su ra hūm̐: rten 'brel phyogs med 'char ba'i dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: yon tan 'dus pa nor lha gter bdag mchod: sarba pañca tsit+ta su ra hūm̐: 'dod rgu 'bad med 'byung ba'i dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: phrin las 'dus pa chos skyong gter srung mchod: sarba pañca tsit+ta su ra hūm̐: myur mgyogs thogs med las kyi dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rig rtsal 'dus pa snang srid dkyil 'khor mchod: sarba pañca tsit+ta su ra hūm̐: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs pa'i dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor lha rnams mnyam sbyor ba'i: byang sems bdud rtsi ma lus pa: char rgyun lta bur babs pa nyid: bdag nyid tsit+ta'i snying dbus thim: ye shes sems dpa'i skur gyur nas: skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta a mṛ ta badz+ra ā yu ṣe a be sha ya sid+dhi hūm̐:

zhes bdud rtsi myang zhing*/ gnyis pa rak+ta'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: bhan+dha yangs pa mkha' klong rdzogs pa'i nang : mu la rak+ta srid pa bskyed pa'i khrag: añja rak+ta bde chen sbyor ba'i khrag: du na rak+ta rgyud drug bsgral ba'i khrag: gu na rak+ta 'byung ba srid pa'i khrag: ma hā rak+ta thugs rje chags pa'i mdangs: 'khor ba'i rgyu bsgral khams gsum dbang sdud rdzas: bde mchog bde spyod rak+ta'i mchod pa 'di: bde gshegs 'dus pa gu ru'i thugs dam bskang : ma hā rak+ta dz+nyā na pū dza hoḥ thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: yi dam bde 'dus zhi khro'i thugs dam bskang : ma hā rak+ta dz+nyā na pū dza hoḥ thun mong grub pa rnam brgyad dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: mkha' 'gro 'dus pa dbyings phyug thugs dam bskang : ma hā rak+ta dz+nyā na pū dza hoḥ skye 'gro chos la 'god pa'i dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: chos skyong 'dus pa dam can thugs dam bskang : ma hā rak+ta dz+nyā na pū dza hoḥ bstan srung drag sngags mthu yi dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: nor lha 'dus pa gnod sbyin thugs dam bskang : ma hā rak+ta dz+nyā na pū dza hoḥ che btsan 'gran zla bral ba'i dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: gsum pa dam rdzas gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: snang ba snod kyi 'jig rten gtor gzhong du: srid pa bcud kyi skye 'gro gtor mar sbyar: dpal gyi gtor ma brjid ldan 'gyings pa 'di: ri rab lhun po bas kyang dpangs re mtho: ma mo'i gtor ma pad+mas bskor ba 'di: gling bzhi gling phran bas kyang bkod re legs: dkar gyi thig btab dmar gyi gur phub pa: gser gyi ri bdun bas kyang brjid re che:

rak+ta dmar gyis gtor ma bran pa 'di: rgya mtsho'i 'jings rnams bas kyang gting re zab: bdud rtsi sman gyis gtor ma bran pa 'di: lha yi zhal zas bas kyang ro re bda': dkar rtsi dmar rtsi sha chen dri chen dang : dri chu byugs pa'i rdzas de rnam pa lnga: seṅge glang chen rta dang ba glang dang : mchog chen mi la sogs te rnam pa lnga: ma hā māṃ sa la sogs sha sna stong : ma hā rak+ta la sogs khrag sna stong : ma hā tsit+ta la sogs snying sna stong : go ro tsa na la sogs klad pa stong : ba su ta dang nang rol rnam pa lnga: shing tog lo tog 'bru sna sman sna dang : rtsi dang rtsa rgyud rtsi chen go snyod dang : lga dang lan tshwa spod kyi bye brag dang : ri sgog klung sgog sha mong sna tshogs dang : bza' dang bca' ba btung ba la sogs pa: 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa sna tshogs pa: thogs med blo yis yongs su kun bsdus nas: ting 'dzin dgongs brgyud dag pas byin brlabs te: bdud rtsir bsgyur ba'i ba liṃ chen po 'di: bla ma rig 'dzin thugs dam bskang gyur cig: ma hā bha ling+ta pū dza bhuñja hoḥ tshe gcig 'od skur grol ba'i dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: yi dam lha tshogs thugs dam bskang gyur cig: ma hā bha ling+ta pū dza bhuñja hoḥ rtag brtan 'gyur med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig: ma hā bha ling+ta pū dza bhuñja hoḥ brtul zhugs rdzu 'phrul thogs med dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dam can srung ma'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig: ma hā bha ling+ta pū dza bhuñja hoḥ lha 'dre mi gsum 'dul ba'i dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: mchod par 'os pa'i thugs dam bskang gyur cig: ma hā bha ling+ta pū dza bhuñja hoḥ tshogs gnyis 'bras bu mthar phyin dngos grub stsol:

bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: 'khor 'das gnyis su med par thugs dam bskang : ma hā bha ling+ta pū dza bhuñja hoḥ dgongs klong chabs cig grol ba'i dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: lnga pa gsang ba bla med kyi mchod pa sbyor sgrol rnam pa gnyis las/ dang po bde chen sbyor ba'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: kun tu bzang mo shes rab dbyings kyi yum: dmigs med snying rjes sems can yongs la snyoms: thabs mchog bde chen 'khor 'das dbyings su dag: 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams thugs dam bskul ba'i phyir: thabs dang shes rab gnyis med mchod pa'i rgyan: a ho ma hā su kha sa ma ya satwaṃ: āḥdang hūm̐ las rdo rje pad+ma'i dal: pra be sha ya phaṭ kyis gsang sgo phyes: su ra satwaṃ gyis bde ba'i rdo rje bskul: sa ma ho yis dgyes pa chen por gnang : ra ho rā ga ya mis mnyam sbyor te: dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med lhun grub kyi: mnyam nyid bde ba chen po'i mchod pa 'bul: dz+nyā na ma hā su kha pū dza hūm̐: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: nam mkhas gar khyab chos dbyings yum gyi mkha': snod kyi 'jig rten rab 'byams gzhal yas khang : gsal snang rtog med sems can kun gyi sems: kun gzhi a la yid ni hūm̐ gi ngang : 'khor 'das gnyis med yab yum thabs shes bsnol: āḥhūm̐ sems gsum 'dres pa'i kun tu bzang : 'gro kun bde gshegs rgyal ba'i sras su gyur: dgyes mchod bde ba chen po bzhes su gsol: dz+nyā na ma hā su kha pū dza hoḥ bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bde ba chen po dag la gang gnas pa: rtogs pa chen po longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: khams gsum las 'das byang chub rin po che: stor ba btsal bas rnyed par ga la 'gyur: thig le chen po chud par gnas pa la: ye shes snying po 'di las gzhan med do:

'khor ba mya ngan 'das la skye 'chi med: bde ba chen po'i ngang la mnyam par rol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bde ba'i rtsi la rol kyang gnyis med bde: srid pa'i 'dod pa shin tu rnam dag pas: mi srid chos kyi dbyings su rnam sbyar nas: rigs 'dus gu ru'i dkyil 'khor dam pa 'dir: rgyal ba rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa la: dam rdzas mchog gi mchod pa 'di 'bul gyis: chos nyid lhun grub dag pa'i dngos grub stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha pū dza pra tīts+tsha hoḥ gnyis pa ru tra bsgral mchod ni/ hūm̐: srid gsum rnam dag chos dbyings brub khung du: gzung 'dzin las rlung dug lnga'i dbang gyur pas: rigs drug 'khrul pa'i mun khung 'khyams pa kun: tshad med 'od gsal snying pos yongs bzung ste: brtse chen byams pas mnyam nyid dbyings su 'ching : dga' chen g.yo bas kun snang rtog pa dag: btang snyoms khyab brdal nyon mongs tshor ba gzhom: rang byung ye shes gnyis 'dzin bdud dang phrol: rig 'dzin dpa' stobs gyad kyi phur bu yis: thugs rje rtse gcig bdag 'dzin ru tra'i dpung : mnyam rdzogs dbyings su sgrol cig kī la ya: las dang bag chags 'khrul pa'i sa bon rnams: shes rab rno mtshon 'bar bas rdul du rlog: lhun grub snod yangs 'od gsal dwangs mar bskyil: dbyings nas skur bzhengs zhi khro rab 'byams lha: ngang gis khros nas ye shes 'bar ba'i zhal: srid gsum rnam par rol pa'i hoṃ yangs par: bstab bo bde chen 'gyur med dbyings su stims: ma rig gti mug bsgral ba'i mchod pa che: chos dbyings ye shes lha tshogs zhal du bstab: ha la pañca dz+nyā na pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: sangs rgyas bstan dgra rnam snang dbyings su ā: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:

zhe ldang lha bdud bsgral ba'i mchod pa che: me long ye shes lha tshogs zhal du bstab: ha la pañca dz+nyā na pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bla ma'i sku dgra rdor sems dbyings su āḥ bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: nga rgyal phung bdud bsgral ba'i mchod pa che: mnyam nyid ye shes lha tshogs zhal du bstab: ha la pañca dz+nyā na pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: rnal 'byor sgos dgra rin 'byung dbyings su phaṭḥ bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: nyon mongs 'dod chags bdud dpung bsgral mchod 'di: sor rtog ye shes lha tshogs zhal du bstab: ha la pañca dz+nyā na pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: mched lcam zur dgra snang mtha'i dbyings su phaṭḥ bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: phrag dog 'chi bdag bdud dpung bsgral mchod 'di: bya grub ye shes lha tshogs zhal du bstab: ha la pañca dz+nyā na pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: yon bdag rkyen dgra don grub dbyings su phaṭḥ bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dug lnga yongs su bsgral ba'i mchod pa 'di: klong gyur ye shes lha tshogs zhal du bstab: ha la pañca dz+nyā na pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: rgyal khams phung 'dre rdor 'chang dbyings su phaṭḥ bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rnam shes tshogs brgyad bsgral ba'i mchod pa 'di: 'da' ka ye shes ging chen zhal du bstab: ha la pañca dz+nyā na pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: mtha' dmag 'byung po kun bzang klong du phaṭḥ bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: brgyad khri bzhi stong nyon mongs bsgral mchod 'di: dbyings sgrol ye shes lha tshogs zhal du bstab: ha la pañca dz+nyā na pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs:

lan chags 'byung po ka dag klong du phaṭḥ bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bsgral bya sgrol byed 'dzin pa'i 'du 'phro rnams: mtha' grol gnyis med ye shes klong du bstims: smon lam log pa'i bdud rigs de bzhin nyid: rgyu zad rkyen zad chos skur grol bar shog: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ma traṃ ru tra mā ra ya pū dza hoḥ drug pa gling bzhi'i gar mchod ni/ hūm̐: thugs rje ye shes rol pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: phung khams skye mched ye nas rgyal ba'i sku: yab yum gnyis med ye nas lhun gyis grub: stangs stabs phyag rgya thams cad glu dang gar: rnam rol phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa 'bul: mu tra gīrti nīrti pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: seṅge'i 'gying gar gsang ba rdo rje'i gar: pad+ma'i 'dzum gar bde spyod dbu ma'i mdangs: las kyi 'jol gar dbang sgyur rgya gram rgya: rin chen bsgyur gar drug ldan 'dzin pa'i stangs: stag mo'i 'gyur stangs bud+dha dbyings kyi gar: khro bo'i 'gying gar g.yas su shigs se shig: khro mo'i bzhad gar g.yon du ya la la: thabs shes zung 'jug mchog thun dngos grub gar: rnal rol phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa 'bul: mu tra gīrti nīrti pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dang po'i dam tshig nam mkha' gar gyis gang : bar gyi dam tshig sa gzhi gar gyis gang : da lta dam tshig gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur: bde chen gar mkhan tshul du sangs rgyas shing : gsang chen nges pa'i mchog ston e ma hoḥ rnam grol phyag rgya phyi nang mchod pa 'bul: mu tra gīrti nīrti pū dza hoḥ gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:
