g.yas kyis se gol gtog pa ta la hoḥ g.yon gyis se gol bsgyur ba sham pa rgya: thabs shes ta la sham pa rtse sprad nas: sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya'i gar bsgyur bas: snang srid thams cad phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor du: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad sprin bzhin gtibs: rnam rol phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa 'bul: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: oṃ ma hā shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na pri sha su ka ta na hūm̐: bdun pa de bzhin nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: gdod nas dag pa'i rang bzhin byang chub sems: skye shi las 'das bya rtsol kun dang bral: dge sdig brjod med kun gzhi yid las 'das: lta med lta ba'i rgyal po'i mchod pa 'bul: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rtog med spros bral gzhi grol rang lugs su: yongs su med de bde gsal mi rtog ngang : bde sdug las dang bag chags rgyu 'bras zad: g.yo med sgom pa'i rgyal po'i mchod pa 'bul: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: tshogs drug zhen med phyogs ris med par bde: gnyis med rang bzhin lhun grub rol pa'i rtsal: dug lnga rang grol snod bcud dngos po stong : mnyam nyid spyod pa'i rgyal po'i mchod pa 'bul: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: brjod bral gshis la dngos med bsgom du med: byas chos blos btang byar med blo las 'das: snang sems 'dzin bral dmigs med dbyings su thim: yongs rdzogs 'bras bu'i rgyal po'i mchod pa 'bul: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gzhi la 'pho 'gyur med pa rnal ma'i ngang : phung khams yul med ming bral 'od lnga'i sbubs:

snang srid rnam dag a ti rdzogs pa che: rang byung kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'i mchog: dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pa ngang gis 'bul: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: sarba dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na badz+ra āḥ

brgyad pa bstod pa ni/ gu ru'i yon tan rjes dran zhing : rtse gcig rjes su 'jug pa'i blos: khyed shes blo bkal gdung dbyangs kyis: hūm̐: ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen lhun grub bla ma longs spyod rdzogs: pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: sku ni mi 'gyur kun tu bzang po'i sku: gsung ni mi 'gag mnyam nyid rig pa'i gsung : thugs ni mi g.yo smra bsam brjod las 'das: sku gsung thugs ldan pad+ma rgyal la bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: 'gro ba'i don du rang byung 'od dpag med: bkra shis yon tan du mas brgyan pa'i sku: 'jig rten dbang bsgyur pad+ma rgyal po'i sras: snang srid zil gnon rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bskyed pa med pa rgya mtsho'i klong las 'khrungs: skye shi rgyun chad gzhom med rdo rje'i sku: rig rtsal dbang thob 'gro ba'i re 'dod skong : bde gshegs kun 'dus sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: stobs bcu'i rtsal gyis log 'dren zil gyis gnon: drag sngags dgongs pas lha srin sde brgyad 'dul: dbyings ye dbyer med ma sring bran du bkol: 'khor lo'i mnga' bdag mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rjes rtsal: ma 'ongs sangs rgyas rnams kyi smon lam mthu: da lta'i sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes dpal: dus gsum sangs rgyas sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: mkhyen pa'i yon tan ye shes tshad las 'das: sprul pa bye ba phrag brgya cig car 'gyed: gang 'dul theg pas gdul bya thar lam 'dren: bstan pa'i bdag nyid mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod:

bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: phyi ltar phar phyin drug ldan sprul pa'i chas: nang ltar sngags mchog sngags bdag 'khor los bsgyur: gsang ba bla med kun bzang rdo rje 'chang : zung 'jug sprul bsgyur 'gyed la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: brjod med spros bral kun bzang snang mtha' yas: bde chen rigs lnga longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: rdo rje sems dpa' sangs rgyas kun gyi rje: dga' rab rdo rje ye shes klong dgu'i gar: dgongs brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gsang ba'i bdag po rig 'dzin rdo rje chos: gsang sngags bka' bab skal ldan rgyal po dzaḥ yang dag mchog brnyes 'gro ba'i don du brtson: rig 'dzin brda brgyud rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rgyud sde kun la dbang sgyur las kyi dbang : sgrub sde brgyad kyi don rtogs mkhas pa brgyad: theg pa'i don la dbang sgyur chos kyi rje: gtad rgya lung bstan rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: che chung bzhi rdzogs bde chen 'dus pa'i sku: sku gcig sku lnga mtshan brgyad bye ba brgyad: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams kun la dbang bsgyur zhing : rlabs chen gdul bya skyong la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: 'khor bar ma chags skyon bral pad+ma 'byung : yon tan rab rdzogs pad+ma sam bha wa: shes bya kun mkhyen blo ldan mchog sred rtsal: khams gsum srid gsum dbang sdud pad+ma rgyal: lhun grub rig 'dzin rnam bzhir phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma rig mun sel 'gro 'dul nyi ma 'od: log 'dren bdud bzhi'i dpung 'joms shākya seng : log lta ru tra rdul brlags seṅge'i sgra:

dregs pa lha srin kun 'dul gro bo lod: dgra bgegs tshar gcod rnam bzhir phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rdo rje mkha' 'gros mi 'gyur bdud sde 'joms: rin chen mkha' 'gros re skong bcud char 'bebs: pad+ma mkha' 'gros rjes chags gzhan snang sdud: las kyi mkha' 'gros bar gcod gdug pa 'dul: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro sde bzhir phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bstan pa'i brgyud 'dzin dgra bgegs bdud 'dul ma: rnal 'byor 'khor skyong byin rlabs zhi ba mtsho: sngags kyi las mdzad mtsho gling ḍāk+ki ma: las kyi bka' sdod thogs med phra men ma: dam tshig mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: pad+ma thod phreng sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos: ji srid nam mkha'i 'khor lo ma zhig bar: de srid 'gro don phrin las rgyun mi 'chad: sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes stobs 'chang ba: 'khor 'das spyi dpal mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: ye shes rang gsal 'gyur med rdo rje'i sku: ka dag klong nas lhun grub thugs rje che: ma 'gags rang gsal zhi khro'i bkod pa rdzogs: 'khrul pa'i snang tshul rang mdangs 'od skur sbyangs: dran rig rang grol bde chen rgyal po'i sku: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dbyings kyi dpal ldan thugs rje bkod pas brgyan: chos nyid gsal rdzogs 'gyur med yon tan ston: tshogs drug rang grol 'gag med thar lam ston: spang thob bral ba'i 'bras bu chos skur rdzogs: 'khor 'das mnyam nyid dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sku: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bde chen klong du 'khor 'das 'ub chud kyang :

gnas skabs 'byung bzhi las rlung 'phen sdud kyi: zag bcas sgyu lus 'jigs tshogs ya nga'i 'phrang : 'byung lnga rang grol ye shes 'od skur rdzogs: mtsho skyes rdo rje dpa' bo gyad kyi lha: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gzung 'dzin mtshan ma ye grol las rab rdzogs: 'byung ba rnam dag dby-ings phyug mkha' 'gro lnga: las rlung bag chags sor sdud mkha' spyod spor: dbu ma'i sgo 'byed lhun grub sku lnga'i klong : dbyer med mnyam par rol mdzad rnal 'byor ma: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: sku lnga ye shes lnga yi rang mdangs las: thugs rje mtha' yas zhi khro'i bkod pa rdzogs: gcig tu ma nges cho 'phrul sna tshogs gar: gang la ci 'dul rol pa'i tshul du ston: du ma ro gcig dgongs klong yangs pa'i mkhar: 'du 'bral med pa'i don gyis phyag 'tshal bstod: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dug gsum nad 'joms drang srong sman gyi rgyal: bdud bzhi'i bar chad sel mdzad seṅge'i sgra: 'byung lnga dbang sdud ye shes pho nya'i klong : zung 'jug bde chen mchog sbyor sman gyi lha: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ye shes stobs kyis snod bcud rgud pa sel: thugs rjes dbang gis rtsol med dgos 'dod 'byung : nus mthu rtsal gyis khams gsum dbang du sdud: 'dod rgu'i srid rje mkha' 'gro nor gyi lha: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: brgyud pa kun la dbang sgyur mthu stobs bdag: ye shes bdun ldan rdo rje'i go cha can: 'byung lnga ye shes 'khor los rgyas 'debs pa:

log 'dren ldang med rnam gnon gur gyi lha: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: stobs ldan nag po mngon spyod dmod pa'i chas: drag sngags thal 'byin rdo rje pha lam sku: sde brgyad g.yul 'gyed phas kyi rgol ba 'joms: bstan dgra bgegs dpung tshar gcod kī la ya: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: chos nyid zhi las thugs rje 'bar ba'i shugs: srid pa dpyi gnon ye shes dgongs pa yis: stong gsum rngam drag ging chen pho nyas 'gengs: 'dre rgod mi min 'tshe ba pha mthar bskrad: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes gzi byin gyi: klong lnga'i rang bzhin srid pa rgya yis 'debs: snod bcud go 'byed mkhyen brtse'i phrin las rdzogs: zab rgya mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod gter sgo 'byed: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dgongs pa klong yangs 'od gsal snying rje'i ngang : rnam 'gyur brtul zhugs spyod pa ma tshogs sdud: srid pa bran bkol lha 'dre mi gsum 'dul: sbas gnas sgo 'byed 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: stobs bcu'i dbyings las 'gying rtsal khros pa'i gar: snang srid dbang sdud bdud 'dul sngags pa'i chas: tshad med rnam bzhi'i phyag rgyas dgra rgol 'joms: bdud bzhi'i dpung bcom dregs pa zil gnon lha: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: tshe rabs las dang smon lam shugs kyis 'brel: dbang lung man ngag brgyud dang nyams chag skong : theg pa 'dzin 'chang rig 'dzin slob dpon sogs:

sgrub pa bka' brgyad zhi khro yi dam lha: gnas yul zhi skyong dpa' bo ḍāk+ki'i tshogs: chos dbyings ye shes rol pa chen po'i lha: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rngam gshe dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ging chen dang : 'gugs 'ching sdom myos las mdzad sgo ma bzhi: bde chen bcud 'dzin mchod sprin lha mo 'bum: bka' nyan las byed gzugs sku dregs pa'i tshul: pho nya bka' sdod dam can srung ma'i tshogs: thams cad chos dbyings chen por brdal khyab pas: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: shes rab dbyings las thugs rje'i thabs kyi sku: rtsol med rang shar phyogs bcu'i zhing kun gyi: rgyal ba rab 'byams dkyil 'khor ma lus rdzogs: gnyis med rang snang gsal stong ye shes lha: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur phyag 'tshal bstod: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes bstod cing gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ dgu pa dzapa ྄la dang po dzap bskul ni/ hūm̐: chos sku khyab brdal zhing khams nas: gdod ma'i mgon po snang mtha' yas: gsung gi thugs dam gnad nas bskul: grags stong sngags kyi rang mdangs bsgyur: sems can rnams kyi don mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: ye shes lnga yi 'od klong nas: longs sku 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: gsung gi thugs dam gnad nas bskul: grags stong sngags kyi rang mdangs bsgyur: sems can rnams kyi don mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: pad ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas: o rgyan chen po rje 'bangs rnams: gsung gi thugs dam gnad nas bskul: grags stong sngags kyi rang mdangs bsgyur: sems can rnams kyi don mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: 'gro 'dul thugs rje'i pho brang nas/

/rig 'dzin o rgyan rtsa gsum gling*/ gsung gi thugs dam gnad nas bskul: grags stong sngags kyi rang mdangs bsgyur: sems can rnams kyi don mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: bsam yas mchims phu'i sgrub gnas nas/ /rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje yang*/ gsung gi thugs dam gnad nas bskul: grags stong sngags kyi rang mdangs bsgyur: sems can rnams kyi don mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: rtswa nang gsang ba'i dga' tshal nas/ /'od dbyings gnyis med bde chen rgyal/ gsung gi thugs dam gnad nas bskul: grags stong sngags kyi rang mdangs bsgyur: sems can rnams kyi don mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gnas bzhi pad+ma chos gling nas/ /karma bhi dh+wa dha ra yang*/ gsung gi thugs dam gnad nas bskul: grags stong sngags kyi rang mdangs bsgyur: sems can rnams kyi don mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: sbas yul rin spungs pho brang nas/ /o rgyan gnyis med 'gro 'dul gling*/ gsung gi thugs dam gnad nas bskul: grags stong sngags kyi rang mdangs bsgyur: sems can rnams kyi don mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gang 'dul der ston gzhal yas nas/ /chos bdag rig 'dzin brgyud par bcas/ gsung gi thugs dam gnad nas bskul: grags stong sngags kyi rang mdangs bsgyur: sems can rnams kyi don mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: bde chen mchog gi 'khor lo nas/ /bka' drin sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ gsung gi thugs dam gnad nas bskul: grags stong sngags kyi rang mdangs bsgyur: sems can rnams kyi don mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: snang stong thig le'i mkha' klong nas/ /yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha/ gsung gi thugs dam gnad nas bskul:

grags stong sngags kyi rang mdangs bsgyur: sems can rnams kyi don mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: rtsa khams dag pa'i pho brang nas/ /yi dam ḍāk+ki'i lha tshogs rnams/ gsung gi thugs dam gnad nas bskul: grags stong sngags kyi rang mdangs bsgyur: sems can rnams kyi don mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: dam tshig gnyan gyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ gsung gi thugs dam gnad nas bskul: grags stong sngags kyi rang mdangs bsgyur: sems can rnams kyi don mdzod cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/ gnyis pa dzap dngos la gsum/ dang po bsnyen pa ni/ kye kye bla ma rin po che: sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku: 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig pu: mgon med bdag la thugs rjes zungs: bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa che: re zhing ltos pa'i gnyen gcig pu: bdag la re sa gzhan na med: sdug bsngal 'di las drang du gsol: rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: khyed la bdag nyid bran du 'bul: skyid sdug re ltos khyed shes pas: bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsol: bla ma sangs rgyas phrin las mdzad: bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: mtha' yas sems can ma lus pa: 'dren pa'i bla mar bdag gyur cig:

ces gsol ba snying nas gdab: de nas dzap dgongs gsal gdab pa ni/ de yang gsang 'dus las/ snang srid gzhal yas bla ma lha/ /thams cad phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor che/ /dper na chu zla 'ja' tshon ltar/ /snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom/ /zhes pa'i dgongs pa'i srog bzung nas/ spyi bo'i bla ma la sems rtse gcig pas mos gus gdung shugs drag pos/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes gsol 'debs kyi tshul du bzla'o/ gnyis pa sgrub pa ni/ dbang bzhi len pa'i dmigs gnad dang sbyar te/ bla ma yab yum sku yi gnas bzhi nas/ /'od zer byung ba bdag gi gnas bzhir thim/ /sku gsung thugs dang ye shes rdo rje yis/ /byin gyis brlab nas dbang bzhi thob par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar bla ma rang la thim pas/ rang nyid thod phreng rtsal gyi sku yi gsal snang dang nga rgyal la sems rtse gcig pas kyang bzla ste/ sha med 'od kyi gzugs can ni/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas sku ru bsgom/ zhes sogs kyi dgongs pa ste sgrub pa'i tshul lo/ gsum pa las sbyor ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyi rigs bzhi'i thod phreng bskul bas de las rang 'dra'i sprul pa dang mkha' khyab tu spros pas phrin las rnam bzhi gang 'dod du bsgrubs par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hri ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: de nas bsnyen sgrub las sbyor rnams sgrub yig bzhin dzap dgongs gsal btab la bzla'o/ mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying rnams lan gsum gsum bzlas/ bcu pa dzap bstod dngos grub blang ba ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: gu ru dhe ḍāk+ki nī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ sogs?shab+da pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: mnyam nyid chos sku'i rang bzhin ni: kun bzang zag pa med par bde:

sems can don la de bzhin gshegs: thugs rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'gag med yan lag drug cu'i gsung : grags stong snying po'i rang bzhin can: 'gro rnams bdud rtsis tshim mdzad pa'i: rang byung gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: rtsol med rang byung chos kyi dbyings: ma skyes 'jigs med rdo rje'i sku: blang dor med par chos dbyings ngang : 'gyur med thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: chos dbyings rol pa chen po las: rtsal dang rol pa mi dmigs kyang : nam mkha' mdzod kyi cho 'phrul gyis: yon tan re skong phyag 'tshal bstod: rang bzhin cir yang ma nges te: dkyil 'khor chen po'i cha bzung nas: rtog med rtog pa ngang gis 'dul: phrin las mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod: lha dang rig 'dzin drang srong dgongs: 'dir bzhugs rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams: smin grol gnyis kyis rgyud sbyangs shing : bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis las gzhung bsrangs: las dang thugs rje mthun pa yi: zhi rgyas dbang drag yid bzhin gter: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐ ā: zhes ting 'dzin ye shes kyi dbang blang ngo*/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa bcu drug las/ bsang sbyang byin rlabs tshogs mchod 'bul: zhes pas zhing lpags sam gcan gzan shun lpags steng*/ sha chang bza' btung la sogs pa/ ci 'byor bsod nams tshogs su bshams/ dang po bsang ba la ni gsum/ thog mar byin rlabs rdzas kyis bsang*/ rdo rjes bdud rtsi blangs te gtor/ de nas nus ldan sngags kyis bsang*/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsang : sarba bi shud+dhe ye swā hā: de nas mos ldan ting 'dzin bsang : tshogs gtor 'bru gsum gcig pa las: lnga ldan 'od zer dpag med 'phros: longs spyod 'bag btsog dag par bsam: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa sbyang ba la yang gsum/ tshogs kyi bdag po ting 'dzin ni: bla ma rigs 'dus yab yum sku: gnyis med sbyor ba'i mkha' dbyings su:

ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: 'phros dngos 'dzin gyi: rnam par rtog pa bsregs gtor sbyangs: de nas bskal pa gsum gyis sbyangs: hūm̐: rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis: chos kun sgyu mar rig pas na: rig pa ye shes ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: 'phros pas 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs: ram̐ las me byung dngos 'dzin bsregs: yam̐ las rlung byung bag chags bsregs: kham̐ las chu byung gnyis 'dzin bkrus: ram̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭḥ yam̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭḥ kham̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭḥ sam̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭḥ de nas chos nyid dag pas sbyangs/ thal mo khog stong phyag rgya bcas/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ lan bdun brjod pas gnyis bsdus kyi chos kun gzhi bral stong nyid ngang*/ gsum pa byin gyis brlab pa la gsum/ thog mar snod bcud byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: snod kyi 'jig rten ma lus 'byung ba lnga: ye nas rnam dag dbyings phyug yum lnga'i mkha': bsam 'das ris med gzhal yas chen por rtogs: ma hā gu ru'i chos nyid klong chen ngang : bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: khams gsum 'gro drug phung khams skye mched rnams: ye nas dus gsum bde gshegs 'khor dang bcas: snang mtha' ris med rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid: gu ru'i mkhyen brtse ma 'gags phyogs med gsal: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: de nas rnal 'byor byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: 'dus shing 'tshogs pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo rnams: ye nas rnam dag rtsa gsum thod phreng rtsal: 'khor 'das gnyis med ye shes lhun gyis grub: gu ru'i dgongs klong bde stong dbyer med ngang : bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: de nas longs spyod byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: snod kyi 'jig rten rnam dag tshogs gzhong du: bcud kyi 'gro drug dam rdzas tshogs su bshams: tshogs brgyad dbang po lang tsho'i dpal gyis brgyan: gnyis med rgyal ba'i thugs dam dgyes skong rdzas:

lha yi me tog rin chen 'dod yon tshogs: mi yi gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i rigs: gshin rje'i sha chen sna tshogs ji snyed pa: srin po'i thod rus klad pa 'bru mar tshogs: gnod sbyin nor bu'i rig byed dza gad bcud: ma mo'i sha khrag snum can sna tshogs dang : nam mkha' lding gi shing thog dri bcud tshogs: drang srong sman sna shing gi lha mo yi: rtsi bcud bdud rtsi me tog sna tshogs rigs: dud 'gro'i gzugs brnyan ngo mtshar dkar gsum tshogs: klu yi snying po sa bdag 'bru sna tshogs: snod bcud 'dod yon longs spyod ma lus pa: rgya che gting zab srid pa'i ltos dang mnyam: kun bzang mchod sprin gnyis med bdud rtsir gyur: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: swa rat+na hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ: zhes brjod lag pa thal mo sbyar te gtug /bzhi pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ phud mchod bsgral bstab bskang bshags rol/ ces pas dang po phud mchod pa la gsum/ thog mar snod bcud rdzas kyis mchod/ gnyis med rol pa chen po'i ngang*/ hūm̐: bla med tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'di: rgyal ba rgya mtsho rnams la mchod pa 'bul: rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis grub pa dang : rgyal mtshan 'phan gdugs bla bre lhab lhub dang : bdug spos dri zhim me tog sil mar bkram: bdud rtsi sman dang snang gsal sgron me bcas: lha dang mi yi rol mo sna tshogs dang : glu dbyangs dril bu sgra snyan tshigs bcad dang : bza' btung ro mchog bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga: rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun la sogs pa: mtshan mchog yid 'ong btsun mo sna tshogs sgeg: thabs ldan rol pa'i mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: bsod nams tshogs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pū dza sarba sa ma ye swā hā:

de nas 'khor gsum yang dag mchod/ hūm̐: bla med tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor 'dir: ma chags pa la chags pa med: chags pa la yang chags pa med: bdag med rtogs na mya ngan 'das: zag med dbyings la ye shes rol: rgyal srid dang ni rang gi lus: bu dang chung ma 'khor dang g.yog: nor gyi dbyig dang sbas pa'i gter: rta mchog rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang : glang chen ne'u le shang shang dang : 'khor 'das rab 'byams mchod pa 'bul: ma lus dgyes pas bzhes mdzod la: 'khor ba'i khri mun stongs par mdzod: mnyam med gu ru rin po che: gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas 'debs: byin rlabs thugs rje'i klong nas stsol: ci bsam 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: tri ma dha la sa pa ri wā ra shud+dhe sa ma ye swā hā: de nas kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: bde bar gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das: rgyal ba rgya mtsho ye shes che: srid pa'i rgya mtsho mtha' yas kun: kun bzang mchod sprin mchog tu rol: bla med mchog gi mchod pa 'di: ye shes lnga yi 'od zer 'phro: 'dod yon longs spyod mkho dgur ldan: nam mkha'i mtha' klas gter chen 'di: rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: dmyal sogs sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzod: gu ru'i thugs rje'i dgongs pa'i klong : khams gsum 'khor ba gnyis su med: lhun grub rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ badz+ra āt+ma ko3 haṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: gnyis pa skye shi med par bsgral zhing bstab/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i brub khung thar med nang : nṛ tri las skyes dgra bgegs nyam thag pa: lcags sgrog gis bcings srog gcod bshan pas bzung : mya ngan ngu 'bod 'o dod lhang lhang bsam: bden pa brdar zhing gzugs la dbab pa ni/ na moḥ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun bden pa dang : dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: drang srong rig 'dzin grub thob brgyud par bcas:

sa dang lam gnas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs: bstan srung dam can chos skyong srung ma dang : gnas dang dur khrod zhing skyong mkha' 'gro sogs: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mthu stobs nus rtsal dang : sngags 'chang bdag gi sngags dang phyag rgya dang : ting 'dzin byin rlabs lhag bsam rnam dag pas: bka' dang bden pa chen po'i mthu stobs kyis: sangs rgyas bstan dgra rgyal khams yongs la 'tshe: sgrub la bar du gcod pa'i log 'dren bdud: thugs rje'i dpyang thag chad pa'i gdul bya rnams: bsgral ba'i zhing bcur gyur pa gang yin pa: stong gsum srid pa'i 'dzin khyon gar gnas kyang : snying nas zungs shig rdo rje lcags kyu ma: khug cig badz+ra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ ske nas chings shig rdo rje zhags pa ma: lus ngag non cig rat+na pā sha hūm̐: yan lag sdoms shig rdo rje lcags sgrog ma: 'byung bzhi dkrugs shig pad+ma pho ṭa baṃ: myos par gyis shig rdo rje dril bu ma: zungs shig gtor cig karma ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ skyabs dang phrold cig rdo rje phra men ma: phyes shig badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ las byed pho nya'i dmag tshogs mthu ma chung : dbang med las kyi rlung gis rgyab nas phul: 'jigs rung 'chi bdag mun pas mdun nas bsus: srid pa mtha' sdud stong khams rdul phran shigs: 'byung ba dgra gshed 'khrugs pa'i 'ur sgra bcas: gzugs la phob cig a be sha ya āḥ ru tra nṛ tri sha truṃ tsit+ta nan: zhes bkug phur pa thogs la/ ham̐'u: che mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga gdengs: g.yon pas phur bus dgra snying gzir: gnod byed pho mo rdul du rlog: hūm̐: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan khyod: dang po zhe sdang pha yi khams: bar du 'dod chags ma yi khams: tha ma za 'dre'i lto bar chags: dug lnga las kyi 'bras bu smin: las ngan de dang ma phral na: rigs drug ngan song rgyun du 'khor: khyod kyi bla ma nga yin no: rnam shes bdag 'dzin phung po la:

shes rab snying po'i phur pa 'debs: las ngan bag chags gzhob tu bsreg: snang mched 'od gsal rang ngo sprod: mtshan 'dzin phung po de yal nas: khyod cing rgyal ba'i sras su skyes: kun bzang sa la gnas par gyur: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta kro ti shwa rī badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma hā yak+ṣa kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la ram̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bsgral dkyil 'khor lha tshogs chos dbyings drag po'i sku ru gsal/ hūm̐: skye med dbyings las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs la: phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs zhi dang khro: rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma lus 'khor dang bcas: khams gsum sgrol byed rngam pa'i dgyes zhal phyes: dug gsum dbyings sdud hu lu'i rngam sgrar bcas: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phung khams bag chags rnams: 'khor ba'i lam lnga dgag phyir zhal du bstab: gnyis med chos kyi dbyings su rnam par rol: khro rgyal tshogs rnams rngam pa'i tshul gyis rol: khro mo'i tshogs rnams chem chem hrug hrug rol: pho nya'i tshogs rnams gtad do tshul gyis rol: ma mo'i tshogs rnams rdul du brlag cing rol: phra men tshogs rnams lhag med rnam par rol: bstan srung tshogs rnams sgrol la rngam par rol: theg chen bstan la sdang zhing dmod pa dang : gsang sngags sgrub la bar du gcod pa'i bdud: las ngan dam sri ma lus zhal du bstab: zhe sdang rus pa gti mug sha chen ri: 'dod chags khrag mtsho nga rgyal klad khrag 'khyil: phrag dog nang khrol mchod pa bla na med: dug lnga bsgral ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: mi 'gyur sku lnga'i dngos grub stsal du gsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī dharma pā la sarba sa ma ya ma hā maṃ sa rak+ta keṃ ni ri ti tsit+ta ba su ta go ro tsa na sarba pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi: gnyis su med par bstab bo/ gsum pa rang bzhin rnam dag bskang zhing bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: phyogs lhung bral ba'i lta ba dang :

the tshom med pa'i spyod pa dang : yengs ba med pa'i ting 'dzin dang : lhag chad med pa'i cho ga yis: rtsa gsum lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : tshogs gtor bdud rtsi rak+ta dang : dza gad mar me gsur chen sprin: rkang gling thod rnga rol mo'i tshogs: sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin rnam dag pas: mthun pa'i dam rdzas ma lus pa: snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bde ba'i gar: tshul bzhin ma nor bsgrubs pa yi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: ye nas ka dag sangs rgyas phyir: snang ba mtha' yas thugs dam bskang : ma 'gags longs sku'i rtsal ston phyir: rdor sems rigs lnga'i thugs dam bskang : spyod yul sku yi gar bsgyur phyir: dga' rab rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang : dgongs gsang theg mchog srol 'dzin phyir: shrī singha'i thugs dam bskang : bka' bab don brgyud yongs 'dzin phyir: rdo rje thod phreng thugs dam bskang : phyogs mtshams thugs rje rol pa'i phyir: sgyu 'phrul mtshan brgyad thugs dam bskang : gnyis med phrin las lhun grub phyir: dbyings phyug ma tshogs thugs dam bskang : kun gzhi ka nas dag pa'i phyir: bde chen rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : tshogs drug lhug par grol ba'i phyir: dus gsum mkhyen pa'i thugs dam bskang : 'byung gzugs mtshan ma rnam dag phyir: dpa' bo gyad kyi thugs dam bskang : skad cig mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas phyir: rdo rje rnal 'byor thugs dam bskang : 'khor ba'i gcong nad 'byin pa'i phyir: 'chi med sman bla'i thugs dam bskang : khams gsum 'khor los bsgyur ba'i phyir: pad+ma rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : bdud bzhi'i dpung rnams gzhom pa'i phyir: rdo rje gur gyi thugs dam bskang : zhing bcu'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phyir: stobs ldan nag po'i thugs dam bskang : 'jigs brgyad mi mthun bskyab pa'i phyir: snang srid zil gnon thugs dam bskang : zab dgu'i gter la mnga' bsgyur phyir: stag zhon khro rgyal thugs dam bskang :

dbang bsgyur brtul zhugs spyod pa'i phyir: nyi ma 'od zer thugs dam bskang : drag sngags dmod pa mthar byed phyir: dregs pa zil gnon thugs dam bskang : gsang sngags dkyil 'khor kun rdzogs phyir: zhi khro rab 'byams thugs dam bskang : snang srid ma lus dgyes pa'i phyir: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : bka' dang bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir: dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang : khams gsum 'khor ba 'dag pa'i phyir: ye shes gsal rdzogs dkyil 'khor gyi: lha dang gnyis med thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hoḥ bdag gis bla med snying po'i sgor zhugs nas: sku yi dam tshig bkur 'os slob dpon mchod: gsung gi dam tshig bsnyen sgrub yi dam lha: thugs kyi dam tshig sbyor sgrol gsang ba bcu: tshul bzhin ma bsgrub rtsa ba'i dam las 'gal: nyes ltung sgrib par gyur pa ci mchis bshags: shes bya lnga dang mi spangs dwang du blang : bsgrub dang spyad bya'i dam tshig nyi shu lnga: yan lag dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: khyad par nyer gcig rgyun gyi dam tshig bzhi: gal mdo nges pa'i dam tshig gsum la sogs: bsrung mtshams ma shes gzhung dang 'gal ba rnams: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyan la bshags: lhun grub ye shes rang gsal dkyil 'khor du: byang zhing dag nas tshangs pa mchog gi don: mnyam nyid bsrung mtshams bral ba'i dngos grub stsol:

zhes yig brgya bzla/ bzhi pa tshogs la rol pa ni/ rdo rje rgyan bro pho mo yis: rnal 'byor pho mo thams cad la: thabs shes rdzas rnams bsnol la stob: kye ho dgongs shig rnal 'byor pa: gsang chen theg par bde ba yis: bde ba chen po bsgrub bya'i phyir: 'dzin med rang grol chen por rol: ga ṇa tsakra sid+dhi hoḥ lan btab pa ni/ hoḥ rgyal ba'i spyod yul thabs kyi lam: gnyis med bde chen rang bzhin mchog: rnam dag tshogs kyi longs spyod 'di: chos nyid ngang du rol par bya: man tra sid+dhi a la la hoḥ zhes brjod gar gyi phyag rgyas blangs/ 'chi med bdud rtsi chen po ltar: phung khams skye mched rgyal ba'i dal: gnyis med bde chen rol pas tshim: nang ltar shes rab ting 'dzin tshogs: rang byung yongs su rdzogs par rol: gsang ba chos nyid lta dgongs tshogs: dbyer med kun grol rol gar spyod: lnga pa lhag ma bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐: dang po phud kyis mchod pa ni: bla ma rig 'dzin dgyes pa'i rtags: bar du bskang zhing bshags pa ni: yi dam mkha' 'gro mthun pa'i rdzas: tha ma 'gugs shing bsgral ba ni: chos skyong dam can rbad pa'i rten: dbyer med tshogs la rol pa ni: nor lha gter bdag dngos grub bdag: kun nas lhag ma sdud pa ni: laṅka gnas nyul dgyes par mchod: dkyil 'khor mtha' la bzhag pa ni: bka' bzhin bstan pa bsrung bar bcol: lhag ma kha chus bran pa ni: 'da' ka dam tshig gcig par ston: hūm̐: bde gshegs rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs bstan srung ni: mtshan mo sgra sgrogs ma mo bye ba 'bum: srod la rab rgyu cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston: smag rum gseb nas mi sdug skad ngan 'don: la las rgyan mdzes spras nas mkha' la lding : la las sder chags bzhon nas sa gzhi nyul: la las gcer mo dur khrod bam ro khur: la las g.yang gzhi gyon nas bhan+dha thogs: la las nang rol 'dren zhing rgyu ma za:

la las srod 'phros drod nyul lam lam 'gyu: don la thams cad rnal 'byor ma sring ste: bye brag so so'i snang ngor sgyu ma'i gar: mi bzad gar sgyur bstan pa'i bya ra'i tshogs: bka' yi las byed phra men 'khor bcas kyis: 'dod yon tshogs kyi lhag ma 'di bzhes la: rgyud srung sgrub pa'i sdong grogs ma g.yel zhing : ma rungs gdug pa'i tshogs rnams tshar bcad nas: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ma tri hriṃ hriṃ mu kha le sa ma ya maṇ+ḍal pā la bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: drug pa tshogs kyi bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐: dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: lta spyod phrin las man ngag thabs mkhas pa: tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen 'di phul bas: bdag cag 'dir 'dus rnal 'byor pho mo dang : pha ma rigs drug khams gsum sems can gyi: tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing sgrib gnyis gnas dag nas: nad gdon sdig sgrib sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig: tshe dpal ye shes bde legs phun tshogs shing : log 'dren gdul bya dbang 'dus chos la 'khod: dgra bgegs rnam par 'tshe ba rdul du rlog: dgongs pa'i ting 'dzin mkhyen brtse'i phrin las rdol: kun bzang go 'phang da lta mngon gyur nas: pad+ma thod phreng rlabs chen phrin las sgo: mngon rdzogs phyam gcig 'gro ba sgrol bar shog: ces smon lam rnam par dag pas rgyas gdab bo/ bdun pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ mos gus gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis su/ hūm̐: ma g.yel bla ma rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: bzhengs shig chos dbyings bden chen klong nas bzhengs: bskul lo 'gro ba'i don du thugs dam bskul: mdzod cig rnam bzhi'i phrin las thogs med mdzod: thugs rje phrin las mdzad pa bsam mi khyab: bye ba phrag brgya sprul sku'i zhing khams su: o rgyan sprul pa bye ba phrag brgya'i tshogs: gang la gang 'dul gdul bya'i re ba bskang : dgongs spyod dag pa ye shes thams cad bskul:

khyad par bdag cag bod kyi sems can rnams: las ngan 'bras bu sdug bsngal mtsho kha rdol: skyabs med mgon med yi chad 'di 'dra la: thugs rje ma g.yel mkhyen brtse'i mthu dpung bskyed: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: las dang rgyu 'bras rnam smin dbang btsan na: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi dgongs pa mchog: thugs rjes yal yol btang snyoms dbang gyur na: dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdul bya gang la mdzad: bdag cag rjes 'jug khyed kyis mi skyong na: pad+ma'i thugs bskyed dam bca' ci la dgongs: nad mug mtshon gyis 'gro ba bzod dka' na: drag rtsal mthu stobs nus pa gang la bskyed: phung byed bdud kyis 'jig rten dbang bsgyur na: shugs sgrol mngon spyod dmod pa'i phrin las gang : byang chub sgrub la bar chad dbang btsan na: mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam tshig g.yel lam ci: brtse chen thugs rje skyed cig mthu ma chung : gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa dbyings nas bskyod: bla ma rig 'dzin byin 'od thibs se thib: nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi byin ya la la: zab gsang bde chen chos sgra 'u ru ru: mkhyen brtse nus pas bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs: yi dam lha tshogs rngam brjid ya la la: hūm̐ dang phaṭ kyi gad rgyangs di ri ri: tsha zer me 'od tshwa tshwa si li li: mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dpa' mo gar sgyur tshogs: glu dbyangs rol mo mang po 'u ru ru: ging chen chos skyong las byed sha ra ra: me rlung mtshon cha bu yug tshubs se tshub: bstan dgra dam nyams phye mar nyi li li: kun kyang thugs rje'i sku la phrin las gar: gnyis med sprul pa'i 'od zer stong khams gang : bdag sogs khams gsum rigs drug sems can gyi: nad gdon sdig sgrib rkyen tshogs gzhob tu sregs:

tshe dpal lus stobs ting 'dzin ye shes skyed: srid pa'i che btsan dregs pa dbang du sdus: ma dag log lta'i snang ba chos la sgyur: tshe gcig byang chub sgrub pa'i bdud tshogs thul: dkar po dge ba'i chos srid lang tsho spel: rgyal khams phung 'dre dme 'khrug mtshon bskal g.yo: ma rungs bdud kyi sde tshogs cham la phob: theg chen bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzod: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes pas thugs dam bskul zhing 'dod pa'i don ji srid grub par dmigs te nges blo brtan par bskyed/ brgyad pa tha tshig chad mdo bsgrag pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la: 'og min dga' ldan chos dbyings pho brang du: bcom ldan dpal chen che mchog he ru kas: dam la btags pa'i kau sing mkha' 'gro ging : dbang phyug ma sring 'bar ma pho nya'i tshogs: dam tshig bzhin du 'dir gshegs gtor ma longs: bdag ni 'od gsal snying po'i srol brgyud 'dzin: khyed rnams dpal gyi bka' sdod dam tshig can: de phyir chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon: bdag gis bcol ba'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: de 'og 'dzam gling dur khrod brgyad kyi gnas: dpal chen khrag 'thung brgyad kyi skur bstan nas: dam la btags pa'i zhing skyong bka' srung tshogs: dam tshig bzhin du 'dir gshegs gtor ma longs: bdag ni bskyed rdzogs las bzhi'i phrin las 'chang : khyed rnams dpal gyi bka' sdod dam tshig can: de phyir chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon: bdag gis bcol ba'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: de 'og bal yul yang le shod kyi gnas:

khrag 'thung rdo rje srin po'i skur bstan nas: dam la btags pa'i ma mo bcu gnyis dang : gtsang ris mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga'i tshogs: dam tshig bzhin du 'dir gshegs gtor ma longs: bdag ni drag sngags stobs 'dus phrin las 'chang : khyed rnams dpal gyi bka' sdod dam tshig can: de phyir chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon: bdag gis bcol ba'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: de 'og bod yul bsam yas has po ri: yak+sha me phreng rtsal gyi skur bzhengs nas: dam la btags pa srid pa'i lha dgu dang : dge bsnyen nyer gcig mgul lha brtan ma'i tshogs: snang srid lha srin dregs pa che dgu rnams: dam tshig bzhin du 'dir gshegs gtor ma longs: bdag ni slob dpon dgongs srol 'dzin pa'i gdung : khyed cag srid pa'i lha dgu g.yar dam can: de phyir chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon: bdag gis bcol ba'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: da lta lho nub o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling : zangs mdog dpal rir srin rgyal skur bzhengs nas: dam la btags pa'i srin tshogs gdon gyi rigs: dam tshig bzhin du 'dir gshegs gtor ma longs: bdag ni pad+ma thod phreng phrin las skyong : khyed cag srid pa'i 'byung po tha tshig can: de phyir chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon: bdag gis bcol ba'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: snga phyi bar gsum tha tshig bka' bsgos pa'i: o rgyan rgya gar bal bod rgya nag sogs: srid pa'i lha srin dregs pa che dgu yis: pad+ma thod phreng mtshan tsam 'dzin pa yang : g.yo med gus pa'i sems kyis spyi bo'i gtsug:

blang zhing bkur bar bya zhes rang dam bcas: tha tshig ma g.yel 'dir gshegs gtor ma longs: bdag ni slob dpon pad+ma'i gdung gsob pa: khyed cag srid pa'i lha 'dre g.yar dam can: de phyir chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon: bdag gis bcol ba'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: nga ni rig 'dzin rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gzi byin bskyed: chos nyid mi 'gyur bden tshig pad+ma'i bka': nga yi bka' las su yang 'da' ma byed: gal te bka' dang dam las 'das gyur na: yak+sha me dbal rdo rje srin po'i sku: stobs ldan nag po 'jigs byed kī la ya: srid gsum shugs sgrol las mkhan dmod pa'i dbal: gnam lcags rdo rjes sde brgyad lus srog 'joms: lcags sdig khros pas dam nyams snying khrag 'thung : gzir 'debs phur bus khams gsum dus gcig sgrol: stong khams sgrol zhing 'tshubs pa'i las byed de: nyam thag 'o dod 'bod pa gdon mi za: de bas bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di longs la: gangs can bod yul sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs: mtha' bzhi'i dmag bzlog dme 'khrug mtshon bskal thul: sad ser btsa' than mi phyug dal yams dang : sri keg byed zor than ltas ngan dgu zlog: dus su char phob lo phyugs srid rnams spel: gtsug lag dben gnas chos 'khor gnyan po skyongs: bshad sgrub mdo sde sngags sde rgyas par spel: 'jig rten bde skyid legs dgu phun tshogs shing : kun kyang chos la spyod pa'i phrin las mdzod: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sarba sa ma ya hūm̐: bha ling+ta khā hi: zhes bsgo/ las rnams thogs med bsgrubs par bsam/ dgu pa bshal chus brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i bka' nyan pa: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis ni: bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma:

dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong : gangs dkar sha med rdo rje kun tu bzang : 'brog chen 'khor 'dus rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso: gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje g.yu bun ma: kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum: gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje klu mo dang : rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal: kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong : btsan la rol pa'i rdo rje sman gcig ma: mo btsun ug chos rdo rje g.yar mo bsil: g.yu yi dril bu rdo rje si le ma: ma sring bod skyong chen mo bcu gnyis kyi: so so'i bran g.yog yang g.yog 'khor dang bcas: lhab lhub mdzes pa'i na bza' sku la gsol: sna tshogs rgyan cha mang po khro lo lo: g.yer kha sil snyan rol mo si li li: glu len bro rdung gar rtsed khyugs se khyug: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa rgyas pa'i bya ra mdzod: oṃ pra mo li tsa tur yak+sha li tsa tur ma tri li tsa tur ra ya sarba i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: bcu pa rta bro brdung ba ni/ hūm̐: bde gshegs rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: grub thob rgya mtshos bro brdungs pas: ye shes lnga ru lhun gyis grub: mu kha chos 'byung khri rkang du: rdo rje mchu yis bro brdungs pas: rigs drug 'khor ba'i rgyun lam gcod: las mtha' rnam bzhi'i dal dbus su: so so'i phrin las bro brdungs pas: zhi rgyas dbang drag lhun gyis grub: hūm̐: bro yang ye shes chen po'i bro: glu yang ye shes chen po'i glu: gar yang phyag rgya drug gi gar: gdangs yang ma 'gags rig pa'i sgra: de ltar brda dang rten 'brel gyis: sna tshogs las kun lhun gyis grub: oṃ nan: ā nan: hūm̐ nan: sgab 'dre 'byung po thams cad satwaṃ bha ya nan: bcu gcig pa dngos grub blang ba la gsum las/ dang po dzap bzlas pa ni/ dngos grub sdud pa'i sngags 'di las sbyor kun la btags zhes pas/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ hri ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ ba su sid+dhi na na kha dhi ā yu puṇ+ye sarba bsdus bsdus pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes bzlas/ gnyis pa dgongs pa bskul zhing tshe dgug pa ni/ mda' dar g.yab cing*/ hūm̐: mkha' mnyam tshe bdag 'od dpag med: chos dbyings nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na shrī bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: lhun grub rigs lnga rdo rje sems: sku lnga dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na shrī bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: rigs 'dus pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: thugs rje ye shes dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na shrī bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: dbyings phyug bde chen mtsho rgyal ma: dbang sgyur stobs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na shrī bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: mtshan brgyad rig 'dzin rje 'bangs tshogs: rmad byung sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na shrī bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: dngos grub kun stsol yi dam lha: thugs rje rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la:

'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na shrī bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: bka' sdod mkha' 'gro chos srung rnams: dam tshig gnyan po'i dkyil 'khor du: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na shrī bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: bskul lo rig 'dzin snying nas bskul: skyed cig thugs dam dbyings nas skyed: bdag cag rig 'dzin sgrub pa por: tshe dang ye shes char chen phob: phyi snod 'byung ba'i tshe bkrag mdangs: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: sgrub rdzas ye shes bdud rtsir bskyil: bkrag dang gzi mdangs ya la la: rig rtsal ye shes stobs skyed la: 'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub par stsol:

zhes bskul tshe 'dzab bzlas pas bskul/ 'khor 'das tshe dpal bcud 'khyil bsgom/ gsum pa dbang blang ba ni/ sgrub rdzas bdag nyid dngos su mos par bskyed/ rtse gcig gsol btab dngos grub stsol bar dmigs/ hūm̐: bstan pa 'di la ngo mtshar rmad byung ba'i: 'jig rten dbang bsgyur pad+ma rgyal po ni: rigs ni za hor rgyal po'i sras su 'khrungs: o rgyan yul du sgro 'dogs ma lus bcad: bsil ba tshal du dngos grub sna tshogs brnyes: wā rā ṇa sīr chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: rgya gar yul du bstan pa rgyas par mdzad: 'jig rten khams kyi gdug pa thams cad btul: bod yul dbus su rgyal po'i thugs dam bskangs: kha ba can du bstan pa rgyas par mdzad: lho nub mtshams su 'gro ba'i don du dgongs: sku tshab lung bstan gsung tshab gter du sbas: lho nub mtshams su 'gro ba'i don la dgongs: skal ldan rnams la zab gsang brda chos ston: zangs mdog dpal rir rig 'dzin gtso 'khor bzhugs: rnga yab gling du srin po'i kha gnon mdzad: 'jig rten 'khor ba ma stongs de srid bar: mya ngan mi 'da' thugs rje spyan gcig po: sku gsum dbyer med che mchog he ru kaḥ mnyam med bla ma mchog khyod dus 'dir dran: gsol ba 'debs so o rgyan rin po che: thugs rjes khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas sprugs: khyad par bdag sogs bod kyi rje 'bangs rnams: rtse gcig pha khyod yon tan dran pa yis: mo gus gdung bas 'bod pa cang gsan nam: brtse chen thugs rje skyed cig mthu ma chung : bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: sku lnga rigs 'dus gu ru zil gnon la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus zhu: skye shi bral ba'i bde chen rgyal po la: lta ba'i gzhi rtsa chod pa'i dngos grub zhu: ka dag mngon rdzogs dpa' bo gyad kyi skur: g.yo med dgongs pa rang gsal dngos grub zhu: tshogs drug zhen bral dus gsum mkhyen pa la:

spyod pa blang dor bral ba'i dngos grub zhu: 'byung lnga rang grol rdo rje rnal 'byor mar: blo bral chos zad 'bras bu'i dngos grub zhu: 'chi med mgon po 'phags mchog sman gyi lhar: tshe ring nad med bde skyid dngos grub zhu: 'dod rgu'i srid rje pad+ma rgyal po la: dgos 'byung lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub zhu: gsang sngags rig sngags khyab bdag gur gyi lhar: log 'dren bdud bzhi tshar gcod dngos grub zhu: drag sngags rtsal 'byin stobs ldan kī la yar: shugs sgrol phrin las mthar phyin dngos grub zhu: bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa brgyad skyob zil gnon lhar: skye 'gro bde la 'god pa'i dngos grub zhu: snang srid dbang bsgyur stag zhon yi dam lhar: chos ltar phyogs med thob pa'i dngos grub zhu: lha 'dre mi gsum 'dul mdzad nyi ma 'od: bzang ngan 'brel tshad don ldan dngos grub zhu: tshad med bzhi ldan dregs pa zil gnon lhar: dmod pa'i las kun gdung mchog dngos grub zhu: bla ma rig 'dzin zhi khro rab 'byams lhar: mngon spyod rdzu 'phrul thogs med dngos grub zhu: gnas yul skyong zhing dpa' bo ḍāk+ki la: rten 'brel phyogs med 'char ba'i dngos grub zhu: bka' nyan las byed chos skyong srung ma la: las bzhi thogs med 'grub pa'i dngos grub zhu: ye shes las grub dkyil 'khor thams cad la: snang srid chos skur 'char ba'i dngos grub zhu: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: mos pas gsol ba snying nas btab pa'i mod: bde gshegs sgyu 'phrul dgongs pa gcig tu dril: sku yi gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum du 'char: gsung gi gdangs sgra 'brug stong ldir ba'i che: thugs kyi dgongs pa nam mkha'i glog bas myur: yon tan gdul bya'i rol pa ma 'dres gsal: phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam ris med brdal: 'gyur med rdo rje sku yi dngos grub stsol:

nad gdon sdig sgrib rkyen ngan bral ba'i tshe: mi 'gyur g.yung drung lta bur lhun grub nas: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: 'gag med rdo rje gsung gi dngos grub stsol: ngag gi sgrib dag brgyad khri bzhi stong sgo: gdul bya so so'i skad du chos ston pas: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca āḥ 'khrul med rdo rje thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: yid kyi sgrib dag chos nyid bde ba che: dus gsum bstan pa'i bdag por lhun grub nas: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: yon tan rdo rje gzi brjid dngos grub stsol: shes bya'i sgrib dag sangs rgyas thugs rje rdzogs: 'khor 'das lhun 'byams zad med gter mnga' ba: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru gu na a bhi ṣiñca trām̐: phrin las rdo rje mthu stobs dngos grub stsol: rtog sgrib dag nas thabs shes dngos grub stsol: dgongs pas rgyas thebs gdul bya mthar phyin nas: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru karma a bhi ṣiñca hoḥ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor sngags bzlas dbang rnams blang*/ dngos grub rdzas la rings pa'i tshul gyis rol/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: gu ru dhe ḍāk+ki nī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ sogs?shab+da pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen lhun grub bla ma longs spyod rdzogs: pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod: bstod par 'os p bcu gnyis pa bzod gsol ni/ oṃ: dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: rang bzhin dkyil 'khor gzhung bzhin zhal phye nas: sgrub rdzas mchod pa gzhung bzhin bshams lags na: bla ma rtsa gsum thugs dang ci 'gal ba:

ye shes spyan ldan rnams la bzod par gsol: sgom pa yun thung yi dam lha ma gsal: bsnyen sgrub ma them dngos grub mthu ma brnyes: sri zhu dad chung bla ma mched la brnyas: tshogs dang phud nyams mkha' 'gro'i thugs dang 'gal: dam rdzas ma tshang srung ma'i thugs dang 'gal: le lo snyom las gnyid chags rmongs pa yis: bskang lhag ma lcogs cho ga chad lhag dang : 'gal 'khrul nyams chag nongs pa ci mchis pa: gzhi med rtsa bral ngang du mthol lo bshags: ye bsrungs chos nyid klong du bzod par gsol: bdag la bsrung mtshams bral ba'i dbyings gnas su: tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol: dbyangs gsal dang yig brgya bzla'o/ bcu gsum pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ hoḥ mi dmigs ka dag ngo bo dbyings rig gi: kun gsal rol pa'i cho 'phrul zhi khro'i lha: lhan skyes ye shes gnyug ma'i sbubs su bsdu: bde gsal mi rtog gnas lugs ngo bor āḥ a a āḥ bcu bzhi pa dge ba bsngo ba ni/ hoḥ gdod nas lhun grub chos dbyings ngo bo yang : de don ma rtogs rmongs khyu'i sems can rigs: a 'thas zhen pa'i 'gog lam gsal mdzad phyir: kun rig don gnyis ston phyir dge tshogs bsngo: bco lnga pa smon lam ni/ hoḥ bla med bde gshegs rgyal ba'i dal bzung nas: mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin rtse gcig gis: ma 'ongs 'di nas rnga yab dpal ri'i zhing : pad 'byung rgyal ba'i sras su mngon par shog: bcu drug pa bkra shis ni/ oṃ: chos sku'i bkra shis snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur: gnas lugs rgyal sa 'dzin pa'i bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis drug pa rdo rje 'chang : thugs rje phyogs bcur khyab pa'i bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung : 'gro kun smin grol 'god pa'i bkra shis shog: snyan brgyud bkra shis mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma: zab rgya mkha' ltar brtan pa'i bkra shis shog: smon lam bkra shis bud+dha dz+nyā na ba:

lung bstan dus las mi 'da' bkra shis shog: gter gnas bkra shis mchims phu'i ke'u tshang du: byin chags yun ring brtan pa'i bkra shis shog: zab chos bkra shis zil gnon rig 'dzin 'dus: mkha' ltar mtha' yas kun khyab bkra shis shog: gter srung bkra shis sngags bdag ral gcig ma: phrin las glog ltar myur ba'i bkra shis shog: nyin yang bkra shis mtshan yang bkra shis shog: nyin mtshan rtag tu bkra shis bde legs shog: ces dang bsam pa lhun 'grub ma'i bkra shis bcas gzhung bzhin bya'o/ de ltar rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i gsol 'debs bskyed rdzogs lam 'khyer gyis rnal 'byor bklags chog tu bkod pa ye shes sprin gyi phung po zhes pa 'di yang rang nyid rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa rnams kyis tshes bcu'i dus mchod kyi slad du gter gzhung las rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rgyas pa dkyil 'khor bcu gsum gyi dgongs pa ji bzhin gtan la phab ste/ bder 'dus rtsa ba'i phrin las ni/ 'bring po dkyil 'khor lnga pa'i las byang nas kyang mi 'gal bar brgyan te/ dbus 'gyur sa yi thig le khams gsum bde ldan dpal 'khyil du skyid grong smyon pas bkod pa dge bar gyur cig /de ltar thugs sgrub bsam lhun chog khrigs rig 'dzin chen po thugs mchog rdo rje'i mdzad par bsnyen sgrub skabs gzhung dang man ngag gis dgongs pa ltar bya'o zhes gzhan du zhal 'phang par mdzad la/ dzap dgongs bla ma gsang 'dus las bzhag par mdzad 'dug pa dang gzhung 'di gtso bo gsol 'debs ltar du sgrub pa yin pa sogs rgyu mtshan dang sbrel na bla ma gsang 'dus kyis bsnyen sgrub las kyi dgongs pa dang ches 'byor bas na/ 'dir yang gsang 'dus bsnyen sgrub kyi dgongs pa bzhin kha 'gengs zhus pa po ni gu h+yas so/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o// // badz+ra bum sgrub skabs ril sgrub yod na thog mar rdo rje nang bsdams sor mo phyer dkrol te dbye ba'i rgyas/

s+pha ra ṇa phaṭḥ ces dang rdo rje khu tshur dpung mgo g.yas g.yon bsnol mthar se gol gtog pa rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas/ badz+ra saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: zhes bdag mdun gnyis med bzhin dang me long ngo bo gcig la snang cha tha dad du phye nas spros bcas lcogs na gzungs thag gtad nas/ thugs kar zla steng gser rdor rtse lnga'i steng : hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng dwangs gsal 'od lnga 'phros: rang mdangs rdo rje'i sngags kyi sgra dbyangs ni: bung ba tshang zhig tshur du lhang nger sgrog: snod kyi 'jig rten pad+ma 'od kyi zhing : bcud kyi sems can gu ru'i sku yi rol: mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor bum pa gzhal yas khang : dam tshig rdzas rnams gu ru'i sku yi rol: ma nges 'gro 'dul bkod pa cir yang 'char: bdag thugs sa bon 'od zer gzungs thag las: brgyud nas ril bu'i lha tshogs thugs kar phog: de las 'od 'phros 'gro ba'i khams kun khyab: rigs drug so so'i las dang sdug bsngal sbyangs: thams cad rgyal ba'i go 'phang mchog la bkod: slar yang sras bcas rgyal ba'i thugs rje dang : snod bcud kun gyi dpal dang yon tan tshogs: 'od zer rnam par bsdus te thim pa las: 'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku 'grub cing : mchog dngos grub pa'i dam tshig rdzas su gyur: mthar sgrub sngags gtso bor bzla'o/ bsam lhun bum sgrub kyi khog dbub nas khol du phyung ba'o/ pa) rig 'dzin srog sgrub yid bzhin nor bu las/ bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi brgyud 'debs dbang bzhi'i bcud 'bebs bzhugs so/ ka dag dang po'i sangs rgyas 'od ma'i 'gyur*/ /ye shes lnga rdzogs rigs lnga rdo rje sems/ /thugs rje kun khyab rgyal sras rigs gsum mgon/ /gsol ba 'debs so dgongs brgyud byin rlabs stsol/ /sprul pa'i sku mchog dga' rab rdo rje dang*/ /las kyi dbang mo grub pa'i rig 'dzin brgyad/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje mtsho rgyal man+da rar/

/gsol ba 'debs so lta ba'i gdeng chen spor/ /phung lnga rnam dag rigs lnga thod phreng dang*/ /tshogs brgyad gnas dag gu ru mtshan mchog brgyad/ /rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang rje 'bangs nyer lnga la/ /gsol ba 'debs so sgom pa'i rtsal chen bskyed/ /bud+dha dz+nyā na gter 'byin rtsa gsum gling*/ /hūm̐ chen 'gro 'dul chos bdag lung zin sogs/ /dgongs brda snyan brgyud rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so spyod pa'i bogs chen dbyung*/ /dbang chen yab yum yi dam rgyud sde bzhi/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro dpa' bo ging chen dang*/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lhar/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /ma mgon lcam dral drag po sde lnga dang*/ /rdo rje chos srung nor lha gter bdag sogs/ /snang srid bla ma'i dkyil 'khor rol pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so don gnyis mthar phyin stsol/ /dkyil 'khor rnam bzhir dbang bzhis rang rgyud smin/ /sgrib pa bzhi dag rig 'dzin bzhi'i lam 'byongs/ /sku bzhi ye shes ka dag mngon gyur nas/ /snang bzhi mthar phyin 'od lus 'grub par shog / ces pa'ang gi li sgrub bla'i ngor gnam lcags pa gu h+yas spel/ pha) ༄༅/ / bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi las byang ngag 'don chog khrigs su bsdebs pa khyer bde don zab ces bya ba bzhugs so/ phyogs dus rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dpyid/ /sin+dhu'i dwang mtshor ngo mtshar pad sdong rtser/ /rang byung sangs rgyas skur snang pad+mar skyes/ /mkha' 'gro'i sprin phung spros de spyi bo'i rgyan/ /gang gi sgrub thabs bye ba phrag brgya'i phul/ /bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus kyi/ /phrin las snying po'i 'don chog khrigs bsdeb pa/ khyer bde don zab 'god la gnang ba stsol/ de yang gzhung las/ nga nyid bzhugs dang dbyer med byin rlabs can: yid bzhin nor bu bla ma'i sgrub pa bstan:

zhes gu ru nyid dang dbyer mi gnyis pa nyid kyis bsngags pa'i thugs sgrub rgya mtsho'i yang bcud o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter thugs sgrub bder 'dus phrin las 'bring po dkyil 'khor lnga pa'i dgongs don nyams su len pa la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ gzhung las/ de yang bla ma sgrub pa'i rim pa ni: bkra shis byin chags rgyal bas me tog 'thor: smon lam mchog ldan dben ri yid 'ong der: /mkho ba'i yo byad sgrub pa'i cha rkyen bsags: zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las/ bum pa rnam rgyal sman sgrub bdud rtsis gtams: kha rgyan mgul chings la sogs tshang bar bya: bhan+dha mtshan ldan sman raka phud kyis bkang : rtsa gsum gtor ma rgyan bzang legs par bshams: gzhan yang spyan gzigs tshogs gtor tshang bas bskor: zhes gsungs pa bzhin rig 'dzin gong mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i sgrub gnas khyad par can rnams su/ dus khyad par can yar mar gyi tshes bcu sogs kyi skabs/ thog mar rang gi spros pa dang mtshams pa'i dkyil 'khor bkod pa'am mdun stegs rim pa gsum gyi steng*/ dbus su dbang bzhi'i rten dkyil 'khor ram 'bru dkar gyi lha tshom bkod pa'i steng*/ bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings dmar po/ de yi steng thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba'i khar dar dmar brgyad ltebs me long sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor shel rdo sogs brtsegs mar byas pa bsham/ bdag bskyed rkyang pa bsnyen 'brel dang tshes bcu dus mchod tshogs 'khor lta bur ma 'dzoms kyang sgrub gtor gcig pus chog /gtor ma rang lugs dpal ri ma dang pad sdong ma zhes bca' gzhi zur gsal ltar gong gtor dang*/ bang rim bar mar rig 'dzin srog sgrub bskang gtor dang de dag gi g.yas g.yon du sman raka chad brtan bskul gsum/ chos skyong sde lnga gtso bor gyur pa'i rang lugs gsol kha dang*/ bang rim 'og mar chu gnyis sngon du 'gro bas nyer spyod 'dod yon lnga sogs mchod pa'i bye brag dang*/

gzhan yang dkar bgegs thun gyi gtor ma tshogs 'khor yo byad bcas 'du bya'o/ de bzhin slob dpon gyi mdun du las bum/ ḍā ma ru/ dar dmar nag /nas gzed yungs gzed/ rdor dril/ las phur/ nang mchod sogs dgos pa'i yo byad ma tshang ba med par tshags su tshud par bya'o/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ thog mar bkra shis brgyad pa/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ sku gsum gsol 'debs sogs nas theg chen dgu ldan/ 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs/ gnas ri so dgu bcas rgyas bsdus skabs dang bstun la/ chos spyod zur gsal ltar bya/ dang po sngon 'gro la rgyud sbyang ba dang cho ga'i sngon 'gro gnyis/ dang po la'ang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdor sems bsgom bzlas dang*/ tshogs bsags bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang lnga las/ thog mar skyabs yul skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar sad par mos la/ rang gzhan sems can rnams 'di nas byang chub bar skyabs su 'gro ba'i 'dun pa dang bcas/

na mo: bde gshegs kun 'dus gu ru pad+ma 'byung : thugs rje'i bdag nyid o rgyan chos kyi rje: rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gsum kun 'dus la: bdag yid rtse gcig gdung bas skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ gnyis pa sems can thams cad byang chub tu 'god 'dod kyi smon pa dang*/ de'i ched du lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bya'o snyam pa ni 'jug pa ste/ smon 'jug byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i dam bca' brtan po'i ngang*/ hoḥ gdod nas rang rig rnam dag sku lnga'i mchog: ji bzhin rtogs pa'i byin rlabs nus rtsal gyi: 'od zer nar ma 'gro la rab spros nas: yang dag sangs rgyas lam 'god sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ mthar skyabs yul rnams rang la thim pas de dag gi thugs rgyud kyi yon tan khyad par can bdag rgyud la 'phos nas byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ gsum pa sgrib pa sbyong ba rdor sems bsgom bzlas ni/ āḥ spyi bor pad dkar zla ba'i gdan: rigs 'dus bla ma rdo rje sems: dkar gsal rdor dril longs spyod rdzogs: thugs srog āḥl yig brgyas bskor: bdud rtsis sgo gsum sgrib dag gyur: oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya: ma nu pā la ya: badz+ra satwa te no pa tiṣ+ṭha: dṛ ḍho me bha wa: su to ṣ+yo me bha wa: su po ṣ+yo me bha wa: a nu rak+to me bha wa: sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha: sarba karma su tsa me: tsit+taṃ shrī yaṃ ku ru hūm̐: ha ha ha ha ho: bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta: badz+ra mā me muñca: badz+ri bha wa ma ha sa ma ya sa twa āḥ yig brgya bzlas shing stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bshags sdom la 'bad par bya'o/ hoḥ bdag ni bag med rmongs pa yis: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig gi: don dang 'gal ba ci mchis pa: rigs 'dus dkyil 'khor tshogs la bshags: gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid: thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid la: 'gro ba'i don phyir bdag skyabs mchi: sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/

sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ ces skyabs gsol gyi tshig brjod pa dang*/ rang rgyud kyi sdig ltung dag nas bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' bde stong chen po'i ngo bor 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam/ bzhi pa tshogs gnyis bsags pa snod bcud bdag lus longs spyod dang bcas pa maṇ+ḍal du dmigs te 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: gling bzhi ri rab khyon ltar bkod pa dang : dngos 'byor yid sprul maṇ+ḍal dag pa'i tshogs: skyabs yul kun 'dus mchog gsum lha tshogs la: 'gro ba'i don phyir dmigs te phu+ul ba yis: ma gyur 'gro kun byang chub lam dgod shog: oṃ i daṃ gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍal keṃ nir+ya ta yā mi: zhes skyabs yul gyi lha la ltos med du 'bul zhing mi dmigs pa'i ngang du bzhag par bya'o/ lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor la dang po tshogs zhing bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid pad+ma 'byung gnas gsal ba yi: spyi bor khyab bdag mgon po rdo rje sems: dung mdog rdor dril bsnol thabs skyil krung bzhugs: yum snyems gri thod bde stong sku la 'khril: hūm̐: de yi spyi bor mgon po 'od mi 'gyur: dmar gsal mnyam bzhag rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: 'ja' lus 'od phung dbyings rig ngo bor gsal: gnyis pa gsol ba 'debs pa'i slad du thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshamasaḥ pad+ma ge sar sdong po laḥ ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyesaḥ pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su gragasaḥ 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskoraḥ khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyiḥ byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsolaḥ gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐ḥ de nas gsol ba 'debs shing dbang bzhi len pa ni/ mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag po dang bcas te/ hūm̐: thog ma'i mgon po kun bzang 'od ma'i 'gyur: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs:

khyab bdag dag pa rdor sems bde gshegs 'dus: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rgyal mchog thugs rje gcig 'dus pad+ma 'byung : gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: dbyings phyug nam mkha'i gos can mtsho rgyal ma: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bka' bab gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas/ /rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zab gter sgo 'byed rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling*/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas/ /rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /lung zin chos bdag thugs mchog rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas/ /rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /las can rgyud 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas/ /rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ yi dam rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i zhabs: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lhar/ gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: snying thig skyong ba'i ral gcig sngags srung mar: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: rigs 'dus bla ma 'grub bar byin gyis rlobs: skyabs yul kun kyang 'od zhu rim pa bzhin: spyi bor thim nas bdag lus snang stong nyid: dbang bzhi rdzogs nas zang thal chen po'i sku: gu ru pad+ma 'od 'bar mchog 'grub shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: badz+ra sa mā ya dza sid+dhi pha la a be sha ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐:

zhes dbang bzhi blangs shing bla ma rang dang dbyer med du bsres la chos dbyings ka dag gi ngang du mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ gnyis pa cho ga'i sngon 'gro la 'gal rkyen bsal ba dang mthun rkyen sgrub pa gnyis/ dang po la'ang dkar phyogs gnas gzhi'i bdag po la gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcol ba dang*/ nag phyogs bka' bsgo zhing bskrad pa'o/ dang po dkar gtor bka' brgyad ltar bya srol bzhin/ gser skyems dkar gtor bcas chu gtsang gis bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ ā kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma nāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na na twata oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swā hā: oṃ yak+ṣa hūm̐: oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃḥ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma gser skyems mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las om̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du: oṃ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+ya: sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: om̐ badz+ra a mṛ t om̐ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ā wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐: om̐ dz+nyā na a wa lo ki te na maḥs man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi bha wa sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hri da ya dz+wa la ni hūm̐: om̐ na maḥ sa man+ta bud+dha nam gra he shwa ri pra bhañja te ma hā sa ma ya swā hā': om̐ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ om̐ las 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga: bh+rūm̐ las rin chen gzhal yas khang : trām̐ las sna tshogs rat+na'i snod: hrīḥlas gsung dbyangs drug cur ldan: āḥlas ci 'dod phun sum tshogs: so so'i dga' mgu tshim byed pa: 'dod pa'i yo byad chen por gyur: hūm̐: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang : grub pa thob pa'i rig 'dzin rnam brgyad kyi: bka' dang dam tshig gnyan la gnas pa yi: lha brgyad klu brgyad gza' brgyad rgyu skar brgyad: sde brgyad sde dpon sum cu rtsa gnyis dang :

phyogs skyong bcu dang sa bdag dmu sman dang : phyi nang gsang ba'i dregs pa sde bcu gnyis: dpal gyi mgon po chen po bdun cu lnga: rgyal chen bzhi dang dus kyi skyong ma 'bum: mkha' la rgyu ba'i yid gzugs gzhi bdag dang : lo zla zhag dus chu tshod dbang ba'i lha: skyes lha yul lha gzhi bdag 'go ba'i lha: khyad par rin chen gter gyi srung ma dang : pha ri tshur kha g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab ri: steng 'og phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gnas pa'i tshogs: bka' dang dam la gnas pa'i gzhi bdag rnams: 'dir gshegs gser skyems phud dang gtor ma bzhes: bdag gi legs nyes bya ba ci la yang : ko long ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par: rin chen gter gyi sa 'di myur du stsol: slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' las ma 'da' bar: bdag gi bsam pa sgrubs la re ba skongs: las bzhi phrin las gang bcol myur du sgrubs: lo legs nad zhi sa phyogs bkra shis nas: dkar po dge bcu sgrub pa'i rogs dan sgrubs: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ bhū mi pa ti lo ka pā la sarba dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hiḥ zhes dkar gtor phyogs gtsang sar phul zhing : bkra shis pa'i phrin las bcol: gnyis pa nag phyogs bgegs la gtor ma bsngo zhing bka' bsgo ba la/ thog mar bgegs gtor byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ de nas rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis lan chags bgegs rigs kyi mgron dgug pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid dbang drag 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas: gzi byin 'od stong zer ma phyogs bcur 'phros: de yi shugs las bgegs rnams snying rjes bkug: gtor ma len phyir gnas 'dir myur du mchis:

oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dza dzaḥ bgegs tshogs 'byung po a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ de nas 'dod yon gtor ma bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs dang 'byung po log 'dren tshogs: deng nas phan dge'i byang chub lam dgod phyir: yid mthun 'dod yon mchod sbyin 'di bzhes la: gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du 'gro bar gyis: ci ste mi 'gro gdug pa'i sems 'chang na: bdag nyid dbang chen drag sngags phyung brdeg gis: khyod kyi lus ngag yid gsum rdul du brlag: de bas rang rang gnas su phyir dengs shig: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas bgegs tshogs phyir bskrad cing mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang : yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong mthu rtsal gyis: dngos grub bar chad byed ba'i bgegs: log par 'dren pa bdud kyi tshogs: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'tshe byed na: bdag nyid dpal chen thugs khros nas: khro bo spros pas nam mkha' gang : khro mo spros pas sa gzhi gang : sras mchog khro chung bar snang gang : me yi bya khyung phyogs bcur 'khrigs: drwa mig lcags sdig glog ltar 'khyugs: 'khor yug mtshon char thog ltar 'bebs: bgegs tshogs thal ba'i rdul du brlag: de bas bka' las ma 'da' zhig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra hūm̐: rak+sha hūm̐: yak+sha hūm̐: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya: gnod byed bgegs tshogs thams cad tshin+dha tshin+dha ban+dha ban+dha ha na ha na pa tsa pa tsa ma tha ma tha da ha da ha hu lu hu lu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: de nas srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐: nga nyid gdod nas rab khros he ru kaḥ ka dag thugs las brdol ba'i shes rab mtshon: rno dbal lhun grub rang rtsal 'gengs pa'i tshogs: bar med khyab ste skar ltar rab 'khrugs pa: bsrungs mtshams med pa dum bu gcig pa ni:

e dbyings mkha' ltar gnas pa'i gur khang gyur: oṃ badz+ra dharma dz+nyā na tsakra e khaṃ raṃ dz+wa la rak+ṣa ye swā hā: bdag nyid kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer khro chung me dpung mtshon thun gyi tshogs spros bgegs tshogs rnams phar bskrad/ 'od zer tshur 'dus pas gzhom med rdo rje'i srung 'khor du gyur bar mos la stong nyid mi shigs pa'i rgya yis gdab bo/ gnyis pa mthun rkyen spel ba la mchod pa'i yo byad dang dkyil 'khor byin dbab pa brda bsgo phyag dam bca' ba bcas lnga/ dang po mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa la/ thog mar thun mong phyi yi mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes brjod pas mchod pa'i gzhi khyab par bsang chu 'thor/ hūm̐: rig pa'i gru 'dzin khyon ltar yangs pa'i dbus: phyi mchod lha mo me tog bdug spos ma: mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo dang : gzugs mdzes lang ling gar mo yid 'ong rigs: lta na sdug cing tshul bzang mchod thogs tshogs: grangs med sprul pa rgyal ba mnyes rdzas gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa khyad par nang gi mchod pa la sman raka gtor gsum las dang po bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: bhan+dha mtshan ldan lcang lo 'khyil ba'i nang : sha lnga rdzas lnga pañca a mṛ ta: dri lnga 'bru bcud chang dang dza gad phud: sman mchod dug lnga sel ba'i ye shes mdangs: dkar mngar kha dang ro skyur zhun gyi rigs: sna tshogs tshang 'di rgyal ba mnyes rdzas gyur: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ gnyis pa rak+ta byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: bum ril bhan+dha dum gcig zlum pa'i dbus: bzang mo'i mkha' yi mu kha sgra gcan gyi: 'khor lor khyab 'jug myur 'gros rab bskul nas: 'dar ma'i rlung las 'gyu ba'i byams chen po: chags med dmar chen gzi 'od 'khyil ba'i tshogs: mtsho ltar 'khrugs pa rgyal ba mnyes rdzas gyur:

oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ gsum pa gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: thabs shes rin chen las grub nyi zla'i snod: rgya cher srid pa'i khyon ltar yangs pa'i dbus: snod gzugs bsdus pa'i bcud mchog ba liṃ ta: lhun mtho dbyings la bsnyegs pa'i rgyan mdzes btsugs: mdangs ldan bcud g.yo rgyas pa'i zer stong 'khyugs: kun tshang mchod pas rgyal ba mnyes mdzad gyur: oṃ ma hā bha ling+ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ gnyis pa byin dbab pa ni/ rang nyid lha yi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin phung gtibs pa ltar byon nas rten bsgrub kyi rdzas dang rnal 'byor pa'i sgo gsum la sib sib thim pas rnam dag ye shes kyi 'khor lor byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhwa gos gzab 'chor dang*/ spos bdug gdung ba'i dbyangs dang rol mo sna tshogs kyi sgra dang bcas spro na byin 'bebs rgyas pa yang 'dir bya/ hūm̐: 'og min bkod pa rab rdzogs lhun grub zhing : lnga ldan zang thal 'gyu ba'i pho brang nas: rigs 'dus rgyal ba rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams: 'du 'bral med par thugs rje'i shugs mtshon nas: gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin chen myur du phob: mchog thun 'bad med lhug par deng stsol shog: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sa ma ya a be sha ya a āḥ

mthar me tog bkram brdung dang bcas byin chen dbab/ gsum pa rang rig don gyi brda sgo dbye ba ni/ hūm̐: rang rig gdod nas kun 'dus rtsa ba gsum: sku lnga lhun grub 'du 'bral med mod kyang : bar du shes bya phra mo'i kun rtog tshogs: da ni rmongs gzhom rang rig brda sgo phyes: oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ bzhi pa rang rig lha dang mjal ba'i brda phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: ma rig ka dag klong thim g.ya' bral phyir: tshe rabs gnyug ma'i rang rig lha zhal mjal: 'dus ma byas kyi gshis lugs so mar bstod: nam yang bag yod mi 'da' chos 'khor bskor: oṃ badz+ra dharma shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na tsakra hūm̐: lnga pa rang bzhin ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor mi gtong bar bzung ba'i dam bca' ba ni/ hūm̐: yang dag don rtogs rlabs po che: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: ngo mtshar che nyid snyan pa'i dal: srog gi phyir yang mi btang bzung : oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta sa ma ye hūm̐: gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bskyed bzlas gnyis/ dang po la'ang gzhi ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi khog dbub pa/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa gnyis/ dang po de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐: ka dag lhun grub bde ba che: mu mtha' bral ba kun la khyab: blo 'das rtog med de bzhin ngang : thog ma'i mgon pos de ltar smras: oṃ dharma dhā tu gar+bha shū n+ya ta hūm̐: gnyis pa kun tu snang ba'i ting 'dzin ni/ hūm̐: rang byung dmigs su ma mchis kyang : zang thal chen po'i brtul zhugs kyi: rol rtsal 'gags med kun tu snang : rdo rje sems dpas de ltar smras: oṃ badz+ra dz+nyā na dharma sa twa swa bhā wa hūm̐: gsum pa rgyu yi ting 'dzin ni/ hūm̐: chos rnams bden med de bzhin la: rang byung snying po rgyu yi mchog: kun gyi srog tu hūm̐ gnas pas: pad+ma badz+ras de ltar smras: oṃ gu ru dz+nyā na sarba tsit+ta badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐: gnyis pa rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa la'ang*/

dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten pa'i 'khor lo bskyed pa/ ye shes pa dbab cing spyan drangs pa/ gnyis med du bsre zhing phyag 'tshal mchod bstod 'bul ba bdun las/ dang po rten bskyed pa la gnyis kyi dang po 'byung ba rim brtsegs bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: ye shes lnga yi rang mdangs las: rtogs pa'i rlung lnga rol rtsal shar: de las phra mo'i sa bon dag: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: brtsegs thabs 'byung ba lnga ru grub: oṃ e ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la: ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la: a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la: ru tra ti ra baṃ: hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭḥ a dharma ya hoḥ gnyis pa rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa la thog mar yum lnga'i mkha' klong rnam par dag pa gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: e nam mkha' mthing nag kun tu bzang mo'i mkha': yam̐ g.yo byed rlung ri dam tshig sgrol ma'i mkha': ram̐ sreg byed me ri na bza' dkar mo'i mkha': kham̐ dam tshig bdud rtsi mā ma kī yi mkha': sum̐ dbang chen sa gzhi sangs rgyas spyan ma'i mkha': keṃ rdo rje ri rab mi shigs brag chen steng : bh+rūm̐ ye shes mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs pho brang bsgom: oṃ bh+rūm̐ dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍal tsakra hūm̐: hūm̐: de dbus mi 'gyur sna tshogs rdo rje yi: lte bar ye shes lnga ldan gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi lhun grub ngang nyid las: rtsig pa 'dod snam pha gu drwa ba mdzes: shar bu mda' yab pu shu brgyad dang ldan: bcu drug gdung ma ka ba brgyad kyis btegs: zhu chen zhu chung nyi zla 'ja' ris 'khyugs: 'phan dar bla bre yol ba sna tshogs bres: phyogs bzhir rta babs chos 'khor nyi zlas mdzes: dbus su rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa'i: zla gam bya 'dab 'od 'bar nor bu'i tog: thog steng gser gyi rgyal mtshan bcu drug dang : rin chen 'phan dar mdzes pa'i cod pan 'phyangs: phyi rol dur khrod chen po brgyad rnams dang : me brgyad shing brgyad chu brgyad rlung brgyad dang :

sprin brgyad nam mkha' brgyad dang mchod rten brgyad: de nas sprul pa yang sprul rnam pa can: sgyu ma'i rtsal du so sor shar ba ni: phyi rol dur khrod chen po brgyad rnams ni: bsil tshal sku la rdzogs dang laṅka brtsegs: pad 'khyil lhun grub gter dang gsang chen rol: he chen brdal ba la sogs dur khrod brgyad: dur khrod brgyad la dbang phyug nyer brgyad dang : baṃ ro brgyad la zhing skyong laṅka brgyad: keng rus brgyad la kau rī ma mo brgyad: gcan spyang brgyad la siṃ ha phra men brgyad: dur bya brgyad la lha bdud gnas nyul brgyad: dug sbrul brgyad la gcan spyang gdong chen brgyad: me 'bar brgyad la gnas pa'i gza' brgyad ni: ki kang mig dmar nyi zla lhag pa dang : phur bu spen pa pa sangs dag dang brgyad: rngam pa shing brgyad dag la gnas pa yi: hūm̐ kar mañju shrī nā gardzu: pra bha hastī bi ma mi tra dang : dha na saṃ skṛ rom+bu gu h+ya dang : shān+tiṃ gar+bha la sogs rig 'dzin brgyad: bdud rtsi'i chu mig brgyad la gnas pa yi: mtha' yas 'jog po dung skyong stobs rgyu dang : pad+ma hu lu ka dang rigs ldan no: bā su ta la sogs te klu chen brgyad: ye shes rlung brgyad dag la gnas pa ni: dbyings phyug spyan ma mā kī gos dkar sgron: tsaṇ+ḍa lī dang skyong byed rnal 'byor ma: sprin chen g.yo ba brgyad la gnas pa yi: dbang po tshangs pa dbang phyug khyab 'jug dang : bh+ring gi ri ti dga' byed tshogs kyi bdag: kīrti la sogs lha brgyad gnas pa'o: nam mkha' brgyad la gnas pa'i zhing khams lha: kun bzang rnam snang mi bskyod rdo rje dang : mi 'khrugs rdor sems rin 'byung 'od dpag med: don yod grub pa la sogs sangs rgyas bzhugs: mchod rten brgyad la rang srung sangs rgyas ni: rnam gzigs gtsug tor can dang log par skyobs: 'khor ba 'jigs dang gser thub 'od srung dang : shākya thub pa byams pa mos snang brgyad:

de la sogs te dur khrod bkod pa brgyad: phyi rol rdo rwa me ri srung ba'i gur: 'ja' 'od lug rgyud gtibs pa'i pho brang gsal: gnyis pa brten pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha bskyed pa la gtso dang 'khor bskyed pa gnyis so/ dang po ni/ hūm̐: de dbus pad+ma nyi zla mdzes pa'i steng : gser gyi rdo rje hūm̐ yig dmar pos mtshan: 'od zhu dran rdzogs gu ru pad+ma ni: dkar dmar mdangs ldan bde chen rgyal po'i tshul: pad zhwa za ber chos gos phod kha gsol: rin chen snyan rgyan dar dmar sku rags mdzes: rdo rje thod pa tshe bum kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams: rgya lham gsol zhing zhabs gnyis rol stabs tshul: bag dro lhun chags gzi brjid ldan par bskyed: hūm̐: lhun grub stong gsal bde chen sku yi sbubs: ye shes 'khor lo lnga yi 'od klong du: badz+ra thod phreng dkar 'dzum mdzes 'od 'phro: pad+ma thod phreng dmar la chags pa'i mdangs: bud+dha thod phreng smug nag zhi ma khro: rat+na thod phreng ser bzhad mdzes cing sgeg: karma thod phreng ljang nag rab tu gtum: thams cad phyag g.yas thod pa'i cang te'u: g.yon pa mnyam bzhag bdud rtsi bhan+dha bsnams: dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ka ber phyam bklubs: bdud 'dul pad zhwa rtse rnon nyi zlas brgyan: zhabs rnams rol stabs swag chen rgya lham gsol: rang 'od 'byung lnga'i yum 'khril bde chen bskul: rtsa khams zhing kun dwangs pa'i lha sku gsal: gnyis pa 'khor tshogs bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: g.yas g.yon pad zlar bde chen bskyed pa'i yum: lha lcam dmar mos mda' dar tshe bum bsnams: mtsho rgyal dkar mos bhan+dha bdud rtsi mchod: zhi 'dzum dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan: chags pa'i nyams kyis gtso la gus pas 'dud: hūm̐: de yi spyi bor nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan: rigs 'dus ngo bo bla ma rdo rje 'chang : sku mdog mthing nag rdor dril bsnol thabs can: phyed skyil pang du dbyings phyug dmar mo 'khril:
