rdo rje tshe bum yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: longs spyod rdzogs sku zung 'jug ldan par bsgom: hūm̐: de yi spyi bor 'ja' 'od thig le'i klong : thog ma'i sangs rgyas snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur: dmar gsal mnyam bzhag skyil krung lham mer gsal: hūm̐: gtso bo'i phyogs bzhi'i 'khor lo'i rim pa bzhir: mdun phyogs pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: dbang chen dmar smug zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: g.yas pas dbyug tho g.yon pas thod khrag bsnams: dur khrod chas ldan brkyang bskum gar stabs can: rdo rje phag mo gri thod mgul nas 'khyud: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'khril sbyor gsal bar bskyed: hūm̐: g.yas su pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: 'jam dpal dmar ser khro 'dzum sgeg bzhad tshul: phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon pas po ti 'dzin: dur khrod chas ldan brkyang bskum gar thabs can: yum chen sher phyin dmar gsal gri thod 'dzin: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'khril sbyor gsal bar bskyed: hūm̐: rgyab tu pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: 'jig rten dbang phyug zhal gsum phyag drug pa: dkar dmar mthing ba'i khro 'dzum mdzes zhal can: g.yas gnyis shel phreng nor bu 'bar ba 'dzin: g.yon gnyis tshe bum bdud rtsi lhung bzed bsnams: rtsa phyag thal sbyar 'chi med tshe bum thogs: longs sku'i chas ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor 'khril: mda' dar dung dmar yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: zhabs gnyis yab 'khril gtso bo bzhengs stabs gsal: hūm̐: g.yon du pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: phyags rdor mthing nag rdo rje sdigs mdzub can: dur khrod chas ldan brkyang bskum 'gying bag bzhugs: sgrol ljang pad phreng dung dmar mgul nas 'khyud: zhabs gnyis sked 'khril zung 'jug ldan par bsgom: hūm̐: de yi phyi rol 'khor yug rim pa bzhin: sna tshogs rin chen mdzes pa'i gdan khri'i steng : 'od zer thig le 'bar ba'i shar phyogs su: pad+ma 'byung gnas mthing nag zhi ma khro:

rdo rje dril 'dzin lha lcam dmar mo 'khril: gcer bu rus rgyan phyed skyil gar stabs bzhugs: lho ru blo ldan mchog sred dkar gsal mdzes: ḍā ru pad phor bsnams nas dar thod bcing : dar dmar phod gsol rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: nub tu nyi ma 'od zer li khri'i mdog: khro 'dzum kha ṭ+wāṃ nyi zer zhags pa bsnams: gcer bu stag sham rus rgyan rol stabs gsal: byang du seṅge sgra sgrogs mthing ka gtum: skra gseb seng skad sgrog cing seng lpags gyon: rdo rje sdigs mdzub stag sham zhabs dor bzhugs: hūm̐: shar lho pad+ma sam+bha dkar smug mdzes: rab byung cha lugs chos gos gsum dang ldan: thod pa skyabs sbyin mdzad nas skyil krung bzhugs: lho nub pad+ma rgyal po dmar gsal sgeg: ḍā ru pad phreng me long lcags kyu bsnams: ber gsol dal 'bol steng na rol stabs bzhugs: nub byang shākya seṅge gser bzang mdog: sa gnon mnyam bzhag dge slong cha lugs can: chos gos dmar po gsol nas zung 'jug bzhugs: byang shar rdo rje gro lod smug nag rngam: rdo rje phur pa bsnams shing rab byung chas: mgo phreng rgyan ldan stag steng gar stabs bzhugs: de yi phyi rol pad 'dab bcu drug la: rdo rje dpa' bo yab yum ging yab yum: rat+na dpa' bo yab yum ging yab yum: pad+ma dpa' bo yab yum ging yab yum: karma dpa' bo yab yum ging yab yum: thams cad gar stabs rus rgyan g.yer kha'i sgra: zhi ma khro la thor tshugs rus rgyan can: phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon pas bhan dmar bsnams: yum rnams thams cad kha ṭ+wāṃ gru mor brten: kun kyang rang mdog gzi brjid ldan par bsgom: de yi phyi rol 'khor yug bar mtshams su: gsang ba'i lha mo bcu drug gar stabs sgyur: rang mdog phyag mtshan mdzes pa'i rgyan dang ldan: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes pa'i tshul du gsal: hūm̐: dbang phyug laṅka zhing skyong gnas nyul sogs: nyi ma dang ni zer bzhin snang ba yi:

sprul pa yang sprul kun kyang 'ja' ltar lhags: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyis: 'og min zhing dang rnga yab dpal ri nas: pad 'byung rgyal ba rig 'dzin lha tshogs rnams: gsang ba'i pho brang gnas 'dir spyan drangs gyur: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ gsum pa ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs shing byin dbab pa ni/ dri bzang gi spos btang zhing rol mo gling bu'i dbyangs snyan dang bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐: bzhi pa dam ye gnyis med du bsre zhing bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: ma chags skyon bral pad+ma ge sar dbus: 'dab stong khyon yangs rin chen seng khri'i steng : pad+ma 'byung gnas rtsa gsum ngo bo mchog: bde gshegs 'dus pa'i lha tshogs bzhugs su gsol: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sa ma ya satwaṃ: lnga pa gnyis med kyi dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal zhing mchod bstod 'bul ba la/ thog mar rang nyid las spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis phyag mchod sogs las rim la 'jug par mos shing*/ de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: ka dag lhun grub bla ma chos kyi sku: zang thal bde chen bla ma longs spyod rdzogs: sna tshogs ma 'gags bla ma sprul pa'i sku: rtsa gsum bder 'dus lha la phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ drug pa mchod pa 'bul ba la drug /dang po phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa ni/

hūm̐: bde chen ngo bo bla ma thabs kyi yab: stong gsal ma 'gags rig pa shes rab yum: zung 'jug dga' bzhi rol pa'i 'khrul 'khor sgyur: phyag rgya bla med mchod pa bzhes su gsol: oṃ badz+ra dz+nyā na mu ṭa rā ga ya ho sarba pū dza hoḥ gnyis pa bstod dbyangs glu'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: gzugs mdzes gar mo lang ling glu dbyangs can: bde ba mi bzod g.yo ba'i sgra skad sgrog: dri za'i dbyangs snyan lta bur sgrun med tshogs: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ lā s+ye mā l+ye gīrti nīrti swa ra sarba pū dza hoḥ gsum pa 'dod yon phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: mdzes pa'i me tog dri zhim bdug pa'i spos: snang gsal mar me bsil ba'i dri chab dang : ro mchog zhal zas snyan pa'i rol mo'i rigs: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: bzhi pa nyon mongs ma spangs nang mchod 'bul ba la sman raka gtor gsum las/ bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: dug lnga rnam dag sku lnga ye shes rdzas: gdod nas snang srid chos sku'i rol rtsal dang : sha lnga rdzas mchog pañca a mṛ ta: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta dz+nyā na pū dza la kha kha khā hi:

bye brag nad sel sman rigs kyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: rnam par rgyal sogs dug lnga sel ba'i sman: kha mngar skyur dang bcud ldan tsha ba'i ro: lde gu khaṇ+ḍa zhun khol 'khyil ba'i tshogs: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ bhai ṣa dz+yai aṇ+ṭau a mṛ ta sarba pañca pū dza la kha kha khā hi: bdud rtsi lag mchod 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kun bzang yab yum rdo rje 'chang chen dang*/ /snang ba mtha' yas dgongs brgyud bla ma la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal ba rigs lnga sogs/ /rig 'dzin brda brgyud bla ma thams cad la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ dga' rab shrī sing rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung*/ /bka' bab lung chen tshig brgyud bla ma la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal sangs rgyas ye shes dang*/ /rtsa gsum gling pa gter brgyud bla ma la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ thugs mchog rdo rje dkon mchog seṅge dang*/ /ye shes rgyal mtshan mi 'jigs rdo rje sogs/ /dbang lung man ngag don brgyud bla ma la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ thod phreng sde lnga lha lcam mtsho rgyal dang*/ /rnam rol mtshan brgyad rig 'dzin 'dus pa la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ yi dam rta phag rigs gsum mgon po dang*/ /dngos grub stsal ba yi dam 'dus pa la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ging dang dpa' bo laṅka gnas nyul sogs/ /grub gnyis char 'bebs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/

sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ mgon po sde lnga dregs sde sa ya dang*/ /bka' gter srung ma dam can rgya mtsho la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ sku gsum mi shigs rdo rje'i klong*/ /ma bcos mchog gi dngos grub kyis/ /bdag rgyud sku gsum snying por grol/ /bde gshegs go 'phang myur thob shog au ḍī sha dha karmas sbyar ba'o// // bha ling gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: thod pa mtshan ldan lcang lo 'khyil ba'i dbus: dpal gyi gtor ma brjid ldan ri ltar spungs: bcud g.yo gling bzhi rol mtsho bkod legs brgyan: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ ma hā bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: dmar chen rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: dung dmar bde chen yangs pa'i bhan+dha ru: chags med bcud g.yo mdangs ldan rlabs su 'khyil: rgyud drug bsgral ba'i rmad byung rak+ta ni: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: lnga pa gsang mchod sbyor sgrol gnyis las/ bde stong sbyor ba dga' bzhi'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: shes rab mu kha chos 'byung sgra gcan rtser: dga' chen khyab bdag nor bu'i sor bsnun pas: byang sems dkar dmar bde rgyun g.yo ba'i tshogs: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra a haṃ pra mo ti raṃ sarba pū dza khā hi: zhe sdang nyon mongs bsgral ba'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: shes bya'i lta ba gyad kyi phur pa yis: nga bdag srid pa'i ru tra bsgral gtubs nas: sha khrag klad rus phung por spungs pa 'di: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su+u ta la kha kha khā hi: drug pa yang gsang de kho na nyid ting 'dzin don gyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: gdod nas rnam dag ye shes sku lnga'i mchog: 'du 'bral med pa'i dbyings rig so ma ni:

bsngo mkhan 'bul yul mi dmigs mchog mchod nyid: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ dz+nyā na dhā tu swa bhā pū dza hoḥ bdun pa rang bzhin lhun grub dkyil 'khor la bstod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: thog ma'i mgon po ye shes lam me ba: ka dag dbyings rig bde chen 'du 'bral med: thugs rje chags pa'i mnyam bzhag skyil krung can: mgon po 'od mi 'gyur la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: nam mkha'i mdangs ldan rigs brgya'i cod pan can: khyab bdag ye shes 'khor los 'gro ba 'dren: thabs shes dbyer med rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: zung 'jug dga' ba'i dbang phyug sku la 'khril: sgyu ma'i ngang tshul phyed skyil rol stabs can: rdor 'chang longs spyod rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: ma bcos spros bral ka dag ngo bo nyid: zang thal 'gags med thugs rjes so sor ston: 'gro ba'i don phyir thugs rje sgyu ma'i gar: o rgyan gu ru pad 'byung sku la bstod: hūm̐: sku mdog dkar mdzes zhi 'dzum chags pa ni: ye shes sku lnga 'du 'bral med pa'i brda: dbu la gser gyi snyan zhu gsol ba ni: bde chen rgyal po 'gro ba'i don mdzad brda: de la rin chen rdo rje btsugs pa ni: kun gzhi gnas lugs 'gyur ba med pa'i brda: rtse mor rgod po'i dang ru btsugs pa ni: sa lam theg chen dus gcig 'jug pa'i brda: dar tshon sna lnga'i cod pan 'phur ba ni: ye shes lnga ldan rol rtsal ston pa'i brda: nyi zla nor bu'i rgyan mdangs spras pa ni: srid zhi'i ma rig mun pa sel ba'i brda: sna tshogs rdo rje'i rgya gram ldan pa ni: dgongs brda rgya mtsho'i slob dpon yin pa'i brda: khyung gshog rin chen drwa bas spras pa ni: brgyud 'dzin bu la 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i brda: rat+na snyan rgyan gdu bu 'khrol ba ni: 'khor los sgyur rgyal kun gyi dad dpon brda: mthing nag chu ris phod ka bklubs pa ni: zab gsang lta ba mi shigs ston pa'i brda:

gong lag mu tig chun pos spras pa ni: rtsa rlung bde stong 'du 'bral med pa'i brda: dar dmar rgya ma'i sku rags bcings pa ni: ma sring mkha' 'gro rtag tu 'du ba'i brda: chos gos gser gyi ha ris gsol ba ni: sde snod lung rigs gsang mdzod 'dzin pa'i brda: smug nag g.yung drung ber chen gsol ba ni: snang srid dbang sdud gtso bo yin pa'i brda: zhe sdang stag gis gong lag brgyan pa ni: skal ngan bdud rigs rgol ba 'joms pa'i brda: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams pa ni: ma rungs zil gnon gdug pa 'dul ba'i brda: g.yon pas bhan+dha tshe bum bsnams pa ni: 'chi med rig 'dzin 'ja' lus 'grub pa'i brda: kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum mchan du 'chang ba ni: dug gsum la sogs 'khrul rtog gcod pa'i brda: gsus pa che zhing gsus khyim 'khyil ba ni: sgrub la mchog thun char ltar 'bebs pa'i brda: zhabs gnyis rol stabs rgya lham gsol ba ni: 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem pa'i brda: sku la 'od dpung gzi brjid 'khyil ba ni: phyogs dus rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo'i brda: spyan rtsa 'khyil zhing mkha' dbyings gzigs pa ni: nam yang thugs rje 'du 'bral med pa'i brda: brda rtags rgyan rdzogs bla ma rje la bstod: 'gro ba'i mgon mchog ma hā gu rur bstod: snang mtha'i dbang phyug mtsho skyes rje la bstod: rgyal sras lhun grub pad 'byung sku la bstod: bstan pa'i skyabs mchog rgya gar pa la bstod: mdo sngags gtsug rgyan nyi 'od gsal la bstod: bka' drin 'khor med pha la bstod pa'i mthus: bu la thugs rje'i byin rlabs char ltar phob: mtshungs med nyi ltar deng 'dir bdag gyur cig: hūm̐: sku yi bdag nyid badz+ra thod phreng rtsal: zhi ba'i las mdzad dkar gsal 'dzum mdangs can: za ber gsol nas cang te'u bhan+dha bsnams: chu khams rnam dag rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'khril: me long ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:

hūm̐: gsung gi bdag nyid pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: dbang gi las mdzad dmar gsal 'dzum mdangs can: za ber gsol nas cang te'u bhan+dha bsnams: me khams rnam dag pad+ma mkha' 'gro 'khril: sor rtog ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: thugs rje'i bdag nyid bud+dha thod phreng rtsal: sna tshogs las mdzad smug nag zhi ma khro: za ber gsol nas cang te'u bhan+dha bsnams: nam mkha' rnam dag sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro 'khril: chos dbyings ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: yon tan bdag nyid rat+na thod phreng rtsal: rgyas pa'i las mdzad ser gsal 'dzum mdangs can: za ber gsol nas cang te'u bhan+dha bsnams: sa khams rnam dag rin chen mkha' 'gro 'khril: mnyam nyid ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: phrin las bdag nyid karma thod phreng rtsal: drag po'i las mdzad ljang nag zhi ma khro: za ber gsol nas cang te'u bhan+dha bsnams: rlung khams rnam dag karma mkha' 'gro 'khril: bya grub ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: zag med dga' bzhi skyed pa'i dbang mo che: dbyings phyug man+da ra ba mtsho rgyal lcam: mda' dar tshe bum srid zhi'i tshe bcud sdud: dwangs ma'i bdud rtsi bde chen mchod sprin g.yo: zung 'jug ye shes 'khor los phyag rgya sgyur: thugs 'dzin yum mchog gnyis la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal me 'od 'khrugs pa'i mdangs: bdud dpung 'joms byed dbyug to bhan+dha bsnams: 'bar ba'i gar dgu dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: snang srid dbang sdud phag mo sku la 'khril: nyon mongs tshar gcod gri thod mgul nas 'khyud: brkyang bskum 'khril sbyor rtsa khams 'khor los bsgyur: rta skad phag skad hūm̐ bh+yo 'brug ltar ldir: dbang chen yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dmar ser sgeg pa gtum chen g.yul las rgyal: bdud dpung tshar gcod ral gri po ti 'dzin: gshe zhing dur khrod chas ldan gar dgu ldan: sangs rgyas kun gyi yum chen sku la 'khril:

ma rig gzhom phyir gri thod mgul nas 'khyud: brkyang bskum 'khril sbyor bde chen thabs kyis bskul: mu stegs rgol ba 'joms byed mthu rtsal can: 'jam dpal yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: byams pa'i 'od zer 'gro la dgyes mdzad pa: 'khor ba stongs phyir shel phreng nor bu 'dzin: byang chub lam ston pad dkar bdud rtsi 'dzin: skye 'chi spang phyir phyag rgya tshe bum thogs: gsang ba'i lha mo rnal 'byor sku la 'khril: rig 'dzin mchog stsol mda' dar dung dmar 'khyud: zhabs gnyis 'khril sbyor bde stong 'du 'bral med: snying rje'i dbang phyug mtha' yas mgon gyur mchog: spyan gzigs yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: bdud dpung 'joms mdzad mthing nag gtum po'i sku: snang srid bsngang phyir rdo rje sdigs mdzub bsgrengs: rngam stabs dur khrod chas ldan gar bsgyur can: dam tshig yum chen sgrol ma sku la 'khril: 'khor ba stongs phyir pad phreng dung dmar 'khyud: zhabs gnyis 'khril sbyor 'khor lo rgyas kyis 'debs: sa bcu'i dbang phyug gtum chen g.yul las rgyal: lag na rdo rje yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: rnga yab gling bzhugs 'gro mgon gu ru rje: gdong dmar srin po thabs kyis kha gnon mdzad: pad+ma 'byung gnas yab yum sku la bstod: bsil ba tshal du yon tan dngos grub brnyes: theg chen chos sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs mdzad pa: pad+ma saṃ bha'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: rā ga ra tir mkhyen gnyis dngos grub brnyes: shes bya kun la thogs med spobs pa rgyas: blo ldan mchog sred sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dga' ba tshal du dbang sdud dngos grub brnyes: ma sring rgya mtsho thabs kyis rol rtsal mdzad: pad+ma rgyal po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: so sa gling du 'gro 'dul dngos grub brnyes: srid zhi'i rmongs tshogs ma rig rab gzhom pa: nyi ma 'od zer sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: za hor yul du bdud 'dul dngos grub brnyes:

log 'dren bdud rigs dam sri 'dul mdzad pa: shākya seṅge'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: ma ghar mu stegs 'dul ba'i dngos grub brnyes: dmod pa drag sngags gnam lcags thog mda' 'phen: seṅge sgra sgrogs sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: stag tshang dregs pa tshar gcod dngos grub brnyes: ma rungs tshar gcod khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ rdo rje gro lod sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dug lnga 'joms mdzad dpa' bo chen po bzhi: rang 'dra mkha' 'gro sde yum dang bcas: bde stong dbang sgyur gtso bo yab yum brgyad: he ru ka pa brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: las bzhi mnga' mdzad gtum pa'i ging chen bzhi: rang 'dra shugs 'gro sde bzhi yum dang bcas: rdzu 'phrul shugs 'chang ging chen yab yum brgyad: 'jigs byed 'bar ba brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho mnyes pa'i gar ma gzugs: phyag na dbang po'i yul 'dzin mchod sprin thogs: khams g.yo 'khor lo bde stong phyag rgya can: bcu drug rig ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: zhing skyong laṅka dbang phyug ma mo dang : gnas nyul la sogs dkyil 'khor skyong ba'i tshogs: bka' yi bya ra las kyi mtha' sdud pa: gter srung la sogs yongs rdzogs bcas la bstod: ces brjod cing gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ brgyad pa bzlas pa sngags kyi rnal 'byor la 'jug pa ni/ dang po sgrub pa'i skabs yin na dzap khang dbye dgos pas/ thog mar bdag mdun 'jug pa gcig bskyed ni/ bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe hūm̐ phaṭ dzaḥ sa rten par/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa mā ya dza sid+dhi pha la hūm̐:phaṭ dzaḥ sa brten pa'i lha/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor las ye shes rtsal 'bar gyi rnam par logs su phyes te mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par bsam mo/ zhes se gol gtog la mdun rten dbye zhing gsal brtan dag gsum gyi ting 'dzin la bslab/ gnyis pa dzap kyis thugs dam bskul ba ni/

hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba bde gshegs 'dus pa'i tshogs: ye shes dbyings nas thugs dam rgyud bskul la: 'gro ba'i don phyir phrin las gter chen gyi: dgongs pa klong yangs byin rlabs shugs 'byung bas: sgrub la smin grol gdams pa zab mo mchog: 'bad med myur ba nyid la stsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru dharma tsit+ta gar+bha ā yur+dz+nyā na s-id+dhi hūm̐: gsum pa dzap dgongs gsal gdab pa la/ thog mar chos sku'i ngo sprod gsal gdab ni/ hūm̐: rang rig snang ba mtha' yas sku: smra brjod bral ba'i sems la ltos: 'khor gsum gdod nas rnam dag ngang : 'khor 'das dbye ba'i sa mtshams 'das: dran rdzogs bla ma chos kyi sku: ka dag 'od gsal gnyug ma'i gshis: chos sku snang mtha' gzhan na med: mi rtog ye shes ngo mtshar che: oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ zhes pa'i sngags phreng gang mang bzlas: de nas spro bsdu bya ba ni: hūm̐: sngags phreng 'od zer lnga ldan tshul: spros pas rgyal ba mchod cing dgyes: bsdus pas byin rlabs 'ub kyis thim: sbyor bas ma sring dbang du sdud: bsgral bas bdag 'dzin dbyings su gtor: lta ba rang rig bla ma lha: sgom pa snang srid chos skur rol: spyod pa re dogs blang dor zad: kun kyang 'bras bu'i ngo bor ldan: oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ

de nas longs sku'i ngo sprod ni: hūm̐: rang rig bla ma rdo rje 'chang : zang thal 'gags med sems la ltos: smra brjod bral yang sna tshogs 'char: rang bzhin klong las thugs rje'i rtsal: kun gyi byed po bdag med nyid: gang shar bla ma longs spyod rdzogs: sgra grags 'gags med stong pa'i dbyings: longs sku ston pa gzhan du med: spros bral rang grol ngo mtshar che: oṃ badz+ra sa twa dz+nyā na dha ra hūm̐: zhi ba'i sngags phreng gang mang bzlas: hūm̐: sngags phreng 'od zer lnga ldan tshul: spros pas rgyal ba mchod cing dgyes: bsdus pas byin rlabs 'ub kyis thim: sbyor bas ma sring dbang du sdud: bsgral bas bdag 'dzin dbyings su gtor: lta ba rang rig bla ma lha: sgom pa snang srid longs sku rol: spyod pa re dogs blang dor zad: kun kyang 'bras bu'i ngo bor ldan: oṃ badz+ra sa twa dz+nyā na dha ra hūm̐: de nas sprul sku'i ngo sprod ni: hūm̐: rang rig pad+ma 'byung gnas sku: sna tshogs shar grol sems la ltos: cir snang sgyu ma'i ngang tshul nyid: snod bcud dkyil 'khor lha yi zhing : rang lus dag kyang gzhal yas khang : rtsa khams bla ma sprul pa'i sku: gzugs rnams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i ngang : sprul sku pad 'byung gzhan na med: sprul sku drwa ba ngo mtshar che: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: sngags phreng gang mang bzlas: hūm̐: sngags phreng 'od zer lnga ldan tshul: spros pas rgyal ba mchod cing dgyes: bsdus pas byin rlabs 'ub kyis thim: sbyor bas ma sring dbang du sdud: bsgral bas bdag 'dzin dbyings su gtor: lta ba rang rig bla ma lha: sgom pa snang srid sprul sku rol: spyod pa re dogs blang dor zad: kun kyang 'bras bu'i ngo bor ldan: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: bzhi pa bzlas pa dngos la bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa las sbyor gsum mo/ dang po bsnyen pa ni/ bdag nyid gu ru snang srid zil gnon gyi/

/chos kyi 'khor lor 'od lnga'i thig klong du/ /bud+dha thod phreng smug nag zhi ma khro/ /cang te'u bhan+dha 'dzin pa'i thugs ka ru/ /pad nyi zla steng rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i/ /lte bar hūm̐ dmar mtha' bskor sngags kyi phreng*/ /g.yas bskor 'od kyis phyogs dus rgyal kun dang*/ /o rgyan chen po'i thugs rgyud rab tu bskul/ /kun kyang gu ru pad+ma'i sku gsung thugs/ /phyag rgya yig 'bru phyag mtshan rnam pa ru/ /spyan drangs mtsho la kha char babs pa bzhin/ /rgyun mi chad par thim pas byin brlab gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes bsnyen pa ci nus bzlas/ dmigs bsal bsnyen sgrub so sor dbye ba'i skabs sgrub tshul dang dus grangs rtags gsum la sbyar ba sogs skabs gzhan du shes par bya dgos so/ gnyis pa sgrub pa'i dmigs pa ni/ gtso bo'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' yi/ /thugs dbus ting 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ gi mthar/ /sngags phreng 'od bcas 'gal me klad skor ltar/ bar med 'phros pas mdun bskyed lha tshogs bskul/ /kun gyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng las/ /'od zer dpag med nam mkha' gang bar 'phros/ /phyogs bcu'i rab 'byams rgyal ba ma lus mchod/ /kun gyi byin rlabs gu ru pad+ma yi/ /gsang gsum 'khor lo'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ /bdag mdun sgrub rdzas la thim dngos grub bskyil/ /'gro drug sems can la phog sdig sgrib sbyangs/ /dam can srung mar phog pas dam tshig bskul/ /rnal 'byor mched lcam la phog nyams sgrib dag /mdor na phyi nang snod bcud snang grags sems/ /gdod nas ye dag lha sngags chos sku'i ngang*/ /ma bcos dkyil 'khor gsum du ngang gis rdzogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa mā ya dza sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ zhes sgrub sngags bsnyen pa'i bcu cha bzla/ gsum pa las sbyor ni/ thugs ka'i 'od kyis rigs bzhi thod phreng dang*/

khyad par rta phag yab yum thugs dam bskul/ /de yi 'od las ye shes 'jig rten gyi/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro kun gyi srog snying bskul/ /de las sprul dang yang sprul mkha' khyab spros/ /nad gdon sdig sgrib ba mor nyi bzhin gzhom/ /tshe dpal bsod nams yar ngo'i zla bzhin spel/ /'khor 'das mos bzhis snang ba dbang du bsdus/ /ma rungs dgra gdon thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag /tshur 'dus thams cad chos dbyings ka dag klong*/ /'khor 'das mnyam nyid rdo rje'i srog 'grub gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hri ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: de ltar sgrub pa'i bcu cha las sbyor bya bar gsungs so/ de yis 'khor 'das kyi stong srog la dbang thob pa'i phrin las rab 'byams la mnga' brnyes par 'gyur bar gdon mi za ba man ngag gi yig cha rnams las ches gsal lo/ de ltar dmigs pa dang ldan pa'i ngang bsnyen sgrub las gsum ci 'grub bzlas pa'i mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten 'brel snying po bcas kyi mthar/ mchod bstod dam bsdu na stong tshig 'bul ba ni/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod/ /bag med 'gal 'khrul nyams chags bshags/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ ma hā sarba pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ gsham du thun gtor 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: rtsa gsum kun 'dus bde gshegs dkyil 'khor du: phyi nang gsang ba'i bla med mchod gtor 'bul: deng 'dir byin rlabs thugs dam rgyud bskul nas: sgrub la dbang bzhi mchog thun stsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha gter bdag la sogs pa rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: zhes thun gtor 'bul/ de dag gis stod las byang bu khrigs su bsdebs pa re zhig grub bo/ skabs 'dir bsnyen rkyang lta bur yin tshe rjes chog la 'jug pas chog go

/rim pa gnyis pa smad las tshogs mchod kyi bya ba la 'jug par mos na/ thog mar chos skyong sde lnga sogs rang lugs gsol kha rgyas bsdus gang rung sngon du song nas/ na raka bshags skong sogs rgyas bsdus ci rigs sngon du 'don srol snga 'gyur spyi chos ltar grub na legs pa'i yan lag yin la ma byas kyang mi 'gal lo/ dang po thabs shes kyi rdzas phun sum tshogs pa 'du byas la/ tshogs phud rim pa gsum du spros nas/ thog mar rig 'dzin srog sgrub tshig lhug btang*/ de nas las rdor gyis tshogs zhus sngon du 'gro bas/ tshogs mchod dngos la/ dang po byin gyis brlab pa ni/ thog mar chu gtsang gis bran zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab/ hūm̐: chos rnams mi dmigs spros dang bral: rang byung gdod nas mkha' ltar khyab: 'khor 'das ro gcig lta ba'i klong : gnyis med ye shes chen por bskyed: gnyis 'dzin bag chags ka nas dag: oṃ dharma shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bdag nyid pad+ma 'od 'bar thugs ka nas: dug gsum sbyang phyir yig 'bru ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: 'od 'phros tshogs la phog pas nyes skyon gtor: bag chags rnam rtog mi dmigs sgyu mar sbyangs: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ hūm̐: byin gyis rlob pa'i yig 'bru oṃ āḥhūm̐: 'dod yon tshogs la phog pas dpag med sbyangs: rtsa gsum bde gshegs mnyes pa'i mchod sprin tshogs: rmad byung nam mkha'i mtha' las khyab par spel: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ga ṇa tsakra sarba ma hā me gha s+pha ra ṇa oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes pa'i snying pos lan gsum gyis spel/ gnyis pa tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: lhun grub rab 'byams stug po bkod zhing nas: bla ma bder 'dus chos sku rgya mtsho rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: bde chen mkha' dbyings khyab brdal pho brang nas: bla ma bder 'dus longs sku rgya mtsho rnams:

zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: zang thal lhan skyes gnyug ma'i pho brang nas: bla ma bder 'dus sprul sku rgya mtsho rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas: o rgyan dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: bde chen nam mkha' 'phrul gyi gdengs ka nas: chos srung bstan pa'i bya ra 'khor bcas rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rab 'jigs sa gsum g.yo ba'i dur khrod nas: bstan srung las mkhan myur mgyogs 'khor bcas rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: chos sku rgya mtsho ka dag sangs se sang : longs sku rgya mtsho rang mdangs ta la la: sprul sku rgya mtsho 'ja' tshon spungs se spung : rtsa brgyud bla ma byin rlabs thibs se thib: yi dam lha tshogs hūm̐ sgra 'u ru ru: ma sring mkha' 'gro'-i brda skad di ri ri: dpa' bo rgya mtshos gar byed shigs se shig: dpa' mo rgya mtshos glu len kyu ru ru: ging chen pho mos gar stabs khrigs se khrig: chos skyong rgya mtsho las byed sha ra ra: nor lha dbang sdud longs spyod chi li li: gter srung gnyer gtad bya ra lhangs se lhang : tshogs gsog rgya mtsho'i bcud g.yo me re re: gnas khang byin 'bebs gar mo kyi li li: 'dir tshogs pho mo dga' bro ya la la: gnas 'dir gshegs la dbang bskur byin chen phob: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa tshogs mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : dam can chos srung nor gyi bdag: gter bdag gnyan po skyong la sogs: rig 'dzin bder 'dus dkyil 'khor la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bla med bdud rtsi'-i mchod pa 'bul: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: sna tshogs spyan gzigs mchod pa 'bul:

mthun rdzas brtse bas bzhai+es su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi: tshogs phud dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du phul/ gtor bsngos mthar dbyung*/ bzhi pa bskang ba la 'jug pa ni/ thog mar bskang gsol 'dod rgu mchog sbyin bshags pa'i bar btang*/ de nas bskang ba bsdus pa ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod mdzes pa'i lha mo sna tshogs dang : nang mchod sha lnga bdud rtsi a mṛ ta: gsang mchod bde stong chags med ye shes rdzas: sman gtor rak+ta sbyor sgrol dbang po lnga: spyan gzigs dkor cha yid 'ong mnyes pa'i brten: rol mo sgra snyan gdangs dbyangs dgyes pa'i glu: kun nas ma tshang med pa'i mchod sprin 'di: bla ma rig 'dzin bde gshegs 'dus pa'i tshogs: rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : nyams chag bskangs shing bar chad sel gyur na: mchog thun 'bad med lhun grub stsal du gsol: zhes thugs dam bskangs/ lnga pa bshags pa ni/ skong bshags rgyas par spro skabs/ hoḥ 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi?sogs bshags pa'ang 'dir bya/ hūm̐: rtsa gsum kun 'dus lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag cag dkyil 'khor zab mo'i sgor zhugs nas: bag med dbang gyur dam 'gal ci mchis pa: mthol bshags bzod gsol mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: oṃ gu ru sa twa sa ma ya: ma nu pā la ya: gu ru sa twa twe no pa: sogs yig rgya brjod/ drug pa bsgral ba ni tshogs tha ma'i dmigs rten mdun du bkod cing rak+tas bran la dgug pa ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i lha: dkyil 'khor skyong sogs srung ma 'khor bcas kyi: bden pa chen po'i mthu stobs nus pa yis: bla ma'i sku dgra sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra: rnal 'byor sgos dgra sems can yongs la 'tshe: ma nyes log par lta ba'i dgra bgegs kyi: bla tshe rnam shes srog dbugs dbang thang bcas: steng 'og phyogs bcu'i bar mtshams gar gnas kyang :

snying nas zungs shig ma mo za byed ma: ske nas zungs shig ma mo gsod byed ma: yan lag sdoms shig ma mo sha za ma: myos par gyis shig ma mo srog bdag ma: lha dang phyes shig ma mo zangs gri ma: bdud dang sprod cig ma mo spu gri ma: dbyer med gtubs shig ma mo srid bdag ma: dus la bab bo pho nya mthu ma chung : dmigs pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs shor ra re: rang dbang med par myur du khug la shog: oṃ ma tri ma tri re ma ti rak+mo a tri ya dgra bgegs a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ bdun pa phur bu thogs la/ hūm̐: dpal chen sras mchog badz+ra kī la ya: rgya mdud steng nas 'brug stong di ri ri: 'chang bzung ngos nas glog dmar khyugs se khyug: chu srin kha nas ser ba hri li li: zur gsum rngam la thog rgod sha ra ra: 'dril zhing 'debs pa'i shan pa phur bu khyod: dgra bgegs gdug pa'i snying la mā ra ya: brlag cing bcom nas ming yang med par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān trig+nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ru tra shag thuṃ nṛ tri ya ma ha ri kha dgra bgegs kyi srog la gzer thuṃ bi shwa tsakra ha la ha la hūm̐ phaṭḥ tshe khrus lung gsum gyi dgongs pa ldan pas bsgral zhing gtub par bya'o/ brgyad pa zhal du bstab pa ni bdud rtsis bran la/ hūm̐: bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha: ye shes spyan ldan 'khor dang bcas pa yi: gnam sa ri rab khyon ltar zhal phyes la: dgra bgegs don snying sha khrag bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta la kha kha khā hi: zhes dkyil 'khor du 'bul/ dgu pa tshogs la rol ba ni rdo rje'i glu gar sogs kyang bya/ las rdor gyis tshogs rdzas thabs shes ma nor bar thogs la tshogs zhus ni/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: bla med dkyil 'khor rdzas chen gyi: dngos grub rmad byung ro brgya'i zas: deng 'dir skal ldan rnams la stsol:

ces zhus pa'i lan du slob dpon gyis phyag rgya dang bcas blangs nas/ hoḥ 'di ni legs 'ong ya mtshan ldan: 'khor 'das ro gcig blang dor bral: gtsang rme gzung 'dzin gdod nas dag: dge bas de bzhin a la la hoḥ e ma hoḥ 'dus pa kun la bkye zhing rol bar bya'o/ bcu pa lhag ma gtong ba ni de tshe las rdor pas lhag ma gral mthar bkod nas phyag sngon du song bas lhag gtor byin gyis brlab pa la thugs gtad par zhu zhes gsol ba dang*/ 'dus pa byings nas/ oṃ a kā ro sa sngags dang*/ lhag ma dam rdzas 'dod yon gyi phung po zad mi shes par nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ e a ra li hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ dzaḥ zhes slob dpon nas mkha' lding gi rgya bcas zhal chab kyi bdud rtsis bran la lhag ma bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐: dang po phud kyi mchod pa ni: bla ma rig 'dzin dgyes pa'i rtags: bar du bskang zhing bshags pa ni: yi dam mkha' 'gro mthun pa'i rdzas: tha ma 'gugs shing bsgral ba ni: chos skyong dam can rbad pa'i rtags: dbyer med tshogs la rol ba ni: nor lha gter bdag dngos grub brda: kun nas lhag ma sdud pa ni: laṅka gnas nyul dgyes par mtshon: dkyil 'khor mtha' la bzhag pa ni: bka' bzhin bstan pa srung bar stsol: lhag ma kha chus bran pa ni: 'da' ka dam tshig gcig par ston: hūm̐: bde gshegs rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs bstan srung ni: mtshan mo sgra sgrogs ma mo bye ba 'bum: srod la rab rgyu sna tshogs cho 'phrul ston: smag rum gseb nas mi sdug bshugs ring 'then: la las rgyan mdzes spras nas mkha' la lding : la las 'dab chags bzhon nas bar snang kheng : la las sder chags bzhon nas sa gzhi nyul: la las gcer mo dur khrod baṃ ro khur: la las g.yang gzhi gyon cing bhan+dha thogs: la las nang rol 'dren zhing rgyu ma za: la las srod 'phros drod nyul lam lam 'gyu: don la thams cad rnal 'byor ma sring ste:

bye brag so sor snang ngor sgyu ma'i gar: mi bzad gar sgyur bstan pa'i bya ra tshogs: bka' yi las byed phra men 'khor bcas kyis: 'dod yon tshogs kyi lhag ma 'di bzhes la: rgyud srung sgrub pa'i sdong grogs ma g.yel zhing : ma rungs gdug pa'i tshogs rnams tshar bcad nas: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ma ma tri hriṃ hriṃ mu kha le sa ma ya maṇ+ḍal pā la i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi:

smon lam ni/ rig 'dzin bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yis/ /bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog / ces dang gtor 'gugs ni/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum gyi bden pa'i stobs kyis sdang dgra gnod byed gdug pa can thams cad drag po dmar gyi gtor ma 'di la khug cig /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bcu gcig pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: rnam dag ye shes dbyings kyi pho brang nas: rig 'dzin kun gyi 'dus gzugs pad+ma 'byung : rtsa gsum lha tshogs bde gshegs dkyil 'khor rnams: thugs rje'i klong nas sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs shig: deng 'dir 'gro la brtse chen gzigs par bskul: deng sang yang mtha' snyigs ma lnga brgya'i dus: sems can dmu rgod khro gtum 'gong po'i tshogs: rnam smin bag chags brtsegs pa'i ngan goms kyis: ci byed rgyu 'bras khyad gsod brtson lags pas: 'chi 'pho ltung bar thugs rje'i rtsal phyungs la: srid pa'i rgya mtsho skem pa'i dus la bab: sdug bsngal btson ra bshig pa'i dus la bab: rnam smin 'khrul sgo gcod pa'i dus la bab: deng nas sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skems par mdzod: hūm̐: bskul lo bzhengs shig rgyal ba thugs rje can: rtsa gsum bder 'dus lha tshogs mthu ma chung : sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khyad du dmod de phrin las bcol ba ni: deng sang snyigs ma yang mtha' 'dul dka'i dus: ma rungs sdig to bdud kyi sde tshogs kyis: gsang sngags bstan pa gnyan la dgra dar bas: mthu chen khyod kyi mngon spyod dus la bab: bar gcod brtsams pa'i log 'dren 'di dag kun: rdo rje bka' yis chad pas rab brdegs nas: bcom zhing brlags te ming yang med par mdzod: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sarba sa ma ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: chos skyong gi gtor 'bul nyung bsdus mthar rig 'dzin brgyud pas gtor ma 'bul/

bcu gnyis pa chad mdo btang ba ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe 'og min bkod pa rab rdzogs nas: zhing khams pho brang 'thug po bkod pa ru: thog ma'i mgon po snang ba mtha' yas dang : rigs kyi yum chen rdo rje rnal 'byor gnyis: ka dag dang po'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs pa ru: sprul sku sgyu ma'i rang gzugs bstan nas kyang : skye 'gag gnas gsum dngos blo bral ba bzhin: gang shar bde stong gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sna tshogs bdag med rtogs pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og gsang sgrom me ri 'bar ba yi: ma la ya zhes tsit+ta'i pho brang nas: rdo rje 'chang dbang dga' rab rdo rje dang : dbyings kyi yum chen snyems ma kun gsal gnyis: rtsal snang brda bzhi'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: ma sring ḍāk+ki dbang phyug rgya mtsho yis: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang : bstan srung phrin las bcol bar khas blangs bzhin: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dngos grub mchog stsol bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og bod yul dbus kyi bsam yas nas: brag dmar mchims phu dpal gyi ke'u tshang du: rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang : dbyings kyi yum chen mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal gnyis: bder 'dus srog sgrub dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: lo tsā'i dwangs ma sangs rgyas ye shes la: lung bstan bka' gtad kha byang phog pa'i tshe: rgyal po la sogs dregs chen bco brgyad kyis: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang : bka' yi bstan pa bsrung phyir khas blangs bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad du gsol: hūm̐: de 'og lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma ru: brag dmar mchims phu dpal gyi gnas mchog tu: rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho yis: bder 'dus zil gnon thugs sgrub gdan drangs tshe: sngags bdag ma mo e ka dzā ṭi yis:

dngos su gzugs bstan gter sgrom phul ba'i tshe: zab chos rgyas pa'i grogs mor khas blangs bzhin: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dus drug ma g.yel bya ra mdzad du gsol: oṃ sarba ḍāk+ki nī dharma pā la ma tri e ka dzā ṭi sa ma ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: bcu gsum pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i bka' nyan ma: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis ni: bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma: dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje ya ma skyong : gangs dkar sha med rdo rje kun tu bzang : 'brog chen 'khor 'dus rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso: gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje g.yu bun ma: kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum: gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje klu mo dang : rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal: kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong : btsan la rol pa'i rdo rje sman gcig ma: mo btsun ug chos rdo rje g.yar mo bsil: g.yu yi dril bu rdo rje si le ma: ma sring bod skyong chen mo bcu gnyis ni: so so'i bran g.yog yang 'khor g.yog dang bcas: lhab lhub mdzes pa'i na bza' sku la gsol: sna tshogs rgyan cha mang po khro lo lo: g.yer kha rol mo sil snyan si li li: glu len bro rdung gar rtsed khyugs se khyug: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa'i bya ra mel tshe mdzod: oṃ pra mo li tsa tur yak+sha li tsa tur ma tri li tsa tur ya sarba i daṃ bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: gtor gzhong kha sbub la 'gugs pa ni/ na mo dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum gyi bden pa'i stobs kyis gnod byed sdang dgra gdug pa can thams cad gtor gzhong ri rab 'bar ba'i 'og tu khug cig /dza hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sa rang rgya dang bcas bcu bzhi pa rta bro bya ba ni/ hūm̐: bde gshegs rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du:

grub thob rgya mtshos bro brdungs pas: ye shes lnga ru lhun gyis grub: mu kha chos 'byung khri rkang du: rdo rje mchu yi bro brdungs pas: rigs drug 'khor ba'i rgyud lam gcod: las mtha' rnam bzhi'i dal dbus su: so so'i phrin las bro brdungs pas: rang rang gzhung bzhin lhun gyis grub: bro yang ye shes chen po'i bro: glu yang ye shes chen po'i glu: gar yang phyag rgya drug gi gar: gdangs kyang ma 'gags rig pa'i sgra: de ltar brda dang rten 'brel gyis: sna tshogs las kun lhun grub shog: oṃ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: sgab 'dre 'byung po thams cad satwaṃ bha ya nan: gtor gzhong kha yar bzed de slob dpon gyis 'bru gtor la/ oṃ 'grub par gyur cig dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: āḥdagyes par gyur cig mchod sprin rgya mtsho mchod: hūm̐ bde bar gyur cig mtha' yas sems can rnams: hrīḥ'agrub par gyur cig bkra shis bde legs stsol: trām̐ brtan par gyur cig smon lam mthu btsan shog: skabs 'gar tshe 'gugs bya bar mos na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hri ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ ba su sid+dhi na na kha dhi ā yu puṇ+ye sarba bsdus bsdus pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: mkha' mnyam tshe bdag 'od dpag med: chos dbyings nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na shrī bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: lhun grub rigs lnga rdo rje sems: sku lnga dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na shrī bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: rigs 'dus pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: thugs rje ye shes dkyil 'khor nas:

ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na shrī bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: dbyings phyug bde chen mtsho rgyal ma: dbang sgyur stobs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na shrī bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: mtshan brgyad rig 'dzin rje 'bangs tshogs: rmad byung sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na shrī bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: dngos grub kun stsol yi dam lha: thugs rje rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na shrī bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: bka' sdod mkha' 'gro chos srung rnams: dam tshig gnyan po'i dkyil 'khor du: ye shes stobs kyis tshe khug la: 'byung ba bcud kyi dpal skyed la: 'khor 'das kun nas byin phob la: bdag cag rnams la deng 'dir stsol: ma ma ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na shrī bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: bskul lo rig 'dzin snying nas bskul: skyed cig thugs dam dbyings nas skyed: bdag cag rig 'dzin sgrub pa por: tshe dang ye shes char chen phob: phyi snod 'byung ba'i tshe bkrag mdangs: rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stims: sgrub rdzas ye shes bdud rtsir bskyil: bkrag dang gzi mdangs ya la la: rig rtsal ye shes stobs skyed la: 'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub par stsol: mda' dar g.yob sgrub rdzas lha nyid dngos su mos par bskyed/

bco lnga pa dngos grub blangs pa ni/ sgrub chen dang sgrub mchod skabs yin na nyin tha ma lta bu las rgyun du mi dgos/ hūm̐: bde mchog ngo bo lhun grub ka dag las: legs rtsal sprul pa'i rnam rol cher ston pa: bder 'dus rig 'dzin rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha: sangs rgyas sku dngos pad 'byung mkha' 'gros bskor: rtsa brgyud bla ma thugs rje'i gter chen po: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag la: tshe chos zas nor gos dang snyan grags stobs: kun la dbang bsgyur 'khor 'bangs mnga' thang rgyas: srid spel longs spyod 'dod pa'i yon tan rnams: skad cig nyid la deng 'dir thob gyur cig: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ha ri ni sa ā yur+dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: dbang bzhi blangs shing dngos grub kyi rdzas la rol/ gsum pa rjes chog la/ dang po mchod bstod ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ sogs? shab+da pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral ka dag ngo bo nyid: zang thal 'gags med thugs rjes so sor ston: 'gro ba'i don phyir thugs rje sgyu ma'i gar: o rgyan gu ru pad 'byung sku la bstod: bstod par 'os p gnyis pa bshags pa ni/ ma 'byor p sogs yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po bzlas/ gsum pa brtan bzhugs ni/ 'di nas rten sogs spyi ltar bya/ bzhi pa rtag pa'i mtha' bsal ba'i slad du dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mi dmigs par bsdu ba ni/ hoḥ mi dmigs ka dag ngo bo dbyings rig gi: kun gsal rol pa'i cho 'phrul zhi khro'i lha: lhan skyes ye shes gnyug ma'i sbubs su bsdu: bde gsal mi rtog gnas lugs ngo bor āḥ a a āḥ zhes bsdus la slar chad pa'i mu spang ba'i phyir/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes brjod pas skad cig la lha yi skur ldang zhing rjes thob kyi bya ba la 'jug par bya'o/

lnga pa gzhan don du dge rtsa bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐: gdod nas chos dbyings lhun grub ngo bo yang : de don ma rtogs rmongs 'gyu'i sems can rigs: a 'thas zhen pa'i gol lam bsal mdzad phyir: kun rig don gnyis rtogs phyir dge tshogs bsngo: drug pa smon lam gyi mtshams sbyar ba ni/ hoḥ bla med bder 'dus rgyal ba'i dal bzung nas: mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin rtse gcig gis: ma 'ongs 'di nas rnga yab dpal ri ru: pad 'byung rgyal ba'i sras su 'khrungs par shog: bdun pa bkra shis brjod pa ni/ ye dharmā? chos sku'i bkra shis snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur: gnas lugs rgyal sa zin pa'i bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis drug pa rdo rje 'chang : thugs rje phyogs bcur khyab pa'i bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung : 'gro kun smin grol 'god pa'i bkra shis shog: snyan brgyud bkra shis mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma: zab rgya mkha' ltar brtan pa'i bkra shis shog: smon lam bkra shis bud+dha dz+nyā na ba: lung bstan dus las mi 'da' bkra shis shog: bla ma'i bkra shis rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling : 'gro don phyogs mthar khyab pa'i bkra shis shog: gter gnas bkra shis mchims phu ke'u tshang du: byin chags yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog: zab rgya'i bkra shis zil gnon rig 'dzin 'dus: mkha' ltar mtha' yas kun khyab bkra shis shog: gter srung bkra shis sngags bdag ral gcig ma: phrin las glog ltar myur ba'i bkra shis shog: nyin yang bkra shis mtshan yang bkra shis nas: nyin mtshan rtag tu bkra shis bde legs shog: ces gzhan yang bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ zhes pa'ang lam zab 'di nyid kyi bskyed rdzogs nyams len la rtse gcig tu gzhol ba'i gsang sngags phur pa gling gi lo gsum sgrub sde skabs gnyis pa legs par grub pa'i gtang rag dang 'brel gcung gnam lcags mkhan po ngag dbang dge legs mchog dang e wam̐ sgrub sde zung nas thugs sgrub sgrub chen gsar 'dzugs mdzad pa'i skabs nye bar mkho ba'i cha rkyen dang*/

'byung gyur yang lam 'di nyid kyi sgo nas rang don bsnyen sgrub dang gzhan don sgrub mchod sgrub chen sogs nyams len dngos gzhi'i mthun gyur rang lugs nyams pa slar gso rgyun skyong rgyur 'gyur ba tsam ma zad deng dus 'dzam gling shar nub kyi mi rigs 'dra min bod kyi skad dang yig rigs la goms 'dris chung ba'i gsar bu rnams 'jug pa bde ba sogs dgos pa du mar mthong ba dang*/ rang slob au ḍī sogs kyis ched bskul byung bar brten/ gter gzhung rtsa ba'i rgyud lung man ngag gi gnad gcus dkrugs gab pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa 'khrugs bsdebs lag len dka' bas cho ga nar 'gros bklag chog pa zhig byung na dge mtshan che bar snyam yang*/ bdag kyang tshul 'di'i mthong rgyun gyi myong ba phra zhing*/ snga rabs kyi zin bris khag la dpyad pas gcig tu nges par ma mthong la gzhan yang deng gi dus rang lugs gsang sngags kyi cho ga bskyed rdzogs snying po'i go don slong ba ni nam mkha'i pad+mo'i zla ru gyur zhing tshig gyer tsam la yang dpyad par mi bzod pa'i chal chol du gyur ba mang zhing phal cher lag len gyi shan du zhugs pa du ma 'dom pa'i rnam dpyod kyi blo rtsal bdag lta bur mi mnga' bas/ des na snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa so zur gnubs gsum gyi phyag bzhes su grags pa'i o rgyan smin grol gling gi phyag srol dang rang lugs rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje'i phyag bzhes chog khrigs rnams phal cher mthun pa snang bas de ga'i 'gros bstun gyi gab bsdebs 'khrugs bsal bcas chu babs kyi tshul du bklags pas grub par bgyis pa'i khul yin yang*/ don du ma 'brel ba dang chad lhag 'gal 'khrul rgyun 'bab kyi gnyer ma bzhin bgrangs kyis mi long ba yod nges pas chos spyan ldan pa rnams dang chos bdag dam can rgya mtsho'i spyan sngar mthol zhing bshags la/

'di las byung ba'i rnam dkar gyi cha shas cung zad mchis na de'ang pad+ma'i phrin las gnubs lugs zab gter 'di nyid mi nyams dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang*/ 'gro kun smin grol gyi 'bras bu g.yur du za ba'i rgyur gyur cig /ces rab byung bcu bdun pa'i shing pho sprel gyi lor rgyam̐l zla ba'i dmar phyogs rgyam̐l ba dang po dus sbyor pau ṣa'i khyim du res gza' ngan las rgyam̐l dang*/ rgyu dkar gyi bu mo lha skyes dang lhan cig rtse 'jor rol ba'i dus dang*/ lhag tu gsang chen snga 'gyur bstan pa'i mig gcig kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyam̐l po rgyam̐l ba klong chen rab 'byams kyi phyi gsal gzugs sku'i bkod pa nang dbyings gdod ma'i gzhi thog tu bsdus pa'i dus khyad par can la/ rgyam̐l ba gang gi rjes dran mchod sprin du dmigs te ngan lam rgyam̐l ba mchog dbyangs kyi skye srid sgo chen rgyam̐l ba'i sprul ming du sgro btags pa gsang sngags bstan 'dzin gyis bgyis shing yi ge pa yang bskul ba po nyid kyis mdzad pas rgyam̐l ba'i bstan pa srid pa'i rtse mor bsnyegs pa'i rgyam̐l mtshan du gyur cig/ //

ba) rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi gsol 'debs bsdus pa bzhugs so/ e ma hoḥ chos sku snang mtha' longs sku pad+ma'i spyan/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa sprul sku pad+ma 'byung*/ /gangs can skyob pa'i ma gcig mtsho rgyal lcam/ /sku gsum bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal rje 'bangs lo paṇa dang*| khyad par phur thogs rgyal po gnubs chen rje/ /zab gter bka' babs rtsa gsum gter bdag gling*/ /yab sras brgyud par bcas la gsol ba 'debs| |pad+ma'i thugs tig rtsa gsum bka' 'dus che'i/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*/ /rdo rje chos srung dam can gter gyi bdag /ma lus dkyil 'khor lha la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pas bdag sogs kun/ /dbang bzhis rgyud smin bskyed rim tshad du 'khyol/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pas rtsa rlung dbu mar dag /rdzogs pa chen po'i snang bzhi mthar phyin nas/ /tshe 'dir 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku 'grub shog / ces pa'ang gi li ban+des bskul ngor gnam lcags gu h+yas so/ ma)༄༅/ /bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ rtsa ba gcig dril gyi las rim khrigs chags su bkod pa dngos grub char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rtsa gsum kun 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'dud/ /de yang bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ rtsa ba gcig dril gyi go rim khrigs chags su bkod pa la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po sngon 'gro la drug las skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bgegs gtor dang*/ mtshams gcod mchod rlob byin 'bebs so/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na moḥ rtsa gsum kun 'dus bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha: ye shes rol pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: skyabs mchi gsol 'debs byin rlobs thugs dam bskul: phrin las 'gro 'dul dpal du yongs smin shog: lan gsum/ gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ hoḥ khams gsum srid pa'i 'khor lo shing rta'i rgyun:

yang yang duḥkha'i srid pa nyer len tshogs: yongs su gzhom par bde gshegs smon pa'i mthu: bdag gis bsgrub phyir byang chub sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ gsum pa bgegs gtor ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid dbang drag 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas: gzi byin 'od stong zer ma phyogs bcur 'phros: de yi shugs las bgegs rnams snying rjes bkug: gtor ma len phyir gnas 'dir myur du mchis: oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ bgegs tshogs 'byung po a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ lan gsum gyis dgug hūm̐ hrīḥ bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang : yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong mthu rtsal gyis: dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs: log par 'dren pa bdud kyi tshogs: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra hūm̐: rak+ṣa hūm̐: yak+ṣa hūm̐: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya gnod byed bgegs tshogs thams cad tshin+dha tshin+dha bhan+dha bhan+dha ha na ha na pa tsa pa tsa ma tha ma tha da ha da ha hu lu hu lu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: bzhi pa mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐: nga nyid gdod nas rab khros he ru kaḥ ka dag thugs las brdol ba'i shes rab mtshon: rno dbal lhun grub rang rtsal 'gengs pa'i tshogs: bar med khyab ste skar ltar rab 'khrugs pa: bsrungs mtshams med par dum bu gcig pa ni: e yi mkha' ltar gnas pa'i gur khang gyur: oṃ badz+ra dharma dz+nyā na tsakra e kham̐ ram̐ dz+wa la rak+ṣa ye swā hā: lnga pa mchod pa byin rlob ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ hrīḥ phyi mchod me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo sil snyan dbyangs dang bcas: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya mchod pa'i sprin: bde gshegs rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas su spel: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐:

rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: dam tshig chen po'i bhan+dha ru: dgyes pa'i sman phud phyu ru ru: rak+ta'i rba rlabs gya ma gyu: rmad byung ba liṃ ye re re: sman raka gtor ma'i mchod sprin 'di: rmad byung bla med rdzas su gyur: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ drug pa byin dbab pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min bkod pa rab rdzogs lhun grub zhing : lnga ldan zang thal 'gyu ba'i pho brang nas: rigs 'dus rgyal ba rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams: 'du 'bral med par thugs rje'i shugs mtshon nas: gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin chen myur du phob: mchog thun 'bad med lhug par deng stsol shog: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sa ma ya a be sha ya a āḥ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la drug las/ rten bskyed spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol dang*/ mchod bstod dzap bzlas bsnyen bstod do/ dang po rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: kun gzhi skye med gsal stong ngang : ma 'gags sna tshogs 'phro 'du las: spro bsgyur 'gyed pa'i sa bon gsal: oṃ bh+rūm̐ hūm̐: e snang gsal ba'i gzhal yas khang : ma bskyed lhun grub gsal rdzogs su: pho brang gzhal yas gru bzhi pa: rtsig 'dod mda' yab 'od phreng mdzes: chos 'khor za ram rin chen tog: phyi nang dkyil 'khor rgyan bkod tshang : snang stong 'od kyi drwa bar bsgom: hūm̐: dbus su nyi zla pad+ma'i steng : gu ru snang srid zil gnon sku: dkar gsal mdangs ldan zhi 'dzum mdzes: dbu la pad zhwa mthong grol gsol: snyan cha mgul rgyan se mo do: phyag g.yas zil gnon rdo rje gdeng : g.yon pas bhan+dha tshe bum bsnams: kha ṭ+wāṃ yum tshul 'khyud cing 'gying : lhab lhub ber dang chos gos dmar: phod kha stod g.yogs ska rags mdzes:

zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol stabs brjid: g.yas su lha lcam mkha' 'gro dmar: mda' dar tshe bum rgyan chas mdzes: g.yon du mtsho rgyal btsun mo dkar: bhan+dha bdud rtsi bskyil zhing mchod: khor yug rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha: tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor ma lus kun: stong gsal 'dzin med wal gyis shar: oṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma dhā ra ḍāk+ki sid+dhi hrīḥ de ltar bskyed pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyi 'phro 'du yis rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings rang rtsal las: snang mtha'i rnam rol pad+ma 'byung : dbyings las ma g.yos rtsal rdzogs su: thugs rje'i 'od skur 'dir snang stsol: oṃ gu ru badz+ra dhā ra hūm̐ dza dzaḥ gsum pa bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ni/ hūm̐: chags med skyon bral rigs kyi bdag: pad 'byung rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: ma skyes bla med dam phyag 'tshal: sgo gsum 'khrul 'dzin sgrib bral nas: dbang bzhis smin grol dngos grub stsol: oṃ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ bzhi pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: me tog mdzes pa'i phreng ba phreng : dri zhim g.yo ba'i bdug spos phyur: snang gsal 'od kyi sgron me gtams: bzang po'i dri chab rab tu bstar: bcud ldan ro brgya'i zhal zas mtho: sna tshogs snyan pa'i rol mo'i sgra: reg 'jam yug gos rgyan gyi tshogs: nang mchod sman raka gtor gsum dang: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol ting 'dzin sogs: blos blangs dwang bas dgyes bskyed nas: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta gu h+ya sa ma ye swā hā: lnga pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ skye 'chi gnyis spangs rdo rje'i go cha can:

snang mtha' bde gshegs rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dang : grub pa'i bla ma rdor 'chang longs spyod rdzogs: snang srid zil gnon ye shes sku lnga 'chang : rdo rje rnal 'byor zab lam bde chen dbyings: dgra bgegs mthar byed dregs pa kun 'dul rtsal: bde gshegs rtsa ba'i yi dam rigs 'dus lha: gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor tshogs: rab 'byams mkhyen brtse'i dpal zhing lha la bstod: drug pa dzap la lnga las/ dzap bskul bsnyen sgrub las sbyor bstod| dang po dzap bskul ni/ kye kye bla ma rin po che: sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku: 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig pu: mgon med bdag la thugs rjes zungs: bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa che: re zhing ltos pa'i gnyen gcig pu: bdag la re sa gzhan na med: sdug bsngal 'di las drang du gsol: rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: khyed la bdag nyid bran du 'bul: skyid sdug re ltos khyed shes pas: bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsol: bla ma sangs rgyas phrin las mdzad: bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: mtha' yas sems can ma lus pa: 'dren pa'i bla mar bdag gyur cig: gnyis pa bsnyen pa ni/ de yang gsang 'dus las/ snang srid gzhal yas bla ma lha/ /thams cad phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor che/ /dper na chu zla 'ja' tshon ltar/ /snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom/ /zhes pa'i dgongs pa srog bzung nas/ spyi bo'i bla ma la sems rtse gcig pas mos gus gdung shugs drag pos/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes gsol 'debs kyi tshul du bzla'o/ gsum pa sgrub pa ni/ dbang bzhi len pa'i dmigs gnad dang sbyar te/ bla ma yab yum sku yi gnas bzhi nas/ /'od zer byung ba bdag gi gnas bzhir thim/ /sku gsung thugs dang ye shes rdo rje yis/ /byin gyis brlabs nas dbang bzhi thob par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ

ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar bla ma rang la thim pas/ rang nyid thod phreng rtsal gyi sku yi gsal snang dang nga rgyal la sems rtse gcig pas kyang bzla ste/ sha med 'od kyi gzugs can ni/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas sku ru bsgom/ zhes sogs kyi dgongs pa ste sgrub pa'i tshul lo/ bzhi pa las sbyor ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis rigs bzhi'i thod phreng bskul bas de las rang 'dra'i sprul pa mkha' khyab tu spros pas phrin las rnam bzhi gang 'dod bsgrubs par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hri ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dza sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes bzlas te las sbyor gyi tshul lo/ mthar yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten snying rnams lan gsum/ lnga pa dzap kyi mchod bstod ni/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta gu h+ya sa ma ye swā hā: hūm̐: mnyam nyid chos sku'i rang bzhin ni: kun bzang zag pa med pas bde: sems can don la de bzhin gshegs: thugs rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'gags med yan lag drug cu'i gsung : grags stong snying rje'i rang bzhin can: 'gro rnams bdud rtsis tshim mdzad pa'i: rang byung gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: rtsol med rang byung chos kyi dbyings: ma skyes 'jigs med rdo rje'i sku: blang dor med par chos dbyings ngang : 'gyur med thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: chos dbyings rol pa chen po las: rtsal dang rol pa mi dmigs kyang : nam mkha' mdzod kyi cho 'phrul gyis: yon tan re skong phyag 'tshal bstod: rang bzhin ci yang ma nges te: dkyil 'khor chen po'i cha bzung nas: rtog med rtog pa ngang gis 'dul: phrin las mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod: lha dang rig 'dzin drang srong dgongs: 'dir bzhugs rig 'dzin bdag cag la: smin grol gnyis kyis rgyud sbyangs shing : bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis las gzhung bsrangs:

las dang thugs rje mthun pa yi: zhi rgyas dbang drag yid bzhin gter: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐ āḥ zhes ting 'dzin ye shes kyi dbang blang ngo*| gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la gsum/ dang po tshogs kyi las rim la brgyad/ sbyang spel spyan 'dren mchod skong bsgral/ tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma'o/ dang po tshogs sbyang spel ba ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: lan gsum gyis sbyangs| oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis byin brlabs/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo? lan gsum gyis mang por spel/ gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ lhun grub rab 'byams zhing khams rgya mtsho nas/ /bla ma bder 'dus sku gsum lha tshogs rnams/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas/ /o rgyan dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung rnams/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /gnas 'dir gshegs la dbang bskur byin chen phob| |mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ gu ru de wa ḍāk+ki nī sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa tshogs phud 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : dam can chos skyong nor gyi bdag: gter bdag gnyan po skyong la sogs: rig 'dzin bder 'dus dkyil 'khor la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de wa ḍāk+ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: bzhi pa skong ba ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod mdzes pa'i lha mo sna tshogs dang : nang mchod sha lnga bdud rtsi a mṛ ta: gsang mchod bde stong chags med ye shes rdzas: sman gtor rak+ta sbyor sgrol dbang po lnga: spyan gzigs dkor cha yid 'ong mnyes pa'i rten: rol mo sgra snyan gdangs dbyangs dgyes pa'i glu: kun nas ma tshang med pa'i mchod sprin 'dis: bla ma rig 'dzin bde gshegs 'dus pa'i tshogs: rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : nyams chag bskangs shing bar chad sel gyur nas:

mchog thun 'bad med lhun grub stsal du gsol: lnga pa bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag cag dkyil 'khor zab mo'i sgor zhugs nas: bag med dbang gyur dam 'gal ci mchis pa: mthol bshags bzod gsol mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: yig brgya bzla/ drug pa bsgral bstab ni/ hūm̐: shes bya lta ba gyad kyi phur pa yis: nga bdag srid pa'i ru tra bsgral gtubs nas: sha khrag klad rus phung por spungs pa 'di: rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta la khā raṃ khā hi: zhes bsgral zhing bstab bo/ bdun pa tshogs la rol pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: bla med dkyil 'khor rdzas chen gyi: dngos grub rmad byung ro brgya'i zas: deng 'dir skal ldan rnams la stsol: de nas slob dpon gyis: hoḥ 'di ni legs 'ong ya mtshan ldan: 'khor 'das ro gcig blang dor bral: gtsang rme gzung 'dzin gdod nas dag: dge bas de bzhin a la la hoḥ e ma hoḥ brgyad pa lhag ma ni/ hūm̐: bde gshegs rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: bka' yi las byed phra men 'khor bcas kyis: 'dod yon tshogs kyi lhag ma 'di bzhes la: rgyud srung sgrub pa'i sdongs grogs mi g.yel zhing : rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa bha ling+ta khā hi/

gnyis pa la lnga las/ bskul dang chad brtan rta bro dang*/ tshe 'gugs dngos grub bskul ba'o/ dang po thugs dam bskul ba ni| hūm̐: bskul lo bzhengs shig rgyal ba thugs dam can: rtsa gsum bder 'dus lha tshogs mthu ma chung : sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa gnyan la dgra dar na: mthu chen khyod kyi mngon spyod dus la bab: bar chod rtsom pa'i log 'dren rdul du rlog: oṃ gu ru dhai wa ḍāk+ki nī sa ma ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: gnyis pa tha tshig bsgrag pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe bar dang tha ma'i bskal pa la: bka' 'dus snying po'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: rgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma'i spyan snga ru: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang : bstan srung phrin las bsgrub pa khas blangs bzhin: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dngos grub mchog stsol bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod: oṃ sarba dharma pā la i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: gsum pa brtan ma skyong ba ni| hūm̐: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i bka' nyan pa: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis ni: so so'i bran g.yog yang g.yog 'khor dang bcas: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bstan pa'i bya ra mel tshe mdzod: oṃ ma ma hring hring bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: bzhi pa rta bro ni/ hūm̐: bde gshegs rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du: rtsa gsum 'dus pas bro brdungs pas: rigs drug 'khor ba'i rgyun lam chod: ye shes lnga ru lhun gyis grub: de ltar brda dang rten 'brel gyi: sna tshogs las kun lhun grub shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: satwaṃ bha ya nan: lnga pa tshe 'gugs bya ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hri ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ ba su sid+dhi na na kha dhi ā yu puṇ+ye sarba bsdus bsdus pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes brgya rtsa bzlas la mda' dar g.yab cing*/

hūm̐: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sku mnga' ba: sku ni nam mkha'i rdul bag med: sku mdog dmar 'tsher 'od zer 'bar: longs spyod mtshan dpe'i rgyan rnams rdzogs: phyag na tshe yi bum pa bsnams: bum pa 'chi med tshe chus bkang : gsang ba'i yum mchog gos dkar 'khril: phyag g.yas tshe mda' yab la 'khyud: g.yon pas tshe bum snyan thad 'dzin: zhabs gnyis yab kyi sked la 'khril: yab yum phyag gi tshe bum dang*/ gnyis med sbyor ba'i mkha' gsang nas: tshe yi 'od zer 'phro 'du gsal: bkrag dang mdangs kyi dpal du shar: phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthar thug pa'i: 'khor 'das gnyis kyi tshe bcud bsdus: bkra shis bum pa'i nang du bskyil: sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag cag la: 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe dbang bskur: skye shi med pa'i dngos grub stsol: 'gyur ba med pa'i don rtogs shog: ces mda' dar g.yab sgrub rdzas bdag nyid dngos su mos par bskyed/ dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐: bde gshegs ngo bo lhun grub ka dag la: bder 'dus rig 'dzin rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag la: tshe chos zas nor gos dang snyan grags stobs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus rnams: skad cig nyid la deng 'dir thob gyur cig: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ha ri ni sa ā yur+dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes dbang blangs/ gsum pa la drug /mchod bstod nongs bshags bsdu ldang dang*/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis so/ dang po mchod bstod ni/ oṃ gu ru dā+e wa ḍāk+ki nī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs| bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: chos sku'i rang bzhin mtha' bral ye shes klong : longs sku'i mtshan nyid sna tshogs 'dzin bral la: sprul sku ji snyed 'gro ba'i mgon mchog che: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha la bstod par bgyi: gnyis pa nongs bshags ni/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten snying brtan bzhugs bya/

gsum pa bsdu ldang ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ badz+ra kā wa tsi rak+ṣa haṃ/ bzhi pa bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐: gdod nas lhun grub chos dbyings ngo bo yang : de don ma rtogs rmongs khyu'i sems can rigs: a 'thas zhan pa'i 'gogs lam bsal bya'i phyir: kun rig don gnyis rtogs phyir dge tshogs bsngo: lnga pa smon lam ni/ hoḥ bla med bder 'dus rgyal ba'i dal bzung nas: mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin rtse gcig gis: ma 'ongs 'di nas rnga yab dpal ri'i zhing : pad 'byung rgyal ba'i sras su 'tshogs par shog: drug pa bkra shis ni/ hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: rje btsun pad+ma badz+ra zhes: bde chen yum mchog man+da ra: pad 'byung yab yum bkra shis shog: ces bkra shis dang bsngo smon rgyas bsdus ci rigs brjod/ de ltar rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi las byang bsdus pa zhig dgos zhes sgrub brtson karma mthar phyin nas yang yang bskul ngor/ gnam sprul lnga pa rig 'dzin phrin las tshe dbang 'dus pa rtsal gyis rtsa gsum gyi lha la gsol ba btab cing gnang ba zhus te gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang la phri bsnan cung zad bgyis te khrigs su bsdebs pa 'dis kyang 'og min me ri 'bar ba'i zhing du tshom bu gcig tu mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // tsa)༄༅/ /bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi bdag 'jug gi rim pa dbang bzhi'i ye shes dpal skyed ces bya bzhugs so/ bde gshegs rtsa gsum bka' 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ de la gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam du 'jug sgo smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba nyid yin la/ dbang gi srog rgyud la brtan par byed pa ni dam tshig la rag las pa yin/ des na dbang bzhi thob nas kyang de yi dam tshig rnams bsrung dgos pa yin pas de la rtag tu ye shes gso ba dang*/ nyams pa sbyong ba gal che ba yin/

de yi thabs lam dbang bdag nyid slob ma'i tshul dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo slob dpon gyi rnam pas bdag 'jug len par bya ba la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba dbang chog ltar bum thod/ me long*/ rig tsaka /shel rdo sogs dbang bzhi'i dkyil 'khor/ lha tsaka /bgrang phreng*/ gtor ma/ rdor dril sogs 'du bya'o/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la sgrub cing 'jug pa gnyis las/ dang po gsol 'debs nas brtsam bskyed bzlas bstod pa'i bar btang la dzap khang dbye zhing bzlas pa grub pa dang rnam bum gyi gzung thag blangs la/ phaṭ dzaḥ sa phyes la/ rang byung bum pa gzhal med khang chen por/ /skad cig mkha' la gza' skar shar ba bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor rtsa ba'i lha tshogs bkra lam mer/ /gsal ba'i thugs srog sngags phreng spro bsdu yis/ /byang sems bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar mos/ zhes gsal brtan gyi ngang nas rtsa sngags ji ltar rigs pa bzla zhing mthar gzung thag spos la/ las bum bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i bum pa tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa'i nang du pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang sngon phyag gnyis thal sbyar gyi bar du bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin pa: khro bo'i chas thams cad ldan pa'i spyi bor oṃ: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: de las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs gnyis su med par gyur: badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las sku: 'jigs byed 'jigs pa'i mthu stobs can: khro bo rgyal po khyod la bstod: las rnams 'grub par mdzad du gsol: thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng 'khor ba de las bdud rtsi babs pas bum pa gang bar mos la: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzlas pa'i rjes yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten snying dang thun mtshams mchod bstod mthar/

mchod yon gyi chu phul bas bum lha 'od du zhu nas bum chu dang dbyer med du gyur par bsams la dung chus gtso las bum pa so sor phul/ skabs 'dir gsol kha na rag skong bshags dang tshogs mchod drang ba'i bar song nas/ thog mar las bum gyi chus/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam? sogs kyi khrus byas la yi ge brgya pa bzlas/ sum+bha ni 'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/ sa gzhi spos chus sogs kyis maṇ+ḍal phul la/ oṃ tsak+ṣu bhan+dha wā ra ma ṇa ye swā hā sa mig dar 'ching*/ āḥkhaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis me tog bzung nas/ thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ kyaiḥ bde gshegs gtso bo bla ma rje: deng 'dir bka' 'dus dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag skal ldan 'jug pa'i phyir: rdo rje rgyal po'i gnang ba stsol: slob dpon gyis: hoḥ skal ldan dam gtsang rigs kyi sras: snod kyi dam pa mchog rnams nyon: deng 'dir bka' 'dus dkyil 'khor du: smin phyir bdag gis dbang mchog sbyin: skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo: bde gshegs kun 'dus gu ru pad+ma 'byung : thugs rje'i bdag nyid o rgyan chos kyi rje: rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gsum kun 'dus la: bdag yid rtse gcig gdung bas skyabs su mchi: smon 'jug byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ni/ hoḥ gdod nas rang rig rnam dag sku lnga'i mchog: ci bzhin rtogs pa'i byin rlabs nus rtsal gyi: 'od zer nar ma 'gro la rab spros nas: yang dag sangs rgyas lam 'god sems bskyed do: tshogs bsags pa yan lag bcu pa ni / hūm̐: rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dbyings nas gshegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: phyi nang gsang gsum kho na nyid: gling bzhi maṇ+ḍal mchod pa 'bul: gus pas phyag bgyi sdig pa bshags: gsol 'debs chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: dbang bskur smin grol dge ba bsngo: lha khyed rdo rje dbyings kyi gtso: nyid ltar bdag gzhan 'byung 'gyur shog: oṃ gu ru badz+ra bai ro tsa na bo dhi sa twa hūm̐:

sdom pa bzung ba ni/ bde gshegs sras bcas bdag la dgongs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni/ /byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar/ /so so thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus yongs su bzung bar bgyi/ lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung*/ nang 'jug la sbyor ba dam la bzhag pa ni/ dam chu gtad la/ hūm̐: 'di ni bde gshegs bla med chu: bsrungs pas mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: nyams pas ltung ba'i las su 'gyur: de bas dam srungs chu 'di 'thung : om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya i dan+te na ra kan: zhes dam chu sbyin/ dngos gzhir ye shes dbab pa ni/ skad cig gis khyed rang rnams rta mgrin yab yum du gsal ba'i spyi gtsug tu: paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba raṃ las nyi ma'i gdan du hūm̐ mthing nag las rje btsun ma hā gu ru rin po che dus gsum sangs rgyas de nyid sku mdog dmar smug khro 'dzum gyi nyams can thugs rje'i spyan gsum phyogs bcur 'khyil zhing gzigs pa: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar 'dzin cing g.yon ka pā la mnyam bzhag gi nang du 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis bkang ba'i bum pa 'dzin cing : sku la phod ka lhab lhub dang chos gos dmar po gser gyi pa tra ris gsol zhing za 'og gi ber chen dmar smug bklubs pa: dbu la shwa ba'i snyan zhu la rgod sgro dar sna lnga'i cod pan dang me long nyi zla nor bu khyung gshog la rin po che'i tshom bu bkod pa gsol ba: gru mor yum mtshon pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang de la g.yer kha sogs rgyan du mas spras pa: zhabs la rgya lham dar chen gsol nas snang srid zil gyis gnon par rol stabs su bzhugs pa: de yi spyi bor bla ma chos sku rdo rje 'chang la yum rnal 'byor dmar mo 'khril ba: gu ru'i gnas lnga ru thod phreng sde lnga phyi rol rta mgrin 'jam dpal spyan ras gzigs phyag na rdo rje'o: de yi phyi rol gu ru mtshan brgyad dpa' bo ging bzhi gsang ba'i rig ma bcu drug laṅka gnas nyul sprul pa nyid sprul dang bcas pa:

gzhan rje 'bangs nyer lnga grub thob brgya rtsa rig 'dzin 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs rnams snang la rang bzhin bral bar nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang gang zhing rnga yab dag pa'i zhing mchog nas 'ja' 'od gur khang 'khrigs te skad cig gis byon nas bdag dang mos pa'i bu la thugs rje'i byin rlabs sprin phung thib thib/ 'ja' 'od thig le thig phran rig pa lug rgyud sbrang char ltar nyi li li babs nas/ lus kyi ba spu bu ga dang dbang po'i sgo rnams nas zhugs snying dbus su thim pas bde ba chen po'i ye shes bzod med du 'bar bar sgoms shig / de nas spyan 'dren pa'i rol mo dbyangs dang bcas/ hūm̐: sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: sogs nas? oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra tsakra badz+ra a be sha ya badz+ra hoḥ spos rol bcas ye shes pa dbab/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ me tog mgor bzhag oṃ puṣ+pe ghṛh+na hoḥ sa me tog dkyil 'khor du 'dor/ slar me tog spyi bor bkod la/ pra ti ghṛh+na sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes lha de spyi bor stim/ mig dbye ba ni/ hūm̐: nga ni zag bcas 'khrul rgya zhig: 'khrul med shes rab spyan dang ldan: rtsal spros ye shes thur ma yis: khyod kyi a 'thas sgrib mun bsal: badz+ra dz+nyā na tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ces gdong g.yog bsal la/ rang rig bla ma rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum du mthong bar mos mdzod/ gnyis pa dbang blang ba dngos la/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ bum pa chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du bla ma rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha tshogs yum dang bcas pa snyoms par zhugs pa dga' ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ rjes su chags pa'i byang chub kyi sems zhu ba'i bdud rtsi spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor sib kyis thim pas/ rim bzhin mgrin pa snying kha lte ba gsang gnas sogs rtsa'i 'khor lo rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsis ltem gyis gang*/

tshe rabs thog med nas lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib las nyon thams cad dri ma med par sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dang gnyis su med par gyur/ bum pa thogs la/ hūm̐: bum pa rang byung bla med gzhal yas khang : bum chu rigs 'dus rje btsun ngo bo nyid: bde gshegs sgrub pa sku yi lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa kā ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar mngon par dbang bskur bas bdud rtsis lus gang nyon mongs pa lnga yi sgrib pa dag /phung po lnga gnas gyur/ ye shes lnga yi rtogs pa mngon du byas/ bdud rtsi lhag ma yar lud pa las snang ba mtha' yas yab yum gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ me tog gtor zhing*/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /thams cad bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus bskyed pa'i bde ba chen po ste/ /des ni deng khyed dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog om̐ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: de nas spros pa la dga' ba'i nang nus pa 'jug par byed pa sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rjes su gnang ba 'di rnams sbyar ba'i dbang du byas pa las/ dbang bzhi kho na blangs pas kyang chad skyon med/ de ltar na gsham gsal/

de yan chad kyis phyi mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor du/ bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku ma hā yo ga spros bcas bum pa'i dbang thob sogasadabang gong gsum la rim par 'jug pas chog /spros na thog mar sku yi rjes su gnang ba la/ mdun bskyed gtso bo las rang 'dra gnyis pa re 'phros rang la thim pas lha so so'i sku dang dbyer med par byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ rigs bdag rdor 'chang thogs la/ hūm̐: drug pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang : yum mchog snyems ma zung 'jug 'khril: thabs shes dbyer med dbang bskur bas: rgyud sde'i gtso bo bdag gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra dha ra pradz+nyā swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: sku gnas lnga'i thod phreng sde lnga thogs la/ hūm̐: bud+dha badz+ra rat+na trām̐: pad+ma karma la sogs pa: bla ma thod phreng sde lnga yi: dbang bskur ye shes don ldan shog: oṃ badz+ra kā ya pañca dz+nyā na shrī swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rta mgrin 'jam dpal rigs gsum bcas thogs la/ hūm̐: rta mchog khro rgyal 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i sku: spyan ras gzigs dbang gsang bdag gtum po sogs: go cha 'jig rten gsum mgon dbang bskur bas: lta ba shes rab snying po'i mthu ldan shog: oṃ badz+ra pradz+nyā ma hā bha lo ka ru ṇa swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: gu ru mtshan brgyad thogs la/ hūm̐: pad+ma 'byung gnas pad+ma sam+bha wa: blo ldan mchog sred pad+ma rgyal po sogs: lhun grub rig 'dzin bzhi yi dbang bskur bas: lam bzhi grol nas rgyud bzhi smin par shog: oṃ gu ru dhe wa tsa tur hūm̐ swā hā: oṃ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: hūm̐: nyi ma 'od zer shākya seṅge dang : seṅge sgra sgrogs rdo rje gro bo lod: mu stegs tshar gcod bzhi yi dbang bskur bas: phrin nas rnam bzhis 'gro ba 'dul bar shog: oṃ badz+ra he ru ka sarba hūm̐ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: dpa' bo yab yum dang ging yab yum thogs la/ hūm̐: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las kyi rigs:

dpa' bo dpa' mo ging chen yab yum bcas: he ru ka yi gnas bcu byin brlabs pa'i: dbang bskur yon tan bcu drug la gnas shog: oṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha ghṛ wa ghṛ wa hūm̐ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: lha mo bcu drug thogs la/ hūm̐: bzhi gnyis rnam shes tshogs brgyad bcu drug khams: g.yo ba rtsa gnyis yang g.yo drug cu bzhi: mchod 'dzin lha mo rnams kyi dbang bskur bas: gsung dbyangs drug cus 'gro ba sgrol bar shog: oṃ badz+ra ḍāk+ki sarba ud ta rā ga he hūm̐ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: dbang phyug zhing skyong laṅka thogs la/ hūm̐: dbang phyug ma mau zhing skyong laṅka gdong : gnas nyul tshogs khang 'grims nas drod tshad nyul: dkyil 'khor gnyan po'i las byed dbang bskur bas: skal ldan sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi bar shog: oṃ badz+ra iṣ+ṭa dwa ra bha la hūm̐ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas chas dbang sbyin pa ni/ hūm̐: pad zhwa phod kha chos gos ber chen dang : rin chen rgyan mdzes sku reg rgya lham sogs: sku'i chas gos du ma'i dbang bskur bas: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su mnga' sgyur cig: oṃ sarba bhi shwa bha tra swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: hūm̐: rdo rje rtse lnga bhan+dha tshe bum dang : kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yer kha thod pa gsum gyis mtshan: sku yi rgya rtags las kyi phyag mtshan gyi: dbang bskur rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' thob shog: oṃ badz+ra dharma ko3 haṃ dz+nyā na swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas zhi ba yongs rdzogs kyi rgyan spyod thogs la/ hūm̐: rigs lnga dar dpyangs stod g.yogs ga shal dang : ang rag rin chen rgyan cha pad+ma'i phreng : zhi ba'i lha rdzas yongs rdzogs dbang bskur bas: zhing khams lta bur mkho dgu longs spyod shog: oṃ sarba mu ṭa ku su me ku su ma ṇi hūm̐ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar sku phyag rgya'i dbang thob pas lus su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas bde bar gshegs pa sprul sku'i bdag nyid du bsgom pa la dbang zhing dngos grub rnam pa gnyis la mnga' brnyes pas 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku thob par 'gyur ro/
