zhes rtogs pa bskyed la/ gsung sngags kyi dbang ni/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ dmar po'i mthar sngags phreng g.yas bskor 'khor bas 'od zer 'ja' 'od thig le'i rang bzhin rang sgra dang bcas 'khor bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru? thod phreng rtsal? hri ma ha ri? de ltar snying khar sngags phreng 'khor ba las 'od zer mkha' khyab tu 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ slar 'od zer tshur 'dus pa hūm̐ yig la thim pas gzi brjid rab tu 'bar zhing brjod med grags stong gsung rdo rje mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor los dbang bsgyur bar gyur/ de nyid brtan pa'i slad du phreng ba thogs la/ hūm̐: bla med sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa: snying po 'dzab dbyangs sgrog pa'i phyir: bzlas pa rdo rje'i phreng ba gtad: dri med pad+ma lug gur rgyud: om̐ badz+ra ma li ta sarba swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar gsung sngags kyi dbang thob pas ngag tu 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung gi snying po longs spyod cing dngos grub rnam gnyis kyi nus pa'i stobs rgyas te 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob par gyur/ zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ de nas thugs kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi 'od zer snying khar mdung tshugs su zug pas gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa dag stai rang lus 'od phung du yal/ rig stong rjen pa ka dag zab gsal gyi ngo bo me long g.ya' bral ba'i gzugs snang bzhin dbyings dang rol rtsal zung du 'jug pa rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin mngon du gyur par mos/ hūm̐: snang zhing gsal la stong zhing 'gag pa med: gsal la nam mkha'i rang bzhin khor yug ltar: chos sku rdzogs chen thugs rje'i lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes me long snying khar bzhag

/de ltar thugs gsal stong phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas sems su 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs kyi bdag nyid skye med blo 'das kyi don ma nor bar mngon sum du rtogs shing khong du chud pas rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa lon te/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku thob par 'gyur ro/ zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ de nas yon tan gtor ma lte bar bzhag la/ hūm̐: rmad byung gtor ma bla med mchog gi rdzas: ngo bo 'dod yon mtshan nyid lha rnams kyi: dngos grub kun 'byung bla ma'i yon tan gyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa gu na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar dngos grub yon tan gyi dbang bskur bas dbul phongs 'dzin pa rnam par dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan longs spyod yid bzhin rgyan gyi rol pa dbang bsgyur zhing*/ dgos 'dod kyi re ba yid bzhin du skong bas 'gro don chag thogs med pa la mnga' brnyes te/ 'bras bu mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku thob par 'gyur ro/ zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ de nas phrin las rdo rje dang dril bu lag tu gtad la/ hūm̐: rdo rje rgyal po thabs kyi mgon mchog nyid: shes rab drug ldan yan lag bcu gnyis sogs: dkyil 'khor chen po'i dam tshig phrin las kyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rab 'byams kyi dbang yongs su rdzogs pas khyab bdag pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyis che ba bskyed pa tsam gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa skye med chos kyi skur sangs rgyas te sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i dgongs pa bzhin yongs su rdzogs par gyur pas/ snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad snang stong dag pa gzhal yas khang bcud kyi sems can thams cad bde stong lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin/

phyi nang 'byung ba'i sgra skad thams cad grags stong sngags kyi rang sgra tshogs drug rang grol thugs rje rol pa'i phrin las mngon du gyur par mos/ me long dang lha sku thogs la/ hūm̐: snang ba bden med nam mkha' bzhin: sna tshogs cho 'phrul rang sar te: nam mkha'i dbyings kyi 'ja' tshon bzhin: sprul pa sgyu ma ltar bstan no: oṃ swa bhā ko'u ta paṃ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes spyi bor bzhag la/ de ltar dbang thams cad brtan par byed pa la 'ja' lus snang stong brda yi dbang thob pas deng phyin chad/ snod bcud gzhal yas lha'i rang bzhin du ye nas yin pa ngo shes pas dag snang dang mos gus rgyun chad med pa'i bkur sti dang*/ sems can thams cad bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po can yin pa dwang du blangs shing sgrub pa'i rgyur ngo shes par gyis shig /de yan chad kyis phyi mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor du/ bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku ma hā yo ga spros bcas bum pa'i dbang thob pas lus kyi sgrib pa dag /lam dus su bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ snod bcud bla ma rtsa gsum lha'i dkyil 'khor gcig tu rdzogs nas/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje mchog gi sprul sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ dbang gong ma gsum las dang po gsang dbang ni/ slob dpon bla ma pad+ma he ru ka'i rang 'od kyi yum rdo rje snyems ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i dga' ba'i sgra dang bde ba'i 'od zer gyis 'phro 'dus phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad spyan drangs pa yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar chags pa chen po'i mes zhu ba sku'i dbyibs rgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs/ byang sems dkar dmar ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i rgyun mu tig gi mdangs can de nyid lce thog tu stsal bas lus thams cad bde bas khyab/ snang gsum 'od gsal du thim/ rtsa thig rlung gsum ye shes su smin par mos mdzod/

ces thod pa mgrin par bskur zhing*/ hūm̐: bhan+dha bde chen snang srid 'byung ba'i snod: nang bcud gsang ba ye shes ḍāk+ki mchog: bde gshegs kun 'dus longs sku'i lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra gu ru ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes bdud rtsi myong*/ bdud rtsi myong ba'i rtsa thams cad byang sems yi ge'i sprin ā li kā li'i rnam pas khengs/ 'ching byed kyi mdud pa bkrol/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog tshogs 'gags/ thig rlung 'od gsal ye shes kyi ngo bor byin gyis brlabs/ gsal stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par mos la de'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par zhog mdzod/ des kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang thob/ ngag rlung tha mal du 'dzin pa'i zhen rtog dang ngag gi dri ma sbyangs/ rdzogs rim a nu la brten pa'i steng sgo rnam grol gyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ sa bcu pa tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi rigs su skyes/ sgra skad 'byin 'jug sngags su dag la 'bras bu gsung rdo rje longs sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ gnyis pa sher dbang ni/ rang nyid bla ma rdo rje he ru ka snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i skur gsal ba la/ slob dpon gyi yum ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma las rigs mthun gyi shes rab ma gzugs dang lang tsho mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa zhig rnam par spros te phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dpang du bkod de gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces rig ma'am dril bu lag g.yon du thogags la/ hūm̐: gsang ba shes rab bde ba'i grogs: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem brda skad 'byin: 'di bsten bde stong dbab 'dren zungs: dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ a nu tā ra ya hoḥ rā ga ya satwaṃ pra mo ti ri mi dharma hoḥ zhes 'khyud rgya dang bcas/ de ltar yab yum 'du shes gsum gyis snyom par zhugs pas/

gnyis snang gi rtog pa'i 'phro 'du bde chen gyi dbyings su nub te/ yas babs kyi dga' ba nyams su myong*/ slar dmar cha dang bcas pa'i rlung 'pho med gyen du drangs pas mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi nyams su myong ba'i mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes lhan skyes bde stong 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ngang la mnyam par zhog cig /de ltar chos thams cad 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ rtog tshogs tha mal 'dzin pa'i zhen pa sbyangs yid sgrib dag /rdzogs rim a nu'i rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang lam nas lam pho nya bsgom pa la dbang*/ sa bcu gnyis pa phyag rgya rig 'dzin gyi rigs su skyes/ bde sdug gang byung lhan skyes ye shes su dag te 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ gsum pa tshig dbang ni/ bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i zhal nas skye med rdo rje'i tshig gi rang byung don gyi dgongs pa ngo sprad de dbugs dbyung bar mos la/ zhes me shel thogs la/ hūm̐: kun gzhi ma bcos stong pa'i dbyings: rang byung rig pa lam gyis shar: sna tshogs 'dzin med de bzhin nyid: ka dag dbyings rig dbang thob shog: oṃ dharma kā ya saṃ bho kā ya nirmā kā ya bi shwa dz+nyā na hrī da hūm̐: zhes rang byung gi ye shes de kho na nyid kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag / de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du rig pa'i rtsal dbang thob/ sgo gsum tha dad 'dzin pa'i shes bya'i sgrib pa ches phra ba sbyangs/ lam dus su ka dag lhun grub zung 'jug rdzogs rim mthar thug pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ snang bzhi zad sar 'khyol te/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku kun bzang rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang mngon du byed pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'o/ zhes rtogs pa bskyed do/ hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa'i: rje btsun pad+ma badz+ra zhes: bde chen yum mchog man+da ra:

pad 'byung yab yum bkra shis shog: tsan dan nags la spyod par gshegs: stag zhon rdo rje gro bo lod: bkra shis khye'u 'dren mtshan ldan lcam: drag po yab yum bkra shis shog: mchims phur bde gshegs sgrub pa mdzad: grub thob rgyal po zil gnon zhabs: zung 'jug dbyings phyug mtsho rgyal ma: rig 'dzin yab yum bkra shis shog: zab rgya'i gnas mchog gter gyi sgrom: mchims phu brag dmar ke'u tshang : dregs sde srung mas bya ra mdzod: chos skyong gter srung bkra shis shog: rjes ni/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ deng nas brtsams te sogs kyis dam tshig khas blangs te lus longs spyod dbul zhing gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal sngar ltar phul/ cho ga'i rjes kyi bya ba rnams las byang bzhin mthar dbyung bar bya'o/ zhes pa'ang sgrub pa chen po spros bcas dang dbang chen rgyas spros skabs nye bar mkho ba'i dbang du byas te thugs sgrub rtsa ba'i dbang chen in+d+ra nī la'i mchod sdong las bdag 'jug gi rim pa cung zad btus pa yin no/ gsam̐ng chen rdo rje theg pa'i bcud/ /sngam̐gs kyi dam gso nyam sbyong slad/ /bstam̐n la mos pa'i skye sprul ming*/ /'dzim̐n des spel bas don ldan shog /ces pa 'di'ang shing sprel lor rgyal zla ba'i dmar phyogs rgyal ba gnyis pa'i dus tshes bzang por gu h+ya'i ming gis smras rim bzhin au ḍī'i sor mos glog gi gar rtsed bzhin yud tsam du grub par bgyis pa'i dge bas dbang bzhi ye shes ma skyes pa skyes shing skyes pa mi nyams par gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ //

tsha) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ las bzhi lhun grub dang bcas pa'i sbyin sreg rigs lnga'i rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ bde gshegs kun 'dus gu ru yid bzhin nor/ /dran pas srid zhi'i gdung sel mtshan mchog brgyad/ /'dod rgu'i dpal ster rnam 'phrul bcu gsum sogs/ /rtsa gsum bka' 'dus dkyil 'khor gtsug na rgyal/ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i kha lo bsgyur ba dang*/ /mchog thun dngos grub char rgyun dbab pa'i phyir/ /sbyin sreg cho ga spel la bla ma lha/ /rtsa gsum srung mas bkas gnang byin gyis rlobs/ de la bla ma'i thugs sgrub bsam lhun gyi cha lag sbyin sreg rtsom pa la gsum/ sbyor ba yo byad kyi bsham bkod/ dngos gzhi phrin las kyi rim pa/ rjes las kyi mtha' bsdu ba'o/ dang po sgrub mchod sogs kyi dus nyin snga ma'i thun mtshams su sa chog bya ba ni/ gang du bya ba'i gnas der gzhi bdag la gtor ma byin nas bka' bsgo/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag g.yas pa sa la bzhag ste lha gang yin gyi rtsa sngags brgya rtsa bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs nas stong nyid du rgyas btab/ mjug chog mchod bstod kyi gong du tshom bu bca' ba rnams sngon du song ste/ dus ni zhi bar shis pa'i yar tshes lta bu la snga dro'i cha dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs sam spyi ltar du kha shar du phyogs la/ zhi ba'i thab stegs gru bzhi pa ba byung gis byugs pa'i khar/ bri thab la tshangs zur gyi thig btab/ rgyar khru gang*/ mchu dang kha khyer la sor bzhi re/ nang du cha gcig la nor 'dzin pa tra/ de'i nang du cha phran gcig pa la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte bar rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ phyi'i zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes spras pa/ kha dog thams cad kun nas dkar por byas pa'i phyir ba byung bdud rtsi lnga dri bzang dang bcas pas byugs/ me tog dkar po bcal du bkram/

de yi steng tsher ma dang srog chags med pa zhi ba'i thab shing zlum bskor du brtsegs/ shar lho ru zhi ba'i me dar dkar po 'dzugs/ slob dpon gyi mdun du bsang chu rdor dril dkar blugs nang mchod rnams bsham/ slob dpon chas gos dkar po dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ 'jam pa'i stan la thab dang zhal sprod byas pas g.yas su mchod rdzas la/ gtso bo'i zhi gtor me lha'i mchod gtor so so'i mdun nyer spyod dang sman raka bcas bkod/ g.yon du 'das ma 'das so sor dbul rgyu'i bsreg rdzas kyi go rim ni/ dpal 'bar/ rlung g.yab ljang gu/ mar khu/ zhi ba'i yam shing sman shing ngam 'o ma can gyi shing sogs la ring thung sor bcu gnyis pa pad kha can/ til dkar nag /dūrba/ zho zan/ dkar gsum mngar gsum 'bru phye dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog /'bras dkar/ swa ba/ nas dkar/ gro dkar/ yungs dkar/ sran dkar/ shing tog /me tog sogs rdzas rnams zhi ba'i snod du so sor bshams pa'am gcig tu bshams kyang rung la/ de yang nad yams sdig sgrib sogs zhi zhing bsnyen sgrub kyi kha skong kho na la til dang*/ gdon zhi ba la yungs dkar/ rtogs sgrib zhi ba la ku sha dang skra sen/ tshe yi bar chad zhi bar dūrba/ rgyal pos chad pa dang pha rol gyi gdug rtsub zhi bar zas mchog sogs/ las rim gang yin gtso bor ston pa'i rdzas rnams ci 'byor du bsags/ gzhan ci ltar dgos pa'i yo byad rnams 'du bya'o/ bdag bskyed kyi las gzhung bsrangs shing bzlas pa'i mjug tshogs mchod bsgral bstab dang bcas pa bya/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum gyi dang po lha'i nga rgyal la gnas bzhin pas rdo dril bsang sbyang ni/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rigs lnga'i rang bzhin thabs kyi rdo rje las sems can thams cad smin par byed pa'i 'od zer kun tu 'phro bar gyur: oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐: zhes rdo rje lan gsum gsor/ āḥlas dbyings phyug yum lnga'i rang bzhin shes rab dril bu'i rnam pas sems can thams cad rig pa sad par byed pa'i chos sgra rgyun mi chad par gyur:

oṃ ma hā ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ zhes dril bu dkrol/ rdor dril thabs shes kyi phyag rgyas snying khar bsnol zhing*/ hūm̐: thabs shes zung 'jug chos nyid mtshon: ma lus 'gro rnams sad pa dang : sems can smin par bya ba'i phyir: rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu 'khrol: oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hūm̐ āḥ thugs kar 'khyud rgya bya zhing*/ rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig /dril bu gsung gi dam tshig /phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig ste/ gong gi rdor dril kha sbyor bas byung ba'i bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid nga'o snyam pas dam tshig gsum dran par byas la 'di nas bzung sreg blugs kyi bya ba mthar ma phyin bar rdor dril sa la mi 'jog pa sbyin sreg gi dam tshig tu bshad do/ mchod pa byin rlob ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ hrīḥ phyi mchod me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo sil snyan dbyangs dang bcas: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya mchod pa'i sprin: bde gshegs rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas su spel: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ zhes lnga'am bdun gyis brlab/ dgang blugs dang sreg rdzas rnams bsang sbyang ni/ blugs gzar thogs la/ hūm̐: thabs kyi rol pa las byung ting 'dzin gyi: dpa' bo rdo rje snod mchog g.yas su thogs: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ dgang gzar thogs la/ hūm̐: shes rab bde stong dga' bzhi'i snyoms 'jug gis: dpa' mo zab lam chos 'byung g.yon du thogs: mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: kha sbyor te rdzas rnams la g.yas bskor du reg cing*/ hūm̐: chags med bdai stong ye shes rnam rol gyis: skye med sna tshogs rdzas kun byin gyis rlobs:

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dz+nyā na pañca a mṛ ta a we sha ya a āḥ de nas bsreg rdzas rnams bdud rtsis bran la/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgyas reg la/ oṃ swā hā sa rdzas rnams dkru/ yam shing la/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ zhun mar la/ oṃ shrī swā hā/ 'bru rnams la/ oṃ dz+riṃ swā hā/ rdzas rnams la/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ stong pa'i ngang las rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin sreg rdzas so so'i rnam par gsal bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gcig la/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya swā hā/ lan gsum btags pa brjod/ de bzhin du/ oṃ ag+ne ye swā hā/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swā hā/ oṃ sarba sam+ba de swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭā ya swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bī dzā ye swā hā/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hā/ oṃ ma hā ba la ya swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma r+yai swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe swā hā/ oṃ a pra ti ha na badz+ra ya swā hā/ 'bru gsum dang rdzas sngags gsum gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pa 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ dge 'dun gyi tshang ngam dkyil 'khor gyi mar me las sbar ba'i lce lde thab tu gzhug cing*/ oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes pas du ba med par 'bar ba'i me g.yas su bskor nas thab tu bcug hūm̐ brjod cing rlung g.yab kyis me spar/ oṃ ag+ni swā hā/ zhes blugs gzar gyis mar khu'i thigs pas gso/ ku sha thogs la/ oṃ/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yin/ /dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa/ /sa las skyes pa 'dab ma'i snying*/ /bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni/ /zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol/ swā hā/ zhes pas thab kyi khar g.yon nas brtsams te g.yas bskor du dgram/ de nas me thab bsang sbyang ni/ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi thugs ka nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum 'phros me thab kyi dbus su 'khod pa las sems can thams cad kyi dug gsum zhi bar byed pa'i 'od zer ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar bar gyur:

de yi ngang las skad cig gis/ bh+rūm̐ las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar: rdo rje me 'od dkar gsal klong : oṃ las zhi ba'i me lha dkar: zhi 'dzum ghaṇ+ḍe bgrang phreng bsnams: sha rgyas gzugs thung lto ba 'khyil: ra skyes khrir bzhugs drang srong skur: 'od 'phros rang 'dra spyan drangs bstim: de ltar du gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis ye shes pa spyan drangs par mos la/ spyan 'dren ni/ me dar g.yab cing*/ hūm̐: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che: me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog: 'dir gshegs 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs: gus pa'i yid kyis khyod phyag 'tshal: sreg blugs zhal zas tshogs bzhes la: zhi ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: las sngags oṃ pad+ma ta kri ta badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ sogs kyis phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ mchod yon 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: 'jig rten 'di'am gzhan dag na: mchod pa'i bye brag dpag med dang : mchod yon zhabs bsil zhal chab sogs: bdud rtsi dag pa lha mo'i tshogs: glu gar rol mo dbyangs dang bcas: bde ba'i nyams dang ldan phyir 'bul: oṃ ag+ne de wa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: oṃ ag+ni dā+e wa sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: oṃ ag+ne dā+e wa sa pa ri wā ra añja ma nam pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: oṃ ag+ne ye sa ma ya satwaṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ byon skyems dgang blugs kyis 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: a yig rang byung me hom du: hom yig byung ba bdud rtsi'i chu: rigs lnga yab yum snyoms 'jug gis: bde ba chen po'i mchod pa 'bul: zhi ba'i las kun 'grub par mdzod: de nas me lha cung zad 'dzum pa'i ljags dang gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la ram̐ yig gis mtshan par

bsams la/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā: zhes bdun gyis dgang blugs mar khus bkang ba kha sbyor zhing g.yas bskor gyis/ oṃ ag+na ye a ti bh+yaḥpa ti bh+yaḥ a be sha yaḥm hā shrī ya ha bh+ya ka bh+ya bha na ye swā hā: zhes lan gsum 'bul/ de nas nyer spyod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams na: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo ji snyed kun: ye shes me lha'i tshogs la 'bul: phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ ag+ne de wa sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ ne wi d+ye/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: de nas 'dod yon lnga 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams na: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos: 'dod yon bla med mchod pa 'di: ye shes me lha'i tshogs la 'bul: phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ ag+ne de wa sa pa ri wā ra rū pspar+she pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ nang mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag na: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa dang*/ rak+ta dmar mchod ar+ghaṃ dang : bcud ldan mchog gi gtor ma rnams: ye shes me lha'i tshogs la 'bul: phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ ag+ne de wa sarba pañca a mṛ ta la khā hi: oṃ ag+ne de wa ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: oṃ ag+ne de wa ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: zhes sman raka gtor gsum 'bul/ tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams na: tshogs mchod bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di: ye shes me lha'i tshogs la 'bul: phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ ag+ne dā+e wa sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog: 'bar ba'i sku la sreg pa'i zhal: phrin las bzhi yi bdag nyid can: tshangs sras mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas rdzas rnams rim bzhin 'bul ba las/ hūm̐: 'bar ba'i rdo rje drang srong lha tshogs la:

ting 'dzin dbang bskur dam rdzas bdud rtsi rnams: dag cing gtsang mar sbyar te 'bul lags na: dgyes pa'i thugs kyis dgongs te bzhes su gsol: oṃ dā+e wa dz+wa la ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes mar khu lan bdun sogs phul zhing mthar oṃ dā+e ba dz+wa la ag+ne ye nad gdon sdig sgrib shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: yam shing*/ oṃ bo dhi bh+rik+ṣā ya swā hā/ gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ mar khu/ oṃ ag+ne ye swā hā/ 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ til/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swā hā/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zho zan/ oṃ sarba sam+ba de swā hā/ bde ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ 'bras/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭā ya swā hā/ bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ swa ba/ oṃ badz+ra bī dzā ye swā hā/ nor dang 'bru phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ nas/ oṃ ma hā be gā ye swā hā/ shugs phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ sran ma/ oṃ ma hā ba la ya swā hā/ stobs phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ gro/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma r+yai swā hā/ nad med phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ dūrba/ oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe swā hā/ tshe ring ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ ku sha/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye swā hā/ srung ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes rdzas rnams so sor nyer gcig re sogs 'bul/ gzhan yang bsreg rdzas ci 'byor pa ag+ne ye dī bya bi shud+dhe ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya bah+na ya hūm̐ phaṭḥswā hā/

zhes bsreg rdzas rnams sngags de kho nas rdzogs par phul nas mthar 'dod don gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: srid pa'i rang bzhin 'dag pa'i phyir: ngo bo nyid kyis dngos med byas: rang bzhin dag pa'i drang srong mchog: dam pa'i srid pa byed par shog: de nas yungs dkar thab tu gtor te/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pas bsreg rdzas lha'i zhal du stob pa dang*/ me nyid ye shes kyi mer byin gyis brlabs te/ bdag gi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ gyis me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam mo/ gsum pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me thab tu bud shing cung zad bsnan/ las bum gyi chus bsang sbyangs la/ hūm̐: 'byung ba'i mnga' bdag drang srong me yi lha: rab 'bar chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i dbus: me long ye shes rang bzhin zhi ba'i thab/ ye shes me dpung dkar gsal 'od 'bar klong*/ ma bskyed lhun grub gsal rdzogs su: pho brang gzhal yas gru bzhi pa: rtsig 'dod mda' yab 'od phreng mdzes: chos 'khor za ram rin chen tog: phyi nang dkyil 'khor rgyan bkod tshang : snang stong 'od kyi drwa bar bsgom: hūm̐: dbus su nyi zla pad+ma'i steng : gu ru snang srid zil gnon sku: dkar gsal mdangs ldan zhi 'dzum mdzes: dbu la pad zhwa mthong grol gsol: snyan cha mgul rgyan se mo do: phyag g.yas zil gnon rdo rje gdeng : g.yon pas bhan+dha tshe bum bsnams: kha ṭ+wāṃ yum tshul 'khyud cing 'gying : lhab lhub ber dang chos gos dmar: phod kha stod g.yogs ska rags mdzes: zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol stabs brjid: g.yas su lha lcam mkha' 'gro dmar: mda' dar tshe bum rgyan chas mdzes: g.yon du mtsho rgyal btsun mo dkar: bhan+dha bdud rtsi bskyil zhing mchod: khor yug rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha: tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor ma lus kun: stong gsal 'dzin med wal gyis shar: oṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma dhā ra ḍāk+ki sid+dhi hrīḥ
de ltar bskyed pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyi 'phro 'du yis rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ

gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings rang rtsal las: snang mtha'i rnam rol pad+ma 'byung : dbyings las ma g.yos rtsal rdzogs su: thugs rje'i 'od skur 'dir snang stsol: oṃ gu ru badz+ra dhā ra hūm̐ dza dzaḥ zhes dang spro bar mos na bder 'dus sogs skabs dang bstun pas chog /mthar mchod yon 'bul ba ni/ rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: sogs dang*/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: sa pa ri wā ra añja ma nam pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: gong ltar 'bul/ gsum pa bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ni/ hūm̐: chags med skyon bral rigs kyi bdag: pad 'byung rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: ma skyes bla med dam phyag 'tshal: sgo gsum 'khrul 'dzin sgrib bral nas: dbang bzhis smin grol dngos grub stsol: oṃ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: me tog mdzes pa'i phreng ba phreng : dri zhim g.yo ba'i bdug spos phyur: snang gsal 'od kyi sgron me gtams: bzang po'i dri chab rab tu bstar: bcud ldan ro brgya'i zhal zas mtho: sna tshogs snyan pa'i rol mo'i sgra: reg 'jam yug gos rgyan gyi tshogs: nang mchod sman raka gtor gsum dang : gsang mchod sbyor sgrol ting 'dzin sogs: blos blangs dwang bas dgyes bskyed nas: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha la 'bul: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: de bzhin du/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: rū pspar+she pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sarba pañca a mṛ ta la khā hi: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: tshogs 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyis mchod:

skye med chos dbyings ngang du bzhes: deng 'dir mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: de nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ skye 'chi gnyis spangs rdo rje'i go cha can: snang mtha' bde gshegs rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dang : grub pa'i bla ma rdor 'chang longs spyod rdzogs: snang srid zil gnon ye shes sku lnga 'chang : rdo rje rnal 'byor zab lam bde chen dbyings: dgra bgegs mthar byed dregs pa kun 'dul rtsal: bde gshegs rtsa ba'i yi dam rigs 'dus lha: gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor tshogs: rab 'byams mkhyen brtse'i dpal zhing lha la bstod: de nas dgang blugs 'bul ba ni/ lha tshogs ljags hūm̐ gzar bu ram̐ mtshan las: bsreg rdzas bdud rtsir drangs te gsol bas mnyes: nam mkha' gang ba'i 'od dkar rab 'phros te: zhi ba'i phrin las rab 'byams sgrub par bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes lan bdun gyis mar khu blugs gzar gyis bkang ba'i dgang blugs kha sbyar te g.yas su bskor nas/ de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ ram̐: ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i hoṃ khang du: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i bsreg rdzas 'bul: dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes nas kyang : thog med las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: hoḥ thog med bsags pa'i sdig ltung nyams chag dang : sngon las 'phral rkyen byad phur rbod gtong sogs: mi mthun dgra gdon rkyen ngan bar chad kun: ma bcos rig pa'i ngang du zhi gyur cig: oṃ sarba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: de bzhin du bsreg rdzas gzhan rnams kyang rtsa sngags kho nas phul zhing brgya rtsa re'i mtshams su 'dod gsol gong ltar bya ba'am/ bye brag bsnyen sgrub kha skong la/ bdag cag ma rig pa'i dbang gis ting nge 'dzin ma gsal zhing bzlas brjod lhag chad du gyur pa sogs gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi sgrib tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa myur ba nyid du thob par mdzad du gsol/

zhes sogs gang zhi ba'i 'dod gsol sbyar/ mthar mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: me tog mdzes pa'i phreng ba phreng : dri zhim g.yo ba'i bdug spos phyur: snang gsal 'od kyi sgron me gtams: bzang po'i dri chab rab tu bstar: bcud ldan ro brgya'i zhal zas mtho: sna tshogs snyan pa'i rol mo'i sgra: reg 'jam yug gos rgyan gyi tshogs: nang mchod sman raka gtor gsum dang : gsang mchod sbyor sgrol ting 'dzin sogs: blos blangs dwang bas dgyes bskyed nas: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha la 'bul: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: de bzhin du/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: rū pa/ shab+da/ gan+dhe/ rā sa/ spar+she pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sarba pañca a mṛ ta la khā hi: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: 'bul gtor dgang gzar khar bzhag ste/ hūm̐: rdo rje dbyings kyi pho brang chen po nas: rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho rnams: thugs dam dbyings nas bskul lo thugs rje bskyed: nyon mongs sdug bsngal zhi ba'i dus la bab: nad gdon rkyen ngan zhi ba'i dus la bab: mi mthun 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i dus la bab: 'byung po'i gdug rtsub zhi ba'i dus la bab: dam sri'i kha rlangs zhi ba'i dus la bab: dus la bab bo rgyal ba thugs rje can: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ma rungs bdud dgra zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: de yis zhi bar ma gyur gang yang med: zhi mdzad lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces 'bul lo/ de nas bstod pa gong ltar bya/ smon lam ni/ hūm̐: ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i hom khung du: thugs rje'i me sbar mtshan ma'i rdzas phul bas: nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun phyogs rnams kun: rdo rje'i mes bsregs ye shes cher gyur shog: las kyi mchod pa dam pa 'di phul bas:

pho nya'i rigs kyi thugs dam bskangs gyur cig: 'bru thug phul bas yid bzhin 'dod 'byung gter: drang srong 'khor bcas thugs dam bskangs gyur cig: mar khu mchod pas khams gsum sems can rnams: sku gsung thugs rdzogs byang chub mchog thob shog: me tog bsregs te phul bas yon tan rnams: ljon shing lta bur tshe dpal rgyas par shog: 'o skom zhal zas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'dis: khams gsum sems can ma lus tshim par shog: ku sha mchod pas bka' dang sngags kyi dbang : dam tshig tshul khrims nyams chag skong bar shog: til dkar bsregs pas bdag sogs sems can gyi: nad gdon sdig sgrib ma lus zhi bar shog: gu gul sbyar ba'i yungs dkar bsregs pa yis: stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs tshogs zhi bar shog: dkar gsum bsregs pas khams gsum sems can rnams: snying po byang sems rgyud la gnas par shog: 'bras dkar bsregs pas bdag dang 'gro ba kun: rnam dkar dge bcu'i dpal la spyod par shog: bdud rtsi bsregs pa'i mchod pa dam pa 'dis: sku lnga'i dngos grub deng 'dir thob par shog gtor ma bsregs pas bsod nams tshogs rdzogs nas: sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin pa mthar phyin shog: rak+ta bsregs pas khams gsum srid gsum gyi: lha 'dre mi nor dbang du bsdus par shog: rig 'dzin bdag gis bde gshegs bka' lung bzhin: phrin las bzung ba'i sngags kyi byin rlabs dang : chos nyid bden pa sangs rgyas rnams kyi mthus: mi mthun phyogs rnams kun nas bzlog pa dang : gnod pa kun zhi tshogs gnyis rdzogs gyur cig: ces smon lam btab/ bzod gsol ni/ hūm̐: bde gshegs kun 'dus dkyil 'khor du: sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di 'bul gyis: 'gal 'khrul nyams pa ci mchis pa: de dag khyed kyis bzod par gsol: rtsa sngags dang*/ sa ma ya shud+dhe āḥ yig brgya bzlas shing bzod par gsol/ bde gshegs kun 'dus dkyil 'khor gyis: zhi bar gyur pa'i las kun mdzad:

sgrub pa'i 'bras bu stsal lags pas: bde gshegs yul du gshegs slad du: sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di 'bul gyi: ci bde bar ni gshegs su gsol: rtsa sngags dang*/ badz+ra mu zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang gi lte ba'i a thung la thim par gyur/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la gnyis las dang po me lha gshegs su gsol ba ni/ blugs gzar gyis mar khu dang*/ oṃ ag+ne ye dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas me gso zhing*/ slar yang me lha cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/ me lha cung zad 'dzum pa'i ljags dang gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la ram̐ yig gis mtshan par bsams la/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā: lan bdun 'bul zhing*/ oṃ: ag+ne chen po me yi lha: 'dod pa'i don rnams rab sgrub cing : thugs rjes sems can don byed pa: gtang rag mchod pa bzhes su gsol: oṃ ag+ne ye dī bya dī bya bi shud+dhe ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya hūm̐ phaṭa ཿswā hā/ de nas rdzas rnams rim bzhin 'bul ba las/ yam shing*/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya swā hā/ mar khu/ oṃ ag+ne ye swā hā/ til/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swā hā/ zho zan/ oṃ sarba sam+ba de swā hā/ 'bras/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭā ya swā hā/ swo ba/ oṃ badz+ra bī dzā ye swā hā/ nas/ oṃ ma hā be gā ye swā hā/ sran ma/ oṃ ma hā ba la ya swā hā/ gro/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma r+yai swā hā/ dūrba/ oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe swā hā/ ku sha/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes rdzas rnams so sor phul/ sngar mchod pa'i skabs mchod rdzas lhag ma rnams tshig dang bstun te thab tu dbul/ oṃ ag+ne de wa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ ne wi d+ye/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: de nas sman raka gtor ma yang 'bul la/ oṃ ag+ne de wa sarba pañca a mṛ ta la khā hi: oṃ ag+ne de wa ma hā rak+ta la khā hi:

me lha'i gtor ma dgang gzar khar bzhag la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis byin brlabs la/ me de bsreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas pa/ /mchod cing bstod do phyag kyang 'tshal/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ ces pas gtor ma me nang du bzhu/ de nas so rtsi dang gos zung kyang 'bul bar spro na/ oṃ badz+ra tam+bu la ye swā hā/ zhes so rtsi dang*/ oṃ badz+ra wasatra ye swā hā/ gos zung yang 'bul/ bstod pa ni/ phyag rgya dril stabs dang bcas/ hūm̐: me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog: 'bar ba'i sku la sreg pa'i zhal: phrin las bzhi yi bdag nyid can: tshangs sras mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod: bzod gsol ni/ hūm̐: drang srong me lha 'khor bcas la: sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di 'bul gyi: 'gal 'khrul nyams pa gang mchis pa: de dag khyed kyis bzod par gsol: oṃ ag+ne dā+e wa te pa ma dag pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: gshegs gsol ni/ hūm̐: drang srong chen po me yi lha: sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di 'bul gyis: khyed kyis sems can don mdzad nas: pho brang nyid du gshegs su gsol: badz+ra mu: me lha ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa lte ba'i a thung la thim par gyur/ de nas rjes shul mi dmigs par bsdu la me rang gzhil btang*/ long khyab med tshe 'o chab kyis me gzhil te ri rtser rlung la bskur ram btsa' sad ser srung sogs la bed spyod bya srol yod/ nang du logs la rjes kyi bya ba gzhung ltar bya'o/ dmigs bsal sgrub mchod lta bu'i dus nyin snga ma'i phyi thun gyi mchod bstod skabs tshom bu bkod la/ dkyil 'khor du bzhugs su gsol zhing*/ sreg blugs dngos kyi skabs 'jig rten me lhar bsreg 'bul grub nas 'bar ba'i rang bzhin du mos te 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa la/ me thab tu bud shing cung zad bsnan/ las bum chus bsang sbyangs byas nas/

thog mar tshom bu spyan 'dren ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyi 'phro 'du yis rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni tshig bdun gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro bas/ hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings rang rtsal las: snang mtha'i? las gzhung spyan 'dren dang spos rol bcas tshom bu gdan drangs thab tu bskor ba dang bcas slob dpon gyi mdun du phul bas/ rtsa sngags kyis tshom bu'i rtse mo thab tu 'bul zhing bzhugs gsol ni/ hūm̐: ma chags skyon bral pad+ma ge sar dbus: 'dab stong khyon yangs rin chen seng khri'i steng : pad+ma 'byung gnas rtsa gsum ngo bo mchog: bde gshegs 'dus pa'i lha tshogs bzhugs su gsol: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sa ma ya satwaṃ: zhes thab tu bzhugs su gsol/ hūm̐: 'byung ba'i mnga' bdag drang srong me yi lha: rab 'bar chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i dbus: ma bskyed lhun grub gsal rdzogs su: pho brang gzhal yas gru bzhi pa: rtsig 'dod mda' yab 'od phreng mdzes: chos 'khor za ram rin chen tog: phyi nang dkyil 'khor rgyan bkod tshang : snang stong 'od kyi drwa bar bsgom: hūm̐: dbus su sogs nas stong gsal 'dzin med wal gyis shar: oṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma dhā ra ḍāk+ki sid+dhi hrīḥ bar brjod/ spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol 'dir mi dgos/ phyag 'tshal ni/ hūm̐: ka dag lhun grub? sogs mchod pa nas bzung rjes gshegs gsol bar gong gsal sbyin sreg ji lta ba yin la bzod gsol rjes/ badz+ra muḥ thab kyi lha tshogs rnams dkyil 'khor ba'i thugs kar gshegs par gyur/ ces spos rol bcas tshom bu slar spyan drangs/ dam tshig pa lte ba'i a thung la thim par gyur zhes tshom bu dkyil 'khor du gdan 'dren bya ba khyad par yin la gzhan rnams dkyus dang mtshungs so/ las bzhi gzhan du kha bsgyur dgos tshe/ ༈ gnyis pa rgyas pa'i me mchod ni/

sbyor dngos phal cher zhi ba dang mtshungs shing*/ sbyin sreg bya ba'i dus kyang yar tshes gza' skar shis pa'i dus nyin gung char rang nyid chas gos ser por bsgyur la/ kha lho ru gyu/ rgyas pa'i gtso gtor dang 'bul gtor ser po gru bzhi/ bsreg rdzas kyi khyad par dkar gsum mngar gsum dang mar khu gtso bo byas la gzhan snga ma ltar mtshungs/ rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi lte bar 'dab brgyad nor bus mtshan pa phyi rol nor phreng zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa thams cad kha dog ser por bsgyur la me tog gcal du bkram/ rgyas par 'os pa'i yam shing 'bras bu can gyi shing sogs ser por kha bsgyur la sbrang rtsi dang mar khus brlan/ thab gru bzhir brtsegs pa khyad par ro/ ༈ gsum pa dbang gi sbyin sreg bya ba'i dus kyang zla ba mar gyi ngo dang dus tshes khyad par can mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus sogs dgong mo'i char rang nyid chas gos dmar por bsgyur la/ kha nub tu gyu/ dbang gi gtso gtor dang 'bul gtor dmar po zla gam dang*/ bsreg rdzas kyi khyad par glang sna ug chos sogs me tog dmar po'i rigs dang 'bru rigs shing tog sogs myos byed kyis sbags la mtshal dmar gyis kha bsgyur ba gong ltar mtshungs/ dbang gi dkyil 'khor dmar po zla gam lte bar 'dab brgyad dang pad+ma'i lcags kyus mtshan pa phyi rol pad phreng zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa thams cad kha dog dmar por bsgyur la me tog gcal du bkram/ dbang la 'os pa'i yam shing tsan+dan sogs kha dog dmar po'i rigs dang thab zla gam brtsegs pa spor byed kyang smad 'tshong ma'i lag nas byung ba'i me sogs khyad par ro/ ༈ bzhi pa drag po'i sbyin sreg bya ba'i dus kyang drag po la shis pa'i zla ba mar gyi ngo nyer dgu sogs 'phrod sbyor rtsub pa'i dus srod kyi char rang nyid chas gos nag por bsgyur la/ kha byang du gyu/ drag po'i gtso gtor dang 'bul gtor nag po gru gsum dang*/

khyad par gyi rdzas tshwa sna gsum dang dug sna gsum lcags zangs thal ba sha khrag sogs las sbrus pa'i ril bu'am phye ma gang rung dang gzhan du dgra gzugs liṅga sogs 'du bya ba'am/ spyi ltar rdzas spyi mthun ltar la dug khrag dang nag po'i tshon gyis kha bsgyur ba tsam gyis kyang rung ngo*/ drag po'i dkyil 'khor nag po gru gsum lte ba ral gris mtshan pa phyi rol ral gri'i phreng ba thams cad kha dog nag por bsgyur/ drag por 'os pa'i yam shing dug shing dang tsher ma can sogs nag pos kha bsgyur ba dug khrag gis ngar gyis brlan pa thab gru gsum brtsegs pa khyad par ro/ ༈ lnga pa lhun grub bam mchog la dus sogs zhi ba dang mtshungs la rang nyid chas gos sngon por bsgyur la/ gtso gtor dang 'bul gtor las bzhi'i gdan can 'brang rgyas sngon po mchod pa zhi ba dang mtshungs la kha dog sngon por bsgyur/ bsreg rdzas zhi rgyas bzhin gtso bor byas/ dkyil 'khor drag po dbus su byas pa'i las bzhi ka tshang ba'i lte bar 'dab brgyad 'khor los mtshan pa phyi rol rdo ra 'od phreng zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa thams cad kha dog mdzes mtshon la gzhi sngon por bsgyur la me tog gcal du bkram/ mchog gi las la 'os pa'i sman shing sogs la yam shing dang*/ thab dbyibs las bzhi'i rang gzugs ltar brtsegs pa khyad par ro/ de nas dngos gzhi sgrub pa'i skabs bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas rdor dril byin rlabs nas thab bskyed kyi bar spyi dang mtshungs la/ khyad par ni/ dang po 'jig rten pa'i me thab bsang sbyang skabs/ ༈ gnyis pa rgyas pa la/

a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swā bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi thugs ka nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum 'phros me thab kyi dbus su 'khod pa las sems can thams cad kyi tshe bsod rgyas par byed pa'i 'od zer ye shes kyi me dpung ser po 'bar bar gyur/ de yi ngang las skad cig gis/ bh+rūm̐ las rgyas pa'i thab khung ser: rin chen me 'od ser gsal klong : trām̐ las rgyas pa'i me lha ser: rgyas 'dzum ghaṇ+ḍe? zhes dang*/ ༈ gsum pa dbang la/ khams sum dbang du byed 'od zer ye shes kyi me dpung dmar po 'bar bar gyur/ de yi ngang las skad cig gis/ bh+rūm̐ las dbang gi thab khung dmar: pad+ma'i me 'od dmar gsal klong : hrīḥlas dbang gi me lha dmar: sgeg 'dzum ghaṇ+ḍe? zhes dang*/ ༈ bzhi pa drag po la/ dgra gdon brlag par byed pa'i drag po'i 'od zer ye shes kyi me dpung ljang nag tu 'bar bar gyur/ de yi ngang las skad cig gis/ bh+rūm̐ las drag po'i thab khung nag: las kyi me 'od ljang nag klong : āḥlas drag po'i me lha ljang : rab gtum ghaṇ+ḍe? zhes dang*/ ༈ lnga pa mchog la/ las bzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i 'od zer ye shes kyi me dpung sna lnga 'bar bar gyur/ de yi ngang las skad cig gis/ bh+rūm̐ las lhun grub thab khung ni/ lhun grub me 'od lnga ldan klong : hūm̐ las lhun grub me lha mthing : zhi 'dzum? sogs so sor kha bsgyur ba'i mthar ghaṇ+ḍe bgrang phreng bsnams: sha rgyas gzugs thung lto ba 'khyil: ra skyes khrir bzhugs drang srong skur: 'od 'phros rang 'dra spyan drangs bstim: de ltar du gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis ye shes pa spyan drangs par mos la/ spyan 'dren ni/ me dar g.yab cing*/ hūm̐: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che: me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog:

'dir gshegs 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs: gus pa'i yid kyis khyod phyag 'tshal: bsreg blugs zhal zas tshogs bzhes la: rgyas pa'i tshab tu dbang la dbang gi? drag po la/ drag po'i zhes kha bsgyur ba'i mthar phrin las 'grub par mdzod: lhun grub la/ phrin las ma lus 'grub par mdzod/ las sngags oṃ pad+ma ta krita badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ sogs kyis phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ mchod yon 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: 'jig rten 'di'am gzhan dag na: mchod pa'i bye brag dpag med dang : mchod yon zhabs bsil zhal chab sogs: bdud rtsi dag pa lha mo'i tshogs: glu gar rol mo dbyangs dang bcas: bde ba'i nyams dang ldan phyir 'bul: oṃ ag+ne de wa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: oṃ ag+ni dā+e wa sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: oṃ ag+ne dā+e wa sa pa ri wā ra añja ma nam pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: oṃ ag+ne ye sa ma ya satwaṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ byon skyems dgang blugs kyis 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: a yig rang byung me hom du: hoṃ yig byung ba bdud rtsi'i chu: rigs lnga yab yum snyoms 'jug gis: bde ba chen po'i mchod pa 'bul: zhi ba'i rgyas pa'i/ dbang gi /drag po'i/ las kun 'grub par mdzod: lhun grub la/ phrin las ma lus 'grub par mdzod/ ces so sor kha bsgyur ro/ de nas me lha cung zad 'dzum pa'i ljags dang gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la ram̐ yig gis mtshan par bsams la/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā: zhes bdun gyis dgang blugs mar khus bkang ba kha sbyor zhing g.yas bskor gyis/ oṃ ag+na ye a ti bh+yaḥpa ti bh+yaḥ a be sha yaḥm hā shrī ya ha bh+ya ka bh+ya bha na ye swā hā: zhes lan gsum 'bul/ de nas nyer spyod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams na: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo ji snyed kun:

ye shes me lha'i tshogs la 'bul: phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ ag+ne de wa sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ ne wi d+ye/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: de nas 'dod yon lnga 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams na: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos: 'dod yon bla med mchod pa 'di: ye shes me lha'i tshogs la 'bul: phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ ag+ne de wa sa pa ri wā ra rū pspar+she pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ nang mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am gzhan dag na: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa dang : rak+ta dmar mchod ar+ghaṃ dang : bcud ldan mchog gi gtor ma rnams: ye shes me lha'i tshogs la 'bul: phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ ag+ne de wa sarba pañca a mṛ ta la khā hi: oṃ ag+ne de wa ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: oṃ ag+ne de wa ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: zhes sman raka gtor gsum 'bul/ tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'jig rten rab 'byams na: tshogs mchod bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di: ye shes me lha'i tshogs la 'bul: phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ ag+ne dā+e wa sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog: 'bar ba'i sku la sreg pa'i zhal: phrin las bzhi yi bdag nyid can: tshangs sras mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas rdzas rnams rim bzhin 'bul ba las/ hūm̐: 'bar ba'i rdo rje drang srong lha tshogs la: ting 'dzin dbang bskur dam rdzas bdud rtsi rnams: dag cing gtsang mar sbyar te 'bul lags na: dgyes pa'i thugs kyis dgongs te bzhes su gsol: oṃ dā+e wa dz+wa la ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes mar khu lan bdun sogs phul zhing mthar 'dod gsol ni/ ༈ rgyas pa la/ oṃ dā+e ba dz+wa la ag+ne ye bdag cag sgrub pa po'i tshe dang bsod nams lung rtogs yon tan thams cad puṣ+ṭīṃ ku ru ye swā hā:

༈ dbang la/ oṃ dā+e ba dz+wa la ag+ne ye bdag cag sgrub pa po'i khams sum srid gsum skye 'gro snang ba thams cad wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ ༈ drag por/ oṃ dā+e ba dz+wa la ag+ne ye bdag cag sgrub pa po'i nad gdon bar chad dang dgra bgegs 'byung po thams cad hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭḥ ༈ lhun grub la/ oṃ dā+e ba dz+wa la ag+ne ye bdag cag sgrub pa po'i phrin las bzhi dang mchog gi dngos grub thams cad 'grub par gyur cig sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ zhes sogs 'dod gsol kha bsgyur bar bya'o/ yam shing*/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya swā hā/ mar khu/ oṃ ag+ne ye swā hā/ til/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swā hā/ zho zan/ oṃ sarba sam+ba de swā hā/ 'bras/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭā ya swā hā/ swa ba/ oṃ badz+ra bī dzā ye swā hā/ nas/ oṃ ma hā be gā ye swā hā/ sran ma/ oṃ ma hā ba la ya swā hā/ gro/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma r+yai swā hā/ dūrba/ oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe swā hā/ ku sha/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes rdzas rnams so so'i mthar 'dod gsol gong ltar kha bsgyur shes par bya'o/ gzhan yang bsreg rdzas ci 'byor pa ag+ne ye dī bya bi shud+dhe ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya bah+na ya hūm̐ phaṭḥswā hā/ zhes bsreg rdzas rnams sngags de kho nas rdzogs par phul nas mthar 'dod don gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: srid pa'i rang bzhin 'dag pa'i phyir: ngo bo nyid kyis dngos med byas: rang bzhin dag pa'i drang srong mchog: dam pa'i srid pa byed par shog: de nas yungs dkar thab tu gtor te/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pas bsreg rdzas lha'i zhal du stob pa dang*/ me nyid ye shes kyi mer byin gyis brlabs te/ rgyas pa la/ bdag cag gi tshe dang bsod nams 'byor drug yon tan thams cad rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ de bzhin du dbang la/ pha rol gyi rlung sems snang ba thams cad bdag gis dbang du 'dus pa'i? drag por/ dgra gdon byad ma thams cad drag pos sgo nas tshar gcod pa'i?

zhes kha bsgyur ba'i mthar phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes sbyar/ lhun grub la/ phrin las rnam bzhi'i mchog thun ma lus pa lhun gyi grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ gyis me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam mo/ ༈ gnyis pa 'das pa'i thab bskyed kha bsgyur ni/ hūm̐: 'byung ba'i mnga' bdag drang srong me yi lha: rab 'bar chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i dbus: rgyas par/ mnyam nyid ye shes rang bzhin rgyas pa'i thab/ ye shes me dpung ser gsal 'od 'bar klong*/ ma bskyed lhun grub gsal rdzogs su: pho brang gzhal yas gru bzhi pa: zhes sogs rtsa ba gcig dril lam rgyas par spro na bder 'dus sogs long khom dang bstun pas chog /dbang la/ sor rtog ye shes rang bzhin dbang gi thab/ /ye shes me dpung dmar gsal 'od 'bar klong*/ ma bskyed lhun grub gsal rdzogs? yang drag por/ bya grub ye shes rang bzhin drag po'i thab/ ye shes me dpung ljang nag 'khrugs pa'i klong*/ ma bskyed lhun grub gsal rdzogs? de bzhin lhun grub la/ chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin lhun grub thab/ ye shes me dpung sna lnga 'bar ba'i klong*/ ma bskyed lhun grub gsal rdzogs? zhes bsgyur bas 'thus so/ de nas spyan 'dren mchod pa bstod pa bar song nas/ dgang blugs 'bul skabs dmigs pa'i khyad par ni/ ༈ gnyis pa rgyas pa la/ lha tshogs ljags hūm̐ gzar bu raṃ mtshan las: bsreg rdzas bdud rtsir drangs te gsol bas mnyes: nam mkha' gang ba'i 'od ser rab 'phros te: rgyas pa'i phrin las rab 'byams sgrub par bsam: rtsa sngags lan bdun gyis mar khus blugs gzar bkang ba kha sbyar te g.yas su bskor nas lan bdun bar phul/ mthar rtsa sngags dang gung mo bsgrengs pa'i rgya bcas/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang grags pa lung rtogs yon tan thams cad oṃ sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/

zhes dang 'dod gsol ni/ raṃ: ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i hom khung du: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i bsreg rdzas 'bul: dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes nas kyang : thogs med las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: hoḥ tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa dang : nyams dang rtogs pa sa lam yon tan rtsal: stobs dang snyan grags gdul bya phrin las kun: rtsol med rig pa'i ngang du rgyas gyur cig: bh+rūm̐ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes dang*/ ༈ gsum pa dbang la/ lha tshogs ljags hūm̐ gzar bu raṃ mtshan las: bsreg rdzas bdud rtsir drangs te gsol bas mnyes: nam mkha' gang ba'i 'od dmar rab 'phros te: dbang gi phrin las rab 'byams sgrub par bsam: rtsa sngags lan bdun gyis mar khus blugs gzar bkang ba kha sbyar te g.yon du bskor nas lan bdun bar phul/ mthar rtsa sngags kho nas pad+ma'i rgya bcas g.yon pa'i kun spyod kyis 'bul la/ khams gsum srid gsum rlung sems snang ba thams cad oṃ sarba wā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes dang 'dod gsol ni/ raṃ: ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i hom khung du: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i bsreg rdzas 'bul: dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes nas kyang : thogs med las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: hoḥ rgyal ba'i mthu byin lha 'dre'i srog snying dang : che dgu gnyan bcu rgyal blon btsun mo sras: 'khor 'bangs pho mo zas nor longs spyod tshogs: 'bad med rig pa'i ngang du dbang sdud gyur: hrīḥ wā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes dang*/ ༈ bzhi pa drag po la/ lha tshogs ljags hūm̐ gzar bu raṃ mtshan las: bsreg rdzas bdud rtsir drangs te gsol bas mnyes: nam mkha' gang ba'i 'od ljang rab 'phros te: drag pos phrin las rab 'byams sgrub par bsam: rtsa sngags lan bdun gyis mar khus blugs gzar bkang ba kha sbyar te g.yon du bskor nas lan bdun bar phul/ rtsa sngags dang mthe chung bsgrengs pa'i rgya g.yon kho nas 'bul la/

nyon mongs dug gsum dang dgra bgegs byad ma thams cad sarba mā ra ya phaṭ/ zhes dang 'dod gsol ni/ raṃ: ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i hom khung du: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i bsreg rdzas 'bul: dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes nas kyang : thogs med las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: hoḥ sngon las 'phral rkyen bstan dgra sgos dgra dang : ma rungs sems can gzugs can gzugs med dang : byad stems rbod gtong than dang ltas ngan bcas: skye med rig pa'i ngang du brlag gyur cig: hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭḥ zhes dang*/ ༈ lnga pa lhun grub la/ lha tshogs ljags hūm̐ gzar bu raṃ mtshan las: bsreg rdzas bdud rtsir drangs te gsol bas mnyes: nam mkha' gang ba'i sna tshogs 'od 'phros te: lhun grub rab 'byams phrin las sgrub par bsam: rtsa sngags lan bdun gyis mar khus blugs gzar bkang ba kha sbyar te g.yas bskor gyis lan bdun bar phul/ mjug rtsa sngags kyi mthar 'dod gsol ni/ raṃ: ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i hom khung du: dam rdzas bdud rtsir 'bar ba'i bsreg rdzas 'bul: dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes nas kyang : thogs med las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: hoḥ nad gdon 'jigs brgyad sdig sgrib zhi ba dang : tshe bsod dpal yon 'byor drug rgyas pa dang : 'khor 'das mos bzhi snang sems dbang du bsdus: gnod byed tshar gcod drag po'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ sarba shān+tiṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ wā shaṃ mā ra ya phaṭ swā hā: zhes dang*/ so so'i rdzas rdzogs pa dang*/ mchod bstod sogs snga ma ltar la rgyas pa'i me rang zhi btang ba'am long khyab med na dri bzang gi chus bsad de me thal ri rtser rlung la bskur ram gter bum du sba/ de bzhin dbang gi me thal chu klung chen por 'dor/ drag po'i me grub ma thag dug khrag gis bsad la thal ba yang mnan pa bya ba ni lag len gyi khyad par te so so'i skabs phyed par bya'o/ 'di nyid thugs sgrub kho na tsam ma yin par gzhan rang lugs las bzhi'i sbyin sreg med pa rnams la'ang lha mtshan dang so so'i cho ga dang bstun lha sngags kha bsgyur bas chog go

/de ltar bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi las bzhi lhun grub dang bcas pa'i sbyin sreg rigs lnga'i rgyan zhes bya ba 'di yang tshul 'di'i tshom bu tshogs sgrub sogs bsnyen sgrub nyams len pa rnams la nye bar mkho ba'i cha rkyen dang slad rang lugs bla ma drag po'i zhi sreg ye shes 'od dpung la gzhi byas shing bder 'dus su kha bsgyur byas la kha skong dgos pa rigs mthun gzhan nas kyang mi 'gal bar brgyan te a su ra yi brag phug dang nye ba'i e wam̐ sgrub sde ru rab byung bcu bdun pa'i shing sprel lo rgyal zla ba'i dmar phyogs rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes la 'jam dbyangs 'gro ba kun 'dul gyis grub par bgyis pas yi ge pa ni sgrub bla gsang sngags 'gro 'dul gyis bgyis shing slar yang 'brong smad sgrub bla karma'i mtshan gyis dag par bsgrubs pa'i dge bas 'gro kun tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing sku gnyis kyi go 'phang mngon du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //

wa)༄༅/ /bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ spros bcas sgrub chen gyi stong thun rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i dgyes dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ pad+ma'i rigs mchog 'dren pa 'od mtha' yas/ /pad+ma'i spyan ldan 'phags mchog snying rje'i gter/ /pad+ma las 'khrungs rgyal sras sprul pa'i sku/ /sku gsum dbyer med drin can bla mar 'dud/ /bla ma'i thugs sgrub rtsa gsum bka' 'dus pa/ /chos kyi rgya mtsho'i spros bcas sgrub chen gyi/ /stong thun rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'dus pa yi/ /dgyes pa'i gar gyi nyams dbyangs 'dir sgrogs bya/ de la thog mar ma traṃ bsgral chog gi gong du rdo rje slob dpon nam rgyal thebs kyis gtsos/ thugs lta dgongs las ma g.yos bzhin du/ rdo rje slob dpon nam rgyal thebs kyis zhwa chos dang bcas gsungs gsal zhing dal la gcod mtshams legs shing brjid cing lhun chags pa'i ngang nas 'di skad do/ kyai/ rdo rje 'dus pa rgya mtsho gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyan po 'di nyid la 'jug par 'os pa'i las dang skal ba ldan pa'i mched lcam rnams kyis tshom bu tshogs su sgrub pa'i phrin las kyi rim pa la 'jug pa'i yan lag ni/ de'ang shing rta chen po sangs rgyas gsang bas/ phyi nang gsang bas bsrung bya ste/ /srin po'i rgyal po tshul bzhin mnan/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mtshan 'dzin rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir du/ thog mar ma traṃ bsgral chog bya ba'i skabs su bab pa yin pas skal ldan rdo rje'i rnal 'byor las su rung zhing*/ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyan por 'du bar 'os pa'i rdo rje'i mched lcam rnams legs par gsan du gsol/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa mchog gi lam la zhugs pas gzhi lam 'bras bu thams cad kyi skabs su thabs snying rje chen po dang*/ shes rab stong pa nyid dbyer mi phyed pa'i rdo rje sdom pa chen po las mi 'da' bas na bdag cag gi ston pa rnam 'dren bzhi pa chen po shākya seṅges kyang thun mong ma yin pa'i rdo rje'i mdzad pa chen po bcu gnyis bstan pa'i bye brag ser skya'i khab tu rdo rje btsun mo'i sgyu ma chen po 'khor brgyad khri dang bcas pa la chags chen rdo rje'i sgyu rtsal gyi 'dod yon la dgyes dgur rol pa'i tshul gyis thabs kyi brtul zhugs mthar phyin par mdzad pas rigs brgya'i khyab bdag drug pa'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa dang*/

dzam+bu gling gi yul dbus rdo rje gdan byang chub shing drung du mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa bstan pa'i snga rol du mi bsrun pa'i bdud kyi cho 'phrul gyi g.yo sgyus brid pa la mkhyen pa'i dbang phyug 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed khro bo dang*/ pad+ma'i pho nya sgrol ma myur ma dpa' mo/ stobs bcu'i nus stobs rdo rje'i khro bo mi g.yo ba'i dpung gis bdud dpung mi 'khrugs phrag gcig dpa' bkong bas bar chad kyi g.yul las rgyal nas mi slob pa'i zung 'jug chen po mngon du bstan nas rdo rje theg pa bla med kyi rgyud sde bsam mi khyab pa rdo rje'i rigs can gyi 'dus pa la bstan pa dang*/ rdo rje theg pa rang gi rgyud kyi gleng gzhi dang sbyar na gu ru'i zhal nas/ ri bo ma la ya gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rtser: bdud po ma traṃ ru tra drag pos bsgral: srin mo ma tshogs rnams la sbyor ba mdzad: zhes pa ltar/ gsang sngags bstan pa dang po de nas byung : gsang sngags bstan pa'i chu mgo brdol ba'i gleng gzhi ltar/ de'ang ma traṃ zhes bya ba 'di lhan skyes dang kun brtags kyis ma rig pa'i rtsal las/ 'khor 'das la bzang ngan dang yul can sogs gnyis 'dzin du shar ba'i don te/ ru tra la lhan skyes don gyi ru tra/ mtshan ma brda yi ru tra/ btags pa ming gi ru tra bcas gsum las/ de la lhan skyes don gyi ru tra ni/ kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las/ bgegs kyi bgegs te bgegs chen po/ /dug lnga'i rtog pa nyid las skyes/ /phyed dang gsum gyi dur khrod na/ /gzhi rtsa lus dang ngag sems so/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lus snang ba'i srid pa/ ngag phyed snang gi srid pa/ yid mi snang ba'i srid pas bsdus pa'i chos so cog la chos dang gzhan du bden par 'dzin nas gzung byar 'khrul pa chos kyi bdag tu 'dzin pa la ma traṃ ka ru tra zhes sems can gyi lus la gnas/ yul can rnam shes tshogs brgyad la nga dang bdag tu lta ba gang zag gi bdag 'dzin la kha traṃ ka ru tra zhes sems can gyi sems la gnas/

gtsang bde rtag bdag sogs phyin ci log gi lta ngan gyis rtag chad kyi mthar lhung ba las dang 'bras bu sogs med par smra ba mi bden 'khrul pa'i bdag 'dzin la a kar+ṣa ru tra zhes sems can gyi ngag la gnas pa ste/ de lta bu'i bdag 'dzin las gyes pa'i dug lnga'i ru tra chen po'i 'khor du/ nye nyon nyi shu rtog tshogs brgyad khri bzhi stong sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa de rnams kyang*/ zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po skye 'chi bde sdug gi rten 'khrul snang lus kyi dur khrod dang khams gsum la sred len gyi gsos btab nas phy-i ma'i skye srid kyi rgyur gyur pa kun gzhi sems kyi dur khrod de gnyis la rten bcas nas bdag tu bzung ba'i bsgral bya dregs pa can de dag dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med par rtogs pa lha yi dur khrod chos dbyings nam mkha' yangs pa'i hom khung du/ rang byung gnyug ma'i ye shes khrag 'thung khro bo'i tshogs kyi rnam par shar ba rnams kyis mi gsang ba'i gsang ba chen po'i thabs khyad par can gyi chos nyid de bzhin nyid kyi phur bus bsgral zhing*/ nang gi rtsa rlung thig le'i rang mdangs phyi rol du shar ba la/ yul nyer bzhi dur khrod chen po brgyad sogs sgrub pa gnas kyi dur khrod chen por byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir gsang sngags thabs mkhas rmad du byung ba'i brda dang thabs kyis btul ba'i tshul yang*/ mtshan ma brda yi ru tra ni/ sngon 'das pa'i dus dpag tu med pa na bskal pa kun tu dga' bya bar sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa'i bstan pa la dge slong thub dka' gzhon nu'i slob ma thar pa nag po zhes bya bas slob dpon gyis bstan pa'i gsang ba'i gnas lugs de kho na nyid kyi lta ba ma rtogs par/ sbas pa'i gsang ba sbyor sgrol brlang por spyad pas spyod pa'i phyogs su lta ba shor zhing*/ nag po kha 'byams log par rtog pa'i dbang gis sbyor sgrol sogs kyi spyod pa rtsing po la 'jol nyog tu spyad cing bla ma dang mched grogs rnams kyang lta spyod mi mthun pa'i dbang gis yul khams gzhan tu spyugs te gzhan khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyang log pa'i lam du bsgyur nas ngan song gsum gyi gnas su skyes pa sha stag ste/

de'i 'bras bur rnam smin gyi 'bras bu dmyal ba tsha grang gi sdug bsngal bskal pa bcu gnyis dang*/ lha sngags rang rgyud du bzlas sgom byas pas rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bus mthar sangs rgyas mar mai mdzad kyi bstan pa'i mjug shākya thub pa'i bstan pa ma byon pa'i gong srin yul laṅka pu ri zhes pa na smad 'tshong ma kun tu rgyu la lha bdud btsan gsum bsdongs nas bshos pa'i bu yi dwags kyi 'gro bas bsdus pa'i srin po bya'i gshog pa can mgo gsum gshog pa drug yod pa zhig skyes ma thag nas nad mug sogs bkra mi shis pa'i ltas ngan bsam gyis mi khyab pas yul khams thams cad nad mug sogs kyis phung zhing stong la khad du song*/ zla ba dgu nas ma shi ba'i ro de dang lhan cig tu dur khrod du bskyal bas zas su ro zos gos su ro gos gyon pas gzugs khams kyi 'bras bu che ba man chad 'jig rten na gang che bar grags pa thams cad ma lus par dbang du bsgyur zhing pho mthong thams cad bsad mo mthong thams cad chung mar bkol nas dur khrod chas brgyad kyi rgyan cha rang byung du grub pa'i yi dwags srin po chen po'i gzugs su skyes nas gzugs khams gnas ris bcu bdun man chad dbang du byas shing gdug pa can mtha' dag bran du bkol bas 'jig rten stong la khad kyi dus su sngon gyi dam tshig gis 'brel ba'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dang phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad tshad med pa'i snying rje chen pos kun nas ma bzod nas bka' bgros te/ dbang chen rta phag yab yum gyis 'dul ba'i dus la bab par bskul ba bzhin de nyid kyis rdo rje khro bo'i sprin tshogs dang bcas pas dur khrod kyi bdag po ma traṃ ru tra bsgral zhing rnam shes gnas spar te gcer bu byang thang du lhung ba bzhin du gyur pa'i tshe na sngar gyi las la gnong 'gyod tshad med pa skyes te smre ngag gdung 'bod yus kyis bshags pas dam tshig nyams chag thams cad lhag ma med par byang zhing sor chud nas/

sangs rgyas stong gi bstan pa skyong ba'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma'i gtso bo legs ldan tshogs kyi bdag por dbang bskur nas ma 'ongs thal bas khebs pa'i zhing du/ bcom ldan 'das thal ba'i dbang po zhes bya bar 'tshang rgya bar lung bstan/ slad kyi 'khor bdud kyi bu mo myos byed ma la sogs pa rnams las kau rī ma brgyad/ singha ma brgyad/ stag gdong sgo ma bzhi sogs su sprul 'khor gyi yi dwags chen po gdug pa can rnams dang dbang phyug nyer brgyad sogs dbang du bsdus shing bran du byas/ dkyil 'khor skyong ba'i srung mar bskos/ ru tra'i phung po mgo bo yan lag dang nying lag rnams dum bu brgyad du bgos nas 'dzam bu'i gling du bor ba las yul chen po brgyad dang*/ dur khrod chen po brgyad du byin brlabs nas skal ldan rnams nyams rtogs spel/ skal med rnams tshar gcod pa'i gnas su gyur pa de dag sngon byung ston pa'i rnam thar te/ rjes 'jug gdul bya'i nyams len la 'jug phyir bsgral chog la 'jug pa 'di'ang sngon dpal chen po'i rnam thar gyi rjes su 'jug par 'gyur ba'i dgos pa dang*/ khams gsum gyi 'byung po'i gtso bo dbang phyug chen po bsgral bas de'i bran du gyur pa'i bgegs phran rnams kyis 'tshe ba'i bsam sbyor rang shugs su zhi bas bar chad mi nus pa dang*/ de'i khog pa dur khrod chen po'i gzhal yas su byin gyis brlabs pa la ḍāk+ki dam can rnams rang bzhin gyis 'du bas bar chad thams cad zhi zhing bkra shis shing byin chags pas dngos grub rnam gnyis 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba 'di dgos pa dang ldan pa'o/ btags pa ming gi ru tra ni/ nang gi rtsa mdud grol zhing gsang ba'i 'og min tu bdud bzhi bcom nas mngon byang lnga yis 'tshang rgya ba'i rten 'brel khyad par can 'grigs pa ste/ de lta bu'i las rim la 'jug pa ni/ rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud las/

srid gsum gdug cing gtum pa la/ /zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur te/ /shes rab thabs kyi ngo bo las/ khro bo de bzhin gshegs sprul mdzad/ ces pa ltar chos nyid ngang gi khro bo/ rang rig ye shes kyi khro bo/ thugs rje shugs kyi khro bo/ phrin las phyag rgya'i khro bo dang bzhi yod pa las/ da lam phrin las phyag rgya'i khro bo nyid dang dpal chen rngam brjid kyi cha byad ltar 'dul ba'i khro bar bcos pa ste/ rgyud las/ khro bo'i tshul can khros pa yis/ /'jig rten gsum dag sreg byed na/ /sangs rgyas thugs rje khros pa yis/ khams gsum ma lus smos ci dgos/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lta ba chos nyid kyi rdzong*/ sgom pa ting 'dzin gyi 'phrang*/ spyod pa snying rje chen po'i ngar dang ldan pas/ bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba gyad kyi lha de nyid gnyen po ting nge 'dzin gyi lha dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i phyag rgya'i gsal snang dang ldan pa'i ngang nas bdag tu lta ba'i ngo bo ma traṃ bkug cing bsgral te khog pa gzhal yas khang du byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang du 'jug pa sogs gzhung gi tshig don rnams kyi bsgom don gsal 'debs pa'i ngang nas las rim la 'jug par zhu/ ༈ sgrub pa po rnams rang rang gi las skal du 'os bab dang bstun pa'i rang gnas su 'khod pa la de ltar du mnga' gsol ba'i skabs rdo rje rgyal tshab bam rgyal thebs kyis zhwa chos bcas gral gsham du bzhengs la/ deng bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan bye ba'i snang ba gsar du 'char ba'i dus 'dir skabs su bab pa ste/ de'ang gsang ba yongs rdzogs chen po'i rgyud las/ rgyud don gsang ba'i sgrub chen la/ /lnga ste phun tshogs gzhi bzung dang*/ /sta gon rim pa'i sgrom bu gzhug /dngos gzhi bsnyen sgrub gzhung bsrangs te/ /mtha' yi cho ga'i rjes bskyang ngo*/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phun sum tshogs pa lngas sgrub pa'i gzhi bting*/ sngon 'gro sta gon gyi cho gas sgrub pa sgrom du gzhug

/bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhis sgrub pa'i gzhung bsrang*/ las mtha' rgyas kyis sgrub pa'i rjes bskyang bar bya dgos pa'i nang nas dkyil 'khor bri zhing rgyan bkod yan chad sngon du song nas da lam sgrub pa po rnams 'os bab dang bstun pa'i mnga' gsol ba'i skabs su bab pa ste/ de yang sbyang gzhi 'gro ba thams cad rang bzhin lha'i dkyil 'khor du gnas kyang*/ sbyang bya gnyis 'dzin chags sdang gi rnam pa bral bya'i tshul du bsgribs pa nyid/ sbyong byed gyi cho ga rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde/ de la'ang phyi nang gnyis las nang rgyud gsang chen yo ga gsum du gyur pa de la/ ring brgyud bka' ma nye brgyud gter ma gnyis kyi phyi ma/ rtsa gsum bka' 'dus dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rnam pa lam du byas pas/ sbyangs 'bras gdod nas bzhugs pa'i zung 'jug gi phyag rgya mngon du byed pa'i thabs khyad par can dang mthar thug gi theg pa gsang sngags bla med kyi bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i dgongs pa rjes su 'brel ba ltar phun sum tshogs pa lngas sgrub pa'i gzhi bzung dgos pas/ ༈ de la phyi yi gnas phun sum tshogs pa ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i zhabs kyis bcags shing*/ thub pa'i dbang po gang la sku bltams pa'i lum+bi ni sogs gnas dang*/ mchod rten go ma sa la sogs rten dang*/ lhun grub brtsegs pa sogs dur khrod bkod pa yongs su tshang la khyad par du ma hā gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas yang dag bde gshegs snying po'i sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe bdud kyis bar chad brtsams pas rdo rje phur pa'i dam la bzhag cing de nyid du mchog gi rig 'dzin mngon du mdzad pa'i bal yul yang le shod kyi char srid pa'i lha klu che dgu bod khams brtan ma bcu gnyis sogs bka' dam gyis rtsis su phab cing srid pa gsum du nyi zla ltar grags par gyur ba'i a su ra rang byung rdo rje'i ke'u tshang zhes dpal he ru ka'i pho brang dang mi gnyis pa de nyid dang*/

myur ma dpa' mo'i dgyes zhal gyi re khā bkra ba'i sgrol ma rang byung sogs dang 'dab 'brel ba'i/ gnam lcags sgrub sde gsang sngags phur pa gling zhes sam/ yang na g.yu lo bkod rje btsun gling zhes byin che la/ las bzhi sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen 'dzoms pas bkra shis dge ba'i gnas/ lhun grub yid 'ong gi gnas/ 'phral rkyen sgrub pa'i gnas rnams kyi mtshan nyid kun ldan du/ nang gi gnas phyi nang snod bcud rang lus dang bcas pas gdod nas gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha yi 'khor lo'i rnam par dag pa yin par shes pas dag mnyam bden pa dbyer med lha'i rang bzhin du shes pa dang*/ gsang ba'i gnas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad chos nyid de kho na nyid du lhun gyis grub pa'i ngang na gnas kyang chos kyi dbyings 'gyur ba med pa'i klong du gnas par rtogs pa dang*/ ༈ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa ni/ lam rim las/ ston pa mdzod ldan chu bo rdzogs/ /gnyer ldan rgyud dang las la mkhas/ /man ngag drod 'dzin brgyad 'chang ba/ /rnal 'byor mtha' ldan shin tu brtan/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rab lta ba'i gdeng gis 'khor 'das mnyam nyid du rtogs pa/ sgom pa'i rtsal gyis snang srid dag pa rab 'byams su shar ba/ spyod pa'i rlabs kyis cir snang chos nyid kyi lam du lhong zhing de nyid bcu dang ldan pa'o/ tha na dbang lung man ngag gis rgyud brlan cing brgyud pa'i byin rlabs kyi bag dang ldan pa/ theg pa che chung gi don shes pa cho ga'i phyag len mkhas shing bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad bsrangs ba/ bsnyen sgrub kyi drod rtags thon pa gzhan phan gyi snying rje che ba/ dag snang phyogs med dang ldan pa/ dad ldan slob ma rnams skyong mkhas pa sogs yon tan gyis rgyud phyug pa/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i mgon dang dpung gnyen du gyur pa don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na zhes bya ba dang*/ ༈ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa ni rgyud las/

ston pa mchog brtson rtogs pa gsal/ /dam tshig sngags dang phyag rgya rnams/ /ma nyams shes shing yon tan ldan/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ bde chen rgyud la bskyed pa'i gzungs ma lus ngag yid gsum mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ rigs lnga'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i 'khor rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las kyi gtso bo bzhi yum dang bcas pa/ don gnyis phrin las sgrub pa'i 'khor rgyal thebs kyi ston pa bzhi/ bar chad dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i 'khor rdo rje spyan pa/ rdo rje mtshams pa ging dang bcas pa/ mchod pa'i zhal zas sbyor ba'i 'khor rdo rje drod 'dzin/ byan pho byan mo dang bcas pa/ dad 'dus thugs rjes bzung ba'i 'khor rdo rje'i mched dang lcam dral/ phyi nang brda sbyor byed pa'i 'khor rdul phyags skyes bu ste/ thams cad kyang bsags pa sngon du song ba'i skal ba can/ nga rgyal dang phrag dog chung zhing dad pa chen pos dkar po chos la 'jug nus pa/ mos gus chen pos bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong ba/ dbang bzhi thob pas man ngag gi snod du rung ba/ dam tshig che bas sgrub pa'i gzhi 'ding ba/ shes rab che bas nges pa'i don go nus pa'i sngon sbyangs kyi skal ba bzang po can no/ ༈ dus phun sum tshogs pa ni/ thog mtha' dbus med dus bzhi mnyam pa chen po'i ngang las tha dad du 'gyur ba med kyang*/ rtog pa ma zad bar rten 'brel gyi tshul yang mi bslu bar 'byung ba chos nyid yin pa'i tshul/ rgyud rngam klong las/ rig byed dag gi yan lag las/ /dus rnams shes par bya ba ni/ /bkra shis lha yi nyi ma dang*/ /sbyor dang dus tshod bzang ba ni/ /mtshan ma'i rtogs pa yin mod kyang*/ /brtags na dngos grub mtshan ma 'byung*/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skabs 'dir dus khyad par can ni/

bod zla dang po la mtshon na/ gdul bya'i snang ngor bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med don kun grub pa/ 'phags pa'i yul mnyan yod kyi tshal du mnyam par bzhag pas byang chub kyi go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa la/ ma bzod nas bdud dmag bye ba phrag khrig gis dpung chen g.yos nas gnam sa g.yo ba'i ngar sgra dang me chu thog ser mtshon cha'i char phab pa rnams/ ci mi snyam pas byams pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis lhag med du bcom nas gdug pa'i mtshon char me tog gi char dang mchod pa'i sprin du bsgyur te bdud sde rnams ngo tsha kha skyengs pa'i gnas su dpa' bkong ba'i ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul chen po'i mdzad pa bstan pa'i dus tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar dang*/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pas o rgyan gyi rgyal srid kyang snying po med par gzigs nas mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin du spangs shing dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad dbang du bsdus nas grub pa chen po'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs te gzhan don rlabs chen mdzad pa'i dus chen tshes bcu sogs dus 'dzoms pa'i dbo zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes pa brgyad nas bco lnga'i bar te gza' skar 'phrod sbyor sogs dus tshes dge zhing shis par/ sogs kha bsgyur/ zla ba dgu pa la dpes mtshon na/ gdul bya'i snang ngor bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med don kun grub pas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha yul du yum la drin lan bsab pa'i mdo gsungs nas slar yang 'dzam bu gling gi skye dgu'i bsod nams kyi zhing du rdzu 'phrul gyis babs pa dang*/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pas bal yul yang le shod du thugs dam yang phur gyi sgo nas phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin mngon du mdzad de dus chen tha skar zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bcur gza' skar sbyor byed sogs lta bu kha bsgyur/ dus tshes dge zhing shis par/

༈ yo byad phun sum tshogs pa ni/ lam rim las/ gos rgyan bza' btung gsang ba dang*/ /sgrub pa'i yo byad lnga rnams dang*/ /dkyil 'khor yo byad mchod pa'i rdzas/ /dngos grub rten dang bar chad zlog /yo byad dag par bsdu bya ste/ gsungs pa bzhin 'tsho ba zas/ nad zlog sman/ dgra zlog mtshon sogs phyi'i yo byad/ rten rdzas/ sgrub rdzas/ rgyan rdzas/ mchod rdzas/ dbang gi rdzas te nang gi yo byad/ ta na ga na/ shes rab snying rje ste gsang ba'i yo byad du bshad pa spyi dang*/ pho brang nang rten thun mong ma yin pa/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ spros bcas rten sgrub pa'i mchod rdzas ma tshang ba med par 'du byas/ dkyil 'khor gyi ri mo bkra yal le/ snang gsal gyi mar me 'od lhag ge /bdug spos kyi dri bzang ngad thul le/ rdo rje'i mched lcam spro dga' dang byin rlabs thibs se 'du ba'i skabs 'dir ston pa rdo rje slob dpon nyid bskyed rdzogs kyi dgongs pa mdzad cing zab mo'i don ston te rnal 'byor yongs kyi dpal mgon du 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su rdo rje'i khri chen po la bzhugs par gsol/ rigs bzhi'i bskyed rdzogs dang dzap bsnyen bgrang ba'i rgyal tshab chen po bzhi phyogs bzhi/ yab kyi dgongs pa dang bstun zhing sbyor ba'i sgyu rtsal shes pa'i gzungs ma kun tu bzang mo rnams yab kyi g.yon tu/ chos 'chad pa'i rdo rje rgyal thebs/ dngos grub kyi rdzas ster ba'i rin chen rgyal thebs/ dbang bskur ba'i bya ba byed pa dbang gi rgyal thebs/ phrin las kyi gzhung bsrang ba las kyi rgyal thebs rnams kyang phyogs bzhi/ phyi nang bar chad srung ba'i brtul zhugs can rdo rje mtshams pa nub byang*/ sgrol ba'i las dang brda la mkhas pa rdo rje'i king ka ra rnams lho nub/ g.yo sgyu med par mi ma yin mthong zhing nyul le'i bar chad bzlog nus pa'i mig rnon rdo rje spyan pa dang*/ dus sbyor dbyug gu sogs la mkhas shing phrin las kyi skabs phyed pa rdo rje drod 'dzin pa gnyis byang shar/

bag ldan gtsang sbra che zhing rnam smin la 'dzem pa'i rdo rje byan pho byan mo dang*/ nga rgyal med cing bka' bzhin sri zhu la brtson pa'i rdo rje rdul phyags pa rnams shar lho/ mched lcam snod dang ldan pa rin po che lta bu'i gang zag rnams kyang gral gyi bar du bzhugs te/ thams cad kyang chos spyod la brtson 'grus chung ba lus kyi skyon dang*/ smra ba mang zhing bzlas pa la mi brtson pa ngag gi skyon dang*/ zhe sdang che zhing byams pa chung ba yid kyi skyon dang*/ brjed nges che zhing bag zon chung ba dam tshig gi skyon dang*/ chang la dga' zhing gnyid che ba ting nge 'dzin gyi skyon dang*/ g.yeng ba la dga' zhing bsgom sgrub la skyo ba dad pa'i skyon te drug po rnam pa thams cad du spang zhing*/ rtogs pa che bas chos nyid dang mi phyed pa/ dad gus che bas bla ma dang mi phyed pa/ dam tshig che bas yi dam dang mi phyed pa/ brtse gdung che bas mched lcam dang mi phyed pa/ brtul zhugs che bas dam rdzas dang mi phyed pa/ sbyor sgrol brtson pas gzungs ma dang mi phyed pa/ snying rje che bas sems can dang mi phyed pa/ ting nge 'dzin gsal bas dngos grub dang mi phyed pa/ skyon dang bral bas 'bras bu sangs rgyas dang mi phyed pa ste yon tan dgu po la rnam pa kun tu brtson zhing*/ gzhan yang rtsa rgyud las/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi ston pa dang : da lta sangs rgyas 'di dag la: tha dad du ni cung min brtag: rdo rje gsang ba'i grogs dag kyang : de dang rjes su mthun par blta: sgo gsum gus pas brtson bya zhing : dam pa'i tshig las 'da' mi bya: zhes so/ ༈ chaus phun sum tshogs pa ni/ 'o skol gyi ston pa skal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de nyid kyis gdul bya mtha' yas pa'i khams dbang po bsam pa dang mtshungs pa'i chos kyi sgo 'phar grangs med par phyes pa thams cad mdor bsdus na theg pa rnam pa gsum dang*/

de dag kyang rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa gnyis su 'du ba yin te/ kun byed rgyal po las/ theg pa rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /mtshan nyid rgyu yi theg pa dang*/ /'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa'o/ zhes theg pa'i 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa de la'ang dbye na/ rgyud sde bzhir dbye ba las 'di ni rnal 'byor bla na med pa nang rgyud yo ga gsum zhes che ba drug gis khyad par du 'phags pa'i snga 'gyur rnying ma'i phyogs su gtogs shing de la'ang ring brgyud bka' ma/ nye brgyud gter ma zab mo dag snang gi bab so chen po gsum du mchis pa'i nang tshan/ brgyud thag nye zhing dam sel gyis ma bslad pa'i byin rlabs tshan kha che ba sogs khyad par byas pa'i zab mo gter gyi phyogs su gtogs la/ o rgyan gling pa'i gter lung las/ de nyid mi gnas mya ngan 'das 'og tu: chos log khrims ral dam nyams lung pa gang : lha mi'i gnas su gtam ngan grags pas khyab: sha 'ug stag sgor sbas pa'i gter kha 'di: mi bzhag 'don pa'i rtag de bstan nas su: o rgyan gter bdag gling pa zhes su 'byung : zhes gsungs pa ltar ma hā gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas dang gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes zung gi rnam 'phrul sprul pa'i skyes mchog pad+ma gter bdag gling pa'am/ rig 'dzin gar gyi dbang phyug gnam lcags rdo rje sogs gsang mtshan dgu dang ldan pa de nyid la zab gter bdun cu don lnga'i bgo skal du bzhugs pa'i nang gses bla rdzogs thugs gsum las 'di ni thugs sgrub kyi skor du gtogs la/ de yang rang gzhung ka tho rin chen phreng ba las/ lha sras rje 'bangs la gnang ba'i zhal gdams las/ mnga' bdag rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis: za hor rig 'dzin pad+ma spyan drangs nas: brag dmar dpal gyi bsam yas pho brang bzhengs: bder 'dus bka' 'dus chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: las can skal ldan rje 'bangs smin par mdzad: bod la mdo sngags bstan pa'i nyi ma shar:

bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis sems can smin par mdzad: lung rigs gnyis kyis theg chen chos sgra sgrogs: 'chad rtsod rtsom pas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs: rtsod bzlog nga ros mu stegs mtha' ru spyugs: rim gnyis spobs pas bstan pa'i srog shing btsugs: rgya chen rgyun mi 'chad pa'i gter kha sbas: snyan brgyud rgya mtsho gangs can ljongs su 'khyil: bstan pa'i sa gnad mi 'jig me btsa' bsdams: mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gtsug lag chos 'khor bzhengs: 'di phyi bod 'bangs skyob pa'i zhal gdams bkod: man ngag rin chen phreng ba'i tshom bu bkram: gsang sngags bstan pa mtha' ru rgyas par mdzad: rje la zhus pas bka' gnang gegs med grub: de nas lha sras mu khri btsan po dang : rje 'bangs rgya mtsho bka' yi 'bangs bcas nas: bsam yas dam pa'i rgya mkhar rtse dgu'i mdun: pho brang dbu rtse rigs gsum dag la ni: ma 'ongs lung bstan zhus pa snga ma dang : mchims phur bder 'dus skor gsum bar pa'i skabs: phyi ma khra 'brug bka' 'dus zhal phyes tshe: zhus lan zhal gdams le'u bdun ma dang : snga phyi thams cad bkra shis mtha' rten du: rje 'bangs rgyal blon dgongs pa rdzogs pa yi: smon lam bsam pa lhun 'grub rgyab chos bzhag: zhal gdams gsol 'debs phyogs gcig bsgrigs nas su: bskyed rdzogs gnyis bcas lag len gdams pa gnang : man ngag bcu gsum ngo sprod rnam lnga bzhag: de'ang ma 'ongs bod 'bangs la dmigs nas: zhal gdams skor rnams bzhed don so so ltar: rin chen gter kha rnams la bkram ste sbas: kha byang yang byang rje 'bangs nyer lngar gtad: ma 'ongs lung byang gung thang la thog tu: lha sras mu khri btsan pos dbu mdzad pa: jo mo mtsho rgyal thugs sras bu lnga la: mi brjed dran pa'i smon lam dang bcas gnang : zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ chos rgyal khri srong sogs las can dag pa'i 'khor rnams la thog mar bsam yas dbu rtse rim gsum sogs bde gshegs bka' 'dus chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/

bar du mchims phu'i brag dmar ke tshang du thugs sras snying gi bu dgu la bder 'dus skor gsum gyi smin grol phog cing zhal gdams stsal/ tha ma khra 'brug tu lha sras rje 'bangs thugs kyi bu lnga la bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i smin grol zhus len zhal gdams bcas mang du stsal/ snga phyi thams cad kyi mtha' rten du rgyab chos bsam pa lhun 'grub ma zhal gdams man ngag bcu gsum sogs rgyas par bka' stsal/ 'on kyang da lta spel ba'i dus min par bstan pa'ang de nyid las/ da lta spel ba'i dus min yig ger gdab: nam zhig srin yul gdul zhing bgrod pa'i lam: mang yul gung thang la kha bya ba ru: bal bod mtshams der sleb dus khyod la gtad: gdams pa shog dril rje yi thugs dam mdzod: snyan brgyud dbyangs can brda yi ri mor zung : da lta'i rje 'bangs rnams kyis smon lam thob: dge bsnyen shan+ta pu ris gter srung gyis: mchims phu brag btsan thig le gnyer du bskos: zhes gsungs pa bzhin phyis gu ru gung thang la thog tu lha sras mchog dang skyel len gyi tshul du gnang*/ ma 'ongs rje 'bangs rnams kyi don du zab gter du bzhag dgos pa'i bka' stsal bzhin/ gter kha khag tu bkram nas sbas pa'i dus rtags lung bstan dang mthun par sprul pa'i gter chen rnams kyis rim bzhin 'byin par gsungs pa yang*/ 'di nyid 'byin pa'i dus dang sa rtags ni/ sum cu kha dar nyi shu'i dus dang mtshungs: khyad par 'di nas gdung rab mi ring bar: rnam smin bskyed rgyal phyogs dang phyogs nas 'byung : lo skor dus dang zla zhag so so ru: gdams pa 'di nyid nye bar mkho ba 'byung : de dus lha sras skye ba rim brgyud dang : da lta'i rje 'bangs grogs lngas rim par 'byin: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ yar rje o rgyan gling pa sogs sprul pa'i gter chen du mar bka' babs 'ga' zhig gnas dus rten 'brel skal bas phongs nas phyis yang gter dang dgongs gter sogs su 'phos pa yang byung ngo*/
