de dag las khyad par gyur pa 'di nyid ni zhal gdams las/ dam chos don chen yang snying 'dus pa yi: bka' yi them byang 'gag tu 'dril ba 'di: 'byin pa'i sa rtags dbus yul bdud kyis 'dzin: sa steng g.yo ba'i mtha' dmag dbus su 'khrigs: bsam yas rta mgrin mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs: jo shāka mdun du khrag gi rlangs pa 'khrigs: gtsug lag sgrub gnas bshig nas sil bur 'thor: byang sems skyes bu mang po gri ru 'chi: bdud sprul sde dpon mang po snying khrag 'pho: chos spyod sde pa mang po dmangs su 'bebs: dmag 'khrug nad yams mi lo bco brgyad 'byung : bdud kyis ma bslus chos byed nyin skar tsam: me chu rlung gsum 'khrugs pa'i na bun bzhin: phyi dang nang med dbyar sos rlan ltar 'brub: de dus nga nyid sku yi sprul pa'i cha: lo tsā sangs rgyas ye shes khyod la gdams: gsung sprul bai ro tsa na khyod la gdams: thugs sprul lha sras rje bo khyod la gdams: yon tan rdo rje bdud 'joms khyod la gdams: phrin las dbang gi mtsho rgyal khyod la gdams: shog dril sgrub khog lnga ru bgyid nas su: sku tshab gter lnga dbang ba'i bu la bzhag: ma 'ongs skal ldan grogs lnga snga phyi ru: rten 'brel dus las ma 'das 'phrad par shog: khyad par rtsod ldan snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus: sangs rgyas ye shes skye ba rtags rgya can: las can skyes bu de yis 'byin par 'gyur: zhes dang*/ sa steng thon pa tsam gyis sgom sgrub dang : spel sbyong 'dzin 'chang klog la nan tan gyis: thugs rjes skyob nges the tshom bor la sgrubs: pad 'byung nga ni sems can don las med: 'di phyi don yod nga phyir 'jug rlom na: nyin mtshan dus drug nga la gsol ba thob: dad ldan mdun du nga nyid sprul pa re: mos gus can la sgo nyal lta bu yod: khyad par tshes bcu'i dus su mngon sum mjal: gsol btab rab gnas thebs rnams dag zhing bgrod:

rnga yab gling du bdag mjal the tshom med: lhag par sems can sdug bsngal nyam thag tshe: blo yi gzu dpang nga nyid gzu bor zhog: 'di yi go rim yi ge 'phrin pa bcas: skal ldan kun gyi rna bar sim par gyis: zhes sogs zab chos 'di nyid gu ru'i thugs dam mthar thug yin pa'i zhal gdams bka' gtad gnang ba ma zad 'di ni dbus gter zug pa rtsa ba lta bu'i chos sde te/ sngar gu ru bod du byon nas bod kyi lha srin ma rungs pa rnams dam la btags/ bsam yas rten dang brten pa rab gnas dang bcas pa legs par grub nas slar rgya gar la phebs par bzhed pa'i tshe rgyal pos gsang sngags gsungs par zhus pa'i tshe/ da dung yang mthun rkyen ma tshang bar gsungs pas rgyal srid mtsho rgyal dang bcas pa ltos med du phul nas gsol ba btab pas zhal gyis bzhes nas gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol gyi chu bo thog mar gang las bab pa'i yul bod kyi rdo rje gdan zhes dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang dang 'brel ba'i dbus yul bsam yas mchims phu'i brag dmar ke'u tshang zhes bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang chen po rang byung rdo rje'i brag la bder 'dus dkyil 'khor gyi re khā bkra lam mer gsal ba'i gangs can sgrub gnas yongs kyi rgyal po ga la ba der/ rje 'bangs snying gi bu dgu bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du smin grol gyi lam la bkod cing*/ slar gnas mchog de nyid du gu ru yab yum gyis skad cig mig 'phrul ltar mi snang bar rgya yis gdams pa mdzad pa'i sku tshab mthong grol/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi chos sman/ thugs sgrub bde gshegs 'dus pa rtsa ba dang yan lag zhal gdams bcu gsum las phran dang bcas pa/ bod rab byung bcu gnyis sa khyi lor phyi nang gi 'byin pa'i rtags rnams mngon du gyur ba'i skabs/ ngo mtshar ba'i sgyu 'phrul du ma dang bcas khrom gter du bzhes nas/

zab gter chos bdag rnams la smin grol chig rdzogs su bstsal bar mdzad pas/ 'di ni gter gzhung rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las rgyas pa dkyil 'khor bcu gsum gyi dgongs pa ji bzhin gtan la phab ste/ bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa ba'i phrin las 'bring po dkyil 'khor lnga pa'i las byang nas kyang mi 'gal bar brgyan te spyi dril gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun 'grub ma'i las byang chog khrigs ye shes sprin phung zhes/ srid 'dir 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral ba 'di nyid chos kyi bdag po o rgyan rog rje gling pa'am rig 'dzin chen po hūm̐ chen 'gro 'dul/ rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje sogs mtshan du mar bsngags pa de nyid kyis rang nyid rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa rnams kyis tshes bcu'i dus mchod sogs nyams bzhes kyi slad du bka' yi bsdu ba mdzad nas rgya cher spel bas/ lam de nyid brten nas thugs sras rig 'dzin bzhi sogs mchog thun dngos grub thob pa grangs las 'das pa byung ba yin te/ de yang kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa ḍāk+ki'i gsang gtam chen mor/ sprel lo sprel zla'i tshes bcu'i nyin pad+ma 'od gling sin+dhu rgya mtsho'i zhing khams bkod par phyi nang gi mchod pa gzab rgyas dang bcas bdag cag 'dus par bcas pas man ngag bcu gsum spyi dril gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun grub ma'i sgo nas tshes bcu'i cho ga bstar ba las/ spyan 'dren gyi tshe mos gus bla na med pas rkyen byas dpal o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po mtshan dpe'i lang tsho blta bas chog mi shes pa dpa' bo mkha' 'gro til gyi gang bu ltar 'khrigs pa'i klong nas rdo rje'i gar stabs srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i rang bzhin du sgyur zhing*/ man+da ra ba'i me tog gi sil ma kun tu 'thor ba'i ngang tshul can chu bur mig gis spyod yul du gyur pas mos gus kyis brgyal ba tsam gyi ngang nas skal ba bzang po'i dge mtshan ci yang thob bo/

zhes gsungs pa bzhin thugs gter gyi klong chen po brdol bas mtshon 'brel tshad don dang ldan par gyur/ de ltar zab gsang chos kyi bdag po o rgyan rog rje gling pa dang*/ rwa ston stobs rdo rje/ o rgyan dri med gling pa/ rtsa nang gter chen/ lcags zam mchog sprul bdun pa bstan 'dzin ye shes lhun grub/ sngags btsun kun dga' blo gros/ o rgyan 'gro 'dul gling pa nas rim par 'khor lo'i mgon po sūr+ya rasmi'i bar byin rlabs kyi tshan kha ma nyams/ dam sel gyi g.ya' dris ma gos/ dngos grub kyi char rgyun ma chad/ nyams myong gi rtags tshad ma yal/ ma dang mkha' 'gro'i khu rlangs thul le ba rig pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis 'chad spel gyi sgo nas 'gro don dpag med mdzad cing*/ 'o skol rnams kyi bsod nams tshogs gnyis kyi rgya mtsho spel ba'i rgyan du gyur pa gzhung rtsa ba la dbyangs rol cho ga'i las 'grigs bsham bkod sogs so zur gnubs gsum gyi phyag bzhes ma nyams par grags pa'i o rgyan smin grol gling gi bka' srol gyis brgyan na/ byin rlabs kyi bka' bab cing 'brel shin tu che ba nyid de/ rgyud rgyal gsang ba snying po las/ gnas dang longs spyod ci bde dang*/ /ma nyams blo ni rab ldan pa'i/ /le lo sgyid snyoms med pa yis/ /the tshom med par bsgrubs byas na/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i gsang mchog dam pa thob/ ces gsungs pa ltar gzhung las ji skad 'byung ba thams cad legs par bsags te/ gzhi mchod dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan bkod bkra lam me/ snang gsal mar me'i phreng ba rnams 'od phung nge*/ dri zhim spos kyi ngad pa bzang chil le/ dzap bzlas sngags kyi snyan dbyangs de 'ur dir re/ gdangs dbyangs rnga rol 'bud dkrol snyan lhang nge*/ dkyil 'khor lha yi gsal snang khra spungs se/ rdo rje'i mched lcam rnams thugs mthun dam gtsang byin thibs se bzhugs pa'i skabs 'dir/

brgyud pa'i bka' bab 'dzin cing yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i ston pa rdo rje rgyal po nyid 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i mgon du bzhugs par/ zab mo'i don ston cing g.yo med chos nyid kyi dgongs pas byin gyis rlabs par zhu/ de nyid la lta sgom mnyam zhing dkyil 'khor gyi las rab 'byams sgrub par nus pa'i rdo rje rgyal tshab/ gtso bo'i dgongs pa skong zhing tan gan gyi sgyu rtsal la mkhas pa'i gzungs ma/ las bzhi'i phrin las dang lta spyod la dbang ba'i rgyal thebs rigs bzhi ni/ chos 'chad spel dang gdams pa'i gnad dkrol mkhan rdo rje rgyal thebs/ dngos grub kyi rdzas ster ba'i rin chen rgyal thebs/ dbang bskur sbyin sreg gi las byed pa dbang gi rgyal thebs/ phrin las kyi gzhung bsrang ba las kyi rgyal thebs/ cho ga'i bya ba la mkhas shing dbyangs dang rol mo'i byang 'dren pa rdo rje las pa/ dus tshod bcu gnyis kyi nyul le bskrad gzir dang tshar gcod pa la dbang ba'i rdo rje ging chen dang ging chung*/ sgab 'dre mnan zhing phyi nang gi bar chad bzlog pa'i rdo rje mtshams pa/ mig mthong mngon shes kyis legs nyes kyi lung ston nus pa'i rdo rje spyan pa/ dus drug gi thun tshod bzung nas phrin las kyi skabs phyed pa rdo rje drod 'dzin te dus mtshams pa/ gtsang sbra che zhing mchod pa'i las khrig la mkhas pa las kyi rdo rje/ phyi nang gi brda sprod cing kun gyi bka' rnams sgrub pa'i rdo rje bya rogs/ bag ldan gtsang sbra che zhing g.yo gtsang bskol ba dang bza' btung 'dren pa la mkhas pa'i rdo rje'i byan pho mo/ yo byad la mkhas shing mched lcam tshogs su 'du ba'i phyag tshang ste tshogs gnyer chen po/ dkyil 'khor gzhal yas sogs la byi dor dang gtsang sbra mkhas shing nga rgyal med cing bka' bzhin sri zhu la brtson pa'i rdo rje rdul phyags pa/ lha sngags ting 'dzin dang bsnyen sgrub kyi bya ba la brtson pa'i rdo rje'i mched lcam 'khor lo'i tshogs rnams thams cad rang dang go rim la mthun pa'i gral la bzhugs shing*/

rang rang gnyer du gtad pa'i bya ba thams cad lta dgongs ting 'dzin gyi ngang nas bka' gsang chen po'i gzhung dang mthun par g.yel ba med pa'i thugs khur bzhes snyam pa'i ngang nas 'di yi rjes zlos gnang bar zhu/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas gdung 'tshob rdo rje rgyal po 'di: sku gsung thugs dang?gsol dgyes par bzhugs:

bar brjod/ ༈ dpal gyi rtags gdab pa'i skabs su/ 'dir 'dus pa'i rig 'dzin sgrub pa po rnams don gyi dag pa sbyar bas lha dang gnyis su med par rtogs pa dang*/ rtags kyi phyag rgya bcings pas mkha' 'gro dam can pho mo rnams kyis sgrub pa por shes pa dang*/ bar chad kyis mi tshugs shing thabs kyi theg pa'i rigs su nges pa'i 'bras bu myur du 'grub pa sogs dgos pa du ma dang ldan pa'i he ru ka rol pa chen po'i chas su 'jug pa'i skabs su bab pa ste/ che mchog 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ ma 'ongs dus na skyes bu dag: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun ngo bo: sku gsum phrin las che ba'i mchog: kun tu bzang po kun gyi bdag: he ru ka yi tshul 'chang ba: brtul zhugs bzang po de la ni: ma rig log par lta ba'i tshogs: bdud bzhi'i phyogs su gtogs rnams kyis: 'tshe zhing bar du gcod pa'am: gdug cing 'da' bar nus ma yin: zhes gsungs/ de yang rtags phyag rgya'i dbang du byas na/ sngon dpal chen pos yi dwags kyi gtso bo dur khrod bdag po brtul zhing de'i chas rnams dpa' ba'i rtags su bzhes pa las byung ba/ ru tra sde gsum bsgral bas tshar gsum gyi phreng ba/ ru tra'i chung ma ma chags thabs kyis rol pas dbang du bsdus pa rak+ta'i thig le/ tshangs pa chen po bsgral ba zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi/ brgya byin dang de'i bzhon pa glang po che btul ba glang chen gyi ko rlon/ gza' chen nyi ma'i bu mo stag gdong spyan gcig ma btul ba stag gi sham thabs/ klu gdug pa can btul ba sbrul nag gi chun pa/ srin mo nyer bzhi btul ba thal chen gyi tshom bu/ dbang mo nyer brgyad dbang du bsdus pa zhag gi zo ris la sogs pa byung ba yin zhing*/ brda yi dag sbyor gyi don ni/ ye shes lnga po don dam spros bral gyi dbyings su gcig pas thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan rgyu ma'i khong seng gis sbrel ba/ thugs rje ci yang 'byung ba bzhi yis 'gro don mdzad pa'i glang ko

/phyin ci log bzhi dang bral ba'i sbrul chun/ phrin las rnam pa bzhi dang tshad med bzhi lhun la rdzogs pa'i g.yang gzhi/ khams gsum rtog pa 'joms pa'i stag sham/ ma rig rnam rtog gi bud shing ye shes chen po'i dbyings su sbyangs pa'i me dpung*/ dug lnga dbang du sdud pa'i khrag chen gyi thig le/ rgyud drug 'khor ba'i bcud tshogs gnyis kyi gsos su blang ba zhag chen gyi zo ris/ skye shi rtsad nas gcod pa thal chen gyi tshom bu/ dug gsum sku gsum du rdzogs pa thod phreng tshar gsum/ stong pa nyid la bdud bzhi bskyod du med pa'i rdo rje'i go khrab bcas dpal gyi chas bcu ste/ rang rang gi rigs dang mthun par dpal pad+ma he ru ka'-i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i gsal snang dang snyems pas dpal gyi chas rnams mnga' gsol du bzhes shing*/ don gyi dag dran dang ldan par dug lnga rtsad nas gcod/ stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang ldan/ ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad la dbang bskur/ gdug pa can zil gyis mnan/ yi ge 'khor lo tshogs chen gyi sa la mnga' mdzad pa rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho rnam 'phrul bcu gsum ye shes lha'i tshom bu'i dgongs pa las g.yel ba med pa'i ngang nas 'di'i rjes zlos gnang bar zhu/ hrīḥ rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'bras bu'i lam zhugs pa: rtags kyi phyag rgya bder?dbang phyug chen po'i sku la rgyan du bzhes: bar brjod/ ༈ bsre bsnan gyi skabs su dam tshig bsgrags pa'i rjes/ slob dpon nam rgyal tshab pas/ 'o skal pa dang ldan pa'i rdo rje'i mched lcam rnams thugs ma yengs par snyan lhan ner gsan 'tshal/ de yang gsang sngags dbang gi mtha' can/ dbang dam tshig gi mtha' can zhes gsungs pa ltar rdo rje theg pa'i lam thog mtha' bar gsum dam tshig la brten nas bgrod dgos te/ a ti bkod pa'i rgyud las/ snga rabs 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*/ /dam tshig 'di la brten te byung*/

/da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*/ /dam tshig 'di la rab tu gnas/ /slad nas 'byon pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*/ /dam tshig 'di la rab tu bsgrub/ ces gsungs pa ltar dam tshig ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gshegs shul yin pas gces spras su bzung 'tshal te gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ dbang srog dam tshig rjes su bzung*/ /dbye na sa ya 'bum sde las/ /bsdu na nyi shu rtsa lnga ste/ /rtsa ba sku gsung thugs la 'du/ /nyams na rdo rje'i dmyal bar 'gro/ /de phyir mig 'bras lta bur bzung*/ /nyams na slar la bshags par bya/ zhes gsungs pa ltar smin byed kyi dbang sngon du nod cing dbang srog dam tshig la gnas pas grol byed kyi lam la 'jug dgos/ dam tshig ni srog gi dbang po dang mtshungs la/ lam gyi rim pa gzhan rnams dbang po yan lag gzhan dang mtshungs pas 'dir yang*/ sngags kyi dngos grub ma lus pa: dam tshig nyid la brten gyur kyang : zhes gsungs pas dam tshig kho na la gces spras su 'bad 'tshal/ dam tshig gi lha ni rdo rje sems dpa' yin te/ mnyam sbyor las/ sems can kun gyi sems gang zhig /rdo rje zhes ni rab tu brjod/ /rdo rje stong pa nyid du gnas/ /sems dpa' ye shes chen po ste/ zhes gzhi rdo rje sems dpa'i dam tshig mi phyed pa de nyid lam du ma nyams par ston par byed pa dang*/ nyams na bshags pa'i yul du grub la/ 'bras bu'ang de'i go 'phang grub pa spyi dpal chen po zhi ba'i skur bstan pa las gnyis su med de/ dam tshig gi bdag po dpal he ru ka ste dam las mi 'da' ba rnams la sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlabs/ yid la 'dod pa thams cad bstsal/ dam las 'das na snying dbus rdo rje gnod sbyin rab tu khros pas mi zad pa'i sdug bsngal bskyed par mdzad/ dam tshig gi srung ma phra men ma bcu drug /spyan pa dbang phyug nyer brgyad rnams kyis kyang legs nyes kyis stangs 'dzin cing dge sdig gi la shan 'byed pa yin pas mngon lkog dang le lo med par/

dran pa dang shes bzhin pa'i bag yod par bsrung dgos shing*/ gang bsrung bar bya ba ni sa ma ya 'bum sde gsungs pa'ang thun mong spyi'i dam tshig nyer brgyad/ sgrub pa khyad par gyi dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis rnams su 'dus te/ de yang rtsa ba sku'i dam tshig tu slob dpon rnam pa bzhi khong pa'i snying ltar btsa'/ rdo rje'i mched bzhi po lus dang mig ltar blta/ gsung gi dam tshig tu sngags kyi snying po lnga dang phyag brgya bzhi rgyun ma chad par nyams su len/ thugs kyi dam tshig tu spyi dang bar gsang gsang 'os gnyer du gtad pa'i gsang bcu sbas/ yan lag gi spyad bya/ mi spang ba/ dwang du blang ba/ shes bya/ bsgrub bya'i dam tshig lnga tshan lnga yal bar mi 'dor ba bsrung bas thun mong gi dam tshig rnam par dag khyad par gyi dam tshig nyer gcig ltem rkyang med par lha chos mi chos bka' chos gsum gyi sgo nas bsrung bas khyad par gyi dam tshig rnam par dag /'khor gsum byang chub sems kyi thig le nyag gcig las gud na med pas bsrung mtshams bral ba'i ye bsrungs chen por rtogs pa lta ba'i dam tshig thugs rje'i dpyang thag ldan pas dam tshig nyams su yang med cing*/ nyams pa'ang myur du 'chos par 'gyur ro/ bang mdzod 'phrul lde las/ spyir ni gsang sngags dam tshig ni/ /bsrung na bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /sa ma ya ni 'bum sde yod/ /ji bzhin pa yi chos nyid la/ /ma bcos pa yi blo bzhag na/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes te/ /mnyam nyid g.yo ba med pa ni/ /dam tshig thams cad bsrung ba yin/ /nyams pa'i chad pa byung ba la/ /mgon skyabs de las che ba med/ ces gsungs/ lta ba mthar phyin pa ma rtogs pa'i gang zag mos slob pas dam tshig nyams na me dang 'dra ste 'tshig /so mtshams kyi mkhar dang 'dra ste rang gzhan phung*/ dug dang 'dra ste thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod/ snying phyung na sman ci tsam btang yang bde bar mi 'gyur ba bzhin du sgom sgrub legs pa ci byas kyang dam tshig nyams na 'bras bu mi 'byung ba lha rnams kyang rang gshed du dbab nas tshe 'dir mi rung pa du ma 'byung zhing*/

phyi ma dmyal khams bco brgyad thams cad kyis kyang sdug bsngal do zla med pa'i rdo rje'i dmyal ba chen por skyes nas sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las mdzad kyang thar pa'i dus med par 'gyur la/ nyams pa'i rgyud kyang slob dpon gsang zhing rang che 'byin pa/ /lung ma nos pa slob dpon gyi sa bzung ba/ kha spyod dang lta spyod mi mthun pa/ gsang ba smra zhing gsang ba'i dam tshig cher mi 'dzin pa/ rgyal blon gyi bya ba sogs mi chos la gtso bo 'dzin pa/ nga rgyal dang rang mthong chang dad che ba/ chos la phyogs ris che zhing gshe skur mang ba/ bdag bstod gzhan smod kyi zur za byed pa/ gtsang dme dang rtog pa shas che bas dam bca' 'dor zhing gnyen po med pa/ sdig pa'i grogs po dang 'grogs pa/ thos pa chung zhing bla ma mkhas pa dang bral ba/ spyod pa thod rgal du byed cing gcig pur mi tshugs pa sogs dam tshig nyams pa'i snga rtags dang bcas te rgyal ba'i bka' chad du ma 'byung bar gsungs pas/ srog dang mig 'bras ltar btsa' bas dam tshig mi nyams pa bsrung zhing*/ nyams chag byung ba dag kyang rab kyis lta ba skye med kyi ngang du la bzla/ 'bring gis srog lan gsum btang ba sogs thabs la mkhas pas bshags/ tha mas kyang gnong 'gyod drag po'i sgo nas stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bshags pas 'chags shing phyin chad bsdoms te legs par bsrungs pa'i phan yon kyang*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang 'dra bar dgos 'dod 'byung*/ sa gzhi dang 'dra bar yon tan thams cad skyed/ nam mkha' dang 'dra bar thams cad kyi go 'byed/ tshe 'dir yang ma nyams pa'i snga rtags legs pa'i yon tan du ma 'byung zhing*/ ring por mi thogs par dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje'i rang gzugs dpal he ru ka'i go 'phang mngon du byed par 'gyur te/ bkod pa chen po'i rgyud las/ rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa yis/ /dngos grub ya mtshan chen po sgrub/ /phrin las bzhi po thogs med cing*/

/rtogs pa mchog gis gong du 'phel/ zhes gsungs/ 'jam dpal grags pas/ zhing gzhan bskal mang sdom la gnas pa bas/ /skad cig 'dir gnas 'bras bu rdzogs par byed/ ces gsungs pas bag yod dus thung ngu re bsten yang don chen por 'gyur zhing*/ de dag kyang mdor bsdu na/ sems la dge ba cha dang bcas pa bsgrub cing*/ mi dge ba cha dang bcas pa bsdoms nas g.yo sgyu'i skyon med pa la 'dus te/ rdo rje snying po phra ba 'byung gnas kyi rgyud las/ dam tshig sdom pa rnam bshad pa/ /kun kyang rang gi sems las so/ /de yi 'phen pa bla mas shes/ /de phyir sems la 'dris pa'i mis/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams mthong ba dang*/ /sku gsum tshad du 'byongs pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas yon tan mngon par 'grub/ /bla ma rtag tu bsten pa'i mis/ /mkha' 'gro'i gzugs rnams mthong ba dang*/ /de yi byin rlabs 'jug pa dang*/ /dus gsum lung yang ston pa dang*/ /skye shi gnyis la dbang thob 'gyur/ /grogs la brtse gdung ldan pa'i mis/ /'gro ba thams cad 'dul ba dang*/ /kun gyis snyan par grags pa dang*/ /gzugs can kun kyang byams pa dang*/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'du ba dang*/ /ma bsgrub dngos grub 'byung ba dang*/ /ngag la nus pa 'bar ba dang*/ /de bzhin mchog dang thun mong 'dir/ /dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /rtag tu dgon par gnas pa'i mis/ /rlung sems tshad med zin pa dang*/ /snang ba grogs su 'char ba dang*/ /rang gi sems la dbang thob 'gyur/ /bla ma bsnyen bkur byas pa'i mi/ /longs spyod mchog dang ldan pa dang*/ /'khor 'bangs rgyas shing bsod nams ldan/ /'gro ba yongs las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu dbang rdzogs byas pa'i mi/ /'gro ba'i gtso bor 'gyur ba dang*/ /kun gyis mthong ba dga' ba dang*/ /ye shes mngon sum 'byongs pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin brlab 'gyur/ /rtag tu gtor ma'i las byed pa/ /bsod nams tshogs rnams rdzogs pa dang*/

/bar chad med cing las rnams 'grub/ /'dod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ /mkha' 'gro bran bzhin khol bar 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pas rdo rje'i mched lcam rnams bag yod dran shes dang ldan pas rtag tu dam tshig sdom pa la nan tan du bzung bar mdzod cig ༈ bzlas dmigs skabs su 'di ltar bshad par bya'o/ da lam/ mched lcam rnams bsnyen pa mi bcad par shub bur bzla bzhin du bsgom don gsal 'debs cung zad zhu ba la gsan 'tshal/ de yang bdag cag gi ston pas chos 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskor ba thams cad bsdu na rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa gnyis su 'du/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa las khyad par du mas 'phags pa 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa yin/ rdo rje theg pa la rgyud sde bzhi dang sgo drug la sogs pa'i dbye na du ma yod pa rnams rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud la 'dus te/ de'ang rgyud sde dang sgrub sde gnyis las phyi ma yin la/ de la'ang bka' gter gyi bab so gnyis las nye brgyud zab mo gter gyi phyogs su gtogs shing de yang slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa bod du phebs nas gdul bya dus la bab pa'i tshe/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis rgyal srid dang*/ ye shes mtsho rgyal/ de mthun dam rdzas bcas gu ru la phul nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ bsam yas mchims phu brag dmar ke'u tshang du gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes sogs snying gi bu dgu la sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor chen po zhal phyes nas dbang bskur bas so so'i me tog ji ltar phog pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi zhal mthong zhing thun mong gi sprul bsgyur nyi zla gdan du bting ba brag la phur pa 'debs pa sogs/ sku tshe de nyid kyi rigs kyi bdag po dang gnyis su med pa'i go 'phang brnyes pas thog drangs/ rje 'bangs nyer lnga/ yer pa'i grub thob brgya rtsa/ shel brag gi sngags pa sum cu/ yang rdzong rtogs ldan nga lnga/ rang grol gyi rnal 'byor ma nyer lnga sogs grub thob kyi tshang chen po brdol ba yin la/

de lta bu gu ru pad+ma dang rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i rnam 'phrul gter ston brgya rtsa bcas mang du byon pa so so la yang*/ bka' dgongs phur gsum bla rdzogs thugs gsum sogs mang du bzhugs pa las/ dgongs 'dus lta bur mtshon na gter chen sangs rgyas gling pa la bla ma dgongs 'dus/ bsam gtan gling pa la yi dam dgongs 'dus sogs bka' bab la/ mkha' 'gro dgongs 'dus ni gter ston 'ga' zhig la bka' bab kyang cha shas tsam las phab ma thub par grags shing*/ 'di ni gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi sku yi skye ba bcu gsum pa pad+ma gter bdag gling pa'am rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'am/ rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus kyi chos skor yin par bzhed la de yang tshe gcig la 'od skur grub pa nyag bla pad+ma bdud 'dul gyi mdzad pa'i gsol bsdus las kyang*/ rtsa gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa'i klong yangs nas/ /rtsa gsum rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med pa/ /rig 'dzin gar dbang rtsa gsum gling pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs dbang bskur stsol/ zhes gsungs pa'i mtshon dam pa du ma'i zhal gyi bzhes pa bzhin rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'am/ bla rdzogs thugs gsum gyi nang gses bla ma'i thugs sgru+ub kyi tshom bu tshogs su sgrub pa rtsa gsum kun 'dus dkyil 'khor 'di lta bu'i lha sngags la bsten pa skal ba re bzang snyam pas/ bla ma la mos gus/ yi dam la dad spro/ mched lcam la gdung shugs/ le lo spang ba'i brtson 'grus brtan po'i sgo nas/ phyi ma hā yo ga ltar thabs kyi brjod bya thams cad rdul tshon dang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor steng du gtan la phab ste bsgrub pa dang*/ nang a nu yo ga ltar shes rab rgyud kyi brjod bya thams cad phung khams skye mched rtsa rlung thig le'i dkyil 'khor du gtan la phab ste bsgrub pa dang*/ gsang ba a ti yo ga ltar bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen thams cad kyi rim pa rnams gnyis med zung 'jug tu gtan la phab cing*/

de gsum po re re la yang thag bcad pa/ la dor ba/ sa bzung ba gsum bskyed rdzogs gong shing dgu la brten nas nyams su len tshul rgya cher gsungs pa las/ da lam phyi'i dkyil 'khor la gtso cher brten te sgrub pa chen po'i rim pa nyams su len pa'i skabs 'dir/ bsnyen sgrub brtson pa yongs kyi rnam pa gsal ba/ nga rgyal brtan pa/ rnam dag dran pa'i sgo nas yul gsum rab tu gsal nas lha gyad du gyur pa'i sku yi sgrub lugs/ lus kyis phreng ba/ ngag gis snying po/ yid kyis lha sngags ting nge 'dzin te bzla tshul gsum gyi sgo nas/ sngags dang sngags kyi gzhi/ gzungs dang gzungs kyi sgo/ rig pa dang rigs sngags kyi don shes pas 'phro 'du'i phreng ba dang bcas gsung gi sgrub lugs/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dgongs pa thig le nyag gcig ngang rim gnyis kyi ting 'dzin la ma yengs pa'i gnad med na 'bras bu 'byin mi nus pas/ rnal 'byor pa rnams sems sangs rgyas su shar bas lam la bgrod du med par shes/ snod bcud dkyil 'khor du shar bas 'bras bu rang byung lhun rdzogs su shes/ sdug bsngal bde chen du shar bas snang ba sna tshogs chos nyid du khyer shes/ nyon mongs ye shes su shar bas spang blang dgag sgrub rang sar grol ba'i gnad shes/ rnam rtog chos nyid du shar bas chos sku rang la ye nas gnas pa'i don shes pa ste shes pa rnam pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rnal 'byor 'bring rnams/ stong gsum lha'i gzhal yas su gsal bas dkyil 'khor la che chung dang yangs dogs med/ phung khams lha ru gsal bas bar chad gdon bgegs kyi yul dang bral/ snod kyi 'jig rten gtor snod du gsal bas mchod gtor la bzang ngan gyi mtshan 'dzin med/ snang srid thams cad rdzas su gsal bas srung ma dam can mi dgyes pa'am mi skong ba'i skyon zad/ gnas lugs stong pa nyid du gsal ba la sangs rgyas kyi chos ma lus pa rang sems su rdzogs pa ste/

gsal ba rnam pa lnga dang ldan pa zhig nges par dgos la/ bskyed rim rtag brtan ther zug tu bzung bas lha 'grub pa'i dus med/ phrin las gyer la sgom med du bzung bas gsang sngags dam med lto phyir bon gyer du song*/ sngags dang snying po rang rgyud par bzung bas byin rlabs dang nus pa'i rgyu med/ rdzas dang gtor chung bshos bur bzung zhing za 'dod dang brnab sems kyi 'bras bu'i dkor dang rnam smin gyi 'dam du tshud/ 'bras bus 'jig rten rtag chad du bzung bas ru tra'i gol sar ltung ba ste sngags pa tha ma bzung ba lngas ma bcings ba ni gal che/ mdor na gsang sngags bla med la zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pa ni/ lta ba'i gdeng gis 'khor 'das rang sems su thag chod pa/ sgom pa'i nyams kyis snang srid dag pa rab 'byams su shar ba/ spyod pa brtul zhugs kyis gang byung lam du longs pa zhig dgos shing*/ de yang bskyed rdzogs gang gi skabs su yang blos bcos nas bsgom pa ni dpem̐/ gdod nas rang bzhin gyis grub pa ni dom̐n te/ sems nyid 'gag med kyi 'char sgo thams cad bskyed rim/ ngo bo stong nyid du khrig ger gnas pa rdzogs rim/ de gnyis gsar du bsre ma dgos pa/ gdod nas tsan+dan dang dri/ nyi ma dang 'od zer gyi tshul du 'bral med zung 'jug tu gnas pa/ ngo bo gsal stong gnyis su med pa ni dom̐n/ rang bzhin phung khams skye mched du shar ba gdod nas lha'i 'khor lor dag pa'i brdam̐/ de nyid mngon du gyur pa'i phyir lha sngags ye shes kyi rnam pa lam du phyed pa gzhi rtagam̐s te/ snang srid gzhir bzhengs su rang byung gi dkyil 'khor zhes mngon sum gyi rim gnyis thams cad de'i khongs su ma 'dus pa gcig kyang med pas bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad de ltar nges pa dang*/ rgyud las/ don grub dngos grub thob pa ni/ /sngags kyi bzlas pas 'grub pa yin/ zhes gsungs pa gtso cher sngags bzla ba la'ang*/

bum dbang dang mthun par phyi rtsol bcas tshig 'bru'i sngags/ gsang dbang dang mthun par nang lhun grub rang byung gi sngags/ sher dbang dang mthun par gsang ba skye med rdo rje'i sngags/ dbang bzhi pa dang mthun par de kho na nyid spros bral brjod med kyi sngags rnams dbang po dang mthun par nyams su len par gsungs shing*/ rtsol bcas kyi sngags la'ang spro bsdus bzlas pa/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ 'gog bzlas sogs yod de/ ji skad du/ ting 'dzin me dang 'dra ba la/ /bzlas brjod rlung dang 'dra bas bskul/ zhes ting nge 'dzin gsal zhing brtan pa ni bud shing dang me'i sa bon rgyu rkyen 'dzoms pa la/ gsang sngags skyon dang bral ba'i bzlas brjod byed pa ni rlung gi dper mdzad pas me dang bud shing 'dzoms par rlung gis bskul na lhag par 'bar ba bzhin ting nge 'dzin dang sngags bzla ba 'dzoms pas bsgrub bya'i 'bras bu shin tu myur ba'i thabs kyi mchog yin zhing*/ de yang ngag bzlas skabs rin chen phreng ba las/ bzlas pa byed tshe long gtam kyal ka dang*/ khro dang 'thab dang shags dang 'jug 'dzin dang*/ /zhum dang lhag pa'i nga rgyal rnam par spangs/ /smra dang rnam rtog spros pa rnam par bcad/ /lha dang sngags las gzhan la mi bsam mo/ zhes pa ltar bzlas pa'i phan yon kyang de nyid las/ lan gcig tsam la sngags brjod na/ /'das dang 'byung dang 'byung gang yin/ /gang gi lce la smra 'gyur ba/ /de dbang bden pa thob par 'gyur/ zhes sngags kyi bden pa 'grub pas bstan srung mthu/ tshe mthud bu/ zang zing nor/ mchog gi dngos grub phun sum tshogs pa 'grub par gsungs la/ bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor la brtson pas dgra gsum sod/ bdud bzhi choms/ 'gro drug gi g.yang sa chod/ mi slob pa'i zung 'jug sku bzhi ye shes lnga mngon du 'gyur bas dad brtson drag pos gzhan du ma yengs par/ snang ba lha/ lha rang sems/ sems stong nyid/ grags stong sngags kyi rol par shes pa'i ngang gzhung nas 'byung ba'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du la rtse gcig nyams su len par zhu/

sgrub pa grol skabs phan yon dang 'brel ba'i mar me'i smon lam ni/ de ltar bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi spros bcas sgrub pa chen po tshom bu tshogs su sgrub pa sbyor dngos rjes gsum rig 'dzin gong ma'i phyag bzhes bzhin tshang la bar chad med par mtha' rgyas su grub ste/ de yang spyir o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i bstan pa'i snying po gter gyi chos la dad pa thams cad/ gu ru nyid bod du phebs pa'i skabs su zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i skal ba dang ldan par gsungs te/ ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi zhal nas/ ma 'ongs pad+ma'i chos la dad pa kun: deng sang gu ru'i zhal mthong smon lam btab: thams cad las can yin pas dga' ba sgoms: kho mo'i tshig 'di rin chen gser las dkon: zhes gsungs pas gzhung tshad ldan nas gsungs pa tshul bzhin nyams su len pa rnams gu ru nyid kyi byin rlabs kyi rol rtsal yin pa'ang gsungs te/ dgongs 'dus lung bstan bka' rgya ma las/ mdor na o rgyan ngas bstan chos rnams la: gzhung bzhin su dang su yis spyod pa kun: thams cad nga yi sprul pa yin par nges: ma 'ongs kun gyis yid gnyis the tshom spongs: gus pas bkur bsti phu dud 'brel pa zhog: ces dang*/ o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas/ gsang sngags don gyi snying po 'di kho na: sgrub chen 'di yi ming tsam su gang 'dzin: o rgyan nga dang snying khrag gcig tu 'dres: zhes dang*/ pad+ma nga yi srog gi dwangs ma ste: dus gsum rgyal ba'i srog snying 'di kho na: dus gsum rgyal ba spyi sgrub 'di ka zab: 'di 'chang o rgyan nga dang 'bral ba med: rig 'dzin brgyad 'dus dam can bran du khol: yang zab snying po mar gyi nying khu dang : dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba ma lus pa: thams cad thams cad ma lus 'dis 'grub ste: de la dus gsum rgyal ba spyi sgrub yin: tshig tshogs mang bas mi zab don la 'di:

o rgyan nga yis thugs bcud min re kan: zhes dang*/ yang gu ru'i zhal nas/ nga mthong sangs rgyas thams cad mthong*/ /nga sgrub sangs rgyas thams cad 'grub/ /nga nyid sangs rgyas kun 'dus yin/ zhes gsungs pas na the tshom dang yid gnyis ma byed par bsgrubs na smos ci/ tha na glegs bam tsam dad pa'i rten du bzung yang*/ gsang ba'i rgyud chen sgrub yig gang sus 'dzin/ /de phyogs thams cad bde gshegs kun 'dus te/ /sha rul dag la sbrang ma ji bzhin no/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin yi dam sgrub sde brgyad sogs thams cad 'dir ma 'dus pa med cing bla ma yi dam kun 'dus 'di lta bu'i sgrub pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa rang gis lo gsum mtshams dam du bcad pa las kyang tshom bu tshogs sgrub zhag bdun phan yon che ste/ rgyud chen gsang ba 'dus pa las/ dad brtson drag pos sgrub gyur na/ /mtshams med lnga po spyad pas kyang*/ /dngos grub thob pa gsang sngags khyad/ /dam ldan rnams la smos ci dgos/ zhes gsungs/ 'di lta bu'i phan yon 'byung ba mi bden sogs bsam mi rung ste/ 'di phyogs the tshom za ba'i mi gang su/ /tshe 'dir yid du mi 'ong kun 'dus nas/ /mnar med rdo rje'i dmyal te der 'gro bas/ /kun gyi thun mong ma yin gsang dam srungs/ zhes kyang gdams par mdzad cing*/ mdor na mchog thun dngos grub ma lus pa myur du 'grub pa'i thabs su lan gcig ma yin par rdo rje'i lung gis yang yang bsngags pa yin la/ phan yon de ldan gyi sgrub pa legs par grub pa la dga' spro dad mos yid ches dang ldan pas slad nas kyang rdo rje rgyal po dang rgyal thebs/ gzungs ma mched lcam dkyil 'khor gcig tu tshogs shing mar me gcig la bltas pa thams cad gcig gis gcig la khong khro nga rgyal sgro skur sogs kyis dam tshig la sel bslad ma zhugs par lha dang dkyil 'khor gyi tshul du blta dgos pa dang*/ 'di nas byang chub ma thob bar du dam tshig rdo rje'i lu gu rgyud gcig tu sbrel ba/

rnam kun 'du 'bral med pa srog gis bsdus pa'i lha'i tshom bu 'khod cing*/ tshom bu tshogs sgrub kyi dge ba'i las chen po bsags pa'ang don yod par bgyi ba'i slad mar me'i smon lam bgyid pa'i skabs su bab pa ste/ de yang rdzong 'phrang las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi spros pa med pa'i dbyings/ /thig le chen po ma bcos lhun grub ngang*/ /skye 'gag med pa byang chub sems kyi don/ /ye shes mar me'i sdong rtsar shar ba'o/ zhes gsungs pa ltar byang chub sems dngos po'i gzugs dang bral ba/ khyad chos drug ldan ye shes kyi 'od phung du 'bar zhing gzhon nu bum pa sku'i tshul du bzhugs pa ni mtshon bya don gyi mar me/ gzhi las gzhi snang du g.yos te/ lhun grub rang snang gi sgo nas shar lugs chen po brgyad kyis 'khor 'das sna tshogs su snang ba mtshon pa brda yi mar me/ 'di la dbye ba snang tshul snod kun gzhi'i kong bu ru/ bcud rnam shes kyi phung po'i sdong bu la/ gnas lugs chos dbyings ye shes kyi mar khus gtams nas rig pa rang gsal gyi sgron me sbar bas lam gzhi snang sku dang ye shes kyi 'od snang 'phro bas/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje'i rigs dgyes pa bskang*/ snod dbyings rig dbyer med kyi kong bu ru/ bcud gzugs phung ma dag gi sdong bu la/ me long ye shes kyi mar khus gtams te shes rab rang byung gi sgron me sbar bas lam chos nyid mngon sum gyi snang bas/ 'bras bu rnam snang gi rigs dgyes pa bskang*/ snod ka ti shel gyi kong bu ru/ bcud tshor phung rnam dag gi sdong bu la/ mnyam nyid ye shes kyi sgron mes gtams te/ lam rgyang zhags 'od gsal gyi mar me sbar bas lam nyams snang gong 'phel gyis/ 'bras bu rin chen gyi rigs dgyes pa bskang*/ snod 'ja' zer thig le'i kong bu ru/ bcud 'du shes rnam dag gi sdong bu la/ sor rtog ye shes kyi mar khus gtams te/

dag pa dbyings kyi sgron me sbar bas/ lam rig pa tshad phebs kyi snang bas/ 'bras bu gsung pad+ma'i rigs dgyes pa bskang*/ snod gzhon nu'i bum sku'i kong bu ru/ bcud 'du byed rnam dag gi sdong bu btsugs nas/ bya grub ye shes kyi mar khus gtams te/ thig le stong pa'i sgron me sbar bas/ lam chos nyid zad pa'i snang bas/ 'bras bu las kyi rigs kyi thugs dam bskangs pas/ rgyu sku dang ye shes/ rkyen 'od dang kha dog /byed las sgron ma bzhir smin te 'khor lo bzhi'i dbus su 'od gsal thig le chen po dang*/ spyi bo nas rtog pa med pa'i sku 'char ba ni mtshon byed rtags kyi mar me ste/ de dag rten cing 'brel 'byung gi dbang las snang gsal mar me 'di yis mtshon byed du byas/ ye shes chen po'i snang bas nyon mongs kyi mun khang bcom/ rgyud drug 'khor ba'i sgo rtsad nas bcad/ rdo rje khro rgyal rnams kyi zhal mthong*/ rang rgyud snang ba bzhi yi shul mtshon/ rig stong khyab brdal chen pos rgyab skyor/ rang grol spyod pa cog bzhag gis mtha' brten te bgrod par bya ba'i lam lnga dang sa bcu bgrod du med pa'i tshul gyis dwangs srog thig le chen por srid pa gsum po yongs su dag pa 'od zer 'phrul bzhad kyi klong dam par bgrod nas chos thams cad bya rtsol gnyis med kyi klong du gdod nas skye 'gag 'pho 'gyur bral ba gzhi rdzogs lhun grub chen por gdeng chen thob/ dbugs chen 'byin/ rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i thugs 'dun rtse gcig pa mdzad nas smon lam gyi rjes zlos gnang bar zhu/ hūm̐: bla med gsang ba mchog gi? sogs dbyangs bor len mthar rol mo sogs rgya cher spel zhing mtha' rgyas su bya'o/ slar smras pa/ mkhas grub bye ba gshegs shul tshogs sgrub kyi/ phyag bzhes rgyud lung man ngag nges pa'i don/ /mtshon byed stong thun snying po sa bon tsam/ /dam pa'i gsung bzhin bsdus la 'dir bkod byas/

/des kyang spros bcas tshom bu tshogs sgrub kyi/ /nyams len go don bskyed rdzogs gnad mthong nas/ /rig 'dzin 'dus mang 'brel bcas ma lus pa/ /phyam gcig pad+ma 'od du skye rgyur smon/ zhes bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ spros bcas sgrub chen gyi stong thun rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i dgyes dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di yang gsang sngags phur pa gling dang sku gsum mkha' 'gro gling gnyis kyi lo gsum sgrub sde grol ba'i skabs dang bstun mkhan rin po che ngag dbang dge legs bzang po mchog nas tshul 'dis sgrub chen gsar 'dzugs kyi sbyin bdag dang go bsgrigs gnang mus bzhin de skabs stong thun dang sgrub pa chen po'i khog dbub sogs dgos pa gal che bar 'dug pas cis kyang gzigs rogs zhes tshe rabs du mar las smon gyi 'brel ba'i mthus brtas/ tshul 'dir mi 'phrog pa'i dad mos rdo rje ltar brtan pa'i 'brong pa rdo shul du skyes pa'i sgrub brtson bla ma o rgyan gsang sngags 'gro 'dul nas nan bskul ngor/ gnam lcags pa gsang sngags bstan 'dzin ming pas rang lugs 'khor 'das zil gnon dang kho bo'i sngar byas pa'i pad+ma khrag 'thung stong thun sogs la gzhi byas nas 'phros don kha bsgyur bcas rab byung bcu bdun pa'i shing pho sprel gyi lo gro zhun zla ba'i tshes 22 dmar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus tshes la ma hā tsi ni gling phran the wan nang pa'i lhan tshogs rgyal khab 17las grub pa'i 'dus tshogs skabs mgron khang chen mor gnas pa'i bar gseng du grub par bgyis pa 'dis kyang snying po'i bstan pa ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // zha)bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ spyi dril gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun grub kyi sgrub pa'i khog dbub mchog thun 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

bla ma rtsa gsum bde gshegs bka' 'dus dpal/ /chos kyi rgya mtsho dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i gter/ /yid bzhin nor bu gu ru yab yum dang*/ /dbyer med drin can bla mar gus btud de/ /bde gshegs kun 'dus tshom bu tshogs sgrub kyi/ /sgrub pa'i khog dbub mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub 'dod rgu'i char rgyun rtag dbab pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i dga' ston 'di na dbye/ de yang thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi rgyab chos bsam lhun man ngag bcu gsum gyi phrin las gcig tu dril ba las byang ye shes sprin phung dang 'brel bar tshom bu tshogs su sgrub pa'i lag len rang lugs rtsa gsum spyir 'jug 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum bzang 'khyer bde don gsal zhes bla rdzogs thugs gsum sogs zhi drag spyir 'jug dang*/ khyad par bsam lhun badz+ra bum sgrub kyi sbyor dngos rjes gsum la gces pa'i sgrub khog yon tan gter mdzod sogs bzhugs kyang snga ma ltar na rang 'dra'i blo rmongs rnams kyi gzhung so so dang zhi drag sogs kha bsgyur tshul bzhin shes par dka' la/ phyi ma yang ril sgrub kho na gtsor bzung mdzad pas sgrub chen rkyang par sbyar ba la dbye gsal mang bas mgo 'khrugs par dogs te 'dir go sla 'jug bde ba'i dbang du byas te nag 'gros su bkod pa la/ phun sum tshogs pa lngas sgrub pa'i gzhi bzung ba/ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhis sgrub pa'i gzhung bsrang ba/ rjes las kyi rim pa mtha' rgyas su bya ba'o/ dang po ni gter kha phal mo cher/ ston pa gnas dang 'khor dang dus/ /yo byad la sogs lngar ldan pa/ zhes 'chad pa mang yang*/ 'dir gsang sngags lam rim ltar na/ phun sum tshogs pa lnga ni/ dang po sgrub pa'i gnas phun sum tshogs pa ni/ rang gzhung las/ de yang bla ma sgrub pa'i rim pa ni: bkra shis byin chags rgyal ba'i me tog 'thor: smon lam mchog ldan dben ri yid 'ong 'dir:

mkho ba'i yo byad sgrub pa'i cha rkyen bsags: sa slong stegs bu bcags te dbus mtho ba: gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang rtse'i dbyibs dag la: thig gdab tshon spel bkod mdzes legs par bya: zhes gsungs pa bzhin gu ru rin po che dang grub thob du mas byin gyis brlabs la/ dben pa nyams dga' zhing dam nyams sde 'khrug sogs grib kyis ma gos pa'o/ gnyis pa dus ni/ rgyal ba'i dus chen bzhi/ ra ba bzhi'i yar ngo*/ yar mar tshes bcu rnams dang ma 'dzoms na gza' skar 'phrod sbyor dge ba la'o/ gsum pa sgrub pa po ni/ rdo rje slob dpon rgyal thebs gzungs mas gtso bor gyur pa'i ston 'khor thams cad so so'i mtshan nyid gzhung mthun dgos par gsungs kyang*/ spyi tsam du bla ma'i thugs sgrub bder 'dus kyi dbang lung rdzogs par thob cing bsnyen pa las rung du byas pas bsgrub bya la the tshom med cing dad pa rtse gcig dang ldan pa/ sgrub pa po nang phan tshun dam sel gtan nas med pa zhig gal che'o/ bzhi pa yo byad ni/ de nyid las/ bum pa rnam rgyal sman sgrub bdud rtsis gtams: kha rgyan mgul chings la sogs tshang bar bya: bhan+dha mtshan ldan sman raka phud kyis bkang : rtsa gsum gtor ma rgyan bzang legs par bshams: gzhan yang spyan gzigs tshogs gtor tshang bar bskor: sogs gzhung nas bshad pa'i sgrub rdzas/ mchod rdzas/ rgyan rdzas la sogs zhib pa gsham gsal rgyan bkod las 'byung ba ltar dam tshig gi yo byad thams cad dang*/ slob dpon gyi mdun g.yon nas brtsams te nang mchod/ las phur/ rdor dril/ dar dmar nag /me tog gi snod/ ḍā ma ru/ las bum rnams tshags su tshud par bya'o/ lnga pa sgrub pa'i thabs ni/ yid ches rtsod bral gyi zab chos brgyud pa drug ldan gyi khyad par du byas pa zab mo gter ma las byon cing de yang dam sel 'dres khyer gyis ma bslad pa'i rgyud lung man ngag khungs btsun gyi dgongs pa dang mthun zhing 'khrul pa med pa/

byin rlabs kyi gzi byin dang ldan pa ste phun sum tshogs pa lnga'o/ gnyis pa bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhis sgrub pa'i gzhung bsrang ba la gnyis/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi'i las rim mo/ dang po la gnyis/ bsod nams kyi dpung bskyed pa/ sa yi cho ga bya ba'o/ dang po la rang rgyud sbyong ba/ chos 'khor bskor ba/ gtor ma gtong ba/ sbyin gtong bya ba bzhi/ de re re la'ang bzhi bzhir 'byung ste/ dang po ni lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang phyir sāts+tsha gdab pa/ nye'u 'don pa/ srog bslu/ rnam 'joms sme brtsegs kyi khrus bya ba/ ngag sgrib sbyang phyir/ na raka dong sprugs dang yig brgya bzlas pa/ yid sgrib sbyang phyir sems bskyed blang ba dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa/ gzhan yang zhi ba'i sbyin sreg blugs pa/ lus ngag yid gsum ka'i phyir du phyag skor dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong la tshogs skong rgya cher bya/ gnyis pa ni/ chos nyid kyi don rtogs phyir sgrub khang gi shar du sher phyin/ bdud gzhom phyir lhor stobs po che/ rgyu 'bras go phyir nub tu lang kar gshegs pa/ bar chad zhi phyir byang du tog gzungs dang grwa nga bklag /gsum pa ni/ byin rlabs 'byung phyir dkon mchog sri zhu yi mgron dang*/ phrin las bcol phyir yon tan/ 'byor pa 'thob phyir snying rje/ bu lon 'khor phyir lan chags kyi mgron rnams la/ phyi chu gtor dang mdos glud/ nang gtor ma/ gsang ba lus kyi mchod sbyin bya bar gsungs so/ bzhi pa ni/ dngos su snang ba'i mgron la dngos 'byor ci rigs pas mnyes shing tshim par byed pa ste/ bla ma dang dge 'dun rje dpon dang yon tan can nad pa dang dbul phongs bya rigs chu gnas bu lon lan chags pa dang*/ mi mdza' ba rnams yon dang bza' btung ci 'byor stob la sgrub pa mthar phyin cing bar chad med pa'i smon lam gdab/ sang sgrub pa'i sta gon bya ba'i snga nub lta bur gral bkod dang*/

ling khrus bya srol ltar na/ mnan bsreg liṅga gnyis tshad ldan bris pa dang*/ ling khrus la mkho ba'i lam rgya gram gyi sa/ chu mig lkug pa'i chu/ ro sol gyi me'am dug shing tsher ma can gyi me/ rlung g.yab bum sgro/ ling phyis sha dmar/ byug rdzas dug khrag /brab rdzas thun yungs/ gzhan yang dbye rdzas g.yab dar sogs bsgral chas/ sdom byed byad thag sngo dmar/ re yug gam ras nag /rtsang gzer/ mnan snod/ hom khung sogs 'du bya la/ ling khrus gnad gyi man ngag bsdus pa ni/ thog mar slob dpon dang las rdor gyis phyi khyams nam mkha' mthong sar bkra shis brgyad pa dang tshig bdun gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro bas/ gu drag dang phur pa'i rgyun khyer gang rung sngon du song nas/ lam rgya gram gyi sa gtor la/

lam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: chu lkug pas bkrus la/ bam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: ro sol gyi me bskor la/ ram̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: rlung la phyar zhing*/ yam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: nam mkha' la g.yug cing*/ e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: e yam̐ ram̐ bam̐ lam̐ shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: zhes dang*/ āḥ kyang nyer gcig dbugs thengs gcig bsgrags te chus bkrus la rang gis btung bar bya'o/ tshe pha rol gyi srog khrag snying khrag dpal chen pos gsol bar bsam/ dug khrag gis byug /dgra lteb tu ltebs la/ re ba dang byad thag sngo dmar gyis bcings/ rtsang rgya gram du gzir/ brub khung du gzhug /'gugs pa bya zhing thun gyis brab pa sogs lag len ma 'chol ba bya/ mthar rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub pa lsogs bkra shis smon lam mdor bsdus byas shing nang du log nas mthar dbyung ngo*/ gnyis pa sa yi cho ga ni/ gzhung las/ sngon 'gro gtsang mar sbyar ba'i gser skyems btang : gzhi bdag rnams la sgrub pa'i rogs dan bcol: zhes gsungs pa bzhin sa chog dngos la lnga/ brtag pa/ bslang ba/ dbang du bya ba/ sbyang ba bzung zhing bsrung ba'o/ dang po ni/ sa yi mtshan nyid dang*/ rten 'brel/ lto 'phye brtag pa rnams te/ sgrub gnas rnying pa la mi dgos so/ gnyis pa snang ba mi las bslangs zin pa'i dbang du byas te/ mi snang bar bslang ba la gnyis/ sa lha dang mi min yul bdag spyi la'o/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gang du bya ba'i gzhi stegs byi dor byas par tshom bu gcig bkod pa'i mdun du mchod gtor dkar zlum mtheb ril gyis mtshan pa gnyis dang*/ gser skyems/ mtha' skor byang shar mtshams 'dzin me tog nas brtsam chu gnyis nyer spyod g.yas bskor du bkod/ bdag bskyed la mkho ba'i phyi nang gi mchod gtor gang dgos phug logs lta bur bshams shing 'og gi skabs so sor dgos pa'i yau byad rnams kyang tshags su tshud par bya'o/

de nas sgrub pa po rnams stan la 'khod de bdag gi rnal 'byor bya ba la/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro bas skyabs sems tshogs bsags kyis rgyud sbyang bar gsungs pa ltar/ rdo rje slob dpon sogs yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro bas/ hūm̐/ rang rig shes pa ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang*/ /dran rtog 'dzin med ngo bo gshis lugs hūm̐/ /yongs gyur bla ma rig 'dzin thod pa rtsal/ /'gags med gsal stong gzhon tshul zhi ma khro/ /za ber phod ka rin chen prog zhu dang*/ /rdo rje bhan+dha kha ṭ+wāṃ shes rab 'chang*/ /rgyal po rol stabs snang srid zil gnon ngang*/ /sku yi cha dang ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor 'ja' ltar lhags/ /sgyu ma'i gar ltar wal gyis gsal ba yi/ /thugs kar hūm̐ mthar snying po'i sngags phreng 'khor/ /'byin 'jug thams cad rdo rje gsum gyi ngang*/ /phyogs bcur 'phros pas byin brlabs thugs rgyud bskul/ /yig 'bru gsum gyis dbang bzhi snying po thob/ /rtsa khams zhing khams lha ru rtag mngon te/ /'phro 'gyu tshogs drug ka dag dbyings su grol/ /snang stong gsal stong bde stong rig stong ngang*/ /gshis lugs lta ba bla ma'i don rtogs nas/ /de bzhin he ru ka par 'grub gyur nas/ /rig 'dzin rgyal ba 'dus pa'ang bdag gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ zhes nyer gcig bzlas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ mthar bsdu ldang bya/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas gsal gdab cing*/ ha ha: hūm̐ hūm̐: ho ho: phaiṃ phaiṃ: de nas khro bo'i gad rgyangs sa gsum rab tu g.yo ba bsgrags par bsam/ hoḥ de ring bkra shis dus tshes bzang : rten 'brel kun gyi mgo yang legs: gnas bdag yul 'dzin phun sum tshogs: mi shigs pho brang sa 'dul lo: mchod gtor rnams/

om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod nang du: oṃ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo'i rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dang*/ gtor gzhong rat+na'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum rgya dang bcas pas brlab: hūm̐: mdun du ri rab gling bzhi'i dbus: skyon bral pad+ma'i lte ba zlum: sa yi lha mo bstan ma ser: bum 'dzin pus btsugs gus pa'i tshul: 'khor du sa 'dzin bcu gnyis bcas: rang mdog phyogs mthun rgyan chas gsal: thugs srog laṃ las 'od 'phros pas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rang rang gdan la dgyes par bzhugs: om̐ baṃ laṃ bhū mi pa ti badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ ri rab rol mtsho bcud kyi bdag: sa la gnas pa'i lha mo che: sa 'dzin bcu gnyis bran g.yog 'khor: mchog gsum rgyal ba'i bka' la nyon: rin chen gser skyems 'di bzhes la: rin chen gser gyi sa mchog stsol: de ring dbang chen dkyil 'khor 'debs: bdag gi zhi rgyas dbang drag gis: phrin las bya ba gang bcol yang : ko long ru nga phrag dog dang : gdug pa'i sdang sems zhi gyur nas: sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen rogs dan dang : lo legs 'bru 'phel nad yams zhi: khyed cag sa mchog 'di phul mthus: mngon rdzogs rgyal ba'i sras su 'gyur: de ltar bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces gtor ma phul la sa gnon gyis rgyas gdab/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par du/ /sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ shākya seṅge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag kyang bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas rig pa 'dzin pa khyod kyis ci dga' bar spyod cig ces gnang ba byin nas de nyid du thim par

bsam/ zhi rol bcas gtor ma phyir phul/ gnyis pa ni/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ s+d+yā na pa ti k+ṣe ṭa pa la lañca na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu ṣe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ hūm̐: shar lho nub byang la gnas pa'i/ /sa 'dzin sde dpon bcu gnyis dang*/ /spar kha sme ba lo skor dang*/ /gza' khyim dus 'gyu zhag gi lha/ /lha klu phyogs skyong sde brgyad dang*/ /'byung ba'i sde brgyad gzhi bdag la/ /gser skyems gtor ma 'di 'bul bas/ /ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad cig /sa rko ri bshig brag bsgyel zhing*/ /chu rlung me 'gyed zor 'phang dang*/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las gang yang*/ legs nyes bya ba gang byas kyang*/ ko long spangs shing rogs dan mdzod/ /gal te phrag dog sdang gyur tshe/ /bdag nyid khyung chen khro rgyal gyis/ /ri rab bsnyil zhing rgya mtsho dkrug /klu dang sa bdag dregs pa'i rigs/ /rdul du brlag par gdon mi za/ /de bas dam srungs phrin las mdzod/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti lo ka pā la sa ma ya ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gāts+tsha/ gnang ba byin nas rang gnas su gshegs par bsam zhing*/ 'jam rol dang bcas gtor ma dang gser skyems phyir 'bul/ mchod pa rnams bsdu'o/ gsum pa dbang du bya ba ni/ stegs kyi mdun nas slob dpon gyis dbang mchog gi phur bu bzung*/ bdag nyid las kyi he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros phur bu la thim: de nyid dpal rta mgrin gyi skur gyur par bsams la/ hrī pad+ma ta kri ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces btab ste lan bdun bzlas pas/ phur bu las byung ba'i 'od zer dmar pos sa gzhi thams cad khyab/ bdag gis dbang du gyur par bsam mo/ bzhi pa sbyang ba la/ sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyis sbyang ba ni/ slob dpon gyi lag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga ser por bsams nas/

phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas te stegs bu'i steng du bzhag /thams cad kyi rdo rje dang bcas lag g.yas sa la reg pa'i tshul byas nas/ om̐ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ lan gsum gyis sa la bsnun/ ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyong ba ni/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ phra mo grangs med pa phyogs bcur 'phros: 'phags pa mchod sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ tshur 'dus ye shes kyi me rlung chur gyur pas ma dag pa'i dngos 'dzin thams cad bsregs gtor sbyangs: rnam dag ye shes kyi zhing khams chen por gyur: ces mos/ don dam par snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos kun rang sems las gud du med pa'i stong nyid kyi gnas lugs dran pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed med par don dam gyi sbyangs ba yang bya/ lnga pa bzung ba dang bsrung ba gnyis las/ thog mar bgegs gtor byin rlob pa la/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ hūm̐: bdag nyid dbang drag 'bar ba'i thugs ka nas: gzi byin 'od stong zer ma phyogs bcur 'phros: de yi shugs las bgegs rnams snying rjes bkug: gtor ma len phyir gnas 'dir myur du mchis: oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dza dzaḥ bgegs tshogs 'byung po a kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ de nas kha phyir bstan la: hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs dang 'byung po log 'dren tshogs: deng nas phan dge'i byang chub lam 'god phyir: yid mthun 'dod yon mchod sbyin 'di bzhes la: gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du 'gro bar gyis: ci ste mi 'gro gdug pa'i sems 'chang na: bdag nyid dbang chen drag sngags phyung brdeg gis: khyod kyi lus ngag yid gsum rdul du brlag: de bas rang rang gnas su phyir dengs shig: oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ

de nas thun brdeg cing : hūm̐ hrīḥ bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang : yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong mthu rtsal gyis: dngos grub bar chad byed ba'i bgegs: log par 'dren pa bdud kyi tshogs: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'tshe byed na: bdag nyid dpal chen thugs khros nas: khro bo spros pas nam mkha' gang : khro mo spros pas sa gzhi gang : sras mchog khro chung bar snang gang : me yi bya khyung phyogs bcur 'khrigs: drwa mig lcags sdig glog ltar 'khyugs: 'khor yug mtshon cha thog ltar 'bebs: bgegs tshogs thal ba rdul du brlag: de bas bka' las ma 'da' zhig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra hūm̐: rak+sha hūm̐: yak+ṣa hūm̐: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya: gnod byed bgegs tshogs thams cad tshin+dha tshin+dha ban+dha ban+dha ha na ha na pa tsa pa tsa ma tha ma tha da ha da ha hu lu hu lu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: mtshams gcod cing srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐: nga nyid gdod nas rab khros he ru kaḥ ka dag thugs las brdol ba'i shes rab mtshon: rno dbal lhun grub drag rtsal 'gengs pa'i tshogs: bar med khyab ste skar ltar rab 'khrugs pa: bsrung mtshams med pa dum bu gcig pa ni: e yi mkha' ltar gnas pa'i gur khang gyur: oṃ badz+ra dharma dz+nyā na tsakra e khaṃ raṃ dz+wa la rak+ṣa ye swā hā: dang po bzung ba ni/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor dbus su bzhengs te mchog phur ram lcags sam seng ldeng gi phur pa sor lnga pa dar gyi cod pan btags pa zhig thogs te/ bsgril ba tsam gyi phyogs bcur khro tshogs thams cad 'dus te thim pas/ phur pa de nyid khro bo chen po zhal gsum phyag drug pa smad gnam lcags 'bar ba'i phur bu dbal gsum du me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba rno ngar dang ldan pa dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su btab pas/ de las byung ba'i me sogs kyis dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi tshun khengs pas bar gcod thams cad gzhob tu bsregs shing sa gzhi dbang du gyur par bsam/

bdag gi thugs ka nas khro bo bcu spros pa'i tshogs kyis sa gzhi gang bar gyur/ phur bu rnams stod zhal gsum phyag drug phur bu 'dril ba/ smad lcags phur me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro bar gyur/ phur pa bsgril la/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha rod ā dz+nyā pa ya ti sarba bigh+nān kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ lan gsum gyis gdab nas/ phur bu las 'phros pa'i khro chung dang me 'od kyis sa gzhi khengs par gyur: spro na 'dir stangs stabs dang bskor ba sogs rgyas bsdus gang rung bya'o/ rtsa ba'i gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ ye shes kyi lha bsnyen pa'i rim pa/ lha dang dbyer med du byed pa sgrub pa'i rim pa/ grub nas dngos grub len pa sgrub pa chen po'i rim pa'o/ dang po la bcu ste/ mtshams gsum rten bca' sta gon bya/ rgyan bkod mnga' gsol brda sbyar zhing*/ sri mnan bskos gdab byin 'bebs so/ zhes pa'i dang po phyi mtshams bcad pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyogs bzhir tho bzhi la rgyal chen so so'i sku'am sngags byang rgyal mtshan dang bcas pa btsugs la so so'i mdun du stegs gtsang mar gtor ma dkar zlum mdun mtheb skyu ril bus mtshan pa re dang*/ de yi mdun du g.yon phyogs nas brtsam pa'i chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga bcas bshams/ sgrub pa po rnams rol chas sogs ser sbreng gi tshul gyis sgrub khang nas don te shar gyi tho mdun du 'khod la/ mchod gtor rnams/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod nang du: om̐ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo'i rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐:

zhes dang*/ gtor gzhong rat+na'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum dang bcas pas brlabs/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas yi ge phuḥ'aphros pas pi waṃ du gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las yul 'khor srung dkar po pi waṃ 'dzin pa dri za'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i thugs ka dang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ri rab kyi shar phyogs nas rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bsdu rgya bcas/ hūm̐: gsang bdag spyan sngar dam mnos shing : bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa: rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung : 'dir gshegs rten la brtan par bzhugs: badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ dh+riṣ+ṭa rāṣ+ṭā ya swā hā: lan bdun/ oṃ ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: bar gyis mchod/

oṃ dh+riṣ+ṭa rāṣ+ṭā ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ hūm̐: shar phyogs rgyal po yul 'khor srung : lus 'phags gling la dbang bsgyur tshe: dri za 'bum dang me lhas bskor: 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i mthu bo che: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: khyed kyis shar phyogs dung sgo 'di: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs par: srung zhing shar gyi sgo mtshams chod: oṃ badz+ra bh+rūm̐ bi pa la rā dza badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: zhes brjod cing phrin las bcol/ oṃ dh+riṣ+ṭa rāṣ+ṭā ya swā hā/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brtan bzhugs bya/ lho yi tho rtsar 'khod la/ mchod gtor rnams/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod nang du: oṃ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo'i rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dang*/ gtor gzhong rat+na'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum dang bcas pas brlabs/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas yi ge phuḥ'aphros pas ral grir gyur: de yongs su gyur pa las 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa gshin rje'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i thugs ka dang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ri rab kyi lho phyogs nas rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rgya dang bcas/ hūm̐: gsang bdag spyan sngar dam mnos shing : bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa: rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po: 'dir gshegs rten la brtan par bzhugs: badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ bi rū dha kā ya swā hā: lan bdun/ oṃ ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ya shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā:

oṃ bi rū dha kā ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ hūm̐: lho phyogs rgyal po 'phags skyes po: 'dzam bu gling la dbang bsgyur tshe: gshin rje 'bum dang grul bum bskor: 'byor drug rgyas pa'i mthu bo che: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: khyed kyis lho phyogs gser sgo 'di: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs bar: srung zhing lho yi sgo mtshams chod: oṃ ār+ya gu li rā dza rat+na rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: zhes brjod cing phrin las bcol/ oṃ bi rū dha kā ya swā hā: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brtan bzhugs bya/ nub kyi tho rtsar 'khod la/ mchod gtor rnams/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod nang du: oṃ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo'i rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dang*/ gtor gzhong rat+na'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum dang bcas pas brlabs/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas yi ge phuḥ'aphros pas sbrul zhags su gyur: de yongs su gyur pa las spyan mi bzang dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin pa klu yi 'khor gyis bskor ba'i thugs ka dang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ri rab kyi nub phyogs nas rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rgya dang bcas/ hūm̐: gsang bdag spyan sngar dam mnos shing : bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa: rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang : 'dir gshegs rten la brtan par bzhugs: badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ bi ru pāk+ṣā ya swā hā: lan bdun/ oṃ ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ya shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā:

oṃ bi ru pāk+ṣā ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ hūm̐: nub phyogs rgyal po spyan mi bzang : ba glang spyod la dbang bsgyur tshe: klu dbang 'bum dang rlung lha bcas: mos bzhi dbang sgyur mthu bo che: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: khyed kyis nub phyogs zangs sgo 'di: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs bar: srung zhing nub kyi sgo mtshams chod: oṃ tsak+ṣu mu ta rā dza pad+ma āt+ma ko3 haṃ: zhes brjod cing phrin las bcol/ oṃ bi ru pāk+ṣā ya swā hā: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brtan bzhugs bya/ byang gi tho rtsar 'khod la/ mchod gtor rnams/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod nang du: oṃ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo'i rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dang*/ gtor gzhong rat+na'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum dang bcas pas brlabs/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas yi ge phuḥ'aphros pas ne'u ler gyur: de yongs su gyur pa las rnam thos sras ljang gu ne'u le 'dzin pa gnod sbyin gyi 'khor gyis bskor ba'i thugs ka dang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ri rab kyi byang phyogs nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rgya dang bcas/ hūm̐: gsang bdag spyan sngar dam mnos shing : bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa: rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras: 'dir gshegs rten la brtan par bzhugs: badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ bai shra ma ṇā ya swā hā: lan bdun/ oṃ ma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ya shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: rtsa sngags mthar/

oṃ bai shra ma ṇā ya i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ hūm̐: byang phyogs rgyal po rnam thos sras: sgra mi snyan la dbang bsgyur tshe: gnod sbyin 'bum dang dbang ldan bcas: dgra bgegs tshar gcod mthu bo che: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: khyed kyis byang phyogs lcags sgo 'di: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs bar: srung zhing byang gi sgo mtshams chod: oṃ bai shra ma ṇā rā dza karma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: zhes brjod cing phrin las bcol/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇā ya swā hā: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brtan bzhugs bya'o/ gnyis pa bar mtshams la gnyis/ dam sri mnan pa sgo byang gdab pa'o/ dang po ni/ stobs chen ma hā ba la'i lto bar khro zhal nang du liṅga bri ba dang bskyed pa sogs gsungs kyang spyir btang du dug shog la dam sri liṅga bya mchu can yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa'i snying khar dza tri na tri dza kha sprod mthar mgrin pa nas brtsams te yig mgo phyir bstan pa/ yamadamasriyamaparimāradzadzaḥ nananan/ tri'utri'umārayanamashodzaḥ khuganan/ zhes dang gzugs kyi mthar yig mgo nang du bstan la/ dusadrugadangabacurargyuba'inyulaledamasrirgyala'agonga'abyungapo'itshogasadangabacasapa'ilusangagayidagasumamathustobasathamasacadanonacig bskalapastongagibaradumaldangazhig om̐lam̐hūm̐lam̐satwaṃbhayanan/ zhes pa rnams kyi mthar dza khram gyis bskor ba bris la/ 'gugs stim ling khrus sogs bya tshul gong du bsal ba ltar sngon du song nas 'dre lteb tu bcag cing tshon skud kyis bcings/ thod ngan nam khyi thod lta bur bcug phung ras kyis dril la rtsang gis gzir ba'i mnan chas bya/ sgo drung du dong gru gsum brus pa la bkod/ slob dpon gyis gser skyems thogs la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs la/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang : bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha: khyad par bde gshegs bka' 'dus lha tshogs rnams:

gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: ma mgon lcam dral dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu yab yum sras: bka' nyan bran g.yog mngag gzhug bcas rnams kyis: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs kyi srung ma dang : sa phyogs 'di yi yul gzhi gnas kyi bdag: lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lha: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: ces pa'i tshig mtshams gsum la gser skyems phul/ de nas pad+ma drag por gsal gdab la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ phaṭḥ.āḥhūm̐: phaṭḥ e yaṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ/ mdun du las kyi gshin rje kha tham nag po sa rim pa dgu'i bdag po nag la 'jigs shing srog la rngam tshul can/ 'chi bdag kha shin tu gdangs pa'i nang du na nag po yongs su gyur pa las dug gi rus sbal nag po khang sgrom gyi dbyibs can/ de'i dbus su tri nag po las dam sri pho mo mdog mi sdug cing sngo ham pa mya ngan gyi gzugs can rid cing nyam thag pa'i gzugs can du gyur/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang*/ chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i? khyad par bla ma bde gshegs rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ sprul pa yang sprul phyag brnyan dang bcas pa rnams kyi? bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis dngos grub la bar du gcod pa'i ya ma dam sri mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la mchis par gyur cig tri yaṃ dzaḥtri badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan gsum gyis 'gugs gzhug byas la/ 'og gi 'don tshig dang bstun te skyer phur sor bzhi pa gdab/ thun rdzas brab/ gu gul bdug /dur rdo la ri rab gling bzhi dang rgya gram bris pas mnan la/ hūm̐: dam sri bya ba'i las ngan 'dis:

rdo rje slob dpon sku la bsdos: mched lcam rnams la gnod cing bskyal: rgyal khams kun tu mi dge btang : gsang sngags lam gyi sgo yang bkag: bka' 'das nam yang ma btang bas: da ni khro bo'i phur tshogs gdab: thun tshogs gdab ste dud tshogs gtibs: gtub cing srin po'i zhal du bstab: ri rab brjid pa'i 'og tu mnan: zhes mthar 'bebs ring 'og tu sa chu me rlung rim pa bcu gsum re dang sāts+tsha nag pos mnan/ hūm̐: gcig ni brjod med nyag gcig rgya: gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgya: gsum pa sku gsung thugs kyi rgya: bzhi pa phyag rgya bzhi yi rgya: lnga pa ye shes lnga yi rgya: drug pa pha rol phyin drug rgya: bdun pa yan lag bdun gyi rgya: brgyad pa rnam thar brgyad kyi rgya: dgu pa theg pa rim dgu'i rgya: bcu pa khro rgyal bcu yi rgya: khyod la rgya bcus bcings te gdab: ri rab brjid pas steng nas mnan: dpa' bo'i bro ra byas te brdungs: bskal pa bye snyed mtha' ru mnan: oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ satwaṃ bha ya nan: 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du khro rgyal 'khor bcas bzhugs par bsams la/ hūm̐: bde gshegs rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du: grub thob rgya mtsho'i bro brdungs pas: ye shes lnga ru lhun gyis grub: mu kha chos 'byung khri rkang du: rdo rje mchu yi bro brdungs pas: rigs drug 'khor ba'i rgyud lam gcod: las mtha' rnam bzhi'i dal dbus su: so so'i phrin las bro brdungs pas: rang rang gzhung bzhin lhun gyi grub: bro yang ye shes chen po'i bro: glu yang ye shes chen po'i glu: gar yang phyag rgya drug gi gar: gdangs yang ma 'gags rig pa'i sgra: de ltar brda dang rten 'brel gyis: sna tshogs las kun lhun grub shog: oṃ āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: sgab 'dre 'byung po thams cad satwaṃ bha ya nan: mched lcam rnams mtheb chung lu gu rgyud du sbrel te bro brdung hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod do/

gnyis pa sgo byang phyi nang gnyis las/ phyi'i sgo gong du ra yi sog pa'am ro ras la sogs par dbang chen rta mgrin yab yum la bya khyung sde lngas bskor ba snying po 'dod gsol bris pa dang skyer phur la snying po bris te rgyab tu btags pa bkod/ dmar gtor dang mchod yon sogs bshams la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas bhan+dha'i snod du mchod lha dngos po'i 'dod yon gyi rnam pa ma tshang ba med par 'char bas nam mkha' gang bar gtor snod bhan+dha 'bar bar gtor rdzas oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las 'dod yon phung po zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod kyi gter du gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ so so'i las sngags kyis bsang*/ oṃ h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las dbang chen rta mchog pad+ma he ru ka sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag g.yas rdo rje nam mkhar gdeng zhing g.yon pas lcags sgrog thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyi gseb nas rta skad 'tsher bas snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dbang du sdud cing zhal gdangs shing ljags 'dril bas phung 'dre dam sri rgyal 'gong gi snying khrag gsol ba/ zhabs gyad kyi dor stabs kyis dam sri pho mo mnan cing*/ yum phag mo gri thod 'dzin pa mgul nas 'khyud pa/ 'jigs byed bya khyung rigs lngas dbur brgyan cing*/ sa bdag klu gnyan zil gyis gnon pa/ sku la dur khrod chas kyis brgyan cing me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na 'gyings pa'i gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes pa badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ hrīḥpad+ma kro ta h+ya ghṛ ba hūm̐: lan bdun/ ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/

hūm̐: dpal chen pad+ma dbang gi lha: che mchog yongs 'dus gtso bo che: las kyi khro bo mi bzad pa: bdud bzhi'i dpung 'joms khrag 'thung sku: dmar nag rdo rje lcags sgrog 'dzin: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril srid gsum g.yo: rab 'jigs gyad kyis dor stabs tshul: dbang sdud dmar mo gri thod 'dzin: 'jigs byed bya khyung sde lngas bskor: gser mig zangs rwa lcags sder bgrad: klu gnyan sa bdag gnyen po che: rgyal 'gong dam sri'i snying khrag 'thung : dbang chen dregs pa khro chen tshogs: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs bar: bar sgo srung zhing gshegs mtshams chod: oṃ pad+ma ta kri ta h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra wā ra hī ga ru ṭa yak+sha badz+ra kro ta hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed dam sri u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa sa ma ya satwaṃ: zhes lan gsum bzlas nas me tog 'thor zhing*/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+raḥ sa brtan bzhugs bya/ zhes phyi'i sgo srung gi gzugs cing sgrub khang sgo yi ya them la zla ba/ ma them la nyi ma/ g.yas su g.yung drung*/ g.yon du 'khor lo bris te bkod la/ hūm̐: steng phyogs zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la: 'og tu nyi ma'i sa gzhi bdal: g.yas su rlung gi g.yung drung la: g.yon du sa yi 'khor lo ste: 'byung ba'i kha sbyor srung ba'i gur: su yang bgrod par mi nus so: dam sri 'byung po mtshams chod cig:

de nas nang sgo'i shing byang la/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sku sngags 'dod gsol skyer phur sngags ldan bcas bkod la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas bhan+dha'i snod du mchod lha dngos po 'dod yon gyi rnam pa ma tshang ba med par 'char bas nam mkha' gang ba gtor snod bhan+dha 'bar bar gtor rdzas oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las 'dod yon phung po zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod kyi gter du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ so so'i las sngags kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i gdan la bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang nag g.yas bum pa 'khor lo g.yon rgya gram thogs pa yum gri thod 'dzin pa sbyor te bzhengs pa'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li hūm̐: lan bdun/ ar+ghaṃ? sogs/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ hūm̐: khro chen 'bar ba bdud rtsi 'khyil: dpal chen las kyi he ru kaḥ sngo sangs thabs shes phyag rgya yis: bum pa 'khor lo rgya gram 'dzin: mi bzad zad med bdud rtsi 'khyil: dam tshig yum chen gri thod sbyor: khro bo'i rol stabs stangs stabs brjid: ye shes dam tshig mkha' 'gros bskor: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: khyed kyis sgo mtshams 'di srung zhing : dngos grub phyi ru ma gtong zhig: sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi mdzad cing : las kyi rtags rgya 'di srungs shig: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li ha ri ni sa baṃ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: zhes dang tiṣ+ṭha badz+raḥ sa brtan bzhugs bya'o/ sgo byang gnyis ma 'dzoms pa'am bsdu na phyi sgo'i rta mgrin kho nas chog go /sgo them gyi nang du brub khung zhig gi nang du zan ling la seng ldeng ngam skyer pa'i phur bu'i dbal la mi g.yo ba'i sngags dang*/

mgul du rgya shog la sgo 'di'i yan chad su yang ma 'da' zhig ces bris te btags pas rgyas btab/ sgo 'di'i yan chad su yang ma 'da' zhig: ces brjod/ gsum pa gsang mtshams la gnyis/ ma traṃ bsgral ba dang khro bcu'i phur gdab bo/ dang po rang rgyud kyi ma traṃ bdag 'dzin gyis 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i nga bdag bsgral ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gzhir ma traṃ gi gzugs brnyan mgo lho nub tu bstan pa gan rkyal du bzhag /stegs bu'i shar ngos slob dpon zhal nub tu phyogs te phyag tu g.yab dar dril bu bsnams nas stong thun zur gsal ltar bshad pa'i rjes su las sngags/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ.āḥhūm̐: ces brjod la/ bdag nyid las kyi he ru ka khro gtum bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i skur gyur par bsam/ ma traṃ ka ru tra dzaḥ lan bdun brjod/ na mo: dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang*/ chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ khyad par du bla ma bde gshegs rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ sprul pa yang sprul phyag brnyan dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ rnam pa ma traṃ ru tra/ ngo bo dngos grub la bar du gcod pa'i bdud dang log 'dren thams cad ma traṃ ru tra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ tri yaṃ dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes bkug ste gzugs la bstims nas/ hūm̐: ma traṃ bya ba'i sdig can khyod: sngon yang sgrub pa kun la bsgribs: sngon tshe dpal chen he ru kas: bsgral nas dur khrod chen por byas: khungs dang rdzas bcas gang las byung : khungs dang rdzas bcas bdag las byung : bdag med stong pa'i tho bas gzhom: oṃ ma hā shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma kau3 haṃ: ma traṃ ru dra dzaḥ

ā kar+sha ru dra dzaḥ kha traṃ ru dra dzaḥ zhes pas chos dang gang zag gi bdag chad par lta ba rnams gzhom pa'i don du/ ma traṃ gi gzugs de nyid slob dpon gyi zhabs g.yas pa'i dor stabs kyis mnan la/ hūm̐: ma traṃ bya ba'i sdig can khyod: rol pa'i stabs kyis mnan pa ni: 'jigs byed chen po he ru kas: mgo ni lho nub mtshams su bstan: rkang pa byang shar mtshams su bstan: khro rgyal zhabs ni g.yas g.yon gyis: gyad kyi dor stabs tshul du mnan: oṃ ma hā shrī he ru ka dṛ sh+ya hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ: ma hā de ba ru tra dza dzaḥhūm̐: zhes lan bdun bzla zhing thams cad kyi lag g.yas kyi sor mo gsum sbreng ba kha ṭ+wāṃ gyi rgyas snying khar bsnun tshul byas la/ gzugs phung hrul gyis zhig: ma rig sgo lnga'i sbubs dang bral: rnam shes tri nag por gnas pa'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis sbyangs pas hūm̐ yig dkar por gyur bdag gi thugs kar thim nas gnyis su med par gyur par bsam zhing*/ las kyi rdo rjes ma traṃ gi lhu tshigs so sor phral nas snying shar/ mgo bo lho/ nang khrol nub/ mtshan ma byang*/ lag g.yas shar lho/ lag g.yon lho nub/ rkang g.yon nub byang*/ rkang g.yas byang shar bcas stegs 'og phyogs mtshams so sor bkod la/ hūm̐: ma traṃ bsgral ba'i phung po ni: gnyis med ral gris dum bur gtub: cha brgyad bgos pa'i dur khrod brgyad: snying shar dur khrod bsil ba tshal: mgo lho dur khrod sku la rdzogs: nang rol nub tu pad+ma brtsegs: mtshan ma byang du laṅka brtsegs: lag g.yas shar lho lhun grub brtsegs: lag g.yon lho nub gsang chen rol: rkang g.yon nub byang he chen brdal: rkang g.yas byang shar 'jig rten brtsegs: ma traṃ bsgral ba'i rdzas brgyad la: dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad bsgom: khog pa gzhal yas khang du bskyed: srog rtsa rnal 'byor bzhugs par bsgom: slob dpon shar du gnas pas bh+rūm̐ dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍal bh+rūm̐:

thugs ka nas bh+rūm̐ 'phros khog pa la thim pas khog pa dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang dur khrod brgyad rwa ba me dang bcas pas bskor bar gyur: thams cad kyi lag g.yas phyi dang lag g.yon nang du byas pa'i khu tshur dpung mgor bsnol zhing*/ hūm̐ pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ces lan bdun bzlas nas rgya bkrol te/ dkyil 'khor gyi sgo shag gis phye bar gyur par bsams la/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon 'gros gar gyis/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: ha ha ha: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces brjod nas dkyil 'khor g.yas su lan gsum bskor nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang du tshud par gyur: zhes brjod la stegs bu'i dbus kyi khri'i khar slob dpon zhal shar du phyogs par bzhugs pa'i mdun du seng ldeng gi phur bu tsan dan dmar pos kha bsgyur zhing rtse mor me tog phreng ba bcings pa bcu bshams/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad dang shar nub rnams su phur gdan bcu bkod la/ rang gi thugs ka nas hūm̐ yig bcu spros phur bu rnams la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las stod khro bo'i gzugs can smad phur bu 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du gyur par bsams la/ thams cad hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang*/ sum+bha na ི'i sngags kyis phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bkug pa la slob dpon gyis lag g.yas tho ba dang g.yon pas phur bu bzung la/ hūm̐: steng 'og phyogs mtshams 'jig rten kun: zhe sdang rdo rje bla na med: sku gsung thugs sprul stobs dang ldan: ta krita khrag 'thung khro rgyal bcu: 'jigs tshul rngam pa'i stangs stabs kyis: gdug pa'i tshogs rnams brlag par mdzod: dur khrod gsang ba'i gnas mchog 'dir: rang byung khro rgyal chen po bcu: log 'dren bdud bgegs mtshams gcod phyir: khro bcu'i phur pa gdab par bya: steng gi phur bu shar gyi shar nas brtsam g.yas su rim par/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā kro ta hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭḥ

shar/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la: ma hā kro ta bi dza ya hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ shar lho/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā kro ta nī la daṇ+ḍa hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭḥ lho/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā kro ta ya mān+ta ka hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭḥ lho nub/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā kro ta ār+ya a tsa le hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ nub/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā kro ta h+ya gh+ri wa hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ nub byang*/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā kro ta a pa rā dzi ta hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭḥ byang*/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā kro ta a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ byang shar/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā kro ta trai lokya bi dza ya hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ 'og gi phur bu nub kyi mdun du/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: ma hā kro ta ma hā bā la hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces 'bar ba'i stangs stabs dang bcas steng gi phur bu shar gyi shar/ shar nas shar lho sogs rim gyis byang shar bar g.yas bskor dang*/ 'og gi phur bu nub kyi nub tu gdab pas/ bgegs rnams kyi snying phug nas g.yo 'gul med cing 'od gsal bar gyur par bsam zhing*/ phur bu las byung ba'i 'od zer srung ba'i 'khor lo 'khrigs pas phyogs mtshams thams cad khyab par bsam/ zhes dang*/ spro na las gzhung nas 'byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi tshig brjod cing bsrung bya srung byed thams cad las 'das pa de kho na nyid kyi srung 'khor yang bya/ bzhi pa rten gyi dkyil 'khor bca' ba la/ thog mar chag chag gdab pa ni/ dung phor ram ka pā lar bdud rtsi rnam pa lngar sbyar ba'i dri bzang gi chus dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi la rdo rje khu tshur gyis byang shar nas g.yas bskor du khyab par khyams med par byugs shing*/

hūm̐: dam tshig rdo rje ye shes gsang ba'i chu: rnam dag yon tan dri ma med pa'i rdzas: smon lam dbang gis byang chub sems bskyed mchog: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor sa gzhir chag chag 'debs: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya maṅga la a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐: zhes brjod cing zhi rol bya/ de nas thig tshon bya ba la/ rgyas pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor sogs spros bcas bya tshul gzhan du shes par bya'o/ 'dir ras bris tsam du rten 'brel mtshon pa'i thig chen brgyad sogs mdor bsdus phyag len mdzad srol ltar sa gzhi 'jam zhing lag mthil ltar mnyam par bya/ hūm̐: bkra shis lha mo dge ba'i grogs: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem tshe 'dzin ma: kun gzhi lhun grub dkyil 'khor la: rig pa rdo rje'i thig thob cig: oṃ bh+rūm̐ dz+nyā na saṃ tri ta dha ra swā hā: zhes slob dpon nub dang rig ma shar du byas la rdor dril dang bcas pa'i ngang nas gung mos thig skud bzung*/ 'og nas gyen du gcus te se gol gtog pa dang bcas/ bh+rūm̐ dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍal la phaṭaḥ zhes brjod/ dang po slob dpon nub/ rig ma shar byas pas tshangs thig dang po gdab/ gnyis pa slob dpon lho ru gnas pa la/ rig ma rgyab 'gros dang bcas byang du 'khod pas tshangs thig gnyis pa gdab/ gsum pa slob dpon g.yas bskor gyis shar lho dang rig ma nub byang la 'khod pas zur thig dang po gdab/ bzhi pa slob dpon lho nub dang rig ma byang shar la gnas pas zur thig gnyis pa gdab pa ste rgyab 'gros spangs te g.yas bskor gong dang mtshungs/ lnga pa log thig bzhi las slob dpon rgyab 'gros dang bcas shar lho'i phyogs su bzhengs la/ rig ma byang shar du gnas bzhin pas shar gyi log thig dang po gdab/ drug pa rig ma sngon dang slob dpon gnyis ka'i rgyab 'gros kyis slob dpon nub byang dang rig ma lho nub tu 'khod pas nub kyi log thig gnyis pa gdab/ bdun pa slob dpon nub byang du gnas bzhin rig ma rgyab 'gros kyis byang shar du 'khod nas byang gi log thig gdab/
