brgyad pa slob dpon sngon du rgyab 'gros kyis shar lho dang rig ma'ang de bzhin rgyab 'gros kyis lho nub tu 'khod de byang gi log thig btab la/ mthar slob dpon nub dang rig ma shar du 'khod pas thig skud slob dpon gyi phyogs su bsdu bar bya'o/ lnga pa sta gon la bzhi/ lha yo byad bum pa slob ma sta gon la gnas pa'o/ de'ang slob ma la dbang bskur dang 'brel na de rnams skabs dang sbyar/ ma 'brel na mi dgos mod/ 'on kyang yo byad sta gon ni nam du'ang dgos pas sgrub rdzas tshang bar bsags la thams cad kyang ye shes kyi rnam rol 'ba' zhig tu mos pas byin gyis brlab pa yin pas gzhung ltar du byas pas tshang la skabs 'dir/ dang po lha sta gon ni gtso bor dkyil 'khor bri bar gnang ba zhu ba'i don yin pas grub na legs pa las lhag skyon du mi 'gyur bas de ltar na/ dkyil 'khor bya ba'i stegs bu'i dbus gtso bo'i gnas su bdud rtsi dri bzang sbyar ba'i chab kyis thig le byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sa ma ya satwaṃ: zhes dbus dang phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi zur bzhi bcas tshom bu bcu gsum bkod/ phyi nang gi mchod gtor bshams la/ las byang 'bring po bder 'dus sam bsdus pa rtsa ba gcig dril ltar mchod pa byin brlabs nas dam tshig pa bskyed/ phyag mchod bstod pa'i bar du song nas thams cad kyis thal mo sbyar te/ hoḥ dus gsum bla ma yi dam lha: yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs: mkha' 'gro dam can ma lus dgongs: dkyil 'khor bzang po legs bris nas: bdag cag bsnyen sgrub las gzhung bsrang : sta gon la ni gnas par mdzod: lan gsum brjod/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis se gol gsum byas la/ lha rnams bar snang 'od kyi drwa bar bzhugs par bsam/ tshom bu mchod gtor rnams bsdu'o/ 'dir yang las byang gi mngon rtogs rgyas pa mi lcogs pa lta bu la/

sgrub pa'i gzhir rang byung ye shes kyi gzhal med khang chen por lha tshogs dwangs pa'i mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba ltar skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/ ces gdod nas grub pa'i sems kyi dkyil 'khor gsal btab la mchod bstod byas pas kyang chog go /gnyis pa bum pa sta gon ni/ sgrub pa'i mthar slob ma la dbang bskur min gang ltar yang*/ bum pa sta gon dgos pas/ bum pa lha grangs sam rnam bum dang las bum tsam 'du bya/ drag sngags yungs thun gyi brab/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdug la bgegs bskrad/ khrus kyis sbyangs/ gtso bo'i snying po brjod la nang bcud mgul chings kha rgyan ldan pa bkod/ mchod pa bshams shing byin gyis brlab/ bum pa bsang sbyang*/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ paṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas yi ge yongs su gyur pa las: bum pa mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan pa: lto ba che zhing lhun rgyas pa: kha g.yer la bkra shis pa'i rdzas rtags mtshan pa: mchur 'dod yon nar ma'i bu ga rab tu 'phyang ba: zhabs bde ba'i bcud chags 'dzag med gzhum zhing mdzes pa: kha rgyan dpag bsam shing dang sgro phod lnga ldan mtshan pa'i tshom bus rnam par spras pa: de yi nang du bh+rūm̐ dang hrīḥ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes yig 'bru sa bon phyag mtshan yongs su gyur pa las: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la gu ru bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi cha lugs rdzogs pa: yum gsang ba ye shes 'khril zhing longs sku'i mtshan dpes rab tu brgyan pa'o: de yi phyogs bzhir sgo ma rigs bzhi'i brdas bskul ba las: oṃ sa ma ya hoḥ oṃ sa ma ya satwaṃ: rā ga ya hoḥ rā ga ya mi: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pas thugs dam bskul: dga' chen khyab brdal gyi phrin las rtsal du mngon: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes pas rgyal ba rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros pa wal gyis gsal bar gyur: oṃ gu ru dz+nyā na dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ye sarba dha ra hoḥ

zhes thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul bas slob dpon yab yum las mchod pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams rang bzhin gsal ba'o: slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la phog: phyogs bcu'i rigs lnga lha yi gtso bo 'od dpag med bcas zhing khams lha rnams kyis dbang bskur khrus bstsal sku gang dri ma dag: chu yi lhag ma yar lud pa las: snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dzaḥ a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: zhes lha tshogs de rnams gsal ba dang : bdag mdun gnyis su mched pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer sna tshogs spros pas rgyal ba ye shes kyi thugs dam bskul: rtsa ba'i sngags phreng 'phros pas gzung thag gi lam du brgyud: bum lha'i zhal du zhugs: thugs kar thim pas sngags phreng rnams 'od zer cha tshang 'khor: gnyis mched pa'i gtso 'khor thams cad mnyam du 'khor: dkyil 'khor phyi nang mu mtha' thams cad yongs su khyab snang srid la phog: skye 'gro spyi dang bye brag thams cad tshe rabs nas bsags pa'i rnam smin thams cad bsregs: lus shel sgong ltar gyur: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje'i byin brlab par gyur pas ye shes lnga yi yon tan cig car du rdzogs: slar yang thugs rje'i shugs dang byin rlabs kyi dngos grub thams cad tshur 'dus bum pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim pas gzi brjid 'od du 'bar bar bsgom: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐: hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya tsit+ta hring hring dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐:

bum sgrub sngags ni: oṃ gu ru ḍāk+ki pad+ma dha ra ha ri ni sa hūm̐: yang dril: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki ka lak+ṣa hūm̐ hrīḥ zhes pa'i sngags brgya phrag re la dung zhal rdo rje'i kha chod can gyi rdzas rnam bum gyi lha la dbyer med bstim: hūm̐: dam tshig ye shes chen po brtan pa'i phyir: a haṃ rang sgras bskul ba'i snying po sngags: zung 'jug zag med lha yi ngo bor gsal: mchod 'bul bde stong dga' bzhi'i dgyes gyur cig: oṃ a haṃ ku mu ṭa la hoḥ zhes pas bstim: mthar dbyangs gsal dang yig brgya rten snying bcas bzlas/ mchod pa kha gso/ gtang rag bgyi ba ni/ hūm̐: dri med dag pa gtsang ma'i chab: rgyal ba'i sku la byi dor phyir: lha yi khrus gsol ci bzhin 'bul: de bzhin legs gtsang zhabs bsil pa: yan lag brgyad ldan dri med 'bul: sa gzhi srid pa med pa'i khyon: ljan ljin la sogs bral ba'i phyir: de bzhin zhabs bsil legs par 'bul: rgyal ba ye shes lnga ldan phyir: gang gis srid pa 'ching bral ba: dri spos rang bzhin rgyud ldan kyang : byugs pa dam pa 'bul bar bgyid: de bzhin zhing dang zhing khams su: ji snyed bde bas rab g.yo bas: mchog dang thun mong zhing khams su: rnam par bkod pas yongs su brgyan: me tog bdug spos phye ma phur: mar me'i phreng ba yol bas brgyan: ji snyed zhing rdul brtsegs pa'i khyon: de snyed bdag gis 'bul lags kyis: sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyi dpal gsol: oṃ sarba ku mu ṭa gan+dhe bha tra sarba me gha la ye shrī hoḥ rigs lnga'i dbyangs bstod ni: hūm̐: chos sku'i rang bzhin mtha' bral ye shes klong : longs sku'i mtshan nyid sna tshogs 'dzin bral po: sprul sku ji snyed 'gro ba'i mgon mchog che: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha la bstod par bgyi: sarba pu ru sha ya hoḥ zhes bstod la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i mchod yon phul bas lha rnams 'od du zhu ba bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur:

las bum ni/ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang pad+mar gnas pa'i khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog ljang sngon phyag gnyis thal sbyar gyi bar du bum pa bsnams pa khro bo'i chas thams cad kyis brgyan par gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: de las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs: badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ar+ghaṃ? sogs kyis mchod/ ham̐'u: 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms byed pa/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas thugs rgyud bskul zhing*/ sku lus las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te bum pa gang bar mos la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ci nus bzlas mthar/ khro bo 'od du zhu ste chur thim pas de'i rdul phra rab kyi grangs snyed pa'i khro bor gyur te phrin las mdzad par mos la/ gsum pa slob ma sta gon ni gsham du gsal/ drug pa rgyan 'god pa ni/ dkyil 'khor sgrom gzhi btsugs pa'i bang rim gong mar gu ru'i sku tshab mthong grol dang sku gsung thugs rten byin rlabs can dang*/ bar ma'i dbus su dbang bzhi'i rten rnam rgyal bum pa mgul chings dmar po kha rgyan can/ de dag gi mtha' bskor du dbu rgyan/ rdor dril dang rdor dril bsnol ma/ gsang sher gyi rten thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba'i khar chos 'byung dar dmar brgyad ltebs khar me long sin+dhu ra byugs pa la chos 'byung bsnol ma'i dbus su mūm̐ḥyig dang zur bzhir thig le dga' 'khyil gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng tshig dbang ngo sprod kyi rten rang byung shel rdo zur drug pa/ sman sgrub dang 'brel na sman gyi pho brang pho mo'i thod pa kha sprod dam ma rnyed na par bu kheb ldan dbu rgyan dang rdor dril sogs kyi chas su bcug ste bzhag

/gzhan yang dbang chen in+d+ra nī la ltar gyi lha tshom yongs rdzogs sam/ bsdu na bum dbang ye shes 'od kyi drwa ba'i lha tsaka rgyas bsdus rab gnas ldan pa dang*/ gsung rten sngags byang gser ram mtshal gyis bris pa'i byang bu/ thugs rten phyag mtshan sogs dbang chas cha tshang tshe 'brang tshe ril tshe chang mda' dar bcas bzhugs su gsol la gzung thag gis bsgril/ rgyab ngos su dbang gtor/ bang rim 'og ma'i dbus su ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor dkram pa'i mtha' bskor shar du mchod yon nas brtsam ste nyer spyod/ rdo rwa'i steng khro bcu'i phur pa/ sgrom ngos bzhir phyi nas rim pa bzhin du ye shes lnga mtshon byed dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i yol ba bris pa'am/ yang na sku gsum mtshon byed dkar mar mthing gsum dang*/ tha ma gang yang rung ba gcig gis dkris shing yol ba'i phyi thams cad dar sna lnga'i drwa phyed bar bar du gsang sngags bla med kyi dam rdzas kyi mtshon phyir rus rgyan zhing chung gi 'phen/ rgyu rlon lda ldi mi mgo'i drwa ba sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i rdzas kyis kyang brgyan/ stag sham gyi sgab skor rdul len zur bzhi mda' dar sna lnga dngul dkar me long brgyan pa dang*/ phyogs bzhir ral gri bzhi/ steng du zur bzhir rgyal mtshan/ logs bzhir 'phan bzhi/ steng na dar gyi gdugs phub/ phyi rol bang rim thog ma'i mdun ngos su/ dbus su bla ma/ g.yas su yi dam/ g.yon du mkha' 'gro/ mtshams bzhir las bzhi gtor ma/ bang rim bar ma'i khar phyogs bzhir dbus su rmad byung bskang ba'i gtor ma dang*/ chos srung gzhi bdag rnams kyi gtor ma dkyil 'khor gyi g.yas g.yon rgyab rnams gang bder bsham/ g.yas su bdud rtsi dang bskul gtor dang chad tho/ g.yon du brtan skyong dang rak+ta rnams bsham/ spro na sbyor ba mtshon byed zan la nyi zla kha sbyor gyi rnam pa steng ma dkar po dang*/ 'og dmar po bgyis pa dang*/

dkar yol la sogs bzang po'i snod 'bri mog gi kha bsgyur ba/ byang sems dkar dmar gyi rnam pa dang*/ bang rim gsum pa la phyogs so sor phyi nang gi mchod pa nyer spyod sna bdun sman raka /bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid sna bdun/ skyems kyi bye brag dang*/ tshogs kyi yo byad kyis mtshon phrin las la dgos pa rnams dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi byang phyogs su lcags hom du nyul le'i liṅga/ las phur bsgral chas yungs dkar sogs thun rdzas rnams kyang 'du bya/ de dag gi bsham bkod kyi tshe sgrub rten rnams rgyan bkod tshig dang bstun te 'god cing*/ rdo rje slob dpon yab yum dang rgyal tshab/ rigs bzhi'i rgyal theb bcas pa rnams kyi sgrub rten dang*/ dbang rdzas rnams dang*/ gzhan rnams kyis rgyan bkod mchod gtor la sogs thogs te/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis dril spos 'dzin pas thog drangs ser sbreng gis dkyil 'khor la g.yas bskor lan gsum byas te/ mdun du 'khod la dbyangs dang bcas te tshig dang mthun par phul la rang gnas su bkod/ hūm̐: bkra shis pho brang bum pa'i gzhal yas khang : mi 'gyur rnam dag rgyal ba'i gnas su gsal: zhi khro'i lha dang dbyer med bzhugs su gsol: me long bdud rtsi dri med dag pa'i rdzas: dam rdzas gtor chen rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskang : phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas sprin ltar gtib: rdo rje dril bu thabs shes gnyis su med: rnga dang ḍā ru dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i rdzas: phur pa ral gri'i bar chad srung bar byed: mda' dar me long longs spyod rgyan rnams rdzogs: tshon skud sna lnga'i drwa ba drwa phyed sbrel: yol ba bla bre 'phen gdugs cod pan dang : bdud rtsi sman raka dngos grub 'byung ba'i rdzas: yid 'ong rig ma mtshan ldan bde ba'i lam: ging pho ging mo bar chad srung ba'i chas: spos dang mar me zhal zas yo byad rnams: thams cad yongs rdzogs lhun grub chen por shar:

pho brang gzhal yas rab tu rgyan bkod pa'i: phrin las rnam bzhi'i yon tan rab rdzogs shog: ces dbyangs dang zhi rol bcas bya zhing sgrub rdzas rnams/ las rdor sogs kyis nor 'khrul med cing bag dro lhun chags dwang ba 'dren par bkod/ mchod pa rnams la spyi khyab tu/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phros/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te/ /dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes su gsol/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo? zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas mkha' khyab tu spel bar bya'o/ rten rnams sbyang ba ni/ sbyang chas bran la/ a kā ro mu? gsum gyis byin brlabs la/ gtor ma g.yas su bskor zhing*/ sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu kha bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ ghṛh+na daṃ bha ling+ta ye swā hā: ting lo g.yon du bskor zhing*/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni? sogs kyi snod du dor la/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang : yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong mthu rtsal gyi: dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs: log par 'dren pa bdud kyi tshogs: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: na mo: drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : gsang sngags rigs sngags gzung sngags snying po sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi bka' bden pa dang : khyad par du bla ma bde gshegs rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang : bden pa chen po'i mthus sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i log 'dren thams cad gtor mas lam rgyag ting lo lam gron gyis la dpag tshad rgyang grags su ma nye bar dengs shig: gal te mi 'gro na ye shes rdo rje me rab tu 'bar bas bsregs shing brlag par gdon mi za'o:

zhes hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod rol mo bsgrags yungs thun brab gu gul gyis bdug gtor ma phyir dor/ me long du bum pa shar ba la las bum gyi chus khrus gsol zhing*/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la yo byad thams cad dang ldan pas sku khrus gsol bar bgyi'o/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa/ /shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar/ rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan/ /mu tig 'aud chags bla res bres pa der/ /de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus/ yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ ji ltar bltam pa tsam gyis kyang*/ sogs? oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐: 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan: thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med: byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te: ci 'dod dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te? sogs/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba bder 'dus thod phreng rtsal: mtshan brgyad rje 'bangs dus gsum gter ston sogs: dngos su zung 'jug sprul pa'i 'khor lo la: snod bcud bag sgrib sbyang phyir khrus gsol lo: gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bder 'dus rig 'dzin ye shes klong dgu'i gar: kun bzang rigs lnga zhi khro dpal chen lha: rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la: srid gsum snang ba sbyang phyir khrus gsol lo: gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐ rgyal ba kun 'dus bde chen 'od kyi rtsal:

sku gsum mkha' 'gro zhing skyong ḍāk+ki'i tshogs: snod bcud zhing khams gcig tu rdzogs pa las: 'byung 'khrug rten 'brel sbyang phyir khrus gsol lo: gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i phrin las thogs med shugs: mthu stobs gzi 'bar ma mgon lcam dral sogs: dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor la: dug lnga dgra gdon sbyang phyir khrus gsol lo: gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos: gtsang la dri rab gus pas sku phyi'o: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ kā ya bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: bdun pa tshogs sgrub kyi las la 'jug rung gi bya ba sgrub pa po rnams mnga' gsol zhing gnas su dgod pa ni/ las kyi rdo rjes thod chang yar bzed nas tshig dang bstun nas so so la bdud rtsi drang ba sogs lag len ltar byas la/ thog mar rgyal thebs kyis stong thun zur gsal ltar sngon du 'gro bas dbyangs bor len gyis/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas gdung 'tshob rdo rje rgyal po 'di: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las rdzogs: dug lnga rtsad gcod dngos grub kun 'byung gnas: ston pa'i sgron mer mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: zhes dang rgyal tshab la/ hūm̐: bla ma'i gdung 'tshob sku gsung thugs kyi sras: dam chos char 'bebs tshe dang dngos grub spel: dbang bskur phrin las rnam bzhi mthar phyin pa: rgyal tshab ston par mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: yum la/ gnyis med bde skyed mtshan nyid rab tu bzang : kun bzang yum du mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: rdo rje las sar/ phrin las gzhung bsrang bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin mdzad: rdo rje karma mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: ging la/ bar gcod bgegs bsgral gzugs phung lha la stob: rdo rje ging mchog mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: mtshams par/ phyi nang mtshams gcod bar chad thams cad srungs:

rdo rje mtshams par mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: spyan pa/ dngos grub bgegs gnyis dus dang drod tshad mkhyen: rdo rje spyan pa mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: dus mtshams par/ phrin las skabs sbyor dus 'dzin nam tshod mkhas: rdo rje dus mtshams mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: phyag tshang par/ phud gtsang g.yos mkhas phyi nang bya byed mkhas: rdo rje phyag tshang mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: byan pa pho mor/ gsal dag dzap mkhas dad ldan brtson par bzhugs: gser phreng mched lcam mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: rdul phyags pa la/ kun gyi bka' sgrub phyi yi nyul le skrod: rdul phyags skyes bu mnga' gsol dgyes par bzhugs: zhes so sor mnga' gsol zhing rang gral du 'khod pa las nam yang ma 'khrugs par bya'o/ de'i rjes 'brel du chas su zhugs shing rtags gdab dgos pas chas rnams las rdor sogs kyis thogs/ rgyal tshab pas gtong thun sngon du 'gro ba'i dbyangs bor len tshul gyis zhi chas la/ hrīḥ rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'bras bu'i lam zhugs pa: rtags kyi phyag rgya bder gshegs dngos su gsal: dbu rgyan cod pan phreng ba dang : do shal dpung rgyan se mo do: stod g.yogs smad dkris sham bur ldan: phyag gdub zhabs gdub rab tu spras: dri mchog ngad ldan brgyan pa po: 'dod yon ma spangs rang grol rgyan du bzhes:

khro chas la: hūm̐: don dam spros med sgyu ma'i khong gseng nas: ye shes lnga ldan thod pa'i dbu rgyan gsol: 'khor ba ma spangs mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol: skye 'chi rtsad gcod thal chen tshom bu gsol: sku gsum lhun grub thod phreng tshar gsum gsol: cis kyang mi shigs rdo rje'i go khrab gsol: ma rig nags sreg ye shes me dpung gsol: zhing bcu yongs sgrol dpal gyi chas bcu 'di: dbang phyug chen po'i sku la rgyan du bzhes: zhes rjes zlos bcas tshig dang bstun nas dpal gyi chas rnams las kyi rdo rjes rgyal tshab par rim par phul la rdo rje slob dpon sogs thams cad kyi gnas so sor bgo zhing rgyan pa'i tshul bya'o/ brgyad pa brda sbyar ba la/ brda sgo dbye zhing brda phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: rang rig gdod nas kun 'dus rtsa ba gsum: sku lnga lhun grub 'du 'bral mi dmigs kyang : bar du shes bya phra mo kun bslang tshogs: da ni rmongs gzhom rang rig brda sgo phyes: gdod nas rang byung lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor mjal ba'i sgo glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri mas bcad pa rig pa ye shes kyi brda mjal bas lhag ge phye bar bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ces brda sgo dbye/ rang snang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor ci ltar shar yang rang rig las gud du med pa'i gnas lugs chu la chu bzhag pa lta bur rtogs pas brda bstod ni/ hūm̐: ma rig ka dag klong thim g.ya' bral phyir: tshe rabs gnyug ma'i rang rig lha zhal mjal: 'dus ma byas 'di gshis lugs mchod sprin bstod: nam yang bag yod mi 'da' chos 'khor bskor: oṃ badz+ra dharma shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na tsakra hūm̐: dgu pa bsre bsnan bya ba ni/ skabs 'dir dbang ma thob pa'i mched gsar bu rnams dkyil 'khor byang shar lta bu logs su phye/ slob dpon gyi mdun rdor dril bdud rtsi yungs thun sogs bkod nas/ bdud rtsi sman mchod ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/

kun bzang yab yum rdo rje 'chang chen dang*/ /snang ba mtha' yas dgongs brgyud bla ma la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal ba rigs lnga sogs/ /rig 'dzin brda brgyud bla ma thams cad la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ dga' rab shrī sing rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung*/ /bka' bab lung chen tshig brgyud bla ma la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal sangs rgyas ye shes dang*/ /rtsa gsum gling pa gter brgyud bla ma la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ thugs mchog rdo rje dkon mchog seṅge dang*/ ye shes rgyal mtshan mi 'jigs rdo rje sogs/ /dbang lung man ngag don brgyud bla ma la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ thod phreng sde lnga lha lcam mtsho rgyal dang*/ /rnam rol mtshan brgyad rig 'dzin 'dus pa la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ yi dam rta phag rigs gsum mgon po dang*/ /dngos grub stsal ba yi dam 'dus pa la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ ging dang dpa' bo laṅka gnas nyul sogs/ /grub gnyis char 'bebs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ mgon po sde lnga dregs sde sa ya dang*/ /bka' gter srung ma dam can rgya mtsho la/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul/ sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi/ sku gsum mi shigs rdo rje'i klong*/ /ma bcos mchog gi dngos grub kyis/ /bdag rgyud sku gsum snying por grol/ /bde gshegs go 'phang myur thob shog

/ ces dang*/ slob dpon gyis/ bdag nyid las kyi dpal chen he ru kar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas ya las lcags kyi sdig pa mgo dgu rwa bco brgyad pa 'phros: de las ye shes kyi me 'bar bas slob bu'i sdig sgrib thams cad sreg par gyur: par bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra yak+sha kro dha ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzla zhing yungs thun gyis brab/ drag sngags yungs thun gu gul dud pa rol mo sogs 'tsham rngam gyis bgegs bskrad/ gsar bu rnams kyi rgyud sbyang ba'i phyir rjes zlos byar gzhug ste/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum brten pa'i zhing gyur la/ /gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*/ /dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la/ /dag pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo/ tshe rabs bgrang ba'i las rnams kun/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ slob ma rnams kyis snying gar ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba re yod par bsgom: byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi rdo rje'i lce thog tu lan gsum bzhag nas/ hūm̐: ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang : byang chub sems dang rdo rje 'dzin: de bzhin sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa: de dag la ni snying ring na: rdo rje yak+sha gnod sbyin gyis: khyod kyi snying la zhugs te 'thung : snying la yang dag gnas pa'o: 'di ni sems can dmyal ba'i chu: dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed: dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni: rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub: ces bdud rtsi byin pas slob mas kyang*/ i dan+te na ra kan sa ma ya yak+sha hūm̐:

zhes myong la snying ga'i ye shes sems dpa' la thim nas dbyer med du gyur par bsam mo/ 'dres gral bsnan pa'i rgyal tshab pas bdud rtsi g.yon bskor du gsar rnying thams cad la bran zhing*/ gtso sngags dzap dbyangs lan gsum mjug tu 'jam rol dang bcas pas bdud rtsi myong nas thams cad kyis/ oṃ: dpal ldan sangs rgyas sku 'chang ba: rdo rje mi phyed sku dang ldan: deng bdag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: rdo rje sku yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: āḥ dpal ldan sangs rgyas gsung 'chang ba: rdo rje mi phyed gsung dang ldan: deng bdag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: rdo rje gsung gi dngos grub stsol: āḥsarba ta thā ga ta wāk+ka badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: hūm̐: dpal ldan sangs rgyas thugs 'chang ba: rdo rje mi phyed thugs dang ldan: deng bdag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: rdo rje thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: zhes dang slob dpon gyis/ deng phyin chad mched gsar rnying thams cad skal ba mnyam zhing dam tshig gcig tu 'dus pa yin pas dam tshig gzhung bzhin du bsrung bar gyis shig: ces bsgo/ thams cad kyi phyag thal sbyar gyi bar me tog bzung nas/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje slob dpon dang : dam tshig 'brel ba'i mched dang lcam dral gyis: sgrub mchog rnams su byin gyis brlabs pa yi: bka' drin rjes su dran phyir gtang rag gtong : zhes drin lan gyi me tog 'thor/ de nas rdo rje'i gral du bzhag pa ni/ mched gsar pa rnams rang rang gral du 'khod nas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ hūm̐: rdo rje 'du 'bral med pa'i gzung thag la: dam tshig srog gis bsdus pa'i mched dang lcam: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub 'thob bya'i phyir: thams cad dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog: ces brjod de dam tshig gi bslab bya rgyas par bya/

de nas thams cad lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐: zhes rdo rje thugs kar gsor ba dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hūm̐: zhes dril bu dkrol zhing dkur brten/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: zhes thugs kar 'khyud rgya byas la dril bu dkrol ba dang*/ rol chen brgya brdung sogs/ rol mo sgra cher bsgrag go /bcu pa lha bstim zhing byin dbab pa ni/ rang gral nas dkyil 'khor la phyogs par bzhengs la/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi lha tshogs rnams sprin gtibs pa bzhin byon nas rang rang gi gnas su bzhugs par bsam zhing rol mo bcas pas/ hūm̐: spros med rtog bral mkha' dbyings dag pa nas: skye med rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs mnga' ba: 'gro don rang byung bcom ldan thugs rje'i lha: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs yab yum sras 'khor bcas: stong nyid dbyings nas thugs dam rgyud bskul gyi: sprul pa dbyings nas rol zhing gshegs su gsol: ces dang gtso 'khor sngags mthar/ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhanaḥ zhes btags pa brjod/ gong du sta gon byas nas nam mkhar bzhugs pa de nyid dkyil 'khor la bstims par mos/ bsdu na spyan 'dren bskos gdab 'dir ma byas kyang chog go /byin dbab pa ni/ 'brel dang byin rlabs che ba nyang gter bde 'dus las 'byung ba ltar na/ sgrub pa po rnams zhwa chos sogs gzi byin bskyed de dkyil 'khor la bskor/ dar sna'i g.yab mo sogs dang spos dud dbyangs rol bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: 'og min bkod pa rab rdzogs lhun grub zhing :

lnga ldan zang thal 'gyu ba'i pho brang nas: rigs 'dus rgyal ba rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams: 'du 'bral med par thugs rje'i shugs mtshon nas: gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin chen myur du phob: mchog thun 'bad med lhug par deng stsol shog: hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams: chos sku skye ba med pa las: gzugs sku 'gro ba'i don bgyid phyir: gnyis med dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: rnal 'byor rig 'dzin sgrub pa por: dngos grub ma lus char ltar phob: lha dang rig 'dzin srung ma'i tshogs: sprul pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs nas kyang : dngos grub ma lus char ltar phob: dbang mchog ma lus bdag la bskur: sku yi gar stabs glog ltar 'khyugs: gsung gi nga ro 'brug ltar ldir: thugs kyi brtse bas bdag la dgongs: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin cig phob: sgrub rdzas rnams la byin gyis rlobs: gzhal yas 'di la brtan par bzhugs: mthu dang rtsal gyi nus pa phyungs: rtags dang mtshan ma dngos su ston: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sa ma ya a be sha ya a āḥ spro na byin 'bebs tshangs pa'i gaṇ+ḍi 'dir bya/ mthar rol 'og dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum byas te gnas dang sgrub pa po dkyil 'khor yo byad dang bcas pa la byin phab nas sku gsung thugs ye shes chen po'i rol par gyur bar bsams la rang gral du 'khod de 'dzab dbyangs lan gsum dang*/ sta dngos ma sbrel na bdag bskyed bsdu ldang bsngo smon rgyun spyod sogs byas pas grub bo/ de nas sta dngos nyin gcig la sbrel ba'i dbang du byas na las byang bder 'dus kyi ting 'dzin rnam gsum nas brtsam bstod pa'i mthar/ bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe hūm̐ phaṭ dzaḥ sa rten par/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā phaṭ dzaḥ sa brten pa'i lha/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor las ye shes kyi 'khor lo logs su phyes te mdun gyi nam mkhar me ri 'dab sbyor gyi tshul du bzhugs par bsam mo/

zhes se gol gtogs pas gsal gdab la bdag mdun dbyer med du dmigs nas dzap bskul dang dzap dgongs gzhung bzhin byas la bzlas par 'jug /bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi mthar bsnyen bstod mdor bsdus bya/ de rjes ā li kā li'i yig brgya bcas kyi lhag chad kha bkang*/ de nas spyi dang bye brag chos srung gi gsol kha grub nas/ bshags skong rig 'dzin srog sgrub sogs nas las gzhung gi tshogs la 'jug /'di nas bzung ma grol bar lhag ma btson du 'dzin/ tshogs smon gyi mthar gtor 'bul dang chad brtan rta bro mchod bstod bzod gsol grub nas brtan bzhugs bsdu ldang bsngo smon shis brjod bar bya/ skabs 'dir nyul le bskrad pa dang byin 'bebs rnams gsham gsal bzhin bya zhing 'dzab dbyangs bcas tshogs mang grol/ 'di nas bzung thun bzhi ma chag par byed dgos pas mtshan thun bzung ba sogs gsham gsal ltar shes par bya'o/ de dag ni dmigs bsal dngos sta sbrags ma'i dbang du byas pa yin no/ ༈ gnyis pa lha dang dbyer med du byed pa sgrub pa dngos la gsum/ 'dzab dgongs bzlas pas dngos grub sgrub pa de'i bar gcod bsal ba/ dus grangs rtags tshad kyi rim pa'o/ dang po ni/ phrin las dang 'brel dgos pas las gzhung nyid nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum ste dus drug /'bring nyin lan gnyis mtshan lan gnyis te dus bzhi/ tha mas kyang nyin mtshan gnyis la tshar re bsrang dgos pas/ thun dang po la rnam 'joms nas bzung*/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ sku gsum gsol 'debs sogs nas theg chen dgu ldan/ gnas ri so dgu bcas chos spyod zur gsal ltar byas la/ las gzhung gsol 'debs mthar skye ba kun tu?myur thob shog nas snyan gsan rol mo brdung*/ de nas bsam pa lhun 'grub ma'i las byang chog khrigs ye shes sprin phung skyabs sems nas brtsam sngon 'gro rnams rgyas par btang*/ dngos gzhi ting 'dzin gsum gyis bdag mdun dbyer med du bsgoms la ye shes 'khor lor bstim zhing mchod bstod bya/

bzlas pa'i mgor dzap khang phyes te dzap dbyangs lan gsum bcas gzung thag blangs/ de yang nyin dang por gzung thag gnyis ka slob dpon la phul nas mthar bsdu ba'i skabs las rdor gyis las kyi gzung thag bsnyen rgyun par gnang srol 'dug /bdag mdun gnyis kar spro bsdu'i dmigs pa dang bzlas pa rgyun mi chad par bya dgos pas/ bsnyen rgyun pa rnams kyis kyang 'di nas bzung mthar ma grol gyi bar du bsnyen pa'i rgyun mi gcod/ grub na thun rer lha'i rgyun khyer lta bu'i mngon rtogs gsal gdab la sngags rgyun blang*/ thun mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying rnams kyis lhag chad kha bkang zhing nus pa brtan par byas la stong tshig phul nas nyul le bskrad gzir dang byin 'bebs mthar rol 'og dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum byas te gnas dang sgrub pa po dkyil 'khor yo byad dang bcas pa la byin phab nas sku gsung thugs ye shes chen po'i rol par gyur bar bsams la rang gral du 'khod de 'dzab dbyangs lan gsum mthar grol lo/ de dag gis thun dang po grub/ thun gnyis pa la mchod kha gsos te mchod pa byin rlabs nas bsnyen pa yan las byang bder 'dus ltar mthar chags su btang*/ stong tshig phul/ rgyal chen kha gso zur gsal ltar bya/ nyul le bskrad gzir dang byin 'bebs pa sogs sngar ltar ram stabs bde byed na/ rdo rje mtshams pas gu gul dud pa dang thun brab ste dkyil 'khor bskor la drag sngags so lnga pa dang*/

oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ badz+ra dha rod ā dz+nyā pa ya ti sarba bigh+nān kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces sder mo'i sngags drag tu brjod pas tshar bcad la srung 'khor gsal gdab pas don 'thus so/ mthar byin 'bebs rgyas pa'am bsdus pa ni/ 'phags mchog thugs rje'i dus la bab/ khyad par bstan pa'i dus la bab/ /mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la bab/ /byin gyis rlobs pa'i dus la bab/ /dbang mchog bskur ba'i dus la bab/ /dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab/ /mthu chen bdud 'dul bcom ldan 'das/ /byin chen byin phob bcom ldan 'das/ /dbang chen dbang bskur bcom ldan 'das/ /dngos grub mchog stsol bcom ldan 'das/ /bdag cag las 'bras mchis par mdzod/ oṃ dz+nyā na a be sha ya āḥ ra ra ra ra tsa la ya tsa la ya hūm̐ a ha dzhaiṃḥ des thun gnyis pa grub/ chos skyong sde lnga sogs rang lugs bka' gter srung ma'i gtor chog sogs rgyun ltar bya'o/ thun gsum pa yang de dang mtshungs la las byang bsdus pa rtsa ba gcig dril bzlas pa stong tshig bcas grub pa dang*/ de nas na raka skong bshags dang gtor bsngo rig 'dzin srog sgrub spyan 'dren bar song nas/ tshogs byin mchod nas phyi snod srid gsum sogs gtor bsngos mthar dbyung*/ skong ba rgyas bsdus nas tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma btson du 'dzin/ bskul chos skyong gtor 'bul dang las gzhung chad brtan rta bro bya/ skabs 'di tsam nas rgyal thebs pa dang ging pa sogs kyis bsgral ba'i bya ba la 'jug pa'i phyir zhwa phod sogs bzhes par phebs/ mchod bstod gzhung ltar bya/ nongs bshags dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying lan gsum gsum brjod brtan bzhugs bya ba ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/

khyad par du bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad ji srid 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du rdul tshon yin na/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ma byas kyi bar du mchan/ de srid du brtan par bzhugs nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol/ om̐ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: zhes 'bru 'thor/ bsngo smon rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa dang*/ ye dhār shis brjod bcas grub nas rol mo rgya cher bya'o/ gnyis pa dngos grub la bar du gcod pa bsal cing byin rlabs gzi byin dbab pa ni/ slob dpon nam rgyal thebs bzhengs mdun du hom khung du/ nyul le'i liṅga bcas pa dang*/ las phur thun rdzas rnams dgod la/ rten bskyed pa ni/ e yaṃ dz+wa la raṃ: brub khung yangs shing gting zab pa'i nang du tri las dngos grub la bar du gcod pa'i log par lta ba'i 'byung po nyul le bdud kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad rid kyang nyam thag pa'i lus can du gyur par bsams la: na mo: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : gsang sngags dang rig sngags gzungs sngags dang snying po dang phyag rgya dang : ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang : chos nyid gdod nas stong kyang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa dang : khyad par bla ma bde gshegs rtsa gsum bka' 'dus dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang : bden pa chen po'i mthu la rten nas dngos grub la bar du gcod cing log par 'dren pa'i 'byung po nyul le bdud kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la mchis par gyur cig: tri yaṃ dzaḥ tri badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

zhes lan gsum gyis 'gugs gzhug byas la/ phur thun tshom bur bskor ba ni/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings nas rang byung grub pa'i lha: khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: shin tu mi bzad khro gtum skur bstan pa: dpal chen yongs rdzogs drag po'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: nga ni dpal chen he ru kaḥ sras 'khor sprul pa bye ba 'bum: bka' sdod rab 'jigs pho nyar bcas: drag po'i lha tshogs dus la bab: g.yas kyi phyag na phur pa 'dril: g.yon gyi phyag na lcags kyu 'gugs: lcags kyus zungs la phur pa thob: gnod byed dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta rang nyid srung phyir spyi bor lan gsum bskor/ pad+ma kro ti shwa rī byad phur bzlog phyir sked la lan gsum bskor badz+ra kī li kī la ya dgra bgegs sgrol phyir mdun du lan gsum bsgril ma hā yak+sha pho rgyud zil gnon g.yas su lan gsum phyar kā la rū pa g.yas su lan gsum bsgril karma raṃ raṃ mo rgyud dbang sdud g.yon du lan gsum phyar dz+wa la raṃ g.yon du lan gsum bsgril hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed dgra bgegs 'byung po thams cad mā ra lag g.yas rdo rje g.yab dar dang bcas pa'i dbye bskrad kyi rgya dang ldan pas ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ tshe khrus lung gsum gyi dmigs pa dang ldan pas phur bu dgra bgegs kyi snying khar gdab bo/ ces drag sngags phur skor byas pas gdab cing thun gyis brab/ khyad par dpal gyi pho nya kun thabs rgyal mo bskul ba ni: hūm̐: shar phyogs dkar mo dung gi gzhal yas nas: khrag mdog dmar mo bswe yi lan phran can: spyan rtsa dmar zlum nyi ma'i zer ltar 'phro: smin ma glog 'khyug bar snang go skabs 'gyed: bu yug thog 'bebs shangs nas rdo rje 'khrug: bzhad pa he dang dpal gyi spu gris gtams: rngam pa'i ljags 'dril bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: ag tshom me 'bar rab 'byams srid pa sreg:

bskal pa'i 'brug sgra snyan nas 'brug stong sgrogs: lag pa dmar po spu gri 'bum gyis gtams: sen mo lcags kyu'i rtse la me chen 'bar: ba spu gnam lcags zhun ma'i rdo rje 'khrug: smin mtshams lcags kyi khro chung char 'bebs shing : zhabs kyi phur pas srin mo lnga brgya gzir: ral pa'i gseb nas khrag gi char pa 'bebs: shin tu mi bzod gtum chen khrag 'thung ma: srin mo'i snying 'byin changs par bcug nas gsol: shin tu mi bzad 'bar ba'i sku gcig ma: dpag tshad lnga brgyar rgyug cing klu srin sgrol: khros pa'i zhal mdog khrag gi mchin pa kha: na bza' dmar po srin gyi g.yang gzhi gsol: phyogs bcur kha bltas phyogs skyong zhabs kyis mnan: bdud la bab na snying khrag dron mo gsol: srin la bab na srog rtsa dmar po gcod: dgra la bab na dug gi kha chu 'debs: bgegs la bab na rū pa rdul du rlog: dpal gyi pho nya dpal gyi thugs las sprul: dam nyams dgra dang 'byung po bgegs la sogs: phung po dum bur gtubs la don snying sregs: dam nyams nyul le'i bar chad rdul du rlog: hūm̐ gru bu gru bu a pa tse: ru pa tse: na ra tse: tsa me thun thun: nā sha ya: na sha satwaṃ bha ya: yak+sha byi na: yak+sha byi na: phye ma phye ma: rdul phran rdul phran: tsit+ta rbad nan: oṃ sum+bha ni? oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya prā ma rā dza trig nan: dha na rak+sha rbud ling : tri'u tri'u ma ma na ya sho na dza mā ra ya rbad rbad: drag sngags spos rol dang khyad par gyi dbyug pas brdeg cing thun gyis brab la srung 'khor gsal gdab pas don 'thus so/ de ma thag dngos grub ster ba'i ltas 'byung bas byin rlabs dgos par gsungs pas chas sogs sngon bshad ltar byas la thog mar/ hūm̐: bzhengs shig pad+ma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dgongs shig phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs rnams: rje btsun chen po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i gnas nas gshegs su gsol:

dbu skra mdzes pa'i thor tshugs shigs se shig: rin chen rgyan cha mang po si li li: dur khrod rus pa'i rgyan cha khro lo lo: sgra dang rol mo mang po 'u ru ru: yi dam lha tshogs hūm̐ sgra di ri ri: mkha' 'gro sde lngas gar byed shigs se shig: ging chen dpa' bos bro rdung khrabs se khrab: ma mo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar thibs se thib: chos skyong sde brgyad las byed khyugs se khyug: zhub chen stong gi sgra skad si li li: g.yas na pho rgyud thams cad sha ra ra: g.yon na mo rgyud thams cad sha ra ra: bar snang thams cad dar gdugs lhabs se lhab: dri zhim spos kyi ngad ldang thu lu lu: mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda skad di ri ri: ging chen dpa' bo'i bshug glu kyu ru ru: hūm̐ gi snang glu mang po di ri ri: phaṭ kyi brda skad drag po sangs se sang : bdag dang 'gro drug sems can thams cad la: thugs rjes gzigs la gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: gnas 'dir thugs rjes dgongs te gshegs nas kyang : bdag gis byang chub snying po ma thob par: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad 'dul ba dang : mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: zhes sngon du 'gro la byin 'bebs pa ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams: chos sku skye ba med pa las: gzugs sku 'gro ba'i don bgyid phyir: gnyis med dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: rnal 'byor rig 'dzin sgrub pa por: dngos grub ma lus char ltar phob: lha dang rig 'dzin srung ma'i tshogs: sprul pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs nas kyang : dngos grub ma lus char ltar phob:

dbang mchog ma lus bdag la bskur: sku yi gar stabs glog ltar 'khyugs: gsung gi nga ro 'brug ltar ldir: thugs kyi brtse bas bdag la dgongs: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin cig phob: sgrub rdzas rnams la byin gyis rlobs: gzhal yas 'di la brtan par bzhugs: mthu dang rtsal gyi nus pa phyungs: rtags dang mtshan ma dngos su ston: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: sa ma ya a be sha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ a āḥ spro bar mos na gzhung gi byin 'bebs tshangs pa'i gaṇ+ḍi 'dir byas la dpon slob rnams kyis rol 'og tu dkyil 'khor la lan gsum bskor zhing dzap dbyangs lan gsum du gyer ro/ ye shes pa brtan pa'i phyir me tog 'thor ba ni/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs: rten 'brel dam tshig rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor la: brtan par bzhugs kyang byin gyis brlab tu gsol: 'grub par gyur cig badz+ra sa ma ya: oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: mtshan thun gsum por 'don 'grig nyin thun gnyis pa dang mtshungs la thun mjug so sor nyul le bskrad gzir dang byin 'bebs pa ma chad par bya la mjug tu dzap dbyangs bcas grol lo/ spro na shar phyogs dkar mo'i gong du gsang zil las byung ba'i gnas nyul rang lugs ltar na/ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ: hūm̐: ma 'di nas gnas chen bye ba stong dang phrag: rtsub 'gyur me ri rab tu 'bar ba yi: zla ba dkar mo khro chu khol ma'i klong : nyi ma dmar ser rak+ta 'khrigs pa'i dbus: ljang nag rlung ri bu yug 'tshubs pa'i dkyil: ti ra pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: las kyi ging chen yab yum bcu gnyis te: ye shes ging chen dkar gsal drag tu 'khros: g.yas g.yon phyag na gri gug thod khrag bsnams: rdo rje ging mo myur mgyogs chu shel mdog: phyag na g.yang gzhi bhan+dha rlon pa thogs: tho rangs nam langs rnal 'byor drod tshad nyul: rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis ma thogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐:

mnyam nyid ging chen ser nag mi sdug gzugs: g.yas g.yon phyag na 'khor lo thod khrag dkrugs: rin chen ging mo gser mdog 'od kyis 'gengs: g.yang gzhi bhan+dha thogs shing stong khams 'grim: nyi shar nyi dros rnal 'byor drod tshad nyul: rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis ma thogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: sor rtog ging chen dmar nag srin po'i gzugs: g.yas g.yon phyag na me thun bhan dmar thogs: pad+ma ging mo zangs mdog mche ba gtsigs: g.yang gzhi bhan dmar 'dzin cing tshogs khang nyul: nyin phyed phyed yol rnal 'byor drod tshad nyul: rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis ma thogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: bya grub ging chen ljang nag khrag 'thung gzugs: rdo rje phur pa 'dzin cing nyon mongs bsgral: las kyi ging mo rlung mdog shugs ldan ma: g.yang gzhi bhan dmar rak+ta dkrug cing 'thung : nyi thal mun 'tshub rnal 'byor drod tshad nyul: rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis ma thogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: chos dbyings ging chen mthing nag gtum pa'i gzugs: g.yas g.yon phyag na gri thun gri zor 'dzin: bud+dha ging mo lcags mdog 'khrul snang gzhom: g.yang gzhi bhan dmar 'dzin cing stong gsum g.yo: srod dang srod 'khor rnal 'byor drod tshad nyul: rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis ma thogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: 'gyu byed ging chen nag po dug gi gdong : g.yas g.yon phyag na spu gri lcags kyu 'dzin: sha za ging mo mun pa'i zug rngu can: g.yang gzhi bhan dmar 'dzin cing dpag tshad khyab: nam phyed phyed yol rnal 'byor drod tshad nyul: rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis ma thogs gshegs su gsol: gnas bzang dur khrod 'grim phyir gshegs su gsol: sha khrag gsur mchod bzhes phyir gshegs su gsol: oṃ ghṛ wa ṣa ṭa kro ta dza dzaḥ hūm̐: bskul lo ging chen pho mo rnams: mdzod cig nyon mongs bdud bzhi thul: rbad do rnal 'byor nyams grib sol: brten no nyon mongs zug ngu sregs:

'bod do dkyil 'khor mu ran skyongs: rnal 'byor dam tshig chag nyams rnams: bshags so rkyen ngan bar chad sol: hūm̐: ging chen lha tshogs dus la bab: nyon mongs lhong gsum dgra dar na: ging chen thugs dam dus la bab: dam tshig gnas nas bskul ba'i tshe: ging phos rdo thun sha ra ra: ging mos me zor wa la la: dmar nag ral pa sa la gzhol: mi lpags g.yang gzhi shams se sham: rgyu ma'i zhags pa na ra ra: stag lpags sham thabs khrigs se khrig: rngam rgyug gar stabs lings se lang : rkang gling phaṭ sgra 'u ru ru: bshugs sgra ljags glu kyu ru ru: bgegs bskrad gad mo lhangs se lhang : phyi yi rnam rtog bdud dgra chom: nang gi nyon mongs bdud dgra chom: gsang ba'i na tsha rkyen ngan phrol: dug lnga'i 'khrul pa da shigs la: nga bdag 'gong po dbyings su sgrol: dam sri gnod byed rmang nas phyungs: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sgrub pa'i bar chad thal bar rlog: oṃ kro ta ghṛ wa hūm̐ hūm̐ gnod byed nyon mongs bdud thams cad gardza gardza phaṭḥ oṃ kro ti shwa rī ghṛ ni bh+yoḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel ngan pa thams cad da ha da ha dz+wa la raṃ: zhes thun brdeg cing me zor ram me bshur btang*/ de nas sgrub pa ma grol bar bgegs che na/ dus bcu gnyis sam/ drug tu cha yang gsal 'bud pa re re btang bas gegs sel lo/ de bzhin tshogs sgrub kyi skabs 'byor mkhos can gyi spros pa rgyas par byed na nyams chag bskang ba'i phyir rdor sems 'khor 'das rang grol dang*/ bar chad bsal ba'i phyir rdo rje mtshams pa rnams zur du bzhag nas yang phur las byang rgyas bsdus gang rung gi dkyil 'khor zur du bsgrub la so so'i khrus dang bgegs bskrad pa'i las dang rgyal tho gso ba rnams mdzad srol yod pa ltar grub na legs so/ rgyud las/ 'khor la bka' bsgo dge sbyong bskul/ zhes khyad par du gsungs pas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis sgrub mched rnams la skabs skabs su blang dor gyi bslab bya dang dam tshig bshad nas/

bskyed bzlas kyi dmigs pa go sla don 'dus bshad grub na legs pa'i yan lag go /gsum pa ni/ dus grangs rtags gsum las/ dus ni smin slob la zla ba drug /mos slob kyi dbang du byas na zla ba gcig gam/ zhag po bdun nam nyin zhag gsum gyi mthar brten par bsgrubs pas kyang*/ dus dang dbang po dang mthun par dngos grub ci rigs pa thob par 'gyur bar gsungs so/ deng sang phyag len du spros bcas sgrub chen rgyas pa'i dbang du byas na sa chog nyin gcig /sta gon nyin gcig dngos gzhi nyin bdun/ rdul tshon chur gshegs nyin gcig bcas nyin bcu'am gzhan du sta gon nyin gcig /dngos gzhi nyin bdun te nyin zhag brgyad la grangs bzung srol yang yod/ rtags ni gsang ba spyi dang so so'i gzhung las 'byung ba ltar yin la/ gal te rtags tshad ngan pa byung na nyul le sprad/ rta bro brdung dam sel ltas byung na yig brgya bzla zhing bshags rgyud bklag /grib mi gtsang pa la rnam 'joms sme brtsegs saugs kyi bum khrus bya/ rtags tshad bzang ngan gang la yang re dogs dgag sgrub med par dbyings su bsre ba gnad yin/ dngos grub kyi ltas bzang nges pa can byung na de nyid du rgyun gyi dngos grub len pa gnad du che bas/ thod pa mtshan ldan chang dang chos sman sbyar bas bkang ba mdun du bzhag

hūm̐: bde gshegs rgyal ba ma lus dgongs su gsol: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i tshogs: lha yi dge bsnyen dam ldan thams cad kyis: tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor bdag cag la: tshe dang chos dang phrin las rnam bzhi dang : rkang mgyogs mig sman ril bu mkha' spyod dang : mthu dang rdzu 'phrul mngon shes nus mthu dang : srid nor zas dang 'dod rgu'i dngos grub stsol: a la la hoḥ zhes brjod la bdud rtsi myang ngo zhes gsungs pa 'di bzhin rgyun du phyag len gnang srol nyung bas ma byas kyang chog go /gsum pa bsgrubs nas dngos grub blang ba sgrub pa chen po'i las rim ni/ dang po sbyor sgrol la bsten pa yin kyang da lta mos slob tsam gyi skabs su rdzas la bsten nas blang ba la gsum/ dngos grub kyi rdzas bsham pa/ cho ga'i sngon 'gro/ cho ga dngos so/ dang po sgrub pa sang grol rgyu'i de ring dgong thun nas dngos grub blang ba'i rdzas bshams te/ dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du gzhi dkar po'i steng du gro yi g.yung drung g.yas 'khyil bris pa'i dbus su rin po che'i snod 'bru bzang gi phye ma mngar gsum dang*/ zho mar 'o mas sbrus pa'i 'brang rgyas nor bu 'bar ba'i gzugs dang*/ phyogs bzhi las bzhi'i 'brang rgyas bza' bca' sna tshogs pas bskor ba g.yas su mngar gsum thud dang bsres pa'i ril bu dang*/ g.yon du bhan+dha bzang por 'bru bcud bdud rtsi a mṛ ta btab pa'ang bsham/ dgong thun bzlas pa'i gsham du/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu grangs med pa 'phros mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas sngon gyi thugs dam rjes su dgongs te sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dngos grub thams cad 'od zer sna lnga'i rnam pas bdag dang sgrub pa'i rdzas la thim pas ye shes mchog gi gzi byin 'bebs par gyur/ bsnyen sgrub sngags/

oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta gu ṇa karma sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes btags pa brgya tsam bzla/ yang phyag len phal mo cher dngos grub kyi rdzas de nangs rang du bsham/ snga nub dmigs bzlas 'di mi byed pa'ang yod pas long skabs dang bstun chog /phyir nangs thor thun phrin las gzhung bsrangs te bsnyen pa'i mthar gong gsal ltar dngos grub kyi dmigs pa 'dir 'bog la dngos grub blang ba'i sngags btags pa bsnyen rgyun bsrang*/ mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying mchod bstod bcas bya/ de nas gtor bsngo tshogs mchod sogs bsdus tsam byed la tshogs tha ma'i skabs nyul le'i liṅga mer bsregs shing chos skyong gi gtor mar bstab/ gnyis pa dngos grub la mi dbang ba'i blta nyan gyi bgegs tshar gcod pa'i phyir/ las byang ltar bgegs bskrad cing rgyal thebs pas dkyil 'khor dang sgrub pa po rnams bskor bzhin drag sngags bzlas shing thun gyis brab la srung 'khor bsgom/ las kyi rdo rjes spos 'dren gyis sna drangs slob dpon nam rgyal thebs kyis zhwa chos g.yab dril bcas dkyil 'khor la bskor zhing byin chen dbab/ spyi bshags ye shes sku mchog lta bu brjod la 'khon bcugs sbyang*/ gsum pa dngos grub bskul ba ni/ lha dang rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dgongs: 'dir 'dus rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams: smin grol gnyis kyis rgyud sbyangs shing : bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis las gzhung bsrangs: bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi mtha' ru phyin: las dang thugs rje mthun pa yis: zhi rgyas dbang drag yid bzhin gter: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐ āḥ hūm̐: dngos grub bstsal dang stsol bar mi dmigs kyang : bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i thugs rje dang :

tshogs lam sbyor lam gnas pa'i rig 'dzin dang : bde gshegs yongs rdzogs rnams kyis zhal bzhes ltar: sgrub mchog bdag la sngon gyi smon lam mthus: tshe dang chos dang las bzhi lhun grub dang : rkang mgyogs mig sman ril bu mkha' spyod dang : srid dang zas nor mthu rtsal dngos grub stsol: sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ de ltar rtse gcig thugs dam rgyud bskul bas: rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor lha rnams mnyam sbyor ba'i: sbyor mtshams 'od zer dmar po phyogs bcur 'phros: 'gro drug sems can rgyud sbyangs mkha' khyab kyi: bde bar gshegs pa rnams la dgyes par bskyed: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi: dngos grub tshur bsdus bdag dang sgrub rdzas la: thim pas 'chi med bdud rtsi dwangs ma che: dngos grub kun gyi snying po 'khyil bar gyur: zhes gsal btab la bsnyen rgyun pa'i gzung thag bsdus te dngos grub kyi gzung thag dang lhan du slob dpon la phul/ bsnyen sgrub lha sngags ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ sham bur/ kā ya sid+dhi oṃ: wāk+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ṇa sid+dhi trām̐: karma sid+dhi hrīḥ sarba lo ka dz+nyā na sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes btags pa stong phrag gam brgya rtsa las mi nyung ba bzlas la/ dngos grub thams cad 'od zer 'ja' tshon lta bu'i rnam pa bdag nyid gnas lngar thim par gyur/ skya rengs 'char kha dang bstun sku gsung thugs rten rnam rgyal bum pa sogs sgrub rdzas las rdor gyis btegs la dngos grub len pa ni/ hrīḥ ye shes lus can 'gran du med pa yi: gzi brjid sku yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: tshangs pa'i dbyangs la chos kyi char chen 'bebs: nus pa sngags kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: gzungs dran ting 'dzin mkhyen brtse yongs kyi gzhi: 'od gsal snying po'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol:

yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam bum pa bzang : 'dod 'byung gter gyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: gdul bya so so'i mos pa ji bzhin du: thogs med 'jug pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: srung dang zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod sogs: thun mong las kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: mkha' spyod ril bu mig sman rkang mgyogs sogs: khyad par grub pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: tshe dang yo byad 'dod rgu bsgyur la sogs: phyi nang dbang bcu'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: mthong thos dran rig gdul bya smin cing grol: bla med mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: zhes dang rang gzhung gi dngos grub bskul tshig ni/ hūm̐: bstan pa 'di la ngo mtshar rmad byung ba'i: 'jig rten dbang bsgyur pad+ma rgyal po ni: rigs ni za hor rgyal po'i sras su 'khrungs: o rgyan yul du sgro 'dogs ma lus bcad: bsil ba tshal du dngos grub sna tshogs brnyes: wā rā ṇa sīr chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: rgya gar yul du bstan pa rgyas par mdzad: 'jig rten khams kyi gdug pa thams cad btul: bod yul dbus su rgyal po'i thugs dam bskangs: kha ba can du bstan pa rgyas par mdzad: lho nub mtshams su 'gro ba'i don du dgongs: sku tshab lung bstan gsung tshab gter du sbas: lho nub mtshams su 'gro ba'i don la dgongs: skal ldan rnams la zab gsang brda chos ston: zangs mdog dpal rir rig 'dzin gtso 'khor bzhugs: rnga yab gling du srin po'i kha gnon mdzad: 'jig rten 'khor ba ma stongs de srid bar: mya ngan mi 'da' thugs rje spyan gcig po: sku gsum dbyer med che mchog he ru kaḥ mnyam med bla ma mchog khyod dus 'dir dran: gsol ba 'debs so o rgyan rin po che: thugs rjes khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas sprugs: khyad par bdag sogs bod kyi rje 'bangs rnams: rtse gcig pha khyod yon tan dran pa yis: mo gus gdung bas 'bod pa cang gsan nam:

brtse chen thugs rje skyed cig mthu ma chung : bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: sku lnga rigs 'dus gu ru zil gnon la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus zhu: skye shi bral ba'i bde chen rgyal po la: lta ba'i gzhi rtsa chod pa'i dngos grub zhu: ka dag mngon rdzogs dpa' bo gyad kyi skur: g.yo med dgongs pa rang gsal dngos grub zhu: tshogs drug zhen bral dus gsum mkhyen pa la: spyod pa blang dor bral ba'i dngos grub zhu: 'byung lnga rang grol rdo rje rnal 'byor mar: blo bral chos zad 'bras bu'i dngos grub zhu: 'chi med mgon po 'phags mchog sman gyi lhar: tshe ring nad med bde skyid dngos grub zhu: 'dod rgu'i srid rje pad+ma rgyal po la: dgos 'byung lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub zhu: gsang sngags rig sngags khyab bdag gur gyi lhar: log 'dren bdud bzhi tshar gcod dngos grub zhu: drag sngags rtsal 'byin stobs ldan kī la yar: shugs sgrol phrin las mthar phyin dngos grub zhu: bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa brgyad skyob zil gnon lhar: skye 'gro bde la 'god pa'i dngos grub zhu: snang srid dbang bsgyur stag zhon yi dam lhar: chos ltar phyogs med thob pa'i dngos grub zhu: lha 'dre mi gsum 'dul mdzad nyi ma 'od: bzang ngan 'brel tshad don ldan dngos grub zhu: tshad med bzhi ldan dregs pa zil gnon lhar: dmod pa'i las kun gdung mchog dngos grub zhu: bla ma rig 'dzin zhi khro rab 'byams lhar: mngon spyod rdzu 'phrul thogs med dngos grub zhu: gnas yul skyong zhing dpa' bo ḍāk+ki la: rten 'brel phyogs med 'char ba'i dngos grub zhu: bka' nyan las byed chos skyong srung ma la: las bzhi thogs med 'grub pa'i dngos grub zhu: ye shes las grub dkyil 'khor thams cad la: snang srid chos skur 'char ba'i dngos grub zhu: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs:

bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: mos pas gsol ba snying nas btab pa'i mod: bde gshegs sgyu 'phrul dgongs pa gcig tu dril: sku yi gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum du 'char: gsung gi gdangs sgra 'brug stong ldir ba'i che: thugs kyi dgongs pa nam mkha'i glog bas myur: yon tan gdul bya'i rol pa ma 'dres gsal: phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam ris med brdal: 'gyur med rdo rje sku yi dngos grub stsol: nad gdon sdig sgrib rkyen ngan bral ba'i tshe: mi 'gyur g.yung drung lta bur lhun grub nas: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: 'gag med rdo rje gsung gi dngos grub stsol: ngag gi sgrib dag brgyad khri bzhi stong sgo: gdul bya so so'i skad du chos ston pas: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca āḥ 'khrul med rdo rje thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: yid kyi sgrib dag chos nyid bde ba che: dus gsum bstan pa'i bdag por lhun grub nas: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: yon tan rdo rje gzi brjid dngos grub stsol: shes bya'i sgrib dag sangs rgyas thugs rje rdzogs: 'khor 'das lhun 'byams zad med gter mnga' ba: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru gu na a bhi ṣiñca trām̐: phrin las rdo rje mthu stobs dngos grub stsol: rtog sgrib dag nas thabs shes dngos grub stsol: dgongs pas rgyas thebs gdul bya mthar phyin nas: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gu ru karma a bhi ṣiñca hoḥ hūm̐: bla ma rig 'dzin bde gshegs 'dus: dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs rnams kyi: bsnyen sgrub bzlas brjod mtha' ru phyin: rang nyid lha la lha nyid rang : rang byung lhan skyes ngo bo 'phros: bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i bye brag rnams:

sgyu ma tsam du sprul bsgyur nyid: don mthong ci bzhin lam du lhong : deng sang skya rengs dang po shar: rdo rje srin po nam langs nye: dngos grub 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: rgyal ba'i thugs dam gnas nas bskul: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bzhi stsol: rtsa gsum lha dngos bdag gyur cig: oṃ kā ya sid+dhi: wāk+ka sid+dhi: tsit+ta sid+dhi: gu na sid+dhi: gu h+ya sid+dhi: sarba sid+dhi ā bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: zhes brjod pas sgrub rdzas bum pa bhan+dha sogs dbang bzhi'i rdzas dang sku gsung thugs rten rnams thog mar slob dpon la phul zhing de nas kun la brim/ dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams bza' btung byas te longs spyod/ stan thog de nyid du dngos grub rnam gnyis bde blag gi tshul du thob par bsams la/ dgongs pa'i gdeng bzung ngo*/ gzhan don du dbang bskur na gtor dbang ye shes snying po tsam mam rgyas bsdus gang yin pa skabs 'dir sbrel lo/ rtsa ba'i gsum pa mtha' rgyas rjes kyi rim pa la gsum/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i rjes chog phyi mtshams bkrol ba slob dpon la sku drin gsol zhing smon lam dang shis brjod bya ba'o/ dang po ni/ dngos grub blang ba kho na'am dbang bskur grub pa'i rjes su/ rnying ma spyi yi phyag bzhes ltar bsnyen pa'i kha skong dang las thams cad myur du 'grub pa'i phyir zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg skabs 'dir bya srol yod pas grub na gal che'o/ yang spros pas lcog na thog mar sta gon gyi skabs drag po'i sbyin sreg dang sgrub pa nyin gsum par zhi ba'i sbyin sreg /drug par dbang gi sbyin sreg dngos grub blangs grub pa'i rjes rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bcas gnang srol yod la/ khag gcig dngos grub rjes las bzhi mchog dang bcas pa'i sbyin sreg lnga dus gcig tu gnang srol yang 'dug /mi nus pa rnams tha ma rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gcig kho nar mdzad pas 'thus par byed pa'ang yod pas spro bsdus so so'i nus tshod dang bstun pas chog go

/lhag chog btang zhing sngar btson du bzung ba'i lhag ma dang lhan cig sgrub khang lho nub gom pa bdun cu'i sar bskyal/ chos skyong gtor 'bul skabs su de dag gi gtor ma rnams yang thog lta bur 'bul/ chad brtan la rgyun bzhag gi gtor ma phyir bskyang zhing rta bro brdung*/ gtang rag gi mchod bstod rgyas par byas la nongs pa bshags/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor yin na brtan bzhugs bya/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ bdag gi rnal 'byor yang 'od gsal du bsdu zhing rgyun spyod go bgo ba ni/ hūm̐: ngar 'dzin rnam dag sgyu lus 'ja' 'dra 'di: bla med sku gsung thugs su rgyas btab nas: bden pa dbyer med lta spyod zung 'brel te: rgyun du 'gro ba 'dren pa'i spyod lam bya'o: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra hrīḥ.āḥ mi 'gyur mi shigs rdo rje'i gur: stong pa'i go cha bla na med: chos sku skye med rdo rje yin: mtshan ma'i spyod yul kun bcom nas: chos kyi dbyings su rgyas btab pas: sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs na: gnod byed bgegs kyis ga la mthong : hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: oṃ badz+ra kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta hūm̐: zhes rgyas gdab bo/ gnyis pa mtshams bkrol zhing dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ rgyal tho bzhi la zlum gtor bzhi sgo byang gnyis la dmar gtor re re dang*/ phyi mchod bcas bsham/ phyi rol shar gyi tho rtsar phyin te/ mchod pa byin rlob pa ni/ mchod gtor rnams/

oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang*/ thams cad stong nyid nam mkha'i ngang : bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod nang du: oṃ las phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs: so so'i lha mo'i rol par bcas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes dang*/ gtor gzhong rat+na'i gzhal yas su: gtor ma 'dod yon phung por spungs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum dang bcas pas brlabs/ oṃ dh+riṣ+ṭa rāṣ+ṭā ya ma hā bha ling+ta khā hi khā hi: lan gsum gyi gtor ma 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: hūm̐: rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung : dri za grul bum tshogs bcas rnams: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: shar phyogs phyi yi dung sgo phyes: dkyil 'khor bya ba mthar yang phyin: gtang rag mchod pas dgyes byas te: skye med chos dbyings ngang du bzhes: zhi ba'i las rnams mthar phyin shog: badz+ra muḥ sa gshegs/ de nas lho yi tho rtsar phyin la mchod gtor rnams/ byin brlab sngar ltar ram bsdu na/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ bai rū dha kā ya ma hā ba ling+ta khā hi khā hi: lan gsum/ ar+ghaṃ? sogs/ hūm̐: rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po: gshin rje me lha'i tshogs dang bcas: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: lho phyogs phyi yi gser sgo phyes: rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor mthar yang phyin: gtang rag mchod pas dgyes byas te: skye med chos dbyings ngang du gshegs: rgyas pa'i las rnams mthar phyin shog: badz+ra muḥ sa gshegs/ de nas nub kyi tho rtsar 'khod la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ oṃ bi ru pāk+ṣā ma hā ba ling+ta khā hi khā hi: lan gsum/ ar+ghaṃ? sogs/ hūm̐: rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang : srin po klu yi tshogs dang bcas:

gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: nub phyogs phyi yi zangs sgo phyes: dbang gi dkyil 'khor mthar yang phyin: gtang rag mchod pas dgyes byas te: skye med chos dbyings ngang du gshegs: dbang gi las rnams mthar phyin shog: badz+ra muḥ sa gshegs/ de nas byang gi tho rtsar 'khod la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇā ya ma hā ba ling+ta khā hi khā hi: lan gsum/ ar+ghaṃ? sogs/ hūm̐: rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras: rlung lha dbang ldan tshogs dang bcas: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: byang phyogs phyi yi lcags sgo phyes: drag po'i dkyil 'khor mthar yang phyin: gtang rag mchod pas dgyes byas te: skye med chos dbyings ngang du gshegs: drag po'i las rnams mthar phyin shog: badz+ra muḥ sa gshegs/ de nas sgo byang phyi nang bkrol ba ni/ phyi sgor mchod gtor bshams/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ? sogs kyis mchod/ hūm̐: khro rgyal dbang chen he ru kaḥ yab yum sprul pa 'khor dang bcas: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dkyil 'khor bya ba mthar yang phyin: bar gyi sgo mtshams phyes su gsol: rtog med chos dbyings ngang la gshegs: bkra shis dge legs mdzad du gsol: badz+ra muḥ zhes lha gshegs sgo byang bsdu'o/ 'byung ba rnams bsdu ba ni/ hūm̐: nyi zla rlung sa 'byung ba bzhi: de ring dkyil 'khor mtha' ru phyin: rgya yi gdams pa dkrol du gsol: 'byung ba rang byung mkha' la thim: zhes rgya bkrol la gser skyems mchod/ de nas nang sgor mchod gtor bshams la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum/ ar+ghaṃ? sogs mchod/ hūm̐: khro rgyal dam tshig bdud rtsi'i mchog:

yab yum sprul pa 'khor bcas rnams: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: de ring dkyil 'khor mthar phyin pas: nang gi srung 'khor bkrol du gsol: dam tshig ye shes dbyings su gshegs: bkra shis dge legs brtan du gsol: oṃ badz+ra muḥ sa gshegs/ me tog dang gser skyems dang bcas sgo byang bsdu'o/ de yang khro bcu'i phur pa bsdu ba ni/ nang du sleb ma thag slob dpon nam rgyal tshab pa dkyil 'khor nub tu 'khod la 'og gi phur bu'am nub kyi phur bu phyi ma lag gnyis skam pa'i rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badz+ra kī la ya ut+kī la ya badz+ra dha rod a dz+nyā pa ya te hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā: blangs te/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ni sarba ar+tha sā dha ni swā hā: zhes phur rtse 'o mas bkru/ chos thams cad skye ba med pa'i don yid la byas te dril bu dkrol zhing*/ ā kā ro? sogs sngags brjod bzhin 'jam rol bcas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor yin na slob dpon gyi rdo rjes re khā nang du bskor zhing las rdor pas rdul tshon dbus su bsdus la slob dpon gyis dngos grub spyi bor bkod/ ras bris dkyil 'khor yin na bsdu'o/ gsum pa thog mar nongs bshags bya ba ni/ mched lcam rnams phan tshun du phyag byas la res mos tshul gyis/ hoḥ thams cad rdo rje mched dang lcam dral te: bde bar gshegs pa'i slob ma dam mnos nas: kun kyang mthun par spyod pa'i dam tshig la: mnyam nyid ngang las legs nyes dbyer med kyang : lus ngag rnam par dag pa'i tshul tsam du: gzhung las nyams shing thugs dang 'gal ba rnams: rnam dag bsam pas mi gnas tshig 'dis bshags: 'dzin med ngang du bzod par bzhes mdzod la: rang bzhin dag pa'i tshangs pa bstsal du gsol: a a āḥ de na rdo rje slob dpon la gtang rag 'bul zhing bzod par gsol ba ni/ thams cad kyi phyag bya lus longs spyod 'bul ba'i blos/ hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon chen po dpal mchog ldan:

gsung rab rgya mtshos lha mi'i 'dren pa'i dpal: yang dag don ston 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal skyob: 'jig rten 'di na pha ma'i tshul du gnas: bka' drin bzang yang bsnyen bkur rngo ma thogs: sdom gsum bsrung bya dam tshig gang nyams kyang : nyes ltung sgrib par mi 'gyur 'dag bya'i phyir: mthol bshags bzod par gsol gyis tshangs par stsol: zhes zhabs spyi bor blangs shing bla ma spyi gtsug tu 'bral med bzung ngo*/ nongs bshags dang bka' drin gsol ba gnyis so/ spros med skabs ma byas kyang chog go /de nas smon lam spyi ltar gdab pa ni thal mo sbyar la/ kye hoḥ mi gnas ye shes chos kyi dkyil 'khor du: ma bcos lhun grub yon tan rdzogs pa'i dpal: rab 'byams rgyal ba'i bka' lung yongs rdzogs nas: 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal du 'gyur bar shog: 'di lta bu yi dkyil 'khor rtag tu brtson: bka' drin che ba'i rdo rje slob dpon dang : lu gu rgyud kyis 'brel ba'i mched lcam rnams: 'bral med dag pa'i zhing du 'tshogs par smon: bla med sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ma thob bar: sa lam mthar phyin 'gro ba thabs kyis sgrol: sku gsum ye shes lnga la spyod par shog: ces rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis smon lam gdab/ khyad par mar me'i smon lam bya ba ni/ thams cad kyis lag g.yas su mar me dang g.yon du spos ring thogs la/ rgyal thebs pas stong thun zur gsal ltar sngon du 'gro bas dbyangs bor len byas te/ hūm̐: bla med gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: rdo rje slob dpon gnyan gyi dbu mdzad nas: dam tshig ldan pa'i mched dang lcam dral rnams: deng nas byang chub snying po ma thob bar: 'khor ba'i g.yang sa chen por mi ltung zhing : ma rig mun pa'i nang du mi 'khyams shog: gcong rong zab mo'i gnas su mi skye dang : dmyal ba'i zangs khar gnas su mi ltung zhing :

gcan gzan gdug pa'i sgra skad mi grags shing : mtshon cha gdug pa'i dbal gyis mi phog shog: rdo rje slob dpon bka' drin che ba dang : mtshan ldan gzungs ma rdo rje mched lcam rnams: mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin rtse gcig gis: sa bcu rim gyis khyad par bgrod par shog: nam zhig tshe 'phos 'chi ba'i dus bzung tshe: ma rig dbang gis 'khor bar ltung srid na: snang gsal mar mes ma rig sdug bsngal sel: nyon mongs dbang gis rigs drug gnas 'khyams na: snang gsal mar mes 'gro drug sdug bsngal sel: rgyu mchog 'di yis sa bcu yongs sgrol te: shes bya'i sgrib sbyangs phyir mi ldog par shog: snang gsal go 'byed zhun mar mdangs ldan 'di: bde gshegs yongs la phul ba'i mthu byin gyis: sa bcu 'das te sa rnams yongs non shog: kun tu 'od dang ma chags pad+ma'i spyan: 'khor lo tshogs chen stug po bkod pa'i sa: de wa ko sha kun bzang dbyer med sa: rdo rje sems ming lcang lo can gyi gnas: bla ma'i sa dang srid gsum gzhir rdzogs sa: rtsod bral lhun po'i sa la thig le yi: sa lam 'gro rnams ma lus lhun bgrod nas: gzugs sku gnyis kyis 'gro don yongs rdzogs shog: ces dang rang lugs bka' brgyad kyi mar me'i smon lam gnyis gang bder bya'o/ gzhan yang spro na theg pa chen po spyi dang khyad par gyi smon lam rgya cher gdab pas/ dus gnyan pa'i phyir 'grub par 'gyur ro/ gzhan du spros bcas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dag la rdul tshon chur gshegs sogs bya ba gzhan du shes par bya'o/ de nas bkra shis spos bskor rgyas spros la zhal nas gsungs pa'i bkra shis tshigs su bcad pas thog drangs/ gzhan so sor 'byung ba'i shis brjod rgyas par spel la/ me tog gi char du bsnyil te/ rol mo snyan par 'khrol ba sogs kyis dge legs su bya'o/ kha skong dang las myur du 'grub pa'i sbyin sreg grub na mchog tu 'gyur zhing gnas srung dang dga' ston sogs mtha' rgyas gzhan du bshad pa ltar ci 'grub byas pas phyin chad legs tshogs rgya cher 'phel bar 'gyur ro/

de ltar bod yul rdo rje gdan dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang dang 'dab 'brel ba'i bsam yas mchims phu'i brag dmar ke'u tshang zhes bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang chen po rang byung rdo rje'i brag la bder 'dus dkyil 'khor gyi re khā bkra lam mer gsal ba'i gangs can sgrub gnas yongs kyi rgyal po ga la ba der ma hā gu ru yab yum gyis las can rje 'bangs grogs lnga sogs smin grol gyi lam la bkod cing gnas mchog de nyid du mi snang bar rgya yis btab pa'i bla gter thugs sgrub bde gshegs 'dus pa zhes o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i gter gzhung rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las 'di nyid chos kyi bdag po o rgyan rog rje gling pa'am rig 'dzin chen po hūm̐ chen 'gro 'dul/ rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje sogs mtshan du mar bsngags pa de nyid kyis rgyas pa dkyil 'khor bcu gsum gyi dgongs pa ji bzhin gtan la phab ste/ bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa ba'i phrin las 'bring po dkyil 'khor lnga pa'i las byang nas kyang mi 'gal bar brgyan te spyi dril gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun 'grub ma'i las byang chog khrigs ye shes sprin gyi phung po zhes bya ba 'di nyid kyi sgo nas tshom bu tshogs su sgrub pa'i thabs la nye bar mkho ba'i khog dbub mchog thun 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba 'di'ang ring lugs 'di nyid kyi bskyed rdzogs rim gnyis rnal 'byor la brtson pa'i bal yul yang le shod gsang sngags phur pa gling gnam lcags sgrub sde sgrub theng gnyis pa thems pa'i dga' ston gtang rag dang 'brel gcung mkhan po ngag dbang dge legs bzang po mchog gis rtsa ba'i sbyin bdag mdzad cing e wam̐ sgrub sde zung dang g.yu lo bkod btsun dgon bcas thun mong nas 'di ga'i sgo nas sman sgrub dang bcas pa'i sgrub pa chen po gsar 'dzugs skabs dgos mkho gzhir bzung rang lugs rtsa gsum spyir 'jug 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum bzang dang*/

bsam lhun badz+ra bum sgrub kyi sgrub khog yon tan gter mdzod sogs gung bstun/ rtsa ba'i sgrub chen phyag len snga 'gyur spyi 'gros bzhin go sla 'jug bde ba'i dbang du byas te chu babs kyi tshul du sgo chen sprul ming du 'bod pa gnam lcags pa man+t+ra shā sa dhā ras rab byung bcu bdun pa shing pho sprel gyi lo dkar phyogs rgyal ba gsum pa res gza' nyi ma'i dbang phyug dang ri dwags mo lhan cig pau ṣa'i khyim du rtsed 'jo la rol ba'i dus tshes dge bar/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad+mar skyes kyis bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis sogs srid pa'i lha 'dre che dgu rnams bka' dam gyis rtsis su phab cing phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i phrin las kyi rgyal rnga sa gsum du ldir ba'i gnas mchog a su ra'i brag phug gi nye 'dab gnam lcags sgrub sde ru sbyar bas yi ge pa ni sgrub brtson pa au ḍī'i mtshan can gyis mdzad pas 'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che phyogs kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // dza)bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ gshin po rjes 'dzin mkha' spyod zab lam gyi chog khrigs thar lam 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ snang mtha' 'od ma'i 'gyur ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ de yang gshin po rjes su 'dzin pa la/ sbyor ba dkyil 'khor mchod rdzas ci 'byor legs par bsham pa'i gung du rnam bum kha rgyan mgul chings dang bcas pa mdun du ming byang gzugs sam pad+ma'i gdan la nṛ yig bris pa g.yas su sbyong byed kyi 'aḥ.aḥshaḥsaḥmaḥhaḥdang g.yon du sbyang bya rigs drug gi sa bon a tri nṛ su pre du bris pa'i gsham du na mo mchog gsum rtsa ba gsum dang khyad par du thugs rje chen po bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la tshe las 'das pa cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ mo'i phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/

sgrib pa sbyang du gsol/ dbang bskur du gsol/ lam bstan du gsol/ mthar thug byang chub kyi go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol lo/ zhes bris pa'i g.yas su bza' ba/ g.yon du btung ba/ gzhan yang sbyangs chas sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams 'du bya'o/ thog mar bde gshegs kun 'dus las byang ngam bde chen zhing sgrub gang rung sngon du 'gro dgos pas 'dir bder 'dus kyi dbang du byas na/ thog mar gsol 'debs nas brtsam bstod pa'i bar song nas dzap khang dbye zhing dzap dgongs gsal gdab la bsnyen sgrub las gsum mthar bum sgrub ni/ gzung thag 'jus te/ phaṭ dzaḥ sa phyes la/ rang byung bum pa gzhal med khang chen por/ /skad cig mkha' la gza' skar shar ba bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor rtsa ba'i lha tshogs bkra lam mer/ /gsal ba'i thugs srog sngags phreng spro bsdu yis/ /byang sems bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar mos/ zhes gsal brtan gyi ngang nas rtsa sngags ji ltar rigs pa bzla zhing*/ de nas gzungs bum sgrub pa ni/

las bum nang du pad zla'i gdan la hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags phreng 'khor ba las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsams la/ oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi ham̐'u: mthar yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten snying bzlas shing thun mtshams mchod bstod ni/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod: lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nyams chag bshags: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: mchod cing bstod la/ mchod yon gyi chu phul bas bum lha 'od du zhu nas bum chu dang dbyer med du gyur par bsam/ de nas rig me dor ba ni/ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya om̐/ āḥbadz+ra sa ma ya āḥ hūm̐ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ swā badz+ra sa ma ya swā/ hā badz+ra sa ma ya hā/ zhes me tog phul bas/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor ba'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams gnyis su med par bsam zhing*/ om̐/ ye shes rgyal po sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan phrin las rmad po che/ /de nyid du ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /phyag rgya chen por bdag gyur cig /om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya ho/ zhes dngos grub bskul zhing bstim mo/ gnang ba zhu ba ni/ thal mo sbyar bas btud de/ om̐/ rdo rje ye shes thob byed pa'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /bdag gi slob mar 'jug par 'tshal/ zhes gsol bas gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ skabs 'dir gsol kha na rag skong bshags dang ma lcogs na gsham gsal ye shes sku mchog dang sman raka gtor ma'i skong bsdus tsam sbyar bas kyang rung ngo*/ de nas tshogs mchod drangs pa'i bar song*/ skabs 'dir ltung bshags bya srol 'dug /de nas gshin don bag chags sbyang ba las/ thog mar rten bskyed pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyang : stong pa'i ngang las:

rang nyid skad cig gis rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru thod phreng rtsal du gsal ba'i mdun du: gdan pad+ma'i steng du tshe las 'das pa'i cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ mo'i phung po khams dang skye mched rnam shes thams cad gsal zhing yongs su rdzogs par gyur: oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐ dza dzaḥ dang po tshe 'das rnam shes 'gugs pa ni: na mo: sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang : chos kyi bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bdain pa dang : snying po sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin rnams kyi bden pa dang : bcom ldan 'das mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dang byang sems rnams kyi bden pa dang : khyad par 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje'i bdag nyid rig 'dzin thod phreng sde lnga la sogs pa'i bden pa dang : bden pa chen po'i mthus 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol du 'phos shing tshe dus las 'das pa'i rnam par shes pa srid pa rigs drug gang du gnas kyang skad cig gis rten 'di la mchis par gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dza dzaḥ zhes lan gsum gyis rten la bkug /de nas mdun rten bskyed pa la/ hoḥ 'jig rten 'di nas 'phos shing pha rol du song ba chaig mo khyod deng 'dir dkyil 'khor zab mo'i sgor zhugs te tshe rabs nas las dang nyon mongs pa'i duḥkha sbyang ba la mos gus dang gdung ba drag po'i shugs skyed cig: de nas zhing khams bkod pa ni: hoḥ tshe las 'das pa'i snang yul mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su zhing khams bkod pa 'di bzhin gsal thob: de yang dbus su seṅge'i khri dang pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la thog ma'i sangs rgyas mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba: mdun du spyan ras gzigs: shar du rdo rje sems dpa': lhor rin chen 'byung ldan: nub tu snang ba mtha' yas: byang du don yod grub pa ste: thams cad kyang yab yum zung 'jug gi sku 'od kyi rang bzhin du 'bar bar mos mdzod/ ces brda sprad la/

bdag nyid kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis rigs lnga drug pa'i bdag nyid spyan drangs te: tshe las 'das pa chaig mo' ི mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen du bzhugs par gyur: oṃ badz+ra pad+ma dha ra ā wa lo ki te badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma pañca ku la badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag: chu yi lhag ma yar lud pa las: 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra pad+ma dha ra ā wa lo ki te badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: zhes mchod pa 'bul: hūm̐: bde gshegs gtso bo mgon po 'od mi 'gyur: rang bzhin 'jig rten dbang phyug drug pa'i bdag: rgyal sras byang sems tshogs dang bcas pa la: bde chen dag zhing bgrod phyir phyag bgyi'o: de nas sbyangs ba ni/ gtor ma mar me changs bu bcas 'du bya la/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ na mo sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang : chos kyi bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang : rdo rje dang : rin chen dang : pad+ma dang : las kyi rigs su gyur pa dang : snying po dang : phyag rgya ting 'dzin rnams kyi? khyad par 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje'i bdag nyid rig 'dzin thod phreng sde lnga la sogs pa'i bden pa dang : bden pa chen po'i mthus 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu song ba chaig mo la gson gyi dus su tshe srog la bar du gcod pa: gshin gyi dus su sgrib pa sbyong ba la bar du gcod cing : gnyen 'brel gyi chas su zhugs nas ngan song du 'khrid pa'i gshed ma byed pa: gnas skabs su gson po nye 'brel rnams la 'tshe bar byed pa thams cad lan chags gtor ma len pa'i ched du 'dir mchis par gyur cig:
