om̐ badz+ra ṭāk+ki rā dza hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes lan gsum gyis dgug la/ sarba bhigh+nān na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo?khaṃ ghṛ h+na daṃ ba liṃ d+ye swā hā/ gsum gyi gtor ma g.yas su bskor la zhi bar sbyang*/ slar yang sum+bha ni? hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis mar me dang chang bu g.yon du bskor zhing drag por sbyong*/ de nas phyed ma'i sbyangs ba ni/ na mo sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang : chos kyi bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang : rdo rje dang : rin chen dang : pad+ma dang : las kyi rigs su gyur pa dang : snying po dang : phyag rgya ting 'dzin rnams kyi? khyad par 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje'i bdag nyid rig 'dzin thod phreng sde lnga la sogs pa'i bden pa dang : bden pa chen po'i mthus 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu song ba chaig mo la gson gyi dus su tshe srog la bar du gcod pa: gshin gyi dus su sgrib pa sbyong ba la bar du gcod pa'i lan chags bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad mchod sbyin gyis gtor ma 'di'i tshim par gyis la sa yi phyogs 'dir ma gnas par phyir dengs shig hūm̐: nyon cig log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs: gson la bdud dang gshin la lcags: mtho ris bde 'gro'i bgegs byed rnams: gtor chu changs bu mar me dang : 'dod yon glud gtor 'di khyer la: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: ci ste 'tshe zhing sdang ba dang : tshe 'das thar pa'i bgegs byed na: rab tu gzhom par gdon mi za: hūm̐: ye shes 'bar ba me yi tshwa tshwa g.yo: sdang mig nyi zla ltar bgrad glog ltar 'khyugs: 'debs pa'i phyag mtshan rdo rje'i mtshon char gdengs: de bas so so rang rang gnas su dengs: nyon mongs bdud dang 'byung po rab tu gzhom: om̐ badz+ra kro ta he kā la kro ti li hūm̐ gnod byed 'byung po thams cad mā ra ya phaṭḥ zhes rol mo'i 'tsham rngam dang bcas thun gyis brab gu gul bdug cing phyir bskrad/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba cis kyang mi chod mi shigs par gyur/

om̐ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye swā hā: de nas rten khrus gsol ba ni/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la yo byad thams cad dang ldan pas sku khrus gsol bar bgyi'o/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa/ /shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar/ rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan/ /mu tig 'aud chags bla res bres pa der/ /de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus/ yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye a hūm̐/ hūm̐: ye shes sku lnga lhun grub bum pa ru: rnam dag dam tshig chu bo drug gis bkang : deng 'dir rgyal ba'i sku la khrus 'bul na: tshe 'das sgrib gnyis bag chags sbyangs nas ni: tshogs gnyis 'bras bu yongs su smin gyur cig: om̐ sarba ta thā ga ta ā bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: ye shes sku la skye 'chi mi mnga' yang : tshe 'das dag zhing pad+mor skye ba'i phyir: rgyal ba'i sku la khrus chab 'di 'bul bas: tshe 'das lus kyi sgrib pa dag gyur cig: om̐ na ma sarba thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: ye shes gsung la 'gags med sgra ldan yang : tshe 'das gsung dbyangs drug cu 'thob pa'i phyir: rgyal ba'i gsung la khrus chab 'di phul bas: tshe 'das ngag gi sgrib pa dag gyur cig: om̐ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐:

hūm̐: ye shes thugs la ka dag sgrib bral yang : tshe 'das rang rig ye shes don rtogs phyir: rgyal ba'i thugs la khrus chab 'di phul bas: tshe 'das yid kyi sgrib pa dag gyur cig: om̐ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: ye shes yon tan phrin las gzhan med kyang : tshe 'das dug lnga dbyings su dag pa'i phyir: yon tan phrin las khrus chab 'di phul bas: tshe 'das tha mal sgrib pa dag gyur cig: om̐ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: sku phyi ba ni/ hūm̐: gtsang zhing dge ba rlung g.yab las byung bas: ma dag 'khrul ba dag par byi dor zhing : ku shas sa bon bgyid la sman spos byug: dri med pañca li kas sku phyi'o: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥsarba bi shud+dhe bi sho dha ya swā hā: de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i/ /na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul/ /gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*/ /rgyan mchog brgya phrag dag kyang dbul bar bgyi/ oṃ badz+ra wasatra ye swā hā/ de nas rigs lnga'i khrus chab kyis ming byang bkru ba ni/ hūm̐: 'di ni me long ye shes chu: tshe 'das khyod la khrus bgyis pas: zhe sdang sgrib pa dag gyur nas: dmyal ba'i sa bon stong gyur cig: om̐ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: tshe las 'das pa'i zhe sdang gi sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig: om̐ badz+ra ma hā duḥkha bi sho dha na ye swā hā: hūm̐: 'di ni sor rtog ye shes chu: tshe 'das khyod la khrus bgyis pas: 'dod chags sgrib pa dag gyur nas: yi dwags sa bon stong gyur cig: om̐ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ tshe las 'das pa'i 'dod chags kyi sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig: om̐ pad+ma pre ta rā ga pre bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: hūm̐: 'di ni chos dbyings ye shes chu: tshe 'das khyod la khrus bgyis pas: gti mug sgrib pa dag gyur nas: byol song sa bon stong gyur cig:

om̐ bā+ai ro tsa na hūm̐: tshe las 'das pa'i gti mug gi sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig: om̐ bud+dha pā paṃ tir+ya ka su bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: hūm̐: 'di ni bla med ye shes chu: tshe 'das khyod la khrus bgyis pas: las kyi sgrib pa dag gyur nas: bag chags sa bon stong gyur cig: om̐ gu ru pad+ma dha ra hrī: tshe las 'das pa'i mir skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig: om̐ dharma rā ga he sha ni bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: hūm̐: 'di ni bya grub ye shes chu: tshe 'das khyod la khrus bgyis pas: phrag dog sgrib pa dag gyur nas: lha min sa bon stong gyur cig: om̐ āḥyo gha hūm̐: tshe las 'das pa'i phrag dog gi sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig: om̐ karma a ri sha tri ta tri bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: hūm̐: 'di ni mnyam nyid ye shes chu: tshe 'das khyod la khrus bgyis pas: nga rgyal sgrib pa dag gyur nas: lha yi sa bon stong gyur cig: om̐ rat+na sam+bha wa trām̐ hūm̐: tshe las 'das pa'i nga rgyal gyi sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig: om̐ rat+na aṇ+ḍa kha a bi sho dha na ye swā hā: hūm̐: 'di ni pha rol phyin drug chu: tshe 'das khyod la khrus bgyis pas: rnam shes tshogs drug gnas dag nas: rigs drug skye ba'i sgo chod cig: oṃ dā na shrī la kan+ti nid+ya sa ma dhi pra dz+nyā ye swā hā: tshe las 'das pa rigs drug gi sdug bsngal las grol te pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi go 'phang thob par gyur cig: om̐ sarba pā paṃ bi shwa dha ye kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: de ltar dug lnga ye shes lnga yi sbyang zin pas 'byung ba'i dug sbyong sogs zur du mi dgos zhes gsungs so/ de nas rten bca' zhing phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: nyon cig tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu: zhing khams 'di nyid rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas zhing :

phyag 'tshal skyabs mchis gus pas gsol ba thob: hoḥ 'jig rten pha rol song ba'i bu khyod nyon: mtshan byang 'di ni lus kyi bla rten yin: snyug ma tshigs drug srog gi bla rten yin: gdugs dang cod pan gos kyi bla rten yin: me long 'di ni sems kyi bla rten yin: mar me 'di ni mthong ba'i bla rten yin: rin chen 'di ni rgyan gyi bla rten yin: dar thag 'di ni lam gyi bla rten yin: pad+ma 'di ni sdod pa'i bla rten yin: mtshan byang 'di la rnam shes rten chos la: dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal sdig pa bshags: 'di'i skabs phyag 'tshal bshags pa las gzhung nas blang gsungs pas/ na mo hūm̐: phyogs bcu dus bzhir bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang : byang sems rig 'dzin 'phags tshogs 'dus sde la: bdag cag gus pas skyabs mchis phyag 'tshal lo: na mo hūm̐: chos sku skye ba med pa'i ngang nyid las: sangs rgyas thams cad thugs las skyes pa'i yab: snang mtha' 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo: chos kyi sku yis byams pa'i spyan gyis gzigs: snying rje thugs kyis 'gro drug gnas nas 'dren: 'phags mchog nam mkha'i rgyal por phyag 'tshal lo: snang stong sku la ye shes rgyun chad med: chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong 'byung ba'i yum: dbyings phyug pha rol phyin mar phyag 'tshal lo: shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su: rdo rje sems dpa' longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas: zhi ba'i rig 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: byang chub sems ma sa khams rnam par dag: me long ye shes sangs rgyas byang sems yum: sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: lho phyogs dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing khams su: rin chen 'byung ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas: rgyas pa'i rig 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: byang chub sems ma chu khams rnam par dag: mnyam nyid ye shes sangs rgyas byang sems yum: mā ma kī yi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su:

rnam par snang mdzad longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas: dbang gi rig 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: byang chub sems ma me khams rnam par dag: sor rtog ye shes sangs rgyas byang sems yum: gos dkar mo y-i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: byang phyogs las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing khams su: don yod grub pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas: drag po'i rig 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: byang chub sems ma rlung khams rnam par dag: bya grub ye shes sangs rgyas byang sems yum: dam tshig sgrol ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: 'phags pa'i zhing khams 'og min 'thug po bkod: sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'dzin 'dus sde la: lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: so sor thar pa rnams kyi sdom pa dang : byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab pa dang : rdo rje sngags kyi dam tshig nyams pa dang : dbang bskur dkyil 'khor dam tshig nyams pa sogs: ngan song sgo bzhi bsags pa mthol lo bshags: bag med las kyis mnar med rgyu bsags dang : phyi nang dam tshig 'gal ba ci mchis pa: zhing khams lha la mthol bshags bzod par gsol: mi sgrib bde chen zhing khams bgrod par shog:

de nas dbang bskur ba ni/ chab blang khrus stsal lha bskyed la: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ maṇ+ḍal phul la/ skyabs sems ni/ na mo: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams ji snyed du: bzhugs pa'i rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i lha tshogs la: sgo gsum mi phyed dad gus drag po yis: skyabs su mchi'o thugs rje'i ye shes bskul: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha tshogs bsgrubs nas ni: gang la gang 'dul thugs rje'i phrin las kyis: 'gro drug 'khrul snang bsgral bar dam bca'o: lan gsum gyis skyabs su 'gro ba dang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ tshogs bsags pa ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba dbyings nas gshegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: sgo gsum dam tshig nyams chag bshags: 'gro don chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs gsol: dge tshogs mkha' mnyam 'gro la bsngo: kun kyang sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog: de nas so byang sngags gsum gyi sdom bzung ni/ bde gshegs sras bcas bdag la dgongs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni/ /byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar/ /so so thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus yongs su bzung bar bgyi/ de nas dam chu btang ba ni/ hūm̐: 'di ni bde gshegs bla med chu: bsrungs pas mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: nyams pas ltung ba'i las su 'gyur: de bas dam srungs chu 'di 'thung : om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya i dan+te na ra kan: ye shes pa dbab pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li? oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho? slob ma mi dmigs par stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las 'og min bde ba can gyi zhing khams bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su/ pad+ma dang nyi zla'i steng du rang gi sems nyid hrīḥyig dmar po 'od 'bar bar gyur/ de nyid yongs su gyur pa las/ bde gshegs kun 'dus gu ru yid bzhin nor bu skur gsal ba'i spyi bo'i mkha' ru thog ma'i sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur ba la bde gshegs rigs lnga'i zhing khams kyi lhar bcas gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas:

bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar spyan drangs te skal ldan slob ma rnams la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod: om̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sarba sa ma ya a be sha ya a āḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes ye shes pa spyan drangs/ brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: thog mar bum dbang gi slad slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs pa dang lhan cig bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pa'i rin po che bum pa bdud rtsi chu rgyun gyis gang ba gnas gsum du bzhag cing tshig don ngo sprod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐: ye shes lnga yi gzhal yas bum pa ru: bum chu dam tshig yi dam lha yi dngos: de ring tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: lus ngag yid gsum las nyon kun byang nas: rnam dag zhing du skye bar mdzad du gsol: om̐ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma gu ru bud+dha sarba kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de ltar dbang bskur bas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ sku gsung thugs kyi dbang thob/ 'bras bu sku gsum gyi sa bon rgyud la bzhag /mthar dbang gi lha rnams kyang khyed rang la dbyer med du thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ su pra tiṣ+tha badz+ra ye swā hā/ hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: sku gsung thugs kyi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor/ mthar maṇ+ḍal phul/ dbang gi smin cing dam tshig sdom pa dag /rim gnyis lam la bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin nas/ /dka' ba med par rig 'dzin go 'phang thob/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis bde blag 'grub gyur cig /tshe las 'das pa bde gshegs gtso bo 'od mi 'gyur dang gnyis su med pa'i skur gyur/ de nas sreg rdzas rnams bsregs shing chu gtsang gis bran la byin gyis brlab pa ni/

oṃ āḥhūm̐: hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las: rin po che zhi ba'i me thab dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du me gsur 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur cig: om̐ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra a wārta a wārta ya hoḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo?khaṃ swā hā/ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ thog mar dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: gzugs kyi lha mo'i me long 'dzin: dkyil 'khor lha yi spyan la 'bul: snang stong mchod pas dgyes gyur cig: tshe 'das bla med thob par shog: om̐ rū pa pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: hūm̐: sgra yi lha mos pi waṃ 'dzin: dkyil 'khor lha yi snyan la 'bul: grags stong mchod pas dgyes gyur nas: tshe 'das bla med thob par shog: om̐ shab+da pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: hūm̐: dri yi lha mos dung chos 'dzin: dkyil 'khor lha yi sku la 'bul: gsal stong mchod pas dgyes gyur nas: tshe 'das bla med thob par shog: om̐ gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: hūm̐: ro yi lha mos zhal zas thogs: dkyil 'khor lha yi ljags la 'bul: bde stong mchod pas dgyes gyur nas: tshe 'das bla med thob par shog: om̐ rā sa pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: hūm̐: reg bya lha mos na bza' 'dzin: dkyil 'khor lha la 'jam mnyen 'bul: tshor stong mchod pas dgyes gyur nas: tshe 'das bla med thob par shog: om̐ spar+she pra tīts+tsha swā hā: zhes rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas dmigs yul tshe las 'das pa'i rgyu tshogs rdzogs lam sgrib pa sbyangs nas: 'bras bu rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur cig: de nas yid lus bar do'i mgron la bsngo ba ni/ om̐ āḥhu ti swā hā: dri gsur 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni: mdangs da nang shi ba lus snga lus bor phyi lus ma thob par:

rig pa gtad med du 'khyams pa'i sems can thams cad la bsngo'o: 'bul lo: mig gi yul du gzugs mdzes par gyur cig: rna ba'i yul du sgra snyan par gyur cig: sna yi yul du dri zhim par gyur cig: lce yi yul du ro mngar bar gyur cig: lus kyi yul du reg bya 'jam par gyur cig: yid kyi yul du rig shes phun sum tshogs par gyur cig: hoḥ thams cad nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin du: longs spyod zad pa med pa yi: rtsod pa med cing 'tshe med pa: rang dbang du ni spyod par shog: de nas rnam shes spar ba ni/ ngo sprod bya ba/ hoḥ nyon cig tshe 'das yid lus rigs kyi bu: 'jig rten tshe 'dir re ba'i nyi ma nub: gnas khang lus kyi sgrom bu 'byung bzhi 'thor: dga' ba'i grogs dang bral nas gcig pur 'khyams: dbang med bya sgro rlung khyer lta bu'i dus: pha ma spun zla mthong yang 'grogs dbang med: 'jig rten snang ba nub pa'i bar do 'dir: skyabs med mgon med dpung gnyen zad pa'i tshe: dkyil 'khor gtso bo bla mar 'dun pa bskyed: yi dam lha yi gsang mtshan dran par gyis: snang ba gang shar bsam blo bral bar zhog: dran rig rgyang so rgyal ba'i thugs kar gtod: mos gus dag snang bgyis pa'i dus gcig po: bla ma'i gdams ngag snying la ma 'chang na: rang gis rang nyid bslu bar mi 'gyur ram: rang sems dri med rnam shes āḥdakar de: snang mtha' ka dag rgyal ba'i thugs ka ru: blo bur phaṭ kyis gdab tshe yar 'phos shig: phaṭḥ phaṭḥ phaṭḥ zhes spar zhing mthar smon lam gdab pa ni/ e ma hoḥ zhing khams mchog rab bde ba can gyi gling : de ru sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa bzhugs: gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas 'khor gyis bskor: g.yas su thugs rje'i bdag po spyan ras gzigs: g.yon du sprul sku'i gtso bo pad+ma 'byung : byang sems rig 'dzin bde gshegs rgyal ba yi: zhing khams khor yug bkod pa'i khyon gyis gang :

dag zhing gtsang ma'i mngon par bkod pa'i gnas: bdag sogs 'di nas tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: rab tu dga' ba'i sa der bgrod par shog: bde gshegs 'od dpag med kyis mdun nas bsus: 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drongs: rje btsun pad 'byung dam pas zhing du skyol: bde gshegs rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i 'phrul gyis phul: skyon med pad+ma'i sbubs su 'khrungs nas su: mngon shes drug ldan 'ja' lus thob par shog: mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i lus bzang thob nas su: sna tshogs mchod pas rtag tu mchod par shog: sred pa bral zhing tshims pa'i dga' bder gnas: zhing khams spyod pa'i go 'phang thob nas su: phyogs bzhir bde gshegs rigs lnga'i zhing khams dang : mtshams bzhir sprul sku rig 'dzin zhing khams dang : dag pa'i zhing nas dag pa'i zhing du gzigs: gzigs stangs gsum gyi thugs rjes 'gro la skyongs: rang dbang thob pa'i rgyal sa zin pa'i tshe: gdod ma'i mgon po chos sku'i klong du bzhugs: longs sku'i rtsal las 'gro ba'i don phyir 'gyed: thabs kyi sprul skus sems can dag zhing ston: dper na rig 'dzin grub thob ldan pa zhig: cig car gnyis sprul mkha' la bskyod pa bzhin: bden pa'i sa thob bden pa de ltar rig: de ltar de bzhin shin tu reg gyur cig: de nas byang bu bsreg pa ni/ hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las khro bo zan za rdo rje zhal gru gsum du gdangs pa'i hom du tshe las 'das pa'i rnam par shes pa'i phung po las kyi sgrib pa shes bya'i sgrib pa: nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pas kun nas bslangs pa'i bag chags kyi sgrib pa thams cad ye shes kyi me yis bsregs pas sku lnga'i sa bon thob par bsam: hūm̐: ye shes mched pa'i hom yangs su: de ring tshe 'das 'di nyid kyi: las dang nyon mongs bsreg pa'i phyir: stong nyid bden pa'i me sbar ro: hūm̐: phung po lnga yi bud shing la: rgyal ba rigs lnga'i me sbar ro:

'byung ba lnga yi bud shing la: yum chen lnga yi me sbar ro: rnam shes drug gi bud shing la: pha rol phyin drug me sbar ro: skye mched bcu gnyis bud shing la: rnam thar bcu gnyis me sbar ro: srog 'dzin bcu drug bud shing la: stong nyid bcu drug me sbar ro: dug lnga ma rig bud shing la: sku lnga ye shes me sbar ro: om̐ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ gu ru bo dhi sa twa ya ma hā sa twa ya: ma hā ka ru ṇi ka pa ri sho dha ya rā dza badz+ra ya bha ga wa ti sarba durga te pa ri sho dha na ye swā hā: oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru bi shwo dha na ye swā hā: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sarba bi shwa dha na ye swā hā: zhes byang bu bsregs pa'i thal ba chu bor dor ram sāts+tsha btab ste chur gshegs/ rjes bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis rgyas gdab par bya'o/ de ltar bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi gshin po rjes 'dzin mkha' spyod zab lamakhrigs su bsdebs pa thar lam 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba 'di yang 'brel thogs bde chen zhing du bgrod pa'i cha rkyen du dmigs te rab byung bcu bdun pa'i shing sprel zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes pa nyi shu nyin gsang sngags phur pa gling du gsang sngags bstan 'dzin pas sbyar bas yi ge pa yang mtshams nag ral pa can o rgyan gsang sngags kyis bgyis pa 'dis kyang gsang sngags bstan pa dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang pha mas gtsor byas 'brel thogs sems can rnams byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // wa)bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ spros bcas sgrub chen gyi stong thun rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i dgyes dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ pad+ma'i rigs mchog 'dren pa 'od mtha' yas/ /pad+ma'i spyan ldan 'phags mchog snying rje'i gter/ /pad+ma las 'khrungs rgyal sras sprul pa'i sku/

/sku gsum dbyer med drin can bla mar 'dud/ /bla ma'i thugs sgrub rtsa gsum bka' 'dus pa/ /chos kyi rgya mtsho'i spros bcas sgrub chen gyi/ /stong thun rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'dus pa yi/ /dgyes pa'i gar gyi nyams dbyangs 'dir sgrogs bya/ de la thog mar ma traṃ bsgral chog gi gong du rdo rje slob dpon nam rgyal thebs kyis gtsos/ thugs lta dgongs las ma g.yos bzhin du/ rdo rje slob dpon nam rgyal thebs kyis zhwa chos dang bcas gsungs gsal zhing dal la gcod mtshams legs shing brjid cing lhun chags pa'i ngang nas 'di skad do/ kyai/ rdo rje 'dus pa rgya mtsho gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyan po 'di nyid la 'jug par 'os pa'i las dang skal ba ldan pa'i mched lcam rnams kyis tshom bu tshogs su sgrub pa'i phrin las kyi rim pa la 'jug pa'i yan lag ni/ de'ang shing rta chen po sangs rgyas gsang bas/ phyi nang gsang bas bsrung bya ste/ /srin po'i rgyal po tshul bzhin mnan/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mtshan 'dzin rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir du/ thog mar ma traṃ bsgral chog bya ba'i skabs su bab pa yin pas skal ldan rdo rje'i rnal 'byor las su rung zhing*/ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyan por 'du bar 'os pa'i rdo rje'i mched lcam rnams legs par gsan du gsol/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa mchog gi lam la zhugs pas gzhi lam 'bras bu thams cad kyi skabs su thabs snying rje chen po dang*/ shes rab stong pa nyid dbyer mi phyed pa'i rdo rje sdom pa chen po las mi 'da' bas na bdag cag gi ston pa rnam 'dren bzhi pa chen po shākya seṅges kyang thun mong ma yin pa'i rdo rje'i mdzad pa chen po bcu gnyis bstan pa'i bye brag ser skya'i khab tu rdo rje btsun mo'i sgyu ma chen po 'khor brgyad khri dang bcas pa la chags chen rdo rje'i sgyu rtsal gyi 'dod yon la dgyes dgur rol pa'i tshul gyis thabs kyi brtul zhugs mthar phyin par mdzad pas rigs brgya'i khyab bdag drug pa'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa dang*/

dzam+bu gling gi yul dbus rdo rje gdan byang chub shing drung du mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa bstan pa'i snga rol du mi bsrun pa'i bdud kyi cho 'phrul gyi g.yo sgyus brid pa la mkhyen pa'i dbang phyug 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed khro bo dang*/ pad+ma'i pho nya sgrol ma myur ma dpa' mo/ stobs bcu'i nus stobs rdo rje'i khro bo mi g.yo ba'i dpung gis bdud dpung mi 'khrugs phrag gcig dpa' bkong bas bar chad kyi g.yul las rgyal nas mi slob pa'i zung 'jug chen po mngon du bstan nas rdo rje theg pa bla med kyi rgyud sde bsam mi khyab pa rdo rje'i rigs can gyi 'dus pa la bstan pa dang*/ rdo rje theg pa rang gi rgyud kyi gleng gzhi dang sbyar na gu ru'i zhal nas/ ri bo ma la ya gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rtser: bdud po ma traṃ ru tra drag pos bsgral: srin mo ma tshogs rnams la sbyor ba mdzad: zhes pa ltar/ gsang sngags bstan pa dang po de nas byung : gsang sngags bstan pa'i chu mgo brdol ba'i gleng gzhi ltar/ de'ang ma traṃ zhes bya ba 'di lhan skyes dang kun brtags kyis ma rig pa'i rtsal las/ 'khor 'das la bzang ngan dang yul can sogs gnyis 'dzin du shar ba'i don te/ ru tra la lhan skyes don gyi ru tra/ mtshan ma brda yi ru tra/ btags pa ming gi ru tra bcas gsum las/ de la lhan skyes don gyi ru tra ni/ kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo las/ bgegs kyi bgegs te bgegs chen po/ /dug lnga'i rtog pa nyid las skyes/ /phyed dang gsum gyi dur khrod na/ /gzhi rtsa lus dang ngag sems so/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lus snang ba'i srid pa/ ngag phyed snang gi srid pa/ yid mi snang ba'i srid pas bsdus pa'i chos so cog la chos dang gzhan du bden par 'dzin nas gzung byar 'khrul pa chos kyi bdag tu 'dzin pa la ma traṃ ka ru tra zhes sems can gyi lus la gnas/ yul can rnam shes tshogs brgyad la nga dang bdag tu lta ba gang zag gi bdag 'dzin la kha traṃ ka ru tra zhes sems can gyi sems la gnas/

gtsang bde rtag bdag sogs phyin ci log gi lta ngan gyis rtag chad kyi mthar lhung ba las dang 'bras bu sogs med par smra ba mi bden 'khrul pa'i bdag 'dzin la a kar+ṣa ru tra zhes sems can gyi ngag la gnas pa ste/ de lta bu'i bdag 'dzin las gyes pa'i dug lnga'i ru tra chen po'i 'khor du/ nye nyon nyi shu rtog tshogs brgyad khri bzhi stong sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa de rnams kyang*/ zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po skye 'chi bde sdug gi rten 'khrul snang lus kyi dur khrod dang khams gsum la sred len gyi gsos btab nas phy-i ma'i skye srid kyi rgyur gyur pa kun gzhi sems kyi dur khrod de gnyis la rten bcas nas bdag tu bzung ba'i bsgral bya dregs pa can de dag dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med par rtogs pa lha yi dur khrod chos dbyings nam mkha' yangs pa'i hom khung du/ rang byung gnyug ma'i ye shes khrag 'thung khro bo'i tshogs kyi rnam par shar ba rnams kyis mi gsang ba'i gsang ba chen po'i thabs khyad par can gyi chos nyid de bzhin nyid kyi phur bus bsgral zhing*/ nang gi rtsa rlung thig le'i rang mdangs phyi rol du shar ba la/ yul nyer bzhi dur khrod chen po brgyad sogs sgrub pa gnas kyi dur khrod chen por byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir gsang sngags thabs mkhas rmad du byung ba'i brda dang thabs kyis btul ba'i tshul yang*/ mtshan ma brda yi ru tra ni/ sngon 'das pa'i dus dpag tu med pa na bskal pa kun tu dga' bya bar sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa'i bstan pa la dge slong thub dka' gzhon nu'i slob ma thar pa nag po zhes bya bas slob dpon gyis bstan pa'i gsang ba'i gnas lugs de kho na nyid kyi lta ba ma rtogs par/ sbas pa'i gsang ba sbyor sgrol brlang por spyad pas spyod pa'i phyogs su lta ba shor zhing*/ nag po kha 'byams log par rtog pa'i dbang gis sbyor sgrol sogs kyi spyod pa rtsing po la 'jol nyog tu spyad cing bla ma dang mched grogs rnams kyang lta spyod mi mthun pa'i dbang gis yul khams gzhan tu spyugs te gzhan khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyang log pa'i lam du bsgyur nas ngan song gsum gyi gnas su skyes pa sha stag ste/

de'i 'bras bur rnam smin gyi 'bras bu dmyal ba tsha grang gi sdug bsngal bskal pa bcu gnyis dang*/ lha sngags rang rgyud du bzlas sgom byas pas rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bus mthar sangs rgyas mar mai mdzad kyi bstan pa'i mjug shākya thub pa'i bstan pa ma byon pa'i gong srin yul laṅka pu ri zhes pa na smad 'tshong ma kun tu rgyu la lha bdud btsan gsum bsdongs nas bshos pa'i bu yi dwags kyi 'gro bas bsdus pa'i srin po bya'i gshog pa can mgo gsum gshog pa drug yod pa zhig skyes ma thag nas nad mug sogs bkra mi shis pa'i ltas ngan bsam gyis mi khyab pas yul khams thams cad nad mug sogs kyis phung zhing stong la khad du song*/ zla ba dgu nas ma shi ba'i ro de dang lhan cig tu dur khrod du bskyal bas zas su ro zos gos su ro gos gyon pas gzugs khams kyi 'bras bu che ba man chad 'jig rten na gang che bar grags pa thams cad ma lus par dbang du bsgyur zhing pho mthong thams cad bsad mo mthong thams cad chung mar bkol nas dur khrod chas brgyad kyi rgyan cha rang byung du grub pa'i yi dwags srin po chen po'i gzugs su skyes nas gzugs khams gnas ris bcu bdun man chad dbang du byas shing gdug pa can mtha' dag bran du bkol bas 'jig rten stong la khad kyi dus su sngon gyi dam tshig gis 'brel ba'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dang phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad tshad med pa'i snying rje chen pos kun nas ma bzod nas bka' bgros te/ dbang chen rta phag yab yum gyis 'dul ba'i dus la bab par bskul ba bzhin de nyid kyis rdo rje khro bo'i sprin tshogs dang bcas pas dur khrod kyi bdag po ma traṃ ru tra bsgral zhing rnam shes gnas spar te gcer bu byang thang du lhung ba bzhin du gyur pa'i tshe na sngar gyi las la gnong 'gyod tshad med pa skyes te smre ngag gdung 'bod yus kyis bshags pas dam tshig nyams chag thams cad lhag ma med par byang zhing sor chud nas/

sangs rgyas stong gi bstan pa skyong ba'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma'i gtso bo legs ldan tshogs kyi bdag por dbang bskur nas ma 'ongs thal bas khebs pa'i zhing du/ bcom ldan 'das thal ba'i dbang po zhes bya bar 'tshang rgya bar lung bstan/ slad kyi 'khor bdud kyi bu mo myos byed ma la sogs pa rnams las kau rī ma brgyad/ singha ma brgyad/ stag gdong sgo ma bzhi sogs su sprul 'khor gyi yi dwags chen po gdug pa can rnams dang dbang phyug nyer brgyad sogs dbang du bsdus shing bran du byas/ dkyil 'khor skyong ba'i srung mar bskos/ ru tra'i phung po mgo bo yan lag dang nying lag rnams dum bu brgyad du bgos nas 'dzam bu'i gling du bor ba las yul chen po brgyad dang*/ dur khrod chen po brgyad du byin brlabs nas skal ldan rnams nyams rtogs spel/ skal med rnams tshar gcod pa'i gnas su gyur pa de dag sngon byung ston pa'i rnam thar te/ rjes 'jug gdul bya'i nyams len la 'jug phyir bsgral chog la 'jug pa 'di'ang sngon dpal chen po'i rnam thar gyi rjes su 'jug par 'gyur ba'i dgos pa dang*/ khams gsum gyi 'byung po'i gtso bo dbang phyug chen po bsgral bas de'i bran du gyur pa'i bgegs phran rnams kyis 'tshe ba'i bsam sbyor rang shugs su zhi bas bar chad mi nus pa dang*/ de'i khog pa dur khrod chen po'i gzhal yas su byin gyis brlabs pa la ḍāk+ki dam can rnams rang bzhin gyis 'du bas bar chad thams cad zhi zhing bkra shis shing byin chags pas dngos grub rnam gnyis 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba 'di dgos pa dang ldan pa'o/ btags pa ming gi ru tra ni/ nang gi rtsa mdud grol zhing gsang ba'i 'og min tu bdud bzhi bcom nas mngon byang lnga yis 'tshang rgya ba'i rten 'brel khyad par can 'grigs pa ste/ de lta bu'i las rim la 'jug pa ni/ rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud las/

srid gsum gdug cing gtum pa la/ /zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur te/ /shes rab thabs kyi ngo bo las/ khro bo de bzhin gshegs sprul mdzad/ ces pa ltar chos nyid ngang gi khro bo/ rang rig ye shes kyi khro bo/ thugs rje shugs kyi khro bo/ phrin las phyag rgya'i khro bo dang bzhi yod pa las/ da lam phrin las phyag rgya'i khro bo nyid dang dpal chen rngam brjid kyi cha byad ltar 'dul ba'i khro bar bcos pa ste/ rgyud las/ khro bo'i tshul can khros pa yis/ /'jig rten gsum dag sreg byed na/ /sangs rgyas thugs rje khros pa yis/ khams gsum ma lus smos ci dgos/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lta ba chos nyid kyi rdzong*/ sgom pa ting 'dzin gyi 'phrang*/ spyod pa snying rje chen po'i ngar dang ldan pas/ bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba gyad kyi lha de nyid gnyen po ting nge 'dzin gyi lha dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i phyag rgya'i gsal snang dang ldan pa'i ngang nas bdag tu lta ba'i ngo bo ma traṃ bkug cing bsgral te khog pa gzhal yas khang du byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang du 'jug pa sogs gzhung gi tshig don rnams kyi bsgom don gsal 'debs pa'i ngang nas las rim la 'jug par zhu/ ༈

sgrub pa po rnams rang rang gi las skal du 'os bab dang bstun pa'i rang gnas su 'khod pa la de ltar du mnga' gsol ba'i skabs rdo rje rgyal tshab bam rgyal thebs kyis zhwa chos bcas gral gsham du bzhengs la/ deng bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan bye ba'i snang ba gsar du 'char ba'i dus 'dir skabs su bab pa ste/ de'ang gsang ba yongs rdzogs chen po'i rgyud las/ rgyud don gsang ba'i sgrub chen la/ /lnga ste phun tshogs gzhi bzung dang*/ /sta gon rim pa'i sgrom bu gzhug /dngos gzhi bsnyen sgrub gzhung bsrangs te/ /mtha' yi cho ga'i rjes bskyang ngo*/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phun sum tshogs pa lngas sgrub pa'i gzhi bting*/ sngon 'gro sta gon gyi cho gas sgrub pa sgrom du gzhug /bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhis sgrub pa'i gzhung bsrang*/ las mtha' rgyas kyis sgrub pa'i rjes bskyang bar bya dgos pa'i nang nas dkyil 'khor bri zhing rgyan bkod yan chad sngon du song nas da lam sgrub pa po rnams 'os bab dang bstun pa'i mnga' gsol ba'i skabs su bab pa ste/ de yang sbyang gzhi 'gro ba thams cad rang bzhin lha'i dkyil 'khor du gnas kyang*/ sbyang bya gnyis 'dzin chags sdang gi rnam pa bral bya'i tshul du bsgribs pa nyid/ sbyong byed gyi cho ga rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde/ de la'ang phyi nang gnyis las nang rgyud gsang chen yo ga gsum du gyur pa de la/ ring brgyud bka' ma nye brgyud gter ma gnyis kyi phyi ma/ rtsa gsum bka' 'dus dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rnam pa lam du byas pas/ sbyangs 'bras gdod nas bzhugs pa'i zung 'jug gi phyag rgya mngon du byed pa'i thabs khyad par can dang mthar thug gi theg pa gsang sngags bla med kyi bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i dgongs pa rjes su 'brel ba ltar phun sum tshogs pa lngas sgrub pa'i gzhi bzung dgos pas/ ༈ de la phyi yi gnas phun sum tshogs pa ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i zhabs kyis bcags shing*/

thub pa'i dbang po gang la sku bltams pa'i lum+bi ni sogs gnas dang*/ mchod rten go ma sa la sogs rten dang*/ lhun grub brtsegs pa sogs dur khrod bkod pa yongs su tshang la khyad par du ma hā gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas yang dag bde gshegs snying po'i sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe bdud kyis bar chad brtsams pas rdo rje phur pa'i dam la bzhag cing de nyid du mchog gi rig 'dzin mngon du mdzad pa'i bal yul yang le shod kyi char srid pa'i lha klu che dgu bod khams brtan ma bcu gnyis sogs bka' dam gyis rtsis su phab cing srid pa gsum du nyi zla ltar grags par gyur ba'i a su ra rang byung rdo rje'i ke'u tshang zhes dpal he ru ka'i pho brang dang mi gnyis pa de nyid dang*/ myur ma dpa' mo'i dgyes zhal gyi re khā bkra ba'i sgrol ma rang byung sogs dang 'dab 'brel ba'i/ gnam lcags sgrub sde gsang sngags phur pa gling zhes sam/ yang na g.yu lo bkod rje btsun gling zhes byin che la/ las bzhi sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen 'dzoms pas bkra shis dge ba'i gnas/ lhun grub yid 'ong gi gnas/ 'phral rkyen sgrub pa'i gnas rnams kyi mtshan nyid kun ldan du/ nang gi gnas phyi nang snod bcud rang lus dang bcas pas gdod nas gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha yi 'khor lo'i rnam par dag pa yin par shes pas dag mnyam bden pa dbyer med lha'i rang bzhin du shes pa dang*/ gsang ba'i gnas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad chos nyid de kho na nyid du lhun gyis grub pa'i ngang na gnas kyang chos kyi dbyings 'gyur ba med pa'i klong du gnas par rtogs pa dang*/ ༈ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa ni/ lam rim las/ ston pa mdzod ldan chu bo rdzogs/ /gnyer ldan rgyud dang las la mkhas/ /man ngag drod 'dzin brgyad 'chang ba/ /rnal 'byor mtha' ldan shin tu brtan/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rab lta ba'i gdeng gis 'khor 'das mnyam nyid du rtogs pa/ sgom pa'i rtsal gyis snang srid dag pa rab 'byams su shar ba/

spyod pa'i rlabs kyis cir snang chos nyid kyi lam du lhong zhing de nyid bcu dang ldan pa'o/ tha na dbang lung man ngag gis rgyud brlan cing brgyud pa'i byin rlabs kyi bag dang ldan pa/ theg pa che chung gi don shes pa cho ga'i phyag len mkhas shing bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad bsrangs ba/ bsnyen sgrub kyi drod rtags thon pa gzhan phan gyi snying rje che ba/ dag snang phyogs med dang ldan pa/ dad ldan slob ma rnams skyong mkhas pa sogs yon tan gyis rgyud phyug pa/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i mgon dang dpung gnyen du gyur pa don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na zhes bya ba dang*/ ༈ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa ni rgyud las/ ston pa mchog brtson rtogs pa gsal/ /dam tshig sngags dang phyag rgya rnams/ /ma nyams shes shing yon tan ldan/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ bde chen rgyud la bskyed pa'i gzungs ma lus ngag yid gsum mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ rigs lnga'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i 'khor rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las kyi gtso bo bzhi yum dang bcas pa/ don gnyis phrin las sgrub pa'i 'khor rgyal thebs kyi ston pa bzhi/ bar chad dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i 'khor rdo rje spyan pa/ rdo rje mtshams pa ging dang bcas pa/ mchod pa'i zhal zas sbyor ba'i 'khor rdo rje drod 'dzin/ byan pho byan mo dang bcas pa/ dad 'dus thugs rjes bzung ba'i 'khor rdo rje'i mched dang lcam dral/ phyi nang brda sbyor byed pa'i 'khor rdul phyags skyes bu ste/ thams cad kyang bsags pa sngon du song ba'i skal ba can/ nga rgyal dang phrag dog chung zhing dad pa chen pos dkar po chos la 'jug nus pa/ mos gus chen pos bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong ba/ dbang bzhi thob pas man ngag gi snod du rung ba/ dam tshig che bas sgrub pa'i gzhi 'ding ba/ shes rab che bas nges pa'i don go nus pa'i sngon sbyangs kyi skal ba bzang po can no/

༈ dus phun sum tshogs pa ni/ thog mtha' dbus med dus bzhi mnyam pa chen po'i ngang las tha dad du 'gyur ba med kyang*/ rtog pa ma zad bar rten 'brel gyi tshul yang mi bslu bar 'byung ba chos nyid yin pa'i tshul/ rgyud rngam klong las/ rig byed dag gi yan lag las/ /dus rnams shes par bya ba ni/ /bkra shis lha yi nyi ma dang*/ /sbyor dang dus tshod bzang ba ni/ /mtshan ma'i rtogs pa yin mod kyang*/ /brtags na dngos grub mtshan ma 'byung*/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skabs 'dir dus khyad par can ni/ bod zla dang po la mtshon na/ gdul bya'i snang ngor bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med don kun grub pa/ 'phags pa'i yul mnyan yod kyi tshal du mnyam par bzhag pas byang chub kyi go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa la/ ma bzod nas bdud dmag bye ba phrag khrig gis dpung chen g.yos nas gnam sa g.yo ba'i ngar sgra dang me chu thog ser mtshon cha'i char phab pa rnams/ ci mi snyam pas byams pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis lhag med du bcom nas gdug pa'i mtshon char me tog gi char dang mchod pa'i sprin du bsgyur te bdud sde rnams ngo tsha kha skyengs pa'i gnas su dpa' bkong ba'i ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul chen po'i mdzad pa bstan pa'i dus tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar dang*/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pas o rgyan gyi rgyal srid kyang snying po med par gzigs nas mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin du spangs shing dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad dbang du bsdus nas grub pa chen po'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs te gzhan don rlabs chen mdzad pa'i dus chen tshes bcu sogs dus 'dzoms pa'i dbo zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes pa brgyad nas bco lnga'i bar te gza' skar 'phrod sbyor sogs dus tshes dge zhing shis par/ sogs kha bsgyur/ zla ba dgu pa la dpes mtshon na/ gdul bya'i snang ngor bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med don kun grub pas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha yul du yum la drin lan bsab pa'i mdo gsungs nas slar yang 'dzam bu gling gi skye dgu'i bsod nams kyi zhing du rdzu 'phrul gyis babs pa dang*/

slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pas bal yul yang le shod du thugs dam yang phur gyi sgo nas phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin mngon du mdzad de dus chen tha skar zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bcur gza' skar sbyor byed sogs lta bu kha bsgyur/ dus tshes dge zhing shis par/ ༈ yo byad phun sum tshogs pa ni/ lam rim las/ gos rgyan bza' btung gsang ba dang*/ /sgrub pa'i yo byad lnga rnams dang*/ /dkyil 'khor yo byad mchod pa'i rdzas/ /dngos grub rten dang bar chad zlog /yo byad dag par bsdu bya ste/ gsungs pa bzhin 'tsho ba zas/ nad zlog sman/ dgra zlog mtshon sogs phyi'i yo byad/ rten rdzas/ sgrub rdzas/ rgyan rdzas/ mchod rdzas/ dbang gi rdzas te nang gi yo byad/ ta na ga na/ shes rab snying rje ste gsang ba'i yo byad du bshad pa spyi dang*/ pho brang nang rten thun mong ma yin pa/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ spros bcas rten sgrub pa'i mchod rdzas ma tshang ba med par 'du byas/ dkyil 'khor gyi ri mo bkra yal le/ snang gsal gyi mar me 'od lhag ge /bdug spos kyi dri bzang ngad thul le/ rdo rje'i mched lcam spro dga' dang byin rlabs thibs se 'du ba'i skabs 'dir ston pa rdo rje slob dpon nyid bskyed rdzogs kyi dgongs pa mdzad cing zab mo'i don ston te rnal 'byor yongs kyi dpal mgon du 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su rdo rje'i khri chen po la bzhugs par gsol/ rigs bzhi'i bskyed rdzogs dang dzap bsnyen bgrang ba'i rgyal tshab chen po bzhi phyogs bzhi/ yab kyi dgongs pa dang bstun zhing sbyor ba'i sgyu rtsal shes pa'i gzungs ma kun tu bzang mo rnams yab kyi g.yon tu/ chos 'chad pa'i rdo rje rgyal thebs/ dngos grub kyi rdzas ster ba'i rin chen rgyal thebs/ dbang bskur ba'i bya ba byed pa dbang gi rgyal thebs/ phrin las kyi gzhung bsrang ba las kyi rgyal thebs rnams kyang phyogs bzhi/

phyi nang bar chad srung ba'i brtul zhugs can rdo rje mtshams pa nub byang*/ sgrol ba'i las dang brda la mkhas pa rdo rje'i king ka ra rnams lho nub/ g.yo sgyu med par mi ma yin mthong zhing nyul le'i bar chad bzlog nus pa'i mig rnon rdo rje spyan pa dang*/ dus sbyor dbyug gu sogs la mkhas shing phrin las kyi skabs phyed pa rdo rje drod 'dzin pa gnyis byang shar/ bag ldan gtsang sbra che zhing rnam smin la 'dzem pa'i rdo rje byan pho byan mo dang*/ nga rgyal med cing bka' bzhin sri zhu la brtson pa'i rdo rje rdul phyags pa rnams shar lho/ mched lcam snod dang ldan pa rin po che lta bu'i gang zag rnams kyang gral gyi bar du bzhugs te/ thams cad kyang chos spyod la brtson 'grus chung ba lus kyi skyon dang*/ smra ba mang zhing bzlas pa la mi brtson pa ngag gi skyon dang*/ zhe sdang che zhing byams pa chung ba yid kyi skyon dang*/ brjed nges che zhing bag zon chung ba dam tshig gi skyon dang*/ chang la dga' zhing gnyid che ba ting nge 'dzin gyi skyon dang*/ g.yeng ba la dga' zhing bsgom sgrub la skyo ba dad pa'i skyon te drug po rnam pa thams cad du spang zhing*/ rtogs pa che bas chos nyid dang mi phyed pa/ dad gus che bas bla ma dang mi phyed pa/ dam tshig che bas yi dam dang mi phyed pa/ brtse gdung che bas mched lcam dang mi phyed pa/ brtul zhugs che bas dam rdzas dang mi phyed pa/ sbyor sgrol brtson pas gzungs ma dang mi phyed pa/ snying rje che bas sems can dang mi phyed pa/ ting nge 'dzin gsal bas dngos grub dang mi phyed pa/ skyon dang bral bas 'bras bu sangs rgyas dang mi phyed pa ste yon tan dgu po la rnam pa kun tu brtson zhing*/ gzhan yang rtsa rgyud las/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi ston pa dang : da lta sangs rgyas 'di dag la: tha dad du ni cung min brtag: rdo rje gsang ba'i grogs dag kyang : de dang rjes su mthun par blta:

sgo gsum gus pas brtson bya zhing : dam pa'i tshig las 'da' mi bya: zhes so/ ༈ chaus phun sum tshogs pa ni/ 'o skol gyi ston pa skal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de nyid kyis gdul bya mtha' yas pa'i khams dbang po bsam pa dang mtshungs pa'i chos kyi sgo 'phar grangs med par phyes pa thams cad mdor bsdus na theg pa rnam pa gsum dang*/ de dag kyang rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa gnyis su 'du ba yin te/ kun byed rgyal po las/ theg pa rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /mtshan nyid rgyu yi theg pa dang*/ /'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa'o/ zhes theg pa'i 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa de la'ang dbye na/ rgyud sde bzhir dbye ba las 'di ni rnal 'byor bla na med pa nang rgyud yo ga gsum zhes che ba drug gis khyad par du 'phags pa'i snga 'gyur rnying ma'i phyogs su gtogs shing de la'ang ring brgyud bka' ma/ nye brgyud gter ma zab mo dag snang gi bab so chen po gsum du mchis pa'i nang tshan/ brgyud thag nye zhing dam sel gyis ma bslad pa'i byin rlabs tshan kha che ba sogs khyad par byas pa'i zab mo gter gyi phyogs su gtogs la/ o rgyan gling pa'i gter lung las/ de nyid mi gnas mya ngan 'das 'og tu: chos log khrims ral dam nyams lung pa gang : lha mi'i gnas su gtam ngan grags pas khyab: sha 'ug stag sgor sbas pa'i gter kha 'di: mi bzhag 'don pa'i rtag de bstan nas su: o rgyan gter bdag gling pa zhes su 'byung : zhes gsungs pa ltar ma hā gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas dang gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes zung gi rnam 'phrul sprul pa'i skyes mchog pad+ma gter bdag gling pa'am/ rig 'dzin gar gyi dbang phyug gnam lcags rdo rje sogs gsang mtshan dgu dang ldan pa de nyid la zab gter bdun cu don lnga'i bgo skal du bzhugs pa'i nang gses bla rdzogs thugs gsum las 'di ni thugs sgrub kyi skor du gtogs la/

de yang rang gzhung ka tho rin chen phreng ba las/ lha sras rje 'bangs la gnang ba'i zhal gdams las/ mnga' bdag rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis: za hor rig 'dzin pad+ma spyan drangs nas: brag dmar dpal gyi bsam yas pho brang bzhengs: bder 'dus bka' 'dus chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: las can skal ldan rje 'bangs smin par mdzad: bod la mdo sngags bstan pa'i nyi ma shar: bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis sems can smin par mdzad: lung rigs gnyis kyis theg chen chos sgra sgrogs: 'chad rtsod rtsom pas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs: rtsod bzlog nga ros mu stegs mtha' ru spyugs: rim gnyis spobs pas bstan pa'i srog shing btsugs: rgya chen rgyun mi 'chad pa'i gter kha sbas: snyan brgyud rgya mtsho gangs can ljongs su 'khyil: bstan pa'i sa gnad mi 'jig me btsa' bsdams: mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gtsug lag chos 'khor bzhengs: 'di phyi bod 'bangs skyob pa'i zhal gdams bkod: man ngag rin chen phreng ba'i tshom bu bkram: gsang sngags bstan pa mtha' ru rgyas par mdzad: rje la zhus pas bka' gnang gegs med grub: de nas lha sras mu khri btsan po dang : rje 'bangs rgya mtsho bka' yi 'bangs bcas nas: bsam yas dam pa'i rgya mkhar rtse dgu'i mdun: pho brang dbu rtse rigs gsum dag la ni: ma 'ongs lung bstan zhus pa snga ma dang : mchims phur bder 'dus skor gsum bar pa'i skabs: phyi ma khra 'brug bka' 'dus zhal phyes tshe: zhus lan zhal gdams le'u bdun ma dang : snga phyi thams cad bkra shis mtha' rten du: rje 'bangs rgyal blon dgongs pa rdzogs pa yi: smon lam bsam pa lhun 'grub rgyab chos bzhag: zhal gdams gsol 'debs phyogs gcig bsgrigs nas su: bskyed rdzogs gnyis bcas lag len gdams pa gnang : man ngag bcu gsum ngo sprod rnam lnga bzhag: de'ang ma 'ongs bod 'bangs la dmigs nas: zhal gdams skor rnams bzhed don so so ltar: rin chen gter kha rnams la bkram ste sbas:

kha byang yang byang rje 'bangs nyer lngar gtad: ma 'ongs lung byang gung thang la thog tu: lha sras mu khri btsan pos dbu mdzad pa: jo mo mtsho rgyal thugs sras bu lnga la: mi brjed dran pa'i smon lam dang bcas gnang : zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ chos rgyal khri srong sogs las can dag pa'i 'khor rnams la thog mar bsam yas dbu rtse rim gsum sogs bde gshegs bka' 'dus chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ bar du mchims phu'i brag dmar ke tshang du thugs sras snying gi bu dgu la bder 'dus skor gsum gyi smin grol phog cing zhal gdams stsal/ tha ma khra 'brug tu lha sras rje 'bangs thugs kyi bu lnga la bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i smin grol zhus len zhal gdams bcas mang du stsal/ snga phyi thams cad kyi mtha' rten du rgyab chos bsam pa lhun 'grub ma zhal gdams man ngag bcu gsum sogs rgyas par bka' stsal/ 'on kyang da lta spel ba'i dus min par bstan pa'ang de nyid las/ da lta spel ba'i dus min yig ger gdab: nam zhig srin yul gdul zhing bgrod pa'i lam: mang yul gung thang la kha bya ba ru: bal bod mtshams der sleb dus khyod la gtad: gdams pa shog dril rje yi thugs dam mdzod: snyan brgyud dbyangs can brda yi ri mor zung : da lta'i rje 'bangs rnams kyis smon lam thob: dge bsnyen shan+ta pu ris gter srung gyis: mchims phu brag btsan thig le gnyer du bskos: zhes gsungs pa bzhin phyis gu ru gung thang la thog tu lha sras mchog dang skyel len gyi tshul du gnang*/ ma 'ongs rje 'bangs rnams kyi don du zab gter du bzhag dgos pa'i bka' stsal bzhin/ gter kha khag tu bkram nas sbas pa'i dus rtags lung bstan dang mthun par sprul pa'i gter chen rnams kyis rim bzhin 'byin par gsungs pa yang*/ 'di nyid 'byin pa'i dus dang sa rtags ni/ sum cu kha dar nyi shu'i dus dang mtshungs: khyad par 'di nas gdung rab mi ring bar:

rnam smin bskyed rgyal phyogs dang phyogs nas 'byung : lo skor dus dang zla zhag so so ru: gdams pa 'di nyid nye bar mkho ba 'byung : de dus lha sras skye ba rim brgyud dang : da lta'i rje 'bangs grogs lngas rim par 'byin: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ yar rje o rgyan gling pa sogs sprul pa'i gter chen du mar bka' babs 'ga' zhig gnas dus rten 'brel skal bas phongs nas phyis yang gter dang dgongs gter sogs su 'phos pa yang byung ngo*/ de dag las khyad par gyur pa 'di nyid ni zhal gdams las/ dam chos don chen yang snying 'dus pa yi: bka' yi them byang 'gag tu 'dril ba 'di: 'byin pa'i sa rtags dbus yul bdud kyis 'dzin: sa steng g.yo ba'i mtha' dmag dbus su 'khrigs: bsam yas rta mgrin mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs: jo shāka mdun du khrag gi rlangs pa 'khrigs: gtsug lag sgrub gnas bshig nas sil bur 'thor: byang sems skyes bu mang po gri ru 'chi: bdud sprul sde dpon mang po snying khrag 'pho: chos spyod sde pa mang po dmangs su 'bebs: dmag 'khrug nad yams mi lo bco brgyad 'byung : bdud kyis ma bslus chos byed nyin skar tsam: me chu rlung gsum 'khrugs pa'i na bun bzhin: phyi dang nang med dbyar sos rlan ltar 'brub: de dus nga nyid sku yi sprul pa'i cha: lo tsā sangs rgyas ye shes khyod la gdams: gsung sprul bai ro tsa na khyod la gdams: thugs sprul lha sras rje bo khyod la gdams: yon tan rdo rje bdud 'joms khyod la gdams: phrin las dbang gi mtsho rgyal khyod la gdams: shog dril sgrub khog lnga ru bgyid nas su: sku tshab gter lnga dbang ba'i bu la bzhag: ma 'ongs skal ldan grogs lnga snga phyi ru: rten 'brel dus las ma 'das 'phrad par shog: khyad par rtsod ldan snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus: sangs rgyas ye shes skye ba rtags rgya can: las can skyes bu de yis 'byin par 'gyur:

zhes dang*/ sa steng thon pa tsam gyis sgom sgrub dang : spel sbyong 'dzin 'chang klog la nan tan gyis: thugs rjes skyob nges the tshom bor la sgrubs: pad 'byung nga ni sems can don las med: 'di phyi don yod nga phyir 'jug rlom na: nyin mtshan dus drug nga la gsol ba thob: dad ldan mdun du nga nyid sprul pa re: mos gus can la sgo nyal lta bu yod: khyad par tshes bcu'i dus su mngon sum mjal: gsol btab rab gnas thebs rnams dag zhing bgrod: rnga yab gling du bdag mjal the tshom med: lhag par sems can sdug bsngal nyam thag tshe: blo yi gzu dpang nga nyid gzu bor zhog: 'di yi go rim yi ge 'phrin pa bcas: skal ldan kun gyi rna bar sim par gyis: zhes sogs zab chos 'di nyid gu ru'i thugs dam mthar thug yin pa'i zhal gdams bka' gtad gnang ba ma zad 'di ni dbus gter zug pa rtsa ba lta bu'i chos sde te/ sngar gu ru bod du byon nas bod kyi lha srin ma rungs pa rnams dam la btags/ bsam yas rten dang brten pa rab gnas dang bcas pa legs par grub nas slar rgya gar la phebs par bzhed pa'i tshe rgyal pos gsang sngags gsungs par zhus pa'i tshe/ da dung yang mthun rkyen ma tshang bar gsungs pas rgyal srid mtsho rgyal dang bcas pa ltos med du phul nas gsol ba btab pas zhal gyis bzhes nas gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol gyi chu bo thog mar gang las bab pa'i yul bod kyi rdo rje gdan zhes dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang dang 'brel ba'i dbus yul bsam yas mchims phu'i brag dmar ke'u tshang zhes bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang chen po rang byung rdo rje'i brag la bder 'dus dkyil 'khor gyi re khā bkra lam mer gsal ba'i gangs can sgrub gnas yongs kyi rgyal po ga la ba der/ rje 'bangs snying gi bu dgu bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du smin grol gyi lam la bkod cing*/

slar gnas mchog de nyid du gu ru yab yum gyis skad cig mig 'phrul ltar mi snang bar rgya yis gdams pa mdzad pa'i sku tshab mthong grol/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi chos sman/ thugs sgrub bde gshegs 'dus pa rtsa ba dang yan lag zhal gdams bcu gsum las phran dang bcas pa/ bod rab byung bcu gnyis sa khyi lor phyi nang gi 'byin pa'i rtags rnams mngon du gyur ba'i skabs/ ngo mtshar ba'i sgyu 'phrul du ma dang bcas khrom gter du bzhes nas/ zab gter chos bdag rnams la smin grol chig rdzogs su bstsal bar mdzad pas/ 'di ni gter gzhung rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las rgyas pa dkyil 'khor bcu gsum gyi dgongs pa ji bzhin gtan la phab ste/ bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa ba'i phrin las 'bring po dkyil 'khor lnga pa'i las byang nas kyang mi 'gal bar brgyan te spyi dril gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun 'grub ma'i las byang chog khrigs ye shes sprin phung zhes/ srid 'dir 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral ba 'di nyid chos kyi bdag po o rgyan rog rje gling pa'am rig 'dzin chen po hūm̐ chen 'gro 'dul/ rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje sogs mtshan du mar bsngags pa de nyid kyis rang nyid rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa rnams kyis tshes bcu'i dus mchod sogs nyams bzhes kyi slad du bka' yi bsdu ba mdzad nas rgya cher spel bas/ lam de nyid brten nas thugs sras rig 'dzin bzhi sogs mchog thun dngos grub thob pa grangs las 'das pa byung ba yin te/ de yang kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa ḍāk+ki'i gsang gtam chen mor/ sprel lo sprel zla'i tshes bcu'i nyin pad+ma 'od gling sin+dhu rgya mtsho'i zhing khams bkod par phyi nang gi mchod pa gzab rgyas dang bcas bdag cag 'dus par bcas pas man ngag bcu gsum spyi dril gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun grub ma'i sgo nas tshes bcu'i cho ga bstar ba las/

spyan 'dren gyi tshe mos gus bla na med pas rkyen byas dpal o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po mtshan dpe'i lang tsho blta bas chog mi shes pa dpa' bo mkha' 'gro til gyi gang bu ltar 'khrigs pa'i klong nas rdo rje'i gar stabs srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i rang bzhin du sgyur zhing*/ man+da ra ba'i me tog gi sil ma kun tu 'thor ba'i ngang tshul can chu bur mig gis spyod yul du gyur pas mos gus kyis brgyal ba tsam gyi ngang nas skal ba bzang po'i dge mtshan ci yang thob bo/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin thugs gter gyi klong chen po brdol bas mtshon 'brel tshad don dang ldan par gyur/ de ltar zab gsang chos kyi bdag po o rgyan rog rje gling pa dang*/ rwa ston stobs rdo rje/ o rgyan dri med gling pa/ rtsa nang gter chen/ lcags zam mchog sprul bdun pa bstan 'dzin ye shes lhun grub/ sngags btsun kun dga' blo gros/ o rgyan 'gro 'dul gling pa nas rim par 'khor lo'i mgon po sūr+ya rasmi'i bar byin rlabs kyi tshan kha ma nyams/ dam sel gyi g.ya' dris ma gos/ dngos grub kyi char rgyun ma chad/ nyams myong gi rtags tshad ma yal/ ma dang mkha' 'gro'i khu rlangs thul le ba rig pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis 'chad spel gyi sgo nas 'gro don dpag med mdzad cing*/ 'o skol rnams kyi bsod nams tshogs gnyis kyi rgya mtsho spel ba'i rgyan du gyur pa gzhung rtsa ba la dbyangs rol cho ga'i las 'grigs bsham bkod sogs so zur gnubs gsum gyi phyag bzhes ma nyams par grags pa'i o rgyan smin grol gling gi bka' srol gyis brgyan na/ byin rlabs kyi bka' bab cing 'brel shin tu che ba nyid de/ rgyud rgyal gsang ba snying po las/ gnas dang longs spyod ci bde dang*/ /ma nyams blo ni rab ldan pa'i/ /le lo sgyid snyoms med pa yis/ /the tshom med par bsgrubs byas na/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/

/rdo rje'i gsang mchog dam pa thob/ ces gsungs pa ltar gzhung las ji skad 'byung ba thams cad legs par bsags te/ gzhi mchod dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan bkod bkra lam me/ snang gsal mar me'i phreng ba rnams 'od phung nge*/ dri zhim spos kyi ngad pa bzang chil le/ dzap bzlas sngags kyi snyan dbyangs de 'ur dir re/ gdangs dbyangs rnga rol 'bud dkrol snyan lhang nge*/ dkyil 'khor lha yi gsal snang khra spungs se/ rdo rje'i mched lcam rnams thugs mthun dam gtsang byin thibs se bzhugs pa'i skabs 'dir/ brgyud pa'i bka' bab 'dzin cing yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i ston pa rdo rje rgyal po nyid 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i mgon du bzhugs par/ zab mo'i don ston cing g.yo med chos nyid kyi dgongs pas byin gyis rlabs par zhu/ de nyid la lta sgom mnyam zhing dkyil 'khor gyi las rab 'byams sgrub par nus pa'i rdo rje rgyal tshab/ gtso bo'i dgongs pa skong zhing tan gan gyi sgyu rtsal la mkhas pa'i gzungs ma/ las bzhi'i phrin las dang lta spyod la dbang ba'i rgyal thebs rigs bzhi ni/ chos 'chad spel dang gdams pa'i gnad dkrol mkhan rdo rje rgyal thebs/ dngos grub kyi rdzas ster ba'i rin chen rgyal thebs/ dbang bskur sbyin sreg gi las byed pa dbang gi rgyal thebs/ phrin las kyi gzhung bsrang ba las kyi rgyal thebs/ cho ga'i bya ba la mkhas shing dbyangs dang rol mo'i byang 'dren pa rdo rje las pa/ dus tshod bcu gnyis kyi nyul le bskrad gzir dang tshar gcod pa la dbang ba'i rdo rje ging chen dang ging chung*/ sgab 'dre mnan zhing phyi nang gi bar chad bzlog pa'i rdo rje mtshams pa/ mig mthong mngon shes kyis legs nyes kyi lung ston nus pa'i rdo rje spyan pa/ dus drug gi thun tshod bzung nas phrin las kyi skabs phyed pa rdo rje drod 'dzin te dus mtshams pa/ gtsang sbra che zhing mchod pa'i las khrig la mkhas pa las kyi rdo rje/

phyi nang gi brda sprod cing kun gyi bka' rnams sgrub pa'i rdo rje bya rogs/ bag ldan gtsang sbra che zhing g.yo gtsang bskol ba dang bza' btung 'dren pa la mkhas pa'i rdo rje'i byan pho mo/ yo byad la mkhas shing mched lcam tshogs su 'du ba'i phyag tshang ste tshogs gnyer chen po/ dkyil 'khor gzhal yas sogs la byi dor dang gtsang sbra mkhas shing nga rgyal med cing bka' bzhin sri zhu la brtson pa'i rdo rje rdul phyags pa/ lha sngags ting 'dzin dang bsnyen sgrub kyi bya ba la brtson pa'i rdo rje'i mched lcam 'khor lo'i tshogs rnams thams cad rang dang go rim la mthun pa'i gral la bzhugs shing*/ rang rang gnyer du gtad pa'i bya ba thams cad lta dgongs ting 'dzin gyi ngang nas bka' gsang chen po'i gzhung dang mthun par g.yel ba med pa'i thugs khur bzhes snyam pa'i ngang nas 'di yi rjes zlos gnang bar zhu/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas gdung 'tshob rdo rje rgyal po 'di: sku gsung thugs dang?gsol dgyes par bzhugs:

bar brjod/ ༈ dpal gyi rtags gdab pa'i skabs su/ 'dir 'dus pa'i rig 'dzin sgrub pa po rnams don gyi dag pa sbyar bas lha dang gnyis su med par rtogs pa dang*/ rtags kyi phyag rgya bcings pas mkha' 'gro dam can pho mo rnams kyis sgrub pa por shes pa dang*/ bar chad kyis mi tshugs shing thabs kyi theg pa'i rigs su nges pa'i 'bras bu myur du 'grub pa sogs dgos pa du ma dang ldan pa'i he ru ka rol pa chen po'i chas su 'jug pa'i skabs su bab pa ste/ che mchog 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ ma 'ongs dus na skyes bu dag: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun ngo bo: sku gsum phrin las che ba'i mchog: kun tu bzang po kun gyi bdag: he ru ka yi tshul 'chang ba: brtul zhugs bzang po de la ni: ma rig log par lta ba'i tshogs: bdud bzhi'i phyogs su gtogs rnams kyis: 'tshe zhing bar du gcod pa'am: gdug cing 'da' bar nus ma yin: zhes gsungs/ de yang rtags phyag rgya'i dbang du byas na/ sngon dpal chen pos yi dwags kyi gtso bo dur khrod bdag po brtul zhing de'i chas rnams dpa' ba'i rtags su bzhes pa las byung ba/ ru tra sde gsum bsgral bas tshar gsum gyi phreng ba/ ru tra'i chung ma ma chags thabs kyis rol pas dbang du bsdus pa rak+ta'i thig le/ tshangs pa chen po bsgral ba zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi/ brgya byin dang de'i bzhon pa glang po che btul ba glang chen gyi ko rlon/ gza' chen nyi ma'i bu mo stag gdong spyan gcig ma btul ba stag gi sham thabs/ klu gdug pa can btul ba sbrul nag gi chun pa/ srin mo nyer bzhi btul ba thal chen gyi tshom bu/ dbang mo nyer brgyad dbang du bsdus pa zhag gi zo ris la sogs pa byung ba yin zhing*/ brda yi dag sbyor gyi don ni/ ye shes lnga po don dam spros bral gyi dbyings su gcig pas thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan rgyu ma'i khong seng gis sbrel ba/ thugs rje ci yang 'byung ba bzhi yis 'gro don mdzad pa'i glang ko

/phyin ci log bzhi dang bral ba'i sbrul chun/ phrin las rnam pa bzhi dang tshad med bzhi lhun la rdzogs pa'i g.yang gzhi/ khams gsum rtog pa 'joms pa'i stag sham/ ma rig rnam rtog gi bud shing ye shes chen po'i dbyings su sbyangs pa'i me dpung*/ dug lnga dbang du sdud pa'i khrag chen gyi thig le/ rgyud drug 'khor ba'i bcud tshogs gnyis kyi gsos su blang ba zhag chen gyi zo ris/ skye shi rtsad nas gcod pa thal chen gyi tshom bu/ dug gsum sku gsum du rdzogs pa thod phreng tshar gsum/ stong pa nyid la bdud bzhi bskyod du med pa'i rdo rje'i go khrab bcas dpal gyi chas bcu ste/ rang rang gi rigs dang mthun par dpal pad+ma he ru ka'-i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i gsal snang dang snyems pas dpal gyi chas rnams mnga' gsol du bzhes shing*/ don gyi dag dran dang ldan par dug lnga rtsad nas gcod/ stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang ldan/ ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad la dbang bskur/ gdug pa can zil gyis mnan/ yi ge 'khor lo tshogs chen gyi sa la mnga' mdzad pa rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho rnam 'phrul bcu gsum ye shes lha'i tshom bu'i dgongs pa las g.yel ba med pa'i ngang nas 'di'i rjes zlos gnang bar zhu/ hrīḥ rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'bras bu'i lam zhugs pa: rtags kyi phyag rgya bder?dbang phyug chen po'i sku la rgyan du bzhes: bar brjod/ ༈ bsre bsnan gyi skabs su dam tshig bsgrags pa'i rjes/ slob dpon nam rgyal tshab pas/ 'o skal pa dang ldan pa'i rdo rje'i mched lcam rnams thugs ma yengs par snyan lhan ner gsan 'tshal/ de yang gsang sngags dbang gi mtha' can/ dbang dam tshig gi mtha' can zhes gsungs pa ltar rdo rje theg pa'i lam thog mtha' bar gsum dam tshig la brten nas bgrod dgos te/ a ti bkod pa'i rgyud las/ snga rabs 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*/ /dam tshig 'di la brten te byung*/

/da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*/ /dam tshig 'di la rab tu gnas/ /slad nas 'byon pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*/ /dam tshig 'di la rab tu bsgrub/ ces gsungs pa ltar dam tshig ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gshegs shul yin pas gces spras su bzung 'tshal te gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ dbang srog dam tshig rjes su bzung*/ /dbye na sa ya 'bum sde las/ /bsdu na nyi shu rtsa lnga ste/ /rtsa ba sku gsung thugs la 'du/ /nyams na rdo rje'i dmyal bar 'gro/ /de phyir mig 'bras lta bur bzung*/ /nyams na slar la bshags par bya/ zhes gsungs pa ltar smin byed kyi dbang sngon du nod cing dbang srog dam tshig la gnas pas grol byed kyi lam la 'jug dgos/ dam tshig ni srog gi dbang po dang mtshungs la/ lam gyi rim pa gzhan rnams dbang po yan lag gzhan dang mtshungs pas 'dir yang*/ sngags kyi dngos grub ma lus pa: dam tshig nyid la brten gyur kyang : zhes gsungs pas dam tshig kho na la gces spras su 'bad 'tshal/ dam tshig gi lha ni rdo rje sems dpa' yin te/ mnyam sbyor las/ sems can kun gyi sems gang zhig /rdo rje zhes ni rab tu brjod/ /rdo rje stong pa nyid du gnas/ /sems dpa' ye shes chen po ste/ zhes gzhi rdo rje sems dpa'i dam tshig mi phyed pa de nyid lam du ma nyams par ston par byed pa dang*/ nyams na bshags pa'i yul du grub la/ 'bras bu'ang de'i go 'phang grub pa spyi dpal chen po zhi ba'i skur bstan pa las gnyis su med de/ dam tshig gi bdag po dpal he ru ka ste dam las mi 'da' ba rnams la sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlabs/ yid la 'dod pa thams cad bstsal/ dam las 'das na snying dbus rdo rje gnod sbyin rab tu khros pas mi zad pa'i sdug bsngal bskyed par mdzad/ dam tshig gi srung ma phra men ma bcu drug /spyan pa dbang phyug nyer brgyad rnams kyis kyang legs nyes kyis stangs 'dzin cing dge sdig gi la shan 'byed pa yin pas mngon lkog dang le lo med par/

dran pa dang shes bzhin pa'i bag yod par bsrung dgos shing*/ gang bsrung bar bya ba ni sa ma ya 'bum sde gsungs pa'ang thun mong spyi'i dam tshig nyer brgyad/ sgrub pa khyad par gyi dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis rnams su 'dus te/ de yang rtsa ba sku'i dam tshig tu slob dpon rnam pa bzhi khong pa'i snying ltar btsa'/ rdo rje'i mched bzhi po lus dang mig ltar blta/ gsung gi dam tshig tu sngags kyi snying po lnga dang phyag brgya bzhi rgyun ma chad par nyams su len/ thugs kyi dam tshig tu spyi dang bar gsang gsang 'os gnyer du gtad pa'i gsang bcu sbas/ yan lag gi spyad bya/ mi spang ba/ dwang du blang ba/ shes bya/ bsgrub bya'i dam tshig lnga tshan lnga yal bar mi 'dor ba bsrung bas thun mong gi dam tshig rnam par dag khyad par gyi dam tshig nyer gcig ltem rkyang med par lha chos mi chos bka' chos gsum gyi sgo nas bsrung bas khyad par gyi dam tshig rnam par dag /'khor gsum byang chub sems kyi thig le nyag gcig las gud na med pas bsrung mtshams bral ba'i ye bsrungs chen por rtogs pa lta ba'i dam tshig thugs rje'i dpyang thag ldan pas dam tshig nyams su yang med cing*/ nyams pa'ang myur du 'chos par 'gyur ro/ bang mdzod 'phrul lde las/ spyir ni gsang sngags dam tshig ni/ /bsrung na bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /sa ma ya ni 'bum sde yod/ /ji bzhin pa yi chos nyid la/ /ma bcos pa yi blo bzhag na/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes te/ /mnyam nyid g.yo ba med pa ni/ /dam tshig thams cad bsrung ba yin/ /nyams pa'i chad pa byung ba la/ /mgon skyabs de las che ba med/ ces gsungs/ lta ba mthar phyin pa ma rtogs pa'i gang zag mos slob pas dam tshig nyams na me dang 'dra ste 'tshig /so mtshams kyi mkhar dang 'dra ste rang gzhan phung*/ dug dang 'dra ste thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod/ snying phyung na sman ci tsam btang yang bde bar mi 'gyur ba bzhin du sgom sgrub legs pa ci byas kyang dam tshig nyams na 'bras bu mi 'byung ba lha rnams kyang rang gshed du dbab nas tshe 'dir mi rung pa du ma 'byung zhing*/

phyi ma dmyal khams bco brgyad thams cad kyis kyang sdug bsngal do zla med pa'i rdo rje'i dmyal ba chen por skyes nas sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las mdzad kyang thar pa'i dus med par 'gyur la/ nyams pa'i rgyud kyang slob dpon gsang zhing rang che 'byin pa/ /lung ma nos pa slob dpon gyi sa bzung ba/ kha spyod dang lta spyod mi mthun pa/ gsang ba smra zhing gsang ba'i dam tshig cher mi 'dzin pa/ rgyal blon gyi bya ba sogs mi chos la gtso bo 'dzin pa/ nga rgyal dang rang mthong chang dad che ba/ chos la phyogs ris che zhing gshe skur mang ba/ bdag bstod gzhan smod kyi zur za byed pa/ gtsang dme dang rtog pa shas che bas dam bca' 'dor zhing gnyen po med pa/ sdig pa'i grogs po dang 'grogs pa/ thos pa chung zhing bla ma mkhas pa dang bral ba/ spyod pa thod rgal du byed cing gcig pur mi tshugs pa sogs dam tshig nyams pa'i snga rtags dang bcas te rgyal ba'i bka' chad du ma 'byung bar gsungs pas/ srog dang mig 'bras ltar btsa' bas dam tshig mi nyams pa bsrung zhing*/ nyams chag byung ba dag kyang rab kyis lta ba skye med kyi ngang du la bzla/ 'bring gis srog lan gsum btang ba sogs thabs la mkhas pas bshags/ tha mas kyang gnong 'gyod drag po'i sgo nas stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bshags pas 'chags shing phyin chad bsdoms te legs par bsrungs pa'i phan yon kyang*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang 'dra bar dgos 'dod 'byung*/ sa gzhi dang 'dra bar yon tan thams cad skyed/ nam mkha' dang 'dra bar thams cad kyi go 'byed/ tshe 'dir yang ma nyams pa'i snga rtags legs pa'i yon tan du ma 'byung zhing*/ ring por mi thogs par dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje'i rang gzugs dpal he ru ka'i go 'phang mngon du byed par 'gyur te/ bkod pa chen po'i rgyud las/ rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa yis/ /dngos grub ya mtshan chen po sgrub/ /phrin las bzhi po thogs med cing*/

/rtogs pa mchog gis gong du 'phel/ zhes gsungs/ 'jam dpal grags pas/ zhing gzhan bskal mang sdom la gnas pa bas/ /skad cig 'dir gnas 'bras bu rdzogs par byed/ ces gsungs pas bag yod dus thung ngu re bsten yang don chen por 'gyur zhing*/ de dag kyang mdor bsdu na/ sems la dge ba cha dang bcas pa bsgrub cing*/ mi dge ba cha dang bcas pa bsdoms nas g.yo sgyu'i skyon med pa la 'dus te/ rdo rje snying po phra ba 'byung gnas kyi rgyud las/ dam tshig sdom pa rnam bshad pa/ /kun kyang rang gi sems las so/ /de yi 'phen pa bla mas shes/ /de phyir sems la 'dris pa'i mis/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams mthong ba dang*/ /sku gsum tshad du 'byongs pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas yon tan mngon par 'grub/ /bla ma rtag tu bsten pa'i mis/ /mkha' 'gro'i gzugs rnams mthong ba dang*/ /de yi byin rlabs 'jug pa dang*/ /dus gsum lung yang ston pa dang*/ /skye shi gnyis la dbang thob 'gyur/ /grogs la brtse gdung ldan pa'i mis/ /'gro ba thams cad 'dul ba dang*/ /kun gyis snyan par grags pa dang*/ /gzugs can kun kyang byams pa dang*/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'du ba dang*/ /ma bsgrub dngos grub 'byung ba dang*/ /ngag la nus pa 'bar ba dang*/ /de bzhin mchog dang thun mong 'dir/ /dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /rtag tu dgon par gnas pa'i mis/ /rlung sems tshad med zin pa dang*/ /snang ba grogs su 'char ba dang*/ /rang gi sems la dbang thob 'gyur/ /bla ma bsnyen bkur byas pa'i mi/ /longs spyod mchog dang ldan pa dang*/ /'khor 'bangs rgyas shing bsod nams ldan/ /'gro ba yongs las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu dbang rdzogs byas pa'i mi/ /'gro ba'i gtso bor 'gyur ba dang*/ /kun gyis mthong ba dga' ba dang*/ /ye shes mngon sum 'byongs pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin brlab 'gyur/ /rtag tu gtor ma'i las byed pa/ /bsod nams tshogs rnams rdzogs pa dang*/

/bar chad med cing las rnams 'grub/ /'dod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ /mkha' 'gro bran bzhin khol bar 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pas rdo rje'i mched lcam rnams bag yod dran shes dang ldan pas rtag tu dam tshig sdom pa la nan tan du bzung bar mdzod cig ༈ bzlas dmigs skabs su 'di ltar bshad par bya'o/ da lam/ mched lcam rnams bsnyen pa mi bcad par shub bur bzla bzhin du bsgom don gsal 'debs cung zad zhu ba la gsan 'tshal/ de yang bdag cag gi ston pas chos 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskor ba thams cad bsdu na rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa gnyis su 'du/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa las khyad par du mas 'phags pa 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa yin/ rdo rje theg pa la rgyud sde bzhi dang sgo drug la sogs pa'i dbye na du ma yod pa rnams rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud la 'dus te/ de'ang rgyud sde dang sgrub sde gnyis las phyi ma yin la/ de la'ang bka' gter gyi bab so gnyis las nye brgyud zab mo gter gyi phyogs su gtogs shing de yang slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa bod du phebs nas gdul bya dus la bab pa'i tshe/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis rgyal srid dang*/ ye shes mtsho rgyal/ de mthun dam rdzas bcas gu ru la phul nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ bsam yas mchims phu brag dmar ke'u tshang du gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes sogs snying gi bu dgu la sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor chen po zhal phyes nas dbang bskur bas so so'i me tog ji ltar phog pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi zhal mthong zhing thun mong gi sprul bsgyur nyi zla gdan du bting ba brag la phur pa 'debs pa sogs/ sku tshe de nyid kyi rigs kyi bdag po dang gnyis su med pa'i go 'phang brnyes pas thog drangs/ rje 'bangs nyer lnga/ yer pa'i grub thob brgya rtsa/ shel brag gi sngags pa sum cu/ yang rdzong rtogs ldan nga lnga/ rang grol gyi rnal 'byor ma nyer lnga sogs grub thob kyi tshang chen po brdol ba yin la/

de lta bu gu ru pad+ma dang rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i rnam 'phrul gter ston brgya rtsa bcas mang du byon pa so so la yang*/ bka' dgongs phur gsum bla rdzogs thugs gsum sogs mang du bzhugs pa las/ dgongs 'dus lta bur mtshon na gter chen sangs rgyas gling pa la bla ma dgongs 'dus/ bsam gtan gling pa la yi dam dgongs 'dus sogs bka' bab la/ mkha' 'gro dgongs 'dus ni gter ston 'ga' zhig la bka' bab kyang cha shas tsam las phab ma thub par grags shing*/ 'di ni gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi sku yi skye ba bcu gsum pa pad+ma gter bdag gling pa'am rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'am/ rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus kyi chos skor yin par bzhed la de yang tshe gcig la 'od skur grub pa nyag bla pad+ma bdud 'dul gyi mdzad pa'i gsol bsdus las kyang*/ rtsa gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa'i klong yangs nas/ /rtsa gsum rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med pa/ /rig 'dzin gar dbang rtsa gsum gling pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs dbang bskur stsol/ zhes gsungs pa'i mtshon dam pa du ma'i zhal gyi bzhes pa bzhin rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'am/ bla rdzogs thugs gsum gyi nang gses bla ma'i thugs sgru+ub kyi tshom bu tshogs su sgrub pa rtsa gsum kun 'dus dkyil 'khor 'di lta bu'i lha sngags la bsten pa skal ba re bzang snyam pas/ bla ma la mos gus/ yi dam la dad spro/ mched lcam la gdung shugs/ le lo spang ba'i brtson 'grus brtan po'i sgo nas/ phyi ma hā yo ga ltar thabs kyi brjod bya thams cad rdul tshon dang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor steng du gtan la phab ste bsgrub pa dang*/ nang a nu yo ga ltar shes rab rgyud kyi brjod bya thams cad phung khams skye mched rtsa rlung thig le'i dkyil 'khor du gtan la phab ste bsgrub pa dang*/ gsang ba a ti yo ga ltar bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen thams cad kyi rim pa rnams gnyis med zung 'jug tu gtan la phab cing*/

de gsum po re re la yang thag bcad pa/ la dor ba/ sa bzung ba gsum bskyed rdzogs gong shing dgu la brten nas nyams su len tshul rgya cher gsungs pa las/ da lam phyi'i dkyil 'khor la gtso cher brten te sgrub pa chen po'i rim pa nyams su len pa'i skabs 'dir/ bsnyen sgrub brtson pa yongs kyi rnam pa gsal ba/ nga rgyal brtan pa/ rnam dag dran pa'i sgo nas yul gsum rab tu gsal nas lha gyad du gyur pa'i sku yi sgrub lugs/ lus kyis phreng ba/ ngag gis snying po/ yid kyis lha sngags ting nge 'dzin te bzla tshul gsum gyi sgo nas/ sngags dang sngags kyi gzhi/ gzungs dang gzungs kyi sgo/ rig pa dang rigs sngags kyi don shes pas 'phro 'du'i phreng ba dang bcas gsung gi sgrub lugs/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dgongs pa thig le nyag gcig ngang rim gnyis kyi ting 'dzin la ma yengs pa'i gnad med na 'bras bu 'byin mi nus pas/ rnal 'byor pa rnams sems sangs rgyas su shar bas lam la bgrod du med par shes/ snod bcud dkyil 'khor du shar bas 'bras bu rang byung lhun rdzogs su shes/ sdug bsngal bde chen du shar bas snang ba sna tshogs chos nyid du khyer shes/ nyon mongs ye shes su shar bas spang blang dgag sgrub rang sar grol ba'i gnad shes/ rnam rtog chos nyid du shar bas chos sku rang la ye nas gnas pa'i don shes pa ste shes pa rnam pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rnal 'byor 'bring rnams/ stong gsum lha'i gzhal yas su gsal bas dkyil 'khor la che chung dang yangs dogs med/ phung khams lha ru gsal bas bar chad gdon bgegs kyi yul dang bral/ snod kyi 'jig rten gtor snod du gsal bas mchod gtor la bzang ngan gyi mtshan 'dzin med/ snang srid thams cad rdzas su gsal bas srung ma dam can mi dgyes pa'am mi skong ba'i skyon zad/ gnas lugs stong pa nyid du gsal ba la sangs rgyas kyi chos ma lus pa rang sems su rdzogs pa ste/

gsal ba rnam pa lnga dang ldan pa zhig nges par dgos la/ bskyed rim rtag brtan ther zug tu bzung bas lha 'grub pa'i dus med/ phrin las gyer la sgom med du bzung bas gsang sngags dam med lto phyir bon gyer du song*/ sngags dang snying po rang rgyud par bzung bas byin rlabs dang nus pa'i rgyu med/ rdzas dang gtor chung bshos bur bzung zhing za 'dod dang brnab sems kyi 'bras bu'i dkor dang rnam smin gyi 'dam du tshud/ 'bras bus 'jig rten rtag chad du bzung bas ru tra'i gol sar ltung ba ste sngags pa tha ma bzung ba lngas ma bcings ba ni gal che/ mdor na gsang sngags bla med la zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pa ni/ lta ba'i gdeng gis 'khor 'das rang sems su thag chod pa/ sgom pa'i nyams kyis snang srid dag pa rab 'byams su shar ba/ spyod pa brtul zhugs kyis gang byung lam du longs pa zhig dgos shing*/ de yang bskyed rdzogs gang gi skabs su yang blos bcos nas bsgom pa ni dpem̐/ gdod nas rang bzhin gyis grub pa ni dom̐n te/ sems nyid 'gag med kyi 'char sgo thams cad bskyed rim/ ngo bo stong nyid du khrig ger gnas pa rdzogs rim/ de gnyis gsar du bsre ma dgos pa/ gdod nas tsan+dan dang dri/ nyi ma dang 'od zer gyi tshul du 'bral med zung 'jug tu gnas pa/ ngo bo gsal stong gnyis su med pa ni dom̐n/ rang bzhin phung khams skye mched du shar ba gdod nas lha'i 'khor lor dag pa'i brdam̐/ de nyid mngon du gyur pa'i phyir lha sngags ye shes kyi rnam pa lam du phyed pa gzhi rtagam̐s te/ snang srid gzhir bzhengs su rang byung gi dkyil 'khor zhes mngon sum gyi rim gnyis thams cad de'i khongs su ma 'dus pa gcig kyang med pas bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad de ltar nges pa dang*/ rgyud las/ don grub dngos grub thob pa ni/ /sngags kyi bzlas pas 'grub pa yin/ zhes gsungs pa gtso cher sngags bzla ba la'ang*/

bum dbang dang mthun par phyi rtsol bcas tshig 'bru'i sngags/ gsang dbang dang mthun par nang lhun grub rang byung gi sngags/ sher dbang dang mthun par gsang ba skye med rdo rje'i sngags/ dbang bzhi pa dang mthun par de kho na nyid spros bral brjod med kyi sngags rnams dbang po dang mthun par nyams su len par gsungs shing*/ rtsol bcas kyi sngags la'ang spro bsdus bzlas pa/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ 'gog bzlas sogs yod de/ ji skad du/ ting 'dzin me dang 'dra ba la/ /bzlas brjod rlung dang 'dra bas bskul/ zhes ting nge 'dzin gsal zhing brtan pa ni bud shing dang me'i sa bon rgyu rkyen 'dzoms pa la/ gsang sngags skyon dang bral ba'i bzlas brjod byed pa ni rlung gi dper mdzad pas me dang bud shing 'dzoms par rlung gis bskul na lhag par 'bar ba bzhin ting nge 'dzin dang sngags bzla ba 'dzoms pas bsgrub bya'i 'bras bu shin tu myur ba'i thabs kyi mchog yin zhing*/ de yang ngag bzlas skabs rin chen phreng ba las/ bzlas pa byed tshe long gtam kyal ka dang*/ khro dang 'thab dang shags dang 'jug 'dzin dang*/ /zhum dang lhag pa'i nga rgyal rnam par spangs/ /smra dang rnam rtog spros pa rnam par bcad/ /lha dang sngags las gzhan la mi bsam mo/ zhes pa ltar bzlas pa'i phan yon kyang de nyid las/ lan gcig tsam la sngags brjod na/ /'das dang 'byung dang 'byung gang yin/ /gang gi lce la smra 'gyur ba/ /de dbang bden pa thob par 'gyur/ zhes sngags kyi bden pa 'grub pas bstan srung mthu/ tshe mthud bu/ zang zing nor/ mchog gi dngos grub phun sum tshogs pa 'grub par gsungs la/ bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor la brtson pas dgra gsum sod/ bdud bzhi choms/ 'gro drug gi g.yang sa chod/ mi slob pa'i zung 'jug sku bzhi ye shes lnga mngon du 'gyur bas dad brtson drag pos gzhan du ma yengs par/ snang ba lha/ lha rang sems/ sems stong nyid/ grags stong sngags kyi rol par shes pa'i ngang gzhung nas 'byung ba'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du la rtse gcig nyams su len par zhu/

sgrub pa grol skabs phan yon dang 'brel ba'i mar me'i smon lam ni/ de ltar bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi spros bcas sgrub pa chen po tshom bu tshogs su sgrub pa sbyor dngos rjes gsum rig 'dzin gong ma'i phyag bzhes bzhin tshang la bar chad med par mtha' rgyas su grub ste/ de yang spyir o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i bstan pa'i snying po gter gyi chos la dad pa thams cad/ gu ru nyid bod du phebs pa'i skabs su zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i skal ba dang ldan par gsungs te/ ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi zhal nas/ ma 'ongs pad+ma'i chos la dad pa kun: deng sang gu ru'i zhal mthong smon lam btab: thams cad las can yin pas dga' ba sgoms: kho mo'i tshig 'di rin chen gser las dkon: zhes gsungs pas gzhung tshad ldan nas gsungs pa tshul bzhin nyams su len pa rnams gu ru nyid kyi byin rlabs kyi rol rtsal yin pa'ang gsungs te/ dgongs 'dus lung bstan bka' rgya ma las/ mdor na o rgyan ngas bstan chos rnams la: gzhung bzhin su dang su yis spyod pa kun: thams cad nga yi sprul pa yin par nges: ma 'ongs kun gyis yid gnyis the tshom spongs: gus pas bkur bsti phu dud 'brel pa zhog: ces dang*/ o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas/ gsang sngags don gyi snying po 'di kho na: sgrub chen 'di yi ming tsam su gang 'dzin: o rgyan nga dang snying khrag gcig tu 'dres: zhes dang*/ pad+ma nga yi srog gi dwangs ma ste: dus gsum rgyal ba'i srog snying 'di kho na: dus gsum rgyal ba spyi sgrub 'di ka zab: 'di 'chang o rgyan nga dang 'bral ba med: rig 'dzin brgyad 'dus dam can bran du khol: yang zab snying po mar gyi nying khu dang : dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba ma lus pa: thams cad thams cad ma lus 'dis 'grub ste: de la dus gsum rgyal ba spyi sgrub yin: tshig tshogs mang bas mi zab don la 'di:

o rgyan nga yis thugs bcud min re kan: zhes dang*/ yang gu ru'i zhal nas/ nga mthong sangs rgyas thams cad mthong*/ /nga sgrub sangs rgyas thams cad 'grub/ /nga nyid sangs rgyas kun 'dus yin/ zhes gsungs pas na the tshom dang yid gnyis ma byed par bsgrubs na smos ci/ tha na glegs bam tsam dad pa'i rten du bzung yang*/ gsang ba'i rgyud chen sgrub yig gang sus 'dzin/ /de phyogs thams cad bde gshegs kun 'dus te/ /sha rul dag la sbrang ma ji bzhin no/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin yi dam sgrub sde brgyad sogs thams cad 'dir ma 'dus pa med cing bla ma yi dam kun 'dus 'di lta bu'i sgrub pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa rang gis lo gsum mtshams dam du bcad pa las kyang tshom bu tshogs sgrub zhag bdun phan yon che ste/ rgyud chen gsang ba 'dus pa las/ dad brtson drag pos sgrub gyur na/ /mtshams med lnga po spyad pas kyang*/ /dngos grub thob pa gsang sngags khyad/ /dam ldan rnams la smos ci dgos/ zhes gsungs/ 'di lta bu'i phan yon 'byung ba mi bden sogs bsam mi rung ste/ 'di phyogs the tshom za ba'i mi gang su/ /tshe 'dir yid du mi 'ong kun 'dus nas/ /mnar med rdo rje'i dmyal te der 'gro bas/ /kun gyi thun mong ma yin gsang dam srungs/ zhes kyang gdams par mdzad cing*/ mdor na mchog thun dngos grub ma lus pa myur du 'grub pa'i thabs su lan gcig ma yin par rdo rje'i lung gis yang yang bsngags pa yin la/ phan yon de ldan gyi sgrub pa legs par grub pa la dga' spro dad mos yid ches dang ldan pas slad nas kyang rdo rje rgyal po dang rgyal thebs/ gzungs ma mched lcam dkyil 'khor gcig tu tshogs shing mar me gcig la bltas pa thams cad gcig gis gcig la khong khro nga rgyal sgro skur sogs kyis dam tshig la sel bslad ma zhugs par lha dang dkyil 'khor gyi tshul du blta dgos pa dang*/ 'di nas byang chub ma thob bar du dam tshig rdo rje'i lu gu rgyud gcig tu sbrel ba/
